attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM line represents an alternative or substitute component that can be used in place of the primary component. Alternative items are used when the primary component is unavailable, supporting supply continuity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Alternative Item Group (ALGRU); VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) Practices

attributes.name: is_critical_component
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is designated as critical to the production of the parent SKU. Critical components trigger priority procurement actions and are subject to enhanced supply chain monitoring and safety stock policies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) Best Practices

attributes.name: issue_method
attributes.description: The method by which this component is issued from inventory to the production order. Backflush automatically posts consumption upon order confirmation; manual requires explicit goods issue; pick list generates a picking document; kanban uses replenishment signals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Backflush Indicator (RGEKZ); Siemens Opcenter MES; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this BOM line record was most recently updated. Used for change detection, data synchronization, and audit trail purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Changed On (AEDAT/AEZET); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements; ISO 9001

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: The number of days before or after the parent order start date that this component must be available. Positive values indicate the component is needed before production start; negative values indicate it is needed after. Used in MRP scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Lead Time Offset (EWAHR); MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position number of this component line within the parent BOM, used for ordering and referencing individual line items. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category. Corresponds to SAP BOM item number (POSNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - CS11 Item Number (POSNR)

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line item. Controls whether the component is included in active MRP runs and procurement planning. Inactive or obsolete lines are retained for historical traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Governance

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of this component that must be ordered from the supplier in a single purchase order. Used in procurement planning to ensure order quantities meet supplier MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Minimum Order Quantity (MINBM); MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) Procurement Standard

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production routing operation or work center step at which this component is consumed. Enables precise material staging and backflushing in the MES and MRP systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Routing Operation (VORNR); Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: phantom_item_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM line represents a phantom assembly — a logical grouping of components that is not physically stocked or produced as a discrete item but is exploded through in MRP planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Phantom Item Indicator (SHKZL); MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: The EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) registration number for this chemical component. Required for substances manufactured or imported into the EU above threshold quantities.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)

attributes.name: recursive_bom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component itself has a subordinate BOM (i.e., it is a sub-assembly or semi-finished good with its own BOM structure). Used to identify multi-level BOM explosion requirements in MRP planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Multi-Level BOM Explosion; MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the component required to produce one unit of the parent SKU at the base quantity defined in the BOM header. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category. Supports MRP and COGS calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module - BOM Component Quantity (MENGE); MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: The expected percentage of this component that will be lost or wasted during the manufacturing process. Used to inflate the planned component quantity in MRP runs and COGS calculations. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.5 = 2.5%).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Component Scrap (AUSSS); GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: The document number or reference identifier for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this hazardous component. Links to the SDS stored in Veeva Vault or the document management system for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault Quality Documents; SDS (Safety Data Sheet)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the operational system of record from which this BOM line was sourced (e.g., SAP_S4HANA, ORACLE_ERP). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards; SAP S/4HANA; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The designated warehouse storage location or bin where this component is staged for production consumption. Used by WMS and MES for material staging, goods issue, and FEFO/FIFO inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Module - Storage Location (LGORT); Blue Yonder WMS; FEFO (First Expired First Out); FIFO (First In First Out)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the required quantity of the component (e.g., KG, L, EA, M, G). Must align with the component material master UOM. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category (measurement dimension).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); GS1 UN/ECE Recommendation 20

attributes.name: usage_probability_pct
attributes.description: The probability (expressed as a percentage, 0–100) that this alternative component will actually be used in production. Used by MRP to calculate weighted component requirements across alternative item groups.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Usage Probability (EWAHR)

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line is effective and should be included in production and MRP planning. Supports date-effective BOM management for product reformulations and packaging changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - BOM Valid From Date (DATUV); PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM line is no longer effective and should be excluded from production and MRP planning. Null indicates the line is open-ended with no planned expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - BOM Valid To Date (DATUB); PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)

products.name: product_formulation
products.description: Formulation master record capturing the approved chemical or ingredient recipe for a consumer goods product (household, personal care, health, or hygiene). Stores formulation code, version number, formulation name, product category, regulatory approval status, pH range, viscosity, color, fragrance code, preservative system, and the R&D project reference. Tracks the full formulation lifecycle from lab development through commercial approval. Sourced from Veeva Vault PLM.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the formulation master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Formulation approval must be signed off by a qualified employee for GMP compliance.

attributes.name: research_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_formulation. Business justification: Provides audit trail from final product formulation back to its research formulation for change management and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) document associated with this formulation, stored in Veeva Vault. Required under OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom) and EU REACH for hazardous substances.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary active ingredient in the formulation (e.g., 'Salicylic Acid', 'Zinc Pyrithione', 'Fluoride'). Required for OTC drug product regulatory filings with FDA and for consumer-facing efficacy claims.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21 OTC Monographs; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: active_ingredient_pct
attributes.description: Concentration of the primary active ingredient expressed as a weight percentage (w/w%) of the total formulation. Proprietary trade secret data. Governs regulatory classification (OTC drug vs. cosmetic), label claims, and dosage compliance.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU REACH Regulation; ISO 22716

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: Free-text or structured declaration of regulated allergens present in the formulation above threshold concentrations (e.g., EU 26 listed fragrance allergens, FDA major food allergens for food-contact products). Required for consumer safety labeling.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III; FDA CFR Title 21; IFRA Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formulation received final commercial approval in the PLM system. Marks the transition from regulatory review to approved lifecycle stage and triggers manufacturing authorization.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: bom_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this formulation to the corresponding Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP S/4HANA PP/MM. Enables traceability between the approved formulation recipe and the manufacturing BOM used for production planning and Material Requirements Planning (MRP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: color_description
attributes.description: Standardized color description of the finished formulation as specified in the quality standard (e.g., 'White to off-white', 'Clear colorless', 'Pale yellow'). Used in visual QC inspection and consumer safety documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this formulation record was first created in the source PLM system (Veeva Vault). Provides audit trail for formulation lifecycle tracking and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ISO 9001; SOX

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this formulation version is authorized for use in commercial manufacturing. May differ from approval_date when a transition period is required to consume existing raw material stocks.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: formulation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the formulation within the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Sourced from Veeva Vault PLM and used as the cross-system business key across SAP S/4HANA QM and Siemens Opcenter MES.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: formulation_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the formulation as registered in the PLM system (e.g., 'Moisturizing Body Lotion Base v2 - Fragrance Free'). Used in regulatory submissions, quality documents, and R&D reporting.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Physical form classification of the formulation describing its physicochemical structure. Drives manufacturing process selection, packaging requirements, and stability testing protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emulsion|solution|suspension|gel|powder|foam|aerosol|solid — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA CFR Title 21; Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: fragrance_code
attributes.description: Proprietary or supplier-assigned code identifying the fragrance ingredient blend used in this formulation. Required for IFRA compliance assessment, allergen declaration, and INCI ingredient listing on product labels.
attributes.references: IFRA (International Fragrance Association) Standards; EU REACH Regulation; ISO 22716

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation has been developed and validated in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards. Required for commercial manufacturing authorization and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR Part 111; GMP

attributes.name: inci_declaration
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Declaration
attributes.description: Full International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) ingredient list for the formulation in descending order of concentration, as required for product label compliance. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients); EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA CFR Title 21 Part 701

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Declared intended use or application of the formulation (e.g., 'Rinse-off body wash for daily use', 'Leave-on facial moisturizer', 'Hard surface disinfectant cleaner'). Determines regulatory classification pathway and labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; CPSC; EPA

attributes.name: is_cruelty_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation and its constituent ingredients have not been tested on animals. Supports cruelty-free certification claims and compliance with EU animal testing ban under Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Article 18; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: is_fragrance_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation contains no added fragrance ingredients. Drives consumer-facing label claims, regulatory declarations, and product positioning for sensitive-skin or hypoallergenic product lines.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Labeling; EU REACH Regulation; FDA CFR Title 21

attributes.name: is_vegan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation contains no animal-derived ingredients or by-products. Supports consumer-facing vegan label claims and retailer listing requirements for vegan-certified product ranges.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; ISO 22716

attributes.name: lab_notebook_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the electronic laboratory notebook (ELN) entry or physical lab notebook record documenting the original formulation development experiments. Provides scientific traceability for regulatory submissions and IP protection.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this formulation record in the source PLM system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ISO 9001; SOX

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the formulation in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) workflow, from initial lab development through commercial approval and eventual obsolescence. Governs which business processes may consume this formulation record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: obsolescence_date
attributes.description: Date on which this formulation version was or is scheduled to be retired and replaced by a newer version. Null for currently active formulations. Used in manufacturing planning to manage version transitions.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: ph_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable pH value of the formulation as defined in the approved specification. Together with ph_min, defines the pH range tolerance band for quality control (QC) release testing and in-process checks.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA CFR Title 21; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: ph_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable pH value of the formulation as defined in the approved specification. Used in quality control (QC) testing and stability assessments. pH range is a critical quality attribute (CQA) for consumer safety and product efficacy.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA CFR Title 21; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: preservative_system
attributes.description: Description or code identifying the preservative system used in the formulation (e.g., 'Phenoxyethanol/Ethylhexylglycerin', 'Benzalkonium Chloride', 'Paraben-free system'). Critical for regulatory compliance, challenge testing, and consumer safety claims.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation; FDA CFR Title 21; ISO 22716; INCI Nomenclature

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level consumer goods product category to which this formulation belongs (e.g., Personal Care, Household Cleaning, Health & Hygiene, Baby Care, Oral Care). Drives regulatory framework selection and INCI declaration requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: personal_care|household_cleaning|health_hygiene|baby_care|oral_care|hair_care|skin_care|fabric_care — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU REACH Regulation; ISO 22716

attributes.name: rd_project_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this formulation to the originating Research and Development (R&D) / New Product Development (NPD) project in the PLM system. Enables traceability from commercial formulation back to the innovation pipeline.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) registration number assigned under EU REACH Regulation for substances manufactured or imported above 1 tonne per year. Required for market access in the European Union.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the formulation as assessed against applicable jurisdictional requirements (FDA, EU REACH, CPSC). Determines whether the formulation may be used in commercial manufacturing. Distinct from internal PLM lifecycle stage.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU REACH Regulation; CPSC; ISO 22716

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory product classification determining the applicable compliance framework and submission pathway. Drives FDA, EPA, or CPSC filing requirements and labeling obligations.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EPA; CPSC; EU REACH Regulation; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009

attributes.name: rspo_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) Certified Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether palm oil or palm-derived ingredients in this formulation are sourced from Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) certified supply chains. Supports sustainability reporting and retailer ESG requirements.
attributes.references: RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); ISO 14001 - Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier of this formulation in the originating source system (Veeva Vault PLM). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer and the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Financial Reporting

attributes.name: stability_period_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf-life stability period of the formulation expressed in months, as determined by accelerated and real-time stability studies. Drives product expiry date calculation, FEFO inventory management, and label 'best before' declarations.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA CFR Title 21; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Specified storage conditions required to maintain formulation integrity and stability (e.g., 'Store below 25°C, away from direct sunlight', 'Refrigerate at 2-8°C'). Used in warehouse management (WMS), logistics planning, and label compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA CFR Title 21; Blue Yonder WMS; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: total_solid_content_pct
attributes.description: Total solid content of the formulation expressed as weight percentage (w/w%). Key physical property used in manufacturing process design, packaging compatibility assessment, and stability testing protocols.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the formulation record following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Each approved change to the formulation recipe increments the version. Enables full formulation lifecycle traceability from lab development through commercial approval.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001 - Document Control

attributes.name: viscosity_max_cps
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable viscosity of the formulation measured in centipoise (cPs) at the specified test temperature. Together with viscosity_min_cps, defines the viscosity tolerance band for quality control (QC) release and in-process testing.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals; Siemens Opcenter MES Quality Management

attributes.name: viscosity_min_cps
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable viscosity of the formulation measured in centipoise (cPs) at the specified test temperature. Critical quality attribute (CQA) governing product texture, pourability, and consumer experience. Used in QC release testing.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals; Siemens Opcenter MES Quality Management

products.name: product_formulation_ingredient
products.description: Individual ingredient line within a formulation record, specifying each chemical or biological substance used in the product formula. Attributes include INCI name (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients), CAS number, EC number, function/role (e.g., surfactant, preservative, fragrance, colorant), concentration percentage (min/max/nominal), raw material supplier code, SDS reference, EU REACH registration status, FDA status, and whether the ingredient is a restricted or prohibited substance under applicable regulations.

attributes.name: product_formulation_ingredient_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ingredient line within a formulation record. Primary key for the formulation_ingredient entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent formulation record to which this ingredient line belongs. Links the ingredient to its product formula in the PLM system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Veeva Vault Product Registration

attributes.name: raw_material_spec_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material master record corresponding to this ingredient, linking to procurement and supplier management data.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: Free-text or structured declaration of allergens present in this ingredient, including EU 14 major food allergens (where applicable for food-contact or ingestible products) and cosmetic fragrance allergens. Supports regulatory labeling and consumer safety.
attributes.references: EU Food Information Regulation 1169/2011; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III; FDA Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the regulatory affairs or R&D professional who approved this ingredient for use in the formulation. Supports GMP audit trail and electronic signature requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); Veeva Vault

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ingredient line was formally approved for use in the formulation. Provides GMP-compliant audit trail for regulatory inspections and quality management system records.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) to every chemical substance. Required for EU REACH registration, SDS documentation, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals; GS1

attributes.name: concentration_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration of the ingredient (% w/w) within the approved formulation range. Critical for safety compliance with regulatory concentration limits (e.g., EU Annex III restricted substances). Classified as confidential due to proprietary formulation IP.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III; FDA 21 CFR; ISO 22716

attributes.name: concentration_min_pct
attributes.description: Minimum allowable concentration of the ingredient (% w/w) within the approved formulation range. Used for in-process quality control and batch release decisions. Classified as confidential due to proprietary formulation IP.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: concentration_nominal_pct
attributes.description: Target or nominal concentration of the ingredient expressed as a weight/weight percentage (% w/w) in the finished formulation. Represents the standard manufacturing target. Classified as confidential due to proprietary formulation IP.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009

attributes.name: concentration_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to express ingredient concentration values (nominal, min, max). Standard is % w/w (weight by weight) for most cosmetic and personal care formulations; ppm or ppb may apply for trace ingredients or contaminants.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this formulation ingredient record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and PLM version history tracking.

attributes.name: ec_number
attributes.description: Seven-digit EC number (EINECS, ELINCS, or NLP list) assigned to chemical substances regulated under EU REACH. Mandatory for REACH registration dossiers and EU market compliance.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA Substance Database

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ingredient line is valid and authorized for use in the formulation. Supports PLM version control and ensures only approved ingredient versions are used in active manufacturing.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 22716

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorization for this ingredient line expires, after which it must be re-reviewed and re-approved. Supports regulatory compliance lifecycle management and formulation version control.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: fda_status
attributes.description: Regulatory status of the ingredient under U.S. FDA regulations. Indicates whether the ingredient is approved, Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS), permitted with restrictions, or prohibited for use in the applicable product category (cosmetics, OTC drug, food contact).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; FDA Cosmetics Regulation; FDA GRAS Database

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes for this ingredient (e.g., Flam. Liq. 3, Skin Irrit. 2, Aquatic Chronic 1). Drives SDS authoring, workplace safety controls, transport classification, and environmental risk assessment.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals); OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008

attributes.name: grade_specification
attributes.description: Quality grade or purity specification required for this ingredient (e.g., USP, NF, Ph.Eur., cosmetic grade, food grade, technical grade). Defines the minimum quality standard for procurement and incoming quality control.
attributes.references: USP (United States Pharmacopeia); Ph.Eur. (European Pharmacopoeia); ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: halal_status
attributes.description: Halal certification status of this ingredient, indicating compliance with Islamic dietary and product standards. Required for halal-certified product lines sold in Muslim-majority markets and for halal labeling claims.
attributes.references: ISWA (Islamic Services of America); IFANCA; ISO/TS 16050 Halal Food

attributes.name: ifra_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance status of this ingredient against the current IFRA Standards for fragrance materials. Applicable to fragrance ingredients and fragrance-containing raw materials. Non-compliant ingredients require reformulation or removal.
attributes.references: IFRA (International Fragrance Association) Standards; IFRA Code of Practice

attributes.name: inci_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name
attributes.description: Standardized INCI name of the ingredient as defined by the Personal Care Products Council and adopted by ISO 11609. Required for cosmetic product labeling compliance under EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 and FDA 21 CFR Part 701.
attributes.references: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients); EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR Part 701

attributes.name: ingredient_function
attributes.description: Functional role or purpose of the ingredient within the product formula (e.g., surfactant, preservative, fragrance, colorant, emollient, emulsifier, pH adjuster, solvent, active). Drives regulatory classification and labeling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: surfactant|preservative|fragrance|colorant|emollient|emulsifier|pH adjuster|solvent|active|thickener|chelating agent|antioxidant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients); EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: ingredient_name
attributes.description: Common or trade name of the ingredient as used internally within the organization, which may differ from the INCI name. Used for internal formulation documentation and procurement communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: ingredient_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this ingredient line within the formulation. Drives PLM workflow gates, regulatory review processes, and manufacturing authorization. Active ingredients are cleared for production use.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 22716

attributes.name: is_active_ingredient
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is classified as an active ingredient (e.g., OTC drug active, sunscreen active, anti-dandruff active) requiring specific regulatory declaration and concentration compliance under FDA OTC monograph or equivalent regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 330 (OTC Drug Products); FDA Sunscreen Monograph; EU Cosmetics Regulation

attributes.name: is_fragrance_allergen
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is a declared fragrance allergen requiring mandatory labeling disclosure under EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 (Annex III) when present above threshold concentrations (0.001% in rinse-off, 0.01% in leave-on products).
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III; IFRA Standards; SCCS Opinion

attributes.name: is_natural_origin
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is of natural origin as defined by ISO 16128 (Guidelines on definitions and criteria for natural and organic cosmetic ingredients). Supports natural/organic product claims and consumer transparency labeling.
attributes.references: ISO 16128 Natural and Organic Cosmetic Ingredients; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009

attributes.name: is_palm_derived
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is derived from palm oil or palm kernel oil. Triggers RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) sourcing compliance requirements and sustainability reporting obligations.
attributes.references: RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: is_prohibited_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is classified as a prohibited substance under applicable regulations (e.g., EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex II, FDA prohibited ingredients list). Prohibited substances must not appear in finished products.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex II; FDA 21 CFR; CPSC Regulations

attributes.name: is_restricted_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is classified as a restricted substance under applicable regulations (e.g., EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III, IFRA restricted list, EPA restricted chemicals). Restricted substances may be used within defined concentration limits.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III; IFRA Standards; EPA Regulations

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this ingredient within the formulation, used for ordering and referencing individual ingredient entries within a formula.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Bill of Materials (BOM)

attributes.name: natural_origin_index
attributes.description: Quantitative natural origin index (0.0000 to 1.0000) calculated per ISO 16128-2 methodology, representing the proportion of the ingredient derived from natural sources. Used to compute product-level natural origin index for claims substantiation.
attributes.references: ISO 16128-2 Natural and Organic Cosmetic Ingredients; EU Cosmetics Regulation

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of this ingredient. Required for customs declarations, country-of-origin labeling, and sustainability sourcing compliance (e.g., RSPO palm oil, FSC certified materials).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GS1; RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); FSC (Forest Stewardship Council)

attributes.name: physical_form
attributes.description: Physical state or form of the ingredient as received from the supplier (e.g., liquid, solid, powder, paste, gel). Relevant for handling, storage, and manufacturing process design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: liquid|solid|powder|paste|gel|emulsion|suspension|gas — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; GHS SDS Section 9

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: ECHA-assigned registration number for the substance under EU REACH, in the format XX-XXXXXXXXXX-XX-XXXX. Required for substances manufactured or imported into the EU above 1 tonne per year.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA Substance Registration

attributes.name: reach_registration_status
attributes.description: Registration status of this ingredient under EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006. Indicates whether the substance has been registered with ECHA, is pre-registered, exempt from registration, or registration is pending. Mandatory for EU market access.

attributes.name: regulatory_limit_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulatory provision or standard that establishes the maximum concentration limit for this ingredient (e.g., 'EU Cosmetics Reg. 1223/2009 Annex III Entry 98', 'FDA 21 CFR 352.10'). Provides audit traceability for compliance decisions.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR; IFRA Standards; CPSC Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_max_concentration_pct
attributes.description: Maximum concentration limit (% w/w) for this ingredient as mandated by applicable regulations (e.g., EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III, FDA OTC monograph limits, IFRA usage limits). Formulation concentration_max_pct must not exceed this value.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III; FDA 21 CFR; IFRA Standards

attributes.name: sds_reference_number
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this ingredient, as maintained in the document management system (Veeva Vault). Required under OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HCS) 29 CFR 1910.1200 and EU REACH.
attributes.references: OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Article 31; GHS (Globally Harmonized System)

attributes.name: sds_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Safety Data Sheet currently associated with this ingredient. Ensures traceability to the correct SDS revision used during formulation approval and manufacturing.
attributes.references: OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU REACH Regulation Article 31

attributes.name: supplier_code
attributes.description: Internal supplier code identifying the approved vendor supplying this ingredient raw material. Links to the supplier master for procurement, VMI, and approved supplier list (ASL) management in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: supplier_material_code
attributes.description: Supplier's own material or product code for this ingredient, used for purchase order communication, EDI transactions, and supplier quality management. Enables cross-referencing between internal and external material identifiers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) Standards; GS1

attributes.name: svhc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is listed as a Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) on the ECHA Candidate List under EU REACH Article 59. SVHC presence above 0.1% w/w in articles triggers communication and notification obligations.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Article 57-59; ECHA Candidate List

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this formulation ingredient record was last modified. Supports change control tracking, data lineage, and incremental data loading in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; Veeva Vault; SAP S/4HANA; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: vegan_status
attributes.description: Vegan classification of this ingredient, indicating whether it is free from animal-derived components. Supports vegan product claims, certification (e.g., The Vegan Society), and consumer labeling requirements.
attributes.references: The Vegan Society Trademark Standard; FTC Green Guides; EU Cosmetics Regulation

products.name: product_packaging_spec
products.description: Packaging specification master defining the complete physical, material, structural, and hierarchy attributes of all packaging levels for each SKU — primary (bottle, tube, sachet, pouch), secondary (carton, sleeve, shrink-wrap), tertiary (case, shipper), display unit, and pallet. Each record represents one packaging level for one SKU and captures: component type, material composition (HDPE, PET, glass, paperboard, aluminum, PCR content %), dimensions (L×W×H), gross/tare weight, color, finish, print method, recyclability code (How2Recycle label), FSC/RSPO certification flag, supplier tooling reference, quantity per hierarchy level (e.g., 12 eaches per case, 48 cases per pallet), Ti-Hi pallet configuration, and GTIN assigned at that level. Supports sustainability reporting (EPR, plastic tax), planogram compliance, DRP/MRP calculations, warehouse slotting, transportation cube optimization, and retailer EDI order processing.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Master / Veeva Vault

attributes.name: product_packaging_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each packaging specification record. One record represents one packaging level for one SKU. MASTER_RESOURCE role — primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Packaging specification approval is an employee responsibility; needed for regulatory packaging compliance.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent SKU for which this packaging specification is defined. Links the packaging record to the product master.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved supplier responsible for manufacturing or supplying this packaging component. Links to the supplier master for procurement, quality, and compliance management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Quality and regulatory approval status of this packaging specification. Only approved specifications may be used in production orders. Supports GMP compliance and change control workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; Veeva Vault PLM; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: artwork_ref
attributes.description: Reference code linking to the approved artwork file for this packaging specification in the digital asset management or PLM system. Ensures the correct print-ready artwork version is used in production.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Primary color of the packaging component as specified in the brand design brief (e.g., 'Pantone 485 C Red', 'White', 'Transparent'). Used for brand compliance, print production, and planogram visual merchandising.
attributes.references: Pantone Color System; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Specific form of the packaging component (e.g., bottle, tube, sachet, pouch, carton, sleeve, shrink-wrap, case, shipper, tray, blister, jar, can, aerosol). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bottle|tube|sachet|pouch|carton|sleeve|shrink_wrap|case|shipper|tray|blister|jar|can|aerosol|pallet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Packaging Component Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where this packaging component is manufactured. Required for customs declarations, import compliance, and supply chain risk assessments.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FDA 21 CFR; EU REACH Regulation; Customs and Border Protection

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging specification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and change management tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency cost management across global sourcing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit EAN barcode assigned to this packaging level for European and international retail markets. Used for POS scanning, retailer EDI, and customs documentation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this packaging specification version becomes active and valid for production use. Supports version management and change control in PLM and ERP systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this packaging specification version is no longer valid for production. Null indicates the specification is open-ended with no planned expiry. Supports change control and version governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: finish
attributes.description: Surface finish specification of the packaging component. Impacts print quality, consumer perception, and manufacturing process selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gloss|matte|satin|soft_touch|metallic|frosted|clear — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: gross_weight_g
attributes.description: Total weight of the packaging component including product contents in grams. Used for freight cost calculations, transportation planning, and customs documentation.
attributes.references: GS1 Package Measurement Rules; SAP S/4HANA MM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-assigned Global Trade Item Number for this specific packaging level. GTINs are assigned at each packaging hierarchy level (each, inner pack, case, pallet). Required for EDI order processing, retailer compliance, and GS1 registry submissions.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Standard; FDA 21 CFR; EDI X12

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging component contains or is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, or transportation documentation (e.g., aerosol propellants, flammable coatings). Triggers SDS requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard; EPA; EU REACH Regulation; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: height_mm
attributes.description: External height dimension of the packaging component in millimeters. Used for planogram compliance, warehouse slotting, Ti-Hi pallet configuration, and transportation cube optimization.
attributes.references: GS1 Package Measurement Rules; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: hi
attributes.description: Number of tiers (layers) stacked on a pallet — the 'Hi' component of the Ti-Hi pallet configuration. Combined with Ti to determine total units per pallet for DRP/MRP and transportation planning.
attributes.references: GS1 Pallet Configuration Standard; Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: is_fsc_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging material is sourced from FSC-certified forests or recycled sources. Required for sustainability claims, retailer compliance programs, and ESG reporting.

attributes.name: is_rspo_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) Certification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether palm oil-derived materials in the packaging component are RSPO-certified. Relevant for packaging components containing palm-based inks, coatings, or adhesives. Supports ESG and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); ISO 14001

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging specification record was last updated. Used for incremental data loads, change detection, and audit compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; SOX; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Supplier lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to delivery of this packaging component. Critical input for MRP/DRP scheduling and supply chain risk management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: length_mm
attributes.description: External length dimension of the packaging component in millimeters. Used for planogram compliance, warehouse slotting, transportation cube optimization, and retailer shelf-space calculations.
attributes.references: GS1 Package Measurement Rules; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current PLM lifecycle state of the packaging specification. Controls whether the spec is available for production orders and procurement. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA material status and Veeva Vault document lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Primary material(s) used in the packaging component (e.g., HDPE, PET, glass, paperboard, aluminum, polypropylene, PCR blend). Supports sustainability reporting, EPR compliance, and plastic tax calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HDPE|PET|glass|paperboard|aluminum|polypropylene|PCR_blend|cardboard|bioplastic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation; EPA; ISO 14001; FSC
