attributes.description: The official certificate or license number issued by the certification body for third-party certified claims. Used for audit trail and regulatory verification purposes.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The consumer touchpoint channel(s) where this claim is authorized to appear. Packaging: on-pack label; Advertising: TV/print/radio; Digital: e-commerce and social media; In-store: POS/planogram materials; All: unrestricted channel use.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; FDA 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: claim_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the claim, used in regulatory submissions, PLM systems, and cross-functional references. Sourced from Veeva Vault claim registration.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Product Registration; FTC 16 CFR Part 260

attributes.name: claim_scope
attributes.description: Defines the level at which the claim applies: Product (specific SKU), Brand (entire brand portfolio), Range (product line/sub-brand), or Ingredient (specific INCI ingredient within the formulation).
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; INCI Nomenclature; GS1

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the claim within the approval and compliance workflow. Approved: substantiated and cleared for use; Pending: awaiting substantiation review; Withdrawn: voluntarily removed; Expired: past validity date; Under Review: triggered by regulatory inquiry or market change.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; Veeva Vault Quality Documents

attributes.name: claim_text
attributes.description: The verbatim consumer-facing claim statement as it appears on product packaging, advertising, or digital channels (e.g., '99.9% germ kill', 'Dermatologist tested', 'Made with 100% recycled packaging'). Must match approved copy exactly.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; ISO 22716

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the claim by its business and regulatory nature. Efficacy: performance-based claims; Environmental: green/sustainability claims; Certification: third-party certified claims; Nutritional: nutrient content or health claims; Safety: dermatological or toxicological safety claims.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: claim_value
attributes.description: The specific numeric value or percentage cited in a quantitative claim (e.g., '99.9', '30', '100'). Stored as STRING to accommodate ranges and non-numeric qualifiers. Null for qualitative claims.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; FDA 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this product claim record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the claim's lifecycle in the data platform.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which the claim is permitted to appear on product packaging, advertising, or digital channels. May differ from approval_date if a future launch date is planned.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; FDA 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: environmental_claim_standard
attributes.description: The specific environmental standard or framework under which an environmental claim is made (e.g., ISO 14021 for self-declared environmental claims, ISO 14024 for Type I eco-labels, EPA Safer Choice). Applicable only for environmental claim types.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EPA; FTC Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the claim authorization expires and must be re-substantiated or withdrawn. Null indicates an open-ended claim with no scheduled expiry. Critical for compliance monitoring and claim lifecycle management.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: fda_reviewed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Review Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has been reviewed for compliance with FDA labeling regulations (21 CFR Part 101 for food/nutrition claims or 21 CFR Part 701 for cosmetics). Applicable for health, nutritional, and drug-related claims.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FDA 21 CFR Part 701; FDA 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: ftc_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has been reviewed and confirmed compliant with FTC advertising guidelines, including the requirement for competent and reliable scientific evidence. True = FTC compliant; False = non-compliant or not yet reviewed.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; FTC Green Guides

attributes.name: inci_ingredient_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Reference
attributes.description: The INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) name of the specific ingredient referenced in an ingredient-scoped claim. Applicable when claim_scope is 'ingredient'. Ensures regulatory alignment with EU Cosmetics Regulation and FDA cosmetic labeling.
attributes.references: INCI Nomenclature; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR Part 701; ISO 22716

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag) for the language in which the claim_text is written (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'es', 'zh-CN'). Supports multi-market, multi-language claim management.

attributes.name: legal_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has been reviewed and cleared by the internal legal counsel for advertising law compliance, IP considerations, and litigation risk. True = legal sign-off obtained.

attributes.name: legal_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the legal counsel who reviewed and approved the claim. Provides audit trail for legal sign-off accountability.

attributes.name: marketing_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the marketing team has approved the claim copy for consumer-facing deployment. Part of the multi-functional claim approval workflow (R&D, Legal, Regulatory, Marketing).
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of the claim's substantiation and compliance status. Calculated from approval_date plus review_frequency_days. Triggers compliance workflow in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; ISO 9001; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or conditional use instructions associated with the claim (e.g., 'Valid only when product contains ≥0.5% active ingredient', 'Pending FDA response as of Q3 2024'). Not for consumer-facing use.

attributes.name: plm_stage
attributes.description: The PLM lifecycle stage of the associated SKU at the time this claim is active. Ensures claims are only deployed during appropriate product lifecycle phases and supports NPD (New Product Development) claim planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PLM; Veeva Vault; GS1

attributes.name: quantitative_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim contains a specific quantitative assertion (e.g., '99.9% effective', 'reduces wrinkles by 30%'). Quantitative claims require a higher standard of substantiation evidence under FTC guidelines.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: The primary regulatory authority governing this claim in its applicable market(s) (e.g., FDA, EPA, CPSC, EU REACH, IFRA). Drives the compliance review process and substantiation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EPA|CPSC|EU_REACH|IFRA|FTC|OSHA|ISO|RSPO|FSC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA; EPA; CPSC; EU REACH Regulation; IFRA; FTC; ISO 22716

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: The mandated periodic review interval in days for re-substantiating or reconfirming the claim's validity. Drives automated compliance alerts and claim lifecycle management workflows.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; ISO 9001; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: scientific_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the R&D scientist or regulatory affairs specialist who validated the substantiation evidence for the claim.
attributes.references: OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals; ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this claim record originated. Veeva Vault is the primary system for regulatory and quality claims; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud for marketing claims; SAP S/4HANA for product master-linked claims.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault; SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: source_system_claim_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this claim record in the originating operational system (e.g., Veeva Vault document ID, SAP object ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault; SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: substantiation_method
attributes.description: The scientific or evidentiary method used to substantiate the claim per FTC competent and reliable scientific evidence standard. Determines the rigor and defensibility of the claim in regulatory or legal proceedings.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals; ISO 9001

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within the claim type (e.g., 'anti-bacterial', 'biodegradable', 'cruelty-free', 'hypoallergenic', 'organic', 'fair-trade'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: anti-bacterial|biodegradable|cruelty-free|hypoallergenic|organic|fair-trade|recyclable|vegan|gluten-free|non-gmo — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; IFRA Standards; RSPO; FSC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this product claim record. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: value_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantitative claim value (e.g., '%', 'mg', 'CFU', 'hours'). Required when claim_value is populated to provide full context for the quantitative assertion.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; ISO 80000

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for the claim record, incremented each time the claim text, substantiation, or approval status changes. Supports claim history tracking and regulatory audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the claim was formally withdrawn from consumer-facing use. Populated only when claim_status is 'withdrawn'. Critical for regulatory audit trail and litigation defense.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; CPSC; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a claim was withdrawn or rejected. Populated when claim_status is 'withdrawn' or 'under_review'. Captures regulatory challenge, substantiation failure, reformulation, or voluntary removal rationale.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 260; Veeva Vault Quality Documents

products.name: product_brand
products.description: Brand master record defining each consumer goods brand in the portfolio. Captures brand code, brand name, brand tier (premium, mass, value), parent brand (for sub-brands), brand owner entity, brand launch year, brand positioning statement, target consumer segment, primary category, brand trademark registration reference, brand status (active, dormant, divested), and the brand equity tracking methodology. Serves as the authoritative brand dimension for marketing, trade promotion, and financial reporting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Brand Master / Salesforce CG Cloud

attributes.name: product_brand_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each brand master record in the Consumer Goods portfolio. Primary key for the product_brand dimension, referenced by all downstream domains including marketing, trade promotion, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Brand manager role is an employee; needed for brand performance dashboards and accountability.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Align internal product_brand records with marketing brand for unified brand strategy and reporting; brand_code is redundant once linked.

attributes.name: architecture_type
attributes.description: Classification of the brand's role within the overall brand architecture strategy. Master brands are umbrella identities; sub-brands extend a master brand; endorsed brands carry a parent endorsement; standalone brands operate independently; house_of_brands indicates a portfolio brand with no visible corporate parent.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Dictionary; Nielsen IQ Brand Hierarchy

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Official consumer-facing name of the brand as registered and used in marketing, packaging, and trade communications. This is the primary human-readable identifier for the brand across all channels including retail, e-commerce, and DTC.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; GS1 Global Data Dictionary

attributes.name: brand_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the brand within the Consumer Goods portfolio. Active brands are fully marketed and distributed; dormant brands are temporarily inactive; divested brands have been sold or licensed out; discontinued brands are permanently retired; pipeline brands are in NPD/R&D pre-launch phase.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PLM Brand Lifecycle; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: brand_tier
attributes.description: Market positioning tier of the brand within the CPG/FMCG portfolio, indicating price-value positioning relative to competition. Drives RSP/MSRP strategy, trade promotion investment levels, and retail channel prioritization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: premium|mass|value|super_premium|private_label — promote to reference product if tiers expand]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Brand Hierarchy Standards; SAP IBP Portfolio Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand master record was first created in the system of record. Provides the audit trail entry point for the brand's data lifecycle. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which the brand's products are distributed to consumers. Retail covers brick-and-mortar stores; DTC (Direct to Consumer) covers brand-owned channels; DSD (Direct Store Delivery) covers direct distribution; omnichannel covers integrated multi-channel distribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Channel Management; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: divestiture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the brand was officially divested, sold, or licensed to a third party. Populated only when brand_status is 'divested'. Required for SOX financial reporting and portfolio restructuring audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: ean_prefix
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Article Number (EAN) / GS1 Company Prefix
attributes.description: GS1 company prefix assigned to the brand owner, forming the first digits of all EAN/GTIN barcodes for products under this brand. Enables GS1-compliant product identification and EDI transactions across the global supply chain.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; GS1 Company Prefix Registry

attributes.name: equity_methodology
attributes.description: Methodology or framework used to measure and track brand equity over time. Determines which external measurement partner (Nielsen IQ, Kantar BrandZ, Ipsos) or internal scorecard approach is applied for brand health KPI reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nielsen_brand_health|kantar_brandz|ipsos_brand_value|internal_scorecard|bav|none — promote to reference product if methodologies expand]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Brand Measurement; ISO 10668 Brand Valuation

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the brand's commercial operations. Global brands are sold in multiple continents; regional brands operate within a defined multi-country region; national brands are limited to a single country; local brands serve sub-national markets; export_only brands are manufactured domestically but sold exclusively in foreign markets.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: gmp_certification_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the GMP certification applicable to the brand's manufacturing operations. Required for FDA-regulated brands (21 CFR Parts 110/111/210/211) and cosmetics brands under ISO 22716. Stored in Veeva Vault Quality Documents.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; ISO 9001

attributes.name: is_licensed_brand
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is operated under a licensing agreement from a third-party brand owner rather than being wholly owned by the Consumer Goods entity. Licensed brands have different royalty accounting treatment in Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and different regulatory responsibility structures.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the brand master record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Exact calendar date on which the brand was first commercially available to consumers. More precise than brand_launch_year; used for anniversary campaigns, brand lifecycle milestone tracking, and NPD stage-gate reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PLM; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: launch_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the brand was first commercially launched in any market. Used for brand age analytics, heritage positioning, and portfolio vintage analysis in brand equity tracking.

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the brand licensing agreement expires, applicable only when is_licensed_brand is True. Critical for contract renewal planning, financial risk management, and SOX disclosure requirements. Null for wholly-owned brands.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; IFRA (for fragrance brand licenses)

attributes.name: msrp_currency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Currency Code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the MSRP/RSP defined at the brand level. Provides the currency context for brand-level pricing strategy and trade promotion ROI calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: nps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether active NPS (Net Promoter Score) consumer sentiment tracking is configured for this brand. When True, the brand is enrolled in periodic consumer surveys and NPS measurement programs linked to the consumer domain's nps_response product.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: owner_division
attributes.description: Internal business division or strategic business unit (SBU) within the Consumer Goods organization that owns and manages the brand. Used for financial reporting, EBITDA attribution, and S&OP planning alignment in SAP S/4HANA CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; SOX

attributes.name: owner_entity
attributes.description: Legal entity name of the company or subsidiary that owns the brand trademark and bears regulatory responsibility for the brand. Critical for SOX financial reporting, regulatory submissions to FDA/EPA/CPSC, and inter-company transfer pricing.

attributes.name: parent_brand_code
attributes.description: Brand code of the parent or umbrella brand for sub-brands and brand extensions. Enables hierarchical brand architecture modeling (e.g., a skincare sub-brand under a master personal care brand). Null for top-level master brands with no parent.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Dictionary; SAP S/4HANA Brand Hierarchy

attributes.name: plm_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the brand in the PLM lifecycle framework. Drives resource allocation, marketing investment levels, and supply chain planning priorities. Concept and development stages are pre-commercial; growth through decline stages are active commercial phases; end_of_life triggers discontinuation planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|development|launch|growth|maturity|decline|end_of_life — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PLM; SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: positioning_statement
attributes.description: Internal strategic statement articulating the brand's unique value proposition, target audience, competitive frame of reference, and key differentiators. Confidential business strategy document used by marketing and trade promotion teams for campaign alignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Brand Management; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_category
attributes.description: Primary GS1 or internal product category to which the brand belongs (e.g., Household Cleaning, Personal Care, Health & Hygiene, Baby Care). Used for category management, Nielsen IQ market measurement, ACV/TDP reporting, and trade promotion planning.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); Nielsen IQ Category Standards

attributes.name: primary_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary market or country of origin for the brand. Used for regulatory compliance (FDA, EU REACH), customs documentation, and market-level financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FDA 21 CFR; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: FDA/regulatory classification of the brand's product portfolio, determining applicable compliance frameworks. OTC drug brands require FDA monograph compliance; cosmetic brands require INCI ingredient declarations per ISO 22716; household chemical brands require EPA registration and SDS documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: otc_drug|cosmetic|food_beverage|household_chemical|medical_device|dietary_supplement|general_merchandise — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EPA Registration; CPSC; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; EU REACH

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or shortened version of the brand name used in space-constrained contexts such as POS displays, planograms (POG), shelf labels, and reporting dashboards where the full brand name may not fit.

attributes.name: social_media_handle
attributes.description: Primary social media handle or username for the brand (e.g., @BrandName on Instagram/Twitter/TikTok). Used for SOV (Share of Voice) measurement, digital marketing analytics, and consumer engagement tracking in Nielsen IQ and Salesforce.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; Nielsen IQ Digital Measurement

attributes.name: source_system_brand_code
attributes.description: Native brand identifier as stored in the originating operational system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA brand master ID, Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud brand record ID). Enables reverse lookup and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and source systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Brand Master; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this brand master record originates. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and conflict resolution when multiple systems contribute brand attributes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Oracle Cloud ERP; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Primary sustainability or environmental certification held by the brand, indicating compliance with responsible sourcing and environmental management standards. FSC covers sustainable forestry; RSPO covers sustainable palm oil; ISO 14001 covers environmental management systems.
attributes.references: FSC Forest Stewardship Council; RSPO Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil; ISO 14001

attributes.name: target_consumer_segment
attributes.description: Primary consumer demographic or psychographic segment the brand is designed to serve (e.g., Millennial Families, Gen Z Beauty Enthusiasts, Health-Conscious Adults 35-55). Drives brand positioning, media SOV allocation, and NPS/CLTV measurement segmentation.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: trade_promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is eligible for trade promotion activities managed through TPM/TPO systems (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud). Brands marked False may be excluded from promotional funding pools, Hi-Lo pricing events, and EDLP programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM; SAP IBP S&OP

attributes.name: trademark_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary jurisdiction in which the brand trademark is registered (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Supports multi-market brand protection management and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: trademark_registration_ref
attributes.description: Official trademark registration number or reference identifier issued by the relevant intellectual property authority (e.g., USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO). Used for legal protection verification, brand licensing agreements, and regulatory labeling compliance.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; WIPO Madrid System

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official consumer-facing website URL for the brand. Used for DTC channel management, digital marketing attribution, and e-commerce integration. Referenced in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud for omnichannel campaign tracking.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; GDPR Article 13

products.name: sku_substitution
products.description: Defines approved substitution, supersession, and equivalence relationships between SKUs, capturing the from-SKU, to-SKU, substitution type (direct replacement, reformulation, repack, size change, promotional swap), effective date range, priority/preference rank, reason code (renovation, cost optimization, regulatory change, discontinuation, temporary supply shortage), customer approval requirement flag, and whether the substitution is bidirectional or directional. Used by supply chain for ATP/CTP available-to-promise calculations, by customer service for order substitution during stockouts, by demand planning for history normalization when SKUs are superseded, and by finance for COGS bridge analysis across product transitions.

attributes.name: sku_substitution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SKU substitution or supersession relationship record in the product master. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SKU substitution approvals are performed by employees; essential for supply‑chain change control.

attributes.name: from_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating SKU being substituted, superseded, or replaced. This is the 'source' product in the substitution relationship, typically the discontinued, reformulated, or out-of-stock item.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Model; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: to_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the replacement or substitute SKU. This is the 'target' product that fulfills demand when the from-SKU is unavailable or discontinued.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Model; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the substitution record received final business or customer approval. Distinct from the effective_date; a substitution may be approved in advance of its operational effective date.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 9001 Change Control

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status for substitutions requiring customer or retailer sign-off. Not_required applies when customer_approval_required is False. Pending indicates awaiting customer response; approved indicates the customer has consented; rejected indicates the customer declined the substitution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: atp_substitution_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Available to Promise (ATP) Substitution Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substitution relationship is active for ATP (Available to Promise) and CTP (Capable to Promise) calculations in supply planning. When True, the to-SKU inventory is considered when confirming availability for orders requesting the from-SKU.
attributes.references: SAP IBP ATP/CTP; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain

attributes.name: auto_substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution can be executed automatically by order management or ERP systems without manual intervention. False requires a customer service representative or account manager to confirm the substitution before order processing proceeds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Management; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Identifies the specific distribution channel to which this substitution applies when substitution_scope is channel_specific. Examples include DTC (Direct to Consumer), retail, e-commerce, wholesale, DSD (Direct Store Delivery). Null when scope is global or regional.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel; GS1 Channel Classification

attributes.name: cogs_impact_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Impact Percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage change in COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) resulting from this substitution. Used by finance for COGS bridge analysis across product transitions, particularly for cost optimization and renovation-driven substitutions. Positive values indicate cost increase; negative values indicate cost savings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Product Costing; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this substitution record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: customer_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer or retailer approval is required before this substitution can be executed on an order. True for key account or contractual SKU commitments where the buyer must consent to any product change. Drives workflow routing in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud account management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: demand_history_normalization
attributes.description: Indicates whether demand planning systems should normalize historical sales data by mapping the from-SKU demand history to the to-SKU when the substitution represents a supersession. True enables SAP IBP to consolidate demand signals across the product transition for accurate forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; S&OP Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this substitution relationship becomes valid and operational. Used by ATP/CTP engines, customer service order management, and demand planning history normalization to determine when the substitution applies.
attributes.references: SAP IBP ATP/CTP; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this substitution relationship is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended substitution with no planned end date. Used to manage temporary supply shortage substitutions and promotional swaps with defined windows.
attributes.references: SAP IBP ATP/CTP; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain

attributes.name: is_bidirectional
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution relationship is bidirectional (True) — meaning either SKU can substitute for the other — or directional (False) — meaning only the from-SKU can be replaced by the to-SKU. Bidirectional substitutions are common for size-equivalent or reformulation-equivalent products.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Substitution; CPG PLM Best Practices

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the market or geography where this substitution is applicable. Null when the substitution is global. Used to manage region-specific regulatory substitutions (e.g., EU REACH-driven reformulations) and market-specific product availability.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: plm_change_order_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Change Order Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) engineering change order or NPD (New Product Development) project that authorized this substitution. Links the substitution record back to the formal product change governance process in Veeva Vault or the PLM system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Product Registration; SAP PLM; ISO 9001 Change Control

attributes.name: price_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage price adjustment applied when the substitute SKU carries a different RSP (Recommended Selling Price) or MSRP than the original SKU. Positive values indicate a price increase; negative values indicate a price reduction. Used by finance for COGS bridge analysis and by customer service for order repricing during substitution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the preference order when multiple substitute SKUs exist for the same from-SKU. Lower values indicate higher preference (1 = most preferred). Used by ATP/CTP and order management systems to select the optimal substitute when multiple options are available.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Substitution Priority; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: quantity_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier applied to convert the ordered quantity of the from-SKU to the equivalent quantity of the to-SKU. For example, a factor of 2.0 means 1 unit of the from-SKU is substituted by 2 units of the to-SKU (e.g., a size change from 500ml to 250ml). Factor of 1.0 indicates a one-for-one substitution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure Conversion; SAP IBP ATP

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason driving the substitution relationship. Renovation indicates a product improvement initiative; cost_optimization indicates a COGS reduction program; regulatory_change indicates compliance with FDA, EPA, EU REACH, or other governing body requirements; discontinuation indicates permanent end-of-life; temporary_supply_shortage indicates an OOS-driven interim substitution; reformulation indicates an ingredient or formula change.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU REACH Regulation; SAP S/4HANA MM Reason Codes

attributes.name: regulatory_change_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the regulatory mandate, compliance ruling, or governing body directive that triggered this substitution when reason_code is regulatory_change. Examples include FDA 21 CFR section references, EU REACH substance restriction IDs, EPA compliance notices, or CPSC safety recall numbers.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU REACH Regulation; EPA; CPSC; ISO 9001

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this substitution record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer and enables reconciliation across SAP S/4HANA MM, Oracle Cloud ERP, Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, and Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud ERP; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this substitution record in the originating operational system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA material substitution record number). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud ERP; Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: substitution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, operational instructions, or caveats associated with this substitution relationship. May include customer communication guidance, handling instructions for customer service teams, or supply chain execution notes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; CPG Operational Best Practices

attributes.name: substitution_scope
attributes.description: Defines the commercial scope within which this substitution is applicable. Global applies across all markets and channels; regional restricts to a geographic region; customer_specific applies only to a named account; channel_specific applies only to a defined distribution channel (e.g., DTC, retail, wholesale).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Area; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: substitution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the substitution record. Active indicates the substitution is in effect; pending_approval indicates awaiting customer or commercial sign-off; expired indicates the effective date range has passed; suspended indicates temporarily halted.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Substitution; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the substitution relationship between the from-SKU and to-SKU. Direct replacement indicates a like-for-like swap; reformulation indicates a change in product formula; repack indicates a packaging change; size_change indicates a net content or pack size change; promotional_swap indicates a temporary trade promotion substitution; supersession indicates a permanent product lifecycle transition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Substitution Reason; CPG PLM Best Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this substitution record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer and for audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: veeva_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the supporting quality or regulatory document stored in Veeva Vault that provides evidence or authorization for this substitution, such as a formulation change approval, regulatory submission, or quality release document.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Documents; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; ISO 9001

products.name: pack_hierarchy
products.description: Defines the packaging hierarchy levels for each SKU — each/unit, inner pack, case/shipper, display unit, and pallet — including the quantity per level, GTIN per level, dimensions, weight, and Ti-Hi (tier × height) pallet configuration. Supports warehouse slotting, DRP replenishment calculations, transportation cube optimization, and retailer EDI order processing.

attributes.name: pack_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pack hierarchy record. Primary key.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU for which this pack hierarchy is defined. Links to the product master.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pack hierarchy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_quantity
attributes.description: The total number of consumer units (eaches) contained in this packaging level. For a case containing 6 inner packs of 12 eaches, this would be 72.

attributes.name: display_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging level is designed as a retail-ready display unit that can be placed directly on the sales floor without unpacking.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: The 13-digit EAN barcode identifier for this packaging level, used internationally for consumer units.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pack hierarchy configuration is no longer valid, supporting packaging changes and product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this pack hierarchy configuration becomes active and valid for use in operations.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: The total weight of the packaging at this level including product and packaging materials, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The GS1 Global Trade Item Number assigned to this packaging level. May be GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14 (case/pallet).

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: The height dimension of the packaging at this level, measured in centimeters.

attributes.name: hi_count
attributes.description: The number of layers stacked on a pallet (Hi in Ti-Hi configuration). Used for pallet configuration and warehouse planning.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The packaging level within the hierarchy: each (consumer unit), inner pack (multi-pack), case (shipper), display unit (retail-ready), pallet (full pallet), or layer (pallet layer).

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: The length dimension of the packaging at this level, measured in centimeters.

attributes.name: max_stack_height
attributes.description: The maximum number of units of this packaging level that can be safely stacked vertically.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pack hierarchy record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity required for this packaging level, used in order processing and trade promotion planning.

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight of the product content only at this level, excluding packaging materials, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: orderable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging level can be ordered by customers or retailers through EDI or other ordering systems.

attributes.name: pack_hierarchy_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this pack hierarchy configuration: active (in use), inactive (temporarily suspended), pending (awaiting approval), or discontinued (permanently retired).

attributes.name: packaging_material
attributes.description: The primary material used for packaging at this level: corrugated cardboard, plastic, wood, metal, composite, or shrink wrap.

attributes.name: pallet_type
attributes.description: The type of pallet used for this packaging level: standard (48x40 inches), euro (1200x800 mm), block, custom, half, or quarter pallet.

attributes.name: quantity_per_level
attributes.description: The number of units from the next lower hierarchy level contained in this level (e.g., 12 eaches per inner pack, 6 inner packs per case).

attributes.name: recyclable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging material at this level is recyclable according to local recycling standards.

attributes.name: recycled_content_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of recycled material content in the packaging at this level, supporting sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: shippable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging level is suitable for direct shipment to customers or distribution centers.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging level can be safely stacked on top of similar units during storage and transportation.

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight of the packaging materials only at this level, excluding product content, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: ti_count
attributes.description: The number of cases or units per layer on a pallet (Ti in Ti-Hi configuration). Used for pallet configuration and warehouse planning.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit UPC barcode identifier for this packaging level, primarily used in North America for consumer units.

attributes.name: volume_cubic_cm
attributes.description: The cubic volume of the packaging at this level, measured in cubic centimeters. Used for warehouse slotting and transportation cube optimization.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: The width dimension of the packaging at this level, measured in centimeters.

products.name: certification
products.description: Tracks third-party certifications and compliance attestations held by a SKU or formulation, such as RSPO (sustainable palm oil), FSC (sustainable packaging), Leaping Bunny (cruelty-free), COSMOS Organic, NSF, Halal, Kosher, EPA Safer Choice, and ISO 22716 GMP. Each record captures certification body, certificate number, certification scope, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and the applicable markets. Supports sustainability reporting, retailer compliance, and consumer-facing claim substantiation.
products.reference: RSPO / FSC / ISO 22716 / EPA Safer Choice

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific formulation version that is certified. Allows certification tracking at the formulation level when a SKU has multiple formulations.

attributes.name: responsible_party_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Certification responsibility is assigned to an employee; needed for audit trails and renewal management.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that holds this certification. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: applicable_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales channels where this certification applies and can be claimed. Examples: retail, e-commerce, DTC (Direct to Consumer), food service, professional, wholesale.

attributes.name: applicable_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic markets or countries where this certification is recognized and can be claimed. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, FRA, JPN).

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent audit or inspection conducted by the certification body to verify ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the most recent audit. Passed indicates full compliance. Passed with conditions indicates minor non-conformances that must be addressed. Failed indicates major non-conformances.

attributes.name: body
attributes.description: The name of the third-party organization or authority that issued the certification. Examples: RSPO Secretariat, Forest Stewardship Council, Cruelty Free International, Ecocert, NSF International, Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America, Orthodox Union.

attributes.name: certificate_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference path or identifier to the official certificate document in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault). Used for regulatory submissions and retailer compliance requests.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate or license number assigned by the certification body. Used for verification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: certification_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the certification covers. May specify ingredients, packaging materials, manufacturing processes, supply chain stages, or product categories included in the certification scope.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Active indicates the certification is valid and in force. Expired means the certification has passed its expiry date. Suspended indicates temporary hold. Revoked means the certification has been withdrawn. Pending and under_review indicate application or renewal in progress.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The type or name of the third-party certification or compliance attestation. Examples include RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), Leaping Bunny (cruelty-free), COSMOS Organic, NSF, Halal, Kosher, EPA Safer Choice, ISO 22716 GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RSPO|FSC|Leaping Bunny|COSMOS Organic|NSF|Halal|Kosher|EPA Safer Choice|ISO 22716|Fair Trade|Rainforest Alliance|USDA Organic|Ecocert|Vegan Society|B Corp|Carbon Neutral|Cradle to Cradle|EWG Verified|Non-GMO Project|PETA Cruelty-Free|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Industry Certification Bodies (RSPO, FSC, IFRA, NSF, ISO)

attributes.name: claim_text
attributes.description: The approved marketing claim or statement that can be used on packaging, advertising, and digital channels to communicate this certification to consumers. Must match certification body guidelines.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Green Guides, Certification Body Guidelines

attributes.name: consumer_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is actively promoted to consumers on packaging, advertising, and digital channels. True means the certification is part of the brand's consumer value proposition.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost paid to obtain and maintain this certification, including application fees, audit fees, and annual licensing fees. Used for sustainability ROI analysis.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the certification cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the certification becomes valid and the product can carry the certification claim or logo.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null if the certification has no expiration.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued by the certification body.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: logo_file_reference
attributes.description: Reference path or identifier to the approved certification logo file in the digital asset management system. Used by packaging and marketing teams.

attributes.name: logo_usage_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is authorized to display the certification body's logo or seal on product packaging and marketing materials.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next audit or surveillance visit by the certification body.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, exclusions, or internal notes related to this certification. May include audit findings, renewal reminders, or scope limitations.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the certification must be renewed to maintain continuous compliance. May differ from expiry date to allow for renewal processing time.

attributes.name: retailer_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is required by one or more key retail customers as a condition of distribution. True means at least one retailer mandates this certification.

attributes.name: standard_version
attributes.description: The version or edition of the certification standard under which the product was certified. Important for tracking compliance with evolving standards.

attributes.name: sustainability_pillar
attributes.description: The primary sustainability or ESG (Environmental Social Governance) pillar that this certification supports. Used for sustainability reporting and ESG disclosure alignment.
attributes.references: GRI (Global Reporting Initiative) Standards, SASB (Sustainability Accounting Standards Board)

attributes.name: verification_url
attributes.description: Public URL where consumers, retailers, or auditors can verify the authenticity of this certification using the certificate number. Supports transparency and claim substantiation.

products.name: product_registration
products.description: Represents the warranty/recall registration linking a SKU to a shopper. Each record captures when and how a shopper registered a product and the current warranty status.. Existence Justification: Consumers actively register each purchased SKU for warranty and recall purposes. A single SKU can be registered by many shoppers, and a shopper can register many different SKUs. The registration itself carries attributes such as registration date, source, and warranty status, making it an operational M:N relationship.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the registration association

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the shopper who registers the SKU

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU being registered

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date the SKU was registered by the shopper

attributes.name: registration_source
attributes.description: Source channel through which the registration was made (e.g., online, in‑store)

attributes.name: warranty_status
attributes.description: Current warranty status of the registered SKU (e.g., active, expired)

products.name: vmi_sku_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the contract between a SKU and a customer VMI agreement. It captures the operational parameters that govern how inventory for each SKU is managed under the VMI program, including replenishment cadence, lead times, inventory targets, and forecast sharing settings.. Existence Justification: A SKU can be covered by multiple VMI agreements with different trade accounts, and each VMI agreement can include many SKUs. The agreement records specific parameters (replenishment frequency, lead time, inventory targets, forecast cadence) for each SKU, and the business actively creates, updates, and deletes these mappings as part of VMI program management.

attributes.name: vmi_sku_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vmi Sku Assignment - Vmi Sku Assignment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the vmi_sku_assignment association

attributes.name: customer_vmi_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vmi Sku Assignment - Customer Vmi Agreement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the VMI agreement record

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU master record

attributes.name: forecast_sharing_cadence
attributes.description: Frequency at which the trade account shares demand forecasts for this SKU

attributes.name: max_inventory_weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Maximum inventory target expressed as weeks of supply for this SKU

attributes.name: min_inventory_weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Minimum inventory target expressed as weeks of supply for this SKU

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the manufacturer reviews inventory levels for this SKU under the VMI agreement

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Committed lead time in days from replenishment order creation to delivery for this SKU

attributes.name: safety_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Buffer inventory expressed as weeks of supply for this SKU

products.name: freight_contract_assignment
products.description: This association captures the contractual relationship between a product SKU and a carrier contract, including the agreed freight rate, volume commitments, and contract effective/expiry dates for each SKU‑carrier pairing.. Existence Justification: In the consumer goods business, each SKU can be covered by multiple carrier contracts, and each carrier contract can apply to multiple SKUs. The company actively creates and maintains these contract records, capturing agreed rates, volume commitments, and effective/expiry dates for each SKU‑carrier pairing.

attributes.name: freight_contract_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Freight Contract Assignment - Freight Contract Assignment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the freight_contract_assignment association

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Freight Contract Assignment - Carrier Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to carrier contract

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to SKU

attributes.name: agreed_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated freight rate for the SKU under this carrier contract

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms become effective for this SKU

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms expire for this SKU

attributes.name: volume_commitment
attributes.description: Committed shipment volume for the SKU under this contract

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association captures the contractual relationship between a SKU and a supplier contract. Each record links one SKU to one supplier contract and stores attributes that are specific to that contract‑SKU pairing, such as pricing, quantity commitments, and validity periods.. Existence Justification: A SKU can be sourced from multiple supplier contracts, each with its own pricing, quantity, and validity terms. Conversely, a single supplier contract can cover many SKUs across the portfolio. Procurement teams actively create, update, and retire these contract‑SKU links, and the link itself stores attributes such as unit price, lead time, and contract validity dates.

attributes.name: supply_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the SupplyAgreement association

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU master record

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier contract

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected lead time in days for delivery of the SKU under this contract

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered for this SKU under the contract

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the unit price (e.g., USD per kg)

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price for the SKU under this contract

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract line item expires for the SKU

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract line item becomes effective for the SKU

attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the category, its purpose and typical product types.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the product category as used in catalogs and reports.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: High‑level business classification of the category for reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the category becomes valid for use in the product master.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the category is retired or no longer valid (null if open‑ended).

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Depth of the category within the hierarchy (root = 0).

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Slash‑delimited path of ancestor category IDs (e.g., "/1/5/9").

attributes.name: is_leaf
attributes.description: True if the category has no child categories; otherwise False.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating source system that supplied the category data.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the category in the source system (e.g., SAP material group code).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the category (e.g., active for use, deprecated for retirement).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the category record.

attributes.name: parent_product_category_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on product_category (parent_product_category_id)

domains.name: manufacturing
domains.description: Owns production planning, scheduling, and execution across manufacturing facilities. Manages production orders, batch records, work orders, MES integration (Siemens Opcenter), line performance (OEE), yield tracking, MRP runs, GMP compliance events, changeover management, and shop floor data collection aligned with ISO 22716 standards.

products.name: manufacturing_facility
products.description: Master record for each manufacturing facility (plant/site) in the Consumer Goods network. Captures plant code, site name, address, GMP certification status, ISO 22716 compliance tier, production capacity (units/day), facility type (mixing, filling, packaging, co-manufacturing), regulatory registration numbers (FDA establishment ID, EPA site ID), and operational status. SSOT for all plant-level master data referenced by production orders, batch records, and OEE metrics.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing facility. Primary key. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: ESG commitments are defined per facility for compliance; linking facility to its commitment enables facility‑level ESG reporting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Facility compliance reporting must reference the jurisdiction governing its operations for regulatory filings and audit purposes.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Facility manager required for safety compliance, production reporting, and labor accountability; obvious to a consumer‑goods plant manager.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Required for Supply Network Planning report to map each plant to its network node, enabling ATP, capacity, and logistics calculations; domain experts expect this mapping.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the manufacturing facility location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or additional location details. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the manufacturing facility is located.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility was officially commissioned and began production operations.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the manufacturing facility is located (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the manufacturing facility record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for the manufacturing facility operations team. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh_per_year
attributes.description: Annual energy consumption of the facility measured in kilowatt-hours, used for sustainability reporting and cost management.

attributes.name: epa_site_number
attributes.description: EPA facility identifier for environmental compliance tracking and reporting under EPA regulations.

attributes.name: erp_plant_code
attributes.description: Plant identifier in the SAP S/4HANA ERP system used for integration with MM, PP, SD, and WM modules.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the manufacturing facility or plant site.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the manufacturing facility based on primary production function: mixing (formulation), filling (liquid/semi-solid), packaging (secondary), co-manufacturing (third-party), integrated (end-to-end), or contract (toll manufacturing).

attributes.name: fda_establishment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Establishment ID
attributes.description: FDA-issued establishment identifier for facilities manufacturing FDA-regulated products (cosmetics, OTC drugs, food). Required for US market distribution.

attributes.name: gmp_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility received its current GMP certification.

attributes.name: gmp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds current Good Manufacturing Practice certification required for consumer goods production.

attributes.name: gmp_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current GMP certification expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_22716_compliance_tier
attributes.description: Internal classification of the facility's compliance level with ISO 22716 cosmetics GMP standards: tier_1 (full compliance), tier_2 (partial compliance), tier_3 (basic compliance), non_compliant.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality or compliance audit conducted at the facility.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the manufacturing facility record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the facility location in decimal degrees for mapping and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the facility location in decimal degrees for mapping and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: mes_system_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is integrated with Siemens Opcenter MES for real-time production tracking and shop floor data collection.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next quality or compliance audit at the facility.

attributes.name: number_of_production_lines
attributes.description: Total count of active production lines within the facility available for manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the manufacturing facility in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: osha_establishment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Establishment Number
attributes.description: OSHA establishment identifier for workplace safety reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the facility: owned (company-owned), leased (long-term lease), contract (third-party operated), joint_venture (shared ownership).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the manufacturing facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the manufacturing plant used across SAP S/4HANA PP module and operational systems. Typically 4-10 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the facility address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: primary_product_category
attributes.description: Main product category or line manufactured at this facility (e.g., skincare, haircare, household cleaning, personal care).

attributes.name: production_capacity_units_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum daily production capacity of the facility measured in finished goods units per day under normal operating conditions.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard operating shift pattern for the facility: single (8 hours), two_shift (16 hours), three_shift (24 hours), continuous (24/7), flexible (variable).

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total floor area of the manufacturing facility in square feet, including production, warehouse, and administrative spaces.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division where the facility is located.

attributes.name: sustainability_rating
attributes.description: Internal sustainability performance rating for the facility based on environmental impact, energy efficiency, waste reduction, and sustainable sourcing practices.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the facility location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Berlin) used for production scheduling and shift planning.

attributes.name: water_consumption_cubic_meters_per_year
attributes.description: Annual water consumption of the facility measured in cubic meters, tracked for environmental compliance and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of employees (full-time equivalent) assigned to the manufacturing facility.

products.name: production_line
products.description: Master record for each physical production line within a manufacturing facility. Captures line code, line name, facility reference, line type (filling, blending, packaging, assembly), design speed (units/hour), nominal OEE target, GMP classification, MES asset tag (Siemens Opcenter), changeover time standard (minutes), and current operational status. Enables OEE benchmarking, scheduling capacity allocation, and MES integration at the line level.
products.reference: Siemens Opcenter MES — Work Center / Resource Master

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production line. Primary key for the production line master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: energy_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.energy_certificate. Business justification: Energy certificates certify renewable energy for a line; linking enables line‑level energy compliance tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Production line belongs to a specific manufacturing facility; replace generic facility reference with direct link to manufacturing_facility.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Line supervisor drives OEE, quality and shift planning; plant experts expect a dedicated supervisor link per line.

attributes.name: allergen_handling_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line handles products containing allergens. Critical for cross-contamination prevention and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allergen types handled on this line (e.g., nuts, dairy, gluten). Used for allergen management and cleaning validation protocols.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical asset tag number assigned to the production line for asset management and tracking purposes. Links to the fixed asset register in the ERP system.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation on the production line. Indicates the level of human intervention required and impacts labor planning and quality consistency.

attributes.name: changeover_time_standard_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to change over the production line from one product or batch to another. Used for production scheduling and OEE loss calculation.

attributes.name: cleaning_validation_protocol
attributes.description: Reference to the cleaning validation protocol document applicable to this production line. Ensures GMP compliance and prevents cross-contamination.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the production line was commissioned and became operational. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production line record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: crew_size_standard
attributes.description: Standard number of operators required to run the production line at full capacity. Used for labor planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting depreciation method applied to this production line asset. Used for financial reporting and asset valuation.

attributes.name: design_speed_units_per_hour
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum production capacity of the line measured in units per hour under ideal conditions. Used for capacity planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh_per_unit
attributes.description: Average energy consumption per unit produced on this line, measured in kilowatt-hours. Key metric for sustainability reporting and cost analysis.

attributes.name: environmental_control_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the production line requires controlled environmental conditions such as temperature, humidity, or air quality. Critical for GMP compliance and product quality.

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: GMP classification level of the production line indicating the quality and cleanliness standards required for products manufactured on this line. Critical for regulatory compliance and product safety.

attributes.name: humidity_range_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable relative humidity range for the production line as a percentage. Format: min-max (e.g., 40-60). Used for environmental monitoring and compliance.

attributes.name: installed_power_kw
attributes.description: Total installed electrical power capacity of the production line in kilowatts. Used for energy consumption tracking and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major overhaul or refurbishment of the production line. Used for maintenance planning and asset condition assessment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production line record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the production line. Unique within the facility and used for operational reference in MES systems and production scheduling.

attributes.name: line_length_meters
attributes.description: Physical length of the production line in meters. Used for facility layout planning and material flow analysis.

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the production line. Used for display in dashboards, reports, and operator interfaces.

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production line based on its primary manufacturing function. Determines the type of operations and products that can be processed on this line.

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures_hours
attributes.description: Average time in hours between equipment failures on this production line. Key reliability metric used for maintenance optimization and capacity planning.

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair_hours
