attributes.description: Quantity of material that required rework or reprocessing to meet quality specifications. Impacts production efficiency and cycle time.

attributes.name: routing_operation_number
attributes.description: Specific operation sequence number within the production routing where yield is measured. Identifies the manufacturing step in the Bill of Materials (BOM) routing.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material that failed quality checks and was scrapped during this operation. Contributes to yield loss and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) variance.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Production shift identifier during which the yield measurement was captured. Used for shift-level performance analysis and labor productivity tracking.

attributes.name: standard_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of output based on Bill of Materials (BOM) and routing. Used to calculate yield variance impact on Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).

attributes.name: theoretical_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Expected yield percentage based on Bill of Materials (BOM) specifications and standard operating procedures. Baseline for variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM, ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for all quantity fields in this yield record. Must be consistent across input, output, scrap, and rework quantities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|EA|M|M2|M3|TON|LB|GAL|OZ — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, GS1 Standards

attributes.name: yield_loss_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of yield variance. Used for Pareto analysis and continuous improvement initiatives. Examples: EQUIP_FAIL, MAT_DEFECT, PROC_ERROR, QUAL_REJECT.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: yield_loss_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the yield loss root cause. Provides context for quality investigations and corrective action planning.

attributes.name: yield_variance_cost_impact
attributes.description: Financial impact of yield variance calculated as (theoretical_yield - actual_yield) * standard_cost_per_unit. Feeds into Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Variance Analysis, SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: yield_variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance between actual and theoretical yield expressed as percentage. Calculated as (actual_yield_percentage - theoretical_yield_percentage). Negative values indicate yield loss.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, SAP S/4HANA CO Variance Analysis

products.name: gmp_event
products.description: GMP compliance event record capturing deviations, non-conformances, and critical control point (CCP) observations during manufacturing. Captures event ID, batch record reference, facility, event type (deviation, OOS result, environmental monitoring excursion, equipment failure, process parameter breach), event severity (critical, major, minor), event description, detection timestamp, GMP regulation reference (ISO 22716, FDA 21 CFR 211), CAPA reference, event status (open, under investigation, closed), and electronic signature of approver. SSOT for GMP compliance event management.
products.reference: Veeva Vault Quality — Deviation / CAPA Record

attributes.name: gmp_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GMP compliance event record. Primary key for the gmp_event data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete GMP compliance business event with a clear lifecycle.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality manager or authorized person who reviewed and electronically signed off on the GMP event record. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance. Nullable until event reaches approval stage.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 22716 Section 10; Veeva Vault Electronic Signature

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing batch record against which this GMP event was detected. Links the compliance event to the specific production batch in the batch record master. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE (resource reference) category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record initiated in response to this GMP event. Nullable when no CAPA has been raised yet or when event severity does not require CAPA. Managed in Veeva Vault Quality module.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; Veeva Vault CAPA Module

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific piece of manufacturing equipment involved in or associated with the GMP event. Particularly relevant for equipment_failure and process_parameter_breach event types. Links to equipment master in SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; ISO 22716 Section 6

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: GMP events must be linked to the specific manufacturing facility where they occurred.

attributes.name: primary_gmp_detected_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (operator, quality technician, or supervisor) who first detected and reported the GMP event. Links to Workday HCM employee master. Required for GMP accountability and electronic signature audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 22716 Section 10; Workday HCM

attributes.name: prior_event_gmp_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous GMP event of the same type that this event is a recurrence of. Populated only when recurrence_flag is true. Enables recurrence trend analysis and CAPA effectiveness assessment across event lineage.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: FK to manufacturing.production_line

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA PP production order or Siemens Opcenter MES work order associated with this GMP event. Enables traceability from compliance event back to the manufacturing execution context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Siemens Opcenter MES; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.100

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: GMP event investigations reference the product registration to ensure corrective actions align with the approved registration details.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being manufactured when the GMP event occurred. Enables product-level compliance traceability, recall risk assessment, and regulatory reporting by product.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.130; ISO 22716

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Regulatory GMP incident reports must identify the raw‑material supplier causing the event for root‑cause analysis.

attributes.name: affected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of product (in the batch unit of measure) potentially affected by the GMP event. Used for impact assessment, recall scope estimation, and financial exposure calculation. Serves as the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT measurement for this non-monetary transaction.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 8; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: affected_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the affected batch quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, EA for each/units). Aligned with GS1 unit of measure codes and SAP S/4HANA base unit of measure configuration.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 22716

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the authorized quality manager electronically signed and approved the GMP event record. Distinct from detection and creation timestamps. Required for regulatory audit trail and SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: batch_disposition
attributes.description: Quality disposition decision for the affected batch resulting from the GMP event investigation. released: batch meets quality standards and is approved for distribution. quarantined: batch held pending investigation outcome. rejected: batch fails quality standards and cannot be released. reworked: batch underwent approved rework procedure. destroyed: batch disposed of due to quality failure.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.165; ISO 22716 Section 9; SAP S/4HANA QM Batch Disposition

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Human-readable batch or lot number of the product being manufactured when the GMP event was detected. Denormalized from the batch record for direct traceability in compliance reports and regulatory submissions without requiring a join.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.130; ISO 22716 Section 8; GS1 SSCC Standards

attributes.name: ccp_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Critical Control Point (CCP) in the manufacturing process where the GMP event was detected. Applicable for process_parameter_breach and environmental_monitoring_excursion event types. Aligned with HACCP and GMP process control frameworks.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.110; ISO 22716 Section 7; HACCP Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: closure_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the GMP event was formally closed after all required CAPA actions were completed and verified effective. Nullable for open or in-progress events. Used to calculate event resolution cycle time for quality KPI reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q10

attributes.name: containment_action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the immediate containment action was executed following GMP event detection (e.g., line stoppage, batch quarantine). Used to calculate detection-to-containment response time, a key GMP performance metric.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q10

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the GMP event record was first created in the system (Veeva Vault or SAP QM). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68 (Electronic Records); 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 22716

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the GMP compliance event was first detected or observed on the shop floor or in the laboratory. This is the principal real-world event time (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Distinct from the record creation timestamp. Critical for regulatory timelines and investigation SLA tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature token or hash of the approver who reviewed and closed the GMP event record, as required by FDA 21 CFR Part 11. Captures the meaning of the signature (e.g., 'Reviewed and Approved'), the signer identity reference, and timestamp encoded in the token. Managed by Veeva Vault e-signature module.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 22716 Section 10; Veeva Vault Electronic Signature

attributes.name: environmental_zone
attributes.description: ISO cleanroom classification zone or EU GMP environmental grade where the GMP event occurred. Relevant for environmental_monitoring_excursion event types. Grade A/B are highest cleanliness requirements; Grade C/D are controlled areas. Used for contamination risk assessment.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 1; ISO 14644 Cleanroom Standards; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.42

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the GMP compliance event, including what was observed, where it occurred, and the immediate circumstances. Captured by the detecting operator or quality technician at time of detection. Serves as the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT (qualitative payload) category for non-monetary TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the GMP compliance event, used in regulatory submissions, CAPA tracking, and cross-system references. Format: GMP-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; Veeva Vault Quality Document Numbering

attributes.name: event_severity
attributes.description: Risk-based severity classification of the GMP event. Critical: potential impact on product safety or patient/consumer harm; requires immediate escalation and regulatory notification. Major: significant departure from GMP requirements with potential quality impact. Minor: low-risk deviation with minimal quality impact. Drives CAPA prioritization and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GMP compliance event. open: newly detected, investigation not yet started. under_investigation: root cause analysis in progress. pending_capa: investigation complete, awaiting CAPA closure. closed: all actions completed and verified effective. cancelled: event determined to be erroneous or duplicate. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; Veeva Vault Quality Workflow

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the GMP compliance event by its nature. Values: deviation (unplanned departure from approved procedure), oos_result (Out-of-Specification laboratory result), environmental_monitoring_excursion (EM limit breach), equipment_failure (critical equipment malfunction), process_parameter_breach (critical process parameter out of range), contamination_event (microbial or cross-contamination incident). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deviation|oos_result|environmental_monitoring_excursion|equipment_failure|process_parameter_breach|contamination_event — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q10

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of the immediate containment or corrective action taken at the time of GMP event detection to prevent further impact (e.g., line stoppage, batch quarantine, equipment isolation). Distinct from the formal CAPA which addresses root cause prevention.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; GMP Good Practice Guidelines

attributes.name: investigation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the root cause investigation must be completed, based on event severity and regulatory SLA requirements. Critical events typically require investigation within 3 business days; major within 10 days; minor within 30 days. Used for overdue investigation tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q10

attributes.name: is_product_recall_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event has been assessed as a potential trigger for a product recall or market withdrawal. True when the event involves a safety risk to consumers that may require removal of product from distribution channels. Activates recall management workflow.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 (Recall Policy); CPSC Section 15(b); ISO 22716 Section 10

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: Name or code of the specific manufacturing process step (e.g., mixing, filling, packaging, sterilization, labeling) during which the GMP event was detected. Sourced from Siemens Opcenter MES routing. Used for process-level failure mode analysis.
attributes.references: Siemens Opcenter MES; ISO 22716 Section 7; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.100

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event is a recurrence of a previously closed event of the same type at the same facility or production line. True when a similar event has occurred within the past 12 months. Triggers escalated investigation and CAPA effectiveness review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q10

attributes.name: regulation_reference
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard or clause that this GMP event relates to or potentially violates. Examples: 'ISO 22716:2007 Section 10.2', 'FDA 21 CFR Part 211.113', 'EU GMP Annex 1'. Used for regulatory submission mapping and compliance gap analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP Guidelines; CPSC Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority was formally notified of this GMP event. Populated only when regulatory_notification_required is true and notification has been submitted. Used for regulatory compliance timeline tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EU GMP Directive; CPSC Section 15(b) Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event requires formal notification to a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EU Competent Authority, CPSC). Typically true for critical events involving potential consumer safety risk, product recall triggers, or serious GMP failures. Drives regulatory affairs workflow.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EU GMP Directive 2003/94/EC; CPSC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assigned to the GMP event based on ICH Q9 risk assessment methodology, combining probability of occurrence, severity of impact, and detectability. Typically scored on a 1-100 scale. Used for risk-based prioritization of investigations and CAPA resources.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ISO 22716 Section 10; FDA Guidance on Quality Risk Management

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorized root cause of the GMP event as determined through investigation. Populated after investigation is complete. Used for trend analysis, systemic failure identification, and CAPA effectiveness measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: human_error|equipment_malfunction|raw_material|process_design|environmental|documentation|training — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the identified root cause of the GMP event, as documented by the quality investigator. Populated upon completion of root cause analysis (RCA). Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA justification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 22716 Section 10; ICH Q10

attributes.name: sap_qm_notification_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Quality Management (QM) notification number associated with this GMP event. Quality notifications in SAP QM are the operational system of record for defect tracking and corrective actions. Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse and SAP QM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 9001:2015 Section 10.2

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing shift during which the GMP event was detected (e.g., A-shift, B-shift, night shift). Used for shift-level quality performance analysis, operator accountability, and identifying shift-specific patterns in GMP deviations.
attributes.references: Siemens Opcenter MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Shift Management; ISO 22716 Section 5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the GMP event record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 22716; Veeva Vault Audit Trail

attributes.name: veeva_document_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier of the corresponding GMP event record in Veeva Vault Quality Document Management system. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record for regulatory document management.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Module; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 22716

products.name: production_confirmation
products.description: Shop floor execution and confirmation record capturing the complete lifecycle of each manufacturing operation within a production order — from assignment and scheduling through actual execution and final confirmation. Captures work order number, parent production order reference, operation number, work center, assigned operator, scheduled start/end, actual start/end, confirmation type (partial, final), confirmed yield quantity, confirmed scrap quantity, actual setup/machine/labor time, operation status (open, in-progress, completed, cancelled), posting date, and MES transaction reference (Siemens Opcenter). SSOT for granular shop floor execution tracking, labor confirmation, production order settlement, and OEE calculation. Subsumes discrete work order assignment data.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Order Confirmation (CO11N)

attributes.name: production_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production confirmation record. Primary key for shop floor execution tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which labor and overhead costs for this operation are allocated for financial accounting.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this operation was performed.

attributes.name: primary_production_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shop floor operator or employee who executed and confirmed this manufacturing operation.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent production order under which this operation was executed.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Production confirmation reports must reference the sales order they fulfill for accurate shipping and invoicing.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished or semi-finished material (SKU) produced by this operation.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (production line, machine, or station) where this operation was performed.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type code representing the type of work performed (e.g., machine hours, labor hours, setup hours) for cost allocation purposes.

attributes.name: actual_end_datetime
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the operation was completed and confirmed by the operator. Used for OEE calculation and production order settlement.

attributes.name: actual_labor_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual operator labor time spent on this operation including manual work, monitoring, and quality checks. Measured in minutes.

attributes.name: actual_machine_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time the machine or equipment was actively running during this operation. Excludes setup and downtime. Measured in minutes.

attributes.name: actual_setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time spent on machine setup, changeover, and preparation activities before production began. Measured in minutes.

attributes.name: actual_start_datetime
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the operator began executing this operation on the shop floor. Captured from MES or manual confirmation.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number assigned to the output produced in this operation. Critical for traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: confirmation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the operator or supervisor regarding this operation execution, including any issues or observations.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this confirmation record was created and submitted to the ERP or MES system.

attributes.name: confirmation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the confirmation event indicating whether this is a partial progress update, final completion, milestone checkpoint, rework confirmation, or cancellation.

attributes.name: confirmed_scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of defective or waste material generated during this operation. Used for yield variance analysis and quality tracking.

attributes.name: confirmed_yield_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of good output produced and confirmed for this operation. Measured in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: downtime_minutes
attributes.description: Total unplanned downtime during this operation due to equipment failure, material shortage, or other interruptions. Measured in minutes.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this operation was executed in compliance with GMP standards as required for regulated consumer goods products.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this confirmation record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: mes_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction reference from the Siemens Opcenter MES system that originated this confirmation. Used for traceability and system reconciliation.

attributes.name: oee_availability_percent
attributes.description: Calculated availability component of OEE for this operation, representing the percentage of scheduled time that equipment was available for production.

attributes.name: oee_performance_percent
attributes.description: Calculated performance component of OEE for this operation, representing actual production speed versus ideal speed.

attributes.name: oee_quality_percent
attributes.description: Calculated quality component of OEE for this operation, representing the percentage of good output versus total output produced.

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Sequential operation identifier within the production order routing. Typically a 4-digit numeric code representing the step in the manufacturing process.

attributes.name: operation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the manufacturing operation indicating its execution state in the production workflow.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Financial posting date when this confirmation was recorded in the ERP system for inventory and cost accounting purposes.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this operation output requires quality inspection before release to inventory or next operation.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation has been reversed or cancelled due to error correction or process adjustment.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why this confirmation was reversed, if applicable. Used for process improvement and error tracking.

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation represents a rework operation to correct defects from a previous production run.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: Planned completion date and time for this operation as determined by production scheduling or MES system.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: Planned start date and time for this operation as determined by production scheduling or MES system.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Production shift identifier during which this operation was executed (e.g., SHIFT_1, DAY, NIGHT). Used for shift performance analysis.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating system that created this confirmation record (SAP PP, Siemens Opcenter MES, or manual entry).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the confirmed quantities (e.g., KG for kilograms, EA for each, LT for liters). Aligns with material master UOM.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining any significant variance between planned and actual quantities or times. Used for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the work order assigned to this manufacturing operation. Externally visible reference used across shop floor systems.

products.name: process_parameter
products.description: In-process control (IPC) and critical process parameter (CPP) record capturing measured process variables during manufacturing operations. Captures parameter record ID, batch record reference, work order reference, work center, parameter name (temperature, pH, viscosity, fill weight, torque, pressure), parameter type (CPP, CQA, IPC), target value, lower control limit, upper control limit, actual measured value, unit of measure, measurement timestamp, measurement method, operator ID, and out-of-specification (OOS) flag. Supports GMP process validation and real-time SPC monitoring.
products.reference: Siemens Opcenter MES — Process Parameter / SPC

attributes.name: process_parameter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process parameter record. Primary key for in-process control and critical process parameter measurements.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the batch manufacturing record under which this parameter was measured. Links to the batch master record for traceability.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrective and preventive action (CAPA) record initiated in response to an out-of-specification measurement.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production operator or technician who recorded or verified the parameter measurement. Links to workforce management system.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific manufacturing equipment or instrument used to measure or control the parameter.

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product specification or process specification document that defines the control limits for this parameter.

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The actual measured value of the process parameter recorded during manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The date when the measuring instrument or sensor is next due for calibration. Ensures measurement validity per GMP requirements.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes recorded by the operator or quality personnel regarding the parameter measurement, including any anomalies or observations.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the measurement result requires corrective action or investigation (True = action required, False = no action needed).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system from which the parameter measurement was captured: MES (Manufacturing Execution System), SCADA, LIMS, manual entry, or ERP.

attributes.name: deviation_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated percentage deviation of the actual value from the target value. Used for trend analysis and process capability assessment.

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing facility or plant where the parameter measurement was recorded. Supports multi-site manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: The lower acceptable boundary for the parameter value. Values below this threshold trigger out-of-specification alerts.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The method used to capture the parameter measurement: manual entry by operator, automated sensor reading, inline PAT sensor, or laboratory analysis.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the parameter measurement was taken during the manufacturing process. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: oos_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the measured value falls outside the defined control limits (True = out of specification, False = within specification).

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the process parameter being measured (e.g., temperature, pH, viscosity, fill weight, torque, pressure, mixing speed, dwell time).

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parameter: CPP (Critical Process Parameter), CQA (Critical Quality Attribute), IPC (In-Process Control), PAT (Process Analytical Technology).

attributes.name: process_stage
attributes.description: The manufacturing process stage or operation step during which the parameter was measured (e.g., mixing, heating, filling, cooling, packaging).

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific production line within the work center where the parameter was measured. Enables line-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this process parameter record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this process parameter record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this parameter measurement must be included in regulatory submissions or audit documentation (True = reportable, False = internal only).

attributes.name: sample_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical sample taken for measurement, if applicable. Links to laboratory information management system (LIMS).

attributes.name: sensor_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific sensor or probe that captured the measurement, if applicable. Used for sensor calibration tracking.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production shift during which the parameter measurement was taken (e.g., A, B, C, or day/night shift codes).

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The target or setpoint value for the process parameter as defined in the batch master recipe or process specification.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the parameter is measured (e.g., Celsius, pH units, cP for viscosity, grams, PSI, RPM, seconds).

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: The upper acceptable boundary for the parameter value. Values above this threshold trigger out-of-specification alerts.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the parameter measurement verification by quality assurance: pending review, verified as acceptable, rejected, or under investigation.

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the parameter measurement was verified by quality assurance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the quality assurance personnel who verified or approved the parameter measurement record.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing work center or production line where the parameter was measured. Aligns with SAP PP work center master data.

products.name: planned_order
products.description: Production planning record representing the complete planning pipeline from S&OP/IBP through MRP execution to production order conversion. Encompasses both Master Production Schedule (MPS) entries (planned quantities by SKU/facility/period with schedule versioning) and MRP-generated planned orders (system-proposed production or procurement proposals). Captures planned order ID, order type (MPS, MRP planned, CBP), SKU, plant, MRP run reference, planned quantity, scheduled start/finish dates, planning period (week/month), schedule version, S&OP cycle reference, IBP plan version, firming indicator, schedule status (draft, firmed, released, converted, deleted), exception message code, planner ID, and conversion status. SSOT for MRP exception management, MPS governance, and the complete production planning pipeline from demand signal through to production order creation.

attributes.name: planned_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the planned order record. Primary key for the planned order entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Planned Order Object

attributes.name: converted_production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order that was created from this planned order upon conversion. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production planner or planning team responsible for managing this planned order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Planner Assignment

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where production is planned to occur.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that this planned order is for. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.trade_account. Business justification: Supports demand‑planning reports linking planned production to specific customer accounts and forecast agreements.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.trade_promotion. Business justification: Planned Promotional Production aligns MRP planned orders with upcoming trade promotions to ensure supply availability.

attributes.name: availability_date
attributes.description: The date when the produced or procured material from this planned order is expected to be available for consumption or shipment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Availability Check

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: The date when this planned order was converted to a production order. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: conversion_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this planned order has been converted to a production order: NOT_CONVERTED (still in planning), PARTIALLY_CONVERTED (split conversion), FULLY_CONVERTED (completely converted).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Conversion

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or automated process that created this planned order.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this planned order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: demand_source_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the originating demand document (sales order number, forecast ID, transfer request number, etc.).

attributes.name: demand_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand signal that triggered this planned order: FORECAST (demand planning), CUSTOMER_ORDER (firm sales order), STOCK_TRANSFER (inter-plant), SAFETY_STOCK (replenishment), PROMOTION (trade promotion demand).

attributes.name: exception_message_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Exception Message Code
attributes.description: Code representing MRP exception conditions (e.g., EX01 = reschedule in, EX02 = reschedule out, EX03 = cancel, EX10 = expedite). Empty if no exception.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - MRP Exception Messages

attributes.name: exception_message_text
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the MRP exception condition requiring planner attention.

attributes.name: firming_date
attributes.description: The date when this planned order was firmed by a planner. Null if not yet firmed.

attributes.name: firming_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this planned order is firmed (locked from automatic MRP changes). True = firmed, False = subject to MRP rescheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Firming Logic

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this planned order must comply with GMP regulations. True for pharmaceutical and cosmetic products requiring ISO 22716 compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: ibp_plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier from SAP IBP system that generated the demand signal driving this planned order. Format: IBP-YYYYMM.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or automated process that last modified this planned order.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this planned order record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lot_size_key
attributes.description: Code indicating the lot-sizing procedure used: EX (exact lot size), HB (lot-for-lot), FX (fixed lot size), PD (periodic lot size), WM (weekly lot size).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Lot Sizing

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or planning group responsible for this material and plant combination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - MRP Controller

attributes.name: mrp_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific MRP run that generated or last modified this planned order. Links to MRP execution history.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - MRP Run

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planners to add comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this planned order.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the planned order, typically system-generated following organizational numbering conventions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Planned Order Number

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planned order: DRAFT (initial creation), FIRMED (locked from MRP changes), RELEASED (approved for execution), CONVERTED (converted to production order), DELETED (marked for deletion), CANCELLED (cancelled before conversion).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Status

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planned order origin: MPS (Master Production Schedule), MRP (Material Requirements Planning generated), CBP (Consumption-Based Planning), MANUAL (manually created), FORECAST (forecast-driven), SAFETY (safety stock replenishment).

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU planned to be produced or procured in this order, expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: planning_period
attributes.description: The planning time bucket this order belongs to, expressed as YYYY-Wnn (week), YYYY-Mnn (month), or YYYY-Qn (quarter). Used for MPS and S&OP alignment.

attributes.name: planning_strategy_group
attributes.description: Two-digit code defining the planning strategy (e.g., 10 = make-to-stock, 20 = make-to-order, 40 = planning with final assembly, 50 = planning without final assembly).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Planning Strategies

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this planned order for scheduling and resource allocation: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Priority Management

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this planned order is for in-house production (IN_HOUSE), external procurement (EXTERNAL), or can be either (BOTH).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Procurement Type

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Identifies the specific combination of BOM (Bill of Materials) and routing to be used for production. Links to production master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Production Version

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The inventory level that triggers generation of a planned order for replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Reorder Point Planning

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The safety stock level maintained for this SKU at this plant, influencing planned order generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Safety Stock

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the MPS schedule that generated or governs this planned order. Enables tracking of schedule changes over time.

attributes.name: scheduled_finish_date
attributes.description: The planned date when production or procurement activities for this order should be completed and goods available.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Basic Dates

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: The planned date when production or procurement activities for this order should begin.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Basic Dates

attributes.name: sop_cycle_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the S&OP planning cycle that this planned order aligns with. Format: SOP-YYYY-Mnn or SOP-YYYY-Qn.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the planned quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter). Follows ISO standard unit codes.

products.name: equipment
products.description: Master reference table for equipment. Referenced by equipment_id.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for equipment

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production line on which the equipment operates.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant entity that houses the equipment.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Purchase price paid for the equipment.

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Internal tag or barcode used to physically label the equipment.

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next calibration.

attributes.name: capacity_units
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the equipment's capacity.

attributes.name: capacity_value
attributes.description: Numeric capacity of the equipment expressed in the specified units.

attributes.name: compliance_gmp
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment complies with GMP standards.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Currency in which the acquisition cost is expressed.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department responsible for the equipment.

attributes.name: depreciation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment is fully depreciated.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to depreciate the equipment.

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when depreciation of the equipment begins.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free‑form text describing the equipment's purpose and characteristics.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total energy consumed by the equipment in kilowatt‑hours.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Category of equipment based on function or form factor.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Level of hazard associated with equipment operation.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the equipment was installed and became operational.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment was last calibrated.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent scheduled maintenance.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the plant or facility where the equipment resides.

attributes.name: maintenance_cost
attributes.description: Cost incurred for the most recent maintenance activity.

attributes.name: maintenance_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between routine maintenance events.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Company that produced the equipment.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Model identifier assigned by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: mtbf_hours
attributes.description: Average operating hours between equipment failures.

attributes.name: mttr_hours
attributes.description: Average time required to repair equipment after a failure.

attributes.name: name

domains.name: consumer
domains.description: SSOT for all end consumers, shoppers, households, and loyalty program members in B2C and DTC channels. Manages consumer profiles, preferences, purchase history, segmentation, NPS scores, CLTV calculations, consent and privacy preferences (GDPR/CCPA), and contact data. Supports CRM, personalization, and consumer engagement programs.

products.name: shopper
products.description: Golden master record for every end consumer and shopper across B2C and DTC channels. Stores consumer identity (full name, date of birth, gender), contact details (primary email, phone), language and currency preferences, acquisition metadata (channel, date), consumer lifecycle status (active/inactive/opted-out), identity verification status, and source system references. This is the single anchor entity for the consumer domain — all other consumer entities reference this record via shopper_id. Supports CRM, personalization, regulatory compliance (GDPR/CCPA subject identification), and consumer 360-degree view.
products.reference: Consumer Master / CRM Account (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud)

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for every end consumer and shopper record in the Consumer Goods golden master. This is the anchor primary key for the entire consumer domain — all other consumer entities reference this record. Role: MASTER_PARTY.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: An identifier linking this consumer to a household grouping. Multiple individual shoppers may share the same household_id, enabling household-level purchase analysis, co-habitation segmentation, and family-targeted promotions. Used in Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel household modeling.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel — Household ID; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Household Object

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: The externally-visible loyalty program membership identifier assigned to the consumer upon enrollment. Used as the primary cross-channel identifier for loyalty point accrual, redemption, and tier management in CRM and POS systems.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Member ID; GS1 Party Identifier

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the consumer was first acquired or registered. Supports marketing attribution, channel ROI analysis, and consumer journey analytics. Aligns with DTC, POS, and loyalty enrollment touchpoints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dtc_web|dtc_mobile|retail_pos|loyalty_enrollment|social_media|event|referral|wholesale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Lead Source; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consumer was first acquired or registered in the system (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for cohort analysis, consumer tenure calculations, and lifecycle marketing programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Created Date; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: age_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has passed age verification for access to age-restricted products (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, certain health products). TRUE = age verified; FALSE = not verified. Required for regulatory compliance with FDA and CPSC age-restriction mandates.
attributes.references: FDA Age Verification Requirements; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; GDPR Article 8 (child consent)

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: The consumer's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification (e.g., age-restricted products), lifecycle segmentation, birthday loyalty rewards, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; FDA Age Verification Requirements

attributes.name: ccpa_subject
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Subject Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer is a California resident subject to CCPA protections. TRUE = CCPA applies; FALSE = not a CCPA subject. Drives opt-out of sale workflows, data deletion requests, and disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.100; California Attorney General CCPA Regulations

attributes.name: cltv_segment
attributes.description: The consumer's current CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) segment classification derived from purchase history and predictive modeling. Used for resource allocation in marketing, personalization prioritization, and retention investment decisions. Segment label, not a calculated metric.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — CLTV Segmentation; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Analytics

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the consumer last provided or updated their privacy consent. Provides the auditable consent record required by GDPR Article 7 and CCPA. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the privacy policy and consent notice that the consumer accepted (e.g., 'v2.3', '2024-01'). Used to track consent currency and trigger re-consent workflows when policy versions are updated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 & Recital 32; CCPA Section 1798.135; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: consumer_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the shopper record distinguishing individual consumers, household accounts, small business buyers, enrolled loyalty program members, and guest/anonymous shoppers. Drives CRM segmentation and personalization strategy.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Account Type; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Classification

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The consumer's country of residence in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Determines applicable regulatory framework (GDPR for EU, CCPA for California), tax jurisdiction, and localized product availability.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this shopper record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform. Serves as the authoritative audit trail for record creation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to sharing their personal data with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, market research firms such as Nielsen IQ). TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented. Critical for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CCPA opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Privacy Guidelines

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred display name or alias used in digital channels, loyalty portals, and personalized marketing communications. May differ from legal name.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive email marketing communications. TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented or withdrawn. Mandatory suppression flag for GDPR/CCPA compliance in all outbound email campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: The consumer's legal family name (surname) as captured at registration or identity verification. Combined with given_name to form the full legal identity for CRM, personalization, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gdpr_subject
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer is a GDPR data subject (i.e., located in the EU/EEA and subject to GDPR protections). TRUE = GDPR applies; FALSE = not a GDPR subject. Drives data processing lawful basis checks, right-to-erasure workflows, and data portability requests.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 & 4; EU REACH Regulation (data subject scope)

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The consumer's self-reported gender identity. Used for consumer segmentation, personalized product recommendations, and inclusive marketing. Collected with explicit consent per GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: The consumer's legal given name (first name) as captured at registration or identity verification. Used for personalized communications, CRM, and regulatory subject identification under GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: identity_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consumer's identity was most recently verified (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to assess verification recency and trigger re-verification workflows for high-risk transactions or regulatory audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; NIST SP 800-63; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Identity Verification

attributes.name: identity_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer's identity has been formally verified through an identity verification process (e.g., email confirmation, document verification, phone OTP). TRUE = verified; FALSE = unverified. Affects eligibility for high-value loyalty redemptions and DTC account features.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); CCPA Section 1798.130; NIST SP 800-63 Digital Identity Guidelines

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: The date of the consumer's most recent confirmed purchase transaction across any channel (DTC, retail POS, e-commerce). Used for recency scoring in RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis, churn prediction, and re-engagement campaign triggers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Last Activity Date; SAP S/4HANA SD — Last Order Date

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the consumer record in the lifecycle. 'active' = engaged consumer; 'inactive' = no activity within defined period; 'opted_out' = consumer has withdrawn consent and must not be contacted; 'suspended' = account temporarily restricted; 'pending_verification' = identity not yet confirmed. Drives GDPR/CCPA suppression logic.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 & 17; CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date the consumer formally enrolled in the loyalty program (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate loyalty tenure, anniversary rewards, and cohort-based loyalty analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Enrollment Date

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: The current redeemable loyalty points balance held by the consumer. This is the raw operational balance as recorded in the loyalty system — not a calculated aggregate. Used for redemption eligibility checks and consumer-facing balance display.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Points; ISO 4217 (currency-equivalent valuation)

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: The consumer's current tier within the loyalty program (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Determines benefit entitlements, promotional eligibility, and personalized offer thresholds. Recalculated periodically based on purchase activity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Tier; Consumer Goods Industry Loyalty Best Practices

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The most recently recorded Net Promoter Score (NPS) for this consumer, on a scale of 0–10. NPS is the industry-standard metric for measuring consumer loyalty and likelihood to recommend. Supports consumer satisfaction analytics and brand health reporting.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company / Satmetrix); Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this consumer. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data and trigger re-survey workflows.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Survey Response Date

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The consumer's residential postal or ZIP code. Used for geographic segmentation, regional marketing campaigns, distribution territory assignment, and retail proximity analysis (OSA, planogram relevance).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; GS1 Address Standards

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred transaction currency in ISO 4217 three-letter code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Used for DTC pricing display, loyalty point valuation, and cross-border e-commerce personalization.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred communication language in IETF BCP 47 format (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'es-MX'). Drives localization of marketing communications, product labels, and digital experience personalization.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; ISO 639-1; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Language Preference

attributes.name: preferred_store_banner
attributes.description: The consumer's self-reported or behaviorally-inferred preferred retail store banner or chain (e.g., 'Walmart', 'Target', 'Kroger'). Used for retail execution targeting, trade promotion personalization, and channel affinity analytics in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Retail Execution; TradeEdge Channel Visibility; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: The primary email address used for all consumer communications, loyalty program enrollment, DTC order confirmations, and digital marketing. Serves as the principal digital identity key in CRM and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: The consumer's primary contact phone number in E.164 international format. Used for SMS marketing, two-factor authentication, consumer care, and DTC order notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in

attributes.name: registration_source_url

attributes.name: sms_opt_in

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id

attributes.name: merged_from_household_id

attributes.name: panel_id

attributes.name: children_present_flag

attributes.name: cltv_band

attributes.name: consent_last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: geographic_region

attributes.name: household_code

attributes.name: household_name

attributes.references: GS1 Party Address Type Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD Address Category

attributes.name: carrier_route
attributes.description: USPS carrier route code assigned to this address (e.g., C001, R001, B001, H001). Used for direct mail presort discounts, delivery sequence optimization, and postal cost modeling in consumer marketing programs.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Carrier Route Certification; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: U.S. Census Bureau census tract code for the address location. Enables demographic overlay analysis, market penetration reporting by socioeconomic segment, and trade area planning for consumer goods distribution.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line; Nielsen IQ Market Intelligence - Geographic Segmentation

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the consumer's address. Used for geographic segmentation, regional marketing campaigns, distribution zone assignment, and regulatory data residency tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; UPU S42 Address Standard

attributes.name: consent_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consumer consent was obtained for storing and processing this address record under applicable privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA). True indicates consent is on file; False requires consent collection before marketing use.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing); GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consumer provided consent for storage and processing of this address record. Required for GDPR Article 7 compliance documentation and CCPA opt-in audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the consumer's address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance, international shipping eligibility, tax jurisdiction, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44 (Data Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.140; GS1 Country Code Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was first created in the system. Supports GDPR Article 30 records of processing activities, data lineage tracking, and audit trail requirements for consumer data governance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: data_residency_region
attributes.description: Geographic data residency classification for this address record, indicating the regulatory jurisdiction governing data storage and processing. Drives GDPR (EU), CCPA (US/CA), and other regional privacy law compliance for data localization requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44-49 (International Data Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.140; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Residency

attributes.name: deliverability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the likelihood that a physical shipment or direct mail piece will be successfully delivered to this address. Derived from address validation provider output. Supports carrier selection and DTC fulfillment risk management.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Deliverability Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: dma_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Designated Market Area (DMA) code for the address location. Used for media planning, Share of Voice (SOV) analysis, and regional brand marketing investment allocation in consumer goods trade promotion programs.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ DMA Definitions; Nielsen Retail Measurement Service

attributes.name: do_not_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has opted out of physical direct mail marketing to this address. When True, this address must be suppressed from direct mail campaign execution lists. Supports GDPR right-to-object and CCPA opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC CAN-SPAM Act; DMA (Data & Marketing Association) Guidelines

attributes.name: dpv_confirmation
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Validation confirmation code indicating the deliverability of the address. Y=Confirmed deliverable, S=Confirmed deliverable (secondary info missing), D=Confirmed deliverable (secondary info present but unneeded), N=Not confirmed. Critical for DTC fulfillment and direct mail campaigns.
attributes.references: USPS CASS DPV Certification; USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this address record is considered valid and active for business use. Supports bi-temporal data modeling, address history tracking, and GDPR right-to-erasure compliance by enabling point-in-time address reconstruction.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP S/4HANA Address Validity Period

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this address record is no longer valid for business use. Null indicates an open-ended active address. Used for address lifecycle management, historical reporting, and GDPR data minimization compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP S/4HANA Address Validity Period

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address format to guide formatting, validation, and carrier routing logic. PO Box addresses may not be eligible for certain DTC carriers; military addresses (APO/FPO/DPO) require specific handling; rural route addresses may have extended delivery windows.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards; UPU S42 International Address Standard

attributes.name: geocoding_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded latitude/longitude coordinates for this address. Rooftop indicates exact parcel-level geocoding; range_interpolated indicates interpolation between street numbers; geometric_center indicates centroid of a polygon. Impacts reliability of proximity-based analytics.
attributes.references: Google Maps Geocoding API Accuracy Levels; ISO 19111 Geographic Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: is_default_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the consumer's default billing address for payment processing and invoice generation. Used in DTC checkout flows and financial compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Customer Master Billing Address; PCI DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: is_default_shipping
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the consumer's default shipping destination for DTC orders. Distinct from is_primary as a consumer may have a primary home address but a different default shipping address (e.g., workplace).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Partner Address Determination; Oracle Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the consumer's primary address record for the given address type. When True, this address is used as the default for order fulfillment, marketing communications, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Address Management

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the consumer's address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Enables geocoded proximity analysis, delivery zone optimization, and location-based personalized marketing.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including house/building number and street name. Core component of the consumer's physical location used for DTC order fulfillment, direct mail marketing, and GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Postal Addressing Standards; GS1 GLN Address Standard

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, floor, or building designations. Supplements address_line_1 to ensure complete and accurate delivery routing for DTC shipments.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location details such as neighborhood, district, or care-of designations. Used in international address formats where three address lines are required.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the consumer's address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used alongside latitude for geocoded proximity analysis, store locator features, and last-mile delivery optimization.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: plus4_code
attributes.description: The four-digit USPS ZIP+4 extension code that narrows delivery to a specific block face or building. Enables postal presort discounts for direct mail campaigns and improves delivery precision for DTC shipments within the United States.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP+4 Code Standard; USPS Publication 28; USPS CASS Certification

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the consumer's address. Used for last-mile delivery routing, trade area analysis, demographic segmentation, and carrier rate determination in DTC fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; UPU S42; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: residential_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the address as residential or commercial. Impacts carrier surcharge calculations (UPS/FedEx residential delivery fees), marketing segmentation, and DTC fulfillment cost modeling.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Residential Delivery Indicator; UPS/FedEx Residential Surcharge Guidelines

attributes.name: sales_territory_code
attributes.description: Internal sales territory or region code assigned to this address based on geographic boundaries. Used for Sales Force Automation (SFA) territory assignment, trade promotion planning, and regional sales performance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Territory Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Territory

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system of record (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Contact Address ID, SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Address GUID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BP Address GUID; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Address Object; Oracle Cloud ERP Party Site ID

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this address record originated. Supports data lineage, master data management (MDM) conflict resolution, and Silver Layer data quality governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Oracle Cloud ERP; ISO/IEC 27001 Asset Management

attributes.name: standardized_address
attributes.description: The full address formatted as a single standardized string per USPS/UPU postal standards after address validation and normalization (e.g., '123 MAIN ST APT 4B, CHICAGO IL 60601-1234'). Used as the canonical address for carrier label generation and deduplication.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Standardization; UPU S42; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the consumer's address using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (e.g., US-CA, CA-ON). Supports tax jurisdiction determination, regional compliance, and territory-based sales reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling personalized marketing communications at optimal local times and for regulatory compliance with time-sensitive consumer notifications.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; GDPR Article 12 (Timely Communication)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, data freshness monitoring, and GDPR data accuracy compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO/IEC 27001 Change Management; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

attributes.name: validation_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party address validation service used to verify this address (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate, Google Maps API). Supports audit trails for data quality governance and vendor performance tracking.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; ISO 9001 Data Quality Management

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation state of the address record as determined by address verification services (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate). Validated addresses reduce failed DTC deliveries and return-to-sender costs. Failed addresses require consumer outreach before order fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS CASS (Coding Accuracy Support System); GS1 Address Validation Guidelines
