attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Orchestration; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_contact_frequency
attributes.description: The consumer's declared preference for how often they wish to receive brand communications. Used by communication orchestration engines to enforce contact frequency caps and prevent consumer fatigue in CPG engagement programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|as_needed|never — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact Frequency Management; FTC CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred language for communications, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'es-MX'). Used by communication orchestration platforms to deliver brand content in the consumer's preferred language.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 — Language Tags; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Preferences

attributes.name: preferred_time_of_day
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred time window for receiving communications and push notifications. Used by send-time optimization algorithms in CPG personalization engines to maximize open rates and engagement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Send-Time Optimization

attributes.name: preferred_timezone
attributes.description: The IANA timezone identifier for the consumer's preferred timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Used in conjunction with preferred_time_of_day to schedule communications at the correct local time for global CPG consumer bases.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Scheduling

attributes.name: product_category_preference
attributes.description: The specific CPG product category this consumer prefers (e.g., 'oral_care', 'hair_care', 'skin_care', 'household_cleaning', 'personal_hygiene'). Drives product recommendation engines and category-level targeted promotions. Populated when preference_category = 'product_category'.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); Nielsen IQ Category Management

attributes.name: retail_channel_preference
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred retail channel for purchasing CPG products. Used for channel-specific targeting, trade promotion alignment, and omnichannel engagement strategies. Supports DSD (Direct Store Delivery) and DTC channel optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ecommerce|grocery|mass_retail|pharmacy|dtc|club_store|convenience|specialty — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Channel Management; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: sku_preference
attributes.description: The specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code that the consumer has declared or demonstrated a preference for. Enables SKU-level personalization and targeted replenishment reminders in DTC and e-commerce channels. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM material master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; GS1 SKU Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this preference record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when the same consumer has preferences captured across multiple touchpoints (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud vs. web portal vs. call center). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_cgc|sap_s4hana|web_portal|mobile_app|call_center|in_store_kiosk|survey_platform|nielsen_iq — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1 Data Quality Framework

attributes.name: source_system_preference_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this preference record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud preference record ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and EDI-based data exchange between CPG operational systems.
attributes.references: EDI Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Data Integration

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the preference category. For example, within 'product_category' the subcategory may be 'hair_care' or 'oral_care'; within 'communication_channel' it may be 'email' or 'push_notification'. Enables multi-level preference taxonomy for CPG personalization engines.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Preference Framework

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason this preference record has been suppressed when preference_status = 'suppressed'. Critical for GDPR right-to-erasure (Article 17) and CCPA opt-out compliance documentation. Ensures downstream systems do not act on suppressed preferences.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; CCPA Section 1798.120

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Formal consent and privacy preference record for a consumer capturing GDPR, CCPA, and other regulatory consent obligations, including full audit history of all consent changes. Stores consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, cookies), current consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent version, capture method (web form, app, in-store, call center), capture timestamp, IP address, regulatory jurisdiction, expiry date, and immutable event log of every status change (prior status, new status, change trigger, channel, processing agent/system). This is the SSOT for consumer privacy compliance and provides the complete consent history required for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent record in the Consumer Goods consumer privacy system. Primary key for the consent_record data product, serving as the SSOT for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or re-consent campaign that prompted this consent record creation or update. Enables campaign-level consent conversion tracking and supports Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and consumer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: channel_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution or engagement channel (e.g., DTC e-commerce, retail loyalty, mobile app) through which the consumer relationship was established and consent was captured. Supports channel-level consent analytics.

attributes.name: data_subject_request_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) or right-to-erasure request that triggered a consent status change, if applicable. Links consent changes to formal regulatory requests for audit traceability under GDPR Articles 15-22.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 15; GDPR Article 17; GDPR Article 21; CCPA Section 1798.105

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Data privacy compliance mandates mapping each consent record to its governing jurisdiction for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program associated with this consent record, if the consumer is a loyalty program member. Consent for loyalty program data processing is tracked separately from general marketing consent.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Consumer Goods brand for which this consent was captured. Enables brand-level consent reporting and ensures that consent granted for one brand is not incorrectly applied to another brand within the same corporate portfolio.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile record for whom this consent record applies. Links the consent record to the consumer master in the CRM/DTC system (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud).

attributes.name: capture_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer's consent was captured. Identifies whether consent was obtained via a web form, mobile app, in-store interaction, call center agent, paper form, or email link. Required for GDPR proof-of-consent obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the consumer's consent action was recorded in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent record and is immutable once set. Required for GDPR Article 7 audit trail.

attributes.name: change_trigger
attributes.description: The business reason or event that triggered the most recent change to the consent status. Distinguishes consumer-initiated changes from system-driven expirations, administrative overrides, legal requests (e.g., right to erasure), or re-consent campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; ISO 29101

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the consent notice was presented to the consumer (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'es-MX'). Required to confirm consent was given in an intelligible form per GDPR Article 7.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(2); GDPR Recital 42; ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: consent_proof_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the stored proof-of-consent artifact (e.g., screenshot, signed form scan, call recording reference, Veeva Vault document ID). Supports GDPR Article 7(1) obligation to demonstrate that consent was given.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); Veeva Vault (Quality Documents); ISO 27001

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the consent grant — whether it applies globally across all Consumer Goods brands and products, is restricted to a specific brand, product category, or a single campaign. Enables granular consent management across the product portfolio.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record indicating whether the consumer has actively granted, withdrawn, or is pending confirmation of consent, or whether the consent has expired past its validity period.

attributes.name: consent_text_snapshot
attributes.description: Verbatim text or reference hash of the consent notice, privacy policy excerpt, or opt-in language presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Immutable record of what the consumer agreed to, required for GDPR Article 7 proof-of-consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent being captured, defining the specific processing activity for which the consumer has provided or withheld consent. Covers marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, and cookies as required by GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 22; CCPA Section 1798.120; ePrivacy Directive

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice, privacy policy, or terms document presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Enables tracking of which policy version was in effect when consent was given, critical for GDPR Article 7 compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: cookie_consent_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cookie categories for which the consumer has granted consent (e.g., 'functional,analytics,marketing'). Captures granular cookie preferences as required by the ePrivacy Directive and GDPR for digital channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: necessary|functional|analytics|marketing|social_media|personalization|advertising — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ePrivacy Directive Article 5(3); GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; IAB TCF 2.0

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the consumer's country of residence at the time of consent capture. Determines applicable privacy regulation (e.g., GDPR for EU countries, CCPA for USA/California). Critical for multi-jurisdiction compliance management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from capture_timestamp which records the business event time. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer when providing consent in digital channels. Supports forensic audit trails and UX analysis of consent capture flows.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer completed a double opt-in confirmation process (e.g., clicked a confirmation link in a verification email) in addition to the initial consent action. Double opt-in provides stronger proof of consent for marketing communications under GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; GDPR Article 7; ePrivacy Directive Article 13

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not yet completed. Provides the definitive timestamp for consent activation in double opt-in workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; GDPR Article 7; ePrivacy Directive Article 13

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this consent record is considered active and binding. Typically aligns with the capture date but may differ for backdated or scheduled consent activations. Supports MASTER_AGREEMENT role effective-period tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this consent record expires and must be renewed or re-confirmed by the consumer. Null indicates open-ended consent with no defined expiry. Used to trigger consent renewal workflows and ensure ongoing compliance with GDPR's requirement for time-limited consent.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the consumer submitted their consent. Captured for digital consent channels (web form, mobile app, email link) as evidence of consent origin. May be considered PII under GDPR in some EU jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); GDPR Recital 30; CCPA Section 1798.140(o)

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this row represents the current active consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD Type 2) pattern in the Silver Layer, where historical consent versions are retained for audit purposes and this flag identifies the latest version.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ISO 29101; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 or equivalent regulation for processing the consumer's personal data. Consent is one of six legal bases; this field distinguishes consent-based processing from other lawful bases to support compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Recital 40-49; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: minor_age_threshold
attributes.description: Age threshold (in years) used to determine whether parental consent was required for this consent record, based on the applicable jurisdiction's rules (e.g., 16 for GDPR default, 13 for COPPA, 13-16 for EU member state variations). Null if consumer is not a minor.

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental or guardian consent was obtained for a minor consumer. Required under GDPR Article 8 for children under 16 (or lower age threshold set by member state) and COPPA for US consumers under 13.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: prior_consent_status
attributes.description: The consent status immediately before the most recent status change. Enables point-in-time audit reconstruction and supports the immutable event log requirement for GDPR Article 7 compliance audits without requiring a separate history table join.

attributes.name: processing_agent
attributes.description: Identifier of the system, application, or human agent (call center representative ID or system name) that processed and recorded the consent event. Supports accountability requirements under GDPR Article 5(2) and provides an audit trail of who or what captured the consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); GDPR Article 24; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: profiling_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profiling and Automated Decision-Making Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to automated profiling and decision-making activities, including personalization algorithms, NPS scoring, CLTV modeling, and segmentation. Required under GDPR Article 22 for automated decision-making with significant effects.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22; GDPR Recital 71; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: re_consent_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the consumer must re-confirm their consent before the current consent record is automatically withdrawn or expired. Null if re-consent is not required. Used to drive automated consent renewal campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: re_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record requires re-confirmation from the consumer due to a material change in the privacy policy, consent notice, or processing purpose. Triggers re-consent outreach workflows in the CRM system.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Increments with each status change or update, enabling full audit history reconstruction. Version 1 is the initial consent capture; subsequent versions reflect changes.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The applicable privacy regulation or jurisdiction framework under which this consent record was created and must be managed. Determines the legal basis, retention rules, and consumer rights applicable to this record (e.g., GDPR for EU consumers, CCPA for California residents).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140(g); LGPD Article 3; ISO 29101

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days this consent record must be retained for compliance purposes after the consent is withdrawn or expires. Determined by applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation, CCPA). Drives automated data lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e); GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this consent record originated (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, web portal, mobile app). Enables data lineage tracking and system-of-record reconciliation across the Consumer Goods technology landscape. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_cgc|sap_s4hana|web_portal|mobile_app|call_center_crm|in_store_pos|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has explicitly consented to their personal data being shared with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, data brokers, analytics providers). Distinct from general data sharing consent; specifically governs external data transfers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 44-49 (International Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.120; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

attributes.name: withdrawal_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Required to demonstrate that withdrawal was as easy as giving consent per GDPR Article 7(3).

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. GDPR Article 7(3) requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent; this timestamp documents the withdrawal event for audit purposes.

products.name: consent_event
products.description: Immutable audit log of every consent status change event for a consumer. Records the prior consent status, new consent status, change timestamp, change trigger (consumer action, system expiry, regulatory request), channel of change, agent or system that processed the change, and associated consent record reference. Provides the full consent history required for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: consent_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each immutable consent status change event record in the audit log. Primary key of the consent_event table.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign or trade promotion that triggered or was associated with this consent collection event. Enables campaign-level consent acquisition analytics and Trade Promotion Management (TPM) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GDPR Article 13

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent consent record that this event modifies. Links the event to the current state of the consumer's consent agreement managed in the consent master table.

attributes.name: data_subject_request_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the formal Data Subject Access Request (DSAR), right-to-erasure request, or opt-out request that triggered this consent event. Populated when change_trigger is 'regulatory_request'. Links the event to the formal rights management workflow.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the human agent (e.g., call center representative, CRM user) or automated system that processed and recorded this consent change event. Supports accountability tracing required by GDPR Article 5(2).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Regulatory reporting of consent changes must reference the jurisdiction that governs the consent.

attributes.name: preference_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific preference center or consent management portal instance through which this consent event was captured. Supports multi-brand and multi-region preference center deployments.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: reversal_event_consent_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consent event that reversed or corrected this event, if applicable. Populated when event_status is 'reversed'. Maintains the immutable audit chain while flagging erroneous records.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the web or mobile application session during which the consent event was captured. Enables cross-referencing with session analytics and digital behavior logs for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer whose consent status changed. Identifies the data subject for GDPR/CCPA audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Consumer Goods brand or product line in whose context the consent was collected (e.g., a specific personal care or household brand). Supports brand-level consent segmentation and multi-brand CRM programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GDPR Article 13

attributes.name: change_channel
attributes.description: The interaction channel through which the consent change was submitted or processed. Supports channel-level compliance reporting and consumer journey analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|call_center|in_store|email|postal|crm_agent|api — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: change_trigger
attributes.description: The initiating cause of the consent status change. 'consumer_action' = consumer explicitly acted; 'system_expiry' = automated expiry rule fired; 'regulatory_request' = GDPR/CCPA erasure or opt-out request; 'admin_override' = internal compliance team action; 'data_import' = bulk migration or integration import.

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent granted in this event is scheduled to expire and require renewal. Supports automated consent refresh workflows and ensures time-limited consent is not used beyond its valid period.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICO Guidance on Consent; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the consent notice was presented to the consumer (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr-FR'). Supports multilingual compliance documentation.

attributes.name: consent_purpose_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific processing purpose for which consent was changed (e.g., MARKETING_EMAIL, PERSONALIZATION, ANALYTICS, THIRD_PARTY_SHARING, LOYALTY_PROGRAM). Aligns with the consent purpose taxonomy defined under GDPR Article 5(1)(b) and CCPA categories.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(b); CCPA Section 1798.100; IAB TCF 2.0

attributes.name: consent_purpose_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the processing purpose for which consent was changed. Provides business-friendly label alongside the consent_purpose_code for reporting and consumer-facing disclosures.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; CCPA Section 1798.100; IAB TCF 2.0

attributes.name: consent_text_snapshot
attributes.description: Verbatim or summarized text of the consent notice or opt-in/opt-out statement presented to the consumer at the time of this event. Immutable snapshot stored for evidentiary purposes under GDPR Article 7(1) and CCPA audit requirements.

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice, privacy policy, or terms document that was presented to the consumer at the time of this consent event. Required to demonstrate that consent was informed under GDPR Article 7(1).

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent grant was confirmed via a double opt-in mechanism (True), where the consumer confirmed their consent through a secondary verification step such as an email confirmation link. Relevant for email marketing compliance.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the consumer completed the double opt-in confirmation step (e.g., clicked the email verification link). Null if double_opt_in_flag is False or not applicable.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Processing status of this consent event record. 'processed' = successfully applied to the consumer's consent profile; 'pending' = awaiting confirmation (e.g., double opt-in); 'failed' = processing error; 'reversed' = event was reversed due to error correction.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the consent status change event occurred. This is the authoritative business event time used for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits, distinct from the record ingestion timestamp.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the kind of consent change event. 'grant' = consumer actively provided consent; 'withdraw' = consumer revoked consent; 'update' = scope or preferences modified; 'expire' = consent lapsed due to time limit; 'regulatory_erasure' = right-to-be-forgotten request; 'system_expiry' = automated system-driven expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grant|withdraw|update|expire|regulatory_erasure|system_expiry — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the consumer's device at the time of the consent event submission. Captured as evidentiary proof of consent origin for GDPR Article 7 compliance. May be considered PII in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 30; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: legal_basis_code
attributes.description: GDPR Article 6 lawful basis under which personal data processing is authorized at the time of this event. 'consent' is the primary basis for marketing; other bases apply to operational processing. Required for GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing Activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 30; ICO Guidance on Lawful Basis

attributes.name: minor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer was identified as a minor (under 16 years for GDPR, under 13 for COPPA) at the time of this consent event. Triggers parental consent verification workflows and restricts certain processing activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); CCPA

attributes.name: new_consent_status
attributes.description: The consent status of the consumer immediately after this event was processed. Together with prior_consent_status, provides the complete state transition record for regulatory audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers or CRM agents to record additional context, observations, or exceptions related to this consent event. Not used for structured data; intended for human-readable audit annotations.

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resulting consent status after this event represents an active opt-in (True) or opt-out/withdrawal (False). Provides a simple boolean signal for downstream marketing suppression lists and CRM segmentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental or guardian consent was obtained for this consent event, applicable when minor_flag is True. Required for GDPR Article 8 and COPPA compliance for processing data of minors.

attributes.name: prior_consent_status
attributes.description: The consent status of the consumer immediately before this event was processed. Captured as an immutable snapshot to enable full before/after audit trail required by GDPR Article 7 compliance reviews.

attributes.name: processing_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system that processed and recorded this consent event (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, CRM Portal, Preference Center API). Provides system-level audit trail for data lineage.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: profiling_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to automated profiling and personalization activities (True = profiling consented; False = profiling not consented or withdrawn). Relevant for GDPR Article 22 automated decision-making compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: proof_of_consent_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document path pointing to the stored evidence of consent (e.g., signed form scan, recorded call reference, screenshot archive, Veeva Vault document ID). Supports GDPR Article 7(1) burden-of-proof requirements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consent event record was first ingested and persisted in the data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from event_timestamp which captures the real-world business event time. Used for data lineage and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The specific data protection regulatory framework under which this consent event is governed and must be reported. Enables framework-specific compliance reporting and audit filtering.
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA Section 1798.120; UK GDPR; PIPEDA; LGPD

attributes.name: source_url
attributes.description: The web URL or deep-link of the page, form, or digital touchpoint where the consumer submitted the consent change (e.g., preference center URL, checkout page, registration form). Provides evidence of the consent collection point for GDPR Article 7 accountability.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.100; IAB TCF 2.0

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent event includes or affects the consumer's consent for sharing their personal data with third-party partners, retailers, or data brokers (True = sharing consented; False = sharing not consented or withdrawn).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or application user-agent string captured at the time of the consent event. Provides technical evidence of the device and browser environment used when consent was given, supporting GDPR Article 7 proof-of-consent requirements.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code capturing the consumer's stated reason for withdrawing consent (e.g., TOO_FREQUENT, NOT_RELEVANT, PRIVACY_CONCERN, UNSUBSCRIBE_ALL). Null for non-withdrawal events. Supports consumer experience analytics and suppression management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason_text
attributes.description: Free-text description provided by the consumer or agent explaining the reason for consent withdrawal. Supplements withdrawal_reason_code with verbatim consumer feedback for qualitative analysis.

products.name: dtc_order
products.description: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) order with line-item detail placed by a shopper through owned e-commerce or brand website channels. Captures order header (order number, date, status, channel, shipping/billing address, payment method, subtotal, discount, shipping cost, tax, total, currency, fulfillment reference) and line items (SKU/GTIN, product name, quantity ordered/shipped, unit price, line discount, line total, promotion code, fulfillment status, return flag). This is the SSOT for DTC channel order transactions and enables SKU-level purchase analysis, replenishment triggers, and product affinity modeling.
products.reference: DTC Order / SAP SD Sales Order

attributes.name: dtc_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) order record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Order‑to‑Campaign linkage enables ROI analysis by attributing direct‑to‑consumer orders to the marketing campaign that generated the purchase.

attributes.name: carbon_emission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_emission. Business justification: Order‑level carbon footprint reporting required for ESG disclosures; each order is linked to its calculated carbon emission record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Order processing costs are allocated to internal cost centers for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_facility. Business justification: Order fulfillment report requires order-level DC assignment for shipping cost, OTIF metrics, and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.logistics_shipment. Business justification: Order fulfillment tracking report requires linking each consumer order to the shipment that delivers it, a standard operational need in consumer goods.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Required for consolidated revenue reporting across channels; DTC orders must be reconciled with central sales order for finance.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Required for Order Fulfillment Tracking report linking each consumer DTC order to the procurement purchase order that supplied the goods.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer (shopper) who placed this DTC order. Links to the consumer master profile in the Consumer domain SSOT, enabling CLTV analysis, loyalty program attribution, and personalization. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer subscription plan that generated this DTC order, when subscription_order_flag is True. Links to the subscription master for recurring order management, churn analysis, and subscription revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.trade_account. Business justification: Corporate purchase orders placed by trade accounts for end consumers require linking dtc_order to trade_account for spend reporting and invoicing.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the shipment was confirmed as delivered to the consumer. Compared against promised_delivery_date to calculate OTIF performance and identify late delivery patterns for carrier SLA management.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; OTIF KPI Standards; SLA Standards

attributes.name: billing_address_same_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing Address Same as Shipping Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the billing address is identical to the shipping address for this order. When False, a separate billing address record is maintained. Used for payment processing and fraud risk scoring.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier assigned to deliver this DTC order (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL). Used for carrier performance analysis, SLA tracking, and logistics cost allocation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation; GS1 Carrier Standards

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: The specific owned DTC channel through which the order was placed (e.g., brand website, mobile app, social commerce). Enables channel-level performance analysis, attribution modeling, and Share of Voice (SOV) reporting across DTC touchpoints.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DTC order record was first ingested and created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and ETL reconciliation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial consolidation, FX reporting, and EBITDA calculations. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer to place this DTC order. Used for UX optimization, mobile commerce analytics, and channel attribution modeling to improve conversion rates across device types.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied at the order header level, including promotional codes, loyalty redemptions, and trade promotion discounts. Used for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) ROI analysis and net revenue reporting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Types; TPM Standards

attributes.name: fulfillment_ref
attributes.description: External reference number linking this DTC order to the fulfillment system (e.g., Blue Yonder WMS warehouse order, 3PL fulfillment reference, or SAP WM transfer order). Enables end-to-end order-to-delivery traceability and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM; GS1 SSCC

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment state of the DTC order at the header level, indicating whether all line items have been picked, packed, and shipped. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI reporting and supply chain performance dashboards.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery; OTIF Standards

attributes.name: gift_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DTC order was placed as a gift, triggering gift wrapping, suppression of price information on packing slips, and gift message inclusion. Used for seasonal demand analysis and consumer gifting behavior modeling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: ip_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from the consumer's IP address at the time of order placement. Used for fraud detection, geo-restriction compliance, and cross-border commerce analytics. Classified as potentially PII under GDPR.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the consumer for this DTC order, based on the order total and applicable loyalty tier multipliers. Feeds into CLTV calculations and loyalty program engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; CCPA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the consumer as a discount on this DTC order. Used for loyalty liability accounting, redemption rate analysis, and consumer engagement reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GAAP

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: DTC Order Placement Date and Time
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when the consumer submitted the order through the DTC e-commerce or brand website channel. This is the principal business event timestamp used for demand planning, daily sales reporting, and S&OP inputs. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the DTC order, tracking progression from placement through fulfillment or cancellation. Used for order management dashboards, OTIF reporting, and consumer communication triggers. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|processing|shipped|delivered|cancelled|returned — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Management; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: order_total_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount charged to the consumer, calculated as subtotal minus discounts plus shipping plus tax. This is the authoritative revenue figure for DTC channel financial reporting and EBITDA contribution analysis. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET net total.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SOX

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument type used by the consumer to complete this DTC order (e.g., credit card, PayPal, digital wallet). Used for payment analytics, fraud detection, and consumer payment preference reporting. Note: No raw card data is stored; only the instrument type.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Processing

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment transaction associated with this DTC order, tracking authorization through capture or refund. Critical for revenue recognition, accounts receivable (DSO), and consumer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; PCI DSS v4.0; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: payment_transaction_ref
attributes.description: External payment gateway transaction reference or authorization code for this order. Used for payment reconciliation, chargeback management, and financial audit trails. Does not contain sensitive card data (PCI DSS compliant tokenized reference only).
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date committed to the consumer at the time of order placement, based on Available to Promise (ATP) or Capable to Promise (CTP) logic. Used for SLA compliance measurement and consumer expectation management.
attributes.references: SAP IBP ATP/CTP; SAP S/4HANA SD; SLA Standards

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or coupon code entered by the consumer at checkout, linking this order to a specific Trade Promotion Management (TPM) campaign. Enables TPM ROI measurement, promotional lift analysis, and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) modeling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM; SAP S/4HANA SD Promotions

attributes.name: return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any item in this DTC order has been returned or a return has been initiated. Used for return rate analysis, product quality monitoring, and consumer satisfaction (NPS) correlation studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Returns Management; ISO 9001 Quality

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the order return (e.g., defective product, wrong item, consumer changed mind). Populated when return_flag is True. Used for quality defect analysis, product improvement, and COGS impact reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: defective|wrong_item|not_as_described|changed_mind|damaged_in_transit|late_delivery|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Returns; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: ship_to_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the shipping destination of this DTC order. Used for carrier routing, last-mile delivery, and geographic sales analysis. Classified as PII under GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: ship_to_city
attributes.description: City of the shipping destination for this DTC order. Used for geographic demand analysis, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), and regional marketing segmentation.

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the shipping destination. Drives international shipping compliance, customs documentation, import/export regulatory requirements, and multi-country revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1; FDA; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: ship_to_name
attributes.description: Full name of the recipient at the shipping address for this DTC order. May differ from the ordering consumer (e.g., gift orders). Required for carrier label generation and last-mile delivery. Classified as PII under GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: ship_to_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the shipping destination. Used for carrier rate calculation, geographic clustering, and micro-market demand analysis.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; GS1 Address Standards

attributes.name: ship_to_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the shipping destination. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regional sales reporting, and regulatory compliance (e.g., state-level FDA or EPA requirements).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; CFR Title 26 Tax Jurisdiction

attributes.name: shipped_date
attributes.description: The date the order was physically dispatched from the fulfillment center or warehouse. Used for lead time analysis, carrier handoff tracking, and revenue recognition timing under ASC 606.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue; GAAP ASC 606; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and handling charges billed to the consumer for this DTC order. Used for logistics cost analysis, free-shipping threshold reporting, and net revenue calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: source_system_order_ref
attributes.description: The native order identifier from the originating e-commerce platform or ERP system (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud order ID, SAP SD sales order number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI integration, and data lineage tracing back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; EDI Standards

attributes.name: subscription_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DTC order was generated as part of a recurring subscription (subscribe-and-save) program. Used to distinguish subscription revenue from one-time purchase revenue for CLTV modeling and replenishment trigger analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GAAP ASC 606 Subscription Revenue

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: The gross merchandise value of all line items before discounts, shipping charges, and taxes are applied. Used as the base for promotional discount calculations, COGS analysis, and gross margin reporting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax or VAT charged on this DTC order, calculated based on the shipping destination jurisdiction. Required for financial reporting, tax compliance, and SOX audit trails. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax; SOX Section 404; CFR Title 26

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment associated with this DTC order. Provided to the consumer for last-mile visibility and used internally for delivery confirmation and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 SSCC; Carrier Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this DTC order record in the Silver layer, capturing status changes, address corrections, or payment updates. Supports change data capture and audit compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

products.name: dtc_order_line
products.description: Individual line item within a DTC order representing a single SKU purchased. Stores order reference, SKU/GTIN, product name, quantity ordered, quantity shipped, unit price, line discount, line total, promotion code applied, fulfillment status, and return flag. Enables SKU-level purchase analysis, replenishment triggers, and product affinity modeling for CPG DTC channels.
products.reference: Sales Order Line Item / SAP SD Order Item

attributes.name: dtc_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual line item within a DTC order. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_LINE.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Line‑level attribution assigns each ordered SKU to the campaign that promoted it, supporting product‑level campaign performance reporting.

attributes.name: carbon_emission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_emission. Business justification: Line‑level emission attribution needed for product‑specific carbon accounting and consumer transparency reports.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment warehouse or distribution center from which this order line was or will be shipped. Supports Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) and warehouse performance analytics.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS - Warehouse; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: dtc_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent DTC order header. Establishes the header/detail relationship for this line item. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Sales Order Item

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: Supports Receiving Verification process linking consumer order line to the goods receipt confirming physical receipt from supplier.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound shipment record associated with this order line. Enables traceability from order line to physical shipment for OTIF tracking and logistics cost allocation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS - Shipment; SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Needed for Line‑Level Fulfillment report to map each consumer order line to the procurement PO line that provided the SKU.

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_recall. Business justification: Recall effectiveness analysis needs to associate each order line with the recall that affected the SKU.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Each line item contributes to a profit center; needed for profit‑center reporting per SKU.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion or marketing campaign that generated the discount applied to this line. Links to the promotion master for Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) and ROI measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion Management (TPM)

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the end consumer or shopper who placed the DTC order. Enables consumer-level purchase history, CLTV analysis, and personalization. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE PARTY_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU purchased on this line. Enables SKU-level purchase analysis, product affinity modeling, and replenishment triggers. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_movement. Business justification: Shipment tracking process ties each order line to the inventory movement record that shipped the product.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Fulfillment allocation report requires linking each order line to the specific stock position that supplied the SKU.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer subscription record that triggered this order line, when subscription_flag is True. Enables subscription lifecycle analysis and recurring revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Subscription Management

attributes.name: supply_atp_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.atp_record. Business justification: REQUIRED: Order line allocation references the ATP record used for inventory commitment; this link supports order‑to‑inventory reconciliation and fulfillment reporting.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was confirmed as delivered to the consumer. Used for OTIF calculation, consumer satisfaction analysis, and carrier performance reporting.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS - Proof of Delivery; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was physically dispatched from the fulfillment warehouse. Used to calculate On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and carrier SLA adherence.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS - Shipment Date; SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Goods Issue Date

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the brand under which the product on this order line is marketed. Supports brand-level revenue reporting, Share of Market (SOM) analysis, and brand portfolio performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Brand; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Identifies the specific DTC sub-channel through which this order line was placed (e.g., brand website, mobile app, subscription program, social commerce). Supports channel-level revenue attribution and consumer journey analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Channel Management; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Standard cost of goods for the units on this order line at time of sale. Used for gross margin calculation, DTC channel profitability analysis, and EBITDA reporting. Classified confidential as it reveals internal cost structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Standard Cost; GAAP ASC 330; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this order line are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency DTC operations and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: dtc_return_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer return record associated with this order line when a return has been initiated. Enables end-to-end return lifecycle tracking and refund reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Returns Order; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle state of this order line. Tracks progression from order confirmation through warehouse picking, packing, shipment, and delivery. Supports On Time In Full (OTIF) monitoring and consumer communication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|picking|packed|shipped|delivered|cancelled|backordered — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery Status; Blue Yonder WMS - Order Status

attributes.name: gift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line was designated as a gift by the consumer. True when the consumer selected gift options (e.g., gift wrapping, gift message). Supports gifting program analytics and packaging operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Order Management

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-standard Global Trade Item Number for the product on this line. Enables cross-retailer product identification, barcode scanning, and regulatory traceability. Conforms to GS1 GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14 formats.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards - GTIN Specification

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product on this order line is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, packaging, or shipping restrictions. True for products subject to DOT, IATA, or EPA hazmat regulations. Critical for carrier compliance and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 (SDS); DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: is_returned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line has been subject to a consumer return. True when a return has been initiated or completed. Enables return rate analysis by SKU, category, and consumer segment for product quality and consumer experience programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Returns Order; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: line_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied to this order line, including promotional discounts, coupon redemptions, and loyalty rewards. Used for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) analysis and margin reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Discount Condition; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM

attributes.name: line_discount_pct
attributes.description: Discount rate applied to this order line expressed as a percentage of the gross unit price. Enables promotional effectiveness analysis and margin impact assessment without requiring price recalculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Discount Percentage; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: line_net_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of this order line after all discounts have been applied but before tax. Core revenue recognition field for DTC channel P&L reporting and COGS analysis. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT monetary component.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Net Amount; SOX Financial Reporting; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent DTC order. Used for ordering, display, and reconciliation of multi-line orders. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Sales Order Item Number

attributes.name: line_subtotal
attributes.description: Gross line value before tax, calculated as unit_price multiplied by quantity_ordered. Represents the pre-discount, pre-tax revenue contribution of this line item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Net Value; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this order line inclusive of all discounts and taxes. Represents the actual amount charged to the consumer for this line item. Used for revenue reporting and consumer billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Total Amount; SOX Financial Reporting; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the consumer for purchasing this order line. Supports loyalty program accrual tracking, Consumer Lifetime Value (CLTV) modeling, and consumer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Loyalty Management; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the consumer as a discount on this order line. Enables loyalty redemption rate analysis and program liability management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Loyalty Management

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Hierarchical product category classification code for the SKU on this line (e.g., Personal Care > Hair Care > Shampoo). Enables category-level sales analysis, assortment planning, and consumer purchase pattern segmentation.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Group

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial name of the product SKU as displayed to the consumer at time of purchase. Captured at order time to preserve historical accuracy independent of future product name changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Description

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date communicated to the consumer as the expected delivery date for this order line. Drives consumer expectation management, NPS impact analysis, and carrier performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Requested Delivery Date; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: promised_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was committed to ship to the consumer at time of order placement. Basis for Available to Promise (ATP) and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Confirmed Delivery Date; SAP IBP - ATP

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or coupon code applied by the consumer at checkout that triggered a discount on this order line. Enables Trade Promotion Management (TPM) redemption tracking, campaign ROI analysis, and fraud detection.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion Management (TPM); SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: quantity_cancelled
attributes.description: Number of units cancelled on this order line, either by the consumer or due to inventory unavailability. Supports cancellation rate analysis and demand signal correction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Cancelled Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU ordered by the consumer on this line. Basis for demand planning, inventory reservation, and fulfillment processing. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Order Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_shipped
attributes.description: Actual number of units of the SKU dispatched to the consumer for this line. May differ from quantity_ordered due to partial fulfillment, Out of Stock (OOS) situations, or split shipments. Key metric for On Time In Full (OTIF) measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery Quantity; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is subject to a regulatory hold preventing fulfillment (e.g., FDA product recall, CPSC safety alert, EU REACH restriction). True when a hold is active. Supports compliance-driven order management and consumer safety programs.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the consumer return of this order line. Supports product quality analysis, Quality Control (QC) escalation, and consumer experience improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DEFECTIVE|WRONG_ITEM|NOT_AS_DESCRIBED|CHANGED_MIND|DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT|LATE_DELIVERY|DUPLICATE_ORDER|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Return Reason; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: subscription_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line was generated as part of a recurring subscription program (e.g., Subscribe & Save). True for subscription-triggered lines. Enables subscription revenue tracking and replenishment program analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Subscription Management

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to this order line, including applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST based on consumer jurisdiction. Required for tax compliance reporting and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Tax Condition; CFR Title 26 (IRS); EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the SKU quantity is expressed on this order line (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, PK=Pack). Aligns with GS1 and SAP UOM standards for consistent quantity interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|BX|KG|LB|OZ|L|ML — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards - Unit of Measure; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Gross selling price per unit of the SKU at the time of order placement, before any discounts or promotions. Represents the consumer-facing price (RSP/MSRP or DTC-specific price). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Condition Price; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this order line record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

products.name: dtc_return
products.description: Consumer return or refund request for a DTC order. Captures return request date, return reason code (defective, wrong item, changed mind, damaged in transit), return status (requested, approved, received, refunded, rejected), return method (mail-in, drop-off), refund amount, refund method (original payment, store credit, loyalty points), and associated order and order line references. Supports consumer satisfaction tracking and product quality feedback loops.

attributes.name: dtc_return_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a DTC return or refund request record. Primary key of this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent who processed or approved the return request. Used for agent performance analytics, quality assurance, and audit trail. Sourced from Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud case management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Workday HCM

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Return investigation workflow uses inspection lot data to determine defect source and regulatory hold decisions.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.logistics_shipment. Business justification: Return processing workflow needs the original shipment reference to manage reverse logistics, refunds, and OTIF metrics.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original DTC order against which this return is raised. Links the return to the parent sales transaction for financial reconciliation and consumer satisfaction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item being returned within the original DTC order. Enables line-level return tracking and partial-order return scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP SD Returns Order Item; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_recall. Business justification: Recall management report requires linking each consumer return to the associated product recall record to track recall effectiveness.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile who initiated the return request. Links to the SSOT consumer master record for CRM, loyalty, and consumer satisfaction analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (SKU) being returned. Enables product-level return rate analysis, quality feedback loops, and defect trending by SKU.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Standard; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_movement. Business justification: Return movement tracking links each return to the inventory movement that records the inbound return flow.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Return processing records which stock position the returned SKU is returned to for inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the return request was approved by the consumer service team or automated system. Used for SLA tracking and return processing time analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP SD Returns Processing

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number of the returned product unit. Critical for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) traceability, product recall management, and quality defect root cause analysis. Sourced from product packaging or consumer-provided information.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (GMP); ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; SAP QM Batch Management

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the shipping carrier handling the return shipment (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL). Used for carrier performance analysis, reverse logistics cost allocation, and carrier claims for damaged-in-transit returns.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation; SAP SD Shipping

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Customer service case or ticket number associated with this return request in the CRM system. Enables cross-referencing between the return record and the consumer service interaction history in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Case Management

attributes.name: consumer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Post-return consumer satisfaction rating collected via survey (typically 1–5 or 1–10 scale). Used as an input to Net Promoter Score (NPS) calculations and consumer experience improvement programs. Collected via Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud post-return survey.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Distinct from request_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this return record (refund_amount, restocking_fee_amount, net_refund_amount). Supports multi-currency DTC operations across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the returned product after quality inspection. Drives inventory management, COGS impact, and regulatory compliance for product destruction. Valid values: restock (return to sellable inventory), refurbish (rework required), destroy (product destroyed per policy), return_to_vendor (sent back to supplier), quarantine (held pending investigation).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; SAP QM Usage Decision

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date printed on the returned product. Used for FEFO compliance validation, quality assessment of returned goods, and regulatory reporting for expired product returns.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EU REACH Regulation; ISO 22716

attributes.name: fraud_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this return has been flagged for manual fraud review based on fraud_risk_score or other risk signals. Supports loss prevention workflows and return abuse management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (0.00–100.00) assigned by the fraud detection system to assess the likelihood of return fraud. Drives manual review routing and automated rejection thresholds. Supports loss prevention analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: loyalty_points_refunded
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points credited back to the consumer's account as part of the refund. Populated when refund_method is 'loyalty_points' or when loyalty points were originally redeemed on the order. Supports loyalty program financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Loyalty Management; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: net_refund_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary amount actually refunded to the consumer after deducting any restocking fees or adjustments from the gross refund amount. Used for financial settlement and consumer account reconciliation.
