attributes.description: Date when this channel classification was retired or deprecated. Null for currently active classifications.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this channel classification became effective and available for use in account classification and reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel classification record was last updated.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to delivery for accounts in this channel.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Market positioning segment typically served by this channel (premium, mainstream, value, discount).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Typical MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) requirement for accounts in this channel, expressed in cases or units.

attributes.name: order_frequency
attributes.description: Typical order frequency pattern for accounts in this channel (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, on-demand).

attributes.name: otif_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target OTIF (On Time In Full) service level percentage for accounts in this channel, typically defined in SLA (Service Level Agreement) terms.

attributes.name: payment_terms_standard
attributes.description: Standard payment terms typically negotiated with accounts in this channel (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: planogram_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this channel typically require POG (Planogram) compliance for shelf placement and merchandising.

attributes.name: pos_data_available_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Data Available Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether POS (Point of Sale) data is typically available from accounts in this channel for demand sensing and analytics.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Typical pricing strategy employed by accounts in this channel: EDLP (Everyday Low Price), Hi-Lo (High-Low promotional pricing), hybrid, or dynamic pricing.

attributes.name: primary_tier
attributes.description: Top-level classification of the trade channel. Primary tier segments the market into major channel categories.

attributes.name: return_policy
attributes.description: Standard return and unsaleables policy applicable to accounts in this channel (e.g., full credit, partial credit, no returns).

attributes.name: secondary_tier
attributes.description: Sub-classification within the primary tier providing granular channel segmentation (e.g., grocery, mass, club, drug, convenience, e-commerce, QSR - Quick Service Restaurant, institutional, cash and carry, broker). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grocery|mass|club|drug|convenience|ecommerce|qsr|institutional|cash_and_carry|broker — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of channel classifications in reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: tdp_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this channel are eligible for TDP (Total Distribution Points) calculation. True if channel is included in weighted distribution metrics.

attributes.name: tertiary_tier
attributes.description: Optional third-level classification for highly specialized channel segments or sub-formats within secondary tier (e.g., natural/organic grocery, dollar stores, online marketplace).

attributes.name: trade_promotion_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts in this channel are eligible for trade promotion programs, TPM (Trade Promotion Management), and promotional funding.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Owns end-to-end supply chain planning and orchestration including demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimization, S&OP/IBP processes, DRP execution, safety stock targets, ATP/CTP calculations, supply network design, demand sensing, forecast accuracy tracking, and supply risk management. Integrates with SAP IBP.

products.name: demand_plan
products.description: Core master entity representing the demand plan across all versions, stages, and consensus outcomes within the S&OP/IBP cycle for each SKU/location/channel/planning period combination. Each record represents a specific version-point: captures version name, version type (statistical baseline/field sales overlay/marketing-adjusted/consensus/final approved), planning cycle reference, created-by persona, approval status, effective date range, planning bucket (weekly/monthly), statistical baseline quantity, commercial overlay, marketing event uplift, new product launch volume, consensus quantity, variance to statistical baseline, channel disaggregation, promotional overlays, and lifecycle stage. The consensus version represents the single agreed demand signal passed to supply planning. Enables forecast accuracy benchmarking across versions. Sourced from SAP IBP Demand Planning module.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand plan record. Primary key representing a specific version-point in the S&OP/IBP cycle for a SKU/location/channel/planning period combination.

attributes.name: channel_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales channel (retail, e-commerce, wholesale, DTC) for which demand is planned.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this demand plan version in the S&OP governance workflow.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Demand planning aligns forecasts with ESG commitments; linking plan to commitment enables KPI tracking.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Integrated Demand Planning uses brand forecasts; brand_id links demand plan to specific brand for Brand Demand Forecast report.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Business process: New Product Demand Planning ties each demand_plan to the originating R&D project, enabling planners to align forecasts with product development timelines.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU for which demand is being planned.

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the S&OP/IBP planning cycle during which this demand plan version was created.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution location, warehouse, or market geography for which demand is planned.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.trade_account. Business justification: REQUIRED: Account‑level demand forecast used in S&OP planning; planners need trade_account context for each demand_plan.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the demand plan version within the S&OP governance workflow.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan version was formally approved and locked for supply planning execution.

attributes.name: commercial_overlay_quantity
attributes.description: Demand adjustment quantity applied by field sales teams based on customer intelligence, market conditions, and sales pipeline visibility.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Planner-assigned confidence rating in the demand forecast based on data quality, market visibility, and forecast stability.

attributes.name: consensus_quantity
attributes.description: Agreed demand forecast quantity representing the single demand signal passed to supply planning after S&OP consensus process. This is the authoritative demand plan.

attributes.name: created_by_persona
attributes.description: Role or persona of the user who created this demand plan version, used for accountability and collaboration tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan version record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for any monetary values associated with this demand plan (e.g., revenue forecasts).

attributes.name: demand_pattern_type
attributes.description: Classification of historical demand behavior pattern used to select appropriate statistical forecasting algorithm.

attributes.name: demand_sensing_signal
attributes.description: Short-term demand trend indicator derived from real-time POS data, shipment data, and market signals to enable rapid forecast adjustments.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this demand plan version becomes active and is used for supply planning and ATP calculations.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this demand plan version remains active. Null indicates the version is currently active with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Historical forecast accuracy metric for this SKU/location/channel combination, used for forecast quality benchmarking and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: forecast_bias_percentage
attributes.description: Systematic tendency to over-forecast or under-forecast, calculated as average percentage deviation from actual demand.

attributes.name: is_consensus_version
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this version represents the official consensus demand plan approved through the S&OP process and used for supply planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan version was last updated or adjusted.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Product lifecycle stage classification used to apply appropriate forecasting models and demand shaping strategies.

attributes.name: marketing_event_uplift_quantity
attributes.description: Incremental demand quantity expected from planned marketing campaigns, promotions, and brand activation events.

attributes.name: npd_launch_volume_quantity
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Product Development (NPD) Launch Volume Quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted demand quantity for new product launches or product line extensions during the planning period.

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments and annotations from demand planners explaining assumptions, adjustments, risks, or special considerations for this forecast.

attributes.name: planning_bucket
attributes.description: Time granularity of the demand plan (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly) used for aggregation and reporting.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning period (week or month) for which demand is forecasted.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning period (week or month) for which demand is forecasted.

attributes.name: promotional_overlay_quantity
attributes.description: Demand uplift quantity attributed to trade promotions, price discounts, and retail execution activities.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Classification of the primary risk factor affecting demand plan reliability and supply fulfillment capability.

attributes.name: risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that this demand plan carries elevated supply risk due to capacity constraints, material shortages, or demand volatility.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this demand plan was extracted (e.g., SAP IBP, TradeEdge, Nielsen IQ integration).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Original unique identifier of this demand plan record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: statistical_baseline_quantity
attributes.description: Unconstrained demand forecast quantity generated by statistical forecasting algorithms before any commercial overlays or adjustments.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which demand quantities are expressed (each, case, pallet, kilogram, liter, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_to_baseline_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between consensus quantity and statistical baseline quantity, indicating the net impact of all commercial adjustments and overlays.

attributes.name: version_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the demand plan version (e.g., 'Statistical Baseline Q1 2024', 'Consensus Final March 2024').

attributes.name: version_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number within the planning cycle, used to track iteration history and version progression.

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand plan version indicating its stage in the S&OP process. Statistical baseline represents unconstrained forecast; consensus represents agreed demand signal passed to supply planning.

products.name: plan
products.description: Core master entity representing the constrained and unconstrained supply plan for each SKU/plant/DC combination. Captures planned production quantities, planned replenishment orders, supply source, planning horizon, constraint flags, and IBP supply planning run metadata. Sourced from SAP IBP Supply Planning module.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supply plan record. Primary key for the supply plan entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Production scheduling must align with marketing campaign launches; campaign_id enables Campaign‑Supply Execution dashboard.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_offset. Business justification: Supply planning incorporates carbon offset purchases to meet carbon‑reduction goals; offset ID must be stored on each plan.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: CARRIER_ASSIGNMENT: Supply plan assigns a primary carrier for the planned shipments, required for cost and SLA calculations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost allocation of each supply plan to a finance cost center for budgeting and variance analysis; planners routinely charge production plans to cost centers.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.demand_plan. Business justification: A supply plan is derived from a specific demand plan; linking plan to demand_plan captures the parent‑child relationship and enables traceability of plan origins.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center or warehouse location for which this supply plan applies.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planner or demand planner responsible for this supply plan.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.lane. Business justification: TRANSPORT_PLANNING: Supply plan defines the transportation lane for moving goods; planners need lane_id to generate accurate movement schedules.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility where the SKU will be produced.

attributes.name: planning_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.planning_run. Business justification: A supply plan is generated as part of a planning run; adding planning_run_id creates the proper parent link and allows removal of the redundant planning_run_code attribute.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: REQUIRED: S&OP supply planning must align production/replenishment with upcoming promotion events to meet forecasted uplift.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Business process: Supply Planning for a new product requires linking each supply_plan to the rd_project that defines the product, ensuring capacity and material plans reflect R&D intent.

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Supply planning must avoid producing or allocating unregistered SKUs; registration link validates plan feasibility.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU for which this supply plan is created.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external supplier if the supply source is external procurement or contract manufacturing.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source location (plant or DC) if the supply source is a transfer from another internal location.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.trade_account. Business justification: REQUIRED: Store‑specific supply plan ties replenishment to the owning trade_account; essential for execution and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: atp_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU that is available to promise to customers for delivery during the planning period, based on projected supply and committed demand.

attributes.name: capacity_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply plan is constrained by production or distribution capacity limitations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this supply plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ctp_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU that can be promised to customers considering both current inventory and planned production capacity.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_quantity
attributes.description: The forecasted demand quantity for this SKU at this location during the planning period, used as input to the supply planning process.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date when this supply plan was executed or committed, triggering downstream production orders or purchase requisitions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this supply plan record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days required from order release to receipt, including production time, procurement time, or transfer time.

attributes.name: material_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply plan is constrained by raw material or component availability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the supply planner regarding assumptions, constraints, or special considerations for this supply plan.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the supply plan record indicating its approval and execution state.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply plan indicating whether it is constrained by capacity and material availability, unconstrained (infinite capacity), a scenario analysis, or a simulation.

attributes.name: planned_order_release_date
attributes.description: The date when the production order or purchase order should be released to meet the planned receipt date, accounting for lead times.

attributes.name: planned_production_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU planned to be produced at the specified plant during the planning period.

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date when the planned supply quantity is expected to be received or available at the destination location.

attributes.name: planned_replenishment_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU planned to be replenished or transferred to the distribution center during the planning period.

attributes.name: planning_bucket
attributes.description: The time granularity or bucket size used for this supply plan (daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly aggregation).

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: The organizational planning group or team responsible for managing supply planning for this SKU or location combination.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan record.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan record.

attributes.name: projected_inventory_balance
attributes.description: The projected on-hand inventory balance at the end of the planning period after accounting for planned supply and demand.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The target safety stock quantity maintained as a buffer against demand variability and supply uncertainty for this SKU at this location.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this supply plan record originated (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle Cloud Supply Chain).

attributes.name: supply_risk_score
attributes.description: A calculated risk score indicating the likelihood of supply disruption or shortage for this SKU at this location, based on supplier reliability, lead time variability, and demand volatility.

attributes.name: supply_source
attributes.description: The source from which the supply will be obtained: internal production, external procurement from suppliers, transfer from another location, or contract manufacturing.

attributes.name: transportation_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply plan is constrained by transportation or logistics capacity limitations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the planned quantities (e.g., cases, pallets, kilograms, liters).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the supply plan, enabling tracking of plan iterations and scenario comparisons (e.g., baseline, consensus, committed).

products.name: forecast_version
products.description: Tracks each named version or snapshot of the demand forecast within the IBP/S&OP cycle (e.g., statistical baseline, field sales overlay, marketing-adjusted, consensus, final approved). Captures version name, version type, planning cycle reference, created-by persona, approval status, and effective date range. Enables forecast accuracy benchmarking across versions.

attributes.name: forecast_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the forecast version record. Primary key.

attributes.name: baseline_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent or baseline forecast version from which this version was derived (e.g., statistical baseline that was then adjusted). Nullable for original baseline versions.

attributes.name: planning_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) or Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycle to which this forecast version belongs.

attributes.name: primary_forecast_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or persona who created this forecast version (e.g., demand planner, sales analyst, system batch job).

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.sop_cycle. Business justification: forecast_version needs to be linked to its planning cycle; added new FK sop_cycle_id referencing sop_cycle.sop_cycle_id. Existing planning_cycle_id column renamed to sop_cycle_id, so removed planning_

attributes.name: tertiary_forecast_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this forecast version record.

attributes.name: aggregation_level
attributes.description: The level of aggregation at which this forecast version is maintained: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) level, product family, brand, category, sales channel, customer account, geographic region, or global total. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sku|product_family|brand|category|channel|customer|region|global — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Comments or notes provided by the approver during the approval process, documenting any conditions, concerns, or guidance related to this forecast version. Nullable if not yet approved or no notes provided.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version was approved. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: archived_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version was archived and moved out of active planning use. Nullable if not yet archived.

attributes.name: bias_percentage
attributes.description: Forecast bias percentage indicating systematic over-forecasting (positive bias) or under-forecasting (negative bias). A value near zero indicates an unbiased forecast. Nullable if not yet calculated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for any monetary values associated with this forecast version (e.g., revenue forecasts). Nullable if forecast is purely volume-based.

attributes.name: demand_sensing_applied
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether demand sensing algorithms (short-term forecast adjustments based on real-time Point of Sale (POS) data, shipment data, or other leading indicators) were applied to this forecast version.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this forecast version becomes effective and is used for operational planning, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), and Available to Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this forecast version remains effective. Nullable for open-ended versions that remain active until superseded.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated forecast accuracy percentage for this version, measured as the percentage of forecasted demand that matched actual demand. Used for benchmarking version performance and continuous improvement. Nullable if accuracy has not yet been calculated.

attributes.name: forecast_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system or application that generated or contributed to this forecast version (e.g., 'SAP IBP', 'TradeEdge', 'Excel Upload', 'Salesforce CG Cloud').

attributes.name: is_active_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this forecast version is currently active and being used for planning and execution. Only one version per planning cycle should typically be active at a time.

attributes.name: is_consensus_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this version represents the consensus forecast agreed upon by cross-functional stakeholders (sales, marketing, supply chain, finance) during the S&OP process.

attributes.name: is_final_approved_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this version is the final approved forecast that will be used for operational execution, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP).

attributes.name: mean_absolute_percentage_error
attributes.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) metric for this forecast version, measuring the average magnitude of forecast errors as a percentage. Lower values indicate better forecast accuracy. Nullable if not yet calculated.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version record was last modified.

attributes.name: new_product_introduction_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether New Product Development (NPD) or New Product Introduction (NPI) launches were incorporated into this forecast version.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning period covered by this forecast version (e.g., end of the fiscal quarter or rolling 18-month horizon).

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning period covered by this forecast version (e.g., start of the fiscal quarter or month).

attributes.name: promotional_events_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether trade promotions, marketing campaigns, and promotional events were factored into this forecast version.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason provided when this forecast version was rejected during the approval process. Nullable if version was not rejected.

attributes.name: statistical_model_applied
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the statistical forecasting model or algorithm applied to generate or adjust this forecast version (e.g., 'Exponential Smoothing', 'ARIMA', 'Machine Learning Ensemble', 'Holt-Winters'). Nullable if no statistical model was used.

attributes.name: time_bucket
attributes.description: The time granularity or bucket size used for this forecast version: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual periods.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which forecast quantities are expressed (e.g., 'EA' for each, 'CS' for case, 'KG' for kilogram, 'L' for liter). Aligns with GS1 standards.

attributes.name: version_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code or identifier for the forecast version used in system integrations and reporting (e.g., 'STAT_BASE', 'CONS_V1', 'FINAL_APR').

attributes.name: version_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description or notes about this forecast version, including assumptions, adjustments made, special considerations, or rationale for key changes.

attributes.name: version_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to this forecast version (e.g., 'Statistical Baseline Q1 2024', 'Consensus Forecast March', 'Final Approved Version').

attributes.name: version_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the iteration or revision order of this forecast version within the planning cycle (e.g., 1 for first draft, 2 for first revision, 3 for consensus).

attributes.name: version_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast version: draft (under construction), in review (submitted for approval), approved (validated and accepted), rejected (not accepted), archived (historical record), or active (currently in use for planning).

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast version indicating its role in the planning process: statistical baseline (system-generated), field sales overlay (sales team input), marketing adjusted (marketing promotions incorporated), consensus (collaborative agreement), final approved (executive sign-off), or simulation (what-if scenario).
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning Best Practices

products.name: forecast_accuracy
products.description: Transactional record capturing forecast accuracy measurements and demand sensing corrections for each SKU/location/planning period. Stores accuracy metrics (MAPE, WMAPE, bias, FA%, forecast error), actuals vs forecast volumes, measurement period, benchmark targets, and near-term demand sensing signals (POS data, syndicated feeds from Nielsen IQ, TradeEdge secondary sales). Captures signal source, sensing horizon, sensed quantity, confidence score, and uplift/downlift versus statistical forecast. Supports both cycle-close accuracy measurement and short-horizon demand correction within SAP IBP. Enables continuous improvement of statistical models and demand sensing algorithms.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the forecast accuracy measurement record. Primary key for this transactional measurement entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the demand planner responsible for the forecast for this SKU/location combination. Enables accountability tracking and planner performance analysis.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU for which forecast accuracy is being measured. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the planning location (distribution center, plant, or region) for which forecast accuracy is measured.

attributes.name: absolute_percent_error
attributes.description: Absolute percentage error calculated as |Actual - Forecast| / Actual. Used as input for Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) aggregation.

attributes.name: accuracy_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the measured forecast accuracy met, exceeded, or fell short of the target. Used for exception-based management and continuous improvement prioritization.

attributes.name: accuracy_target_percent
attributes.description: The target forecast accuracy percentage established for this SKU/location/period combination. Used for performance benchmarking and KPI tracking.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: The actual demand quantity realized during the planning period. Sourced from shipments, sales orders, or Point of Sale (POS) data depending on the measurement level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD, Nielsen IQ POS Data

attributes.name: bias_percent
attributes.description: Forecast bias expressed as a percentage: (Forecast - Actual) / Actual. Positive bias indicates systematic over-forecasting; negative bias indicates under-forecasting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast accuracy record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0.0 to 1.0) representing the completeness and reliability of the input data used for accuracy calculation. Lower scores indicate missing or questionable data that may compromise measurement validity.

attributes.name: demand_sensing_applied_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether demand sensing corrections were applied to the statistical forecast for this SKU/location/period. True if near-term demand signals were incorporated.

attributes.name: demand_volatility_coefficient
attributes.description: Coefficient of variation representing demand volatility for the SKU/location combination. Calculated as standard deviation divided by mean demand. Higher values indicate more volatile demand patterns and typically correlate with lower forecast accuracy.

attributes.name: forecast_error
attributes.description: The absolute difference between forecast quantity and actual quantity (Actual - Forecast). Positive values indicate under-forecast; negative values indicate over-forecast.

attributes.name: forecast_model_type
attributes.description: The type of forecasting model used to generate the original forecast. Identifies whether the forecast was produced by statistical algorithms, machine learning models, consensus planning, manual planner input, or a hybrid approach.

attributes.name: forecast_quantity
attributes.description: The forecasted demand quantity for the SKU/location/period as predicted by the statistical model or demand planning system at the time of forecast creation.

attributes.name: forecast_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the forecast used for accuracy measurement. Enables tracking of accuracy across multiple forecast iterations and scenario planning versions within the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycle.

attributes.name: mape
attributes.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error for the SKU/location/period. Primary forecast accuracy metric expressed as a percentage. Lower values indicate better accuracy.

attributes.name: measurement_cycle
attributes.description: Identifier of the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) or Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycle during which this accuracy measurement was performed. Typically formatted as YYYY-MM or cycle name.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the forecast accuracy measurement was calculated and recorded. Represents the business event time of the accuracy calculation cycle close.

attributes.name: new_product_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU was classified as a new product during the forecast period. New Product Development (NPD) items typically have limited historical data and lower forecast accuracy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing contextual information about the accuracy measurement, including explanations for significant variances, data quality issues, or special circumstances affecting the period.

attributes.name: out_of_stock_days
attributes.description: Number of days during the planning period when the SKU was out of stock at the location. Out of Stock (OOS) events distort accuracy measurement as actual demand is constrained by availability.

attributes.name: percent
attributes.description: Forecast accuracy percentage calculated as 100% - MAPE. Represents the complement of error, where higher values indicate better accuracy. Commonly used for executive reporting.

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level at which forecast accuracy is being measured. Supports accuracy tracking at SKU/location, product family, brand, category, or total company aggregation levels.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning period for which forecast accuracy is being measured.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning period for which forecast accuracy is being measured. Typically aligned with S&OP cycle boundaries.

attributes.name: product_lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: The lifecycle stage of the SKU at the time of forecast measurement. Accuracy expectations and benchmarks vary by lifecycle stage, with new product introductions (NPD) typically having lower accuracy than mature products.

attributes.name: promotional_period_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the planning period included promotional activity for this SKU/location. Promotional periods typically exhibit different accuracy patterns than baseline demand periods.

attributes.name: sensed_quantity
attributes.description: The demand-sensed quantity after incorporating near-term signals such as Point of Sale (POS) data, syndicated market data from Nielsen IQ, or secondary sales from TradeEdge. Null if demand sensing was not applied.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing, Nielsen IQ, TradeEdge

attributes.name: sensing_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) representing the reliability of the demand sensing signal. Higher scores indicate stronger signal quality and greater confidence in the sensed adjustment.

attributes.name: sensing_horizon_days
attributes.description: The number of days into the future for which demand sensing was applied. Typically ranges from 7 to 90 days depending on product velocity and signal availability.

attributes.name: sensing_signal_source
attributes.description: The primary data source used for demand sensing correction. Identifies whether the signal came from Point of Sale (POS) data, Nielsen IQ syndicated feeds, TradeEdge secondary sales, shipment actuals, order backlog, promotional lift models, or manual planner override. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pos_data|nielsen_iq|trade_edge|shipment_data|order_backlog|promotional_lift|manual_override — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sensing_uplift_percent
attributes.description: Percentage uplift or downlift applied by demand sensing relative to the statistical forecast. Calculated as (Sensed Quantity - Forecast Quantity) / Forecast Quantity. Positive values indicate uplift; negative values indicate downlift.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which forecast and actual quantities are expressed (e.g., cases, eaches, kilograms, liters). Must be consistent across forecast and actual for valid accuracy calculation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast accuracy record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: wmape
attributes.description: Weighted Mean Absolute Percentage Error, calculated as sum of absolute errors divided by sum of actuals. Preferred metric for aggregated accuracy measurement across product hierarchies.

products.name: inventory_policy
products.description: Master entity defining inventory policy parameters, safety stock calculations, service level commitments, and OTIF targets for each SKU/location node in the supply network. Captures safety stock target and calculated quantities (days of supply, units, calculation method, demand variability, lead time variability, service level input, calculated vs approved SS units, effective date, review status), reorder point, min/max levels, cycle stock target, replenishment method (MRP/DRP/VMI), review cycle, service level targets (fill rate %, on-time delivery %, OTIF composite %), customer/channel-level OTIF commitments, retailer-mandated target flags, penalty clause indicators, and measurement windows. Owned by supply planning; consumed by distribution and manufacturing execution.

attributes.name: inventory_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory policy record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Inventory policies are driven by specific compliance obligations (e.g., temperature control); linking ties policy to obligation.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Inventory policies are owned by specific cost centers; linking enables policy‑related budgeting and compliance audits.

attributes.name: policy_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Inventory Policy Governance requires a policy owner employee to approve and maintain each policy.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Business need: Inventory policies for launch items are derived from the associated R&D project, allowing policy parameters to be set per project.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this inventory policy is defined.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution facility, warehouse, or storage location node in the supply network where this policy applies.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this inventory policy was formally approved and authorized for use in supply planning and execution.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status indicating whether the policy has been reviewed and approved by authorized supply planning personnel.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the supply planning manager or director who approved this inventory policy for operational use.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory policy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_otif_commitment_percent
attributes.description: Specific OTIF performance level committed to a customer or channel, which may differ from internal targets and may be contractually binding.

attributes.name: cycle_stock_target_units
attributes.description: Target cycle stock quantity representing the average inventory held to meet expected demand between replenishments, excluding safety stock.

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand variability (coefficient of variation or standard deviation) used in safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this inventory policy expires or is superseded. Null indicates an open-ended policy.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this inventory policy becomes active and applicable for planning and execution.

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of customer demand that should be fulfilled from available inventory without backorders or stockouts.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory policy record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this inventory policy was last reviewed and validated by the supply planning team.

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: Standard deviation or variance of replenishment lead time in days, used to account for supply uncertainty in safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level_units
attributes.description: Maximum inventory level allowed at this location for this SKU, used to prevent overstocking and manage warehouse capacity constraints.

attributes.name: measurement_window_days
attributes.description: Time period in days over which service level performance is measured and evaluated against targets (e.g., rolling 30 days, 90 days, quarterly).

attributes.name: minimum_stock_level_units
attributes.description: Minimum inventory level that should be maintained at this location for this SKU, typically aligned with safety stock or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review and update of this inventory policy, ensuring policies remain aligned with business conditions.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of orders that should be delivered by the customer-requested or committed delivery date.

attributes.name: otif_composite_target_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Composite Target Percent
attributes.description: Composite OTIF (On Time In Full) target percentage representing orders delivered both on time and in full quantity, a critical customer service metric.

attributes.name: penalty_clause_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure to meet the defined service level targets will result in financial penalties, chargebacks, or other contractual consequences.

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the inventory policy, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special considerations, exceptions, seasonal adjustments, or business context relevant to this inventory policy.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory policy indicating its approval and operational state. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|suspended|expired|archived — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reorder_point_units
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered, calculated as lead time demand plus safety stock.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The inventory replenishment strategy applied: MRP (Material Requirements Planning), DRP (Distribution Requirements Planning), VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory), JIT (Just In Time), Kanban, or Fixed Order Quantity.

attributes.name: retailer_mandated_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service level targets are mandated by a retail customer as part of their supplier requirements or vendor compliance program.

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: Frequency in days at which inventory levels are reviewed and replenishment decisions are made for this SKU-location combination.

attributes.name: safety_stock_calculated_units
attributes.description: System-calculated safety stock quantity based on demand variability, lead time variability, and service level inputs before manual approval or adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Safety Stock Calculation Engine

attributes.name: safety_stock_calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate safety stock: fixed value, forecast error-based, demand variability, lead time variability, combined variability, or service level-driven calculation.

attributes.name: safety_stock_days_of_supply
attributes.description: Safety stock expressed as the number of days of average demand coverage, providing a time-based view of inventory buffer.

attributes.name: safety_stock_target_units
attributes.description: Target safety stock quantity in base units of measure, representing the buffer inventory to protect against demand and supply variability.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: Target service level percentage (e.g., 95%, 98%, 99.5%) representing the desired probability of not stocking out during the replenishment lead time.

products.name: safety_stock
products.description: Transactional record capturing the calculated and approved safety stock quantity for each SKU/location/time-period combination. Stores calculation method (statistical, days-of-supply, manual override), demand variability, lead time variability, service level input, calculated SS units, approved SS units, effective date, and review status. Distinct from inventory_policy (policy target) as this captures the actual calculated output.

attributes.name: safety_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety stock calculation record. Primary key for the safety stock entity.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Safety‑stock calculations must respect compliance constraints such as shelf‑life limits; link provides required obligation data.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand planner or supply planner responsible for reviewing and approving this safety stock calculation. Links to workforce or user master data.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Business process: Safety stock calculations for a new SKU reference the originating rd_project to capture launch‑specific risk and service‑level targets.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product SKU for which safety stock is calculated. Links to the product master data.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standard

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location, distribution center, or facility where the safety stock applies. Links to distribution facility master data.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: The ABC classification of the SKU based on revenue contribution or volume. A items are high-value requiring tight control; B items are moderate; C items are low-value. Influences service level targets and safety stock investment decisions.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the safety stock calculation was approved by the planner. Marks the transition from calculated to approved state in the workflow.

attributes.name: approved_safety_stock_units
attributes.description: The final approved safety stock quantity in base units of measure after planner review and adjustment. This is the target value used for inventory policy execution and Available to Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: average_daily_demand_units
attributes.description: The mean daily demand quantity in base units of measure. Used as input to safety stock calculations and represents expected consumption rate.

attributes.name: average_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The mean replenishment lead time in days from order placement to receipt. Used in safety stock calculations to determine the exposure period for demand and supply variability.

attributes.name: calculated_safety_stock_units
attributes.description: The system-calculated safety stock quantity in base units of measure. This is the raw output from the calculation engine before any manual adjustments or approvals.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the safety stock quantity. Statistical methods use demand and lead time variability; days-of-supply uses fixed coverage targets; manual override represents planner judgment; service level and lead time methods focus on specific risk factors; hybrid combines multiple approaches.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the safety stock calculation was executed by the planning system. Provides audit trail for calculation runs and version control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: days_of_supply_target
attributes.description: The target safety stock coverage expressed in days of average demand. Used when calculation method is days-of-supply based. Represents the buffer duration to protect against stockouts.

attributes.name: demand_classification
attributes.description: The demand pattern category for this SKU-location. Steady indicates consistent demand; seasonal shows periodic peaks; erratic has high variability; lumpy has infrequent large orders; intermittent has sporadic demand; obsolete indicates phase-out. Influences calculation method selection.

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand volatility expressed as coefficient of variation or standard deviation. Used in statistical safety stock calculations to quantify demand uncertainty.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this safety stock target becomes active and is used for inventory policy execution, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), and Available to Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this safety stock target expires and is replaced by a new calculation. Used to manage the lifecycle of safety stock policies and trigger recalculation cycles.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: The historical forecast accuracy for this SKU-location combination expressed as a percentage. Used to adjust safety stock calculations based on forecasting reliability. Lower accuracy typically requires higher safety stock.
attributes.references: Demand Planning Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Standards

attributes.name: holding_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The annual cost to hold one unit of inventory including warehousing, insurance, obsolescence, and capital cost. Used in inventory optimization to balance service level against carrying cost. Expressed in local currency.
attributes.references: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and Inventory Valuation Standards

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this safety stock record is currently active and being used for inventory policy execution. True means active; False means superseded or inactive.

attributes.name: last_review_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the safety stock record was last reviewed by a planner, regardless of whether changes were made. Used to track planner engagement and ensure regular review cycles.

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: Measure of supply lead time uncertainty expressed in days. Represents the standard deviation or range of lead time fluctuation used in safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity constraint from the supplier or manufacturing process. Safety stock calculations must consider MOQ to ensure replenishment orders are feasible.
attributes.references: Procurement and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next safety stock review cycle. Used in Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes to ensure regular policy updates.
attributes.references: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Best Practices

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The order quantity increment or lot size multiple required by supplier or production constraints. Safety stock and reorder quantities must align with this multiple.

attributes.name: override_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the planner when manually overriding the calculated safety stock. Documents the business context and rationale for the adjustment.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason code when approved safety stock differs from calculated safety stock. Captures planner judgment factors such as promotional events, seasonal peaks, supply chain risks, new product introductions, product phase-outs, or quality concerns.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning period for which this safety stock calculation is effective. Defines the validity window for the safety stock target.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning period for which this safety stock calculation is effective. Used in Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycles.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of the safety stock calculation. Pending review indicates awaiting planner action; approved means active for execution; rejected requires recalculation; under revision is being adjusted; expired indicates the planning period has passed.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The shelf life or expiration period of the product in days. Critical for Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) safety stock decisions to prevent obsolescence. Influences maximum safety stock levels and First Expired First Out (FEFO) policies.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Quality Management Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record that generated or last updated this safety stock calculation. SAP IBP for integrated business planning, SAP S/4HANA for ERP-based calculations, Oracle Cloud SCM for Oracle supply chain, Blue Yonder for advanced optimization, TradeEdge for demand sensing, or Manual for planner-entered values.

attributes.name: stockout_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The estimated cost of a stockout per unit including lost sales, expediting costs, customer dissatisfaction, and brand impact. Used in service level optimization to quantify the cost of Out of Stock (OOS) events. Expressed in local currency.

attributes.name: supply_risk_score
attributes.description: A quantitative risk score assessing supply chain vulnerability for this SKU-location. Higher scores indicate greater risk from supplier reliability, geopolitical factors, transportation disruptions, or single-source dependencies. Used to adjust safety stock buffers.

attributes.name: target_service_level_percent
attributes.description: The desired in-stock probability or fill rate target expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00, 98.50). Drives the safety stock buffer size to achieve the specified On Shelf Availability (OSA) or Service Level Agreement (SLA).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for safety stock quantities. EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon. Must align with SKU base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: The XYZ classification based on demand variability. X items have low variability (predictable); Y items have moderate variability; Z items have high variability (unpredictable). Used alongside ABC to determine safety stock strategy.

attributes.name: z_score
attributes.description: The standard normal distribution value corresponding to the target service level. Used in statistical safety stock formulas to translate service level percentage into buffer quantity.

products.name: supply_replenishment_order
products.description: Transactional record representing a planned or released replenishment order generated by DRP execution for moving inventory between supply network nodes (plant-to-DC, DC-to-DC). Captures order type (planned/firmed/released), source location, destination location, SKU, requested quantity, confirmed quantity, planned ship date, planned receipt date, and DRP run reference. Distinct from purchase orders (owned by procurement) and production orders (owned by manufacturing).

attributes.name: supply_replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supply replenishment order record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier_contract. Business justification: CONTRACT_COMPLIANCE: Each replenishment order is governed by a carrier contract; needed for rate and penalty enforcement.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the logistics carrier or transportation provider assigned to execute this replenishment shipment.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Replenishment orders incur expenses that must be tracked against the responsible cost center for expense reporting and internal charge‑backs.

attributes.name: destination_location_supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supply network node to which inventory will be delivered (distribution center, warehouse, or retail location).

attributes.name: drp_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the DRP execution run that generated this replenishment order, used for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Regulatory traceability requires linking each replenishment order to its inspection lot for recall and safety reporting; experts expect this FK for product safety audits.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.lane. Business justification: ORDER_EXECUTION: Replenishment order execution follows a specific lane; lane_id links order to transportation routing.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical shipment record associated with this replenishment order once released for execution.

attributes.name: primary_supply_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or automated process that created this replenishment order record.

attributes.name: primary_supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supply network node from which inventory will be shipped (plant, distribution center, or warehouse).

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: REQUIRED: Replenishment orders are often generated to satisfy demand generated by a specific promotion event.

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Regulatory compliance verification before order release ensures SKU has active registration; essential for legal shipment.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product SKU being replenished through this order.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Actual date the goods were received at the destination location.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment departed from the source location.

attributes.name: available_to_promise_quantity
attributes.description: ATP quantity at the source location at the time the replenishment order was created, used to validate supply availability.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the replenishment order was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU confirmed for shipment by the source location, may differ from requested quantity due to supply constraints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this order.

attributes.name: drp_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the DRP execution run that generated this order was executed.

attributes.name: forecast_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted demand quantity at the destination location that drove the replenishment calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this replenishment order record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: order_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost associated with this replenishment order, including product cost, transportation cost, and handling fees.

attributes.name: order_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions related to this replenishment order, such as handling requirements or routing constraints.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of the replenishment order in the supply chain workflow.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order lifecycle stage: planned (system-generated recommendation), firmed (manually confirmed but not released), or released (committed for execution).

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: Target date for goods receipt at the destination location, accounting for transit lead time.

attributes.name: planned_ship_date
attributes.description: Target date for shipment departure from the source location as calculated by the DRP engine.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority classification for order fulfillment, typically driven by stock-out risk, customer service level, or strategic importance.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the SKU received at the destination location, captured at goods receipt.

attributes.name: replenishment_order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique order number for the replenishment order, used for tracking and reference across systems and communications.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU requested for replenishment as calculated by the DRP engine or demand planner.

attributes.name: safety_stock_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order was triggered by inventory falling below safety stock threshold at the destination location.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the SKU shipped from the source location, captured at dispatch.

attributes.name: transit_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Planned number of days for goods to travel from source to destination location.

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation planned or used for this replenishment shipment.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields in this order (EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|EA|KG|LB|L|GAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: network_node
products.description: Master entity representing each node in the supply network (manufacturing plant, regional DC, forward DC, co-manufacturer, 3PL site). Captures node type, geographic location, capacity class, lead time to downstream nodes, sourcing rules, and active status. attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Primary key for network_node

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Operating costs of each network node (warehouse, DC) are allocated to a cost center for overhead accounting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_facility. Business justification: Required for Logistics Network Planning report to map each supply network node to its physical distribution center, enabling accurate cross‑dock and VMI planning.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: ESG reporting per network node requires linking node to its ESG commitment; planners need node‑level targets for compliance.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id

attributes.name: node_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Node Operations Management Dashboard tracks the manager responsible for each warehouse/distribution node.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Required for Cost Allocation Report: each network node is assigned to an org unit for budgeting and performance reporting.

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: address_line_2

attributes.name: capacity_class
attributes.description: Classification of the supply network node storage and throughput capacity used in IBP supply planning for capacity-constrained optimization.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the supply network node is located. Used for geographic analysis and transportation planning. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply network node record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_dock_enabled_flag

attributes.name: dsd_enabled_flag

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying the physical location of the supply network node for EDI transactions and supply chain visibility.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply network node is certified to handle and store hazardous materials. Used for product allocation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply network node record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the supply network node in decimal degrees. Used for transportation optimization and network design analytics.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from this supply network node to downstream nodes or customers. Used in DRP execution and ATP/CTP calculations.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the supply network node in decimal degrees. Used for transportation optimization and network design analytics.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the supply network node used across planning and execution systems. Typically a short alphanumeric code used in SAP IBP and ERP systems.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the supply network node (e.g., 'Chicago Regional DC', 'Memphis Manufacturing Plant', 'Dallas Forward DC').

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the supply network node in the supply planning system. Active nodes participate in DRP and IBP planning runs.

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply network node indicating its role in the supply chain (manufacturing plant, regional distribution center, forward distribution center, co-manufacturer, third-party logistics warehouse, cross-dock facility, or supplier location). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_plant|regional_dc|forward_dc|co_manufacturer|3pl_warehouse|cross_dock|supplier_location — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Ownership model of the supply network node (company-owned, leased, third-party logistics managed, co-manufacturer, or contract facility). Used for cost allocation and strategic network design.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Planning group or cluster assignment for the supply network node used in IBP and S&OP processes to aggregate nodes for planning purposes.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the supply network node location. Used for logistics routing and delivery planning. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency
attributes.description: Standard replenishment frequency for inventory at this supply network node. Used in DRP planning and inventory policy definition.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: safety_stock_days
attributes.description: Target safety stock coverage in days of supply maintained at this network node. Used in inventory optimization and S&OP planning.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: sourcing_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this supply network node in sourcing rules and allocation logic (lower number = higher priority). Used in IBP supply planning and ATP/CTP allocation.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province code where the supply network node is located. Used for tax jurisdiction and regulatory compliance. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the supply network node measured in standard storage units (pallets, cases, or cubic meters). Used for inventory optimization and DRP planning.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the storage capacity (pallets, cases, cubic meters, square meters). Aligns with WMS and IBP planning units.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply network node has temperature-controlled storage capabilities for temperature-sensitive products. Used in product allocation and quality management.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: throughput_capacity_daily
attributes.description: Maximum daily throughput capacity of the supply network node measured in standard units (cases, pallets, or production units per day). Used for production and distribution planning.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: throughput_capacity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the daily throughput capacity. Used in production scheduling and distribution planning.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the supply network node location (e.g., America/Chicago, America/New_York). Used for scheduling and ATP/CTP calculations.

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply network node participates in Vendor Managed Inventory programs. Used in collaborative planning and replenishment processes.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

products.name: network_lane
products.description: Master entity defining the sourcing lane between two supply network nodes (source-destination pair). Captures lane type (production, transfer, external procurement), primary/secondary sourcing priority, standard lead time, transportation lead time, minimum order quantity (MOQ), lot size, and active status. Used by DRP and IBP to determine replenishment routing.

attributes.name: network_lane_id
attributes.description: Primary key for network_lane

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred or contracted transportation carrier servicing this lane. Used for freight planning and cost estimation.

attributes.name: destination_location_supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiving supply network node (distribution center, warehouse, retail store, or customer location) to which goods are delivered.

attributes.name: primary_supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating supply network node (plant, distribution center, warehouse, or external supplier) from which goods are sourced.
