attributes.name: capacity_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum throughput capacity of this lane per planning period (day, week, month), representing the upper limit of goods that can be moved. Used by Supply Planning and Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) for capacity-constrained optimization.

attributes.name: capacity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the capacity quantity field, indicating how lane capacity is measured and constrained. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|TU|KG|LB|L|GAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Regulatory or business compliance requirements applicable to this lane, such as temperature control (Good Manufacturing Practice - GMP), hazardous materials handling (Environmental Protection Agency - EPA), or cross-border customs (Food and Drug Administration - FDA).

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard transportation or transfer cost per unit of measure for moving goods along this lane. Used for supply chain cost modeling and total landed cost calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply network lane record was first created in the system, following ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for cost and pricing on this lane (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply network lane ceases or will cease to be effective. Null for lanes with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this supply network lane becomes or became effective and available for use in planning and execution systems.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lane is currently active and available for use in supply planning and replenishment. True if active; false if temporarily or permanently disabled.

attributes.name: is_primary_lane
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lane is the primary (preferred) sourcing route for the destination. True if this is the default lane used under normal conditions; false for backup or secondary lanes.

attributes.name: lane_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the supply network lane, typically a concatenation or encoded representation of source-destination pair used in planning systems and operational communications.

attributes.name: lane_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the supply network lane, often including source and destination location names for easy identification in reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: lane_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply network lane based on the nature of the sourcing relationship: production (from manufacturing plant), transfer (between internal facilities), external procurement (from supplier), direct shipment (plant to customer), cross-dock (no storage), or drop-ship (supplier to customer).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this supply network lane record, used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply network lane record was most recently updated, following ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: Standard batch or lot size for replenishment orders on this lane. Orders are typically rounded to multiples of this quantity for operational efficiency (e.g., full pallet, full truckload).

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or shipped on this lane in a single replenishment cycle, constrained by capacity, vehicle limits, or storage restrictions.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or shipped on this lane to meet operational or economic constraints. Used by DRP to ensure replenishment orders meet minimum thresholds.

attributes.name: network_lane_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply network lane: active (operational), inactive (temporarily disabled), suspended (on hold), planned (future activation), or decommissioned (permanently closed).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information about this supply network lane.

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Specific target percentage for On Time In Full delivery performance on this lane, a key supply chain Key Performance Indicator (KPI) measuring the percentage of orders delivered on time and complete.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Organizational grouping or planning segment to which this lane belongs, used for segmented planning and reporting in Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP).

attributes.name: processing_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Time in days required for order processing, picking, packing, and loading at the source location before shipment begins.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Supply risk classification for this lane based on factors such as lead time variability, carrier reliability, geopolitical risk, and single-source dependency. Used for supply risk management and contingency planning.

attributes.name: safety_stock_days
attributes.description: Number of days of safety stock coverage recommended at the destination to buffer against variability in this lanes lead time and demand. Used by Inventory Optimization to calculate safety stock targets.

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: Target service level percentage for on-time and in-full delivery performance on this lane, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95%). Used to measure On Time In Full (OTIF) performance.

attributes.name: sourcing_priority
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the preference order for this lane when multiple sourcing options exist for the same destination. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = primary, 2 = secondary, etc.). Used by Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) to determine replenishment routing.

attributes.name: standard_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total planned lead time in days from order placement to goods receipt at destination, including processing time, transportation time, and buffer. Used by Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) for replenishment calculations.

attributes.name: transportation_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Transit time in days for goods to move from source to destination, excluding processing and handling time. Component of the total standard lead time.

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary method of transportation used for moving goods along this lane: truck (road freight), rail (train), ocean (sea freight), air (air cargo), intermodal (combination), or parcel (small package delivery).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantities on this lane: EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), TU (truck unit), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), L (liter), GAL (gallon). Aligns with GS1 standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|TU|KG|LB|L|GAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: atp_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing the Available-to-Promise (ATP) and Capable-to-Promise (CTP) calculation results for each SKU/location/date combination. Stores confirmed ATP quantity, CTP quantity, cumulative ATP, demand pegging reference, supply pegging reference, calculation timestamp, and ATP method (simple, cumulative, multi-level). Consumed by sales order management for order promising.

attributes.name: atp_record_id
attributes.description: Primary key for atp_record

attributes.name: atp_rule_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific ATP business rule or configuration applied during calculation, enabling traceability of ATP logic.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific lot or batch for lot-controlled SKUs where ATP is tracked at the batch level.

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: ATP calculations need to confirm inventory belongs to registered products to meet legal availability commitments.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU for which ATP is calculated.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution facility or warehouse location where ATP is calculated.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity already committed or reserved for existing sales orders, reducing available ATP.

attributes.name: atp_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate ATP. Simple ATP considers only on-hand inventory minus allocations. Cumulative ATP includes planned receipts over time. Multi-level ATP considers BOM components. Product allocation ATP applies allocation rules across customer segments.

attributes.name: atp_check_horizon_days
attributes.description: The number of days into the future that the ATP check considers for availability. Defines the planning horizon for promise calculations.

attributes.name: atp_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number generated when ATP is reserved for a sales order, providing traceability between ATP records and order promising.

attributes.name: atp_date
attributes.description: The date for which ATP quantity is calculated. Represents the promise date for order fulfillment.

attributes.name: atp_quantity
attributes.description: The confirmed quantity available to promise to customers for the given SKU, location, and date. Represents uncommitted inventory available for new orders.

attributes.name: atp_status
attributes.description: The current status of the ATP record. Available indicates positive ATP. Constrained indicates limited availability. Blocked indicates ATP is not available for promising. Expired indicates the ATP date has passed.

attributes.name: backorder_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of unfulfilled demand from previous periods that impacts current ATP availability.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this ATP record was calculated. Critical for understanding data freshness and order promising accuracy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ATP record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: ctp_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity that can be promised considering both current inventory and planned production or supply receipts. Extends ATP by including future supply.

attributes.name: cumulative_atp_quantity
attributes.description: The cumulative ATP quantity calculated across multiple time periods, showing total available quantity from current date through the ATP date.

attributes.name: customer_priority_tier
attributes.description: The priority tier of the customer or channel for which ATP is being calculated, used in allocation scenarios where high-priority customers receive preferential ATP.

attributes.name: demand_pegging_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking ATP consumption to specific demand sources such as sales orders, forecasts, or customer reservations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the inventory lot or batch, relevant for FEFO (First Expired First Out) ATP logic in consumer goods with shelf life constraints.

attributes.name: forecast_consumption_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of forecast demand consumed by actual sales orders, used in ATP calculations to avoid double-counting demand.

attributes.name: intransit_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity currently in transit to the location that will contribute to ATP upon arrival.

attributes.name: minimum_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The minimum remaining shelf life in days required for the product to be available for promising, ensuring customers receive products with adequate shelf life.

attributes.name: on_hand_inventory
attributes.description: The physical inventory quantity available at the location at the time of ATP calculation.

attributes.name: planned_receipt_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity expected to be received from production orders, purchase orders, or transfers by the ATP date.

attributes.name: planning_version
attributes.description: The planning scenario or version identifier in SAP IBP under which this ATP calculation was performed, enabling what-if analysis and scenario planning.

attributes.name: product_allocation_group
attributes.description: The allocation group or priority segment assigned to this ATP calculation, used when ATP is allocated across customer tiers or channels.

attributes.name: production_order_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity scheduled for production that will be available by the ATP date.

attributes.name: purchase_order_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity on open purchase orders expected to be received by the ATP date.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum inventory buffer maintained to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. May reduce ATP if policy enforces safety stock protection.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that generated this ATP record (e.g., SAP IBP, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud SCM).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this ATP record in the source operational system, enabling traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: supply_pegging_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking ATP availability to specific supply sources such as production orders, purchase orders, or stock transfers.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for all quantity fields in this record. Common values: EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), L (liter), GAL (gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ATP record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer.

products.name: sop_cycle
products.description: Master entity representing each S&OP/IBP planning cycle instance (monthly cadence). Captures cycle name, planning month, cycle phase (statistical forecast, demand review, supply review, pre-S&OP, executive S&OP), phase status, cycle owner, key milestones, and sign-off records. Provides the governance framework for all demand and supply planning activities within the cycle.

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the S&OP/IBP planning cycle instance. Primary key.
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: primary_sop_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee responsible for orchestrating and governing this S&OP cycle (typically the Demand Planning Manager or S&OP Manager).

attributes.name: quaternary_sop_executive_sponsor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the executive sponsor who chairs the executive S&OP meeting and provides final sign-off (typically VP of Supply Chain or COO).

attributes.name: quinary_sop_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this S&OP cycle record.

attributes.name: tertiary_sop_supply_planner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the lead supply planner responsible for the supply review phase of this cycle.

attributes.name: baseline_demand_volume
attributes.description: The total baseline demand volume (in units) across all SKUs for the planning horizon at the start of this cycle.

attributes.name: consensus_demand_volume
attributes.description: The total consensus demand volume (in units) across all SKUs after demand review adjustments.

attributes.name: constrained_supply_volume
attributes.description: The total constrained supply volume (in units) that can be delivered given capacity and material constraints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this S&OP cycle record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cycle for external reference and system integration (e.g., 'SOP-2024-01', 'IBP-Q1-24').

attributes.name: cycle_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this S&OP cycle is scheduled to complete and be locked (typically before the start of the planning month).

attributes.name: cycle_locked_date
attributes.description: The date when this S&OP cycle was locked and finalized.

attributes.name: cycle_locked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this S&OP cycle has been locked and no further changes are permitted (True if locked, False if still open for edits).

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or label for the S&OP cycle (e.g., 'January 2024 S&OP Cycle', 'Q1 FY2024 IBP').
attributes.references: APICS Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model

attributes.name: cycle_notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes or comments about this S&OP cycle, including special circumstances, deviations from standard process, or other relevant context.

attributes.name: cycle_phase
attributes.description: Current phase of the S&OP cycle: statistical_forecast (initial statistical forecast generation), demand_review (demand planning team review), supply_review (supply planning team review), pre_sop (pre-S&OP reconciliation meeting), executive_sop (executive S&OP decision meeting), closed (cycle completed and locked).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: cycle_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this S&OP cycle officially begins (typically the first day of the cycle month).

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: The cadence or type of S&OP cycle: monthly (standard monthly cadence), quarterly (quarterly review), annual (annual planning), rolling (continuous rolling horizon), event_driven (triggered by specific business events).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: demand_consensus_achieved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether demand consensus was achieved during the demand review phase (True if consensus reached, False otherwise).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: demand_review_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the demand review phase must be completed.

attributes.name: executive_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the executive sponsor formally approved the S&OP plan for this cycle.
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: executive_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the executive S&OP meeting approved the plan (True if approved, False if rejected or pending).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: executive_approval_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the executive sponsor regarding the approval decision, including any conditions or action items.
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: executive_sop_meeting_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the executive S&OP meeting where senior leadership reviews and approves the plan.
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number) within the fiscal year (e.g., 1 for January, 12 for December).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this planning cycle belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: frozen_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months at the start of the planning horizon that are frozen and not subject to change (typically 0-3 months).

attributes.name: key_assumptions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the key business assumptions underlying this S&OP cycle (e.g., promotional plans, market trends, supply constraints, new product launches).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: key_risks
attributes.description: Free-text field documenting the key risks identified during this S&OP cycle (e.g., supplier reliability, demand volatility, capacity constraints).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this S&OP cycle record was last updated.

attributes.name: mitigation_actions
attributes.description: Free-text field describing the mitigation actions agreed upon to address identified risks and supply gaps.
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: phase_status
attributes.description: Status of the current cycle phase: not_started (phase has not begun), in_progress (phase is actively underway), completed (phase finished and approved), on_hold (phase temporarily paused), cancelled (phase or cycle cancelled).

attributes.name: planning_horizon_months
attributes.description: The number of months into the future that this S&OP cycle plans (e.g., 18 months, 24 months).

attributes.name: planning_month
attributes.description: The target month for which this S&OP cycle is planning demand and supply (typically the first day of the planning month).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: pre_sop_meeting_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the pre-S&OP reconciliation meeting where demand and supply teams align on recommendations.
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: statistical_forecast_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the statistical forecast phase must be completed.

attributes.name: supply_consensus_achieved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supply consensus was achieved during the supply review phase (True if consensus reached, False otherwise).
attributes.references: APICS Sales and Operations Planning Best Practices

attributes.name: supply_gap_volume
attributes.description: The total supply gap (in units) representing the difference between consensus demand and constrained supply (positive indicates shortfall, negative indicates surplus).

attributes.name: supply_review_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the supply review phase must be completed.

products.name: consensus_demand
products.description: Transactional record capturing the final consensus demand volume agreed upon during the S&OP demand review for each SKU/location/planning period. Stores statistical forecast input, commercial overlay, marketing event uplift, new product launch volume, consensus quantity, variance to statistical baseline, approver, and S&OP cycle reference. Represents the single agreed demand signal passed to supply planning.

attributes.name: consensus_demand_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consensus demand record. Primary key for this entity representing a single agreed demand signal from the S&OP demand review process.

attributes.name: consensus_planner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand planner responsible for preparing and maintaining this consensus demand record. Primary point of contact for demand questions.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.demand_plan.demand_plan_id — Links consensus demand records to demand plan header. Required for S&OP process tracking and forecast accuracy measurement.

attributes.name: planning_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the time bucket (week, month, quarter) for which this consensus demand is valid. Links to the planning calendar.

attributes.name: primary_consensus_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business user (demand manager, S&OP lead, or executive) who approved this consensus demand record. Establishes accountability for the demand signal.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific trade promotion or marketing event driving incremental demand. Populated only when promotion_flag is true.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU for which consensus demand is being planned. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Reference to the specific S&OP or IBP cycle during which this consensus demand was agreed. Enables tracking of demand evolution across planning cycles.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planning location (distribution center, plant, or market) for which this consensus demand applies.

attributes.name: tertiary_consensus_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user who last modified this consensus demand record. Enables tracking of who made the most recent changes.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consensus demand record is currently active and should be used by supply planning. False indicates the record has been superseded or deactivated.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the consensus demand record within the S&OP workflow. Only approved records are released to supply planning.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the consensus demand was formally approved and released to supply planning. Marks the transition from draft to official demand signal.

attributes.name: bias_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of systematic forecasting bias based on historical performance. Over-forecast indicates consistent overestimation; under-forecast indicates consistent underestimation; neutral indicates balanced accuracy.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for demand planners to capture additional context, assumptions, risks, or special considerations related to this consensus demand record.

attributes.name: commercial_overlay_quantity
attributes.description: The demand adjustment applied by commercial teams based on market intelligence, customer commitments, and sales insights. Can be positive or negative.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of confidence in the consensus demand figure based on data quality, market stability, and input reliability. Used for risk-based supply planning.

attributes.name: consensus_quantity
attributes.description: The final agreed demand volume for this SKU/location/period after all inputs and overlays have been applied. This is the single demand signal passed to supply planning and represents the official forecast.

attributes.name: constrained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consensus demand has been adjusted downward due to known supply constraints. True means demand was constrained; false means demand is unconstrained.

attributes.name: constraint_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the supply constraint that limited consensus demand (e.g., production capacity, raw material shortage, distribution capacity). Populated only when constrained_flag is true.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consensus demand record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: customer_commitment_quantity
attributes.description: Demand volume backed by firm customer orders, contracts, or commitments for this planning period. Represents the most reliable component of consensus demand.

attributes.name: demand_category
attributes.description: Classification of the demand type to enable segmented planning and analysis. Base demand represents ongoing business; promotional and seasonal reflect event-driven spikes; new launch and phase-out support lifecycle transitions.

attributes.name: demand_driver_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary business driver or causal factor influencing this demand (e.g., holiday season, weather pattern, competitive action, regulatory change). Supports root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: demand_driver_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the demand driver or business rationale behind the consensus demand figure. Captures qualitative insights from demand planners and commercial teams.

attributes.name: demand_volatility_index
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand variability for this SKU/location combination, typically expressed as coefficient of variation. Higher values indicate greater uncertainty and require higher safety stock.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_previous_period
attributes.description: The forecast accuracy percentage achieved for this SKU/location combination in the previous planning period. Used to assess forecasting performance trends and adjust confidence levels.

attributes.name: forecast_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the statistical forecasting model or algorithm used to generate the baseline statistical forecast (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, machine learning model).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consensus demand record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this consensus demand record was last reviewed and validated by the demand planning team during the S&OP demand review meeting.

attributes.name: marketing_event_uplift_quantity
attributes.description: Incremental demand volume expected from planned marketing campaigns, promotions, or trade events during this planning period.

attributes.name: new_product_launch_quantity
attributes.description: Demand volume attributed to new product introductions or product launches scheduled for this planning period. Typically based on launch plans and market sizing.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next S&OP demand review when this consensus demand will be re-evaluated and updated based on latest market intelligence.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planning time horizon for this demand record. Short-term (0-3 months) is firm; medium-term (3-12 months) is flexible; long-term (12+ months) is strategic.

attributes.name: promotion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consensus demand includes uplift from planned trade promotions or marketing events. True means promotional activity is planned; false means base demand only.

attributes.name: seasonality_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor representing seasonal demand patterns for this planning period. Values above 1.0 indicate peak season; below 1.0 indicate off-season.

attributes.name: statistical_forecast_quantity
attributes.description: The baseline demand forecast generated by statistical forecasting algorithms before any manual adjustments or commercial overlays. Serves as the starting point for consensus demand.

attributes.name: unconstrained_demand_quantity
attributes.description: The theoretical demand volume if all supply constraints (capacity, materials, inventory) were removed. Used for capacity planning and investment decisions.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which consensus demand quantity is expressed (each, case, pallet, kilogram, liter, etc.). Must align with product master UOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PAL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage variance between consensus demand and statistical forecast, calculated as (variance_to_statistical / statistical_forecast_quantity) * 100. Used to monitor forecast override patterns.

attributes.name: variance_to_statistical
attributes.description: The difference between consensus demand quantity and statistical forecast quantity. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments. Key metric for forecast bias analysis.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking iterations of this consensus demand record within the same S&OP cycle. Increments with each revision to support change history.

products.name: constraint
products.description: Master entity capturing identified supply constraints at each node in the supply network for a given planning horizon. Stores constraint type (capacity, material, labor, regulatory, supplier), constrained resource identifier, constrained SKU or product family, constraint quantity (available vs required), constraint start/end date, severity level, mitigation action, resolution status, owning planner, and allocation method applied during shortage (proportional, priority-based, fair share). Used in constrained supply planning runs within IBP to drive supply allocation decisions and exception generation.

attributes.name: constraint_id
attributes.description: Primary key for constraint

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Supply constraints often generate cost impacts; linking to a cost center enables financial impact reporting and mitigation budgeting.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or warehouse node where the constraint is identified. Links to the distribution facility master.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supply planner or demand planner responsible for managing and resolving this constraint. Links to the workforce or user master for accountability tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing plant or production facility where the constraint is identified. Links to the plant master for location context.

attributes.name: planning_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) or Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) run during which this constraint was identified.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU or product family affected by this constraint. Links to the product master for constrained item identification.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external supplier when the constraint originates from supplier capacity or material availability limitations.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: constraint should reference the network node where the constraint applies; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The algorithm applied to allocate constrained supply across competing demand: proportional (pro-rata by demand), priority_based (by customer or product priority), fair_share (equal distribution), customer_tier (by customer segmentation), or strategic_account (key account preference).

attributes.name: constrained_resource_identifier
attributes.description: Business identifier of the specific resource that is constrained, such as production line code, warehouse zone, labor pool identifier, or material code. Provides granular traceability to the bottleneck.

attributes.name: constraint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the constraint: identified (newly detected), active (currently impacting supply), mitigated (workaround applied), resolved (constraint removed), or escalated (requires executive intervention).
attributes.references: Supply Chain Exception Management Best Practice

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Classification of the constraint by root cause: capacity (production or storage capacity limitation), material (raw material or component shortage), labor (workforce availability), regulatory (compliance or certification limitation), supplier (external supplier constraint), or transportation (logistics capacity constraint).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this constraint record was first created in the data platform. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount, such as USD, EUR, or GBP. Aligns with corporate reporting currency standards.

attributes.name: customer_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this constraint directly impacts customer order fulfillment or On Time In Full (OTIF) performance. True indicates customer-facing impact requiring expedited resolution.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: The calculated number of days the constraint is expected to persist, derived from start and end dates. Used for prioritization and impact assessment.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the constraint is expected to be resolved or no longer impact supply. Marks the end of the constrained planning horizon. Nullable for constraints with indefinite duration.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The organizational level to which this constraint has been escalated for resolution: none (managed at planner level), team_lead, director, vp (vice president), or executive (C-suite). Reflects the severity and business impact of the constraint.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated revenue or margin impact of the constraint in the planning currency, calculated as shortfall quantity multiplied by unit margin or revenue. Used for executive reporting and prioritization.

attributes.name: identified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the constraint was first detected by the planning system or planner. Represents the constraint discovery event in the planning lifecycle.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this constraint record was last updated in the data platform. Audit field for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the constraint record was last reviewed or updated by a planner. Used to track active management and ensure constraints are not stale.

attributes.name: mitigation_action
attributes.description: Description of the action plan or workaround implemented to address the constraint, such as alternate sourcing, production rescheduling, expedited shipping, or demand shaping. Free-text field for planner notes.

attributes.name: mitigation_effectiveness_score
attributes.description: Quantitative assessment of how effectively the mitigation action reduced the constraint impact, expressed as a percentage (0-100). Used for continuous improvement and mitigation strategy evaluation.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: The organizational planning team or business unit responsible for this constraint, such as regional supply planning, category planning, or global S&OP team. Used for workload distribution and escalation routing.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numerical ranking of this constraint relative to other active constraints, used to sequence resolution efforts and resource allocation. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: The actual quantity of the resource or material available during the constraint period. Represents the constrained supply capacity.

attributes.name: quantity_required
attributes.description: The quantity of the resource or material required to meet demand without constraint. Represents the unconstrained demand signal.

attributes.name: quantity_shortfall
attributes.description: The calculated gap between required and available quantities (required minus available). Represents the magnitude of the constraint impact.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this constraint is driven by regulatory, certification, or compliance requirements such as Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval, or Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) restrictions.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing detailed notes on how the constraint was resolved, lessons learned, and recommendations for future prevention. Used for knowledge management and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the constraint was fully resolved and supply capacity restored. Nullable for constraints that remain active or unresolved.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the underlying cause of the constraint: demand_spike (unexpected demand increase), supply_disruption (supplier or logistics failure), quality_issue (product recall or quality hold), capacity_limitation (fixed asset bottleneck), forecast_error (planning inaccuracy), or external_event (natural disaster, geopolitical event).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business impact classification of the constraint: critical (customer-facing stockout risk), high (significant revenue impact), medium (manageable with mitigation), or low (minimal business impact).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or code of the operational system that originated this constraint record, such as SAP IBP, Blue Yonder, or manual planner entry. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the constraint begins to impact supply availability. Marks the beginning of the constrained planning horizon.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which constraint quantities are expressed, such as cases, pallets, kilograms, liters, or production hours. Aligns with the constrained resource measurement standard.

products.name: risk_register
products.description: Master entity tracking identified supply chain risks that could disrupt supply continuity. Captures risk category (supplier, logistics, geopolitical, regulatory, natural disaster), affected SKUs/nodes, probability score, impact severity, risk owner, mitigation plan, contingency stock requirement, and risk status. Supports supply risk management and business continuity planning.

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Primary key for risk_register

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Risk mitigation actions are funded through specific cost centers; the link supports risk‑related expense tracking and SOX reporting.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center affected by this risk, if the risk is DC-specific. Links to the distribution facility master data for logistics continuity planning.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing plant affected by this risk, if the risk is plant-specific. Links to the plant master data for production continuity planning.

attributes.name: primary_risk_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: quaternary_risk_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this risk record, linking to the workforce master data for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier associated with this risk, if the risk is supplier-specific. Links to the supplier master data for vendor risk management.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: risk_register should be tied to a specific network node for risk tracking; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: tertiary_risk_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this risk record in the system, linking to the workforce master data for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: actual_closure_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the risk was closed or fully mitigated, enabling risk resolution cycle time analysis and mitigation effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: affected_node_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of supply network node identifiers (plants, distribution centers, suppliers) that are exposed to this risk, supporting network resilience analysis.

attributes.name: affected_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU identifiers that are exposed to this supply chain risk, enabling product-level impact analysis and mitigation planning.

attributes.name: assessed_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment (probability and impact scoring) was completed, establishing the baseline for risk monitoring.

attributes.name: contingency_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated financial cost of implementing the contingency plan, including expedited freight, alternative sourcing premiums, and safety stock carrying costs, measured in the base currency.

attributes.name: contingency_plan
attributes.description: Reactive response plan to be executed if the risk materializes, including alternative sourcing strategies, safety stock deployment, and business continuity procedures.

attributes.name: contingency_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Additional safety stock quantity recommended to buffer against this risk, expressed in the base unit of measure. Used for inventory optimization and DRP planning.

attributes.name: contingency_stock_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the contingency stock quantity (e.g., EA, CS, KG, LB), aligned with the SKU base UOM for consistency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk record was first created in the system, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this risk record (impact_score, contingency_cost_estimate).

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk was escalated to higher management levels, tracking the escalation timeline for governance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this risk has been escalated to senior management or executive leadership due to high severity or strategic importance.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country code where the risk is localized, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional identifiers for geopolitical and natural disaster risk tracking.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply chain risk was first identified and entered into the risk register, supporting risk aging and trend analysis.

attributes.name: impact_score
attributes.description: Quantitative financial estimate of potential loss or cost if the risk event occurs, measured in the base currency. Used for risk prioritization and contingency budget planning.

attributes.name: impact_severity
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the potential business impact if the risk materializes: critical (business-threatening), high (major disruption), medium (moderate impact), low (minor inconvenience), or negligible (minimal effect).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk record, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX, enabling change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent risk review or reassessment, ensuring risks are periodically evaluated as part of the S&OP and IBP governance process.

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the proactive actions and controls implemented to reduce the probability or impact of the risk, including timelines and responsible parties.

attributes.name: mitigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when mitigation activities commenced, tracking the timeline of risk response execution.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next risk review or reassessment, supporting proactive risk management and compliance with review frequency policies.

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative assessment of the likelihood that the risk event will occur, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00) based on historical data, expert judgment, and predictive analytics.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the supply chain risk type: supplier (vendor failure, capacity constraints), logistics (transportation disruption, port delays), geopolitical (trade restrictions, political instability), regulatory (compliance changes, import/export restrictions), natural_disaster (weather events, earthquakes, pandemics), or quality (product defects, contamination).

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the supply chain risk, including context, potential triggers, and business impact scenarios.

attributes.name: risk_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, updates, or observations related to the risk, supporting collaborative risk management and knowledge sharing.

attributes.name: risk_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the supply chain risk, formatted as RISK-NNNNNNNN for external communication and tracking.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk rating calculated as probability_score multiplied by impact_score, used for risk ranking and prioritization in the S&OP and IBP processes.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk: identified (newly discovered), assessed (analysis complete), active (currently impacting operations), mitigated (controls in place), closed (no longer a threat), or monitoring (under observation).

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the primary risk category for more precise risk segmentation and analysis.

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the nature of the supply chain risk for quick identification and reporting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system from which this risk record originated (e.g., SAP IBP, TradeEdge, manual entry), supporting data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the risk is expected to be fully mitigated or closed, used for risk management performance tracking and SLA monitoring.

products.name: planning_exception
products.description: Transactional record capturing supply planning exceptions and alerts generated during IBP supply planning and DRP execution runs. Stores exception type (OOS risk, excess inventory, late replenishment, unmet demand, capacity breach), affected SKU/location, exception severity, exception date, recommended action, planner assignment, resolution status, resolution notes, and originating run reference. Drives exception-based planning workflows and planner workbench prioritization.

attributes.name: planning_exception_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the planning exception record. Primary key for the planning exception entity.

attributes.name: primary_planning_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planner or demand planner assigned to resolve this exception.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU affected by this planning exception.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant, distribution center, or location where the planning exception occurred.

attributes.name: tertiary_planning_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified the planning exception record.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recommended action type for resolving the exception. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: expedite_order|cancel_order|increase_production|decrease_production|transfer_stock|adjust_forecast|override_plan — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auto_resolution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception was automatically resolved by the system without planner intervention.

attributes.name: business_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the exception if not resolved, expressed in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Type of supply chain constraint that contributed to the planning exception.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the planning exception record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the business impact amount.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_quantity
attributes.description: The forecasted demand quantity for the affected SKU-location during the exception period.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception was escalated to management or cross-functional teams for resolution.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The organizational level to which the exception was escalated, if applicable.

attributes.name: exception_date
attributes.description: The date when the planning exception was identified or when the exception condition is projected to occur.

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the planning exception for planner reference.

attributes.name: exception_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique exception number assigned to this planning exception for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: exception_quantity
attributes.description: The magnitude of the exception expressed as a quantity (e.g., shortage quantity, excess quantity, unmet demand quantity).

attributes.name: exception_recurrence_count
attributes.description: Number of times this type of exception has occurred for the same SKU-location combination within a defined time window.

attributes.name: exception_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the planning exception indicating the urgency and business impact of the issue.
attributes.references: Supply Chain Exception Management Best Practices

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planning exception indicating its resolution progress.

attributes.name: exception_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the planning exception was detected and recorded by the IBP system.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planning exception indicating the nature of the supply planning issue. OOS Risk (Out of Stock Risk), Excess Inventory, Late Replenishment, Unmet Demand, Capacity Breach, or Safety Stock Breach.

attributes.name: gap_quantity
attributes.description: The calculated gap between demand and supply that triggered the exception (positive for shortage, negative for excess).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the planning exception record was last modified.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: The planning group or team responsible for managing exceptions for this SKU-location combination.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_date
attributes.description: The specific date within the planning horizon where the exception condition manifests.

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the IBP planning run or DRP execution run that generated this exception.

attributes.name: priority_score
attributes.description: Calculated priority score used to rank exceptions in the planner workbench, based on severity, business impact, and urgency.

attributes.name: projected_inventory_balance
attributes.description: The projected inventory balance at the time of the exception, used to assess the severity of stock-out or excess inventory conditions.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: System-generated or planner-defined recommended action to resolve the planning exception.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when the planning exception was marked as resolved or closed.

attributes.name: resolution_duration_hours
attributes.description: The elapsed time in hours from exception detection to resolution, used for performance tracking.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the actions taken to resolve the exception and the outcome.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the planning exception was marked as resolved or closed.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause that triggered the planning exception.
attributes.references: Supply Chain Root Cause Analysis Framework

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the root cause analysis findings for the planning exception.

attributes.name: safety_stock_target
attributes.description: The target safety stock level for the SKU-location combination at the time of the exception.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source system that generated the planning exception (e.g., SAP IBP, TradeEdge, internal planning engine).

attributes.name: supply_plan_quantity
attributes.description: The planned supply quantity (production or replenishment) for the affected SKU-location during the exception period.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the exception quantity (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, PAL for pallet).
attributes.references: UN/CEFACT Unit of Measure Code List

products.name: sku_planning_param
products.description: Master entity storing SKU-level planning parameters used in demand and supply planning calculations. Captures planning horizon, lot size, minimum order quantity (MOQ), shelf life (days), FEFO/FIFO flag, planning strategy (make-to-stock/make-to-order), ABC/XYZ classification, demand pattern type, seasonality index, and IBP planning group assignment. Distinct from product master (owned by product domain) as this captures supply-planning-specific parameters.

attributes.name: sku_planning_param_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Planning Parameter ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU planning parameter record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility where this SKU is produced or sourced. Used for plant-specific planning parameters.

attributes.name: product_lca_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.product_lca. Business justification: SKU planning uses product LCA data (carbon/water footprints) to set planning parameters and sustainability targets.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU in the product master. Links planning parameters to the specific product variant being planned.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: sku_planning_param needs to be associated with the network node it applies to; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC inventory classification based on revenue contribution or consumption value. A items are high-value requiring tight control, C items are low-value with relaxed control.
attributes.references: Inventory Management Best Practices - Pareto Analysis

attributes.name: backorder_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backorders are permitted for this SKU when inventory is insufficient. True allows demand to be backordered, false requires immediate fulfillment or cancellation.

attributes.name: coverage_profile_days
attributes.description: Target days of supply to maintain in inventory. Represents desired inventory coverage horizon based on demand forecast and replenishment frequency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planning parameter record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_part_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as a critical part requiring special planning attention. Critical parts may have higher service levels or expedited replenishment.

attributes.name: demand_pattern_type
attributes.description: Characterization of the SKUs historical demand pattern. Determines appropriate forecasting method and safety stock calculation approach.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which these planning parameters are no longer active. Null indicates parameters are currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which these planning parameters become active and are used by planning systems. Supports time-phased parameter changes.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: Fixed production or procurement lot size quantity when using fixed lot size method. Represents standard batch size for manufacturing or ordering.

attributes.name: forecast_model_type
attributes.description: Statistical or machine learning model used for demand forecasting. Determines the algorithm applied during forecast generation in IBP or demand planning systems.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_processing_time_days
attributes.description: Time required for quality inspection and goods receipt processing after physical delivery. Adds to total replenishment lead time.
attributes.references: Quality Management and Warehouse Operations Standards

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used for inventory valuation and consumption. FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), or weighted average costing.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planning parameter record was last updated. Tracks most recent change for change management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when planning parameters were last reviewed and validated by the planning team. Supports periodic parameter maintenance and accuracy audits.

attributes.name: lot_size_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate production or procurement lot sizes. Determines how order quantities are calculated in MRP and supply planning runs.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Limited by production capacity, storage constraints, or supplier capabilities.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum inventory level target for this SKU. Used in min-max planning to cap inventory investment and prevent overstock situations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Enforced by supplier contracts or manufacturing constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum remaining shelf life required at time of shipment to customer or retail delivery. Ensures product quality and retailer acceptance.

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for this SKU. Used for workload assignment and exception management routing.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure that controls how the planning system generates procurement proposals. Determines planning logic and automation level.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for next planning parameter review. Ensures regular validation of planning assumptions and parameter accuracy.

attributes.name: order_multiple_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity increment in which orders must be placed. All order quantities must be multiples of this value due to packaging or production constraints.

attributes.name: parameter_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special planning considerations, parameter rationale, or exceptions for this SKU. Provides context for planning decisions.

attributes.name: parameter_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planning parameter record. Active parameters are used in planning runs, inactive parameters are ignored.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to goods receipt. Used for MRP scheduling and supply plan timing calculations.
attributes.references: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Lead Time Standards

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: IBP planning group assignment for demand and supply planning segmentation. Groups SKUs with similar planning characteristics for collaborative planning processes.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days into the future for which demand and supply planning is performed. Defines the forward-looking planning window for this SKU.
attributes.references: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Best Practices

attributes.name: planning_strategy
attributes.description: Manufacturing planning strategy that determines how the SKU is planned and produced. Make-to-stock produces to forecast, make-to-order produces against customer orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Planning Strategy

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the planning system cannot automatically change planned orders without planner approval. Protects near-term production schedule stability.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is externally procured from suppliers, produced in-house, or both. Determines supply planning logic and sourcing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Procurement Type

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers a replenishment order. Calculated based on lead time demand plus safety stock to prevent stockouts.

attributes.name: rounding_profile_code
attributes.description: Code defining rounding rules for planned order quantities. Ensures quantities align with packaging units, pallet configurations, or production batch constraints.

attributes.name: safety_stock_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate safety stock levels. Fixed quantity uses static buffer, service level based uses demand variability and lead time uncertainty.

attributes.name: seasonality_profile_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the seasonality pattern applied to this SKU for demand forecasting. Links to predefined seasonal index curves (e.g., summer peak, holiday spike).

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: Target service level percentage for this SKU (e.g., 95%, 98%, 99%). Drives safety stock calculation to achieve desired product availability.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the SKU in days from production date to expiration. Critical for FEFO inventory management and demand planning for perishable goods.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all planning quantities (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, KG for kilogram). Standardizes quantity representation across planning processes.

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: XYZ demand variability classification. X items have stable demand, Y items have moderate variability, Z items have highly erratic or sporadic demand patterns.

products.name: inventory_projection
products.description: Transactional record capturing the forward-looking inventory projection (projected available balance) for each SKU/location/date combination as output from the supply planning run. Stores projected on-hand, projected on-order, projected demand, projected receipts, days-of-supply projection, OOS risk flag, excess inventory flag, and planning run reference. Distinct from physical inventory positions (owned by inventory domain).

attributes.name: inventory_projection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory projection record. Primary key for this transactional projection entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planner or planning team responsible for this SKU-location combination. Enables accountability and collaboration.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU for which inventory is being projected. Links to the product master data.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standard

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location (distribution center, plant, warehouse) for which inventory is projected.

attributes.name: atp_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available to promise to new customer orders on the projection date, calculated from projected balance minus committed allocations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory projection record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: ctp_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity capable to promise considering future production capacity and material availability, extending beyond current ATP.

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: Projected number of days the available inventory balance will cover forecasted demand. Critical metric for inventory health and service level assessment.

attributes.name: demand_source
attributes.description: Source system or process that provided the demand forecast used in this projection (e.g., statistical forecast, demand sensing, customer orders, consensus demand).

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized exception or alert code triggered by this projection (e.g., LOW_STOCK, EXCESS_INV, CAPACITY_CONSTRAINT). Supports exception-based planning workflows.

attributes.name: excess_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the projected available balance exceeds maximum stock levels or days-of-supply targets, signaling potential overstock risk.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Historical forecast accuracy percentage for this SKU-location combination, used to assess confidence in the projection and adjust safety stock.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory projection record was last updated. Tracks changes and supports version control.

attributes.name: oos_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the projected available balance falls below safety stock or service level thresholds, signaling potential stockout risk.

attributes.name: planning_bucket
attributes.description: Time granularity of the projection. Daily for near-term tactical planning; weekly or monthly for mid-term; quarterly for long-term strategic planning.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Organizational planning group or segment responsible for this projection (e.g., regional planning team, product category planning team).

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planning run that generated this projection. Enables traceability to planning execution and version control.

attributes.name: planning_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supply planning run that generated this projection was executed. Distinct from record creation; represents the business event time.

attributes.name: projected_available_balance
attributes.description: Net projected inventory balance after accounting for on-hand, receipts, and demand. Key metric for Available-to-Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: projected_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted demand (consumption, sales, or shipments) expected to occur on the projection date. Input from demand planning or demand sensing.

attributes.name: projected_on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted physical inventory quantity expected to be available on-hand at the location on the projection date. Core output of supply planning calculation.

attributes.name: projected_on_order_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted quantity of inventory currently on order (in-transit or planned receipts) expected to arrive by or on the projection date.

attributes.name: projected_receipt_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted quantity of planned receipts (production output, purchase orders, or replenishment) expected to arrive on the projection date.

attributes.name: projection_confidence_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of confidence in this projection based on demand volatility, forecast accuracy, and supply reliability.

attributes.name: projection_date
attributes.description: The specific future date for which this inventory projection applies. Core dimension for time-series inventory planning.

attributes.name: projection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the planner regarding assumptions, exceptions, or special considerations for this projection.

attributes.name: projection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this projection record. Indicates whether the projection is in draft, approved for execution, published to downstream systems, or superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: projection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the projection methodology. Baseline uses unconstrained demand; constrained applies capacity limits; optimized applies optimization algorithms; scenario and simulation support what-if analysis.

attributes.name: projection_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this projection scenario. Supports multiple what-if scenarios and plan iterations within the same planning cycle.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The reorder point threshold used in the planning logic. When projected balance falls below this level, replenishment is triggered.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The safety stock target quantity used as the baseline for OOS risk assessment on the projection date. May vary by date if dynamic safety stock policies are applied.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: Target service level (fill rate or in-stock probability) that the projection aims to achieve. Used to calibrate safety stock and OOS risk thresholds.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system that generated this projection (e.g., SAP IBP, Blue Yonder, Oracle Cloud Supply Chain). Supports multi-system integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: supply_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assessing supply chain vulnerabilities (supplier reliability, lead time variability, geopolitical risk) that may impact this projection.

attributes.name: supply_source
attributes.description: Source of supply for projected receipts (e.g., internal production, external procurement, transfer from another location).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which all projected quantities are expressed (e.g., EA, CS, KG, LB). Must be consistent across all quantity fields in this record.

products.name: demand_event
products.description: Master entity capturing planned business events that create demand uplift or downlift adjustments to the statistical forecast. Includes trade promotions, new product launches (with ramp-up volume curves, cannibalization impacts, and supply readiness status), product discontinuations, price changes, seasonal events, and market expansion activities. Stores event type, affected SKUs, affected customers/channels, volume impact (units and percentage), event start/end date, confidence level, initial stocking quantity (for launches), launch market/channel scope, and source system reference. Provides the causal layer that explains forecast adjustments beyond statistical extrapolation and bridges R&D/product NPD pipeline with supply chain readiness planning.

attributes.name: demand_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel or sales channel affected by this demand event.

attributes.name: primary_demand_employee_id
