attributes.description: Reference to the demand planner or business user responsible for creating and maintaining this demand event.

attributes.name: primary_demand_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU affected by this demand event. For multi-SKU events, this may reference a product family or be null with SKU scope defined elsewhere.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: REQUIRED: Demand events (e.g., product launches) are linked to a promotion event for lift analysis and spend tracking.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: demand_event should be linked to the network node where the event impacts supply; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or retail account affected by this demand event. Null for market-wide events.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demand event requires formal approval before being included in the demand plan. True for high-impact or high-risk events.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demand event was approved.

attributes.name: cannibalization_rate_percent
attributes.description: For new product launches, the percentage of new product demand that is expected to cannibalize existing SKU demand rather than represent net-new volume.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level or business certainty that the event will occur and deliver the projected volume impact. Used for risk-adjusted planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demand event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts in this record.

attributes.name: discontinuation_reason
attributes.description: For product discontinuation events, the business rationale for discontinuing the SKU (e.g., low sales, regulatory, reformulation, portfolio rationalization).

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code for the demand event, used for external reference and cross-system tracking.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the demand event, including business rationale, scope, and expected market impact.

attributes.name: event_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the demand event ceases to impact demand. Null for indefinite events such as permanent price changes or discontinuations.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the demand event for business user identification and reporting.

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planner comments, assumptions, risks, or additional context about the demand event.

attributes.name: event_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the demand event begins to impact demand. For promotions, this is the promotion start date. For launches, this is the market availability date.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand event. Controls whether the event is included in demand planning calculations.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand event indicating the nature of the business activity that creates demand variance. Determines which event-specific attributes are populated.

attributes.name: initial_stocking_quantity
attributes.description: For new product launches, the initial pipeline fill quantity required to stock distribution centers and retail shelves before consumer demand begins.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demand event record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: For product discontinuation events, the final date on which orders for the SKU will be accepted.

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: For product discontinuation events, the final date on which the SKU will be shipped to customers.

attributes.name: launch_channel_scope
attributes.description: For new product launches, describes which distribution channels and customer segments are included in the launch (e.g., DTC-only, mass retail, specialty, omnichannel).

attributes.name: market_geography_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code or market region code where the demand event applies. For new product launches, indicates launch market scope.

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the demand planning run or Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle in which this event was incorporated into the forecast.

attributes.name: price_change_amount
attributes.description: For price change events, the absolute change in unit price. Positive for price increases, negative for price decreases.

attributes.name: price_change_percent
attributes.description: For price change events, the percentage change in unit price relative to the previous price.

attributes.name: price_elasticity_coefficient
attributes.description: For price change events, the estimated price elasticity of demand used to calculate volume impact. Negative values indicate normal goods (price up, demand down).

attributes.name: promotion_funding_amount
attributes.description: For trade promotion events, the total budget allocated to fund the promotion, including trade spend, discounts, and allowances.

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: For trade promotion events, the specific promotion mechanism (e.g., temporary price reduction, buy-one-get-one, display allowance, feature ad).

attributes.name: ramp_up_weeks
attributes.description: For new product launches, the number of weeks over which demand is expected to ramp from zero to steady-state volume.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this demand event was created or synchronized.

attributes.name: source_system_event_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this demand event in the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: supply_readiness_status
attributes.description: For new product launches, indicates whether manufacturing, procurement, and supply chain are ready to support the launch volume. Critical gate for launch approval.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume impact quantities. Aligns with SKU base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: volume_impact_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in demand relative to the statistical baseline forecast. Positive for uplift, negative for downlift.

attributes.name: volume_impact_units
attributes.description: Absolute incremental or decremental demand volume attributed to this event, expressed in base units. Positive for uplift events, negative for downlift events.

products.name: otif_target
products.description: Master entity defining On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) service level targets by customer, channel, and product category. Captures on-time delivery target (%), in-full fill rate target (%), OTIF composite target (%), measurement window, penalty clause flag, retailer-mandated target flag, and effective date range. Provides the service level commitment baseline for supply planning and distribution execution.

attributes.name: otif_target_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the OTIF service level target record.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: otif_target is defined per supply node; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: target_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: OTIF Performance Ownership assigns a responsible employee for each OTIF target in the OTIF Management Dashboard.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer account for which this OTIF target is defined. Null if target applies to a customer segment or channel rather than individual customer.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this OTIF target was formally approved and authorized for use in supply planning and performance measurement.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this OTIF target definition, indicating whether it has been reviewed and approved by authorized stakeholders.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who approved this OTIF target definition, typically a supply chain director or customer service leader.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel classification for which this OTIF target is defined (retail, wholesale, direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, foodservice, export).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OTIF target record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_segment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer segment (e.g., national retailers, regional chains, independent stores) to which this OTIF target applies.

attributes.name: delivery_tolerance_hours
attributes.description: Acceptable time window variance (in hours) before or after the scheduled delivery time within which delivery is still considered on-time.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this OTIF target expires or is superseded by a new target definition. Null indicates an open-ended commitment.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this OTIF target becomes effective and is used for performance measurement and compliance evaluation.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Performance threshold below which OTIF failures trigger escalation to senior management or customer service recovery actions.

attributes.name: in_full_fill_rate_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage for in-full order fulfillment, representing the proportion of orders that must be delivered with 100% of requested quantity.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this OTIF target record, used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent review of this OTIF target definition to assess continued relevance and appropriateness.

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which OTIF performance against this target is measured and reported to stakeholders.

attributes.name: measurement_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days over which OTIF performance is measured and evaluated against the target (e.g., rolling 30 days, quarterly 90 days).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this OTIF target to ensure alignment with business strategy and customer expectations.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage for on-time delivery performance, representing the proportion of orders that must be delivered within the agreed delivery window.

attributes.name: otif_composite_target_percent
attributes.description: Composite OTIF target percentage representing orders that must meet both on-time AND in-full criteria simultaneously. This is the primary service level commitment metric.

attributes.name: penalty_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial penalties or chargebacks apply when OTIF performance falls below the target threshold.

attributes.name: penalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to calculate financial penalties when OTIF targets are not met, typically applied to order value or invoice amount.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Supply planning team or organizational unit responsible for achieving this OTIF target and managing associated supply plans.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority classification for this OTIF target, indicating the strategic importance and resource allocation priority (tier 1 = highest priority customers).

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Product category or hierarchy level to which this OTIF target applies, enabling category-specific service level commitments.

attributes.name: quantity_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable variance percentage for order quantity fulfillment. Orders within this tolerance are considered in-full (e.g., 98% fulfillment may be acceptable).

attributes.name: retailer_mandated_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OTIF target is mandated by the retailer/customer as part of their vendor compliance program versus internally set by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: sla_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal SLA document or contract section that defines this OTIF commitment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this OTIF target record originated, typically SAP IBP or customer SLA management system.

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the OTIF target definition, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the OTIF target configuration, typically indicating the customer segment or channel it applies to.

attributes.name: target_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special conditions, or business rationale for this OTIF target definition.

attributes.name: target_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the business owner or supply chain manager accountable for achieving this OTIF target.

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OTIF target definition (active, inactive, pending approval, expired, suspended).

attributes.name: action_expression

attributes.name: allocation_method

attributes.name: condition_expression
attributes.description: Logical expression that must be satisfied for the rule to fire.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the ATP rule.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which the rule is no longer applicable (null if open‑ended).

attributes.name: is_default

attributes.name: max_allocation_qty
attributes.description: Upper limit on quantity that can be allocated by this rule.

attributes.name: min_allocation_qty

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority determining rule evaluation order; lower numbers indicate higher precedence.

attributes.name: rule_category
attributes.description: Supply‑chain domain where the rule is applied (e.g., order level, line level, inventory level).

attributes.name: rule_code

attributes.name: rule_name

attributes.name: rule_type

attributes.name: safety_stock_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to safety stock calculations within the rule.

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: fallback_atp_rule_id

domains.name: sales
domains.description: Owns commercial sales execution, order management, and revenue transactions across all channels (retail, wholesale, DTC, e-commerce). Manages sales orders, pricing agreements, sales force automation (SFA), retail account call records, POG compliance, RSP/MSRP price management, ACV/TDP/SOM metrics, and field sales KPIs. Integrates with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.

products.name: trade_account
products.description: SSOT master record for all B2B trade customers including retailers, distributors, wholesalers, and foodservice operators. Captures authoritative account identity: legal entity name, trade channel classification (grocery, mass, club, drug, foodservice, e-commerce), account tier, credit rating, payment terms, currency, tax identifiers, DUNS number, GLN (GS1 Global Location Number), primary language, account status, lifecycle dates, and full status change audit history (previous status, new status, change reason, change timestamp, changed-by user). This is the golden record for all trade partner identity — every other customer domain entity references this product via FK.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Customer Master (SD), Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the B2B trade account. Primary key for the trade account master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost allocation report requires each customer linked to a cost center for internal expense tracking and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_facility. Business justification: Logistics planning assigns each trade account a primary distribution center for order fulfillment and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Retailer ESG reporting requires each trade account to be linked to its ESG commitments for sustainability scorecards and supplier contracts.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_storage_location. Business justification: VMI replenishment planning requires each trade account to have a designated warehouse (storage location); the default_storage_location_id FK enables the VMI allocation report.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis assigns each customer to a profit center to aggregate revenue and margin in financial reporting.

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: The date when this trade account was permanently closed or terminated, if applicable.

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: The date when this trade account was first established and approved for business transactions.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the trade account: active (operational), inactive (dormant), suspended (temporarily blocked), pending approval (new account under review), credit hold (payment issues), or closed (permanently terminated).

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Strategic tier classification based on account size, coverage, and business importance: Tier 1 (national key accounts), Tier 2 (regional chains), Tier 3 (local/metro accounts), Tier 4 (independent operators).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The business model classification of the trade partner: retailer (sells to end consumers), distributor (logistics and fulfillment), wholesaler (bulk reseller), foodservice operator (restaurants/catering), or broker (sales intermediary).

attributes.name: acv_total
attributes.description: The total All Commodity Volume representing the annual dollar sales volume across all product categories for this retail account, used for market coverage analysis.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance allowed for this trade account before credit hold is applied.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit risk rating assigned to this trade account by internal credit management or external credit bureau (e.g., AAA, AA, A, BBB, BB, B, CCC, D).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all financial transactions with this trade account (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, MXN).

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or DBA name under which the account operates in the market, if different from legal entity name.

attributes.name: dsd_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account receives direct store delivery (DSD) shipments bypassing the retailers distribution center.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for unique identification of the business entity.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account has EDI connectivity enabled for electronic exchange of purchase orders, invoices, and advance ship notices.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: The 13-digit GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying the legal entity and physical location of the trade partner.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the street address for the trade account headquarters or primary business location.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the street address (suite, floor, building) for the trade account headquarters.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: The city name of the trade account headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the trade account headquarters location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the trade account headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region of the trade account headquarters location.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent purchase order received from this trade account.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the trade partner organization as it appears on legal documents and contracts.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity (in units or cases) required for orders placed by this trade account.

attributes.name: otif_sla_target_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Percent
attributes.description: The contractual OTIF service level agreement target percentage for order fulfillment performance (e.g., 95.00 represents 95% of orders delivered on time and in full).

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The primary payment instrument used by this account: ACH (automated clearing house), wire transfer, check, EDI payment (electronic funds transfer via EDI 820), or credit card.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The standard payment terms code governing invoice payment due dates and early payment discounts (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The account status immediately prior to the most recent status change, maintained for audit trail and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The business email address of the primary contact for order management, invoicing, and account communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the primary business contact or account manager at the trade partner organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The business phone number of the primary contact, including country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: primary_language_code
attributes.description: The 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the preferred communication language with this trade account (e.g., en, es, fr, de).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this trade account master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this trade account master record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: status_change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for the most recent account status change (e.g., payment default, business closure, credit improvement, contract renewal).

attributes.name: status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the most recent account status change occurred.

attributes.name: status_changed_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who executed the most recent account status change, for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account holds a valid tax exemption certificate for sales tax or VAT purposes.

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: The government-issued tax identification number for this legal entity (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in other jurisdictions).

attributes.name: tdp_count
attributes.description: The total number of distribution points (store locations or outlets) operated by this trade account where products can be sold.

attributes.name: trade_channel
attributes.description: The primary retail or distribution channel through which this trade account operates: grocery (supermarkets), mass (mass merchandisers), club (warehouse clubs), drug (pharmacy chains), convenience stores, foodservice (restaurants/institutions), or e-commerce (online retailers). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grocery|mass|club|drug|convenience|foodservice|e-commerce — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account participates in a VMI program where the supplier manages inventory replenishment based on POS or warehouse data.

products.name: account_contact
products.description: Individual contacts associated with a trade account, including buyers, category managers, logistics coordinators, and finance contacts at the retailer or distributor. Captures full name, job title, department, contact role (primary buyer, logistics, finance, marketing), phone, email, preferred communication channel, active status, and opt-in/opt-out flags for commercial communications. Supports SFA and retail execution workflows in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.

attributes.name: account_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: reports_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to another account contact record representing this contact's direct manager or supervisor within the trade account organization. Enables organizational hierarchy mapping.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Hierarchy

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice operator) to which this contact belongs.

attributes.name: assistant_name
attributes.description: The name of the contact's administrative assistant or executive assistant, if applicable. Used for scheduling and communication routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: assistant_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the contact's administrative assistant. Used for scheduling and communication routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: contact_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional notes, preferences, or context about the contact. Used by sales representatives to document relationship insights.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: The contact's role in the buying decision process. Distinguishes between primary decision-makers, influencers, and administrative contacts. Critical for sales force automation and account planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Active contacts are currently employed and engaged with the account. Inactive or terminated contacts are retained for historical reference.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's primary functional role at the trade account. Determines which business processes and communications this contact participates in.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The organizational department or functional area within the trade account where this contact works. Examples include Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Marketing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact's role at the trade account ended, if applicable. Null for currently active contacts. Used for historical tracking and relationship continuity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact became active in their current role at the trade account. Used for tracking tenure and relationship history.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the contact. Used for commercial communications, order confirmations, and business correspondence.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the contact, if applicable. Still used in some trade channels for purchase orders and formal documentation.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The given name of the individual contact at the trade account.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete formatted name of the contact, typically concatenated as first name and last name. Used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact has purchasing authority and decision-making power for the account. True if decision maker, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact is the primary point of contact for the trade account. True if primary, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position held by the contact at the trade account organization. Examples include Senior Buyer, Category Manager, Supply Chain Director.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The contact's preferred language for business communications, represented as a 3-letter ISO 639-2 language code. Examples: ENG (English), SPA (Spanish), FRA (French).

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent interaction or communication with this contact. Used to track engagement frequency and identify dormant relationships.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Activity Tracking

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The family name or surname of the individual contact at the trade account.

attributes.name: linkedin_profile_url
attributes.description: The URL of the contact's LinkedIn professional profile. Used for social selling and relationship intelligence.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile or cellular phone number for the contact. Used for urgent communications and field-based retail execution activities.

attributes.name: next_follow_up_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next planned follow-up or interaction with this contact. Supports proactive account management and sales cadence planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Activity Management

attributes.name: opt_in_email
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact has opted in to receive commercial email communications. True if opted in, False if opted out. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: opt_in_phone
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact has opted in to receive commercial phone communications. True if opted in, False if opted out. Required for telemarketing compliance.

attributes.name: opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact has opted in to receive commercial SMS or text message communications. True if opted in, False if opted out.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the contact. Includes country code, area code, and local number.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method for receiving business communications. Supports personalized engagement strategies in SFA and retail execution workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: salesforce_user_code
attributes.description: The Salesforce user ID of the sales representative or account manager responsible for this contact. Links to the internal sales team member managing the relationship.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - User Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this contact record originated. Examples include Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP S/4HANA SD, or manual data entry.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this contact in the source operational system. Used for data reconciliation and integration traceability.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: The sales territory or region code to which this contact and their account are assigned. Used for sales force automation and territory management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Territory Management

products.name: account_address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with a trade account, including headquarters, billing address, ship-to locations, and sold-to locations. Captures address type (HQ, billing, ship-to, sold-to, returns), street, city, state/province, postal code, country, GS1 GLN for the location, geo-coordinates, time zone, and address validation status. Supports EDI ship-to/bill-to mapping and DSD route planning.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Ship-To / Sold-To Partner Functions

attributes.name: account_address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice customer) that this address belongs to.

attributes.name: account_address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are available for transactions; inactive addresses are retained for historical reporting; pending addresses await validation; closed addresses are permanently retired.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and building identifier. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing Standard, Universal Postal Union S42

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, apartment, or unit number. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing Standard, Universal Postal Union S42

attributes.name: address_line_3
attributes.description: Additional address line for complex addresses, building names, or delivery instructions. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_name
attributes.description: Business name or label for this address location (e.g., 'Main Distribution Center', 'Regional Office - Northeast', 'Store #1234').

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: headquarters (HQ), billing address, ship-to location, sold-to location, returns processing center, or warehouse/distribution center. Supports Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) ship-to/bill-to mapping and Direct Store Delivery (DSD) route planning.

attributes.name: address_validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last validated against postal authority databases. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42, USPS CASS

attributes.name: address_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of address verification against postal authority databases. Validated addresses improve delivery success rates and reduce logistics costs.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42, USPS CASS

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the address location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing Standard, Universal Postal Union S42

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for delivery personnel including receiving hours, dock locations, access codes, contact requirements, and handling instructions. Critical for On Time In Full (OTIF) performance.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards, Consumer Goods Industry Best Practices

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Specific dock door or bay number for deliveries at warehouse or distribution center locations. Used by carriers and Direct Store Delivery (DSD) drivers.

attributes.name: dsd_route_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct Store Delivery (DSD) Route Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is eligible for Direct Store Delivery (DSD) routing (True) or requires warehouse distribution (False). Critical for route planning and logistics optimization.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards, Consumer Goods Industry Best Practices

attributes.name: edi_location_qualifier
attributes.description: EDI X12 location qualifier code used in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions to identify the address role (e.g., ST for ship-to, BT for bill-to, SF for ship-from). Supports automated order processing and Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) generation.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standards, ANSI ASC X12

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address was deactivated or replaced. Null indicates the address is currently active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Supports address history tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became active and valid for use in transactions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Supports address history tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying this physical location in the global supply chain. 13-digit numeric identifier used for EDI transactions and supply chain visibility.

attributes.name: inactivation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for address inactivation (e.g., location closed, address changed, account terminated, consolidation). Used for audit trails and business intelligence.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial analysis, route optimization, and Direct Store Delivery (DSD) planning. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for geospatial analysis, route optimization, and Direct Store Delivery (DSD) planning. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code, ZIP code, or postcode for mail delivery routing. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit ZIP in USA, alphanumeric in Canada/UK). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: primary_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary address for the account (True) or a secondary/alternate address (False). Used for default shipping and billing operations.

attributes.name: receiving_hours_end
attributes.description: End time for receiving deliveries at this location in 24-hour format (HH:mm). Used for delivery scheduling and On Time In Full (OTIF) compliance.

attributes.name: receiving_hours_start
attributes.description: Start time for receiving deliveries at this location in 24-hour format (HH:mm). Used for delivery scheduling and On Time In Full (OTIF) compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record that originated this address (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD, Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, Oracle Cloud ERP). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this address in the source system of record. Used for data reconciliation and bidirectional synchronization.

attributes.name: standardized_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been standardized to postal authority format (True) or remains in original input format (False).
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42, USPS CASS

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region code or name. Uses standard postal abbreviations (e.g., CA, NY, ON, QC). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes, Universal Postal Union S42

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier for sales tax, value-added tax (VAT), or goods and services tax (GST) calculation. Used in invoice generation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: OECD Tax Standards, Local Tax Authority Guidelines

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for this location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago, Europe/London). Used for delivery scheduling, service level agreement (SLA) tracking, and On Time In Full (OTIF) calculations.

products.name: account_hierarchy
products.description: Defines the parent-child organizational hierarchy of trade accounts, enabling roll-up of ACV, TDP, trade spend, and sales performance from store level to banner, banner to chain, and chain to parent corporation. Captures parent account, child account, hierarchy level (store, banner, chain, parent corporation), effective date range, hierarchy type (commercial, logistics, financial), and consolidation flag. Critical for S&OP and TPM reporting.
products.reference: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Hierarchy; Nielsen IQ Retailer Hierarchy

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account hierarchy relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: child_account_trade_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child account in the hierarchy. References the lower-level organizational entity (e.g., store, banner, chain).

attributes.name: primary_trade_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent account in the hierarchy. References the higher-level organizational entity (e.g., banner, chain, parent corporation).

attributes.name: acv_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether All Commodity Volume (ACV) metrics should be rolled up from child to parent account. True means include in ACV aggregation; false means exclude. Critical for market coverage and distribution analysis.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the hierarchical relationship change. Draft indicates the relationship is being defined; pending approval indicates the relationship is awaiting management review; approved indicates the relationship has been validated; rejected indicates the relationship was not approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business user who approved the hierarchical relationship. Used for audit trail and governance purposes.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hierarchical relationship was approved. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial and operational metrics from the child account should be consolidated into the parent account for reporting purposes. True means consolidate; false means report separately. Critical for All Commodity Volume (ACV), Total Distribution Points (TDP), trade spend, and sales performance roll-ups.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the account hierarchy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchical relationship ends or is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended relationship. Critical for historical analysis and point-in-time reporting.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchical relationship becomes effective. Used for temporal tracking of organizational changes, mergers, acquisitions, and restructuring events.

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child account within the hierarchy tree, with 1 representing the top level (parent corporation) and increasing numbers representing deeper levels (chain, banner, store). Used for recursive queries and hierarchy traversal.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Level of the child account within the organizational hierarchy. Store represents individual retail locations; banner represents a retail brand or fascia; chain represents a retail chain or group; parent corporation represents the ultimate parent entity; division represents a business division; region represents a geographic region.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path representing the full lineage from root to child account, typically formatted as slash-separated account identifiers (e.g., /1/23/456/7890). Enables efficient ancestor and descendant queries for Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Trade Promotion Management (TPM) reporting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Type of organizational hierarchy relationship. Commercial hierarchies support sales and trade promotion roll-ups; logistics hierarchies support distribution and delivery planning; financial hierarchies support invoicing and payment consolidation; reporting hierarchies support management reporting structures; legal hierarchies represent corporate ownership; operational hierarchies support day-to-day execution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the account hierarchy record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the hierarchical relationship. May include business context, special handling instructions, or historical information about organizational changes.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership or control the parent account has over the child account. Used for proportional consolidation in financial and operational reporting. Range 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: primary_hierarchy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary hierarchical relationship for the child account when multiple hierarchy types exist. True means this is the default hierarchy for reporting and analytics; false means this is a secondary or alternate hierarchy.

attributes.name: relationship_code
attributes.description: Business code or identifier representing the nature of the parent-child relationship. May include codes for wholly-owned subsidiary, franchise, joint venture, affiliate, or other relationship types specific to the consumer goods trade channel.

attributes.name: relationship_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the hierarchical relationship. Provides business context for the parent-child linkage (e.g., Regional Banner Group, Corporate Ownership, Distribution Network).

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current status of the hierarchical relationship. Active indicates the relationship is currently in effect; inactive indicates the relationship has ended; pending indicates the relationship is awaiting activation; suspended indicates the relationship is temporarily paused; terminated indicates the relationship has been permanently ended.

attributes.name: rollup_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied when rolling up metrics from child to parent account. Used for proportional allocation of All Commodity Volume (ACV), Total Distribution Points (TDP), trade spend, and sales performance when a child account participates in multiple hierarchies or has split ownership.

attributes.name: sales_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales performance metrics should be rolled up from child to parent account. True means include in sales aggregation; false means exclude. Essential for Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or code of the source system that provided the hierarchical relationship data. May reference Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution), Oracle Cloud ERP, or other master data management systems.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the hierarchical relationship record in the source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and bidirectional synchronization.

attributes.name: tdp_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Total Distribution Points (TDP) metrics should be rolled up from child to parent account. True means include in TDP aggregation; false means exclude. Essential for numeric distribution and weighted distribution reporting.

attributes.name: trade_spend_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether trade promotion spending should be rolled up from child to parent account. True means include in trade spend aggregation; false means exclude. Critical for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) reporting.

products.name: retail_store
products.description: Individual physical retail store or outlet location associated with a trade account banner or chain. Captures store number, store name, banner, format (hypermarket, supermarket, convenience, club, drug, dollar, e-commerce fulfillment center), store size (sq ft), trading area, store open/close dates, store manager, operating hours, and planogram zone assignment. Used for retail execution, OSA tracking, and DSD route management.
products.reference: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Store; TradeEdge Outlet Master

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retail store location. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Store‑level budgeting and expense tracking use a cost center per retail store for internal cost accounting.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_facility. Business justification: Store replenishment process requires an assigned distribution center to schedule deliveries and calculate OTIF performance.

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Trading Partner ID
attributes.description: EDI trading partner identifier used for electronic order transmission, invoicing, and Advanced Shipping Notices (ASN).

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Store profitability reporting aggregates sales and costs by profit center, requiring a link from store to profit_center.

attributes.name: store_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Store Manager Assignment report linking each store to the responsible employee manager.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: Store‑level VMI or direct replenishment ties a retail store to the exact supplier site that ships inventory, needed for logistics and OTIF tracking.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent trade account, banner, or retail chain that owns or operates this store.

attributes.name: acv_weight
attributes.description: All Commodity Volume (ACV) weighting factor representing this stores share of total market volume, used for distribution and market share calculations.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the retail store location.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, building, or unit number.

attributes.name: banner_name
attributes.description: The retail banner or brand under which this store operates (e.g., Walmart Supercenter, Target, Kroger).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the retail store is located.

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date when the store permanently closed or is scheduled to close. Null if store is active.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the store is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this retail store record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dsd_route_code
attributes.description: Route code or identifier for Direct Store Delivery (DSD) logistics and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying this physical store location for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) and supply chain transactions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this retail store record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent retail execution visit or sales call to this store location.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the store location for mapping and route optimization.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the store location for mapping and route optimization.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned retail execution visit or sales call to this store location.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date when the store first opened for business operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the store (e.g., Mon-Fri 8am-10pm, Sat-Sun 9am-9pm) used for retail execution visit planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: osa_target_pct
attributes.description: Target On Shelf Availability (OSA) percentage for this store indicating expected in-stock performance for key Stock Keeping Units (SKUs).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: otif_sla_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target On Time In Full (OTIF) service level percentage agreed with this store for delivery performance measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion Standards

attributes.name: planogram_zone
attributes.description: Planogram zone or cluster assignment indicating which shelf layout and assortment plan applies to this store.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: pos_system_type
attributes.description: Type or vendor of the Point of Sale (POS) system used at this store for transaction processing and sales data capture.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the store location used for logistics and Direct Store Delivery (DSD) routing.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the store is located.

attributes.name: store_format
attributes.description: The retail format classification of the store indicating size, assortment, and operational model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hypermarket|supermarket|convenience|club|drug|dollar|specialty|e-commerce_fulfillment_center — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: store_name
attributes.description: The official name or designation of the retail store location.

attributes.name: store_number
attributes.description: The retailer-assigned unique store number or code used for operational identification and Direct Store Delivery (DSD) routing.

attributes.name: store_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the retail store location.

attributes.name: store_size_sq_ft
attributes.description: Total retail selling space of the store measured in square feet, used for All Commodity Volume (ACV) and Total Distribution Points (TDP) calculations.

attributes.name: store_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the retail store location.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution Standards

attributes.name: store_tier
attributes.description: Strategic tier classification (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2) indicating store importance based on volume, profitability, or strategic value for prioritized retail execution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: tdp_weight
attributes.description: Total Distribution Points (TDP) weighting factor representing this stores contribution to numeric distribution metrics.

attributes.name: trading_area
attributes.description: Geographic trading area or market designation (e.g., metro area, region) used for sales territory and distribution planning.

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store participates in a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) program where the manufacturer manages replenishment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion Standards

products.name: edi_trading_partner
products.description: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) configuration and trading partner profile for a trade account. Captures EDI partner ID, ISA/GS qualifiers, EDI standard (ANSI X12, EDIFACT), supported transaction sets (850 PO, 855 PO Ack, 856 ASN, 810 Invoice, 852 POS Data, 867 Product Transfer), communication protocol (AS2, SFTP, VAN), test vs. production flag, EDI go-live date, and SLA for acknowledgment turnaround. Owned by the customer domain as part of trade account configuration.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA EDI Partner Profile; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Trading Partner ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EDI trading partner configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade customer account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice operator) that this EDI configuration serves.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_sla_hours
attributes.description: The contractual turnaround time (in hours) for Consumer Goods to send functional acknowledgments (997) or business acknowledgments (855) back to the trading partner after receiving an EDI transaction.

attributes.name: as2_identifier
attributes.description: The AS2 identifier (AS2-From or AS2-To) used in AS2 message headers when AS2 protocol is in use.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: The communication protocol used to transmit EDI documents between Consumer Goods and the trading partner (e.g., AS2 for secure internet-based exchange, SFTP for file transfer, VAN for value-added network).
attributes.references: AS2 RFC 4130, SFTP RFC 4251, GS1 EANCOM

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Contact Email Address
attributes.description: The email address of the primary EDI contact at the trading partner for operational communication and issue escalation.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary EDI coordinator or technical contact at the trading partner organization responsible for EDI operations and issue resolution.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Contact Phone Number
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary EDI contact at the trading partner for urgent operational issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this EDI trading partner configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: digital_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether EDI transmissions must include digital signatures for non-repudiation (common in AS2 protocol).

attributes.name: edi_go_live_date
attributes.description: The date when EDI transactions with this trading partner went live in production.

attributes.name: edi_partner_code
attributes.description: The unique EDI partner identifier assigned to the trading partner, used in EDI envelope headers (ISA/GS segments) to route transactions.

attributes.name: edi_standard
attributes.description: The EDI messaging standard used for communication with this trading partner (e.g., ANSI X12 for North America, UN/EDIFACT for international).
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards, ANSI ASC X12, UN/CEFACT

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Trading Partner Status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the EDI trading partner configuration (active for live production, testing for certification phase, inactive for discontinued partners, suspended for temporary holds).

attributes.name: edi_version
attributes.description: The specific version of the EDI standard in use (e.g., 004010, 005010 for ANSI X12; D96A, D01B for EDIFACT).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 Version Directory, UN/EDIFACT Directory

attributes.name: encryption_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether EDI transmissions with this trading partner must be encrypted (e.g., AS2 with encryption, SFTP with SSH).

attributes.name: environment_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDI configuration is for production transactions, testing/certification, or development purposes.

attributes.name: gs_qualifier
attributes.description: GS application sender/receiver code qualifier that identifies the type of identification being used in the GS segment.

attributes.name: gs_receiver_code
attributes.description: The application receiver code used in the GS03 segment, identifying the trading partner as the receiver at the functional group level.

attributes.name: gs_sender_code
attributes.description: The application sender code used in the GS02 segment, identifying Consumer Goods as the sender at the functional group level.

attributes.name: isa_qualifier
attributes.description: ISA interchange ID qualifier code that identifies the type of identification being used in the ISA segment (e.g., 01=DUNS, 14=DUNS+4, ZZ=Mutually Defined). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|14|20|27|28|29|30|33|ZZ — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: isa_receiver_code
attributes.description: The receiver identification code used in the ISA08 segment of outbound EDI transactions, representing the trading partner receiving the data.

attributes.name: isa_sender_code
attributes.description: The sender identification code used in the ISA06 segment of outbound EDI transactions from Consumer Goods to the trading partner.

attributes.name: mdn_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether Consumer Goods requests a Message Disposition Notification (MDN) receipt from the trading partner when using AS2 protocol.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special configuration requirements, partner-specific business rules, or operational considerations for this EDI relationship.

attributes.name: processing_sla_hours
attributes.description: The contractual turnaround time (in hours) for Consumer Goods to process inbound EDI transactions (e.g., convert 850 PO into sales order) after receipt.

attributes.name: sftp_directory_inbound
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Inbound Directory Path
attributes.description: The directory path on the SFTP server where Consumer Goods retrieves inbound EDI files from the trading partner.

attributes.name: sftp_directory_outbound
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Outbound Directory Path
attributes.description: The directory path on the SFTP server where Consumer Goods deposits outbound EDI files for the trading partner to retrieve.

attributes.name: sftp_host
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Host Address
attributes.description: The SFTP server hostname or IP address used for file-based EDI exchange when SFTP protocol is in use.

attributes.name: sftp_port
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Port Number
attributes.description: The TCP port number used for SFTP connections (typically 22).

attributes.name: sftp_username
attributes.description: The username credential used to authenticate to the trading partner SFTP server.

attributes.name: transaction_set_810_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Consumer Goods sends 810 Invoice transaction sets to the trading partner for billing.

attributes.name: transaction_set_846_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory position data is exchanged via 846 Inventory Inquiry/Advice transaction sets for Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) programs.

attributes.name: transaction_set_850_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trading partner sends 850 Purchase Order transaction sets to Consumer Goods.

attributes.name: transaction_set_852_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transaction Set 852 Point of Sale (POS) Data Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trading partner sends 852 Product Activity Data (POS sales data) to Consumer Goods for demand sensing and replenishment.

attributes.name: transaction_set_855_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transaction Set 855 Purchase Order (PO) Acknowledgment Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Consumer Goods sends 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgment transaction sets back to the trading partner.

attributes.name: transaction_set_856_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transaction Set 856 Advanced Ship Notice (ASN) Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Consumer Goods sends 856 Advanced Ship Notice transaction sets to notify the trading partner of shipments.

attributes.name: transaction_set_867_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transaction Set 867 Product Transfer and Resale Report Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trading partner sends 867 Product Transfer and Resale Report transaction sets for secondary sales visibility (distributor to retailer).

attributes.name: transaction_set_997_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether 997 Functional Acknowledgment transaction sets are exchanged to confirm receipt and syntactic validation of EDI documents.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this EDI trading partner configuration record was last modified.

attributes.name: van_mailbox_code
attributes.description: The mailbox identifier assigned by the VAN provider for routing EDI documents to and from the trading partner.

attributes.name: van_provider
attributes.description: The name of the Value-Added Network provider facilitating EDI exchange (e.g., SPS Commerce, TrueCommerce, Cleo) when VAN protocol is in use.

products.name: customer_vmi_agreement
products.description: Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement between the CPG manufacturer and a trade account. Captures VMI program type (full VMI, CMI/Co-Managed Inventory, consignment), covered SKU scope, min/max inventory targets by location, replenishment frequency, lead time commitments, forecast sharing cadence, VMI start/end dates, responsible demand planner, and performance SLA thresholds (fill rate %, OTIF %, weeks of supply targets). Links to trade_account and drives automated replenishment triggers in SAP IBP or similar APS systems.
products.reference: SAP IBP VMI; VMI Industry Standard

attributes.name: customer_vmi_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) Agreement ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the VMI agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_customer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturer employee (demand planner or supply planner) responsible for managing this VMI agreement and executing replenishment decisions.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: VMI program execution requires linking each customer VMI agreement to the supplying vendor for inventory replenishment planning.

attributes.name: tertiary_customer_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who last modified this VMI agreement record. Supports audit and accountability.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice operator) participating in this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the VMI agreement, used in communications with the trade partner and in SAP IBP or APS systems.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VMI agreement: draft (being negotiated), pending approval (awaiting sign-off), active (in force), suspended (temporarily paused), terminated (ended early), or expired (reached end date).

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VMI agreement automatically renews at the end of the term (True) or requires explicit renegotiation (False).

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the signed legal contract document stored in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault, SharePoint).

attributes.name: covered_sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct SKUs included in the VMI agreement scope. Used for agreement complexity assessment and system configuration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMI agreement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this VMI agreement (penalties, inventory valuation, etc.).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the VMI agreement expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended agreements with auto-renewal clauses.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the VMI agreement becomes binding and replenishment responsibilities transfer to the manufacturer.

attributes.name: forecast_sharing_cadence
attributes.description: Frequency at which the trade account shares demand forecasts, POS data, or promotional plans with the manufacturer to support VMI planning.

attributes.name: inventory_ownership_model
attributes.description: Defines who owns the inventory at the trade account location: customer-owned (traditional), supplier-owned consignment (ownership transfers at sale), shared risk, or pay-on-scan (ownership transfers at POS scan).

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to value inventory under this VMI agreement: FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), weighted average, or standard cost.

attributes.name: inventory_visibility_method
attributes.description: Technical method by which the manufacturer receives inventory position data from the trade account: EDI 846 (inventory inquiry/advice), API integration, web portal access, manual reports, WMS integration, or none.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMI agreement record was last updated. Tracks changes to terms, status, or configuration.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review meeting or report for this VMI agreement. Used to track review compliance.

attributes.name: max_inventory_weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Maximum inventory target expressed as weeks of supply. Replenishment orders are sized to bring inventory to this level without exceeding it.

attributes.name: min_inventory_weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Minimum inventory target expressed as weeks of supply (demand coverage). Triggers replenishment when inventory falls below this threshold.

attributes.name: next_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal performance review meeting or report. Drives calendar reminders and preparation workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special terms, exceptions, or operational instructions specific to this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: order_transmission_method
attributes.description: Method by which replenishment orders are transmitted to the trade account or their systems: EDI 850 (purchase order), API, web portal, email, fax, or manual entry.

attributes.name: penalty_amount_per_incident
attributes.description: Fixed financial penalty amount charged per SLA violation incident (e.g., per OOS event, per late delivery). Expressed in the agreement currency.

attributes.name: penalty_clause_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VMI agreement includes financial penalties or chargebacks for SLA violations (e.g., missed OTIF targets, excess OOS incidents).

attributes.name: performance_review_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the manufacturer and trade account conduct formal performance reviews of VMI metrics (fill rate, OTIF, inventory turns, OOS incidents).

attributes.name: pos_data_sharing_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Data Sharing Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trade account shares real-time or near-real-time POS (point of sale) data with the manufacturer to improve demand sensing accuracy.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required before the end date to trigger renewal or termination discussions. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days.

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the manufacturer reviews inventory levels and triggers replenishment orders: daily, twice weekly, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, on-demand (event-driven), or continuous (real-time). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|twice_weekly|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|on_demand|continuous — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Committed lead time in days from replenishment order creation to delivery at the trade account location. Used for min/max inventory calculations.

attributes.name: safety_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Buffer inventory expressed as weeks of supply to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Included in min inventory calculations.

attributes.name: sku_scope_type
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of SKU coverage in the VMI agreement: all SKUs, specific product category, specific brand, explicit SKU list, or custom selection criteria.

attributes.name: sla_target_fill_rate_percent
