attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Fill Rate Percent
attributes.description: Contractual target for order fill rate (percentage of ordered quantity delivered) that the manufacturer commits to achieve under this VMI agreement. Typically 95-99%.

attributes.name: sla_target_oos_incidents_per_month
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Out of Stock (OOS) Incidents Per Month
attributes.description: Maximum allowable number of out-of-stock incidents per month at the trade account location under this VMI agreement. Exceeding this triggers penalty or review clauses.

attributes.name: sla_target_otif_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target On Time In Full (OTIF) Percent
attributes.description: Contractual target for OTIF (On Time In Full) delivery performance that the manufacturer commits to achieve. Measures both timeliness and completeness of deliveries.

attributes.name: trade_partner_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary trade account contact for VMI communications, forecast sharing, and issue escalation.

attributes.name: trade_partner_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the trade account responsible for VMI coordination and issue resolution.

attributes.name: trade_partner_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary trade account contact for urgent VMI issues and escalations.

attributes.name: vmi_program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VMI program model: full VMI (supplier owns inventory decisions), CMI/Co-Managed Inventory (collaborative), consignment (supplier owns inventory until sale), supplier-managed replenishment, continuous replenishment, or vendor-owned inventory.

products.name: account_sla
products.description: Service Level Agreement terms defined for a trade account, covering order fulfillment, delivery, and service commitments. Captures SLA type (OTIF, fill rate, lead time, invoice accuracy, claims resolution), target metric value, measurement period, penalty/incentive terms, effective date range, SLA tier (gold, silver, bronze), and owning commercial team. Distinct from VMI agreements — covers the full commercial service commitment beyond inventory replenishment.
products.reference: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Service Level

attributes.name: account_sla_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account service level agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for SLA ownership tracking; SLA records must reference the employee managing the account.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice customer) to which this SLA applies.

attributes.name: account_sla_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA. Draft indicates pending approval; active indicates in force; suspended indicates temporarily paused; expired indicates end date reached; terminated indicates early cancellation; under review indicates renegotiation in progress.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved this SLA. Typically a commercial director or senior account executive. Nullable for draft or unapproved SLAs.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA was formally approved and moved to active status. Nullable for draft or unapproved SLAs.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA automatically renews at the end of the effective period (True) or requires explicit renegotiation (False).

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the master commercial contract or trading agreement under which this SLA is governed. Links SLA to broader contractual framework.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record inception.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for penalty and incentive amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date when the SLA terms become binding and performance measurement begins.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the SLA terms expire or are scheduled to end. Nullable for open-ended agreements subject to termination notice.

attributes.name: escalation_procedure
attributes.description: Description of the process and contacts for escalating SLA breaches or disputes. Includes escalation levels, response times, and resolution authority.

attributes.name: exclusion_conditions
attributes.description: Description of circumstances under which SLA performance measurement is suspended or penalties waived (e.g., force majeure, natural disasters, customer-caused delays, system outages).

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of incentive per occurrence or per measurement period when SLA target is exceeded. Nullable if incentive is non-monetary or variable.

attributes.name: incentive_terms
attributes.description: Description of rewards or bonuses provided when performance exceeds the target. May include volume bonuses, preferred status, or co-investment in joint initiatives.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this SLA record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: measurement_period
attributes.description: Time window over which SLA performance is calculated and reported. Rolling periods provide continuous assessment; fixed periods align with calendar or fiscal cycles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|rolling_30_days|rolling_90_days — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: minimum_performance_threshold
attributes.description: Lowest acceptable performance level before penalties or escalation are triggered. Typically set below the target to allow for minor variance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal SLA review meeting or renegotiation session.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special terms, historical amendments, or operational guidance related to this SLA.

attributes.name: owning_team
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal commercial, sales, or customer service team responsible for managing this SLA and the account relationship.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of penalty per occurrence or per measurement period when SLA is breached. Nullable if penalty is non-monetary or variable.

attributes.name: penalty_terms
attributes.description: Description of financial or commercial penalties applied when performance falls below the minimum threshold. May include rebates, credits, discounts, or service recovery actions.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which SLA performance reports are generated and shared with the account. On-demand indicates ad-hoc reporting upon request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|biweekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|on_demand — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the SLA terms are formally reviewed and potentially renegotiated with the account. As-needed indicates event-driven reviews.

attributes.name: sla_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the SLA. Externally-known unique code used in contracts and commercial communications.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service tier classification indicating the level of commitment and priority. Higher tiers typically receive more favorable terms, faster response, and stricter performance guarantees.

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Category of service level commitment. OTIF (On Time In Full) measures delivery timeliness and completeness; fill rate measures order fulfillment percentage; lead time measures order-to-delivery duration; invoice accuracy measures billing correctness; claims resolution measures dispute handling speed; order accuracy measures picking/shipping correctness.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this SLA record originated (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP SD, Oracle Cloud ERP).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this SLA record in the source operational system. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: target_metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target metric value. Percentage for rate-based metrics (OTIF, fill rate, accuracy); days or hours for time-based metrics (lead time, resolution time); count for volume-based metrics; ratio for comparative metrics.

attributes.name: target_metric_value
attributes.description: Quantitative performance target that must be achieved. For OTIF this is percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95%); for lead time this is days; for fill rate this is percentage; for invoice accuracy this is percentage; for claims resolution this is days.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the SLA before the effective end date.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this SLA record. Audit trail for accountability.

products.name: account_segment
products.description: Commercial segmentation, channel classification taxonomy, and go-to-market tier assignment for trade accounts. Owns the complete channel reference hierarchy (primary: retail, foodservice, wholesale, DTC; secondary: grocery, mass, club, drug, convenience, e-commerce, QSR, institutional) as well as the commercial segment assignment (strategic, key account, regional, emerging, tail). Captures channel code, channel name, channel tier, segmentation model version, customer tier, strategic priority flag, assigned sales region, applicable region, active status, and effective date range. Drives trade promotion allocation, field sales call frequency, and standardized channel reporting across all downstream domains.
products.reference: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Segmentation

attributes.name: account_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account segment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consumer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_consumer_segment. Business justification: Account segmentation aligns with marketing consumer segment definitions; the link supports segment‑based campaign targeting and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: primary_account_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that assigned this segment classification.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice customer) to which this segmentation applies.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account segment assignment is currently active and in use for commercial operations.

attributes.name: acv_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification based on All Commodity Volume, representing the total retail sales volume of the account across all product categories.

attributes.name: applicable_region
attributes.description: Geographic region where this segmentation applies (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment assignment was formally approved.

attributes.name: assigned_sales_region
attributes.description: Sales region or territory to which this account segment is assigned for field sales coverage and quota allocation.

attributes.name: channel_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier assignment within the channel, indicating relative importance or volume contribution (tier_1 = highest, tier_4 = lowest).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account segment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_tier
attributes.description: Credit limit tier classification for accounts in this segment, determining maximum outstanding receivables allowed.

attributes.name: customer_tier
attributes.description: Customer value tier assignment based on revenue, volume, or strategic importance (platinum = highest value, standard = baseline).

attributes.name: dsd_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is eligible for Direct Store Delivery, bypassing distribution centers for direct product delivery to retail locations.

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Trading Partner Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is configured as an EDI trading partner for automated order and invoice exchange.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this account segment assignment expires or is superseded by a new assignment. Null indicates open-ended assignment.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this account segment assignment becomes effective and applicable for business operations.

attributes.name: field_sales_call_frequency
attributes.description: Recommended frequency of field sales representative visits based on account segment and strategic priority.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account segment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this account segment assignment was last reviewed and validated by commercial leadership.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this account segment assignment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this account segment assignment, capturing additional context or special considerations.

attributes.name: otif_sla_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage for On Time In Full delivery performance as defined in the service level agreement for this account segment.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code applicable to this account segment (e.g., NET30, NET60, COD).

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Pricing strategy applicable to this account segment (EDLP = Everyday Low Price, Hi-Lo = High-Low promotional pricing).

attributes.name: primary_channel_code
attributes.description: Code representing the primary channel classification (e.g., RETAIL, FOODSERVICE, WHOLESALE, DTC).

attributes.name: primary_channel_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary channel (e.g., Retail, Foodservice, Wholesale, Direct to Consumer).

attributes.name: secondary_channel_code
attributes.description: Code representing the secondary channel sub-classification (e.g., GROCERY, MASS, CLUB, DRUG, CONVENIENCE, ECOMMERCE, QSR, INSTITUTIONAL).

attributes.name: secondary_channel_name
attributes.description: Full name of the secondary channel sub-classification (e.g., Grocery, Mass Merchandiser, Club, Drug, Convenience Store, E-Commerce, Quick Service Restaurant, Institutional).

attributes.name: segment_assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale or trigger for this segment assignment (e.g., annual review, volume threshold met, strategic partnership established).

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the commercial segment assignment (e.g., STRATEGIC, KEY_ACCT, REGIONAL, EMERGING, TAIL).

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the commercial segment (e.g., Strategic Account, Key Account, Regional Account, Emerging Account, Tail Account).

attributes.name: segmentation_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the segmentation model or algorithm used to assign this segment (e.g., 2024.Q1, V3.2).

attributes.name: strategic_priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is designated as a strategic priority for executive engagement and resource allocation.

attributes.name: tdp_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification based on Total Distribution Points, representing the weighted distribution reach of the account.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_eligibility
attributes.description: Eligibility status for trade promotion programs and funding allocation based on segment classification.

attributes.name: vmi_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is eligible for Vendor Managed Inventory programs where the supplier manages inventory replenishment.

products.name: account_assortment
products.description: Authorized product assortment (range) agreed between the CPG manufacturer and a trade account or retail banner. Captures the list of authorized SKUs/GTINs, assortment type (core range, seasonal, promotional, new item), listing status (listed, delisted, pending), listing date, delist date, minimum order quantity (MOQ), and planogram slot count. Supports OSA monitoring, new item launch tracking, and distribution gap analysis via TradeEdge.
products.reference: TradeEdge Channel Visibility; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: account_assortment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account assortment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: authorized_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Assortment Authorization audit requires linking the approving employee to each assortment entry.

attributes.name: packaging_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_profile. Business justification: Packaging decisions for each assortment reference packaging_profile to ensure recyclability, material compliance, and regulatory packaging standards.

attributes.name: product_lca_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.product_lca. Business justification: Assortment planning uses product LCA data to select SKUs that meet carbon‑footprint and water‑footprint targets.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Assortment Planning Report requires linking each assortment record to the originating R&D project that defined the SKU, enabling traceability from market launch back to development.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (SKU) included in this assortment agreement.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice operator) for which this assortment is defined.

attributes.name: assortment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assortment item. Core range items are permanent listings; seasonal items are time-bound; promotional items support trade promotions; new items are recent launches; limited edition items are short-run offerings; test market items are regional trials.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: The date when this assortment listing was formally authorized or approved. Used for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: authorized_distribution_points
attributes.description: The number of store locations or distribution points within the account where this SKU is authorized for sale. Used for TDP and ACV calculations.

attributes.name: category_role
attributes.description: The strategic role this SKU plays in the category assortment. Destination items drive traffic; routine items are everyday purchases; occasional items are infrequent buys; convenience items are impulse purchases.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier of the trade agreement or contract that governs this assortment. Links to master trade agreement documentation.

attributes.name: delist_date
attributes.description: The date when the product was or will be removed from the authorized assortment. Null for active listings. Used for OSA monitoring and distribution gap analysis.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is delivered via direct store delivery to this account. True if DSD; false if warehouse delivery.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this assortment record expires. Null for open-ended core range items. Used for seasonal and promotional assortments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this assortment record becomes effective. Used for seasonal and promotional assortments with defined start dates.

attributes.name: exclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is exclusive to this account (not available to other retailers). True if exclusive; false if non-exclusive.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The GS1 Global Trade Item Number for the product in this assortment. May be GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when an order was placed for this SKU by this account. Used for distribution gap analysis and OSA monitoring.

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this SKU was shipped to this account. Used for on-time in-full (OTIF) tracking and distribution monitoring.

attributes.name: launch_wave
attributes.description: The launch wave or phase identifier for new item introductions. Used to track rollout progress and coordinate new item launch activities.

attributes.name: listing_date
attributes.description: The date when the product was first authorized for sale to this account. Marks the start of the assortment agreement for this SKU.

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the product listing with the account. Listed indicates active authorization; delisted indicates removal from assortment; pending indicates approval in progress; suspended indicates temporary hold; discontinued indicates permanent removal.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity agreed between the manufacturer and the account for this SKU. Expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: moq_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the minimum order quantity. Defines whether MOQ is expressed in eaches, cases, pallets, layers, or inner packs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this assortment listing. May include special handling instructions, promotional details, or account-specific requirements.

attributes.name: planogram_slot_count
attributes.description: The number of shelf facings or slots allocated to this SKU in the retailers planogram. Used for on-shelf availability (OSA) monitoring and space management analysis.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this SKU within the accounts assortment. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for allocation and supply planning decisions.

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assortment item is part of a trade promotion or promotional event. True if promotional; false if regular assortment.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this assortment record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this assortment record was last updated in the lakehouse. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this assortment record originated. Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud for retail execution; TradeEdge for channel visibility; SAP SD for sales distribution; Oracle SCM for supply chain; manual entry for ad-hoc records.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this assortment record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: vmi_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is eligible for vendor managed inventory replenishment with this account. True if VMI-eligible; false otherwise.

products.name: account_credit_profile
products.description: Credit and financial risk profile for a trade account, capturing credit limit, current credit exposure, credit rating (internal and external), payment terms (net 30, net 60, COD), DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) target, credit hold status, credit review date, credit insurance coverage, and credit analyst notes. Managed in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR and used for order release decisions and financial risk management.

attributes.name: account_credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account credit profile record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the credit analyst responsible for managing this account's credit profile and conducting credit reviews.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice customer) to which this credit profile applies.

attributes.name: available_credit_amount
attributes.description: Remaining credit capacity available for new orders, calculated as credit limit minus current exposure. Used for order release decisions.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the account filed for bankruptcy. Null if no bankruptcy filing exists.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account has filed for bankruptcy or is in bankruptcy proceedings. True = bankruptcy status, False = no bankruptcy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_analyst_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the credit analyst documenting credit decisions, risk factors, payment behavior, disputes, and other relevant credit management information.

attributes.name: credit_hold_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit hold was placed on this account. Null if no hold is currently active.

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for credit hold (e.g., OVERLIMIT = exceeded credit limit, PASTDUE = overdue invoices, DISPUTE = payment dispute, BANKRUPTCY = customer bankruptcy filing).

attributes.name: credit_hold_status
attributes.description: Current credit hold status for this account. Active = credit hold in effect, orders blocked; Released = no hold, orders allowed; Manual Review = requires credit analyst approval; Blocked = permanently blocked.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum insured amount under the trade credit insurance policy for this account. Null if no insurance coverage exists.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is covered by trade credit insurance. True = covered, False = not covered.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the trade credit insurance covering this account. Null if no insurance coverage exists.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the trade credit insurance provider (e.g., Euler Hermes, Atradius, Coface). Null if no insurance coverage exists.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure authorized for this trade account, expressed in the account's functional currency. Approved by credit management and reviewed periodically.

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the credit limit amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: credit_limit_override_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date for a temporary credit limit override. After this date, the credit limit reverts to the standard amount. Null if no override is active.

attributes.name: credit_limit_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit limit has been manually overridden by credit management (e.g., temporary increase for seasonal demand). True = override active, False = standard limit.

attributes.name: credit_limit_override_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the credit limit override (e.g., 'Seasonal demand increase for Q4 holiday period', 'Strategic account expansion').

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent credit review for this account. Credit reviews are typically conducted annually or triggered by significant events (payment default, financial distress).

attributes.name: current_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Current outstanding receivables balance for this account, including open invoices, unbilled deliveries, and pending orders. Updated in real-time from SAP FI-AR.

attributes.name: dso_actual_days
attributes.description: Actual DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) for this account over the trailing 90-day period, calculated as (Average Accounts Receivable / Revenue) × Number of Days.

attributes.name: dso_target_days
attributes.description: Target DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) for this account, representing the expected number of days to collect payment. Used for performance monitoring and credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning level (collection escalation stage) for this account. 0 = no dunning, 1-9 = escalating collection actions. Higher levels indicate more aggressive collection efforts.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this credit profile became effective. Used for historical tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this credit profile expires or was superseded by a new profile. Null for the current active profile.

attributes.name: external_credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating from external credit bureau or rating agency (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX score, Experian rating). Format varies by provider.

attributes.name: external_credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score from external credit bureau (e.g., PAYDEX score 0-100, FICO commercial score). Higher scores indicate lower risk.

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit rating assigned by the company's credit analysts based on payment history, financial strength, and business relationship. Scale: AAA (highest) to D (default). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent dunning notice (collection letter) sent to this account. Null if no dunning has occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this credit profile record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic credit review. Used for credit management workflow and compliance with internal credit policy.

attributes.name: payment_method_preference
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for this account. ACH = Automated Clearing House, Wire = wire transfer, Check = paper check, EDI = Electronic Data Interchange payment, Credit Card = corporate credit card.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30, COD). Maps to SAP payment terms master.

attributes.name: payment_terms_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of payment terms (e.g., 'Net 30 days', 'Net 60 days', '2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30', 'Cash on Delivery').

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current status of this credit profile record. Active = currently in use, Inactive = historical/superseded, Suspended = temporarily disabled, Under Review = pending credit analyst review.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Overall financial risk classification for this account based on credit rating, payment history, exposure, and external factors. Low = minimal risk, Medium = moderate risk, High = elevated risk, Critical = severe risk.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this credit profile data originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI-AR, Oracle ERP Financials).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this credit profile record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

products.name: account_pricing_agreement
products.description: Negotiated pricing agreement between the CPG manufacturer and a trade account, defining the contracted price list, discount structure, and rebate terms for a defined period. Captures price list ID, pricing tier, base price, negotiated discount %, volume rebate thresholds, promotional allowance terms, EDLP vs. Hi-Lo pricing strategy, RSP/MSRP guidance, effective date range, and approval status. Managed in SAP S/4HANA SD condition records.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Records / Pricing Agreements

attributes.name: account_pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account pricing agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who most recently modified this pricing agreement record, establishing accountability for changes.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Sustainability‑linked pricing agreements tie discount tiers to the achievement of ESG commitment targets.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master price list that serves as the base for this agreement. The price list contains SKU-level pricing that may be further adjusted by discounts and rebates defined in this agreement.

attributes.name: primary_account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee ID of the account manager or key account manager responsible for this trade relationship and pricing agreement.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Pricing Agreement creation references the R&D project that established product cost and target RSP, essential for cost‑plus pricing calculations and audit trails.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B trade customer (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice account) that this pricing agreement applies to.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the pricing agreement, typically including the account name and agreement period for easy identification.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this pricing agreement, used in contracts and communications with the trade partner.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the pricing agreement. Draft agreements are being negotiated, pending approval agreements await internal authorization, active agreements are in force, suspended agreements are temporarily inactive, expired agreements have passed their end date, and terminated agreements have been cancelled before expiration.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing agreement structure. Standard agreements use fixed pricing, promotional agreements support temporary campaigns, volume-based agreements offer discounts based on purchase volume, tiered agreements have multiple pricing levels, custom agreements are negotiated individually, national account agreements cover enterprise-wide terms, and regional agreements apply to specific geographic areas. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|promotional|volume_based|tiered|custom|national_account|regional — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this pricing agreement. Tracks whether the negotiated terms have been reviewed and authorized by the appropriate internal stakeholders (pricing manager, sales director, finance).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pricing agreement received final approval and was authorized for activation.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement automatically renews at the end of the effective period. When true, the agreement extends for another term unless either party provides termination notice.

attributes.name: base_discount_percent
attributes.description: The negotiated base discount percentage applied to list prices for this account. This is the foundational discount before any volume rebates or promotional allowances.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pricing agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all pricing, discounts, and rebates in this agreement are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which products are sold under this agreement (e.g., retail, foodservice, wholesale, DTC). Different channels may have different pricing structures.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: The product division or business unit to which this pricing agreement applies (e.g., personal care, household products, health and wellness). Allows different divisions to maintain separate pricing agreements with the same account.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_percent
attributes.description: The discount percentage offered if the account pays invoices before the standard payment due date, incentivizing faster payment.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this pricing agreement expires and the negotiated terms are no longer valid. Nullable for open-ended agreements that remain active until explicitly terminated.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this pricing agreement becomes active and the negotiated terms take effect. Orders placed on or after this date are subject to these pricing conditions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pricing agreement record was most recently updated, tracking the latest change to any field.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity required per order or per SKU to qualify for the negotiated pricing terms. Ensures economical order sizes for manufacturing and logistics.

attributes.name: msrp_guidance_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Guidance Amount
attributes.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price for products covered by this agreement. Similar to RSP but typically used for durable goods and higher-value items.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special terms, negotiation context, exceptions, or other relevant information about this pricing agreement that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the invoice payment schedule and early payment discount terms for this agreement (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The pricing strategy model applied to this agreement. EDLP (Everyday Low Price) maintains consistent low prices, Hi-Lo (High-Low) uses regular price with frequent promotions, hybrid combines both approaches, cost-plus adds margin to cost, and market-based aligns with competitive market rates.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: The tier level assigned to this account within the pricing hierarchy, determining the base discount level. Higher tiers typically receive better pricing based on volume commitments, strategic importance, or relationship strength.

attributes.name: promotional_allowance_cap_amount
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount available for promotional allowances during the agreement period. Caps the total promotional funding regardless of purchase volume.

attributes.name: promotional_allowance_percent
attributes.description: The negotiated promotional allowance percentage that the account can apply toward trade promotions, displays, and marketing activities. This is a fund allocation for cooperative marketing efforts.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of days before the effective end date that either party must provide notice if they wish to terminate rather than renew the agreement.

attributes.name: rsp_guidance_amount
attributes.description: The manufacturer's recommended selling price guidance provided to the trade account for consumer-facing pricing. This is advisory and not binding, but helps maintain brand positioning and margin expectations.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: The sales organization responsible for managing this pricing agreement. In SAP S/4HANA, this determines the organizational unit that owns the customer relationship and pricing terms.

attributes.name: volume_rebate_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether volume-based rebates are active for this agreement. When true, the account qualifies for additional discounts based on purchase volume thresholds.

attributes.name: volume_rebate_percent_1
attributes.description: The additional rebate percentage applied when volume rebate threshold 1 is met or exceeded.

attributes.name: volume_rebate_percent_2
attributes.description: The additional rebate percentage applied when volume rebate threshold 2 is met or exceeded.

attributes.name: volume_rebate_percent_3
attributes.description: The additional rebate percentage applied when volume rebate threshold 3 is met or exceeded.

attributes.name: volume_rebate_threshold_1
attributes.description: The first volume threshold (in currency or units) that triggers an additional rebate percentage. Represents the minimum purchase volume required to qualify for the first tier of volume-based discounts.

attributes.name: volume_rebate_threshold_2
attributes.description: The second volume threshold that triggers a higher rebate percentage. Represents the purchase volume required to qualify for the second tier of volume-based discounts.

attributes.name: volume_rebate_threshold_3
attributes.description: The third volume threshold that triggers the highest rebate percentage. Represents the purchase volume required to qualify for the third tier of volume-based discounts.

products.name: account_status_history
products.description: Audit history of status changes for a trade account lifecycle, capturing each transition event: new, active, on-hold (credit hold, compliance hold), suspended, closed, reactivated. Records previous status, new status, change reason code, change date/time, changed by user, and supporting notes. Enables compliance audit trails and account lifecycle analytics without polluting the master trade_account record.

attributes.name: account_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each account status change event record. Primary key for the account status history audit trail.

attributes.name: primary_account_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person or automated process that initiated the status change. Critical for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Security and Access Control Policy

attributes.name: reversed_history_account_status_history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the original account_status_history record that this entry reverses or corrects. Null if this is not a reversal entry.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the trade account master record that this status change event applies to. Links the status history to the B2B customer account.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The business identifier of the trade account at the time of status change. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and historical reporting.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change required managerial or compliance approval before execution. True if approval workflow was triggered, false if change was auto-approved or did not require approval.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the status change was approved. Null if no approval was required or if change is pending approval.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the approver who authorized the status change. Denormalized for audit readability.
attributes.references: Internal Security and Access Control Policy

attributes.name: change_method
attributes.description: The method by which the status change was executed: manual user action, automated workflow, batch process, API call, or EDI transaction. Distinguishes human-initiated vs system-initiated changes.

attributes.name: change_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or application that originated the status change event (e.g., SAP_SD, SALESFORCE_CG_CLOUD, CREDIT_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM, EDI_GATEWAY). Used for traceability and system integration audit.

attributes.name: changed_by_user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who initiated the status change. Denormalized for audit readability and historical reporting when user records may be archived.
attributes.references: Internal Security and Access Control Policy

attributes.name: compliance_violation_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific compliance violation that triggered a compliance hold or suspension. Null if status change is not compliance-related.

attributes.name: credit_limit_at_change
attributes.description: The credit limit assigned to the trade account at the time of this status change. Captured for historical credit risk analysis and compliance audit. Expressed in the accounts base currency.

attributes.name: days_sales_outstanding_at_change
attributes.description: The DSO metric for the trade account at the time of status change. Measures average collection period and provides context for payment-related status transitions.

attributes.name: edi_control_number
attributes.description: The unique control number of the EDI transaction that triggered or communicated this status change. Used for EDI audit trail and reconciliation. Null for non-EDI status changes.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: The EDI transaction set code (e.g., 846 Inventory Inquiry, 997 Functional Acknowledgment) associated with this status change if the change was triggered by or communicated via EDI. Null for non-EDI status changes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date when the new status became active. May differ from the system change timestamp for backdated or scheduled status changes.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date when a hold status was or will be released. Used for temporary holds with defined resolution timelines. Null for permanent status changes or non-hold statuses.

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Specific classification of hold when the new status is a hold state. Distinguishes between credit holds, compliance holds, quality holds, legal holds, and payment holds. Null if status is not a hold state.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The status of the trade account after this change event. Captures the to-state in the account lifecycle transition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|active|on_hold|credit_hold|compliance_hold|suspended|closed|inactive — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, comments, or instructions related to the status change. Used by account managers and credit analysts to document special circumstances or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated notification (email, EDI message, or system alert) was sent to the trade account contact or internal stakeholders about this status change. True if notification was successfully dispatched.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the status change notification was sent. Null if no notification was sent or if notification failed.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_at_change
attributes.description: The total outstanding receivables balance for the trade account at the time of this status change. Provides financial context for credit-related status transitions. Expressed in the accounts base currency.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The status of the trade account immediately before this change event. Captures the from-state in the account lifecycle transition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|active|on_hold|credit_hold|compliance_hold|suspended|closed|inactive — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this audit record was first inserted into the account status history table. Distinct from status_change_timestamp which represents the business event time.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change event must be included in regulatory reporting submissions (e.g., SOX compliance, FDA audit trails, anti-money laundering reports). True if regulatory disclosure is required.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change record represents a reversal or correction of a previous status change. True if this is a corrective entry, false for normal status transitions.

attributes.name: sla_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change affects the accounts SLA terms or service level commitments. True if SLA metrics or obligations are modified by this status transition.

attributes.name: status_change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the status change (e.g., CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION, CUSTOMER_REQUEST, ACCOUNT_CLOSURE, REACTIVATION_APPROVED). Used for categorization and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: status_change_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of why the account status was changed. Provides context beyond the reason code for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the account status change was executed in the system. Primary business event timestamp for this audit record.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to supporting documentation for this status change (e.g., approval memo, compliance report, customer correspondence, legal notice). Used to link audit trail to source documents.

products.name: account_compliance_record
products.description: Regulatory and trade compliance records associated with a trade account, including licenses, certifications, and regulatory registrations required to conduct business. Captures compliance type (business license, food handler permit, alcohol license, import/export license, GDPR data processing agreement, CCPA opt-out record), issuing authority, license number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and document reference. Ensures the CPG manufacturer only transacts with compliant trade partners.
products.reference: FDA Trade Partner Compliance; GDPR Article 28 Processor Agreement

attributes.name: account_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account compliance record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Each compliance record must reference the specific regulatory obligation it satisfies, supporting the Compliance Obligation Tracking report used by legal and risk teams.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.environmental_permit. Business justification: Compliance records reference the specific environmental permit governing the account's operations for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: ESG compliance reporting links each compliance record to the relevant ESG commitment it satisfies.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires each account compliance record to be linked to the jurisdiction governing the obligation, enabling jurisdiction‑specific reporting and audits.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (retailer, distributor, wholesaler, or foodservice operator) to which this compliance record applies.

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Compliance verification reports must capture which employee performed the verification for each record.

attributes.name: compliance_scope
attributes.description: Describes the scope or coverage of the compliance record, such as specific product categories, geographic regions, or business activities covered by this license or certification.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance record. Indicates whether the license or certification is currently valid, expired, pending approval, suspended, or revoked.

attributes.name: compliance_type
attributes.description: The category of compliance or regulatory requirement. Defines the nature of the license, certification, or regulatory registration required to conduct business with this trade partner.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21, EPA Regulations, GDPR Article 28, CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI pointing to the scanned or digital copy of the compliance document stored in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault). Enables audit trail and verification.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Management, Internal Document Repository Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the compliance record becomes legally valid and enforceable. May differ from issue_date if there is a grace period or delayed activation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the license, permit, or certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Nullable for perpetual licenses. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the license, permit, or certification was originally issued by the regulatory authority. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The name of the governmental body, regulatory agency, or certification organization that issued the license or certification (e.g., FDA, EPA, State Department of Health, EU REACH).
attributes.references: FDA, EPA, CPSC, EU REACH, State and Local Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country in which the issuing authority operates (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: issuing_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or regional subdivision within the issuing country where the license or certification was granted. Relevant for jurisdictions with state-level regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this compliance record was successfully renewed. Nullable if never renewed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by the issuing authority for this license, permit, or certification. Used for verification and audit purposes.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards, FDA Registration, State Licensing Authorities

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, exceptions, or remarks related to this compliance record. Used for audit trail and internal communication.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent compliance notification (renewal reminder, expiry alert) was sent. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a renewal or expiry notification has been sent to the account or internal stakeholders. True if notification sent, False otherwise.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The overarching regulatory framework or legal standard under which this compliance record is governed (e.g., FDA CFR Title 21, EU REACH, GDPR, CCPA, ISO 22716).
attributes.references: FDA CFR, EU REACH, GDPR, CCPA, ISO Standards

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the license or certification must be renewed to avoid lapse. Used for proactive compliance monitoring and alerts. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of the renewal process for this compliance record. Tracks whether renewal is pending, submitted, approved, rejected, or overdue.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the business risk associated with non-compliance or lapse of this record. Critical risk indicates that business cannot be conducted without this compliance in place.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance record was last verified by internal compliance or legal teams. Used to track due diligence and audit readiness. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

products.name: order
products.description: Core sales order record capturing all commercial sales transactions across retail, wholesale, DTC, and e-commerce channels. Contains order header details (order number, date, channel type, status, delivery dates, OTIF status, payment terms, currency, totals, SAP SD document number) and line-level detail (SKU/GTIN, quantities ordered/confirmed/shipped, unit pricing, discounts, trade promotion references, line status, COGS, gross margin, delivery schedule). Serves as the primary transactional backbone of the sales domain enabling both order-level and SKU-level revenue and margin analysis.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the sales order record. Primary key for the order entity.

attributes.name: account_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer location that receives the invoice and is responsible for payment. May differ from ship-to location.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost Center Allocation report requires each sales order to be charged to a cost center for internal expense tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center assigned to fulfill this order. Determines inventory allocation and shipping origin.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this order. Used for authorization audit trail and approval workflow tracking.

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.pricing_agreement. Business justification: Orders are governed by a pricing agreement; linking captures contract context.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: Order‑level Promotion Event Attribution report requires linking each order to the specific promotion event that generated the sale.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Required for linking each sales order to the R&D project that created the product, enabling ROI and product launch performance reporting.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer location where goods should be delivered. May differ from bill-to location for multi-site customers.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager who created or owns this order. Used for commission calculation and SFA reporting.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Order Fulfillment Allocation report requires linking each order to the supply network node that will source inventory for accurate ATP/CTP calculations.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Directly assigning a territory to an order simplifies reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or retail account that placed this order. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the order was delivered to the customer. Used to calculate OTIF performance and delivery variance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the order was approved for fulfillment. Marks transition from draft/pending to confirmed status in the order lifecycle.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for order cancellation if status is cancelled. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which the order was received. Critical for channel-specific analytics and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: cogs_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of goods sold for all items on this order. Used for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by supply chain and logistics based on ATP/CTP availability. Committed date for OTIF tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on this order. Determines currency for pricing, tax, and totals.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the order including trade promotions, volume discounts, and negotiated price reductions.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which products are sold. Defines the route-to-market and channel-specific pricing rules.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: The product division or business unit for this order. Used for divisional P&L reporting and product line segmentation.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Freight and shipping charges applied to the order. May be customer-paid or supplier-absorbed depending on terms.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: Gross profit on the order calculated as total revenue less COGS. Key profitability metric for order-level margin analysis.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining the transfer of risk and cost responsibility between buyer and seller. Examples: FOB, CIF, DDP.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The date when the sales order was placed or created by the customer. Primary business event timestamp for order lifecycle.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the sales order. Used for customer communication and order tracking across systems.

attributes.name: order_source
attributes.description: The system or channel through which the order was originally captured. Used for channel attribution and system integration tracking.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sales order indicating its position in the order-to-cash workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|confirmed|in_fulfillment|shipped|delivered|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order based on fulfillment method and business process. Determines routing, pricing, and delivery rules.

attributes.name: otif_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order was delivered on time and in full per customer commitment. Key supply chain KPI for customer service measurement.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the credit period and discount conditions for this order. Examples: NET30, 2/10NET30.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority classification for order fulfillment. Determines sequencing in warehouse picking and expedited shipping eligibility.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The customers purchase order number provided at order placement. Required for EDI transactions and invoice matching.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date requested by the customer at the time of order placement. Used for OTIF performance measurement.

attributes.name: sales_office
attributes.description: The sales office or branch that originated this order. Used for territory management and sales force performance tracking.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: The sales organization responsible for this order. Defines the selling entity and organizational hierarchy for reporting.

attributes.name: sap_sd_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Document Number
attributes.description: The native SAP SD sales order document number. Used for system-to-system integration and ERP traceability.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: The transportation mode selected for order delivery. Impacts delivery time, cost, and carrier selection.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for customer-specific delivery instructions, packaging requirements, or handling notes for warehouse and logistics teams.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, discounts, and freight charges. Base revenue amount for the order.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the order including sales tax, VAT, GST, and other applicable taxes per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for the order including subtotal, taxes, freight, less discounts. The invoiced amount for revenue recognition.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Commercial billing document issued to retail accounts, distributors, or DTC consumers upon order fulfillment. Contains invoice header (invoice number, date, billing type, payment terms, gross/net values, tax, currency, payment status, DSO tracking, EDI status) and line-level detail (SKU/GTIN, billed quantities, unit prices, trade discounts, net line values, tax codes, revenue recognition categories, COGS allocation). Links to the originating sales order and serves as the accounts receivable source record enabling SKU-level revenue and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing address location for this invoice. The address where invoice is sent and payment is remitted from.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Financial consolidation needs each invoice posted to the responsible cost center for accurate profit analysis.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Invoice generation audit needs the employee responsible for creating the invoice to satisfy financial controls.

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.pricing_agreement. Business justification: Invoice billing often follows a pricing agreement; linking provides traceability.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Financial reconciliation links each invoice to the specific production order that produced the sold goods, supporting cost of goods sold analysis.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: Invoice‑level trade spend reconciliation needs to reference the promotion event responsible for the invoiced sales.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical delivery location where goods were shipped. May differ from bill-to account for multi-site customers.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order that this invoice fulfills. Links invoice to order for order-to-cash reconciliation.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail account, distributor, or DTC consumer who is billed on this invoice. The sold-to party in the order-to-cash process.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this invoice. Used for period-based billing and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this invoice. Relevant for subscription, service, or recurring billing scenarios.

attributes.name: billing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type: standard invoice for goods/services, credit memo for returns/adjustments, debit memo for additional charges, proforma for advance notice, intercompany for internal transfers, or consignment for stock-based billing.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was cancelled or voided. Null for active invoices. Used for cancelled invoice reporting and audit.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold_amount
attributes.description: Total standard cost of all products billed on this invoice. Used for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis at invoice level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the billing system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All monetary amounts on this invoice are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: days_sales_outstanding
attributes.description: Number of days between invoice date and payment date (or current date if unpaid). Key metric for working capital management and customer payment behavior analysis.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the customer has raised a dispute or deduction claim against this invoice. Triggers collections hold and dispute resolution workflow.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the reason for invoice dispute. Enables root cause analysis of deductions and customer dissatisfaction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pricing|quantity|quality|delivery|promotion|damaged_goods|not_received — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: Code representing the distribution channel through which the sale was made (e.g., retail, wholesale, DTC, e-commerce). Enables channel-specific revenue analysis.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product division or business unit to which invoice revenue is attributed. Supports divisional P&L reporting.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is expected per the agreed payment terms. Used for DSO tracking and collections management.

attributes.name: edi_document_number
attributes.description: Unique EDI transaction control number assigned when invoice is transmitted via EDI 810. Used for EDI audit trail and error resolution.

attributes.name: edi_transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of EDI 810 invoice transmission to customer's system. Tracks electronic invoice delivery for large retail and distributor accounts.

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total freight, shipping, and logistics charges added to the invoice. May be separately itemized for customer transparency.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice value before any deductions, including all line items, charges, and fees but before trade discounts and taxes.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: Gross profit on this invoice, calculated as net_amount minus cost_of_goods_sold_amount. Key profitability metric for customer and product analysis.

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining the division of costs and risks between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Critical for international trade invoicing.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was officially issued to the customer. This is the accounting date used for revenue recognition and aging calculations.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique invoice document number used for customer communication, payment reconciliation, and accounts receivable tracking. Typically follows company-specific numbering scheme.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current state of the invoice in the accounts receivable lifecycle. Tracks progression from draft through payment completion or dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|sent|partially_paid|paid|overdue|cancelled|disputed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this invoice record. Tracks changes for audit and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice total after all discounts, charges, and taxes. This is the amount due from the customer and recorded in accounts receivable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for special instructions, billing notes, dispute comments, or customer-specific messaging that appears on the invoice document.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice. Calculated as net_amount minus paid_amount. Used for aging analysis and collections prioritization.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount received against this invoice across all payment transactions. Used to calculate outstanding balance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used (or expected) for settling this invoice. Influences payment processing and reconciliation workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire_transfer|ach|check|credit_card|edi_payment|cash|direct_debit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number provided by the customer or payment processor for reconciliation. Links invoice to bank statement or remittance advice.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment settlement status indicating whether the invoice has been paid in full, partially, or remains outstanding.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard code representing the payment terms agreement (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Determines due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
