attributes.description: Customer's purchase order number that authorized this invoice. Required for PO-based invoicing and three-way match reconciliation.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_category
attributes.description: Classification determining how revenue from this invoice is recognized per accounting standards (ASC 606 / IFRS 15). Drives financial reporting and revenue allocation logic.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales organization unit responsible for this invoice. Used for revenue attribution and sales performance reporting.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all tax amounts (sales tax, VAT, GST, excise) applied to the invoice. Calculated based on tax jurisdiction and product tax classification.

attributes.name: trade_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total trade promotion discounts, volume rebates, and negotiated price reductions applied at invoice level. Reduces gross amount to arrive at net taxable amount.

products.name: pricing_agreement
products.description: Contractual pricing arrangement established with a retail account, distributor, or wholesale customer defining agreed RSP/MSRP, net pricing, volume-based tiered discounts, promotional allowances, and rebate structures. Captures agreement number, effective start/end dates, pricing tier, base list price, contracted net price, volume thresholds, rebate percentage, payment terms, currency, and approval status. Source of truth for customer-specific pricing in SAP SD condition records.
products.reference: SAP SD Condition Record / Pricing Agreement

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pricing agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pricing agreement approvals must be signed off by a specific employee for regulatory and pricing governance.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: ESG‑linked pricing agreements require a FK to the relevant ESG commitment for compliance reporting and contract enforcement.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_hierarchy. Business justification: Pricing agreements are defined per product hierarchy to set prices for all SKUs within that hierarchy; essential for price‑setting reports.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Pricing agreements are negotiated per brand for trade accounts; brand-level pricing is required for contract management.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Associates pricing agreements with the originating R&D project to manage cost‑plus pricing and profitability per development project.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail account, distributor, or wholesale customer with whom this pricing agreement is established.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the pricing agreement for business reference and reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the pricing agreement, used in contracts and SAP SD condition records.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing agreement structure: standard pricing, volume-based tiered discounts, promotional allowances, rebate structures, long-term contract, or spot pricing.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status indicating whether the pricing agreement has been reviewed and authorized by management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager or executive who approved the pricing agreement.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the pricing agreement was formally approved by authorized personnel.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pricing agreement automatically renews upon expiration unless terminated by either party.

attributes.name: base_list_price
attributes.description: Standard manufacturer list price before any discounts, allowances, or negotiated reductions are applied.

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the legal contract document or master agreement associated with this pricing agreement.

attributes.name: contracted_net_price
attributes.description: Agreed net price per unit after applying all negotiated discounts and allowances as defined in the pricing agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pricing agreement record was first created in the system.

products.description: Point-of-sale sell-through transaction representing consumer purchases at retail outlets, capturing secondary sales (offtake) data sourced from syndicated data providers (Nielsen IQ, IRI/Circana), retailer EDI/portal feeds, or TradeEdge. Enables demand sensing, on-shelf availability (OSA) monitoring, ACV/TDP/SOM metric computation, and retailer scorecard reporting. Granularity varies by source from store-day-SKU to week-account-SKU.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the point-of-sale transaction record. Primary key for the POS transaction entity.

attributes.name: cashier_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: POS transactions record the cashier employee for labor tracking, shift reporting, and audit of sales.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific retail store or outlet where the consumer purchase occurred.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product sold in this transaction. Links to the product master.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail account or customer where the transaction occurred. Links to the trade account master.

attributes.name: acv_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store is included in the All Commodity Volume (ACV) universe for weighted distribution calculations. Used for Total Distribution Points (TDP) and ACV metrics.

attributes.name: baseline_sales_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction represents baseline (non-promotional) sales. Used to separate baseline from incremental promotional volume in Trade Promotion Management (TPM) analysis.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The retail channel classification where the transaction occurred (e.g., Grocery, Mass Merchandiser, Drug, Convenience, Club, Dollar, Online, Specialty). Used for channel performance analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grocery|mass_merchandiser|drug|convenience|club|dollar|online|specialty — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction monetary values.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A quality score (0-100) assigned to the transaction record based on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the source data. Used for data reliability assessment.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or provider from which the POS transaction data was obtained (e.g., Nielsen IQ, IRI/Circana, Retailer EDI, Retailer Portal, TradeEdge, Internal).

attributes.name: data_source_file_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the source data file or feed from which this transaction record was extracted. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied to this transaction due to promotional activity. Used for promotional effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: The 13-digit European Article Number identifying the product. International standard barcode identifier.

attributes.name: extended_retail_value
attributes.description: The total retail sales value for this transaction line (units sold multiplied by retail selling price). Core metric for revenue and market share analysis.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14) identifying the product sold. Standardized product identifier for cross-retailer analysis.

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: The designated market area or geographic market classification for the store location. Used for market-level Share of Market (SOM) analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, annotations, or data quality observations related to the transaction record.

attributes.name: out_of_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an out-of-stock condition was detected at the store during the transaction period. Used for On-Shelf Availability (OSA) monitoring.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the POS transaction record was processed and loaded into the lakehouse silver layer. Used for data pipeline monitoring.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the product as provided by the data source. May include brand, variant, and size information.

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: The type of promotional activity applied to this transaction (e.g., Temporary Price Reduction, Multi-Buy, Coupon, Loyalty Discount, Clearance).

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product was sold under a promotional offer or trade promotion at the time of transaction. Used for Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) analysis.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the POS transaction data was received from the source system or data provider. Used for data latency monitoring.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The granularity or aggregation period of the POS data as provided by the source (e.g., Daily, Weekly, Monthly). Varies by syndicated data provider.

attributes.name: retail_selling_price
attributes.description: The per-unit retail price at which the product was sold to the consumer. Used for price compliance monitoring against Recommended Selling Price (RSP) and Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP).

attributes.name: retailer_name
attributes.description: The name of the retail chain or banner where the transaction occurred. Used for retailer scorecard reporting.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The retailer-specific Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the product variant sold. May differ from manufacturer SKU.

attributes.name: store_city
attributes.description: The city where the retail store is located. Used for geographic sales analysis.

attributes.name: store_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the retail store is located.

attributes.name: store_format
attributes.description: The format or size classification of the retail store (e.g., Superstore, Supermarket, Small Format, Express). Used for format-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: store_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the specific retail store location where the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: store_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the retail store location. Used for micro-market analysis.

attributes.name: store_state_province
attributes.description: The state or province where the retail store is located. Used for regional sales analysis.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when the consumer purchase transaction occurred at the retail outlet. Primary business event date for demand sensing and On-Shelf Availability (OSA) monitoring.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or receipt number for the point-of-sale transaction as provided by the data source.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the consumer purchase transaction was recorded at the point of sale.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity sold (e.g., Each, Case, Pack, Box, Dozen, Pound, Kilogram). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|BX|DZ|LB|KG|OZ|ML|LT|GL — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: The quantity of product units sold in this transaction. Core metric for demand sensing and sell-through analysis.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit Universal Product Code scanned at the point of sale. North American standard barcode identifier.

attributes.name: week_ending_date
attributes.description: The Saturday date marking the end of the reporting week for weekly aggregated POS data. Standard for Nielsen IQ and IRI/Circana weekly reporting.

products.name: return_order
products.description: Sales return authorization and credit memo request capturing product returns from retail accounts, distributors, or DTC consumers. Records return authorization number, return reason code (damaged in transit/expired/shelf-life rejection/overstock/quality defect/wrong item shipped/recall), return date, originating order reference, returned SKU/GTIN, returned quantity, return value, restocking fee if applicable, credit memo status (requested/approved/issued/posted), and disposition instruction (return to stock/destroy/rework/donate). Tracks reverse logistics triggers and financial credit processing for AR settlement.
products.reference: SAP SD Returns Order (RE) / Credit Memo Request

attributes.name: return_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the return order record. Primary key.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Return processing requires identifying the original batch for quality assessment and potential recall actions.

attributes.name: originating_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original sales order that this return is associated with.

attributes.name: processed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Return processing must capture the employee handling the return for accountability and quality control.

attributes.name: product_complaint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.product_complaint. Business justification: Return processing links to product complaints for root‑cause analysis and corrective action tracking.

attributes.name: product_recall_id

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Return processing needs the original purchase order to calculate credit, restocking fees, and inventory adjustments.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Connects returns to the originating R&D project for post‑launch quality and satisfaction analysis.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Return orders must reference the exact SKU being returned for warranty, credit, and compliance processing; used in return analytics.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail account, distributor, or DTC consumer initiating the return.

attributes.name: waste_generation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.waste_generation. Business justification: Returned goods generate waste; linking return orders to waste generation records enables accurate waste reporting and cost recovery.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional adjustments applied to the return value (e.g., damage deductions, handling fees, promotional credits).

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier used for reverse shipment of the returned goods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_memo_issued_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was officially issued to the customer.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Unique credit memo document number issued for this return in the financial system.

attributes.name: credit_memo_posted_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was posted to the general ledger for financial settlement.

attributes.name: credit_memo_status
attributes.description: Current status of the credit memo in the accounts receivable settlement process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_requested|requested|approved|issued|posted|rejected|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this return order.

attributes.name: customer_responsible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is financially responsible for the return (True) or the business absorbs the cost (False).

attributes.name: disposition_instruction
attributes.description: Instruction for handling the returned goods based on inspection results and business rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: return_to_stock|destroy|rework|donate|quarantine|return_to_vendor|scrap — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel code through which the original sale and return are processed.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: SAP division code representing the product line or business unit.

attributes.name: goods_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the returned goods were physically received at the return processing facility or warehouse.

attributes.name: inspection_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when quality inspection of the returned goods was completed.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality inspector who performed the inspection of returned goods.

attributes.name: lot_batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the returned product for traceability.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this return order record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return order record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the return.

attributes.name: original_unit_price
attributes.description: Original unit price at which the product was sold in the originating sales order.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_result
attributes.description: Result of the quality inspection performed on the returned goods.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for processing and restocking the returned goods, if applicable.

attributes.name: return_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the return was officially authorized by the business for processing.

attributes.name: return_authorization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique authorization number issued for this return request. Format: RMA-XXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: return_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the return based on the originating channel: retail account, distributor, direct-to-consumer, or wholesale.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the product return. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damaged_in_transit|expired|shelf_life_rejection|overstock|quality_defect|wrong_item_shipped|recall|customer_dissatisfaction|packaging_defect|promotional_return — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: return_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description providing additional context about the return reason.

attributes.name: return_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the return request was initiated by the customer or account.

attributes.name: return_shipping_cost
attributes.description: Cost incurred for shipping the returned goods back to the warehouse.

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the return order in the reverse logistics and credit processing workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|authorized|in_transit|received|inspected|approved|rejected|credit_issued|closed|cancelled — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: return_value_gross
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of the returned goods before any deductions (returned quantity × original unit price).

attributes.name: return_value_net
attributes.description: Net monetary value to be credited to the customer after restocking fees and adjustments (gross - restocking fee - adjustments).

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units being returned.

attributes.name: returned_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the returned quantity (EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code responsible for processing this return.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Shipment tracking number provided by the carrier for the return shipment.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the warehouse or distribution center where the returned goods were received.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this return order record.

products.name: territory

Captures territory code, name, region, district, channel assignment (grocery/drug/mass/club/convenience/e-commerce), territory type (field/key account/national account), channel characteristics (trade class, EDI capability, DSD eligibility), active status, effective dates, and assigned quota. Master reference for SFA routing, field sales KPI attribution, and channel-level segmentation.
products.reference: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Territory Management

attributes.name: territory_id

attributes.name: account_count

attributes.name: acv_coverage

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: territory_id

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: minimum_threshold

attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Incentive Compensation

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: period_end_date

attributes.name: period_start_date

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Time period granularity for the quota (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual).
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP)

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Scope of products covered by this quota (all products, specific category, specific brand, or specific SKU).

attributes.name: quota_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the quota assignment.

attributes.name: quota_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or reference number for the quota assignment.
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP)

attributes.name: quota_source
attributes.description: Method by which the quota was determined. Top-down = allocated from corporate targets, Bottom-up = aggregated from field input, Negotiated = agreed between management and rep, Algorithmic = calculated by predictive model.

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue|volume|new_distribution|tdp|acv|unit_sales|gross_margin — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
