products.name: distribution_point
products.description: Total Distribution Points (TDP) record tracking which SKUs are actively distributed and available for sale at specific retail accounts or store locations. Captures store/account reference, SKU/GTIN, distribution status (active/inactive/authorized/delisted), authorization date, delist date, channel, planogram slot reference, ACV-weighted distribution flag, and distribution source (sell-in confirmed/POS verified). Core entity for ACV/TDP metric computation and new product distribution tracking.
products.reference: TDP (Total Distribution Points) / Nielsen IQ Distribution Tracking

attributes.name: distribution_point_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the distribution point record. Primary key.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.energy_consumption. Business justification: Energy consumption of distribution points is tracked for sustainability KPIs and must be linked to the distribution point entity.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Supply chain traceability links distribution points to the manufacturing facility that supplied the product for logistics and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Distribution points are managed per brand to ensure correct shelf placement and brand‑level inventory control.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Binds distribution point records to the R&D project of the SKU, supporting launch logistics planning.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific retail store location where the SKU is available for sale.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Distribution points record which SKU is allocated to each retail location; required for inventory allocation and shelf‑stocking dashboards.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: VMI programs tie a store distribution point to the supplier site that replenishes it, enabling inventory‑level monitoring.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Distribution Point Inventory Planning uses the supplying network node to compute safety stock, replenishment, and service level targets.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail trade account or customer where the SKU is distributed.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU became actively distributed and available for sale at this point.

attributes.name: actual_retail_price
attributes.description: Current actual retail selling price observed at this distribution point, may differ from RSP/MSRP.

attributes.name: acv_percentage
attributes.description: The ACV percentage contribution of this retail location to the total category volume, used for weighted distribution metrics.

attributes.name: acv_weighted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution point is included in ACV-weighted distribution calculations (True/False). ACV-weighted stores represent a significant portion of category sales volume.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU was authorized for distribution at this retail location or account.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Retail channel classification for this distribution point (grocery, mass merchandiser, drug, convenience, club, e-commerce, specialty). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grocery|mass_merchandiser|drug|convenience|club|ecommerce|specialty — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution point record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for pricing at this distribution point.

attributes.name: delist_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU was delisted or removed from distribution at this location. Null if still active.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code representing the route-to-market for this distribution point.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel Master

attributes.name: distribution_source
attributes.description: Source system or method used to confirm distribution at this point (sell-in confirmed from ERP, POS verified from transaction data, syndicated data from Nielsen/IRI, field audit from sales force, retailer feed from EDI).

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU at this distribution point. Active indicates the product is currently distributed and available for sale; authorized indicates approval but not yet active; delisted indicates removal from distribution; inactive indicates temporary suspension.

attributes.name: distribution_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution status was last verified or confirmed through the distribution source.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: SAP division code representing the product line or business unit for this distribution.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution point is serviced via Direct Store Delivery (True) or warehouse distribution (False).

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution point supports EDI transactions for order and inventory management (True/False).

attributes.name: facing_count
attributes.description: Number of product facings (front-facing units) allocated to this SKU on the retail shelf at this location.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Geographic market or region code for this distribution point, used for regional distribution analysis.

attributes.name: last_pos_sale_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Point of Sale (POS) Sale Date
attributes.description: Most recent date when a POS transaction was recorded for this SKU at this location, used to verify active distribution.

attributes.name: launch_wave
attributes.description: Launch wave or phase identifier for new product rollouts, indicating the sequence of distribution expansion.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this distribution point record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution point record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: msrp_price
attributes.description: Manufacturer suggested retail price for this SKU at this distribution point.

attributes.name: new_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution point represents a new product introduction (True/False). Used for NPD distribution tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding special conditions, exceptions, or context for this distribution point.

attributes.name: osa_status
attributes.description: Current on-shelf availability status of the SKU at this location, indicating whether the product is physically available for purchase.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution

attributes.name: planogram_slot_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the planogram slot or shelf position where this SKU is merchandised at the store.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution

attributes.name: pog_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU placement at this location is compliant with the authorized planogram (True/False).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution

attributes.name: rsp_price
attributes.description: Manufacturer recommended selling price for this SKU at this distribution point.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code responsible for this distribution point.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Master

attributes.name: shelf_position
attributes.description: Vertical and horizontal shelf position classification for the SKU at this location (eye level, top shelf, middle shelf, bottom shelf, end cap, promotional display).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution

attributes.name: tdp_count_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution point is counted in TDP metrics (True/False). Used to calculate numeric distribution reach.

attributes.name: vmi_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution point operates under a Vendor Managed Inventory agreement (True/False).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this distribution point record.

products.name: price_list
products.description: Standard price list master defining list prices, RSP/MSRP, and channel-specific base prices for SKUs across different trade classes and geographies. Contains both header-level metadata (price list code, name, currency, effective dates, channel applicability, type, approval status) and SKU-level price entries (unit price, MOQ, price UoM, effective dates, override flags) for each product in the list. Serves as the pricing baseline from which customer-specific pricing agreements and trade discounts are derived in SAP SD condition records.
products.reference: SAP SD Price List / Condition Type PR00

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price list record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the pricing manager or analyst responsible for maintaining this price list. Defines accountability for price list accuracy and updates.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Price lists are often brand‑specific, enabling brand‑level pricing strategy and compliance.

attributes.name: superseded_by_price_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer price list that replaces this one when status is superseded. Enables price list succession tracking and historical pricing analysis.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for the price list. Tracks progression through pricing governance approval process before activation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the pricing manager or executive who approved this price list for activation. Required for audit trail and pricing governance compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the price list was approved for activation. Critical for audit trail and compliance with pricing governance policies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price list record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all prices in this list are denominated. Critical for multi-currency pricing operations and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel to which this price list applies. Enables channel-specific pricing strategies for retail stores, wholesale distributors, direct-to-consumer (DTC), e-commerce platforms, foodservice operators, and institutional buyers.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: SAP SD division code representing the product line or business unit to which this price list applies. Enables division-specific pricing strategies across product portfolios.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the price list expires and is no longer valid for new pricing calculations. Nullable for open-ended price lists. Aligns with SAP SD condition record validity period.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the price list becomes valid and active for pricing calculations in sales orders and quotations. Aligns with SAP SD condition record validity period.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External system identifier or reference number for this price list in the source system. Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: freight_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether freight costs are included in the prices in this list. True when prices are freight-inclusive (delivered pricing), false when prices are ex-works or FOB.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic region, country, or territory to which this price list applies. Supports region-specific pricing strategies and regulatory compliance with local pricing regulations.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining delivery and risk transfer terms associated with prices in this list (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Clarifies freight and insurance responsibilities.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required for prices in this list to apply. Used to enforce volume thresholds and support tiered pricing strategies.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Item Configuration

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this price list record. Required for audit trail and accountability in pricing governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price list record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail for pricing governance compliance.

attributes.name: moq_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure (UoM)
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity threshold. May differ from price UoM to support different ordering and pricing units.
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure Configuration

attributes.name: msrp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price list contains manufacturer suggested retail prices (MSRP). True when prices represent official MSRP for consumer-facing pricing and promotional compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about the price list including special conditions, exceptions, or business context for pricing decisions.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms associated with this price list (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Defines credit period and early payment discount eligibility for customers purchasing under this list.

attributes.name: price_basis
attributes.description: Pricing methodology or basis used to establish prices in this list. List price indicates standard published pricing, cost plus indicates markup over cost, market based indicates alignment with market rates, competitive indicates positioning relative to competitors, value based indicates pricing tied to customer value perception.

attributes.name: price_list_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the price list used in SAP SD pricing procedures and condition records. Externally-known identifier used in pricing agreements and sales documents.

attributes.name: price_list_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the price list purpose, scope, and applicability including target customer segments and product categories covered.

attributes.name: price_list_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name of the price list for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: price_list_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price list. Draft indicates under development, pending approval indicates awaiting authorization, active indicates currently in use, inactive indicates temporarily disabled, expired indicates past validity period, superseded indicates replaced by newer version.

attributes.name: price_list_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price list by its business purpose and application context. Standard lists provide baseline pricing, promotional lists support time-limited campaigns, contract lists support negotiated agreements, channel-specific lists apply to distribution channels, seasonal lists support seasonal pricing strategies, and clearance lists support inventory liquidation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Price List Type Configuration

attributes.name: price_protection_days
attributes.description: Number of days of price protection coverage offered under this price list. Defines the lookback period for retroactive price adjustments when price protection is enabled.

attributes.name: price_protection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether price protection provisions apply to this price list. When true, customers who purchased at higher prices may be eligible for retroactive credits if prices decrease during the protection period.

attributes.name: price_rounding_rule
attributes.description: Rounding rule applied to calculated prices from this list. Supports psychological pricing strategies and currency denomination constraints.

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure in which prices are expressed in this list (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, PAL for pallet). Aligns with SAP MM material master UoM configuration.
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure Configuration

attributes.name: pricing_condition_type
attributes.description: SAP SD condition type code that defines how prices from this list are applied in pricing procedures (e.g., PR00 for base price, K004 for material price). Links price list to SAP pricing schema configuration.

attributes.name: rsp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price list contains recommended selling prices (RSP) for retail partners. True when prices represent manufacturer-suggested retail pricing guidance.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP SD sales organization code to which this price list applies. Defines the organizational scope for pricing applicability in the sales and distribution structure.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which this price list record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD, Oracle Pricing Cloud, Salesforce CPQ). Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax category or classification code applicable to prices in this list. Determines tax treatment for products priced under this list in compliance with jurisdictional tax regulations.

attributes.name: trade_class
attributes.description: Customer trade class or customer pricing group to which this price list applies. Used to segment pricing by customer type such as mass merchandisers, drug stores, grocery chains, convenience stores, or specialty retailers.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the price list. Increments with each revision to support version control and change tracking for pricing history and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this price list record. Required for audit trail and accountability in pricing governance.

products.name: price_list_item
products.description: Individual SKU-level price entry within a price list, capturing the specific list price or MSRP/RSP for a given product in a given channel and currency. Records SKU/GTIN reference, price list reference, unit price, minimum order quantity (MOQ), price unit of measure, effective dates, and override flag. Enables granular SKU-level pricing management and supports SAP SD condition record maintenance.

attributes.name: price_list_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price list item record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent price list that contains this item. Links this SKU-level price entry to its governing price list header.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (SKU) for which this price is defined. Identifies the specific finished good or SKU being priced.

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_contract. Business justification: Price list items are derived from supplier contracts; linking ensures contract‑based pricing compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this price list item. Tracks whether the price has been reviewed and approved by pricing management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who approved this price list item. Supports audit trail and accountability for pricing decisions.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price list item was approved. Part of the pricing governance audit trail.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The sales channel or distribution channel for which this price applies (e.g., retail, wholesale, DTC, e-commerce). Enables channel-specific pricing strategies.

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: The SAP SD condition type code that defines the pricing logic for this item (e.g., PR00 for base price, K004 for customer discount). Maps to SAP pricing procedure.

attributes.name: cost_price
attributes.description: The standard cost or COGS for this SKU in the specified currency. Used for margin analysis and profitability calculations. Business-confidential data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price list item record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all price amounts in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The customer segment or pricing group for which this price applies (e.g., national accounts, regional chains, independent retailers). Supports segment-based pricing.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The SAP distribution channel code for this price list item. Defines the route-to-market for which this price applies.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: The SAP division code for this price list item. Represents the product line or business unit responsible for this pricing.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price list item expires and is no longer valid for new sales transactions. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this price list item becomes active and can be used in sales transactions. Part of the item's validity period.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic region, country, or market for which this price is valid. Supports regional pricing strategies and multi-country operations.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The globally unique GTIN (UPC, EAN, or GTIN-14) for the product. Supports EDI transactions and retail POS integration.

attributes.name: item_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this item within the parent price list. Used for ordering and display purposes.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: The base list price for this SKU in the specified currency and unit of measure. Represents the standard selling price before any discounts or promotions.

attributes.name: margin_percentage
attributes.description: The target gross margin percentage for this price list item, calculated as (list_price - cost_price) / list_price * 100. Business-confidential data.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered for this SKU at this price. Used to enforce order minimums and support volume-based pricing tiers.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this price list item record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price list item record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes.

attributes.name: moq_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the minimum order quantity (e.g., EA, CS, PAL).

attributes.name: msrp_price
attributes.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price for this SKU. Used for retail channel pricing guidance and price protection calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this price list item. Used to document special pricing conditions, exceptions, or business rationale.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price list item represents a manual override of standard pricing logic. True if this is an exception price.

attributes.name: price_list_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this price list item. Controls whether the item can be used in pricing calculations.

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for which the price is quoted (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, PAL for pallet). Aligns with product packaging hierarchy.

attributes.name: pricing_unit_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of base units represented by one pricing unit. For example, if price is per case and a case contains 12 units, this value is 12.

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price is part of a promotional campaign. True if this is a temporary promotional price rather than standard list price.

attributes.name: rsp_price
attributes.description: The recommended selling price for this SKU in the target market. May differ from MSRP based on regional pricing strategies.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: The SAP sales organization code responsible for this price list item. Aligns with organizational hierarchy and reporting structure.

attributes.name: sap_condition_record_number
attributes.description: The unique SAP SD condition record number for this price list item. Enables traceability back to the source ERP system.

attributes.name: scale_basis
attributes.description: The basis for volume-based pricing scales (e.g., quantity, order value, weight, volume). Defines how tiered pricing thresholds are measured.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_from
attributes.description: The lower bound of the quantity range for which this price applies in a tiered pricing structure. Used for volume discount calculations.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_to
attributes.description: The upper bound of the quantity range for which this price applies in a tiered pricing structure. Null indicates no upper limit for the highest tier.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this price list item record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: sales_deduction
products.description: Short-payment or deduction record raised by a retail account or distributor against an invoice, representing disputed amounts, unauthorized deductions, or trade promotion claims. Captures deduction number, originating invoice reference, deduction date, deduction type (trade promotion/pricing dispute/shortage claim/quality claim/freight allowance), claimed amount, approved amount, status (open/under review/approved/rejected/written off), resolution date, and responsible analyst. Critical for accounts receivable management and trade spend reconciliation.
products.reference: CPG Deduction Management / SAP SD Credit/Debit Memo

attributes.name: sales_deduction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales deduction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounts receivable analyst or deduction specialist responsible for investigating and resolving the deduction.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Deduction accounting entries must reference a GL account to post adjustments in the general ledger.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating invoice against which the deduction was raised.

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing agreement that may be relevant to the deduction, particularly for pricing dispute claims.

attributes.name: promotion_deduction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_deduction. Business justification: Audit trail linking sales deductions to their originating promotion deduction is required for compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail account or distributor that raised the deduction.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion or promotional agreement that the deduction claim is associated with, if applicable.

attributes.name: aging_days
attributes.description: The number of days the deduction has been open since the deduction date, used for aging analysis and collection prioritization.

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The amount approved by the business for write-off or credit after review and validation of the deduction claim.

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: The total amount claimed or deducted by the customer or distributor from the invoice payment.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code in the ERP system that owns the accounts receivable and deduction record.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for absorbing the deduction expense, used for internal cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the deduction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deduction amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number or claim number provided by the customer or distributor for tracking the deduction on their side.

attributes.name: deduction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deduction was raised or recorded by the customer or distributor.

attributes.name: deduction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the deduction, often provided by the customer or generated by the accounts receivable system.

attributes.name: deduction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deduction: open, under review, approved, rejected, written off, or partially approved.

attributes.name: deduction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deduction reason: trade promotion claim, pricing dispute, shortage claim, quality claim, freight allowance, or damaged goods claim.
attributes.value_regex: trade promotion|pricing dispute|shortage claim|quality claim|freight allowance|damaged goods

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the claimed amount that is under dispute and has not been approved or rejected.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the sale and subsequent deduction occurred (e.g., retail, wholesale, DTC, e-commerce).

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: The product division or business unit associated with the deduction, aligned with SAP SD organizational structure.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deduction has been escalated to senior management or a specialized resolution team due to complexity or high value.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the deduction record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the deduction record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the customer payment or remittance advice where the deduction was taken.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deduction was resolved (approved, rejected, or written off).

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes and comments captured by the analyst during the investigation and resolution process, including rationale for approval or rejection.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Detailed explanation or categorization of the underlying root cause identified during deduction investigation (e.g., system pricing error, promotional terms misalignment, delivery shortage).

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: The sales organization code responsible for the transaction and deduction, aligned with SAP SD organizational structure.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number generated when the deduction is posted to the general ledger for financial accounting.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting documentation provided by the customer or generated during investigation (e.g., proof of delivery, promotional agreement, quality report).

attributes.name: valid_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deduction claim was determined to be valid based on investigation and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the deduction record.

products.name: sales_rebate_agreement
products.description: Volume-based or performance-based rebate agreement with a retail account or distributor defining the conditions under which financial rebates are earned and paid. Captures agreement number, customer reference, rebate type (volume/growth/new product/category performance), calculation basis (revenue/units), threshold tiers, rebate percentage or fixed amount per tier, accrual method, settlement frequency (monthly/quarterly/annual), effective dates, and approval status. Manages trade spend accruals and settlement in SAP SD rebate processing.

attributes.name: sales_rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales rebate agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Rebate agreements need an employee approver to satisfy financial compliance and audit requirements.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_hierarchy. Business justification: Rebate agreements are scoped to product hierarchies to calculate rebate amounts per product family; needed for rebate settlement reports.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Rebate agreements are negotiated per brand; brand‑specific rebate tracking is needed for financial reporting.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail account or distributor participating in this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: Method used to accrue rebate liabilities: at invoice creation, upon payment receipt, at shipment, or periodic batch calculation.

attributes.name: accrued_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Total rebate amount accrued to date under this agreement but not yet settled or paid.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the rebate agreement for business reference and reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the rebate agreement, typically generated by SAP SD rebate processing module.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the rebate agreement before it becomes active.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business user who approved this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rebate agreement was approved for activation.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate agreement automatically renews at the end of its term.

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The metric used to calculate rebate eligibility and amounts: revenue value, unit volume, gross sales, or net sales.

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the legal contract document or attachment that governs this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rebate agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel code indicating the route-to-market for this rebate agreement (e.g., retail, wholesale, DTC).

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: SAP division code representing the product line or business unit for this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement becomes active and eligible for accrual calculations.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions, countries, or sales territories where this rebate agreement applies.

attributes.name: last_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent rebate settlement payment made under this agreement.

attributes.name: maximum_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Cap on the total rebate amount that can be earned under this agreement during its term. Nullable if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_qualification_amount
attributes.description: Minimum purchase amount or volume required for the customer to qualify for any rebate under this agreement.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rebate agreement record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, special terms, or business context related to this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which rebate amounts are paid to the customer: credit memo, check, electronic funds transfer, or offset against receivables.

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Description or reference to the product categories, SKUs, or product hierarchy levels included in this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: rebate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate agreement based on the performance criteria: volume-based, growth-based, new product introduction, category performance, product mix, or customer loyalty.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiration that renewal or termination notice must be provided.

attributes.name: retroactive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether rebate rate increases apply retroactively to all prior purchases when a higher tier is reached.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code responsible for managing this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: sales_rebate_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rebate agreement indicating its operational state.

attributes.name: sap_rebate_agreement_number
attributes.description: Native SAP SD rebate agreement document number from the source ERP system.

attributes.name: settled_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Total rebate amount that has been settled and paid to the customer under this agreement.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which rebate payments are calculated and settled with the customer.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or explanation for early termination of the rebate agreement, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rebate agreement was terminated before its scheduled end date.

attributes.name: tier_structure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate agreement uses a tiered threshold structure with escalating rebate rates.

products.name: sales_dsd_route
products.description: Direct Store Delivery (DSD) route master and delivery execution record. Defines the sequence of retail store stops, delivery frequency, and assigned DSD driver/vehicle for direct delivery operations. Also captures actual delivery execution events including delivery date, SKUs/quantities delivered, quantities returned (empties/unsold), delivery confirmation status, store receiver signature, exceptions, and settlement amounts. Supports DSD channel order management, field execution planning, and delivery settlement.

attributes.name: sales_dsd_route_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales Direct Store Delivery (DSD) Route ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DSD route record. Primary key for the sales_dsd_route product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: DSD routes are assigned to carriers for transport; linking enables carrier SLA tracking and cost management.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center from which this DSD route originates for inventory loading and dispatch.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the DSD driver or sales representative assigned to execute deliveries on this route.

attributes.name: network_lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_lane. Business justification: DSD Route Planning tracks which network lane (origin‑destination, carrier, lead time) a route follows; lane attributes are needed for cost and service calculations.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Assigning a sales rep to a DSD route clarifies responsibility for route execution.

attributes.name: actual_distance_km
attributes.description: Actual distance traveled in kilometers during a specific delivery execution on this route.

attributes.name: actual_duration_hours
attributes.description: Actual time in hours taken to complete a specific delivery execution on this route, including all stops and travel time.

attributes.name: actual_stop_count
attributes.description: Actual number of retail store stops completed during a specific delivery execution on this route.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DSD route record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement amount and financial transactions on this route.

attributes.name: delivery_confirmation_status
attributes.description: Status of delivery confirmation for a specific route execution, indicating whether deliveries were accepted by store receivers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: delivery_day_of_week
attributes.description: Scheduled day of the week when deliveries are executed on this route. Multiple days may be represented in separate route records or via custom schedule.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: delivery_execution_date
attributes.description: Actual date when a specific delivery execution event occurred on this route. Captures the real-world delivery event timestamp for execution tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: delivery_frequency
attributes.description: Standard frequency pattern for deliveries on this DSD route, defining how often stores on the route receive deliveries.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel code indicating the route of goods to market for this DSD route (e.g., retail, food service).

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: Product division or business unit code associated with this DSD route, defining the product scope served.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this DSD route configuration is discontinued or replaced. Null for open-ended routes.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this DSD route configuration becomes active and operational for delivery execution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: estimated_distance_km
attributes.description: Total estimated distance in kilometers for completing all stops on this DSD route.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated time in hours required to complete all deliveries on this DSD route, including travel and stop time.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of delivery exceptions encountered during route execution (e.g., store closed, access denied, damaged goods, shortages).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing delivery exceptions, issues, or special circumstances encountered during route execution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: geographic_territory
attributes.description: Geographic territory or region code that this DSD route covers, used for sales territory management and planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this DSD route record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DSD route record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General notes or comments about the DSD route configuration, special instructions, or operational considerations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: otif_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route execution met OTIF service level requirements for all stops on the route.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: planned_stop_count
attributes.description: Number of retail store stops planned on this DSD route during a standard delivery cycle.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: receiver_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether store receiver signatures were captured electronically during delivery execution for proof of delivery.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: route_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end time for route execution, typically when the driver returns to the warehouse. Format HH:mm.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the DSD route, typically including geographic or customer cluster identifiers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the DSD route. Externally-known route code used in field operations and driver assignments.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: route_optimization_score
attributes.description: Calculated score representing the efficiency of the route configuration based on distance, time, and stop sequence optimization.

attributes.name: route_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start time for route execution, typically when the driver departs from the warehouse. Format HH:mm.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DSD route indicating whether it is operational, planned, or discontinued.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DSD route based on its operational purpose and frequency pattern.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: Sales organization code responsible for managing this DSD route within the enterprise structure.

attributes.name: sap_sd_route_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Route Number
attributes.description: Route number reference in SAP S/4HANA SD module for integration and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Total settlement amount for the route execution, representing the net financial value of delivered goods minus returns and adjustments.

attributes.name: total_cases_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of cases delivered across all stops during a specific route execution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: total_quantity_delivered
attributes.description: Total quantity of products delivered across all stops during a specific route execution, measured in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: total_quantity_returned
attributes.description: Total quantity of products returned (empties, unsold, damaged) collected during a specific route execution, measured in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the delivery vehicle assigned to this DSD route for transportation and delivery execution.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this DSD route record.

products.name: sales_dsd_delivery
products.description: Direct Store Delivery (DSD) execution record capturing the actual delivery of products to a retail store by a DSD driver. Records delivery date, route reference, store/account, driver reference, vehicle reference, SKUs delivered, quantities delivered, quantities returned (empties/unsold), delivery confirmation status, store receiver signature captured flag, delivery exception notes, and settlement amount. Operational record for DSD channel order fulfillment and settlement.
products.reference: DSD Delivery Execution / SAP SD Delivery

attributes.name: sales_dsd_delivery_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales Direct Store Delivery (DSD) Delivery ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DSD delivery record. Primary key for the sales_dsd_delivery product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Each DSD delivery is performed by a carrier; linking enables carrier performance and cost allocation reporting.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center from which the delivery was dispatched. Links to warehouse master for inventory and logistics tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DSD driver who executed the delivery. Links to workforce or driver master for performance tracking.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: DSD delivery records should be tied to the originating sales order for fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store where the delivery was made. Links to the retail store master for account and location details.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.route. Business justification: Delivery follows a defined route; the FK supports route efficiency analysis and exception handling.

attributes.name: sales_dsd_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DSD route this delivery is part of. Links to the route master for planning and optimization.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account associated with this delivery. Links to the customer trade account for billing and settlement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this delivery record. Ensures consistent financial reporting across regions.

attributes.name: delivery_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of products delivered in this transaction before adjustments. Base amount for settlement calculation.

attributes.name: delivery_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the delivery was confirmed and signed off by the store receiver. Marks the completion of the delivery transaction.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the delivery was executed at the retail store. Principal business event timestamp for DSD execution.

attributes.name: delivery_exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any exceptions or issues occurred during this delivery. True if exceptions were recorded, false for clean deliveries.

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes about the delivery. Captured by the driver for operational context, special instructions followed, or store feedback.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the DSD delivery. Human-readable reference number used in operational systems and driver documentation.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current status of the DSD delivery in its lifecycle. Indicates whether the delivery was successfully completed, partially delivered, rejected by the store, cancelled, or still pending.

attributes.name: delivery_time
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the delivery was completed at the store. Used for route optimization and On Time In Full (OTIF) performance measurement.

attributes.name: delivery_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery based on its business purpose. Regular deliveries are routine replenishment, emergency deliveries address out-of-stock situations, promotional deliveries support trade promotions, and new store deliveries are initial stock placements.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this delivery. Includes trade promotions, volume discounts, and pricing agreement adjustments.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the distribution channel for this delivery. DSD is a distinct channel from warehouse distribution and e-commerce.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product division or business unit for this delivery. Used for divisional P&L and performance reporting.

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing delivery exceptions, issues, or special circumstances. Captured by the driver for operational follow-up and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: exception_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for delivery exception. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery. Used for route verification, geofencing compliance, and delivery proof.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery. Used for route verification, geofencing compliance, and delivery proof.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount to be settled for this delivery after all adjustments. Calculated as delivery_amount minus return_amount minus discount_amount plus tax_amount.

attributes.name: otif_status
attributes.description: Classification of delivery performance against On Time In Full (OTIF) service level agreement. Measures whether the delivery was completed on schedule and with complete quantities.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method of payment collected or arranged for this delivery. Cash and check are collected on delivery, credit and EDI are settled through accounts receivable, account indicates billing to trade account.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the payment transaction associated with this delivery. Links to payment or invoice records for reconciliation.

attributes.name: return_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of products returned during this delivery. Deducted from the delivery amount in settlement.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales organization responsible for this delivery. Used for organizational reporting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: sap_sd_delivery_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Delivery Number
attributes.description: SAP SD system delivery document number for integration and traceability. Links this DSD delivery to the source ERP transaction.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_time
attributes.description: The planned delivery time as scheduled in the route plan. Used to measure delivery punctuality and OTIF compliance.

attributes.name: signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a digital or physical signature was captured from the store receiver as proof of delivery. True if signature was obtained, false otherwise.

attributes.name: signature_image_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the stored signature image file or document. Links to document management system for proof of delivery retrieval.

attributes.name: store_receiver_name
attributes.description: Name of the store employee who received and accepted the delivery. Captured for proof of delivery and accountability.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this delivery. Calculated based on jurisdiction tax rates and product tax classifications.

attributes.name: total_cases_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of cases delivered to the store across all SKUs in this delivery. Aggregate quantity for operational reporting.

attributes.name: total_cases_returned
attributes.description: Total number of cases returned from the store during this delivery. Includes empties, unsold products, damaged goods, and expired items.

attributes.name: total_units_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (eaches) delivered to the store across all SKUs in this delivery. Used for inventory accuracy and settlement.

attributes.name: total_units_returned
attributes.description: Total number of individual units returned from the store during this delivery. Used for reverse logistics and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle used for this delivery. Links to fleet or vehicle master for asset tracking and maintenance.

products.name: account_onboarding
products.description: Tracks the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle for new trade accounts from initial application through full activation. Captures onboarding request date, applicant legal entity, KYC/KYB verification status, credit application status, compliance document checklist completion, EDI setup milestone, initial assortment agreement status, pricing agreement status, assigned onboarding coordinator, target go-live date, actual activation date, and onboarding stage (application, verification, credit approval, setup, testing, active). Enables CPG manufacturers to manage the multi-week new account setup process and measure time-to-trade for new retail and distributor partners.

attributes.name: account_onboarding_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each account onboarding record.

attributes.name: account_assortment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the first product assortment agreement created during onboarding.

attributes.name: account_pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the first pricing agreement established during onboarding.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee responsible for managing the onboarding process.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.trade_account. Business justification: Onboarding records belong to a specific trade account; linking enables traceability of the onboarding lifecycle to the account.

attributes.name: actual_activation_date
attributes.description: Date the trade account was officially activated and began transacting.

attributes.name: applicant_duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet unique identifier for the applicant organization.

attributes.name: applicant_legal_entity
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization applying for a trade account.

attributes.name: assortment_agreement_status
attributes.description: Status of the product assortment agreement with the trade account.

attributes.name: compliance_checklist_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required compliance documents have been submitted and approved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding record was first created in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: credit_application_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the credit application submitted during onboarding.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 currency code used for all monetary amounts in the onboarding agreement.

attributes.name: dsd_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account uses Direct Store Delivery logistics.

attributes.name: edi_setup_milestone_date
attributes.description: Date the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) configuration was completed for the account.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which the onboarding agreement becomes effective (often same as target_go_live_date).

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date the onboarding agreement ends or is superseded; null if open‑ended.

attributes.name: kyb_status
attributes.description: Current status of KYB verification for the applicant.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of KYC verification for the applicant.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the onboarding record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or observations recorded by the onboarding team.

attributes.name: onboarding_request_date
attributes.description: Date the onboarding request was submitted by the prospective trade account.

attributes.name: onboarding_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the onboarding lifecycle.

attributes.name: onboarding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the onboarding effort (e.g., brand‑new account, transfer from another system, reinstatement after suspension).

attributes.name: overall_status
attributes.description: High‑level status indicating whether onboarding is ongoing, finished, or halted.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code (e.g., NET30, NET45) agreed for the account.

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_status

attributes.name: required_documents_completed_flag

attributes.name: risk_assessment_level

attributes.name: risk_assessment_score

attributes.name: sla_target_osa_percent

attributes.name: sla_target_otif_percent

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: target_go_live_date

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag

attributes.name: resubmitted_account_onboarding_id

products.name: sales_vmi_agreement
products.description: Represents a VMI agreement between a trade account and a supplier, capturing the contractual terms and effective period for each partnership.. Existence Justification: Trade accounts can partner with multiple suppliers under VMI programs, and each supplier can serve multiple trade accounts. The VMI agreement is an operational entity that is created, updated, and terminated by business users and carries its own attributes such as agreement number, effective dates, status, and replenishment model.

attributes.name: sales_vmi_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the vmi_agreement association

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id

attributes.name: agreement_number

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: replenishment_model

attributes.name: sales_vmi_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agreement (e.g., Active, Inactive, Terminated)

products.name: call
products.description: Represents an interaction (call/visit) between a trade account and a sales representative. Captures details of each sales call such as date, type, status, objectives, activities performed, and duration.. Existence Justification: In the consumer goods business, a trade account can be visited or contacted by multiple sales representatives (field, inside, DSD) and each sales rep serves many trade accounts across territories. The interaction is recorded as a sales call with its own attributes (date, type, status, objectives, activities, duration), which are managed by users for performance reporting and territory management.

attributes.name: call_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the sales_call association

attributes.name: sales_rep_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id

attributes.name: activities_completed

attributes.name: call_date
attributes.description: Date of the sales call

attributes.name: call_status
attributes.description: Status of the call (e.g., completed, cancelled)

attributes.name: call_type

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the call in minutes

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Objective of the call (e.g., product demo, order taking)

products.name: compliance_assignment
products.description: This association captures the operational relationship between a trade_account and a compliance_obligation. It records which obligations each account must meet and stores compliance-specific details that belong to the link, such as status, license numbers, and relevant dates.. Existence Justification: Each B2B trade account must satisfy a set of regulatory compliance obligations, and each regulatory obligation applies to many trade accounts. The compliance team actively creates, updates, and deletes records that link a trade_account to a compliance_obligation, tracking status, dates, and license information for each link.

attributes.name: compliance_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the compliance_assignment association

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the trade_account master record

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the obligation for this account (e.g., pending, compliant, non‑compliant)

attributes.name: compliance_type
attributes.description: Type of compliance activity for this account (e.g., registration, reporting)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date the license/permit expires for the account

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the license/permit was issued to the account

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: License or permit number issued to the account for this obligation

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: manager_email
