attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a CAPA investigation is required based on deviations or non-conformances identified during batch production or testing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the batch release record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: deviation_count
attributes.description: Number of manufacturing or quality deviations recorded during the production and testing of this batch. Used for quality trend analysis.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the batch should not be sold or used. Calculated from production date plus shelf life. Critical for FEFO inventory management and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the batch was manufactured in full compliance with GMP requirements. False indicates deviation or non-conformance.

attributes.name: hold_initiated_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory or business hold was placed on the batch. Nullable if no hold exists.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the batch is on hold, if applicable. Includes regulatory citation, investigation reference, or customer complaint number.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the batch release record was last updated. Tracks changes to release status, hold status, or other critical fields.

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing facility or plant where the batch was produced. Used for site-level quality tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: product_registration_number
attributes.description: Regulatory registration or approval number for the product in the target market. Required for FDA NDC, EU product registration, or equivalent.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date when the batch manufacturing was completed. Critical for shelf-life calculation and FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: qc_inspection_status
attributes.description: Overall status of QC inspection and testing for this batch. Summarizes results from multiple QC test records.

attributes.name: qp_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the Qualified Person electronically signed the batch release decision. Part of 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance.

attributes.name: qualified_person_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Qualified Person who signed off on the batch release. Required for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_status
attributes.description: Indicates if the batch is under any regulatory or business hold that prevents distribution. Holds may be imposed by FDA, EPA, internal quality, customer complaint, or recall investigation.

attributes.name: regulatory_market
attributes.description: Primary regulatory market or jurisdiction for which this batch was released. Different markets may have different release requirements and QP sign-off rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|DEU|FRA|ITA|ESP|CHN|JPN|AUS|BRA|IND — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA, EU GMP, Health Canada, TGA, ANVISA

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the batch that was rejected and marked for destruction or rework. Part of quality yield tracking.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when the batch was officially released for distribution and sale. Marks the point at which product becomes available to promise (ATP).

attributes.name: release_decision
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the batch: released for distribution, rejected for destruction, quarantine for further testing, conditional release with restrictions, pending review, or on hold pending investigation. Critical GMP control point.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.165, EU GMP Chapter 6

attributes.name: release_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the Qualified Person regarding the release decision. May include justification for conditional release or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the batch release decision was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: released_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the batch that was approved for release and distribution. May be less than batch size if partial rejection occurred.

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date when the batch must be retested to confirm continued quality and stability. Common for raw materials and intermediates.

attributes.name: sap_qm_inspection_lot
attributes.description: SAP QM inspection lot number associated with this batch release. Links to SAP S/4HANA QM module for detailed inspection results and usage decisions.

attributes.name: stability_study_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking to the stability study protocol and results that support the assigned shelf life and expiry date for this batch.

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault system linking to the official batch release record and supporting quality documents. Integrates with Veeva Vault QMS.

products.name: certificate_of_analysis
products.description: Certificate of Analysis (CoA) documents issued per finished goods or raw material batch. Stores test parameters, specification limits, actual results, pass/fail status, issuing lab, authorized signatory, issue date, and customer-facing distribution flag. Supports trade customer requirements and regulatory submissions. Managed in Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the certificate of analysis record. Primary key.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_laboratory_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate Of Analysis Laboratory Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.laboratory. Business justification: Link certificate_of_analysis to the laboratory that issued it, removing redundant name/code fields.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lot or batch for which this certificate of analysis was issued. Links to the specific production batch of finished goods or raw materials.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: COA must reference the supplier of the batch for traceability and regulatory compliance; supplier_name is replaced by FK.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the certificate was officially approved by the authorized signatory. Represents the moment of quality release decision.

attributes.name: authorized_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the quality assurance professional authorized to approve and sign this certificate. Must have appropriate delegation of authority.

attributes.name: authorized_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the authorized signatory (e.g., QA Manager, Quality Director, Laboratory Supervisor).

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing batch or lot number for the material being certified. Critical for traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Total quantity produced in the manufacturing batch. Used to assess sample representativeness and for statistical quality control.

attributes.name: batch_size_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the batch size. Typically matches the material's production UOM.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique certificate number assigned to this CoA document. Used for customer communication and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: certificate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the certificate based on the material type being certified. Determines applicable test parameters and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this certificate record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: customer_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certificate is intended for external distribution to trade customers or is for internal use only. True if customer-facing.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digitally signed PDF or scanned image of the certificate stored in Veeva Vault or document management system.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the material should not be used or sold. Based on stability studies and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the batch and testing process were conducted under GMP conditions. True if GMP-compliant.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which this certificate of analysis was officially issued and authorized for distribution to customers or regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the batch was manufactured or produced. Used for shelf-life calculations and FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing facility or plant where the batch was produced. Critical for site-specific compliance and traceability.

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_name
attributes.description: Full name and location of the manufacturing site. Supports multi-site operations and regulatory site registration requirements.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: The product or material code (SKU, item number, or raw material identifier) for which this certificate was issued. Links to master product or material data.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Full textual description of the material or product covered by this certificate. Includes product name, variant, and key characteristics.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this certificate record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: overall_result_status
attributes.description: Aggregate pass/fail status for all test parameters on this certificate. Determines batch release decision and customer distribution eligibility.

attributes.name: quantity_tested
attributes.description: The quantity of material sampled and tested for this certificate. Expressed in the material's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: quantity_tested_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity tested (e.g., kilograms, liters, units). Aligns with material master UOM.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certificate is required for regulatory submissions or compliance filings with FDA, EPA, or other governing bodies. True if required for submission.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special conditions related to the testing or batch. May include deviations or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: The date by which the material should be retested to confirm continued conformance to specifications. Applicable primarily to raw materials.

attributes.name: specification_version
attributes.description: Version number of the product specification or quality standard used for testing. Ensures traceability to the correct specification limits.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Recommended storage conditions for the material (e.g., store in cool dry place, refrigerate at 2-8°C, protect from light). Based on stability data.

attributes.name: supplier_lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number assigned by the supplier for raw materials or packaging materials. Used for supplier quality traceability.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which quality control testing was performed for this certificate. May differ from manufacturing date for retained samples.

attributes.name: test_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the analytical test methods used (e.g., USP, ASTM, internal method codes). May be a comma-separated list for multiple methods.

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Unique document identifier in Veeva Vault system where the certificate is stored. Enables integration with regulatory document management.

products.name: quality_stability_study
products.description: Master and detail record for product stability studies conducted to validate shelf life and storage conditions per ICH Q1A/Q1B/Q5C guidelines and FDA/EU GMP requirements. Header captures study type (accelerated, real-time, intermediate, stress, photostability), product/formulation, storage conditions (25°C/60%RH, 30°C/65%RH, 40°C/75%RH), study duration, protocol reference, and overall study status. Detail level stores all time-point measurement results including pull date, storage condition, test characteristic, measured value, specification limit, pass/fail status, trend flag, and out-of-trend (OOT) indicator. Feeds shelf-life determination, regulatory submission data packages, and label claim validation in Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: quality_stability_study_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stability study record. Primary key.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Stability studies are performed on a defined lot batch; linking enables shelf‑life reporting and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: quality_stability_study_specification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Stability Study Specification Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Link quality_stability_study to the specification it validates, eliminating the free‑text reference column.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or formulation being tested in this stability study.

attributes.name: approved_shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Regulatory-approved or final determined shelf life in months based on stability study results. May differ from proposed shelf life if data does not support full duration.

attributes.name: commitment_due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which stability study results must be submitted to the health authority. Applicable only when stability_commitment_flag is true.

attributes.name: container_closure_system
attributes.description: Detailed specification of the container and closure materials and design used in the stability study. Critical for assessing barrier properties and product protection.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Container Closure Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stability study record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: deviation_count
attributes.description: Number of protocol deviations or non-conformances recorded during the stability study execution (e.g., missed time points, temperature excursions, testing delays).

attributes.name: formulation_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific product formulation or recipe being tested. Used to track formulation changes and their impact on stability.

attributes.name: ich_climatic_zone
attributes.description: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) climatic zone classification for the intended market. Zone I (temperate), Zone II (subtropical/Mediterranean), Zone III (hot/dry), Zone IV (hot/humid). Determines required storage conditions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stability study record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: manufacturing_site
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the manufacturing facility where the batch being tested was produced. Important for site-specific stability commitments.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or context about the stability study that do not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: out_of_specification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any test results during the study were out of specification, triggering investigation and potential corrective action. True if any OOS results occurred.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Investigating Out-of-Specification Results

attributes.name: out_of_trend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any test results showed unexpected trends or deviations from expected stability behavior, even if within specification. True if any OOT results occurred.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Investigating Out-of-Trend Results

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the primary and secondary packaging used for the stability samples (e.g., HDPE bottle with child-resistant cap, aluminum tube with flip-top cap). Packaging can significantly impact product stability.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Classification of the product type being tested (e.g., oral solid, topical cream, liquid suspension, aerosol). Different product forms have different stability considerations and testing requirements.

attributes.name: proposed_shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Intended or claimed shelf life in months that this stability study is designed to support. Final shelf life determination is based on study results.

attributes.name: protocol_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the approved stability study protocol document that defines test methods, sampling schedule, acceptance criteria, and storage conditions. Links to protocol management system or Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: regulatory_purpose
attributes.description: Primary regulatory or business purpose for conducting the stability study. Registration studies support new product applications. Post-approval studies fulfill ongoing commitments. Change-control studies assess impact of manufacturing or formulation changes.

attributes.name: regulatory_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or regulatory authority for which this stability study is being conducted (e.g., USA, EU, Japan, Global). Different regions may have different storage condition requirements per ICH climatic zones.

attributes.name: report_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the final stability study report was reviewed and approved by quality assurance. Marks formal completion of the study.

attributes.name: report_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier for the final stability study report. Links to document management system or Veeva Vault for full study documentation.

attributes.name: responsible_laboratory
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the laboratory facility conducting the stability testing. May be internal quality control (QC) lab or external contract testing laboratory.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of individual product units or samples placed on stability for this study. Must be sufficient to support all planned time-point testing.

attributes.name: stability_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this study is part of a formal stability commitment made to a regulatory authority. True if this is a committed study that must be completed and reported per regulatory agreement.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Primary storage condition for the study, expressed as temperature and relative humidity (e.g., 25°C/60%RH for long-term, 30°C/65%RH for intermediate, 40°C/75%RH for accelerated). May include additional conditions such as light exposure or freezing.

attributes.name: storage_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Target relative humidity percentage for the stability study storage condition.

attributes.name: storage_instruction
attributes.description: Consumer-facing storage instructions that will appear on product labeling, derived from stability study results (e.g., Store at room temperature, Do not freeze, Protect from light).

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Target storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the stability study chamber or condition.

attributes.name: study_conclusion
attributes.description: Summary conclusion of the stability study results, including whether the product met all acceptance criteria throughout the study duration and any recommendations for shelf life or storage conditions.

attributes.name: study_coordinator
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the person responsible for coordinating and overseeing the stability study execution.

attributes.name: study_duration_months
attributes.description: Planned total duration of the stability study in months. Typical durations are 6 months for accelerated studies, 12-36 months for real-time studies, and up to 60 months for long-term studies.

attributes.name: study_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual completion date of the stability study. For ongoing studies, represents the projected completion date based on protocol duration.

attributes.name: study_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the stability study, typically assigned by the quality management system or laboratory information management system (LIMS). Used for external reference and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the stability study was initiated and samples were placed on stability storage. Marks the beginning of the study timeline for time-point calculations.

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stability study. Tracks progression from planning through completion or discontinuation.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stability study protocol. Accelerated studies use elevated temperature/humidity to predict shelf life. Real-time studies use recommended storage conditions. Intermediate studies bridge accelerated and real-time. Stress studies test extreme conditions. Photostability studies assess light exposure impact. In-use studies simulate consumer usage conditions.

attributes.name: test_parameters
attributes.description: List of quality attributes and test methods included in the stability protocol (e.g., appearance, pH, assay, impurities, microbial limits, viscosity). Comma-separated or structured list.

attributes.name: testing_frequency
attributes.description: Schedule of time points at which samples are pulled and tested (e.g., 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36 months). Defined in the study protocol and varies by study type.

products.name: stability_result
products.description: Time-point measurement results from stability study intervals. Records pull date, storage condition, test characteristic, measured value, specification limit, pass/fail status, and trend flag. Feeds shelf-life determination and regulatory submission data packages in Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: stability_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stability test result record. Primary key for the stability result entity.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production lot or batch being tested for stability.

attributes.name: original_result_stability_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original stability result record if this is a retest.

attributes.name: quality_stability_study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent stability study protocol under which this result was generated.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product being tested in this stability study.

attributes.name: analyst_name
attributes.description: Name of the laboratory analyst who performed the test.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stability result was reviewed and approved by quality assurance.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or observations recorded by the analyst or reviewer regarding this stability result.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stability result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deviation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage deviation of the measured value from the specification target or initial value.
attributes.references: ICH Q1E Evaluation of Stability Data

attributes.name: instrument_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the analytical instrument used to perform the test.

attributes.name: laboratory_location
attributes.description: Physical location or site code of the laboratory where the test was performed.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Numeric result obtained from the stability test for this characteristic at this time point.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stability result record was last modified.

attributes.name: out_of_specification_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the result is out of specification and requires investigation per GMP requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 GMP for Finished Pharmaceuticals

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured value meets the specification limits. Pass indicates conformance, fail indicates non-conformance.

attributes.name: pull_date
attributes.description: Date when the sample was pulled from stability storage for testing at this time point.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result is included in regulatory submission packages to FDA, EMA, or other health authorities.

attributes.name: retest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result is a retest following an initial out-of-specification result or laboratory investigation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 GMP for Finished Pharmaceuticals

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality professional who reviewed and approved the test result.

attributes.name: sap_qm_inspection_lot
attributes.description: SAP Quality Management inspection lot number associated with this stability test result.

attributes.name: shelf_life_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result impacts the determination of product shelf life or expiration dating.
attributes.references: ICH Q1E Evaluation of Stability Data

attributes.name: specification_lower_limit
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable value for this test characteristic as defined in the product specification.

attributes.name: specification_target
attributes.description: Target or nominal value for this test characteristic as defined in the product specification.

attributes.name: specification_upper_limit
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable value for this test characteristic as defined in the product specification.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Environmental condition under which the sample was stored (temperature and relative humidity). Standard ICH conditions include 25°C/60% RH (long-term), 30°C/65% RH (intermediate), and 40°C/75% RH (accelerated).

attributes.name: test_characteristic
attributes.description: Specific quality attribute or parameter being measured (e.g., assay, impurity level, pH, viscosity, color, odor, dissolution rate, microbial count).

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory test was performed on the pulled sample.

attributes.name: test_interval_number
attributes.description: Sequential interval number within the stability study protocol (e.g., 0, 1, 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24 months).

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: Analytical method or procedure used to measure the test characteristic (e.g., HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, titration, Karl Fischer).
attributes.references: ICH Q2 Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this stability test result.

attributes.name: trend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result shows a statistically significant trend toward specification limits that may predict future failure.
attributes.references: ICH Q1E Evaluation of Stability Data

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the measured value is expressed (e.g., %, mg/g, pH units, cP, CFU/g).

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the associated stability test report or certificate of analysis stored in Veeva Vault quality document management system.

products.name: gmp_audit
products.description: GMP audit event records with associated findings for internal and external audits of manufacturing facilities, contract manufacturers, and laboratories. Header captures audit type (internal, regulatory, third-party, supplier), audit scope, facility, lead auditor, audit date range, overall rating, and closure status. Finding detail captures classification (critical, major, minor, observation), finding description, regulatory reference (FDA 483, EU GMP chapter), affected process area, response due date, and linkage to CAPA. Supports regulatory inspection readiness, FDA/EU GMP compliance tracking, and Veeva Vault audit management.

attributes.name: gmp_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GMP audit event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audit_checklist_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit checklist or protocol used during the audit to ensure consistent evaluation criteria.

attributes.name: audit_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit program or audit plan under which this audit was conducted (e.g., annual internal audit program, supplier qualification program).

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPA record initiated in response to audit findings.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System identifier for the lead auditor, linking to employee or external auditor master data.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility, contract manufacturer, or laboratory where the audit was conducted.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the audit fieldwork was completed.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the audit commenced on-site or remotely.

attributes.name: affected_process_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of process areas or departments affected by audit findings (e.g., production, quality control, warehouse, documentation, cleaning validation).

attributes.name: audit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional audit notes, context, or observations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the audit event, used for tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: audit_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the final audit report was issued to the facility or organization.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Description of the audit scope including processes, systems, and areas covered (e.g., production lines, quality systems, documentation practices, cleaning validation).

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit: scheduled (planned but not started), in_progress (fieldwork underway), report_draft (findings being documented), report_issued (final report delivered), closed (all findings resolved), cancelled (audit did not proceed).

attributes.name: audit_team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional audit team members who participated in the audit.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit based on the auditing party: internal (self-assessment), regulatory (FDA, EU authority), third-party (certification body), supplier (vendor qualification), or customer (buyer audit).

attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit findings require formal CAPA initiation (True) or are informational only (False).

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when all audit findings were resolved and the audit was formally closed.

attributes.name: closure_status
attributes.description: Status of audit closure: open (findings not yet addressed), pending_response (awaiting facility response), under_review (response being evaluated), closed (all findings resolved), escalated (unresolved findings escalated to management or regulatory authority).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical findings that pose immediate risk to product quality, patient safety, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up audit is required to verify implementation of corrective actions (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the follow-up audit to verify corrective action effectiveness.

attributes.name: gmp_standard_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the GMP standard or regulation against which the audit was conducted (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EU GMP Annex 1, ICH Q7).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EU GMP, ICH Q7

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead auditor responsible for conducting and reporting the audit.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major findings representing significant GMP deviations requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor findings representing opportunities for improvement without immediate compliance risk.

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: Number of observations noted during the audit that do not constitute non-conformances but warrant attention.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Summary rating assigned to the facility based on audit findings: compliant (no significant issues), acceptable (minor issues), needs_improvement (major issues requiring action), non_compliant (critical GMP violations), critical (immediate regulatory risk).

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority conducting the audit (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, Health Canada) for regulatory audits; null for internal or third-party audits.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number assigned by the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA 483 number, EMA inspection reference).

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the audited facility must submit a formal response to audit findings, including corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the facility submitted its formal response to the audit findings.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned end date for the audit as communicated to the facility.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the audit as communicated to the facility.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the audit record originated (e.g., SAP QM, Veeva Vault, internal audit management system).

attributes.name: total_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of findings (observations, deviations, non-conformances) identified during the audit.

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the audit report document stored in Veeva Vault for regulatory document management and audit trail.

products.name: audit_finding
products.description: Individual findings and observations raised during a GMP audit. Stores finding classification (critical, major, minor, observation), finding description, regulatory reference, affected process area, response due date, and linkage to CAPA. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and FDA/EU GMP compliance tracking.

products.name: control_chart
products.description: Statistical Process Control (SPC) control chart records for monitoring critical quality attributes (CQAs) on production lines. Master level stores chart type (X-bar/R, X-bar/S, p-chart, c-chart, CUSUM, EWMA), monitored characteristic, control limits (UCL/LCL/CL), subgroup size, sampling frequency, and out-of-control action plan (OCAP) reference. domains.name: distribution
domains.description: Owns warehouse operations, inventory management, and order fulfillment across distribution centers. Manages inbound/outbound logistics within DCs, put-away/picking/packing processes, cycle counting, FEFO/FIFO inventory rotation, WMS integration (Blue Yonder), OTIF performance, OSA metrics, and DSD execution for direct store delivery channels.

products.name: distribution_facility
products.description: Master record for each physical distribution center (DC) or warehouse facility in the CPG network. Captures DC identity, location, type (ambient, chilled, frozen, DSD hub), capacity metrics, WMS integration identifiers (Blue Yonder site codes), SAP plant/storage location mappings, operating hours, and operational status. SSOT for DC facility master data across the distribution domain.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Primary key for facility

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Facilities have specific ESG commitments (energy, waste, emissions) that are tracked for performance dashboards and compliance.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks the facility manager employee for each distribution center, required for operational performance metrics and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the distribution center facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or unit information. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the distribution center is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center ceased operations. Null for active facilities. Used for historical analysis and network optimization studies.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary contact email address for the distribution center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the distribution center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the distribution center is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution center record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: cross_dock_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility supports cross-docking operations where inbound goods are directly transferred to outbound shipments with minimal storage time.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard frequency in days for cycle counting inventory at this facility. Used for inventory accuracy management and audit compliance.

attributes.name: dc_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the distribution center used across operational systems. Externally-known unique code for the facility.

attributes.name: dc_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the distribution center or warehouse facility.

attributes.name: dock_doors_inbound
attributes.description: Number of dock doors designated for inbound receiving operations. Impacts receiving throughput capacity and scheduling.

attributes.name: dock_doors_outbound
attributes.description: Number of dock doors designated for outbound shipping operations. Impacts shipping throughput capacity and carrier scheduling.

attributes.name: dsd_hub_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facility serves as a DSD hub for direct-to-retail delivery operations. DSD hubs bypass traditional distribution channels for faster store replenishment.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution center based on temperature control and operational model. Ambient for room temperature, chilled for refrigerated, frozen for sub-zero, multi-temperature for mixed zones, DSD hub for Direct Store Delivery operations, cross-dock for flow-through distribution.

attributes.name: fsc_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified under FSC chain of custody standards for sustainable sourcing. Required for handling FSC-certified paper and wood-based products.
attributes.references: Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) Chain of Custody Certification

attributes.name: gmp_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified under Good Manufacturing Practice standards. Required for handling cosmetics, personal care, and certain consumer goods products.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified to handle and store hazardous materials. Required for distribution of products with EPA or OSHA regulated substances.

attributes.name: inventory_rotation_method
attributes.description: Primary inventory rotation method used at this facility. FIFO (First In First Out) for standard goods, FEFO (First Expired First Out) for perishables and date-sensitive products, LIFO (Last In First Out) for specific use cases.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the facility lease agreement. Null for owned facilities. Used for lease renewal planning and facility strategy.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution center record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center commenced operations. Used for facility age analysis and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekdays in format HH:MM-HH:MM. Used for scheduling inbound deliveries, outbound shipments, and workforce planning.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekends in format HH:MM-HH:MM. Used for scheduling weekend operations and carrier coordination.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the distribution center in its lifecycle. Active indicates full operations, inactive for temporarily closed, under construction for new facilities being built, decommissioned for permanently closed, seasonal for facilities operating only during peak periods, maintenance for temporary closure due to upgrades or repairs.

attributes.name: osa_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target OSA performance percentage for stores served by this distribution center. OSA measures product availability at retail shelf level.

attributes.name: otif_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target OTIF performance percentage for this distribution center. OTIF measures the percentage of orders delivered on time and in full, a key supply chain KPI.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of facility ownership model. Owned for company-owned facilities, leased for long-term leased properties, third-party logistics for 3PL-operated warehouses.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the distribution center address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code representing this distribution center in the ERP system. Maps to the SAP MM and WM modules for material management and warehouse management.

attributes.name: sap_storage_location
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA storage location code within the plant. Represents the primary storage location identifier for inventory transactions in SAP WM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Storage Location Master Data

attributes.name: shifts_per_day
attributes.description: Number of operational shifts per day at the facility. Used for labor planning, throughput capacity modeling, and operational cost analysis.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division where the facility is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_pallet_positions
attributes.description: Maximum number of pallet positions available for storage. Key metric for inventory capacity planning and space utilization analysis.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility has temperature-controlled storage zones. True for facilities with chilled or frozen capabilities, false for ambient-only.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the distribution center location. Used for scheduling, shift planning, and cross-facility coordination.

attributes.name: total_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total warehouse floor space capacity in square feet. Includes all storage, staging, and operational areas within the facility.

attributes.name: wms_site_code
attributes.description: Unique site identifier in the Blue Yonder WMS system. Used for integration and synchronization between the lakehouse and the operational WMS platform.

products.name: distribution_storage_location
products.description: Granular storage location master within a distribution center — aisles, bays, levels, bin positions, and pick faces as defined in Blue Yonder WMS. Tracks location type (bulk, pick, reserve, staging, dock), zone classification, temperature zone, weight/volume capacity, and FEFO/FIFO eligibility flags. Enables put-away and picking optimization at the slot level.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id

attributes.name: abc_classification

attributes.name: aisle
attributes.description: Aisle designation within the warehouse layout for physical navigation and picking route optimization.

attributes.name: bay

attributes.name: bin_position
attributes.description: Specific bin or slot position within the level for granular inventory placement and retrieval.

attributes.name: blocked_date

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the location is blocked or unavailable, such as maintenance, damage, safety hold, or quality quarantine.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for cycle counting inventory at this location to maintain inventory accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: distribution_storage_location_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within the bay for height-based slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: dsd_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is designated for DSD operations where products bypass the DC and are delivered directly to retail stores.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: equipment_type_required

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location is scheduled to be decommissioned or removed from active use. Null for indefinite locations.

attributes.name: fefo_eligible_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the location supports FEFO inventory rotation logic for expiry-sensitive products (pharmaceuticals, food, cosmetics).

attributes.name: fifo_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location supports FIFO inventory rotation logic for age-based stock management.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is certified and equipped for storing hazardous materials per OSHA and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: height_cm

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage location record was most recently updated in the WMS system.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length dimension of the storage location in centimeters for dimensional slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location as defined in Blue Yonder WMS. Typically formatted as aisle-bay-level-bin (e.g., A01-B05-L03-P12).

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the storage location for operational reference.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location indicating availability for inventory placement and retrieval.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location by operational function: bulk storage, active pick face, reserve inventory, staging area, dock door, or cross-dock zone.

attributes.name: mixed_lot_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location permits storage of multiple lot or batch numbers for the same SKU or requires lot segregation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Location Master, GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: mixed_sku_allowed_flag

attributes.name: pick_face_flag

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
