attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_storage_location. Business justification: Inventory position records on‑hand quantities at a specific DC location. Linking to distribution_storage_location provides the authoritative location details and removes the generic storage_location_i

attributes.name: inventory_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Supports Inventory Ownership Dashboard, assigning a responsible employee for each DC inventory position for accountability and cycle‑count oversight.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific lot or batch of the SKU. Critical for traceability, quality control, and FEFO inventory rotation.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Provides real‑time visibility of prototype SKU inventory tied to the RD project, essential for launch readiness dashboards.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product SKU for which inventory position is tracked.

attributes.name: actual_weight
attributes.description: The actual measured weight of the inventory for catch weight items. Used for billing and compliance when item weight varies.

attributes.name: catch_weight_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is a catch weight item requiring actual weight capture at transaction time (true) or standard weight (false).

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The unit cost of the inventory lot. Used for inventory valuation and cost of goods sold calculations. Business confidential financial data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory position record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for inventory valuation (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: days_on_hand
attributes.description: The number of days the inventory has been on hand since receipt. Calculated as current date minus receipt date. Used for aging analysis.

attributes.name: days_to_expiry
attributes.description: The number of days remaining until the inventory lot expires. Calculated as expiry date minus current date. Critical for FEFO rotation and markdown decisions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product lot expires and can no longer be sold or distributed. Critical for FEFO inventory management and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: inventory_condition
attributes.description: The physical condition classification of the inventory. Used for disposition decisions and channel restrictions.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the inventory position. Determines availability for picking and order fulfillment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Inventory Status Codes

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: The date when this inventory position was last physically counted during a cycle count operation. Used to schedule next count and assess inventory accuracy.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Management

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: The date when inventory was last moved into or out of this storage location. Used for slow-moving inventory identification.

attributes.name: last_movement_type
attributes.description: The type of the last inventory movement transaction that affected this position (receipt, putaway, pick, replenishment, transfer, adjustment, return). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: receipt|putaway|pick|replenishment|transfer|adjustment|return — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory position record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data freshness assessment.

attributes.name: license_plate_number
attributes.description: The warehouse management system license plate number assigned to the handling unit. Used for tracking and automated material handling.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The alphanumeric lot or batch number assigned during manufacturing. Used for traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product lot was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculations and FEFO rotation.

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: Indicates the ownership model of the inventory (owned by company, consignment from supplier, customer-owned for returns, vendor-managed inventory).

attributes.name: pallet_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the pallet or handling unit on which the inventory is stored. Used for warehouse automation and tracking.

attributes.name: pick_face_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory position is in a primary pick face location (true) or reserve storage (false). Pick face locations are optimized for order picking efficiency.

attributes.name: putaway_date
attributes.description: The date when the inventory was put away into this storage location after receiving. Used for aging analysis and FEFO compliance.

attributes.name: quantity_allocated
attributes.description: The quantity of on-hand inventory that has been allocated to outbound orders or reservations but not yet picked. Reduces available-to-pick quantity.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: The quantity available for new order allocation and picking. Calculated as quantity_on_hand minus quantity_allocated minus quantity_quarantine minus quantity_hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ATP Logic, Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: quantity_damaged
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory identified as damaged and not suitable for sale or distribution. Typically awaiting disposal or return to supplier.

attributes.name: quantity_hold
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory placed on hold due to quality issues, customer complaints, or pending investigation. Not available for picking.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: The total physical quantity of the SKU-lot currently present in the storage location. Measured in the SKU's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: quantity_quarantine
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory placed in quarantine status pending quality inspection or regulatory clearance. Not available for picking.

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory reserved for specific customers, channels, or promotional programs. Subset of allocated quantity with additional business constraints.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date when the inventory lot was received into the distribution center. Used for inventory aging and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: replenishment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory position requires replenishment from reserve to pick face (true) or not (false). Triggers automated replenishment tasks.

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory position snapshot was captured. Used for point-in-time inventory reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: storage_zone
attributes.description: The logical zone within the distribution center where the inventory is stored (e.g., ambient, refrigerated, frozen, hazmat, high-velocity, reserve).

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The temperature control zone classification for the storage location. Critical for cold chain compliance and product quality.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: total_inventory_value
attributes.description: The total financial value of the inventory position calculated as quantity_on_hand multiplied by cost_per_unit. Used for balance sheet reporting. Business confidential financial data.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which inventory quantities are tracked (Each, Case, Pallet, Pound, Kilogram, Liter, Gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|LB|KG|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: weight_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for actual weight (Pound, Kilogram, Ounce, Gram). Applicable for catch weight items.

products.name: distribution_cycle_count
products.description: Cycle count event record capturing scheduled or ad-hoc physical inventory counts at DC locations, including line-level detail for each SKU/lot counted with system vs. actual quantities and variance calculations.
products.reference: Physical Inventory Count / SAP WM Inventory Document

attributes.name: distribution_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count event record. Primary key for the distribution cycle count entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the cycle count adjustment.

attributes.name: distribution_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center where the cycle count was performed.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific storage location (bin, rack, aisle) within the DC where the count was performed.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific lot or batch being counted, critical for FEFO/FIFO inventory rotation and traceability.

attributes.name: primary_distribution_counter_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse associate who performed the physical count.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product SKU being counted in this cycle count line.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC inventory classification of the SKU at the time of count: A (high value/velocity), B (medium), C (low), D (obsolete/slow-moving).

attributes.name: adjustment_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory adjustment has been approved by a supervisor or manager.

attributes.name: adjustment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an inventory adjustment is required based on the variance exceeding tolerance thresholds.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cycle count adjustment was approved by a supervisor or manager.

attributes.name: count_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the physical counting activity was completed.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform the physical count: manual (paper-based), RF scanner (handheld device), voice picking (voice-directed), or automated (RFID/sensor).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Module

attributes.name: count_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cycle count event, typically generated by the WMS. Format: CC-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Module

attributes.name: count_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason triggering this cycle count: routine (scheduled ABC cycle), discrepancy (prior variance), audit (compliance), quality (QC hold), recall (product recall), transfer (location move).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Module

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the physical counting activity began.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count event.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Module

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cycle count event: scheduled (routine ABC cycle), ad-hoc (unplanned), exception (triggered by discrepancy), blind (counter does not see system quantity), or targeted (specific SKU/lot focus).

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: The actual physical quantity counted by the warehouse associate during the cycle count event.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the inventory value variance amount.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the lot/batch being counted, critical for FEFO inventory rotation.

attributes.name: inventory_value_variance_amount
attributes.description: The financial impact of the variance, calculated as variance_quantity multiplied by the standard cost of the SKU. Expressed in the DC's functional currency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: recount_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which recount iteration this represents (1 for first recount, 2 for second, etc.). Null if no recount performed.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Module

attributes.name: recount_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount is required due to significant variance or quality control procedures.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cycle count was scheduled to be performed.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: The inventory status of the counted stock: available (unrestricted), hold (QC hold), quarantine (quality review), damaged, expired, or reserved (allocated to orders).

attributes.name: system_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU/lot recorded in the WMS at the time of the cycle count.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The acceptable variance percentage threshold. Variances within this percentage may not require adjustment.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_quantity
attributes.description: The acceptable variance quantity threshold defined for this SKU/location combination. Variances within this threshold may not require adjustment.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which quantities are expressed: EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), LB (pound), KG (kilogram), L (liter), GAL (gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|LB|KG|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context or explanation for the variance observed during the cycle count.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Module

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the system quantity, calculated as (variance_quantity / system_quantity) * 100.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between counted quantity and system quantity (counted minus system). Positive indicates overage, negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Root cause classification for the variance: picking error, receiving error, damage, theft, system error, location error, expiry, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: picking_error|receiving_error|damage|theft|system_error|location_error|expiry|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wms_transaction_code
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier generated by the WMS for this cycle count event, used for audit trail and system reconciliation.

products.name: distribution_dsd_route
products.description: Master record for Direct Store Delivery (DSD) routes defining the sequence of retail store stops served by a DSD driver/vehicle from a DC or satellite depot. Captures route code, route name, assigned DC, territory, day-of-week schedule, number of stops, total route distance, estimated drive time, vehicle type requirement, and active status. Supports DSD execution planning and OSA performance tracking by route.

attributes.name: distribution_dsd_route_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distribution Direct Store Delivery (DSD) Route ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DSD route record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: DSD route planning assigns a carrier to each route; the carrier_id FK enables carrier performance and cost analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or depot from which this DSD route originates. Links to the facility master.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.lane. Business justification: DSD route aligns with a transport lane to calculate distance, fuel surcharge, and service level expectations.

attributes.name: primary_distribution_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver or sales representative permanently or primarily assigned to this route. May be null for unassigned or pool routes.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales or service territory to which this route is assigned. Used for sales force alignment and performance tracking.

attributes.name: average_order_value
attributes.description: Historical average order value per stop on this route in local currency. Used for revenue forecasting and route profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for monetary values associated with this route (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this route configuration was discontinued or superseded. Null for currently active routes. Used for historical route analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this route configuration became active and operational. Used for historical route analysis and change tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_drive_time_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated total driving time for the route in minutes, excluding stop service time. Used for driver shift planning and OTIF performance targets.

attributes.name: estimated_service_time_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated total time spent at customer stops for unloading, merchandising, and order processing in minutes. Combined with drive time for total route duration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_optimization_date
attributes.description: Date when this route was last reviewed and optimized for efficiency. Used to identify routes due for re-evaluation.

attributes.name: merchandising_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this route includes merchandising activities (shelf stocking, display setup, POG compliance) in addition to delivery. True if merchandising is part of the service.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or route-specific considerations (e.g., 'Avoid highway during rush hour', 'Customer prefers morning delivery').

attributes.name: number_of_stops
attributes.description: Total count of retail store or customer locations included in this route. Used for route capacity planning and driver workload estimation.

attributes.name: osa_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target OSA percentage for stores on this route, representing the expected in-stock rate at point of sale. Used for DSD execution quality and replenishment effectiveness tracking.

attributes.name: otif_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target OTIF performance percentage for this route, representing the expected rate of deliveries completed on time and in full. Used for SLA management and driver performance evaluation.

attributes.name: planned_departure_time
attributes.description: Standard departure time from the DC for this route in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for driver scheduling and DC loading dock coordination.

attributes.name: planned_return_time
attributes.description: Expected return time to the DC for this route in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for driver shift planning and vehicle turnaround scheduling.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking of this route relative to other routes in the territory or DC, with lower numbers indicating higher priority. Used for resource allocation during capacity constraints.

attributes.name: requires_cold_chain
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this route requires temperature-controlled (refrigerated or frozen) transportation for product integrity. True if cold chain is required.

attributes.name: requires_hazmat_certification
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the driver assigned to this route must hold hazmat certification due to regulated products (e.g., aerosols, flammables). True if certification is required.

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the DSD route, used for operational reference and scheduling. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by logistics planning.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the DSD route, often including geographic or customer identifiers (e.g., 'Downtown Metro Route A', 'North Region Convenience Stores').

attributes.name: route_optimization_score
attributes.description: Calculated efficiency score for this route based on distance, time, stops, and revenue, typically ranging from 0-100. Higher scores indicate more optimized routes. Used for continuous improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the DSD route. Active routes are in regular service; inactive routes are permanently discontinued; suspended routes are temporarily paused; under_review routes are being optimized; seasonal_closed routes are off-season.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DSD route based on service model: standard (regular scheduled delivery), express (same-day or expedited), bulk (high-volume customers), emergency (unplanned replenishment), seasonal (temporary routes for peak demand).

attributes.name: service_day_pattern
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days of the week this route is scheduled to run (e.g., 'Mon,Wed,Fri' for a three-day-per-week route). Supports recurring schedule planning.

attributes.name: start_location_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the route start point (typically the DC or depot). Used for route optimization and GPS tracking.

attributes.name: start_location_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the route start point (typically the DC or depot). Used for route optimization and GPS tracking.

attributes.name: total_distance_km
attributes.description: Total driving distance for the complete route in kilometers, from DC departure through all stops and return. Used for fuel cost estimation and vehicle range planning.

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity_required_units
attributes.description: Minimum vehicle cargo capacity required in standard units (cases, pallets, or cubic meters) to fulfill typical route demand. Used for vehicle assignment.

attributes.name: vehicle_type_required
attributes.description: Type of vehicle required to service this route based on cargo volume, weight, and product requirements (e.g., refrigerated for cold chain products).

products.name: distribution_dsd_delivery
products.description: Transactional record of a DSD driver's delivery execution to a specific retail store on a given route visit. Captures route reference, store/account reference, driver ID, vehicle ID, visit date, arrival and departure timestamps, products delivered by SKU and quantity, products returned/credited, in-store merchandising activities performed, POD (proof of delivery) capture method, and delivery status. Integrates with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud retail execution and TradeEdge secondary sales visibility.
products.reference: DSD Delivery / Direct Store Delivery Transaction

attributes.name: distribution_dsd_delivery_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distribution Direct Store Delivery (DSD) Delivery ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DSD delivery transaction. Primary key for the distribution_dsd_delivery product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DSD driver who executed this delivery. Links to workforce employee master data.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store account where this delivery was executed. Links to the customer.retail_store master data.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DSD route this delivery is part of. Links to the route master data defining the planned sequence of store visits.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the driver arrived at the retail store location. Used for On Time In Full (OTIF) performance measurement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this delivery record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this delivery transaction.

attributes.name: delivery_exception_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any exception or issue encountered during the delivery attempt. Used for root cause analysis of delivery failures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: store_closed|access_denied|incomplete_order|damaged_product|wrong_address|weather_delay|traffic_delay|vehicle_breakdown|none — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the driver regarding delivery conditions, store feedback, or special circumstances encountered during the visit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the DSD delivery transaction. Externally visible delivery document number used for tracking and proof of delivery reference.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DSD delivery transaction. Tracks progression from scheduled visit through completion or failure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_transit|arrived|in_progress|completed|failed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: delivery_value_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of products delivered during this visit, calculated at invoice price. Represents gross delivery value before returns and credits.

attributes.name: delivery_window_end
attributes.description: The end of the agreed delivery time window with the retail store. Part of Service Level Agreement (SLA) for OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: delivery_window_start
attributes.description: The beginning of the agreed delivery time window with the retail store. Part of Service Level Agreement (SLA) for OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: departure_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the driver departed from the retail store after completing delivery and merchandising activities.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate captured at delivery location for route verification and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate captured at delivery location for route verification and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complete ordered quantity was delivered without shortages. Component of OTIF performance measurement.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Reference to the sales invoice document generated for this DSD delivery. Links to financial billing and accounts receivable.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this delivery record was last updated in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: merchandising_activity_type
attributes.description: The type of in-store merchandising activity performed during the delivery visit. Supports retail execution and On Shelf Availability (OSA) objectives.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: merchandising_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total time in minutes spent on merchandising activities during the store visit. Used for labor productivity analysis.

attributes.name: merchandising_performed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-store merchandising activities (shelf stocking, rotation, display setup) were performed during this delivery visit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: net_delivery_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary value of the delivery after subtracting return credits from gross delivery value. Represents actual secondary sales value.

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery arrived within the agreed delivery time window. Component of OTIF performance measurement.

attributes.name: otif_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery met On Time In Full (OTIF) performance criteria: arrived within delivery window and delivered complete order quantity.

attributes.name: pod_capture_method
attributes.description: The method used to capture proof of delivery from the store recipient. Electronic signature and photo are preferred for audit trail.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: pod_photo_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the photo evidence of delivery captured at the store. Links to document management system for audit purposes.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: pod_signature_image_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Proof of Delivery (POD) Signature Image URL
attributes.description: URL reference to the stored electronic signature image captured as proof of delivery. Links to document management system.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: The name of the store employee who received and acknowledged the delivery. Captured for proof of delivery and accountability.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: return_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of product returns credited to the store during this visit. Reduces net delivery value.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time
attributes.description: The planned arrival timestamp at the retail store based on route optimization and store delivery window requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this delivery transaction. Typically Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud or mobile DSD application.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this delivery record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: temperature_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether temperature-sensitive products were maintained within required cold chain temperature ranges during delivery. Critical for food safety and quality compliance.

attributes.name: total_cases_delivered
attributes.description: The total quantity of product cases delivered to the store during this visit. Aggregate measure across all SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) delivered.

attributes.name: total_cases_returned
attributes.description: The total quantity of product cases returned from the store during this visit due to damage, expiration, or other quality issues.

attributes.name: total_units_delivered
attributes.description: The total quantity of individual product units delivered to the store during this visit. Aggregate measure across all SKUs delivered.

attributes.name: total_units_returned
attributes.description: The total quantity of individual product units returned from the store during this visit due to damage, expiration, or other quality issues.

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery vehicle used for this DSD delivery. Links to fleet asset master data.

attributes.name: visit_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the DSD delivery visit to the retail store occurred. Business event date for reporting and analytics.

products.name: dsd_delivery_line
products.description: Line-level SKU detail for each product delivered or returned during a DSD store visit. Records SKU code, GTIN, lot number, expiry date, ordered quantity, delivered quantity, returned quantity, return reason code, unit selling price, line total value, and shelf placement confirmation. Enables secondary sales capture, OOS identification, and FEFO compliance tracking at the store-SKU level.
products.reference: DSD Delivery Line / Secondary Sales Line

attributes.name: dsd_delivery_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct Store Delivery (DSD) Delivery Line ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DSD delivery line item. Primary key for this product.

attributes.name: distribution_dsd_delivery_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent DSD delivery header record. Links this line item to the overall store visit and delivery transaction.

attributes.name: distribution_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center location from which this product was sourced for delivery.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DSD driver who delivered this line item. Used for driver performance tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion or promotional campaign associated with this delivery line, if applicable.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Tracks DSD pilot deliveries of new formulations, required for consumer test logistics and performance reporting.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery route on which this line was delivered. Used for route optimization and logistics analysis.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product master record for the SKU delivered or returned on this line.

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cold chain temperature requirements were maintained throughout delivery. True if compliant, False if temperature excursion occurred.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Standard cost of goods sold for the delivered quantity. Used for margin analysis and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this delivery line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the SKU delivered to the store during this visit. Used for secondary sales capture and inventory replenishment tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specific line item was delivered or processed at the store. Used for OTIF performance tracking and delivery window compliance.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount or promotional allowance applied to this line. Used for trade promotion settlement and margin analysis.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-before date. Used for FEFO inventory rotation and shelf-life management in stores.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14) for the product. Enables cross-system product identification and retail scanning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this delivery line record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the delivery document. Used for ordering and referencing specific line items within the delivery.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current status of this delivery line. Values: DELIVERED (fully delivered), PARTIAL (partially delivered), REJECTED (rejected by store), RETURNED (returned to warehouse), CANCELLED (cancelled before delivery).

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value for this delivery line (delivered quantity × unit selling price). Represents secondary sales revenue at store level.

attributes.name: lot_number

products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Item (EKPO)

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for the po_line product.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each PO line posts to a GL account; required for accurate ledger posting and audit trails.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent purchase order header. Links this line item to its containing purchase order document.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.sds. Business justification: Line‑level SDS reference is needed for quality and safety checks during order fulfillment; PO line stores the specific SDS identifier.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record. Identifies the raw material, packaging component, or indirect good being ordered on this line.

attributes.name: batch_management_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material on this line is subject to batch management. When true, batch number must be assigned during goods receipt for traceability.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Supplier-confirmed delivery date for this line item. May differ from the requested delivery date based on supplier capacity and lead time.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which the expense for this purchase order line will be charged. Used for financial accounting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line was originally created in the system. Used for audit trail and procurement cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the net price. Indicates the currency in which the supplier will be paid.

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this purchase order line has been marked for deletion. When true, the line is logically deleted but retained for audit purposes.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Requested or confirmed delivery date for this purchase order line. Target date by which the supplier should deliver the material to the receiving plant.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether goods receipt is required for this purchase order line. When true, physical receipt must be posted before invoice can be processed.

attributes.name: goods_received_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material received against this purchase order line. Updated with each goods receipt posting. Used for delivery tracking and invoice matching.

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk between buyer and supplier. Examples: EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP.

attributes.name: incoterm_location
attributes.description: Specific location or port associated with the Incoterm. Defines the point where responsibility and risk transfer occurs.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice verification is required for this line. When true, supplier invoice must be matched and verified against this PO line.

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity invoiced by the supplier for this purchase order line. Used for three-way matching between PO, goods receipt, and invoice.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field on the line item.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from order placement to expected delivery. Used for demand planning and inventory replenishment calculations.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the purchase order. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the PO document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order line. Tracks progression from open through goods receipt to closure or cancellation.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original manufacturer's part number for the material. Important for quality assurance and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material or service being ordered. Provides human-readable context for the line item.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Classification code grouping similar materials for procurement analysis and reporting. Used for spend categorization and supplier segmentation.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material being ordered. Alphanumeric code used across procurement, manufacturing, and supply chain systems.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier for this material. Procurement must order at least this quantity to meet supplier terms.

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this purchase order line calculated as ordered quantity multiplied by net price. Excludes taxes and freight.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Net unit price for the material excluding taxes and additional charges. Base price agreed with the supplier per price unit.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material ordered on this purchase order line. Represents the total amount requested from the supplier.

attributes.name: outstanding_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity yet to be received on this purchase order line. Calculated as ordered quantity minus goods received quantity.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage by which the supplier may over-deliver beyond the ordered quantity. Used to control goods receipt tolerances.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where the material will be received and consumed. Determines the receiving location for goods receipt.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity unit for which the net price applies. For example, price per 100 units or per 1000 units. Used to calculate total line value.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the procurement team or buyer responsible for this purchase order line. Used for workload distribution and performance tracking.

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or department that requested this material through a purchase requisition. Provides accountability and cost center traceability.

attributes.name: short_text
attributes.description: Additional short text or notes specific to this purchase order line. Provides supplementary information for procurement and receiving teams.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location or warehouse area within the plant where the material will be stored upon receipt. Used for inventory positioning.

attributes.name: supplier_material_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own material or part number for this item. Used for cross-referencing and communication with the supplier.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining the applicable tax rate and jurisdiction for this line item. Used for invoice verification and tax reporting.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage by which the supplier may under-deliver below the ordered quantity. Used to control goods receipt tolerances and automatic PO closure.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity. Standard codes such as KG (kilogram), LT (liter), EA (each), MT (metric ton), CS (case).

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Goods receipt (GR) event recorded when raw materials, packaging, or indirect goods are physically received at a plant or distribution center against a purchase order. Captures GR document number, posting date, receiving plant, storage location, received quantity per line, unit of measure, batch number, FEFO expiry date, quality inspection flag, movement type, and GR status. Triggers inventory update and three-way match process. Supports GR reversal and return-to-vendor scenarios.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO / MSEG movement type 101)

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Primary key for goods_receipt

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID of the warehouse operator or receiving clerk who physically accepted and posted the goods receipt. Used for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_storage_location. Business justification: REQUIRED: Records the exact storage location where goods receipt is posted, enabling accurate stock updates.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment or transportation leg that delivered these goods. Links to logistics tracking and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand Inventory Receipt: receipt of goods is recorded per brand to monitor inbound inventory and support brand performance dashboards.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific line item on the purchase order for which goods were received. Enables line-level tracking and three-way match.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which goods were received. Links this goods receipt to the originating procurement document.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Materials‑to‑Project Log records receipt of goods against the specific R&D project they support.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.sds. Business justification: Receiving teams verify the SDS against the received goods; the receipt records the SDS ID instead of a simple flag.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who delivered the goods. Used for supplier performance scorecards and VMI reconciliation.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Inbound logistics requires linking each goods receipt to the warehouse node for accurate inventory updates and OTIF reporting.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The supplier-provided or internally-assigned batch or lot number for traceability. Critical for quality management, recalls, and FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the transportation carrier or logistics provider who delivered the goods. Used for carrier performance analysis.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier-provided Certificate of Analysis was received with the shipment. Required for GMP compliance and quality assurance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was first created in the database. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the valuation amount is expressed. Typically the company code currency.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The supplier-provided delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the shipment. Used for cross-referencing and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the supplier delivery note or packing slip. May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date by which the received material must be consumed or disposed of. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory rotation and shelf-life management.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this goods receipt transaction. Used for audit trails, supplier communication, and three-way match processing.

attributes.name: gr_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed (cancelled). True means the inventory posting has been negated due to return-to-vendor or data correction.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt. Indicates whether the receipt is active, has been reversed, or is awaiting quality inspection clearance.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the quality inspection lot created for this goods receipt. Links to QM inspection results and certificate of analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material was produced by the supplier. Used for shelf-life calculation and quality assurance.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the raw material, packaging component, or indirect good that was received. Links to material master data.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: The SAP movement type code that classifies the nature of the goods receipt transaction (e.g., 101 for GR against PO, 122 for return delivery). Determines inventory and financial posting logic.

attributes.name: otif_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt met the On Time In Full criteria (received on or before requested date with full ordered quantity). Used for supplier performance scorecards.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the goods receipt was posted to inventory. This is the principal business event timestamp for inventory valuation and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods must undergo quality inspection before being released for use. True triggers QM workflow and blocks stock until clearance.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The physical quantity of goods received and accepted into inventory. This is the principal quantitative fact for this transaction.

attributes.name: receiving_plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or distribution center where the goods were physically received. Aligns with organizational hierarchy and inventory segmentation.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, exceptions, or special handling instructions related to this goods receipt. Used for operational communication and audit context.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversing goods receipt transaction, if this receipt was cancelled. Links to the offsetting inventory movement.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason why this goods receipt was reversed. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: The specific storage location or warehouse zone within the receiving plant where goods were placed. Used for inventory positioning and picking optimization.

attributes.name: sustainable_sourcing_certification
attributes.description: The sustainability certification standard under which the received material was sourced (e.g., FSC for paper/packaging, RSPO for palm oil). Supports ESG reporting and sustainable sourcing initiatives.
attributes.references: FSC Chain of Custody, RSPO Supply Chain Certification

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the received quantity is expressed (e.g., KG for kilograms, EA for each, L for liters). Must align with material master UOM.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The per-unit price used for inventory valuation at the time of goods receipt. May be standard cost, moving average price, or PO price depending on valuation method.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: The total inventory value of the received goods in the company currency, calculated as received quantity multiplied by standard or moving average price. Used for financial posting and COGS calculation.

products.name: supplier_invoice
products.description: Supplier invoice received for goods or services delivered against a purchase order. Captures invoice header (supplier-assigned number, invoice date, posting date, gross amount, tax amount, currency, payment due date, three-way match status, tolerance check result, blocking reason, processing status) and invoice line items (referenced PO line, material/service description, invoiced quantity, unit price, line amount, tax code, line-level match status). Supports granular three-way match (PO vs GR vs invoice) at both header and line level. Feeds accounts payable and COGS allocation. Owns all line-level detail as embedded attributes.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification / Logistics Invoice Verification (MIRO / RBKP)

attributes.name: supplier_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Invoices are allocated to cost centers for expense tracking; required by internal budgeting controls.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AP invoices must map to a GL account for posting; essential for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center allocation of supplier invoices supports profitability analysis of purchased goods.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice was issued.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.sds. Business justification: Invoices for regulated chemicals must reference the SDS to support audit trails and tax compliance.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who issued this invoice.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the invoice for payment.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was approved for payment.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The baseline date used for calculating payment due date and cash discount periods.

attributes.name: blocking_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why the invoice is blocked from payment, if applicable. Empty if not blocked.

attributes.name: blocking_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason the invoice is blocked from payment.

attributes.name: cash_discount_days
attributes.description: The number of days within which payment must be made to qualify for the cash discount.

attributes.name: cash_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount available for early payment per payment terms.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The company code within the ERP system that is responsible for this invoice.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amounts.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice, including early payment discounts.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the invoice was posted.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice was posted.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date goods were received or services were confirmed, used for three-way match validation.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the supplier issued the invoice. This is the principal business event timestamp for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or notes about the invoice provided by the supplier or entered during processing.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The unique invoice number assigned by the supplier. This is the externally-known identifier for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received by the organization.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|paid|blocked|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice type indicating the nature of the transaction.

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of line items included in this invoice.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the invoice record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount payable after taxes and discounts. This is the final amount due to the supplier.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date payment was made to the supplier.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the supplier per payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be made to the supplier.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned when payment is made, linking the invoice to the payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The plant or facility code where goods were received or services were rendered.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the financial accounting system.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice at header level.

attributes.name: tolerance_check_result
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice passed tolerance checks for price and quantity variances.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the invoice payment per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Code representing the withholding tax type and rate applied.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the invoice record in the system.

products.name: invoice_line
products.description: Individual line items on a supplier invoice corresponding to specific PO lines or service entry sheets. Captures invoice line number, referenced PO line, material/service description, invoiced quantity, unit price, line amount, tax code, and line-level match status. Enables granular three-way match (PO line vs GR line vs invoice line) and supports COGS allocation at the material level.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Line Item (RSEG)

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for invoice_line

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the goods receipt line that this invoice line matches against. Enables three-way match verification between PO, GR, and invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent supplier invoice header. Links this line item to the overall invoice document.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the invoiced item. Links to the product or raw material being purchased.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order line that this invoice line corresponds to. Critical for three-way match validation (PO vs GR vs Invoice).

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service entry sheet line for service-based invoices. Used when the invoice line corresponds to a service rather than a material.

attributes.name: amount_variance
attributes.description: Total amount variance for this line calculated as the difference between invoiced amount and expected amount based on PO and GR.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for the material on this invoice line. Critical for quality traceability, recall management, and FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why this invoice line is blocked from payment. Common reasons include price variance, quantity variance, or missing goods receipt.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which this invoice line expense is allocated. Used for internal cost tracking and management reporting.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code indicating where the material was manufactured or produced. Required for customs, trade compliance, and sustainable sourcing reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CHN|DEU|IND|BRA|MEX|CAN|GBR|FRA|ITA|JPN|KOR|THA|VNM|POL|ESP — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice line. Must match the invoice header currency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|INR|CAD|AUD|BRL|MXN — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Supplier delivery note or packing slip number referenced on this invoice line. Used for traceability and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Absolute discount amount applied to this invoice line. Alternative to or in addition to discount_percentage.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Line-level discount percentage applied by the supplier. Reduces the net amount before tax calculation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date for the material batch. Essential for FEFO inventory rotation and regulatory compliance in consumer goods.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this invoice line amount will be posted. Determines the financial classification for COGS, expense, or asset capitalization.

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service units invoiced on this line. Used for three-way match comparison against PO quantity and GR quantity.

attributes.name: line_gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount for this invoice line including taxes and charges. Sum of line_net_amount and line_tax_amount.

attributes.name: line_net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount for this invoice line before taxes and charges. Typically calculated as invoiced_quantity multiplied by unit_price, adjusted for any line-level discounts.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the invoice document.

attributes.name: line_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to this invoice line. Calculated based on the tax code and net amount.

attributes.name: line_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this invoice line. May include supplier remarks or internal annotations.

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Three-way match status for this invoice line. Indicates whether the line matches the PO and GR within acceptable tolerance thresholds.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the material or service as it appears on the invoice line. May differ from master data description if supplier uses alternate naming.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms applicable to this invoice line if different from header-level terms. Defines due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code where the material is received or consumed. Links procurement to manufacturing and supply chain operations.

attributes.name: price_variance
attributes.description: Difference between invoiced unit price and PO unit price. Used to identify pricing discrepancies and trigger approval workflows.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center assignment for this invoice line. Enables profitability analysis at the business unit or product line level.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: Difference between invoiced quantity and goods receipt quantity. Positive values indicate over-invoicing; negative values indicate under-invoicing.

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the Safety Data Sheet associated with this material. Required for hazardous materials and chemical ingredients per OSHA and REACH regulations.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Specific storage location within the plant where the material is stored. Provides granular inventory tracking.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability or ethical sourcing certification applicable to this material. Examples include FSC for paper/packaging, RSPO for palm oil, or organic certifications.
attributes.references: FSC Standards, RSPO Principles and Criteria

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction and rate code applied to this invoice line. Determines the tax calculation method and rate percentage.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Tax rate percentage applied to this line. Derived from the tax code configuration.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the invoiced quantity. Must match the UOM on the corresponding PO line and goods receipt for proper three-way match. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|LB|L|GAL|M|FT|BOX|CASE|PALLET|EACH|TON|MT — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure as stated on the invoice line. Compared against PO unit price during invoice verification to identify price variances.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from this invoice line payment. Reduces the net payment to the supplier.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Withholding tax code for this invoice line. Applicable in jurisdictions requiring tax withholding at source for certain supplier payments.

products.name: supplier_scorecard
products.description: Periodic supplier performance scorecard evaluating suppliers across key procurement KPIs: OTIF delivery rate, quality rejection rate (defect PPM), invoice accuracy, responsiveness, sustainability compliance, and regulatory adherence. Captures scorecard period, overall weighted score, individual KPI scores, trend vs prior period, scorecard status, and recommended action (maintain/develop/escalate/delist). Supports strategic supplier relationship management, sourcing decisions, and category reviews.
products.reference: Supplier Performance Management / SAP Ariba Supplier Risk

attributes.name: supplier_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier scorecard record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_supplier_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement professional or category manager who conducted the scorecard evaluation.

attributes.name: spend_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement category or commodity group this supplier primarily serves, used for category-level benchmarking.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier being evaluated in this scorecard.

attributes.name: action_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal corrective action plan or performance improvement plan is required based on scorecard results.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the scorecard was formally approved and published.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text commentary providing qualitative context, notable achievements, concerns, or recommendations for supplier relationship management.

attributes.name: cost_competitiveness_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier pricing competitiveness relative to market benchmarks and alternative suppliers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary values in this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period covered by this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period covered by this scorecard.

attributes.name: innovation_collaboration_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier contribution to new product development, process improvements, and collaborative innovation initiatives.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices submitted without errors requiring correction or dispute during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_score
attributes.description: Normalized score for invoice accuracy performance, weighted to contribute to overall score.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scorecard record was last updated.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier performance review and scorecard generation.

attributes.name: otif_delivery_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Delivery Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on time and in full during the evaluation period. Key supply chain reliability metric.

attributes.name: otif_score
attributes.description: Normalized score for OTIF performance, typically weighted and scaled to contribute to overall weighted score.

attributes.name: overall_weighted_score
attributes.description: Composite weighted score aggregating all KPI scores, typically on a 0-100 scale. Primary metric for supplier performance ranking.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Classification tier assigned based on overall score and KPI performance, determining supplier relationship management strategy.

attributes.name: prior_period_overall_score
attributes.description: Overall weighted score from the previous evaluation period, used for trend analysis and performance tracking.

attributes.name: quality_rejection_rate_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Rejection Rate Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Defect rate measured in parts per million, indicating the number of rejected units per million units received. Critical quality metric.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Normalized score for quality performance based on rejection rates and quality incidents, weighted to contribute to overall score.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Strategic recommendation for supplier relationship management based on scorecard results: maintain current relationship, develop capabilities, monitor closely, escalate issues, or delist supplier.

attributes.name: regulatory_adherence_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier compliance with regulatory requirements including SDS documentation, GMP standards, FDA regulations, EPA requirements, and REACH compliance.
attributes.references: FDA, EPA, EU REACH Regulation, ISO 22716 (GMP for Cosmetics)

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier responsiveness to inquiries, requests for quotation, change orders, and issue resolution. Based on response time and communication quality.

attributes.name: scorecard_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the supplier scorecard, typically following format SC-YYYYMMDD or similar.

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scorecard indicating its approval and publication state.

attributes.name: sustainability_compliance_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier adherence to sustainability requirements including FSC certification, RSPO compliance, environmental standards, and ethical sourcing practices.
attributes.references: FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), ISO 14001

attributes.name: total_po_count
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders issued to this supplier during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: total_purchase_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of purchases from this supplier during the evaluation period, used for spend-weighted analysis.

attributes.name: trend_vs_prior_period
attributes.description: Directional indicator showing whether overall performance improved, declined, or remained stable compared to the previous evaluation period.

products.name: sourcing_event
products.description: Strategic sourcing event or category review initiative managing the end-to-end sourcing process for a commodity or spend category. Captures event name, commodity category, spend category reference, event type (RFQ/reverse auction/e-auction/negotiation/sole-source justification), event owner, target savings, baseline spend, awarded savings, event timeline, number of suppliers invited/participated, and event outcome status. Supports category management, procurement savings tracking, and strategic sourcing governance.

attributes.name: sourcing_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sourcing event. Primary key.
