attributes.name: primary_sourcing_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the procurement professional or category manager responsible for managing this sourcing event.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Project‑Driven Sourcing links each sourcing event to the R&D project it aims to support.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing event was approved by the appropriate authority.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the sourcing event by procurement leadership or governance committee: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized to proceed), or rejected (not authorized).

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing event was awarded to the winning supplier(s). Null until award decision is made.

attributes.name: awarded_savings_amount
attributes.description: Actual savings amount achieved based on awarded supplier bids compared to baseline spend. Null until event is awarded.

attributes.name: baseline_spend_amount
attributes.description: Historical or current annual spend amount for the commodity or category being sourced, used as the baseline for calculating savings. Expressed in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: bid_close_date
attributes.description: Date when the bidding window closes and no further supplier responses are accepted.

attributes.name: bid_open_date
attributes.description: Date when the bidding window opens and suppliers can begin submitting responses.

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: Primary commodity or material category being sourced (e.g., 'Raw Materials - Palm Oil', 'Packaging - Plastic Bottles', 'Indirect - MRO Supplies'). Aligns with procurement category taxonomy.

attributes.name: competitive_bidding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sourcing event involves competitive bidding among multiple suppliers (true) or is a sole-source/single-source procurement (false).

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end date for the contract resulting from this sourcing event.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual start date for the contract resulting from this sourcing event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sourcing event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this sourcing event (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the sourcing event scope, objectives, requirements, and any special terms or conditions communicated to suppliers.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the sourcing event, typically including the commodity or category being sourced (e.g., 'Q2 2024 Packaging Materials RFQ', 'Annual Palm Oil Sourcing').

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the sourcing event, typically formatted as SE-YYYYNNNN for external reference and communication with suppliers.

attributes.name: event_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the sourcing event: awarded (supplier selected), no_award (no suitable bids), cancelled (event terminated), extended (timeline extended), or rebid (reissued).

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sourcing event: draft (being prepared), published (sent to suppliers), open (accepting bids), closed (bidding ended), awarded (supplier selected), or cancelled.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of sourcing event mechanism used: RFQ (Request for Quotation), RFP (Request for Proposal), RFI (Request for Information), reverse auction, e-auction, negotiation, sole-source justification, or single-source. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rfq|rfp|rfi|reverse_auction|e_auction|negotiation|sole_source|single_source — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sourcing event record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: procurement_organization
attributes.description: Procurement organization or business unit conducting the sourcing event (e.g., 'Global Procurement', 'Regional Procurement - EMEA', 'Category Management - Raw Materials').

attributes.name: publish_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing event was published and made available to invited suppliers.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Risk classification of the sourcing event based on supply continuity, financial exposure, regulatory compliance, and business impact: low, medium, high, or critical.

attributes.name: sole_source_justification
attributes.description: Business justification for sole-source or single-source procurement when competitive bidding is not used. Required for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this sourcing event data originated (e.g., 'SAP MM', 'Oracle Procurement Cloud', 'Ariba Sourcing').

attributes.name: spend_category_code
attributes.description: Standardized spend category classification code used for procurement analytics and reporting. Links to enterprise spend taxonomy.

attributes.name: strategic_initiative_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sourcing event is part of a strategic procurement initiative or transformation program (e.g., supplier consolidation, dual sourcing, regionalization).

attributes.name: suppliers_awarded_count
attributes.description: Number of suppliers awarded business as a result of this sourcing event. May be greater than 1 for multi-award scenarios.

attributes.name: suppliers_invited_count
attributes.description: Total number of suppliers invited to participate in the sourcing event.

attributes.name: suppliers_participated_count
attributes.description: Number of suppliers who submitted bids or responses to the sourcing event.

attributes.name: sustainability_criteria
attributes.description: Description of specific sustainability requirements or certifications required for this sourcing event (e.g., 'FSC-certified packaging', 'RSPO-certified palm oil', 'carbon-neutral shipping').

attributes.name: sustainability_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sourcing event includes mandatory sustainability criteria such as FSC certification, RSPO compliance, or other environmental/social governance requirements.

attributes.name: target_savings_amount
attributes.description: Target cost savings or cost avoidance amount that the sourcing event aims to achieve, expressed in the reporting currency.

products.name: spend_category
products.description: Hierarchical classification taxonomy for procurement spend categories covering raw materials (oils, surfactants, fragrances, actives, excipients), primary and secondary packaging, MRO, capex, and indirect services. Captures category code, category name, parent category, category level (L1/L2/L3/L4), commodity type, applicable regulatory frameworks (REACH, FDA, RSPO), preferred sourcing strategy, and category owner. Enables spend analytics, category management, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: spend_category_id
attributes.description: Primary key for spend_category

attributes.name: category_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the procurement category manager responsible for strategy, supplier relationships, and performance for this category.

attributes.name: parent_category_spend_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent spend category in the hierarchical taxonomy. Null for top-level (L1) categories.

attributes.name: annual_spend_budget_amount
attributes.description: Planned annual procurement spend budget for this category in base currency (USD). Used for budget tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the spend category in procurement systems. Used as the business identifier for category classification and reporting.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the spend category scope, including materials, services, and goods covered under this classification.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the category in the spend taxonomy (L1=top level, L2=sub-category, L3=detailed category, L4=granular classification).

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the spend category (e.g., Surfactants, Primary Packaging, MRO Supplies).

attributes.name: category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the spend category in the procurement taxonomy (active=in use, inactive=deprecated, under_review=being evaluated, consolidating=merging with other categories, phasing_out=being eliminated).

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the commodity type covered by this category (raw materials, packaging, maintenance/repair/operations, capital expenditure, indirect services, logistics, professional services). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|packaging|mro|capex|indirect_service|logistics|professional_service — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_coverage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of category spend covered by formal contracts or pricing agreements (0-100). Higher coverage indicates better spend management.

attributes.name: cost_savings_target_percentage
attributes.description: Annual cost reduction target for this category as a percentage of baseline spend. Used for procurement performance management.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this category record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this spend category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for spend budget and reporting (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this category classification is no longer effective. Null for currently active categories.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this category classification became effective in the procurement taxonomy.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this category record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this spend category record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent category strategy review and performance assessment.

attributes.name: lead_time_days_typical
attributes.description: Average procurement lead time in days for materials in this category from purchase order to goods receipt.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Material group classification from ERP system (SAP MM material group) for raw materials and packaging components.

attributes.name: moq_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether minimum order quantity constraints typically apply to materials in this category.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next category strategy review and supplier performance evaluation.

attributes.name: preferred_sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Recommended sourcing approach for this category (single source, dual source, multi-source, spot buy, strategic partnership, vendor managed inventory, consignment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_source|dual_source|multi_source|spot_buy|strategic_partnership|vmi|consignment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: procurement_organization
attributes.description: Procurement organizational unit responsible for managing this category (e.g., Global Procurement, Regional Procurement EMEA, Direct Materials Procurement).

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Three-character purchasing group code from ERP system responsible for operational procurement activities in this category.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of applicable regulatory frameworks governing materials in this category (e.g., REACH, FDA CFR 21, RSPO, FSC, ISO 22716). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REACH|FDA|RSPO|FSC|ISO_22716|GMP|IFRA|EPA|CPSC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation, FDA CFR, RSPO Standards, FSC Certification, ISO 22716

attributes.name: risk_profile
attributes.description: Supply risk assessment for this category considering supplier concentration, market volatility, geopolitical factors, and regulatory complexity.

attributes.name: sds_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials in this category require Safety Data Sheet documentation for regulatory compliance and workplace safety.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, EU CLP Regulation

attributes.name: spend_visibility_level
attributes.description: Classification of spend data visibility and tracking maturity for this category (high=fully tracked and managed, medium=partially tracked, low=limited visibility).

attributes.name: strategic_importance
attributes.description: Business criticality classification of this category to operations and product quality (critical=business-critical materials, strategic=high-value/high-risk, tactical=moderate importance, non-critical=low impact).

attributes.name: supplier_consolidation_target
attributes.description: Target number of preferred suppliers for this category as part of supplier rationalization strategy.

attributes.name: sustainable_sourcing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category is subject to sustainable sourcing requirements (e.g., FSC-certified paper, RSPO-certified palm oil, conflict-free minerals).

attributes.name: unspsc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC)
attributes.description: Eight-digit UNSPSC code for global commodity classification alignment and cross-industry spend benchmarking.

products.name: approved_supplier_list
products.description: Approved Supplier List (ASL) entry defining which suppliers are authorized to supply specific materials or spend categories to specific plants. Captures material/category, supplier, plant, approval status (approved/conditional/blocked/delisted), approval date, re-evaluation due date, approval basis (audit/certification/qualification test), and blocking reason. Enforces sourcing compliance and prevents unauthorized supplier usage in PO creation.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Source List (ME01 / EORD) / Approved Supplier List

attributes.name: approved_supplier_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approved supplier list entry. Primary key for the ASL record.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Project‑Specific Approved Supplier List ensures only vetted suppliers are used for a given R&D project.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Safety Data Sheet document for hazardous materials supplied by this supplier. Links to document management system. Required for chemicals, fragrances, and hazardous substances per OSHA and REACH regulations.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific material or spend category that the supplier is approved to provide. Links to material master or category taxonomy.

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master purchasing contract or framework agreement governing this supplier-material relationship. Links to contract management system.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier authorized to supply materials or services. Links to the supplier master record.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the person or committee who authorized the supplier approval. Provides accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_basis
attributes.description: Method or evidence used to grant supplier approval. Audit = on-site supplier audit; Certification = third-party certification (ISO, FSC, RSPO); Qualification test = material sample testing; Performance review = historical performance analysis; Risk assessment = supply chain risk evaluation; Legacy approval = pre-existing authorization.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier was approved for this material-plant combination. Represents the effective start of authorization.

attributes.name: approval_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current approval expires and requires re-evaluation. Null indicates indefinite approval subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current authorization status of the supplier for this material-plant combination. Approved = full authorization; Conditional = approved with restrictions; Blocked = temporarily prohibited; Delisted = permanently removed; Pending = under evaluation; Suspended = on hold pending review.

attributes.name: blocking_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier was blocked, delisted, or suspended. Null when status is approved, conditional, or pending.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the supplier is blocked, delisted, or suspended. Includes quality issues, compliance violations, delivery failures, financial instability, or ethical concerns. Null when status is approved or conditional.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory and policy compliance status for this supplier-material combination. Compliant = meets all requirements; Non-compliant = violations identified; Under review = compliance assessment in progress; Exempted = waiver granted.
attributes.references: FDA, EPA, REACH, OSHA Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: conditional_terms
attributes.description: Specific restrictions or requirements when approval status is conditional. Examples: reduced order quantities, enhanced inspection, expedited payment terms, or geographic limitations. Null when status is not conditional.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASL entry was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delivery_rating
attributes.description: Supplier delivery performance rating for this material-plant combination. A = excellent (>95% OTIF); B = good (90-95% OTIF); C = acceptable (85-90% OTIF); D = marginal (80-85% OTIF); F = failing (<80% OTIF).
attributes.references: On Time In Full (OTIF) Performance Standard

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic purchase orders and confirmations are enabled for this supplier-material-plant combination. True = EDI transactions supported; False = manual processing.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming goods from this supplier-material combination require quality inspection before goods receipt posting. True = inspection mandatory; False = direct posting allowed.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Control, SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier audit or site visit for this material-plant combination. Used to track audit currency and schedule follow-ups.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this ASL entry. Tracks change accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASL entry was last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from PO issuance to goods receipt for this supplier-material-plant combination. Used for MRP and demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Requirements Planning (MRP)

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier for this material-plant combination. Used to enforce purchasing constraints in PO creation.

attributes.name: moq_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity. Examples: KG (kilograms), EA (each), LT (liters), MT (metric tons). Follows ISO 80000 or UN/CEFACT standards.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier audit or site visit. Drives proactive supplier quality management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the supplier approval, special handling instructions, historical issues, or other relevant information for procurement and quality teams.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution facility code where the supplier is authorized to deliver. Follows GS1 GLN or internal plant coding standard.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the preferred source for this material-plant combination. True = preferred supplier with priority allocation; False = approved but not preferred.

attributes.name: price_validity_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current pricing agreement. Null indicates open-ended pricing subject to change notification.

attributes.name: price_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current pricing agreement for this supplier-material-plant combination. Used to enforce valid pricing periods in PO creation.

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Supplier quality performance rating for this material-plant combination. A = excellent (>98% acceptance); B = good (95-98%); C = acceptable (90-95%); D = marginal (85-90%); F = failing (<85%). Derived from quality inspection results.

attributes.name: re_evaluation_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier performance review or qualification audit. Drives proactive supplier management activities.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Supply chain risk classification for this supplier-material-plant combination. Low = stable supply, multiple sources; Medium = moderate dependency; High = single source or volatile region; Critical = business-critical material with supply constraints.

attributes.name: sole_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the only approved source for this material-plant combination. True = sole source (supply risk); False = multiple sources available.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability certifications held by the supplier for this material. Pipe-separated list of certifications: FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, B Corp, Carbon Neutral. Supports sustainable sourcing initiatives.

attributes.name: vmi_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier-material-plant combination is eligible for Vendor Managed Inventory programs. True = VMI enabled; False = traditional procurement.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this ASL entry. Provides accountability and audit trail.

products.name: supplier_qualification
products.description: Supplier qualification and audit record documenting the formal assessment of a supplier's capability, quality systems, and compliance before onboarding or re-qualification. Captures qualification type (initial/periodic/for-cause), audit date, audit scope, auditor name, audit findings count by severity (critical/major/minor), overall qualification result (qualified/conditional/failed), corrective action required flag, and next qualification due date. Supports GMP, ISO 9001, and regulatory compliance requirements.
products.reference: Veeva Vault Quality / SAP QM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: supplier_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier being qualified. Links to the supplier master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification result was formally approved by the authorized quality or procurement manager.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality manager or procurement director who formally approved the qualification result and authorized the supplier status change.

attributes.name: approved_material_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of material categories or product types that the supplier is qualified to provide based on this assessment. Examples include raw materials, packaging components, finished goods, indirect materials.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification audit or assessment was conducted. Primary business event timestamp for the qualification activity.

attributes.name: audit_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the audit concluded. Used to calculate total audit duration and resource allocation.

attributes.name: audit_method
attributes.description: Method used to conduct the qualification audit. On-site for physical facility visits, remote for virtual assessments, hybrid for combination, document review for paper-based evaluation, self-assessment for supplier-submitted questionnaires.

attributes.name: audit_report_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the detailed audit report document stored in the document management system. Links to the full audit findings, evidence, and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Description of the areas, processes, and systems covered in the qualification audit. May include manufacturing facilities, quality systems, environmental controls, documentation practices, and specific product categories.

attributes.name: audit_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the on-site or remote audit commenced. Used for detailed audit scheduling and duration tracking.

attributes.name: auditor_certification
attributes.description: Professional certifications held by the lead auditor, such as Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Lead Auditor ISO 9001, or other relevant credentials.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead auditor or assessment team leader who conducted the qualification. May be internal quality personnel or third-party auditor.

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Organization or company that the auditor represents. May be internal (company name) or external third-party audit firm.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when all required corrective actions were verified as complete and closed. Null if corrective actions are still open or not required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the supplier must complete and submit evidence of corrective actions for identified findings. Null if no corrective actions are required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier must implement corrective actions to address findings before full qualification is granted. True for conditional qualifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this qualification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical non-conformances identified during the audit. Critical findings represent severe quality or compliance issues that pose immediate risk and typically result in failed qualification.

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier demonstrated compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice standards during the qualification audit. Critical for suppliers of ingredients, packaging, and finished goods in regulated consumer goods categories.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: iso_9001_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier demonstrated compliance with ISO 9001 Quality Management System standards during the qualification audit.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this qualification record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes throughout the qualification lifecycle.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the audit. Major findings represent significant quality system gaps that require corrective action but may allow conditional qualification.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformances or observations identified during the audit. Minor findings represent opportunities for improvement that do not prevent qualification.

attributes.name: next_qualification_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic re-qualification or audit. Typically set based on qualification type and risk rating, commonly 1-3 years from current qualification.

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: Number of general observations or recommendations noted during the audit that are not formal non-conformances but represent best practice suggestions.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the overall qualification assessment result, typically on a 0-100 scale. Used for supplier performance benchmarking and comparison.

attributes.name: qualification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the auditor regarding the qualification assessment, including strengths, concerns, special conditions, or context for the qualification decision.

attributes.name: qualification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the qualification event. Externally visible reference number used in audit documentation and supplier communications.

attributes.name: qualification_result
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the qualification assessment. Qualified indicates full approval, conditional indicates approval with corrective actions required, failed indicates supplier did not meet requirements, pending indicates assessment incomplete, not assessed indicates qualification was cancelled or not performed.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the qualification process. Tracks the workflow state from scheduling through completion.

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Type of qualification assessment being performed. Initial for new supplier onboarding, periodic for scheduled re-assessments, for-cause for triggered audits due to quality issues, re-qualification for suppliers returning after suspension, pre-qualification for preliminary assessment, special for ad-hoc evaluations.

attributes.name: qualification_valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the qualification status. Date from which the supplier is considered qualified to supply materials or services.

attributes.name: qualification_valid_until_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the qualification status. Date after which the qualification is no longer valid and re-qualification is required. Null for indefinite qualifications pending periodic review.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier demonstrated compliance with applicable regulatory requirements such as FDA, EPA, REACH, or other jurisdiction-specific regulations relevant to the materials or services being qualified.
attributes.references: FDA Food and Drug Administration, EPA Environmental Protection Agency, EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: sds_documentation_verified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Documentation Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier provided complete and compliant Safety Data Sheets for all chemical materials and ingredients. Critical for raw material and packaging suppliers.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration, GHS Globally Harmonized System

attributes.name: sustainability_criteria_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier met sustainability and responsible sourcing criteria during qualification, including certifications such as FSC, RSPO, or environmental management practices.
attributes.references: FSC Forest Stewardship Council, RSPO Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil, ISO 14001 Environmental Management

products.name: procurement_vmi_agreement
products.description: Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreement defining the terms under which a supplier manages and replenishes inventory of raw materials or packaging at a Consumer Goods plant or warehouse. Captures VMI agreement number, supplier, material scope, managed location, min/max inventory levels, replenishment trigger (min stock/forecast-driven), review frequency, VMI start and end dates, consignment flag, ownership transfer trigger, and VMI performance SLA. Supports lean inventory and supply continuity strategies.
products.reference: VMI / Consignment Stock Agreement (SAP MM Special Stock)

attributes.name: procurement_vmi_agreement2_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the vmi_agreement association

attributes.name: procurement_vmi_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Procurement Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) Agreement ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the VMI agreement record.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the distribution facility in the VMI agreement

attributes.name: responsible_buyer_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who manages inventory under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific supplier site responsible for VMI replenishment under this agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the VMI agreement, typically indicating the supplier, material category, and managed location.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the VMI agreement, used in procurement documents and supplier communications.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VMI agreement based on the category of materials managed (raw materials, packaging, indirect goods, MRO, or finished goods).

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VMI agreement automatically renews at the end of its term unless either party provides termination notice.

attributes.name: consignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory under this VMI agreement is held on consignment, where the supplier retains ownership until consumption by Consumer Goods.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master procurement contract or purchase agreement that governs the commercial terms underlying this VMI arrangement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this VMI agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code used for pricing and payment under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether EDI is used for automated exchange of VMI inventory data, replenishment orders, and consumption reports between Consumer Goods and the supplier.

attributes.name: edi_message_types
attributes.description: The specific EDI message types used for VMI transactions (e.g., 846 Inventory Inquiry, 852 Product Activity Data, 850 Purchase Order).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the VMI agreement expires or is scheduled to terminate, after which the supplier is no longer responsible for inventory management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the VMI agreement becomes active and the supplier begins managing inventory at the specified location.

attributes.name: inventory_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure used for inventory levels in this VMI agreement (e.g., kilograms, liters, pallets, cases, each).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this VMI agreement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: managed_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Consumer Goods plant, warehouse, or distribution center where the supplier manages inventory under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: managed_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the Consumer Goods facility where VMI inventory is managed by the supplier.

attributes.name: material_scope
attributes.description: Description of the materials, SKUs, or product categories covered under this VMI agreement, defining what the supplier is responsible for replenishing.

attributes.name: max_inventory_level
attributes.description: The maximum inventory quantity allowed at the managed location, defining the upper limit for supplier replenishment to avoid overstocking.

attributes.name: min_inventory_level
attributes.description: The minimum inventory quantity that must be maintained at the managed location, triggering replenishment when stock falls below this threshold.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the VMI agreement, including any unique operational requirements or exceptions.

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_trigger
attributes.description: The event that triggers transfer of inventory ownership from the supplier to Consumer Goods (e.g., goods receipt, consumption, withdrawal, invoice receipt, or time-based).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms for VMI inventory, specifying when payment is due after ownership transfer (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, upon consumption).

attributes.name: performance_review_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which Consumer Goods and the supplier conduct formal performance reviews of the VMI agreement against SLA targets.

attributes.name: procurement_vmi_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VMI agreement indicating whether it is in draft, actively managing inventory, suspended, terminated, or expired.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of days advance notice required to terminate or modify the VMI agreement before its renewal date.

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days required for the supplier to replenish inventory from order placement to delivery at the managed location.

attributes.name: replenishment_model
attributes.description: The inventory replenishment strategy used by the supplier under this VMI agreement (min/max levels, forecast-driven, consumption-based, kanban, or continuous replenishment).

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the supplier reviews inventory levels and triggers replenishment orders under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: sla_fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Fill Rate Target Percentage
attributes.description: The target fill rate percentage the supplier must achieve under this VMI agreement, representing the percentage of demand that must be met from available inventory.

attributes.name: sla_otif_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: The target OTIF percentage the supplier must achieve for VMI replenishments, measuring the percentage of deliveries that arrive on time and in full quantity.

attributes.name: sla_stockout_tolerance_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Stockout Tolerance Days
attributes.description: The maximum number of days per period that stockouts are tolerated under this VMI agreement before SLA penalties apply.

attributes.name: supplier_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary supplier contact for VMI operations.

attributes.name: supplier_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary supplier contact responsible for VMI operations and replenishment under this agreement.

attributes.name: supplier_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary supplier contact for VMI operations and issue escalation.

attributes.name: target_inventory_level
attributes.description: The optimal inventory quantity the supplier should maintain at the managed location, balancing availability and carrying costs.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the VMI agreement was terminated, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for termination if the VMI agreement status is terminated, providing context for the end of the supplier-managed inventory arrangement.

products.name: price_condition
products.description: Procurement price conditions and pricing records maintained for materials and services sourced from suppliers, including base prices, surcharges, freight conditions, and discounts. Captures condition type (base price/freight/surcharge/discount/tax), supplier, material, plant, validity start and end dates, condition value, condition unit, scale quantity breaks, and price determination sequence. Enables accurate PO pricing, COGS calculation, and price variance analysis.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record / Condition Record (MEK1 / KONP)

attributes.name: price_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price condition record. Primary key for the price condition entity.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this price condition is applicable.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RFQ process that resulted in this price condition. Null for non-RFQ pricing.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or service for which this price condition applies.

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier contract under which this price condition is established. Null for non-contract pricing.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier providing the material or service under this price condition.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price condition was formally approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person who approved this price condition.

attributes.name: approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price condition has been formally approved for use in purchase orders (True/False).

attributes.name: calculation_type
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the condition value (fixed amount, percentage, quantity-based scale, value-based scale).

attributes.name: condition_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the condition (price, discount, surcharge, freight, tax) for grouping and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: condition_record_number
attributes.description: The unique business identifier for this price condition record in the source procurement system.

attributes.name: condition_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this condition is applied within the pricing procedure (lower numbers applied first).

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price condition (active, inactive, pending approval, expired, superseded by newer condition).

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: The category of pricing element this condition represents (base price, freight, surcharge, discount, tax, rebate, duty, handling, insurance, packaging). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_price|freight|surcharge|discount|tax|rebate|duty|handling|insurance|packaging — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: condition_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the condition value (e.g., per kilogram, per piece, per liter, percentage).

attributes.name: condition_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the price condition (price per unit, discount percentage, surcharge amount, etc.).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price condition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the condition value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: The Incoterms rule applicable to this price condition, defining delivery and cost responsibilities (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP).

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The specific location or port associated with the Incoterms rule (e.g., FOB Shanghai, CIF New York).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price condition record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity required for this price condition to be applicable.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the user who last modified this price condition record.

attributes.name: moq_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the minimum order quantity (e.g., EA, KG, L).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this price condition, including special terms, negotiation context, or usage instructions.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code associated with this price condition (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: per_unit_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity basis for the condition value (e.g., price per 100 units, per 1000 kg).

attributes.name: per_unit_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure corresponding to the per unit quantity (e.g., EA, KG, L).

attributes.name: price_determination_rule
attributes.description: The business rule or formula used to determine the final price when multiple conditions apply (e.g., lowest price, weighted average, last price).

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: The origin or method by which this price condition was established (contract, RFQ, supplier catalog, negotiated, spot purchase, market index).

attributes.name: pricing_procedure
attributes.description: The pricing procedure schema that determines the sequence and calculation logic for applying this condition.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: The buyer group or team responsible for managing this price condition and supplier relationship.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: The organizational unit responsible for procurement activities under this price condition.

attributes.name: scale_basis
attributes.description: The basis for tiered pricing scales (none for flat pricing, quantity, value, weight, volume for scale-based pricing).

attributes.name: scale_quantity_from
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold for this price scale tier. Null for non-scaled pricing.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_to
attributes.description: The maximum quantity threshold for this price scale tier. Null for open-ended tiers.

attributes.name: scale_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for scale quantity thresholds (e.g., EA, KG, L).

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax classification code applicable to this price condition for tax calculation purposes.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The geographic tax jurisdiction applicable to this price condition (country, state, or local tax authority).

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this price condition is no longer valid. Null for open-ended conditions.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this price condition becomes effective and can be applied to purchase orders.

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Scheduled delivery lines (schedule lines) against a purchase order or scheduling agreement specifying planned delivery dates and quantities for raw materials and packaging. Captures schedule line number, planned delivery date, confirmed delivery date, scheduled quantity, confirmed quantity, delivery status (scheduled/confirmed/partially received/complete), and transport mode. Supports MRP, DRP, and production scheduling by providing confirmed inbound supply commitments.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement Schedule Lines (EKET)

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery schedule line. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Delivery schedule assigns a carrier to each scheduled delivery, enabling carrier performance tracking and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material (raw material, packaging component, or indirect good) being scheduled for delivery.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order or scheduling agreement to which this delivery schedule line belongs.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Project Delivery Planning schedules deliveries based on the timeline of the associated R&D project.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.sds. Business justification: Delivery schedules include the SDS ID to ensure carriers handle hazardous materials according to regulations.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier responsible for delivering the scheduled material.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the material was received at the plant, captured from goods receipt transactions.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Shipping Notice number sent by the supplier via EDI or portal, providing advance notification of this delivery.

attributes.name: atp_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule line is considered in Available to Promise (ATP) calculations for downstream order promising.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer batch or lot number for the material being delivered, critical for traceability and quality management.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why goods receipt is blocked for this schedule line, if applicable.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the supplier has confirmed, rejected, or revised this schedule line.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supplier confirmed this delivery schedule line.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier, which may differ from the scheduled date based on supplier capacity or logistics constraints.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material confirmed by the supplier for delivery. May differ from scheduled quantity based on supplier capacity or constraints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this delivery schedule line was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for any monetary values associated with this delivery schedule line.

attributes.name: delivery_instruction
attributes.description: Special handling or delivery instructions for this schedule line (e.g., dock requirements, unloading equipment, temperature control).

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Supplier-provided delivery note or packing slip number accompanying this shipment.

attributes.name: delivery_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this delivery schedule line, used for expediting and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this delivery schedule line indicating progress from scheduling through receipt. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|confirmed|in_transit|partially_received|fully_received|cancelled|delayed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Acceptable over-delivery or under-delivery tolerance as a percentage of scheduled quantity, per contract terms.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date of the material batch being delivered, critical for shelf-life management in consumer goods.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_blocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether goods receipt is blocked for this schedule line due to quality, compliance, or commercial issues.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterms code defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and supplier for this delivery (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this delivery schedule line was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days between order placement and scheduled delivery for this schedule line.

attributes.name: mrp_element_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule line is an active MRP element used in material requirements planning calculations.

attributes.name: outstanding_quantity
attributes.description: The remaining quantity yet to be received, calculated as confirmed quantity minus received quantity.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the receiving manufacturing plant or distribution center for this delivery.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery requires quality inspection before goods receipt can be completed.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material received against this schedule line through goods receipt transactions.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date requested by the purchasing organization or production planning, which may differ from the scheduled date based on MRP or DRP requirements.

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the purchase order identifying this specific delivery schedule. Used for ordering and referencing individual schedule lines.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The originally planned delivery date for this schedule line as specified in the purchase order or scheduling agreement.

attributes.name: scheduled_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material originally scheduled for delivery on this schedule line as per the purchase order or scheduling agreement.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the specific storage location within the plant where the material will be received.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of this schedule line, calculated as confirmed quantity multiplied by unit price.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Shipment tracking number provided by the carrier for monitoring delivery progress.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The primary mode of transportation used or planned for delivering this schedule line.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for all quantities on this schedule line (e.g., KG for kilograms, EA for each, L for liters).

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure for the material on this schedule line, as per the purchase order or contract.

products.name: po_confirmation
products.description: Supplier order acknowledgement and confirmation record for a purchase order, capturing the supplier's confirmed delivery date, confirmed quantity, any partial acceptance or substitution, and confirmation method (EDI 855/portal/email). Captures confirmation number, confirmation date, confirmed delivery date, confirmed quantity per line, variance from PO quantity, supplier reference number, and confirmation status. Enables OTIF tracking and proactive supply risk management.
products.reference: EDI 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgement / SAP MM Order Acknowledgement

attributes.name: po_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order confirmation record. Primary key for the po_confirmation product.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original purchase order that this confirmation acknowledges. Links to the purchase order header.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier providing the confirmation. Links to the supplier master data.

attributes.name: buyer_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the buyer approved or rejected the confirmation. Null if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: buyer_approval_notes
attributes.description: Notes or comments entered by the buyer during the approval or rejection process. Captures buyer feedback on variances or special conditions.

attributes.name: buyer_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the confirmation requires explicit buyer approval before proceeding. True when there are significant variances, substitutions, or price changes that need buyer review.

attributes.name: buyer_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of buyer approval for confirmations that require review. Tracks whether the buyer has accepted or rejected the supplier's confirmed terms.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier or freight forwarder that the supplier will use for shipment. Provided in confirmation for shipment tracking and coordination.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier issued the confirmation acknowledgement. Represents the business date of confirmation, not the system receipt timestamp.

attributes.name: confirmation_method
attributes.description: Method or channel through which the supplier submitted the confirmation. EDI 855 is the standard electronic acknowledgement, but portal, email, and manual methods are also tracked.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number assigned by the supplier to this order acknowledgement. Used for supplier reference and tracking.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the supplier confirmation indicating whether the order or line item was accepted, partially accepted, or rejected by the supplier.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the confirmation was received and recorded in the procurement system. Used for tracking confirmation lead time and system audit.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Delivery date confirmed by the supplier. May differ from requested date due to supplier capacity, lead time constraints, or material availability. Critical for OTIF tracking and supply risk management.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed by the supplier for delivery. May differ from requested quantity in cases of partial acceptance, substitution, or supplier capacity constraints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this confirmation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit price and total amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY.

attributes.name: delivery_date_variance_days
attributes.description: Number of days difference between confirmed delivery date and requested delivery date. Positive values indicate delay, negative values indicate early delivery commitment.

attributes.name: delivery_location_code
attributes.description: Specific delivery location or dock within the plant where goods should be delivered. May be a warehouse, storage location, or receiving dock identifier.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_number
attributes.description: Unique EDI transaction identifier for confirmations received via EDI 855. Null for non-EDI confirmations. Used for EDI audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk between buyer and supplier. Examples: EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP. Confirmed by supplier in acknowledgement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this confirmation record was last updated. Tracks changes to confirmation status, buyer approval, or other fields throughout the confirmation lifecycle.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Internal material code or SKU for the item being confirmed. Links to material master data for product identification.

attributes.name: otif_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation represents a risk to OTIF performance. True when confirmed delivery date is later than requested or confirmed quantity is less than requested, signaling potential supply disruption.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the receiving plant or facility for the confirmed delivery. Used for logistics planning and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: po_line_item_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the purchase order that this confirmation applies to. Enables line-level confirmation tracking.

attributes.name: promised_ship_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier commits to ship the goods. Used for in-transit tracking and logistics planning.

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the requested and confirmed quantities. Examples include EA (each), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), L (liter), CS (case), PLT (pallet).

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: Difference between confirmed quantity and requested quantity (confirmed minus requested). Positive values indicate over-confirmation, negative values indicate under-confirmation or rejection.

attributes.name: quantity_variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance between confirmed and requested quantity, calculated as (quantity_variance / requested_quantity) * 100. Used for supplier performance tracking and OTIF analysis.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for partial or full rejection of the purchase order line. Populated when confirmation_status is rejected or partially_accepted. Examples: capacity_constraint, material_unavailable, price_dispute, discontinued_product.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description of the rejection reason provided by the supplier. Provides additional context beyond the standardized rejection reason code.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Original delivery date requested in the purchase order. Used as baseline for on-time delivery tracking.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity requested in the purchase order for this line item. Used as baseline for variance calculation.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Additional instructions or notes from the supplier regarding the confirmation, delivery requirements, handling instructions, or other special conditions.

attributes.name: substitute_material_code
attributes.description: Material code of the substitute product proposed by the supplier. Populated only when substitution_flag is True. Requires buyer approval before acceptance.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is proposing a substitute material or product in place of the originally requested item. True if substitution is proposed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: supplier_material_code
attributes.description: Supplier's material code or part number for the item. Used for cross-reference and supplier catalog mapping.

attributes.name: supplier_reference_number
attributes.description: Supplier's internal reference number for this order or line item. May be a sales order number, production order number, or other supplier-side tracking identifier.

attributes.name: total_line_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for this confirmation line, calculated as confirmed_quantity * unit_price. Used for financial reconciliation and invoice matching.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number or waybill number for the shipment. May be provided at confirmation time for pre-arranged shipments or updated later when goods are shipped.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Confirmed unit price for the material as acknowledged by the supplier. Should match the purchase order price unless price changes are negotiated.

products.name: procurement_vmi_agreement2
products.description: Represents a VMI agreement between a supplier and a distribution facility, capturing inventory targets and SLA metrics that are managed as a contract entity.. Existence Justification: Suppliers and distribution facilities enter Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreements where each supplier can serve multiple facilities and each facility can work with multiple suppliers. The agreement records inventory targets and service‑level metrics, which are actively created, maintained, and queried by both procurement and distribution teams.

attributes.name: procurement_vmi_agreement2_id
attributes.description: Primary key for procurement_vmi_agreement2

products.name: service_entry_sheet_line
products.description: Master reference table for service_entry_sheet_line. Referenced by service_entry_sheet_line_id.

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for service_entry_sheet_line

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contract under which the service is provided.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the purchase order linked to this service line.

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent service entry sheet (header).

attributes.name: service_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the service or activity recorded on this line.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier providing the service.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the line was approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier who approved the service entry line.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the line record was created.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for monetary values.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount applied to this line.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the service line becomes effective.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the service line expires or is no longer valid.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total amount before taxes and discounts (quantity * unit_price).

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number associated with the service line.

attributes.name: is_vmi
attributes.description: Indicates if the service is part of a Vendor Managed Inventory program.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequence number of the line within the service entry sheet.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the line.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount after tax and discount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes for the line.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the service units delivered.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the service was received or acknowledged.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the service performed.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability certification applicable to the service.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount applied to this line.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity.

attributes.name: unit_price
