attributes.name: validation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the redemption has been validated against promotion rules and eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the redemption record was validated or rejected.

products.name: consumer_offer
products.description: Master entity defining consumer-facing promotional offers (coupons, digital offers, loyalty rewards, instant rebates, free goods with purchase) that are part of a trade promotion or brand marketing program. Captures offer code, offer type, offer description, discount value/percentage, qualifying SKUs, minimum purchase requirement, offer validity period, distribution channel (FSI, digital, in-store, DTC app), maximum redemption limit, and offer status. Distinct from trade funding — this entity owns the consumer-facing offer definition.

attributes.name: consumer_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consumer-facing promotional offer. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the broader marketing campaign that this consumer offer supports. Links to the marketing campaign entity. Null if not part of a campaign.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category associated with this consumer offer. Links to the product category master data entity.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand associated with this consumer offer. Links to the brand master data entity.

attributes.name: primary_consumer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this consumer offer. Links to the user or employee master data entity. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Consumer offers for new product launches are created under the umbrella of the related R&D project.

attributes.name: target_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.consumer_segment. Business justification: Required for Offer‑to‑Segment targeting report; marketers need to join offers with consumer segments to measure lift and compliance.

attributes.name: tertiary_consumer_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this consumer offer record. Links to the user or employee master data entity.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent trade promotion program that this consumer offer is part of. Links to the trade promotion entity. Null if offer is standalone.

attributes.name: actual_cost_incurred
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred from all redemptions of this offer to date. Used for budget variance analysis and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: actual_redemption_count
attributes.description: Actual number of times this offer has been redeemed by consumers to date. Updated in near real-time from POS (Point of Sale) and e-commerce systems.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the consumer offer in the governance workflow. Pending = awaiting review; Approved = authorized for activation; Rejected = not approved.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the consumer offer was approved. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode value associated with the consumer offer for scanning at POS (Point of Sale). May be UPC (Universal Product Code), EAN (European Article Number), or proprietary coupon barcode format.

attributes.name: consumer_offer_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the consumer offer including terms, conditions, and value proposition. Used for consumer communication and internal reference.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the offer is valid (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consumer offer record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the discount value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to qualifying purchase. Null if discount is fixed-value based. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 15.00 for 15% off).

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Fixed monetary discount amount provided by the offer in the specified currency. Null if discount is percentage-based.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which the consumer offer is distributed. FSI = Free Standing Insert (newspaper); Digital = online/web; In-Store = physical retail location; DTC App = Direct-to-Consumer mobile application; Email = email marketing; Social Media = social platforms; POS = Point of Sale display. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fsi|digital|in_store|dtc_app|email|social_media|pos — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: estimated_cost_per_redemption
attributes.description: Projected cost to the business for each redemption of this offer, including discount value and administrative costs. Used for budget planning and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Entity responsible for funding the consumer offer discount. Brand = manufacturer-funded; Trade = trade promotion budget; Co-op = cooperative funding between manufacturer and retailer; Retailer = retailer-funded.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the consumer offer. National = available across entire country; Regional = specific regions or states; Local = specific cities or markets; Store-Specific = individual retail locations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consumer offer record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: maximum_redemption_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this offer during the validity period. Null indicates unlimited redemptions.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum purchase value required to qualify for the offer. Null if no minimum purchase requirement exists.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying units or SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) that must be purchased to redeem the offer. Null if no quantity requirement exists.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the consumer offer for redemption tracking and identification. Used by consumers at point of sale or digital checkout.

attributes.name: offer_name
attributes.description: Marketing name or title of the consumer offer as displayed to consumers in promotional materials and digital channels.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consumer offer. Draft = under development; Approved = ready for activation; Active = currently redeemable; Paused = temporarily suspended; Expired = validity period ended; Cancelled = terminated before expiration.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consumer offer mechanism. Coupon = physical or digital coupon; Digital Offer = app-based or online promotion; Loyalty Reward = points-based redemption; Instant Rebate = immediate price reduction; Free Goods = complimentary product with purchase; BOGO = Buy One Get One; Bundle Discount = multi-product savings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coupon|digital_offer|loyalty_reward|instant_rebate|free_goods|bogo|bundle_discount — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualifying_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU identifiers or product codes that qualify for this offer. May reference specific products, product families, or categories. Null if offer applies to all products.

attributes.name: redemption_channel
attributes.description: Channel where the consumer can redeem the offer. In-Store = physical retail; Online = e-commerce website; Mobile App = DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) mobile application; Call Center = phone order; Any = omnichannel redemption allowed.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer can be combined with other offers or promotions. True = can be stacked; False = exclusive offer.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal terms and conditions governing the use and redemption of this consumer offer. Includes restrictions, exclusions, and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: total_budget_allocated
attributes.description: Total budget amount allocated for this consumer offer across all redemptions. Used for financial planning and spend tracking.

attributes.name: total_redemption_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total number of redemptions allowed across all customers for this offer. Null indicates no aggregate limit.

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer can be transferred or shared between consumers. True = transferable; False = non-transferable, tied to original recipient.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date when the consumer offer becomes active and redeemable. Consumers cannot redeem the offer before this date.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date when the consumer offer expires and is no longer redeemable. Consumers cannot redeem the offer after this date.

products.name: flight_allocation
products.description: This association captures the allocation of a promotion_event to a campaign_flight, including spend and volume metrics that are specific to the event‑flight pairing. Each record links one promotion_event to one campaign_flight and stores attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: A promotion_event represents a specific trade promotion execution at a retailer/store, while a campaign_flight represents a media flight for a marketing campaign. In practice, a single promotion_event can be linked to multiple campaign_flights (e.g., the same in‑store promotion is supported by TV, digital, and print flights), and a single campaign_flight can include many promotion_events across different retailers. The business tracks allocation of spend and volume per promotion_event‑flight pair, which is managed by planners as a distinct record.

attributes.name: flight_allocation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Promotion Flight Allocation - Promotion Flight Allocation Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the promotion_flight_allocation association

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Promotion Flight Allocation - Campaign Flight Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the campaign_flight

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Promotion Flight Allocation - Promotion Event Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the promotion_event

attributes.name: actual_volume_units
attributes.description: Realized sales volume for the promotion_event under this campaign_flight

attributes.name: allocated_spend_amount
attributes.description: Spend allocated to this promotion_event within the specific campaign_flight

attributes.name: planned_volume_units
attributes.description: Forecasted sales volume for the promotion_event under this campaign_flight

domains.name: marketing
domains.description: Owns brand management, consumer engagement campaigns, digital marketing, and market research. Manages campaign planning, media spend, creative assets, influencer partnerships, social media engagement, marketing attribution, brand health metrics, SOV (Share of Voice), SOM, consumer sentiment analysis, and Nielsen IQ panel insights.

products.name: marketing_brand
products.description: Master record for each brand in the Consumer Goods portfolio. Captures brand identity, positioning, architecture tier (masterbrand, subbrand, endorsed), target consumer segment, brand equity scores, SOV (Share of Voice) benchmarks, brand health KPI targets, and lifecycle stage. Serves as the SSOT for brand master data referenced across campaign, media, and trade promotion domains.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the brand record. Primary key for the brand master data product.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Required for brand‑level ESG reporting linking each brand to its sustainability commitments.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Brand‑level financial performance is tracked via a dedicated GL account for revenue and expense aggregation.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: BRAND MANAGER role is an employee; required for brand performance reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: parent_brand_marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent brand in the brand hierarchy. Null for masterbrand level. Used to establish brand family relationships and roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: primary_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Brand Supplier Management: each brand designates a primary supplier for sourcing, required for supplier performance and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: annual_marketing_budget
attributes.description: Total allocated marketing investment for the brand for the fiscal year, including media spend, trade promotion, consumer promotion, and agency fees.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target
attributes.description: Planned annual revenue goal for the brand in the base currency. Used for budget planning, performance tracking, and brand portfolio prioritization.

attributes.name: architecture_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the brand within the corporate brand architecture hierarchy. Masterbrand represents the corporate umbrella, subbrand is a distinct offering under the masterbrand, endorsed carries both corporate and product brand, ingredient brand is a component brand, private label is retailer-owned, and house brand is a proprietary store brand.

attributes.name: awareness_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of target consumers who recognize or recall the brand when prompted or unprompted. Measured through consumer surveys and market research panels.

attributes.name: brand_category
attributes.description: Primary product category or market segment in which the brand competes. Examples include personal care, household cleaning, health and wellness, beauty, food and beverage.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the brand for operational reference across systems. Used in SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) hierarchies, trade promotion systems, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: brand_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the brand's purpose, value proposition, and positioning in the market. Used for internal reference and marketing brief development.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The official registered name of the brand as it appears on product packaging, marketing materials, and consumer-facing communications.

attributes.name: brand_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the brand. Active indicates current market presence with ongoing marketing investment, inactive is temporarily paused, pending launch is approved but not yet in market, under review is strategic assessment phase, sunset is planned phase-out, and archived is historical record only.

attributes.name: consideration_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of target consumers who would consider purchasing the brand when making a category purchase decision. Key indicator of brand relevance and competitive positioning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the brand was officially discontinued or withdrawn from active marketing. Null for active brands. Used for portfolio rationalization reporting and historical analysis.

attributes.name: equity_score
attributes.description: Composite metric measuring the overall strength and value of the brand based on consumer awareness, perceived quality, brand associations, and loyalty. Typically scaled 0-100 with higher scores indicating stronger brand equity.

attributes.name: geographic_market_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the brand's distribution and marketing activities. Global indicates worldwide presence, regional covers multiple countries in a region, national is single-country, and local is sub-national markets.

attributes.name: guidelines_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Guidelines Document Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the comprehensive brand guidelines document containing logo usage, color specifications, typography, tone of voice, and visual identity standards.

attributes.name: is_licensed_brand
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the brand is operated under a licensing agreement from another entity. True indicates licensed brand, false indicates owned brand.

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the brand is a private label or store brand owned by a retail customer rather than the manufacturer. True indicates private label, false indicates manufacturer-owned brand.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the brand was first introduced to the market. Used for brand age calculations, anniversary campaigns, and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the brand in its market lifecycle. Development indicates pre-launch planning, launch is initial market introduction, growth is rapid expansion phase, maturity is stable market presence, decline is decreasing market share, revitalization is strategic renewal effort, and discontinued indicates end of active marketing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: development|launch|growth|maturity|decline|revitalization|discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: logo_asset_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Logo Asset Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official brand logo asset in the digital asset management system. Used for marketing materials, packaging design, and digital campaigns.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score measuring consumer willingness to recommend the brand to others. Calculated as percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors, ranging from -100 to +100.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Legal entity or business unit that owns the intellectual property rights to the brand. May differ from the manufacturing or distribution entity.

attributes.name: positioning_statement
attributes.description: Concise statement defining the brand's unique value proposition, competitive differentiation, and emotional benefit to the target consumer. Foundation for all marketing communications.

attributes.name: preference_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of target consumers who prefer this brand over competitive alternatives. Indicates brand loyalty and pricing power potential.

attributes.name: primary_color_hex
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the primary brand color used in packaging, marketing materials, and digital assets. Ensures consistent brand identity across touchpoints.

attributes.name: primary_distribution_channel
attributes.description: Main channel through which the brand reaches consumers. Examples include mass retail, specialty retail, e-commerce, DTC (Direct to Consumer), professional/salon, or foodservice.

attributes.name: som_percent
attributes.description: Brand's percentage of total category sales volume or value. Primary metric for competitive market position and growth tracking.

attributes.name: sov_percent
attributes.description: Brand's share of total advertising and promotional activity within the category, measured across paid media, earned media, and owned channels. Key indicator of marketing investment relative to competitors.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Specific subcategory within the broader brand category. Provides granular classification for competitive analysis and shelf placement strategy.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Third-party sustainability certifications or eco-labels associated with the brand, such as FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), or B Corp. Multiple certifications separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: FSC, RSPO, B Corp Certification Standards

attributes.name: target_consumer_segment
attributes.description: Primary demographic and psychographic profile of the intended consumer audience for the brand. Includes age range, income level, lifestyle attributes, and purchase behaviors.

attributes.name: target_som_percent
attributes.description: Strategic target for the brand's market share. Used for annual planning, performance evaluation, and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: target_sov_percent
attributes.description: Strategic target for the brand's share of voice in the category. Used for media planning and budget allocation decisions. Typically set to exceed current SOM (Share of Market) to drive growth.

attributes.name: trademark_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current trademark registration expires and requires renewal. Critical for maintaining legal protection of brand assets.

attributes.name: trademark_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic territories or countries where the brand trademark is registered and legally protected. May include multiple jurisdictions separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: WIPO Madrid System for International Trademark Registration

attributes.name: trademark_registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the trademark was officially registered with the relevant trademark authority. Used for renewal tracking and IP portfolio management.

attributes.name: trademark_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number assigned by the trademark authority for the brand name, logo, or other protected brand elements. Used for legal protection and IP (Intellectual Property) management.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial value of the brand as an intangible asset. Calculated using income, market, or cost approaches for financial reporting and M&A (Mergers and Acquisitions) purposes.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master record for each marketing campaign executed by Consumer Goods. Captures campaign name, type (ATL, BTL, digital, shopper, influencer, integrated), objective, target audience, brand association, channel mix, planned vs. actual media spend, campaign start/end dates, creative concept, campaign status, and owning brand/category. Sourced from Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and internal campaign management systems.
products.reference: Campaign Management / Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing campaign. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: FK to marketing.agency

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who approved this campaign for execution. Links to workforce/user master data.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category this campaign targets. Links to the category hierarchy.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Campaign expense allocation requires charging campaign spend to a specific cost center for budgeting.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Campaigns are often created to support specific ESG commitments; linking enables compliance tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Campaign costs are posted to a specific GL account to support detailed expense reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary brand being promoted in this campaign. Links to the brand master data.
attributes.references: Product and Brand Master Data Standards

attributes.name: primary_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Campaign planning and ROI attribution need a primary SKU reference to allocate budget and measure lift per product.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Campaign planning aligns with R&D product development projects to synchronize launch timing and messaging.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Campaigns are owned by a sales rep responsible for execution and alignment with sales activities.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Campaign Sponsorship Procurement: marketing campaigns often have a sponsoring supplier; linking enables sponsor spend tracking and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: target_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the predefined consumer segment this campaign is designed to reach. Links to consumer segmentation master data.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.trade_account. Business justification: Campaigns are often targeted to specific key trade accounts; the marketing team needs to link each campaign to the account for promotion planning and performance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign concluded. May differ from planned end date due to extensions, early termination, or performance-based adjustments.

attributes.name: actual_media_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual total media spend incurred for this campaign, in the company's reporting currency. Includes all paid media costs across channels.

attributes.name: actual_production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The actual cost incurred for creative production, including all content creation, design, video production, and asset development expenses.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign went live and began execution. May differ from planned start date due to operational adjustments.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign was formally approved for execution by authorized stakeholders, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify and track the campaign across systems, media buys, and analytics platforms.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards for Product and Campaign Identification

attributes.name: campaign_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the campaign's purpose, strategy, key messages, and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the marketing campaign as used in internal planning and external communications.

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the campaign: draft (initial planning), planned (scheduled), approved (ready for execution), active (currently running), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (finished), or cancelled (terminated before completion). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|planned|approved|active|paused|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the campaign by execution approach: ATL (Above The Line - mass media), BTL (Below The Line - targeted), digital (online channels), shopper (in-store/retail), influencer (social media partnerships), or integrated (multi-channel).

attributes.name: channel_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of marketing channels used in the campaign (e.g., TV, digital display, social media, print, radio, OOH, in-store).

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the campaign is executed (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: creative_concept
attributes.description: High-level description of the creative theme, messaging strategy, and visual identity used in the campaign.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this campaign record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the campaign: global (worldwide), regional (multi-country region), national (single country), or local (city/metro area).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the campaign is currently active (True) or inactive (False). Active campaigns are either running or scheduled to run.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign record was last updated or modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Primary business goal of the campaign: awareness (brand visibility), consideration (product evaluation), conversion (purchase), loyalty (retention), launch (new product introduction), or relaunch (product refresh).

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for campaign conclusion as defined during planning phase.

attributes.name: planned_media_spend_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted total media spend allocated to this campaign during the planning phase, in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: planned_production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted cost for creative production, including content creation, design, video production, and asset development.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for campaign launch as defined during planning phase.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this campaign record originated (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, internal campaign management system).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this campaign in the source operational system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Textual description of the intended consumer segment for this campaign, including demographic, psychographic, and behavioral characteristics.

products.name: campaign_flight
products.description: Transactional record of campaign execution at the flight level, capturing performance metrics across ALL channels (digital, TV, OOH, print, social, search, programmatic) at the campaign-channel-market-date grain. Defines scheduled media run dates, channel, market/geography, budget allocation, and flight-level performance targets. Captures planned and actual impressions, clicks, CTR, video views, view-through rate, conversions, CPC, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency, GRPs (traditional), and platform-specific metrics (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic DSP). A single campaign may have multiple flights across different channels or geographies. Sourced from digital ad platform APIs, agency post-buy reports, and media monitoring systems. Serves as the unified granular performance record for omnichannel campaign measurement.

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the campaign flight record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: FK to marketing.agency

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign. A single campaign may have multiple flights across different channels or geographies.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the creative asset used in this flight. Links to creative asset management system for creative performance analysis.

attributes.name: flight_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Flight manager (employee) oversees execution; essential for flight performance review and responsibility logs.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand being promoted in this flight. Enables brand-level campaign performance aggregation.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.retail_store. Business justification: Flight schedules are executed at individual retail stores; linking flight to store enables store‑level media execution tracking and OTIF reporting.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the flight media execution ended. Captures real execution timeline for post-campaign analysis.

attributes.name: actual_impressions
attributes.description: Actual number of impressions delivered during the flight. Core metric for reach and frequency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the flight media execution began. Used for variance analysis against planned schedule.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: Attribution methodology used to assign conversion credit to this flight. Critical for multi-touch attribution analysis.

attributes.name: budget_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated to this flight. Represents the planned media spend for this specific flight execution.

attributes.name: budget_spent_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount spent on this flight. Used for budget variance analysis and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) calculation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary media channel for this flight execution. Supports omnichannel campaign measurement across digital, TV, out-of-home, print, social media, and search.

attributes.name: clicks
attributes.description: Total number of clicks generated by the flight. Primary engagement metric for digital and search campaigns.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate expressed as a decimal (conversions divided by clicks or impressions). Measures campaign effectiveness in driving desired actions.

attributes.name: conversions
attributes.description: Total number of conversions attributed to this flight. Conversion definition varies by campaign objective (purchase, sign-up, download, etc.).

attributes.name: cpa
attributes.description: Average cost per conversion for this flight. Critical metric for performance marketing and Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: cpc
attributes.description: Average cost per click for this flight. Key efficiency metric for paid search and digital campaigns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flight record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: ctr
attributes.description: Click-through rate expressed as a decimal (clicks divided by impressions). Key performance indicator for digital campaign effectiveness.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this flight record.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or platform from which performance data was captured (e.g., Meta API, Google Ads API, agency post-buy report, Nielsen IQ). Used for data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: flight_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the campaign flight for business user identification and reporting.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the flight within the campaign. Used for external reporting and agency coordination.

attributes.name: flight_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the campaign flight.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times an individual was exposed to the campaign (impressions divided by reach). Measures message repetition.

attributes.name: grp
attributes.description: Gross Rating Points for traditional media (TV, radio, OOH). Measures total audience delivery as a percentage of target population multiplied by frequency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flight record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: market_geography
attributes.description: Geographic market or region where the flight is executed. Supports market-level performance tracking and regional campaign optimization.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Date on which performance metrics were measured or reported. Supports daily granular performance tracking at the campaign-channel-market-date grain.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the flight execution, performance anomalies, or special circumstances. Supports qualitative context for quantitative performance data.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Specific placement or ad format type within the channel (e.g., banner, video, native, sponsored post, display, search text ad). Enables placement-level optimization.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Specific advertising platform or network (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, programmatic DSP, linear TV network). Enables platform-specific performance analysis.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Product category or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) group being promoted. Supports category-level marketing effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Estimated number of unique individuals exposed to the campaign flight. Used for audience coverage analysis.

attributes.name: roas
attributes.description: Return on Ad Spend expressed as a ratio (revenue generated divided by ad spend). Primary metric for campaign profitability assessment.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned end date for the flight media run. Defines the flight duration for budget allocation and performance measurement.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the flight media run. Used for campaign planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the target audience segment for this flight (e.g., demographic, psychographic, behavioral criteria). Supports audience-specific performance analysis.

attributes.name: target_impressions
attributes.description: Planned number of impressions for this flight. Used for media planning and performance target setting.

attributes.name: video_completion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that were completed (watched to end). Measures creative engagement quality.

attributes.name: video_views
attributes.description: Total number of video views for video creative flights. Applicable to digital video, social, and TV campaigns.

products.name: media_plan
products.description: Formal media plan document capturing planned media investments across channels (TV, digital, OOH, print, social, search, programmatic) for a brand or campaign. Includes planned impressions, GRPs, reach, frequency, CPM, total planned spend, agency, media owner, market, and planning period. Serves as the authoritative pre-buy record for media investment decisions.

attributes.name: media_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the media plan record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign associated with this media plan.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Media plans must align spend with ESG targets; FK provides audit trail for sustainable media buying.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand for which this media plan is created.

attributes.name: planner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Media planner employee owns the plan; needed for budget approval audit and planner workload tracking.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Media plans are built for product launches that stem from a particular R&D project, ensuring budget aligns with development timeline.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the media agency responsible for planning and buying this media investment.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this media plan.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this media plan was formally approved for execution.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total campaign or brand budget allocated to this media plan line.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this media plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: creative_format
attributes.description: Format of the creative asset planned for this media (e.g., 30-second spot, banner ad, full-page print, billboard).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the planned spend amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: Time segment of day for broadcast media (e.g., Prime Time, Early Morning, Late Night, Daytime).

attributes.name: flight_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the media flight or execution period for this plan.

attributes.name: flight_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the media flight or execution period for this plan.

attributes.name: kpi_target
attributes.description: Target Key Performance Indicator metric and value for measuring media plan success (e.g., Reach 70%, CTR 2.5%, ROAS 3.0).

attributes.name: market
attributes.description: Geographic market or Designated Market Area (DMA) targeted by this media plan (e.g., USA, New York DMA, UK).

attributes.name: media_channel
attributes.description: Primary media channel category for this plan line (TV, digital, out-of-home, print, social, search, programmatic, radio, cinema, podcast). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tv|digital|ooh|print|social|search|programmatic|radio|cinema|podcast — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: media_owner
attributes.description: Name of the media owner or publisher (e.g., NBC, Google, Meta, Clear Channel).

attributes.name: media_subchannel
attributes.description: Detailed subchannel or platform within the primary media channel (e.g., Facebook, Google Display, National TV, Local Radio).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this media plan record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes, comments, or special instructions related to this media plan.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Primary marketing objective for this media plan (awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, trial).

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the media plan used for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or title of the media plan document.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the media plan indicating its approval and execution state.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the media plan by planning horizon and purpose.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version number of this media plan document to track revisions and iterations.

attributes.name: planned_cpm
attributes.description: Planned cost per thousand impressions for this media investment.

attributes.name: planned_cpp
attributes.description: Planned cost per rating point for broadcast media investments.

attributes.name: planned_frequency
attributes.description: Planned average number of times the target audience will be exposed to the media message.

attributes.name: planned_grp
attributes.description: Planned Gross Rating Points representing the total reach multiplied by frequency for the target audience.

attributes.name: planned_impressions
attributes.description: Total number of planned impressions (ad exposures) for this media plan.

attributes.name: planned_reach_percent
attributes.description: Planned percentage of the target audience reached at least once during the planning period.

attributes.name: planned_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total planned media spend amount for this media plan in the base currency.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this media plan.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this media plan.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the target audience demographic or segment for this media plan (e.g., Adults 25-54, Moms with Kids, HHI 75K+).

products.name: media_spend
products.description: Transactional record of actual media spend incurred per channel, campaign, brand, and time period. Captures invoiced spend, committed spend, variance to plan, media owner, agency fees, working vs. non-working spend classification, and cost-per-metric actuals (CPM, CPC, CPV). Sourced from agency billing systems and reconciled against media plan commitments.

attributes.name: media_spend_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the media spend transaction record. Primary key for the media spend data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign associated with this media spend transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Media spend invoices are posted against cost centers to track advertising costs per organizational unit.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system that performed the reconciliation of this media spend record.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Accounting of media spend requires a GL account reference for journal entry creation.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand for which this media spend was incurred.

attributes.name: media_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media plan that authorized this spend.

attributes.name: agency_fee_amount
attributes.description: The agency service fee or commission charged for managing the media buy.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: The name of the media agency that managed the media buy and invoiced the spend.

attributes.name: buy_type
attributes.description: The method by which the media inventory was purchased (e.g., Programmatic, Direct, Auction, Guaranteed).

attributes.name: clicks_delivered
attributes.description: The total number of clicks generated by the media placement for this spend transaction.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the media spend was incurred (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: cpc_actual
attributes.description: The actual cost per click (CPC) achieved for this media spend, calculated as working spend divided by clicks delivered.

attributes.name: cpm_actual
attributes.description: The actual cost per thousand impressions (CPM) achieved for this media spend, calculated as (working spend / impressions) * 1000.

attributes.name: cpv_actual
attributes.description: The actual cost per video view (CPV) achieved for this media spend, calculated as working spend divided by video views delivered.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media spend record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the spend amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope of the media placement (e.g., National, Regional, Local, Global).

attributes.name: impressions_delivered
attributes.description: The total number of ad impressions delivered for this spend transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number from the media owner or agency billing system for this spend transaction.

attributes.name: invoiced_spend_amount
attributes.description: The total amount invoiced by the media owner or agency for this media spend transaction.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this media spend record is currently active and valid (True) or has been voided or superseded (False).

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific market or Designated Market Area (DMA) where the media was placed (e.g., New York, Los Angeles, London).

attributes.name: media_channel
attributes.description: The media channel through which the advertising was delivered (e.g., TV, Digital Display, Social Media, Search). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TV|Radio|Print|Digital Display|Social Media|Search|Video|Out-of-Home|Programmatic|Influencer|Podcast|Streaming|Email|Mobile|Affiliate|Sponsorship|Other — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: media_owner_name
attributes.description: The name of the media owner or publisher that provided the advertising inventory (e.g., Google, Meta, NBC Universal).

attributes.name: media_subchannel
attributes.description: The specific subchannel or platform within the media channel (e.g., Facebook, Google Ads, CNN, Spotify).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media spend record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: non_working_spend_amount
attributes.description: The portion of invoiced spend allocated to agency fees, production costs, and other non-media expenses (non-working media).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this media spend transaction, including reconciliation notes or dispute details.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice for this media spend was paid.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The payment status of the invoice associated with this media spend transaction.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of media placement or ad format (e.g., Banner, Video Pre-Roll, Native, Sponsored Post, 30-Second Spot).

attributes.name: planned_spend_amount
attributes.description: The originally planned or committed spend amount from the media plan for this channel and period.

attributes.name: production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The cost of creative production, ad serving, and other production-related expenses included in this spend transaction.

attributes.name: reconciled_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media spend record was reconciled against the media plan and delivery metrics.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current reconciliation status of this spend transaction against the media plan and delivery metrics.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this media spend record was extracted (e.g., agency billing system, media management platform).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this media spend record in the source system.

attributes.name: spend_date
attributes.description: The date on which the media spend was incurred or invoiced.

attributes.name: spend_period
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar period (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03) to which this spend is allocated for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: The demographic or psychographic target audience for this media placement (e.g., Adults 25-54, Moms with Kids, High-Income Households).

attributes.name: variance_to_plan_amount
attributes.description: The difference between invoiced spend and planned spend (invoiced minus planned), indicating over- or under-spend.

attributes.name: video_views_delivered
attributes.description: The total number of video views or completions delivered for video media placements.

attributes.name: working_spend_amount
attributes.description: The portion of invoiced spend that directly purchased media inventory (working media), excluding agency fees and production costs.

products.name: creative_asset
products.description: Master record for each creative asset and content item (TV commercial, digital banner, social post, print ad, packaging visual, influencer brief, video, blog post, email template) used in marketing campaigns or published on owned/earned channels. Captures asset name, format, dimensions, file type, brand, campaign association, creative concept, approval status, rights/usage restrictions, expiry date, DAM reference ID, and content publishing metadata (planned publish date, actual publish date, publishing channel, content status, content type, target audience segment, content owner). Serves as the unified creative and content management record supporting brand compliance, creative reuse tracking, DAM integration, and coordinated omnichannel content calendar planning. No separate content calendar product exists — all scheduling and publishing metadata lives here.

products.name: influencer
products.description: Master record for influencer and content creator partners engaged by Consumer Goods, including full engagement/activation history. Captures influencer handle, platform(s), follower count, engagement rate, audience demographics, content category, tier (nano, micro, macro, mega), brand safety score, contract status, preferred contact, and historical campaign participation. Engagement detail records capture: engagement type (sponsored post, product seeding, brand ambassador, event appearance), campaign association, contracted deliverables, content submission dates, approval status, agreed fee, actual fee paid, platform, post URLs, reach, impressions, engagement metrics, and content performance. Serves as the SSOT for influencer partner identity, roster management, and all activation history. No separate engagement product exists — all engagement transactional data lives here as detail records.

attributes.name: agency_id

attributes.name: employee_id

products.name: market_research_study
products.description: Master record for each market research study or syndicated data subscription commissioned or conducted by Consumer Goods. Captures study name, research type (quantitative, qualitative, U&A, concept test, pack test, NPS, brand health tracker, consumer panel), research agency/data provider (Nielsen IQ, Kantar, Circana, Ipsos), fieldwork dates, target market, sample size, methodology, status, key findings summary, and periodic panel metrics (household penetration, purchase frequency, basket size, repeat rate, switching behavior, buyer demographics). Serves as the SSOT for all primary and syndicated research investment, output tracking, and consumer panel insight management. Enables research ROI tracking and insight activation across brand strategy.

products.name: brand_health_tracker
products.description: Consolidated periodic brand performance scorecard capturing all consumer perception, market position, competitive share, media share, and social sentiment metrics for a brand in a specific market and time period. Captures awareness (spontaneous, aided), consideration, preference, purchase intent, NPS, brand equity index, SOV% (Share of Voice by channel — TV, digital, OOH, social), SOM% (value share, volume share by category/channel/geography), total category spend, competitor benchmarks, social sentiment scores (positive/neutral/negative breakdown), mention volume, share of conversation, platform distribution, net sentiment score, and key image attribute scores. Sourced from Nielsen Ad Intel/Kantar media monitoring (SOV), Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement/Circana (SOM), proprietary brand tracking studies (awareness/equity), and social listening platforms (sentiment). Serves as the single authoritative brand scorecard enabling longitudinal brand health monitoring, SOV vs. SOM gap analysis, competitive benchmarking, market share trend tracking, and sentiment trend analysis.

products.name: agency
products.description: Master record for marketing agency partners engaged by Consumer Goods. Captures agency name, agency type (creative, media, digital, PR, shopper, research, influencer), holding group, scope of services, retainer vs. project basis, primary contact, contract status, performance rating, markets served, assigned brands, and fee structure. Serves as the SSOT for agency partner identity and roster management within the marketing domain. Enables agency performance benchmarking and spend consolidation analysis.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing agency partner. Primary key for the agency master record.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the agency's primary business address (street address, building number).

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the agency's primary business address (suite, floor, building name). Nullable.

attributes.name: agency_code
attributes.description: Internal short code or identifier used to reference the agency in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the marketing agency partner.

attributes.name: agency_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the agency based on core service offering: creative (brand and campaign creative development), media (media planning and buying), digital (digital marketing and social media), pr (public relations and communications), shopper (shopper marketing and retail execution), research (market research and consumer insights).

attributes.name: annual_retainer_amount
attributes.description: Total annual retainer fee amount committed under the current contract. Null if engagement is project-based only.

attributes.name: assigned_brands
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Consumer Goods brand names or brand identifiers that this agency is contracted to support.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the agency's primary business address.

attributes.name: contract_end_date

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current agency contract or master service agreement.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agency contract: active (contract in force), pending (contract under negotiation or awaiting signature), suspended (temporarily paused), terminated (ended before expiration), expired (contract term ended).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the agency's primary business address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this agency record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.name: is_active

attributes.name: is_minority_owned

attributes.name: is_preferred_vendor

attributes.name: is_woman_owned

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date

attributes.name: markets_served
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic markets or regions where the agency provides services to Consumer Goods (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, or specific country codes).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this agency record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: onboarding_date

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: performance_rating

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: primary_contact_email

attributes.name: primary_contact_name

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary agency contact.

attributes.name: scope_of_services

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: state_province

attributes.name: tax_number

attributes.name: termination_date

products.name: marketing_budget
products.description: Marketing budget allocation record capturing planned and approved marketing investment by brand, category, channel, campaign type, and fiscal period. Captures total budget, working media budget, non-working budget, agency fees, research budget, committed spend, actual spend, variance, and budget owner. Distinct from finance domain general ledger — this is the marketing-owned investment planning record.

attributes.name: marketing_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing budget allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category to which this budget allocation is assigned. Null for brand-level or corporate-level budgets.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Budget allocations are often earmarked to meet ESG commitments; linking enables financial ESG tracking.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand to which this budget allocation is assigned. Null for multi-brand or corporate-level budgets.

attributes.name: primary_marketing_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing leader or business owner responsible for managing and executing this budget allocation.

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of budget that has been actually spent (invoiced and paid) as of the measurement date.

attributes.name: agency_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the budget allocated to agency fees and retainers for creative, media, and strategic services.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget allocation was formally approved by the authorized approver or budget committee.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code for this marketing budget allocation, used for tracking and reference across planning systems.

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title for this marketing budget allocation, typically describing the scope or purpose.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget allocation in the approval and execution workflow.

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget allocation by planning horizon and purpose (annual, quarterly, campaign-specific, project-based, tactical, or strategic).

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: The type of marketing campaign or activity this budget supports (awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, product launch, seasonal, promotional). Null for non-campaign budgets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: awareness|consideration|conversion|retention|launch|seasonal|promotional — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The primary marketing channel or media type for which this budget is allocated (digital, TV, print, radio, out-of-home, social media, search, display, video, retail, events). Null for multi-channel budgets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: digital|tv|print|radio|ooh|social|search|display|video|retail|events — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: committed_spend_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of budget that has been committed through purchase orders, contracts, or reservations but not yet invoiced or paid.

attributes.name: contingency_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the budget held in reserve for unforeseen opportunities or adjustments during the budget period.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The finance cost center code to which this marketing budget is assigned for general ledger tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU) to which this budget applies. Null for global budgets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was first created in the system, capturing the initial planning event.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all budget amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget allocation expires and no further spending can be committed. Null for open-ended budgets.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget allocation becomes effective and spending can be committed against it.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year, represented as an integer 1-12. Null for annual or quarterly budgets.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter within the fiscal year to which this budget allocation applies (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Null for annual budgets.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget allocation applies, represented as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope of the marketing investment covered by this budget (global, regional, national, local).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code under which this marketing budget spend is recorded in the financial system.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget allocation is currently active and available for spending (True) or has been deactivated or superseded (False).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was last modified or updated, reflecting the most recent change to budget allocation or spend tracking.

attributes.name: non_working_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total budget allocated to non-working expenses (production, creative development, agency fees, research) that do not directly reach consumers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions for this budget allocation.

attributes.name: production_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the budget allocated specifically to creative production costs (video production, photography, design, content creation).

attributes.name: research_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the budget allocated to market research, consumer insights, brand tracking, and measurement activities.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this budget record originated (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle ERP, custom budget planning tool).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this budget record in the source operational system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total approved marketing investment amount for this budget allocation, including all working and non-working components.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the total budget amount and the actual spend amount (positive indicates under-spend, negative indicates over-spend).

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance amount expressed as a percentage of the total budget amount, indicating budget utilization performance.

attributes.name: working_media_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total budget allocated to working media spend (paid media placements, impressions, airtime) that directly reaches consumers.

products.name: market_share_record
products.description: Periodic market share (SOM) measurement record capturing a brand's or SKU's value and volume share within a defined category, channel, and geography at a given time period. Captures value share %, volume share %, category total value, brand value, data source (Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement, IRI/Circana), market definition, and period. Enables SOM trend tracking and competitive benchmarking.
products.reference: SOM (Share of Market) / Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: market_share_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the market share measurement record.

attributes.name: analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Market share reports are produced by an analyst; linking enables responsibility tracking and report version control.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category within which market share is calculated.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand for which market share is measured.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific SKU for which market share is measured. Nullable when measurement is at brand or category level.

attributes.name: acv_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total category sales volume represented by stores carrying the brand or SKU (weighted distribution).

attributes.name: brand_value_amount
attributes.description: Total sales value (revenue) for the brand or SKU during the measurement period.

attributes.name: brand_volume_quantity
attributes.description: Total sales volume (units) for the brand or SKU during the measurement period.

attributes.name: category_total_value_amount
attributes.description: Total sales value (revenue) for the entire category during the measurement period.

attributes.name: category_total_volume_quantity
attributes.description: Total sales volume (units) for the entire category during the measurement period.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Retail channel or trade class within which market share is measured (e.g., total market, food, drug, mass, club, convenience, ecommerce). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: total_market|food|drug|mass|club|convenience|ecommerce — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Data quality or confidence level assigned to this measurement (high, medium, low) based on sample size or data completeness.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts in this record.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source of the market share data (e.g., Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement, IRI/Circana, internal sales data, other syndicated source).

attributes.name: data_source_report_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or reference number from the source system report.

attributes.name: geography_code
attributes.description: Code representing the specific geographic area (e.g., country code, state code, metro code) for the measurement.

attributes.name: geography_level
attributes.description: Geographic granularity at which market share is measured (national, regional, state, metro, local).

attributes.name: geography_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the geographic area for the measurement.

attributes.name: is_projected
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this record contains projected/estimated data (true) or actual reported data (false).

attributes.name: market_definition
attributes.description: Description of the market scope and boundaries used for the share calculation (e.g., total category, specific segment, competitive set).

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Date when the market share measurement was captured or reported by the data source.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time period for which market share is measured.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period for which market share is measured (e.g., week, month, quarter).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was last modified in the data platform.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, commentary, or context about this market share measurement (e.g., data anomalies, market events, methodology changes).

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the measurement period (weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly).

attributes.name: rank_position
attributes.description: Competitive rank position of the brand or SKU within the category for this period (1 = market leader).

attributes.name: share_point_change
attributes.description: Change in value share percentage points compared to the previous comparable period (positive = gain, negative = loss).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this record originated.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this record in the source system.

attributes.name: tdp_count
attributes.description: Total Distribution Points representing the weighted percentage of stores carrying the brand or SKU.

attributes.name: value_share_percent
attributes.description: Market share expressed as a percentage of total category sales value (revenue). Also known as dollar share or revenue share.

attributes.name: volume_share_percent
attributes.description: Market share expressed as a percentage of total category sales volume (units). Also known as unit share.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume quantities (e.g., units, cases, liters, kilograms).

attributes.name: year_over_year_change_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in value share compared to the same period in the prior year.

attributes.name: performance_obligations

products.name: brand_assignment
products.description: This association captures the operational relationship between trade accounts and brands. It records when a brand is launched at a specific trade account, its current status, and whether it is the primary brand for shelf planning.. Existence Justification: Brands are allocated to trade accounts for shelf planning and promotional purposes. Each trade account can carry multiple brands, and each brand can be sold through multiple trade accounts. The assignment is actively managed and includes attributes such as launch date, status, and a primary‑brand flag.

attributes.name: primary_brand_flag

products.name: brand_distribution_allocation
products.description: This association captures the allocation of brands to supply network nodes, including the percentage of inventory allocated, primary flag, and the effective date range for each allocation.. Existence Justification: Brands are actively allocated to supply network nodes with defined allocation percentages, primary flags, and effective date ranges. The planning team manages these allocations, and a single brand can be stocked at many nodes while a node can carry many brands.

attributes.name: primary_flag

products.name: campaign_inventory_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between a marketing campaign and a stock position. It captures the percentage of inventory allocated and the start/end dates of the allocation period for each link.. Existence Justification: A marketing campaign allocates portions of inventory at specific locations to support promotional activities. Each allocation is defined by a percentage and a time window, and the same inventory can be allocated to multiple campaigns over time, while a campaign can allocate to many stock positions.

attributes.name: allocation_start_date

products.name: marketing_offset_allocation
products.description: Represents the allocation of carbon offset credits to marketing campaigns. Each record links one campaign to one carbon offset and captures allocation-specific details such as the amount allocated, purchase date, and quantity purchased.. Existence Justification: A marketing campaign can be linked to multiple carbon offset credits, and a single carbon offset credit can be allocated across several campaigns. The business actively records each allocation with details such as allocation amount, purchase date, and quantity purchased, which are managed by sustainability and marketing teams.
