products.name: campaign_submission_link
products.description: This association product represents the contractual link between a marketing campaign and a regulatory submission. It captures claim_type, approval_status, and approval_date that are specific to each campaign‑submission pairing.. Existence Justification: In Consumer Goods, a marketing campaign often requires regulatory submissions to obtain claim approvals. A single campaign may depend on several submissions (e.g., different claims or regions) and a single submission can be used to support multiple campaigns.

products.name: campaign_assignment
products.description: This association captures the staffing of marketing campaigns. Each record links one campaign to one employee and stores attributes that belong to the assignment such as role, allocation percentage, and assignment dates.. Existence Justification: A marketing campaign is staffed by multiple employees (e.g., planners, creatives, analysts) and an employee can be assigned to multiple campaigns over time. The assignment is actively managed, with role, allocation percentage, and start/end dates captured for each employee‑campaign pairing.

products.name: event_participation
products.description: Association representing the participation of employees in marketing events, capturing the employee's role and the start/end dates of their involvement for each event.. Existence Justification: Marketing events are staffed by multiple employees (coordinators, hosts, presenters) and each employee can be assigned to many events over time. The business actively records each employee's role and the dates they participated in the event for planning, reporting, and post‑event analysis.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Owns financial planning, accounting, and reporting including general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, cost accounting, COGS allocation, EBITDA reporting, DSO/DIO tracking, budgeting, revenue recognition, and SOX-compliant financial controls and audit trails. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and Oracle Cloud Financials.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for organizational cost centers used in SAP S/4HANA CO module. Defines the financial accountability units within the CPG enterprise — brand units, manufacturing plants, regional sales offices, and shared service centers. Each cost center carries a hierarchy path, responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, currency, and active period. Serves as the foundational dimension for all cost accounting, COGS allocation, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_category

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.description: Indicates whether this account uses open item management for tracking and clearing individual line items (e.g., AR, AP, bank clearing accounts).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Open Item Management

attributes.name: pl_category
attributes.description: For income statement accounts, indicates the P&L category: gross revenue, net revenue, COGS, gross margin, operating expense (SG&A, marketing, trade spend), EBITDA, EBIT, or net income. Not applicable for balance sheet accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gross_revenue|net_revenue|cogs|gross_margin|operating_expense|ebitda|ebit|net_income|not_applicable — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS; Consumer Goods Industry P&L Structure

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: The organizational level at which budget planning and forecasting is performed for this account (e.g., company code, profit center, cost center).

attributes.name: posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct postings are allowed to this account. Some accounts (e.g., summary or control accounts) may only accept postings from automated processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Field Status Configuration

attributes.name: profit_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. Used for segment reporting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Profit Center Accounting; IFRS 8

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that summarizes detailed transactions from subsidiary ledgers such as AR, AP, or inventory.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reconciliation Account; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: retained_earnings_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the retained earnings account where net income/loss is transferred during year-end closing.
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI Year-End Closing

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: The default sort key used for organizing and displaying line items within this account (e.g., posting date, document number, amount).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Sort Key Configuration

attributes.name: sox_control_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to SOX internal control requirements and enhanced audit procedures.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax treatment category for this account (e.g., taxable revenue, non-taxable revenue, input tax, output tax, tax-exempt). Used for VAT, sales tax, and GST reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 334; EU VAT Directive; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration

attributes.name: tax_code_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tax codes can be entered when posting to this account. Typically true for revenue and expense accounts, false for balance sheet accounts.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account is valid and available for posting. Used for time-dependent account structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Account Master Validity

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this GL account is valid. After this date, the account is no longer available for posting. Null indicates no end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Account Master Validity

products.name: ledger
products.description: Financial ledger master defining the accounting ledgers maintained in the enterprise — leading ledger (IFRS/GAAP), parallel ledgers for local GAAP, and extension ledgers for management reporting. Each ledger record captures ledger type, accounting principle, currency type, fiscal year variant, and posting period variant. Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements common in global CPG companies operating across multiple regulatory jurisdictions.
products.reference: SAP FI Ledger / Oracle Cloud Ledger

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial ledger record. Primary key for the ledger entity.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.chart_of_accounts

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.company_code

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ledger stewardship is tracked for consolidation control and audit; responsible employee must be recorded.

attributes.name: accounting_principle
attributes.description: The accounting standard or principle applied in this ledger, such as International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP), local country-specific GAAP, tax accounting rules, or management accounting conventions.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation, FASB US GAAP, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether comprehensive audit trail logging is enabled for all postings and changes to this ledger, supporting regulatory compliance and forensic analysis.

attributes.name: base_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the base currency in which this ledger maintains balances (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: consolidation_ledger_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger is used for group consolidation purposes, aggregating financial data from multiple legal entities for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording when this ledger record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for ledger lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Defines the currency perspective maintained in this ledger. Local currency represents the operating entity's functional currency, group currency is the consolidated reporting currency, hard currency is a stable reference currency (e.g., USD, EUR), and index currency supports inflation-adjusted reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IAS 21 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ledger ceases to be active and no longer accepts financial postings. Null for ledgers with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ledger becomes active and begins accepting financial postings. Supports temporal validity for ledger lifecycle management.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Code identifying the fiscal year calendar structure used by this ledger, defining the number of posting periods, special periods, and year-end closing rules. Common in SAP S/4HANA FI to support diverse fiscal calendars across global entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: is_leading_ledger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the leading ledger (primary book of record) for the company code. Only one ledger per company code can be designated as the leading ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Leading Ledger Concept

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this ledger record. Supports change tracking and audit trail for ledger configuration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording when this ledger record was last modified. Enables change tracking and supports audit trail requirements for financial system configuration.

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the ledger within the enterprise. Used as the business identifier for the ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle Cloud Financials.

attributes.name: ledger_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the ledger's purpose, scope, and usage within the enterprise financial reporting architecture. Provides context for finance users and auditors.

attributes.name: ledger_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the ledger for human-readable identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ledger. Active ledgers accept postings, inactive ledgers are configured but not yet in use, closed ledgers are archived and no longer accept postings, and suspended ledgers are temporarily disabled.

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ledger indicating its role in the financial reporting architecture. Leading ledger is the primary book of record, parallel ledgers support alternative accounting principles (e.g., local GAAP), and extension ledgers provide management reporting views.

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: Code defining the posting period structure for this ledger, including the number of regular periods (typically 12 monthly periods) and special periods for year-end adjustments and closing entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Configuration

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years that financial data in this ledger must be retained to comply with statutory, tax, and regulatory record-keeping requirements. Common retention periods range from 7 to 10 years for financial records.

attributes.name: sox_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger maintains controls and audit trails compliant with Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404 requirements for internal controls over financial reporting.

attributes.name: supports_cost_of_sales_accounting
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supports Cost of Sales (COGS) Accounting Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger supports cost of sales (COGS) accounting method, which matches costs directly to revenue in the period of sale, as opposed to period-based cost accounting.

attributes.name: supports_profit_center_accounting
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger maintains profit center accounting data for internal management reporting and profitability analysis by organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: supports_segment_reporting
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger supports segment reporting as required by IFRS 8 Operating Segments. Segment reporting enables financial analysis by business unit, product line, or geographic region.

attributes.name: valuation_view
attributes.description: Defines the valuation perspective applied in this ledger. Legal valuation follows statutory requirements, group valuation applies consolidated group policies, profit center valuation supports internal management reporting, and cost center valuation tracks cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this ledger record in the system. Supports audit trail and accountability for ledger configuration changes.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core general ledger journal entry header capturing every financial posting in the consumer goods enterprise. Records document type (vendor invoice, customer payment, goods issue, payroll posting, accrual, reversal), posting date, fiscal period, company code, ledger, currency, exchange rate, reference document, and SOX-compliant posting user and approval chain. The authoritative transactional record for all financial activity sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle Cloud Financials.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry header.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BELNR, Oracle Cloud GL_JE_HEADERS

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center to which costs or revenues from this journal entry are allocated. Used for management accounting and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO BSEG-KOSTL, Management Accounting

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entries reference GL accounts by code; adding gl_account_id FK normalizes the relationship and removes the redundant code column.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Journal entries belong to a specific ledger; adding ledger_id FK links each entry to its ledger without removing existing ledger_group (kept for reporting).

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who posted or created this journal entry. Critical for SOX compliance and audit trail. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-USNAM, SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Used for EBITDA calculation by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO BSEG-PRCTR, IFRS 8, US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: R&D expense tracking mandates associating journal entries with the originating RD project for cost accounting and project profitability reporting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the journal entry was approved. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: The baseline date used for calculating payment terms and due dates for vendor invoices and customer receivables. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-ZFBDT, DSO calculation

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch input session if this journal entry was created through automated batch processing. Used for tracking mass data uploads and interface postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI batch processing, Oracle Cloud GL_INTERFACE

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Code representing the business area or division for cross-company code reporting. Used for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared. Used for DSO and DIO calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BSEG-AUGDT, DSO/DIO tracking

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing document if this open item has been cleared (paid or offset). Used for accounts payable and receivable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BSEG-AUGBL, DSO/DIO tracking

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the legal entity or business unit within the enterprise. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BUKRS, ISO 17442 LEI

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Organizational unit in management accounting that represents a closed system for cost accounting. Used for internal management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO controlling area, Management Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the document currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the source document (invoice, receipt, payment voucher). May differ from posting date. Used for document control and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BLDAT, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the accounting document within the company code and fiscal year. This is the externally visible business key for the journal entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BELNR, Oracle Cloud GL_JE_HEADERS.JE_HEADER_ID

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification code indicating the nature and source of the journal entry. Examples: SA (General Ledger Document), AB (Accounting Document), KR (Vendor Invoice), DR (Customer Invoice), DZ (Customer Payment), KA (Vendor Payment), KG (Vendor Credit Memo), KN (Customer Credit Memo), KZ (Payment Request), RE (Invoice Receipt), RV (Invoice Reversal), WA (Goods Issue), WE (Goods Receipt), ZP (Payment Posting). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AB|KR|DR|DZ|KA|KG|KN|KZ|RE|RV|WA|WE|ZP — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BLART, Oracle Cloud GL_JE_CATEGORIES

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was created or entered into the system. Used for audit trail and process monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-CPUDT, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert document currency amounts to local currency. Expressed as local currency per one unit of document currency. Null if document currency equals local currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-KURSF, IFRS IAS 21, US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: Code indicating the type of exchange rate used for currency translation. Examples: M (Average Rate), B (Bank Buying Rate), G (Bank Selling Rate), P (Posting Date Rate).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-KURST, IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric period within the fiscal year (typically 1-12 for monthly periods, or 1-13 for year-end adjustments). Determines the reporting period for financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-MONAT, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year representing the fiscal year to which this journal entry is assigned. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-GJAHR, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Code classifying the journal entry by functional area (e.g., Production, Sales, Administration, R&D). Used for cost of goods sold (COGS) allocation and functional expense reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO BSEG-FKBER, COGS allocation, EBITDA reporting

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information or explanation about the journal entry. Used for documentation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BKTXT, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry involves intercompany transactions between different company codes within the enterprise. True if intercompany, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI intercompany processing, IFRS 10, US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the ledger or accounting principle under which this entry is recorded. Examples: 0L (Leading Ledger - IFRS), 2L (Local GAAP), 3L (Management Reporting). Supports parallel accounting for multiple reporting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New GL RLDNR, IFRS, US GAAP

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the company code local currency. All amounts are translated to this currency for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to this document (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Used for cash flow forecasting and DSO tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-ZTERM, DSO calculation

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. This is the effective date for financial reporting and determines the fiscal period assignment. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BUDAT, IFRS IAS 1, US GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Values: draft (entry created but not posted), posted (entry successfully posted to GL), parked (entry saved for later posting), cancelled (entry voided before posting), reversed (entry reversed by a subsequent document).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI workflow status, Oracle Cloud GL_JE_HEADERS.STATUS

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (invoice number, purchase order number, payment reference). Used for cross-referencing and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-XBLNR, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this is a reversal document, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-STBLG, US GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the original document. Examples: 01 (Reversal in Current Period), 02 (Reversal in Next Period), 03 (Correction), 04 (Accrual Reversal), 05 (Error Correction), 06 (Period-End Adjustment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|03|04|05|06|07|08|09 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-STGRD, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original journal entry that is being reversed by this entry. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-STBLG, US GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this journal entry originated. Examples: SAP_FI (SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting), SAP_CO (SAP Controlling), ORACLE_GL (Oracle Cloud General Ledger), ORACLE_AP (Oracle Accounts Payable), ORACLE_AR (Oracle Accounts Receivable), SFDC (Salesforce), WMS (Warehouse Management System), MES (Manufacturing Execution System). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_FI|SAP_CO|ORACLE_GL|ORACLE_AP|ORACLE_AR|SFDC|WMS|MES — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit procedures. True if SOX-controlled, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework, PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: tax_reporting_date
attributes.description: The date relevant for tax reporting purposes. May differ from posting date based on tax jurisdiction rules. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI tax date, IRS Publication 538, EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner if this is an intercompany transaction. Used for consolidation and elimination entries. Null if not an intercompany transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BSEG-PRCTR, IFRS 10, US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: SAP transaction code or Oracle program identifier used to create this journal entry. Examples: FB01 (Post Document), FB50 (G/L Account Posting), MIRO (Enter Invoice), F-28 (Post Incoming Payments). Used for audit trail and process analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-TCODE, SOX Section 404

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual line items of a general ledger journal entry. Each line captures the GL account, cost center, profit center, WBS element, business area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction currency, amount in company code currency, amount in group currency, tax code, and assignment field. Enables granular cost allocation, COGS decomposition, and audit trail tracing at the line level as required by SOX compliance.
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry Line Item (BSEG)

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for granular cost allocation, COGS decomposition, and SOX-compliant audit trail tracing at the line level.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entry lines store GL account code; FK to gl_account enables proper account lookup and eliminates duplicate code.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header document. Links this line to the overall journal entry batch and posting context.

attributes.name: amount_company_code_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount converted to the local currency of the company code. Used for statutory reporting and local GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: amount_group_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount converted to the group reporting currency. Enables consolidated financial reporting across all subsidiaries.

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount of this line item in the original transaction currency. Preserves the original posting amount before currency conversion.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-text assignment field for additional reference information such as invoice number, purchase order, or payment reference. Enhances traceability.

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation. Used to compute due dates and cash discount periods.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area classification for cross-company code segment reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Business Area Accounting

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this open item was cleared or settled. Null if the item remains open.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Open Item Management

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing entry that settled this open item. Null if the item remains open.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Open Item Management

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity identifier representing the company or subsidiary for which this line is posted. Enables consolidated and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: company_code_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company code local currency. Typically the statutory reporting currency of the legal entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which this expense or revenue is allocated. Enables departmental cost tracking and managerial accounting analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: customer_account_number
attributes.description: Customer account number for revenue and receivables postings. Links financial transactions to customer master data.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and account balance calculation.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due for payables or expected for receivables. Critical for DSO and cash flow management.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to company code or group currency. Critical for currency translation audit trail.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification (e.g., production, sales, administration, R&D). Supports cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the group reporting currency. Typically USD or EUR for multinational consumer goods companies.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Internal order for tracking costs of short-term jobs, events, or overhead activities. Enables job costing and overhead allocation.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry header. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Line Item Numbering

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Material or SKU associated with this line item for inventory and COGS postings. Links financial postings to product master data.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms applicable to this line item. Determines due date calculation and cash discount eligibility.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center associated with this line item. Supports plant-level cost accounting and inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Plant Master Data

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit posting key controlling account type, debit/credit indicator, and field status. Fundamental to SAP FI posting logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Posting Key Configuration

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center responsible for this line item. Supports segment reporting and profitability analysis by business unit or product line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or units associated with this line item. Enables unit cost calculation and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External or internal document number referenced by this line (e.g., invoice, purchase order, contract). Supports document linkage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item is a reversal of a previous posting. True if this is a reversal entry.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original entry that this line reverses. Null if this is not a reversal.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: Special GL indicator for down payments, bills of exchange, guarantees, or other special transactions. Enables special ledger processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Special GL Transactions

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Storage location within the plant for inventory-related postings. Enables warehouse-level inventory tracking and valuation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item in transaction currency. Supports VAT, sales tax, and other indirect tax reporting.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code determining the tax treatment of this line item. Drives automatic tax calculation and tax reporting compliance.

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Descriptive text explaining the nature or purpose of this journal entry line. Provides human-readable context for audit and review.

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transactions. Enables intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction amount. Identifies the currency in which the original transaction was denominated.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., EA, KG, LT). Standardizes quantity representation across transactions.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Value date for cash management and bank reconciliation. Represents the effective date for interest calculation and cash position.

attributes.name: vendor_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor account number for procurement and payables postings. Links financial transactions to vendor master data.

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: WBS element for project-related postings. Links costs and revenues to specific projects, phases, or deliverables in project accounting.

products.name: ar_invoice
products.description: Accounts receivable master record representing the full trade receivable lifecycle for consumer goods sales to retailers, distributors, and wholesalers. Owns invoice creation, payment terms, cash receipt application, partial payments, deductions/short-payments, clearing, and write-offs. Captures invoice number, billing date, due date, payment terms, gross amount, trade discounts, net amount, tax, currency, payment method, payment date, amount received, clearing reference, DSO aging bucket, dunning level, and deduction reason codes. The single source of truth for all receivable balances, cash application, deduction management, DSO tracking, cash flow forecasting, and revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA SD billing and FI-AR.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable invoice record. Primary key for the AR invoice entity.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AR invoices reference GL accounts by code; adding FK normalizes accounting data.

attributes.name: sales_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.invoice. Business justification: AR invoice reconciliation process matches each AR invoice to the originating sales invoice for cash application.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (customer) to whom this invoice was issued. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: amount_received
attributes.description: Total amount received from the customer against this invoice. May be less than total amount due to partial payments or deductions. Null for unpaid invoices.

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was created and issued to the customer. Principal business event timestamp for the invoice lifecycle.

attributes.name: billing_document_type
attributes.description: SAP billing document type code indicating the nature of the invoice (e.g., F2=standard invoice, G2=credit memo, L2=debit memo). Determines accounting treatment and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was cleared in the financial system, either through full payment or write-off. Null for open invoices.

attributes.name: clearing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned when the invoice is cleared in the financial system. Links to the clearing document for audit trail. Null for open invoices.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that issued the invoice. Required for multi-entity financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the AR system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of deductions taken by the customer against this invoice. Includes short-payments, chargebacks, and unauthorized deductions requiring resolution.

attributes.name: deduction_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for customer deductions (e.g., pricing dispute, damaged goods, short shipment, promotional allowance). Used for deduction root cause analysis.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is currently under dispute by the customer. True if disputed, false otherwise. Disputed invoices are excluded from standard collection processes.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the customer is disputing the invoice. Used for dispute resolution and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the goods were sold (e.g., retail, wholesale, DTC, e-commerce). Used for channel profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel Master

attributes.name: dso_aging_bucket
attributes.description: Aging category based on number of days the invoice has been outstanding past the due date. Used for DSO reporting, collections prioritization, and bad debt provisioning.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is expected from the customer based on agreed payment terms. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation and dunning.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning level indicating the escalation stage of collection efforts (0=no dunning, 1=first reminder, 2=second reminder, etc.). Higher levels indicate more aggressive collection actions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the invoice was posted. Used for monthly financial reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for year-over-year financial analysis and annual reporting.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was posted to the general ledger. Used for financial period assignment and month-end close processes.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any trade discounts, deductions, or adjustments. Represents the full billed value of goods or services.

attributes.name: invoice_number

attributes.name: invoice_status

attributes.name: net_amount

attributes.name: payment_date

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

products.name: ap_invoice

Owns invoice receipt, three-way match verification, payment scheduling, payment execution, early payment discount capture, and clearing. Captures vendor invoice number, invoice date, posting date, due date, gross amount, tax, net amount, payment terms, currency, match status, payment method, payment date, payment amount, payment run ID, bank account reference, early discount taken, clearing document, and payment block details. products.name: cogs_allocation

products.name: fixed_asset

attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of the asset over its useful life. Common methods include straight-line, declining balance, and units of production. Determines the depreciation expense pattern.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Key, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when depreciation posting begins for the asset. Typically the capitalization date or the first day of the following month, depending on enterprise policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Area, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was disposed, sold, scrapped, or retired. Marks the end of the asset lifecycle. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Retirement, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal (proceeds minus net book value at disposal).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Retirement, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: disposal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for disposing of the asset. Used for asset lifecycle analysis, capital planning, and audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sale|scrap|obsolete|damaged|transfer|donation|end_of_life — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Retirement, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognized on the asset when its recoverable amount falls below its carrying value. Required under IAS 36 Impairment of Assets. Reduces net book value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Impairment, IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the fixed asset record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Master, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixed asset record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Master, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_revaluation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent asset revaluation. Revaluations adjust the carrying value to fair market value under IAS 16 revaluation model. Used for compliance and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Revaluation, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Specific location or sub-location within the plant where the asset is installed or stored. Enables granular asset tracking and physical inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Functional Location, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or vendor who produced the asset. Used for warranty claims, spare parts sourcing, and vendor performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Master, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model or part number of the asset. Used for technical specifications, spare parts identification, and maintenance planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Master, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the remaining capitalized value of the asset.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Area, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant, warehouse, or facility where the asset is physically located. Used for operational tracking and maintenance planning. Corresponds to SAP Plant or Oracle Inventory Organization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center to which the asset is assigned for internal profitability analysis. Used for segment reporting and performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center, IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number used to acquire the asset. Links the asset to procurement records for audit trail and vendor reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: revaluation_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent revaluation adjustment. Positive values indicate upward revaluation; negative values indicate impairment. Posted to revaluation reserve or income statement per IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Revaluation, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. The amount expected to be recovered through sale or disposal. Depreciation is calculated on acquisition cost minus salvage value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Class, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which the fixed asset record originated (e.g., SAP, Oracle, legacy system). Used for data lineage and integration reconciliation.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Integration Standards, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected economic useful life of the asset in years, as determined by asset class and enterprise policy. Used to calculate annual depreciation expense. May be fractional (e.g., 7.5 years).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Class, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased. Used for vendor performance tracking and procurement analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty expires. Used to determine whether repairs are covered under warranty or require capital expenditure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Master, ISO 55000 Asset Management

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Intercompany financial transaction record capturing cross-entity postings between legal entities within the consumer goods corporate group. Covers intercompany sales of finished goods, cost allocations, management fee charges, royalty payments, intercompany loans, and dividend distributions. Stores sending company code, receiving company code, transaction type, posting date, amount, currency, transfer price, arm's-length validation flag, netting status, elimination flag, reconciliation reference, and matching status. Critical for consolidated financial reporting, transfer pricing compliance, intercompany elimination in group close, and regulatory documentation under OECD transfer pricing guidelines.
products.reference: SAP FI Intercompany Document / Oracle Cloud Intercompany

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Creator of intercompany transaction needed for transfer‑pricing documentation and audit traceability.

attributes.name: elimination_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the consolidation elimination journal entry that reversed this intercompany transaction in the group financial statements.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Intercompany transactions record GL account code; FK to gl_account creates a proper accounting relationship.

attributes.name: netting_run_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the netting run in which this intercompany transaction was processed, if applicable.

attributes.name: arms_length_validated_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the transfer price has been validated as compliant with arms-length pricing principles under OECD transfer pricing guidelines.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area code representing the line of business or product category associated with this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany receivable or payable was cleared through payment or offsetting entry.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the payment or clearing entry that settled this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code associated with this intercompany transaction for management accounting and cost allocation purposes.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created this intercompany transaction record in the ERP system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this intercompany transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document (invoice, agreement, or internal charge memo) that originated this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany receivable or payable arising from this transaction is expected to be settled.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this intercompany transaction has been eliminated in the consolidated group financial statements.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the group currency amount.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction was posted.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction was posted, derived from the posting date and the company's fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the corporate group's reporting currency for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the corporate group's reporting currency (typically USD, EUR, or other primary currency).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this intercompany transaction record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this intercompany transaction record was last modified.

attributes.name: matching_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction has been successfully matched with the corresponding entry in the counterparty entity's records during the intercompany reconciliation process.

attributes.name: netting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction has been included in an intercompany netting process to reduce cash movements between entities.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and settlement conditions for this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger. This is the principal business event timestamp for financial reporting and period assignment.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center code associated with this intercompany transaction for internal profitability analysis.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the legal entity receiving the intercompany transaction. Represents the crediting entity in the intercompany posting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_reference
attributes.description: The unique reference number linking this intercompany transaction to its corresponding entry in the counterparty entity's books for reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The external reference number from the source document (invoice, purchase order, service agreement) that originated this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the legal entity initiating or sending the intercompany transaction. Represents the debiting entity in the intercompany posting.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the source ERP system or financial application from which this intercompany transaction was extracted (e.g., SAP_S4, ORACLE_ERP).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this intercompany transaction is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit procedures.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code applicable to this intercompany transaction for VAT, GST, or other indirect tax purposes.
attributes.references: GS1 Country Codes / Internal Tax Master

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency, before any adjustments or eliminations.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated.

attributes.name: transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context and business rationale for this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this intercompany transaction in the ERP system. Used for cross-reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany transaction in the financial close and consolidation process.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the cross-entity posting: goods transfer (finished goods sales), service charge (shared services allocation), management fee, royalty payment, intercompany loan, or dividend distribution.

attributes.name: transfer_price
attributes.description: The price charged for goods or services in this intercompany transaction, established according to the company's transfer pricing policy.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arms-length price: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP), Resale Price Method (RPM), Cost Plus Method (CPM), Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM), Profit Split Method (PSM), or other.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter II

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between this intercompany transaction and its matched counterparty entry, if any discrepancy exists during reconciliation.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax deducted from this intercompany transaction, if applicable under local tax regulations.

products.name: finance_accrual
products.description: Financial accrual and prepayment record for period-end close activities in the consumer goods enterprise. Captures accrual type (trade spend accrual, marketing accrual, bonus accrual, warranty accrual, rebate accrual), accrual basis (manual, automated rule-based), accrual amount, reversal date, GL account, cost center, profit center, supporting documentation reference, and approval status. Supports accurate period-end COGS and SG&A reporting and SOX-compliant accrual management.
products.reference: SAP FI Accrual Engine / Oracle Cloud Accruals

attributes.name: finance_accrual_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial accrual record. Primary key for the accrual entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Finance accruals are posted against a cost center; the string code column becomes unnecessary after the FK is introduced.

attributes.name: primary_finance_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the finance manager or controller who approved the accrual entry. Required for SOX compliance and segregation of duties.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Vendor or supplier identifier if the accrual relates to a specific vendor liability (e.g., rebate accrual, freight accrual). Null for internal accruals.

attributes.name: tertiary_finance_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the accrual entry. Tracks changes for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Customer or trade account identifier if the accrual relates to customer-specific trade spend or rebate. Null for non-customer accruals.

attributes.name: accrual_category
attributes.description: High-level accounting category of the accrual entry. Determines whether this is an expense accrual, liability accrual, revenue accrual, or prepaid asset.

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accrual entry. Tracks the approval and posting workflow state for SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: accrual_type
attributes.description: Classification of the accrual by business purpose. Determines the nature of the expense or liability being recognized.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the accrual in the base currency. Represents the estimated expense or liability being recognized in the current accounting period.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the accrual entry. Tracks whether the accrual has been reviewed and approved by authorized finance personnel.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the accrual was approved. Part of the audit trail for period-end close activities.

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the business rationale, assumptions, and any special circumstances related to the accrual. Supports external audit review.

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Method by which the accrual was calculated and recorded. Indicates whether the accrual was manually entered by finance staff or automatically generated by system rules.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area or division code for cross-company segment reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements by business line.

attributes.name: calculation_method_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of how the accrual amount was calculated. Supports audit review and ensures transparency in accrual estimation methodology.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity company code for which the accrual is recorded. Supports multi-entity consolidation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the accrual record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail timeline.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the accrual amount. Supports multi-currency accrual management for global operations.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date on the source document that triggered the accrual. May differ from posting date for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number assigned to this accrual entry in the financial system. Used for audit trail and cross-reference with source documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number Standard

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the accrual is recognized. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the accrual is recognized. Supports period-end reporting and year-over-year analysis.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost of sales accounting. Distinguishes between COGS, SG&A, R&D, and other functional expense categories.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account number to which the accrual is posted. Determines the financial statement line item affected by this accrual.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the accrual record was last updated. Supports audit trail and change tracking for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Product or material SKU if the accrual is product-specific (e.g., warranty accrual by SKU). Null for non-product accruals.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the accrual entry was posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period in which the accrual is recognized.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center code for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Supports EBITDA reporting by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Standard

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the accrual will be automatically reversed in the subsequent accounting period. Null for accruals that do not auto-reverse.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversal entry if the accrual has been reversed. Links the original accrual to its reversal for complete audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number Standard

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the accrual was reversed. Supports audit review and analysis of accrual accuracy.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the source document or transaction in the originating system. Enables traceability back to the source for audit purposes.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which the accrual originated (e.g., SAP_FI, ORACLE_FIN, MANUAL_ENTRY). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sox_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accrual entry meets SOX compliance requirements including proper documentation, approval, and audit trail. True if compliant, False otherwise.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting documentation or source system record that justifies the accrual. Required for SOX audit trail and compliance.

products.name: sox_control
products.description: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) internal control record defining and tracking the financial controls framework for the consumer goods enterprise. Covers the full control lifecycle: definition, testing, remediation, and certification. Captures control ID, name, objective, type (preventive/detective), frequency, risk area, responsible owner, test date, test method (inquiry, observation, inspection, re-performance), sample size, exceptions identified, remediation status, remediation due date, effectiveness rating, and test conclusion. Supports SOX 302/404 compliance, internal audit management, control deficiency tracking, and external auditor evidence packages.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SOX control record. Primary key for the sox_control data product.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center to which the control owner belongs, used for organizational reporting and control coverage analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO, Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: SOX controls capture GL account code; FK to gl_account enables direct validation against the chart of accounts.

attributes.name: primary_sox_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee responsible for executing and maintaining the control.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: tertiary_sox_tester_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal auditor or external auditor who performed the most recent control test.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code to which this control applies, supporting multi-entity SOX compliance programs.

attributes.name: control_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the control, typically following organizational control numbering scheme (e.g., FIN-AP-001, FIN-GL-005).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_documentation_link
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed control documentation, including control narratives, process flows, and evidence repositories.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is performed or executed (e.g., daily reconciliation, monthly close review, event-driven approval).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the control (e.g., 'Three-Way Match for Purchase Orders', 'Journal Entry Approval').
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_nature
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is performed manually by personnel, automated through system configuration, or semi-automated requiring both system and manual steps.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: Detailed statement of what the control is designed to achieve, including the risk it mitigates and the assertion it supports (e.g., 'Ensure all vendor invoices are matched to purchase orders and receiving documents before payment to prevent unauthorized disbursements').
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the control owner for reporting and accountability purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_owner_title
attributes.description: Job title of the control owner (e.g., Accounts Payable Manager, Financial Controller, GL Accountant).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control: active (in operation), inactive (temporarily suspended), under-review (being evaluated for changes), or retired (no longer applicable).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control based on its timing and purpose: preventive (stops errors before they occur), detective (identifies errors after occurrence), or corrective (remediates identified errors).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this control record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Severity classification of any identified control deficiency: none (no issues), control deficiency (minor issue), significant deficiency (important enough to merit attention), or material weakness (reasonable possibility of material misstatement).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this control was retired or superseded. Null for active controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this control became effective and operational.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Overall assessment of control effectiveness based on testing results: effective (operating as designed), ineffective (deficiency identified), not-tested (testing not yet performed), or not-applicable (control not in scope for current period).

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature of exceptions identified during testing, including root cause analysis and impact assessment.

attributes.name: exceptions_identified_count
attributes.description: The number of exceptions or deviations identified during the most recent control test.

attributes.name: external_auditor_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm that reviewed this control (e.g., Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG).

attributes.name: external_auditor_reviewed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this control has been reviewed by external auditors (true) or only by internal audit (false).

attributes.name: financial_statement_assertion
attributes.description: The specific financial statement assertion that this control supports: existence (assets/liabilities exist), completeness (all transactions recorded), accuracy (amounts correct), valuation (proper measurement), rights and obligations (entity has legal claim), or presentation and disclosure (proper classification and disclosure).

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter for which this control test and assessment applies, supporting quarterly SOX certification requirements.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this control test and assessment applies, supporting multi-year SOX compliance tracking.

attributes.name: itgc_dependent_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this control relies on IT general controls (true) or operates independently (false). ITGC-dependent controls require underlying IT controls to be effective.

attributes.name: key_control_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a key control (true) or supporting control (false). Key controls are critical to preventing or detecting material misstatements and receive heightened testing and monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this control record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which identified deficiencies must be remediated, typically driven by materiality and external audit timelines.

attributes.name: remediation_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on remediation activities, including actions taken, resources required, and progress updates.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation efforts for identified deficiencies: not-required (no deficiency), planned (remediation plan approved), in-progress (actively remediating), completed (remediation finished), or validated (remediation effectiveness confirmed).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: risk_area
attributes.description: The financial statement area or business process that this control addresses (e.g., Revenue Recognition, Accounts Payable, Inventory Valuation, Financial Close, COGS Allocation).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: test_conclusion
attributes.description: Detailed conclusion statement from the most recent control test, including auditor assessment, basis for conclusion, and any qualifications or limitations.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent control test was performed.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: The audit procedure used to test the control: inquiry (asking control owner), observation (watching control execution), inspection (examining evidence), re-performance (auditor executes control independently), or analytical review (comparing data patterns).

attributes.name: test_population_size
attributes.description: The total number of items or transactions in the population from which the test sample was drawn.

attributes.name: test_sample_size
attributes.description: The number of items or transactions selected for testing in the most recent control test.

attributes.name: tester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tester for audit trail and accountability purposes.

products.name: revenue_recognition
products.description: Revenue recognition event record capturing the timing and amount of revenue recognized under ASC 606 / IFRS 15 for consumer goods sales transactions.
