attributes.description: Gross freight cost charged by the carrier for this specific leg, expressed in the transaction currency. Used for freight cost allocation, COGS calculation, and carrier contract compliance auditing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the freight cost amount on this leg (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight cost consolidation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight in kilograms of the cargo on this leg, including packaging and pallets. Used for freight rate calculation, vehicle load compliance, and carrier billing validation.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM/TM Module

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: INCOTERMS 2020 code defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between shipper and carrier/buyer for this leg (e.g., FOB, CIF, DAP). Determines freight cost ownership and insurance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg requires temperature-controlled cold chain handling (True) for perishable or temperature-sensitive consumer goods (e.g., health, hygiene, or food products). Triggers cold chain monitoring and compliance checks.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg involves the transport of hazardous materials (True) as classified under DOT, IATA, or IMDG regulations. Triggers special handling, documentation (SDS), and carrier compliance requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Regulations; OSHA HazCom Standard; FDA CFR Title 49; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: is_transshipment_point
attributes.description: Indicates whether the destination node of this leg is an intermediate transshipment point (True) rather than the final delivery destination (False). Used to identify relay legs in intermodal routing and cost allocation.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA TM Module

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shipment leg record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5; SAP S/4HANA TM Module

attributes.name: leg_distance_km
attributes.description: Total distance in kilometers for this shipment leg from origin node to destination node. Used for freight cost calculation, carbon emissions estimation, and route optimization analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Module; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: leg_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer indicating the order of this leg within the parent shipment (e.g., 1 = first leg, 2 = second leg). Enables reconstruction of the full shipment route in correct order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Module; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: leg_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this shipment leg, often assigned by the carrier or freight forwarder (e.g., waybill number, booking reference). Used for carrier communication and freight audit.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD/TM Module

attributes.name: leg_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shipment leg reflecting its operational state. Drives track-and-trace visibility and exception management workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|in_transit|arrived|completed|cancelled|delayed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the origin node for this leg (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR). Used for customs compliance, trade lane analysis, and carbon footprint reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GS1 Global Standards; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in this shipment leg. Used for dock scheduling, vehicle load planning, and carrier billing reconciliation in consumer goods distribution.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: planned_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time at which the shipment leg is expected to arrive at the destination node. Used for receiving planning, dock scheduling, and OTIF target setting.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning; SAP S/4HANA TM Module

attributes.name: planned_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time at which the shipment leg is planned to depart from the origin node. Used for transportation planning, carrier booking, and On Time In Full (OTIF) baseline measurement.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning; SAP S/4HANA TM Module

attributes.name: planned_transit_hours
attributes.description: Expected transit duration in hours for this leg as defined in the carrier contract or transportation plan. Used as the baseline for on-time performance measurement and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Module; SAP IBP

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_status
attributes.description: Status of the Proof of Delivery (POD) document for this leg. Tracks whether POD has been received, is pending, or is under dispute. Required for freight audit, accounts payable, and customer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the Proof of Delivery (POD) was confirmed or received for this leg. Used for OTIF measurement, freight audit closure, and customer service resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain compliance during this leg. Applicable to temperature-sensitive consumer goods. Used for cold chain monitoring and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; ISO 22716; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain compliance during this leg. Applicable to temperature-sensitive consumer goods. Used for cold chain monitoring and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; ISO 22716; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for this leg (e.g., road, rail, air, ocean, intermodal, courier). Determines applicable freight rates, transit time benchmarks, and regulatory requirements. Aligns with GS1 and INCOTERMS classification.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; INCOTERMS 2020; SAP S/4HANA TM Module

attributes.name: transport_service_type
attributes.description: Service level classification for this leg (e.g., Full Truckload (FTL), Less-than-Truckload (LTL), parcel, express, standard, bulk). Impacts freight cost calculation and carrier selection logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle, vessel, aircraft, or rail car assigned to execute this leg (e.g., truck license plate, vessel IMO number, flight number, rail car ID). Used for asset tracking and carrier compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total cargo volume in cubic meters (CBM) for this leg. Used for volumetric freight rate calculation, container utilization analysis, and load planning optimization.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA TM Module

products.name: shipment_item
products.description: Line-item detail of goods included in a shipment. Captures SKU/GTIN, product description, ordered quantity, shipped quantity, unit of measure, gross weight, net weight, volume, hazmat flag, temperature-sensitive flag, lot/batch number, expiry date (FEFO compliance), and packaging type. Enables item-level traceability and cold-chain compliance tracking.

attributes.name: shipment_item_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shipment line item record in the logistics data platform. Primary key for the shipment_item entity.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center from which this item was picked and dispatched. Used for inventory depletion tracking, warehouse performance analytics, and DRP (Distribution Requirements Planning).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: event_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event_sku. Business justification: Needed for Promotional SKU shipment reconciliation to calculate allocated vs actual promotional volume per shipment.

attributes.name: handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the physical handling unit (pallet, carton, tote) in which this item is packed for shipment. Used for load planning, dock management, and proof of delivery reconciliation in the WMS.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module; GS1 Logistic Label Standards

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Required for lot traceability report linking inspected lots to shipped items, enabling recall and compliance verification.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment header record. Establishes the header-to-line relationship for all items within a single shipment dispatch event. Aligns with SAP SD delivery document header.

attributes.name: packaging_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_profile. Business justification: Needed for packaging sustainability reports: associate each shipped SKU with its packaging profile to calculate recyclability and carbon footprint.

attributes.name: prototype_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.prototype. Business justification: Needed to associate shipped items with the specific prototype they contain, enabling prototype test result traceability in the Prototype Test Management process.

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Needed for item‑level compliance reporting; links each shipped item to its regulatory registration for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Required for shipping manifest and inventory reconciliation; each shipment line must reference the master SKU to enable traceability, OTIF reporting, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Needed for Pick Allocation process linking each shipment item to the specific stock position it was sourced from, supporting inventory reservation and traceability.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed as received by the consignee at the delivery destination, captured from proof of delivery (POD) or EDI 214 acknowledgment. Used for invoice reconciliation and OTIF final measurement.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations, import duty determination, and trade compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WTO Rules of Origin; FDA Import Regulations; EU Customs Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment item record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which unit_cost and line_value are expressed. Enables multi-currency financial consolidation and FX reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_document_number
attributes.description: ERP delivery document number (e.g., SAP outbound delivery number) associated with this shipment line. Serves as the primary cross-reference between the logistics execution system and the financial/order management system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/WM Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the product lot being shipped, used to enforce FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory rotation, ensure shelf-life compliance at retail, and prevent shipment of expired goods.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU Regulation 1169/2011; FEFO Best Practices; ISO 22716

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of this shipment line item in kilograms, including product, inner packaging, and outer packaging. Used for freight cost calculation, carrier capacity planning, and customs declarations.
attributes.references: GS1 Logistic Label Standards; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code for the product, used for customs clearance, import duty calculation, and international trade compliance. Typically 6-10 digits per WCO HS nomenclature.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; CBP 19 CFR; EU Combined Nomenclature

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item contains a controlled substance subject to DEA scheduling, FDA drug regulations, or equivalent international narcotics controls. Triggers enhanced chain-of-custody documentation requirements.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; FDA 21 CFR; EU Regulation 273/2004

attributes.name: is_dsd
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is fulfilled via Direct Store Delivery (DSD) channel, bypassing the retailer's distribution center and delivering directly to the store. Impacts route planning, SFA integration, and trade promotion settlement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; DSD Industry Best Practices

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment item is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, labeling, and transport documentation per DOT, IATA, or IMDG regulations. Triggers mandatory SDS (Safety Data Sheet) attachment.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IMDG Code; EPA Regulations; OSHA HazCom Standard

attributes.name: is_temperature_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item requires temperature-controlled handling and transport (cold chain). When true, temperature range requirements and cold-chain compliance monitoring are enforced throughout the shipment lifecycle.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716; GDP Guidelines for Pharmaceuticals and Consumer Health

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product being shipped, including product name, variant, and pack size. Used on shipping documents, proof of delivery, and freight audit records.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this shipment line item. Tracks progression from warehouse picking through delivery confirmation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|picked|loaded|in_transit|delivered|short_shipped|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this item within the parent shipment, used for ordering and referencing individual line items. Corresponds to SAP SD delivery item position number.

attributes.name: line_value
attributes.description: Total declared value of this shipment line item (shipped_quantity × unit_cost), used for customs valuation, cargo insurance, and financial reporting. Expressed in the shipment currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/CO Module; SOX Financial Reporting; WTO Customs Valuation Agreement

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the product lot was manufactured. Used in conjunction with expiry date to calculate remaining shelf life at time of shipment and validate minimum remaining shelf life (MRSL) requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for storage and transport of this item. Applicable when is_temperature_sensitive is true. Exceedances trigger quality holds and non-conformance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; GDP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 22716

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for storage and transport of this item. Applicable when is_temperature_sensitive is true. Used to configure cold-chain monitoring alerts and carrier SLA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; GDP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 22716

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the product content only in kilograms, excluding all packaging materials. Required for regulatory labeling compliance, customs documentation, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU Regulation 1169/2011; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of this item originally ordered by the customer or requested in the purchase order. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) calculation and order fulfillment rate reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; S&OP Best Practices

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging unit in which the item is shipped. Determines handling requirements, stacking rules, and warehouse slotting. Aligns with GS1 packaging hierarchy levels.
attributes.references: GS1 Packaging Hierarchy Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Customer or retailer purchase order number associated with this shipment line. Required for EDI 856 ASN (Advance Ship Notice) transmission and retailer compliance programs.
attributes.references: EDI X12 856 ASN Standard; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment line item has been placed on a quality hold due to a failed QC inspection, temperature exceedance, or regulatory non-conformance. Items on hold must not be delivered until released by QA.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Product registration or regulatory approval number required for cross-border shipments of regulated consumer goods (e.g., FDA registration, EPA registration, EU REACH authorization). Stored for customs and import compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EPA Regulations; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for any quantity rejected or short-shipped on this line item, such as OOS (Out of Stock), quality hold, weight discrepancy, or carrier refusal. Used for root cause analysis and OTIF exception reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; ISO 9001 Non-Conformance Reporting

attributes.name: sales_order_line
attributes.description: Line item number within the originating sales order corresponding to this shipment item. Used for precise order-to-shipment reconciliation and partial fulfillment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; EDI 856 ASN Standards

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order number from the ERP system (SAP SD) that triggered this shipment line. Enables order-to-delivery traceability and OTIF measurement at the order line level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; EDI 856 ASN Standards

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned to an individual product unit, applicable for serialized items requiring unit-level traceability (e.g., high-value consumer electronics, regulated health products). Null for non-serialized bulk items.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; GS1 SGTIN Standards; DSCSA Serialization Requirements

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of this item loaded and dispatched in the shipment. May differ from ordered quantity due to partial fulfillment, OOS (Out of Stock) conditions, or substitution. Core metric for OTIF compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 ASN Standards

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) — an 18-digit identifier assigned to the logistic unit (pallet, case) containing this item. Enables pallet-level traceability and EDI 856 ASN compliance with retail trading partners.
attributes.references: GS1 SSCC Standard; EDI X12 856 ASN; CPSC Traceability Requirements

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location or bin within the warehouse from which this item was picked, as recorded in the WMS. Used for warehouse slotting optimization and pick path efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of measure for this item at time of shipment, used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, inventory valuation, and freight cost allocation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO standard cost.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the shipped quantity is expressed. Common values include EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), L (litre), GAL (gallon). Aligns with GS1 UOM codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 UOM Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this shipment item record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: volume_m3
attributes.description: Cubic volume of this shipment line item in cubic metres, used for truck load planning, container utilization optimization, and freight rate calculation based on dimensional weight.
attributes.references: GS1 Logistic Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

products.name: delivery
products.description: Record of final delivery execution and proof of delivery (POD) at the consignee location. Captures delivery number, shipment reference, consignee account, delivery address, scheduled and actual delivery timestamps, delivered quantity, delivery status (full/partial/failed/refused), recipient name and signature, electronic signature flag, condition of goods at receipt, photo attachment references, discrepancy notes, POD source (DSD handheld, e-POD app, paper scan), driver/vehicle reference, and exception codes. SSOT for last-mile delivery outcomes, OTIF calculation, and dispute resolution evidence.

attributes.name: delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each delivery execution record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the delivery data product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver or delivery agent responsible for executing the last-mile delivery. Used for performance tracking and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment record from which this delivery was dispatched. Links delivery execution back to the shipment planning record.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned delivery route assigned to this delivery. Enables route optimization analysis and OTIF (On Time In Full) performance measurement.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Delivery execution is tied to a specific sales order; the link supports delivery confirmation and invoicing workflows.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consignee (receiving party) account — typically a retail store, distribution center, or wholesale customer — to whom the goods are delivered.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle or transport unit used for this delivery. Supports fleet management, cold-chain compliance, and route analytics.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the delivery was completed at the consignee location, as recorded by the driver via DSD handheld, e-POD app, or paper scan. Principal business event timestamp for OTIF calculation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 EANCOM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: actual_temperature_c
attributes.description: Actual temperature in degrees Celsius recorded during delivery, captured by IoT sensor or driver log. Used to verify cold-chain compliance and support FDA/EU GDP regulatory reporting for temperature-sensitive goods.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22000; EU GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the delivery destination. Captured at time of delivery for POD (Proof of Delivery) and audit purposes, independent of master address data.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the carrier or 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) provider responsible for executing the delivery. Used for carrier performance scorecarding, freight audit, and contract compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: carrier_tracking_number
attributes.description: External tracking number assigned by the carrier for track-and-trace visibility. Enables real-time shipment monitoring and customer-facing delivery status updates.
attributes.references: GS1 SSCC Standards; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the delivery destination address. Used for geographic delivery performance analysis, route optimization, and regional OTIF (On Time In Full) reporting.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery requires temperature-controlled cold-chain logistics (True) — applicable for perishable food, pharmaceutical, or temperature-sensitive consumer goods. Drives vehicle assignment and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22000 Food Safety; EU GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: consignee_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the receiving party (store, warehouse, or customer) at the delivery destination. Used for POD (Proof of Delivery) documentation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the delivery destination (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Required for cross-border regulatory compliance, customs documentation, and international freight management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the delivery record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA SD outbound delivery creation). Audit trail field for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the freight cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight cost reporting and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of goods physically delivered and accepted at the consignee location. Core metric for OTIF (On Time In Full) in-full measurement, fill rate KPI, and invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 EANCOM

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the delivery, typically sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD outbound delivery document (e.g., 80XXXXXXXX). Used in EDI communications, carrier coordination, and customer-facing tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery execution. 'full' = all ordered quantities delivered; 'partial' = some quantities delivered; 'failed' = delivery attempt unsuccessful; 'refused' = consignee rejected delivery; 'pending' = delivery not yet attempted. Core field for OTIF (On Time In Full) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 EANCOM

attributes.name: delivery_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery method. DSD (Direct Store Delivery) = manufacturer delivers directly to retail shelf; warehouse = delivery to distribution center; cross_dock = transit without storage; drop_ship = vendor ships directly to consignee; returns = reverse logistics delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DSD|warehouse|cross_dock|drop_ship|returns — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Consumer Goods Industry DSD Standards

attributes.name: electronic_signature_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the POD (Proof of Delivery) signature was captured electronically (True) via e-POD app or DSD handheld, or obtained on paper (False). Determines evidentiary strength for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act; eIDAS Regulation; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized exception code identifying the reason for delivery failure, partial delivery, or refusal (e.g., CONSIGNEE_CLOSED, ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND, CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, REFUSED_QUALITY). Sourced from carrier or DSD system exception taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing delivery discrepancies, exceptions, or special circumstances recorded by the driver or dispatcher. Supplements the structured exception code for dispute resolution and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD POD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: first_attempt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the first delivery attempt at the consignee location. Relevant when the delivery required multiple attempts (e.g., failed first attempt followed by successful re-delivery). Supports carrier performance analytics.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight cost incurred for this delivery in the transaction currency. Used for freight audit, carrier invoice reconciliation, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) allocation, and logistics cost-to-serve analytics.

attributes.name: goods_condition_code
attributes.description: Condition of goods as assessed at point of delivery receipt. 'good' = acceptable; 'damaged' = physical damage observed; 'partial_damage' = some units damaged; 'temperature_breach' = cold-chain violation detected; 'contaminated' = product integrity compromised. Triggers quality investigation and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: good|damaged|partial_damage|temperature_breach|contaminated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FDA 21 CFR; CPSC Regulations

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the full ordered quantity was delivered (True). Component of the OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI, enabling separate on-time vs. in-full root cause analysis and fill rate reporting.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Compliance Program; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery was completed on or before the scheduled delivery date/time (True). Component of the OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI, enabling separate on-time vs. in-full root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Compliance Program; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of goods ordered for this delivery as per the originating sales order. Baseline for OTIF (On Time In Full) in-full calculation and delivery fill rate measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 EANCOM

attributes.name: otif_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery met the OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI criteria — True if delivered on or before the scheduled date AND at 100% of ordered quantity. Core retail compliance metric for major retailers (e.g., Walmart OTIF penalty program).
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Compliance Program; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: photo_attachment_reference
attributes.description: Storage reference or URL to photo evidence captured at delivery (e.g., goods condition, placement, damaged packaging). Supports POD (Proof of Delivery) documentation and insurance claims.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD POD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: pod_source
attributes.description: System or method used to capture the POD (Proof of Delivery). DSD_handheld = Direct Store Delivery device; epod_app = electronic POD mobile application; paper_scan = digitized paper document; EDI = Electronic Data Interchange confirmation; manual = manually entered. Determines data quality and evidentiary weight.
attributes.references: GS1 EANCOM EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the delivery destination. Supports geographic clustering, last-mile zone analysis, and carrier zone-based freight cost allocation.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU)

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for ordered and delivered quantities (e.g., EA=each, CS=case, PAL=pallet, KG=kilogram). Aligns with GS1 unit of measure codes and SAP base unit of measure configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PAL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; ISO 80000; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who physically received and signed for the delivery at the consignee location. Core POD (Proof of Delivery) field for dispute resolution and legal evidence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA SD POD

attributes.name: refused_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of goods refused or rejected by the consignee at point of delivery. Triggers reverse logistics, credit memo processing, and quality investigation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Returns Management; ISO 9001

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which the delivery was scheduled to arrive at the consignee location. Used as the baseline for OTIF (On Time In Full) on-time measurement and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise planned date and time window start for delivery at the consignee location. Supports time-window compliance measurement and carrier SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: signature_reference
attributes.description: Storage reference or URL pointing to the captured electronic or scanned signature image for this delivery. Used as legal evidence in POD (Proof of Delivery) dispute resolution.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) — 18-digit identifier assigned to the shipping unit (pallet, case, or container) for this delivery. Enables end-to-end supply chain traceability per GS1 standards.
attributes.references: GS1 SSCC Standard; GS1-128 Barcode Specification

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain delivery compliance. Compared against actual recorded temperature to detect cold-chain breaches and trigger regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22000; EU GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain delivery compliance. Compared against actual recorded temperature to detect cold-chain breaches and trigger regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22000; EU GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the delivery record in the source system. Supports incremental data loading, audit trails, and change detection in the Silver layer.

products.name: proof_of_delivery
products.description: Formal POD record capturing evidence of successful goods receipt at the consignee. Captures delivery reference, recipient name and signature, timestamp of receipt, condition of goods at delivery (intact/damaged), photo attachment references, electronic signature flag, discrepancy notes, and POD source (DSD handheld, e-POD app, paper scan). Critical for dispute resolution, freight audit, and DSD compliance.
products.reference: POD / e-POD / DSD Proof of Delivery

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the proof of delivery record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or 3PL responsible for executing the delivery. Used for freight audit, carrier performance tracking, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: delivery_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery order (SAP outbound delivery document) associated with this POD. Enables traceability from POD back to the originating delivery instruction.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver or delivery agent who executed the delivery. Used for DSD compliance, driver performance tracking, and dispute resolution. May reference an internal employee ID or carrier-assigned driver code.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module; OSHA

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment for which this proof of delivery was captured. Links POD to the outbound or inbound shipment record.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned delivery route on which this POD was captured. Enables route-level performance analysis, stop sequencing, and DSD route compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consignee (retail customer, distributor, or DC) who received the goods. Supports PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The bill of lading number issued by the carrier for this shipment. Serves as the primary legal transport document reference and is used in freight audit, customs compliance, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: carrier_scan_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the carrier's own barcode or RFID scan event at the point of delivery, as transmitted via EDI or carrier portal. May differ from receipt_timestamp if there is a lag between physical delivery and system capture.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery maintained required cold-chain temperature conditions throughout transit (True = compliant). Critical for temperature-sensitive consumer goods (e.g., dairy, frozen, pharmaceutical). Supports FDA and ISO 22716 compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POD record was first created in the system, either by a DSD handheld, e-POD app, or paper scan ingestion process. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_reference_number
attributes.description: The consignee's own purchase order or reference number for this delivery. Enables cross-referencing between the supplier's POD and the customer's receiving records for EDI reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of goods confirmed as received by the consignee at the time of delivery. Used to calculate OTIF (On Time In Full) fill rate and identify quantity discrepancies against the ordered quantity.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: delivery_location_gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) of the delivery destination. Provides a globally unique, standardized identifier for the consignee location, enabling interoperability with trading partners and EDI systems.

attributes.name: delivery_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the physical delivery location (e.g., store name, distribution center name, warehouse name). Provides human-readable identification of the delivery destination for reporting and operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 GLN Standards

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery event. Drives freight audit workflows, OTIF (On Time In Full) reporting, and dispute resolution processes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|delivered|partially_delivered|failed|disputed|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: delivery_temperature_c
attributes.description: Recorded temperature in degrees Celsius at the point of delivery for temperature-sensitive goods. Used to verify cold-chain compliance and support FDA regulatory reporting for perishable or pharmaceutical consumer goods.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a discrepancy was identified at the time of delivery (True = discrepancy exists). Triggers downstream dispute resolution, freight audit, and claims workflows.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of any discrepancy observed at delivery, such as quantity shortages, damaged packaging, wrong items, or temperature excursions. Used in dispute resolution and freight audit processes.

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the type of discrepancy identified at delivery. Enables structured reporting and root cause analysis across the logistics network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: quantity_shortage|overage|damaged_goods|wrong_item|temperature_breach|missing_documentation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which a delivery dispute was formally resolved. Used to measure dispute resolution cycle time and SLA compliance for freight audit and carrier management.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any freight or delivery dispute associated with this POD. Tracks the lifecycle of dispute resolution from identification through closure. Supports freight audit and carrier claims management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: dsd_route_stop_sequence
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct Store Delivery (DSD) Route Stop Sequence
attributes.description: The sequential stop number of this delivery within the DSD route. Used for route optimization analysis, driver performance measurement, and DSD compliance reporting in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module

attributes.name: electronic_signature_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the POD was captured via electronic signature (True) or via paper-based signature (False). Drives e-POD compliance reporting and DSD handheld audit workflows.
attributes.references: FTC Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (ESIGN); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: freight_bill_number
attributes.description: The carrier-issued freight bill or bill of lading (BOL) number associated with this delivery. Used to match POD records to freight invoices during freight audit and payment processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: geofence_validated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GPS coordinates captured at delivery were within the expected geofence boundary of the consignee location (True = within geofence). Used to detect fraudulent or erroneous POD captures in DSD operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery confirmation. Used for geofencing validation, proof of delivery location verification, and DSD compliance auditing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery confirmation. Used alongside latitude for geofencing validation, delivery location verification, and DSD compliance auditing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: goods_condition
attributes.description: Condition of the goods as assessed at the point of delivery by the recipient. Drives claims processing, carrier liability assessment, and quality incident reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: intact|damaged|partial_damage|refused|short_delivered — promote to reference product if additional conditions are required]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of goods that was originally ordered and expected to be delivered. Compared against delivered_quantity to compute fill rate and identify shortages or overages for OTIF reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SAP IBP

attributes.name: otif_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery met the OTIF (On Time In Full) criteria — delivered on or before the scheduled date and at the full ordered quantity (True = OTIF achieved). Core KPI for supply chain performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: photo_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of photo attachments captured and associated with this POD record. Indicates the volume of photographic evidence available for dispute resolution and claims processing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module

attributes.name: photo_attachment_urls
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of URL or file path references to photo images captured at delivery (e.g., photos of damaged goods, delivery location, pallet condition). Stored in secure document repository and referenced for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: pod_confirmation_method
attributes.description: The method used to confirm delivery receipt (e.g., signature, PIN code, photo-only, verbal confirmation, unattended drop). Supports compliance with carrier SLA requirements and DSD operational standards.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module; FTC ESIGN Act

attributes.name: pod_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number for this POD document. Used in freight audit, dispute resolution, and EDI acknowledgement exchanges with carriers and customers.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: pod_source
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the POD was captured. Distinguishes between DSD (Direct Store Delivery) handheld devices, e-POD mobile applications, scanned paper documents, EDI transmissions, or carrier portal uploads. Critical for DSD compliance and data quality assessment.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud DSD Module

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the delivered and ordered quantities (e.g., EA = Each, CS = Case, PAL = Pallet, KG = Kilogram). Ensures consistent quantity comparison across SKUs and delivery types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PAL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the consignee acknowledged receipt of the goods. This is the principal business event timestamp for the POD and is the authoritative time used for OTIF measurement and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual at the consignee location who physically received and signed for the goods. Required for legal proof of delivery and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; FTC Advertising and Labeling

attributes.name: recipient_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual who received the goods (e.g., Receiving Manager, Store Associate, Warehouse Clerk). Provides context for authorization level of the signatory.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The planned delivery date as agreed in the delivery order or carrier SLA. Used to calculate on-time performance against the OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: signature_image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path reference to the stored digital image of the recipient's signature. Used as legal evidence in freight disputes and customer claims. Stored in secure document repository.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this POD record, such as status updates, discrepancy note additions, or signature capture. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle or transport unit used for the delivery (e.g., truck registration number, fleet asset ID). Used for route optimization analysis, cold-chain compliance, and carrier audit.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module; OSHA

products.name: freight_order
products.description: Transportation planning and tendering record issued to a carrier for a specific shipment movement. Captures freight order number, tendering method (spot/contract/load board), carrier assignment, load type (FTL/LTL/parcel), pickup and delivery locations, requested pickup window, freight order status (tendered/accepted/rejected/in-transit/delivered), agreed rate, and equipment type required. Sourced from SAP TM / Blue Yonder TMS.

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the freight order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier rate agreement or contract under which this freight order is priced. Null for spot-tendered orders without a pre-negotiated contract.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Agreement; Blue Yonder TMS Rate Management

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (trucking company, parcel carrier, or 3PL) assigned to execute this freight order. Links to the carrier master.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Master; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns internal cost center to freight orders for budgeting and chargeback of transportation expenses.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery/destination location (retailer DC, customer warehouse, store, or end-consumer address) to which the freight order is directed.
attributes.references: SAP TM Location Master; GS1 GLN Standard

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Freight order creation is driven by a sales order; linking enables transport planning and order‑to‑shipment reporting.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pickup/origin location (plant, warehouse, distribution center, or supplier facility) from which the freight order originates.
attributes.references: SAP TM Location Master; GS1 GLN Standard

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal business unit or facility acting as the shipper/consignor for this freight order.

attributes.name: accessorial_charges_amount
attributes.description: Total accessorial charges (e.g., liftgate, detention, residential delivery, inside delivery, hazmat handling) applied to this freight order beyond the base rate and fuel surcharge.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Charges; Blue Yonder TMS; NMFC Accessorial Standards

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the carrier completed delivery at the destination location. Core field for OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement, carrier scorecard, and proof-of-delivery reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Event Management; Blue Yonder TMS Track and Trace; OTIF KPI

attributes.name: actual_pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the carrier picked up the freight at the origin location. Compared against the pickup window to determine on-time pickup performance for OTIF reporting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Event Management; Blue Yonder TMS Track and Trace; OTIF KPI

attributes.name: agreed_freight_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated or spot-quoted rate agreed with the carrier for executing this freight order, expressed in the transaction currency. Used for freight cost accrual, freight audit, and carrier rate benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Agreement; Blue Yonder TMS Rate Management; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number serving as the legal contract of carriage between the shipper and carrier. Required for freight claims, customs clearance, and proof-of-delivery documentation.
attributes.references: UCC Article 7 Bills of Lading; SAP TM; GS1 EDI 856 ASN Standard; FDA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: carrier_invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number issued by the carrier for this freight order. Used for freight audit and payment matching in accounts payable. Populated upon receipt of carrier invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; SAP TM Freight Settlement; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight order record was first created in the source TMS system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from order creation to carrier acceptance.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the agreed freight rate and all monetary amounts on this freight order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_window_end
attributes.description: End of the agreed delivery time window at the destination location. Defines the latest acceptable delivery time per retailer or customer SLA.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS; Retailer SLA

attributes.name: delivery_window_start
attributes.description: Start of the agreed delivery time window at the destination location. Defines the earliest acceptable delivery time per retailer or customer SLA.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS; Retailer SLA

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the freight movement relative to the company's network: inbound (from supplier to plant/DC), outbound (from plant/DC to customer/retailer), or interplant (between internal facilities).
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order Type; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of transportation equipment required for this freight order (e.g., dry van, refrigerated/reefer, flatbed, tanker, intermodal container). Critical for cold-chain compliance for temperature-sensitive consumer goods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_van|reefer|flatbed|tanker|intermodal|curtainsider|box_truck — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Equipment Type; Blue Yonder TMS; ISO 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: freight_audit_status
attributes.description: Status of the freight invoice audit process for this freight order. Tracks whether the carrier invoice has been received, validated against the agreed rate, approved for payment, or disputed due to discrepancies.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Settlement; Blue Yonder TMS; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: freight_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the freight order as issued by the Transportation Management System (TMS). Used in carrier communications, EDI transactions, and proof-of-delivery documents.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; GS1 EDI Standard

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Fuel surcharge applied to this freight order by the carrier, expressed in the transaction currency. Fuel surcharges are typically indexed to DOE diesel fuel price indices and are a standard component of carrier invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Charges; Blue Yonder TMS; DOE Diesel Fuel Index

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including product, packaging, and pallet weight. Used for carrier rate calculation, weight-based freight billing, and regulatory compliance for road transport weight limits.
attributes.references: SAP TM Shipment Weight; GS1 Logistics Label Standard; EU Road Transport Regulation

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the transfer of risk, cost responsibility, and delivery obligations between buyer and seller for this freight order. Governs freight cost ownership and insurance responsibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight order requires temperature-controlled cold-chain transportation (e.g., refrigerated or frozen consumer goods). Triggers reefer equipment assignment and temperature monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight order contains hazardous materials (hazmat) requiring special handling, placarding, and regulatory documentation per DOT 49 CFR and IATA/IMDG regulations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; IMDG Code; EPA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight order record was last modified in the source TMS system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shipment load mode. FTL (Full Truckload) indicates the carrier's entire trailer is dedicated to this shipment; LTL (Less-than-Truckload) indicates shared trailer space; parcel indicates small-package carrier service; intermodal indicates multi-modal container movement; rail indicates rail freight.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Mode; NMFC Classification; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the freight order. Tracks progression from tendering to carrier through acceptance, in-transit movement, and final delivery or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tendered|accepted|rejected|in_transit|delivered|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order Status; Blue Yonder TMS Status Model

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in this freight order. Used for dock scheduling, trailer space planning, and carrier rate calculation for pallet-based pricing agreements.
attributes.references: SAP TM Handling Units; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Pallet Label Standard

attributes.name: pickup_window_end
attributes.description: End of the agreed pickup time window at the origin location. Defines the latest time the carrier may arrive for loading without incurring a late pickup penalty.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS Appointment Scheduling

attributes.name: pickup_window_start
attributes.description: Start of the agreed pickup time window at the origin location. Defines the earliest time the carrier may arrive for loading. Used for dock scheduling and carrier compliance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS Appointment Scheduling

attributes.name: pod_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Proof of Delivery (POD) document has been received and recorded for this freight order. Required for freight payment release, dispute resolution, and retailer compliance.
attributes.references: SAP TM Proof of Delivery; Blue Yonder TMS; GS1 EDI 214

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the Proof of Delivery (POD) was received and confirmed. Used for delivery confirmation, OTIF (On Time In Full) final measurement, and freight payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP TM Proof of Delivery; Blue Yonder TMS; OTIF KPI

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used as the primary tracking identifier for LTL (Less-than-Truckload) shipments. Issued by the carrier upon freight pickup and used for track-and-trace and freight claims.
attributes.references: NMFC LTL PRO Number Standard; SAP TM; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipper requests delivery at the destination location. Core input for OTIF (On Time In Full) performance measurement and retailer compliance scoring.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; OTIF KPI Standard

attributes.name: requested_pickup_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipper requests the carrier to pick up the freight at the origin location. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement and carrier performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; OTIF KPI Standard

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Contracted service level for this freight order defining the expected transit time commitment (e.g., standard ground, expedited 2-day, overnight, same-day). Drives carrier selection and freight cost.
attributes.references: SAP TM Service Level; Blue Yonder TMS; Carrier SLA

attributes.name: shipment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number used by the carrier or 3PL to identify this shipment in their system. Enables cross-system track-and-trace and carrier invoice reconciliation via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange).
attributes.references: SAP TM External Reference; GS1 EDI 214 Transport Status; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain shipments. Applicable when is_cold_chain is True. Exceedance triggers a quality hold and potential product rejection per GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) standards.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; GDP Guidelines (EU); GMP

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain shipments. Applicable when is_cold_chain is True. Used for carrier compliance verification and cold-chain excursion detection.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; GDP Guidelines (EU)

attributes.name: tendering_method
attributes.description: Method used to tender the freight order to a carrier. Contract indicates a pre-negotiated rate agreement; spot indicates a one-time market rate; load_board indicates posting to a freight exchange; dedicated indicates a committed fleet arrangement; auction indicates a competitive bidding process.
attributes.references: SAP TM Tendering; Blue Yonder TMS Carrier Selection

attributes.name: tms_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the source Transportation Management System (TMS) from which this freight order record was ingested into the lakehouse. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing.
attributes.references: SAP TM; Blue Yonder TMS; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: total_freight_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of this freight order including base rate, fuel surcharge, and all accessorial charges. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) allocation, freight budget vs. actuals reporting, and carrier invoice audit.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Cost; Blue Yonder TMS; SOX Financial Reporting; COGS Accounting

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation for this freight order. Drives regulatory requirements, transit time expectations, and carbon emissions calculation for sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Mode; GS1 Transport Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Reporting

attributes.name: volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the shipment in cubic meters. Used for LTL (Less-than-Truckload) dimensional weight calculation, trailer utilization analysis, and freight cost optimization.
attributes.references: SAP TM Shipment Volume; Blue Yonder TMS; NMFC Dimensional Weight Rules

products.name: route
products.description: Optimized delivery route plan for a vehicle or driver covering multiple sequential stops. Captures route ID, route date, vehicle/trailer assignment, driver reference, total planned distance and duration, planned departure time, route optimization algorithm used, route status (planned/dispatched/in-progress/completed), and ordered stop details including stop sequence, consignee reference, delivery address, planned/actual arrival and departure times, stop type (delivery/pickup/cross-dock), cases/pallets to deliver, stop status, and dwell time. Supports last-mile route optimization, DSD execution, and stop-level performance tracking.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the delivery route plan. Primary key for the route entity in the logistics domain.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or 3PL partner responsible for executing this route. Relevant for outsourced last-mile and DSD operations.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating depot, distribution center, or warehouse from which this route departs. Links to the facility/location master.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver assigned to execute this route. Links to the workforce/driver master record.

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp at which the vehicle departed the depot. Compared against planned_departure_time to measure on-time departure performance and identify dispatch delays.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: actual_distance_km
attributes.description: Actual driving distance recorded for the route in kilometers, typically captured via telematics or GPS. Compared against planned distance for route efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: actual_duration_min
attributes.description: Actual total route duration in minutes from depot departure to return. Used to measure route execution efficiency and identify deviations from plan.

attributes.name: actual_return_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp at which the vehicle returned to the depot. Used to calculate total route duration, driver overtime, and vehicle utilization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; OSHA Hours-of-Service Regulations

attributes.name: co2_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Estimated carbon dioxide emissions in kilograms for this route, calculated from fuel consumption and vehicle type. Supports sustainability reporting, ESG disclosures, and ISO 14001 environmental management.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the system, typically when the route plan was generated by the optimization engine or manually by a dispatcher.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the freight_cost field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across global distribution networks.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Total planned or actual freight cost for this route in the operating currency. Used for transportation cost tracking, carrier invoice reconciliation, and freight audit processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_liters
attributes.description: Estimated or actual fuel consumed in liters for this route. Used for fleet cost management, carbon emissions calculation, and sustainability reporting under ISO 14001.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route carries hazardous materials (e.g., aerosols, flammable cleaning products) requiring special handling, placarding, and regulatory compliance under DOT and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Regulations; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; OSHA SDS Requirements

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route requires cold-chain compliance (temperature-controlled vehicle and handling). Critical for perishable consumer goods, dairy, frozen foods, and pharmaceutical products subject to FDA and GMP requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP; GS1 Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: is_dsd
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is a Direct Store Delivery (DSD) route, where the manufacturer delivers directly to retail store shelves bypassing the retailer's distribution center. Drives specific execution workflows in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1 DSD Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or instructions for the route, such as special handling requirements, access restrictions, or dispatcher comments. Visible to drivers via mobile dispatch applications.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: optimization_algorithm
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the route optimization algorithm or engine used to generate this route plan (e.g., 'VRP-TW', 'Clarke-Wright', 'Blue Yonder Optimizer v4.2'). Supports algorithm performance benchmarking and audit.

attributes.name: optimization_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the route optimization algorithm was executed to generate this route plan. Used to track plan freshness and identify routes built on stale demand data.

attributes.name: otif_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route achieved full OTIF (On Time In Full) compliance — all stops were serviced within the agreed time windows and all ordered quantities were delivered. Key KPI for retailer scorecards.
attributes.references: GS1 OTIF Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP IBP

attributes.name: planned_departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp at which the vehicle is planned to depart the depot for this route. Used for driver scheduling, dock door allocation, and on-time departure KPI tracking.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: planned_distance_km
attributes.description: Total planned driving distance for the route in kilometers, as calculated by the route optimization algorithm. Used for fuel cost estimation, carbon footprint calculation, and driver pay.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: planned_duration_min
attributes.description: Total planned route duration in minutes, including drive time and estimated stop dwell times. Used for driver scheduling and OTIF planning.

attributes.name: planned_return_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp at which the vehicle is expected to return to the depot after completing all stops. Used for driver hours-of-service compliance and dock planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; OSHA Hours-of-Service Regulations

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic or physical proof of delivery (POD) must be captured at each stop on this route. Drives mobile app workflows for drivers and supports dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1

attributes.name: route_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this route is planned to be executed. Used for daily route scheduling, driver dispatch, and OTIF performance tracking.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the route, typically reflecting the geographic territory or customer cluster served (e.g., 'Northeast Metro DSD Run').
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the route, used in operational communications, driver manifests, and carrier EDI exchanges. May align with SAP Transportation Management route codes.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD; EDI X12 204

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the route. Tracks progression from planning through dispatch, active execution, and completion or cancellation. Supports real-time track-and-trace and operational dashboards.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route by operational purpose. DSD (Direct Store Delivery) routes serve retail outlets directly; mixed routes combine deliveries and pickups; cross-dock routes transfer goods between facilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery|pickup|mixed|cross_dock|dsd|milk_run — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1

attributes.name: service_time_window_end
attributes.description: Latest allowable timestamp for the route to complete servicing stops. Breaching this window results in OTIF failures and potential retailer chargebacks.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1 OTIF Standards

attributes.name: service_time_window_start
attributes.description: Earliest allowable timestamp for the route to begin servicing stops, as defined by customer or retailer receiving window constraints. Used as an input constraint in the route optimization algorithm.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable cargo temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain routes. Breaches trigger non-conformance events and potential product quarantine per GMP and FDA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP; GS1 Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable cargo temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain routes. Enforced during transit to maintain product integrity and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP; GS1 Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: total_cases_delivered
attributes.description: Actual number of cases delivered across all stops on this route. Compared against total_cases_planned to compute fill rate and identify short-shipments.
