attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: total_cases_planned
attributes.description: Total number of cases (selling units) planned for delivery across all stops on this route. Used for vehicle load planning and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: total_pallets_planned
attributes.description: Total number of pallets planned for loading on this route. Used for vehicle capacity utilization and dock door planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: total_stops_completed
attributes.description: Actual number of stops successfully completed during route execution. Compared against total_stops_planned to measure route completion rate and identify failed deliveries.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: total_stops_planned
attributes.description: Total number of delivery or pickup stops planned for this route. Used for workload balancing, route complexity scoring, and driver capacity planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total planned cargo volume in cubic meters for the route. Used alongside total_weight_kg to assess vehicle cube utilization and prevent overloading.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total planned payload weight in kilograms for the route. Used to verify compliance with vehicle gross vehicle weight (GVW) regulations and optimize load efficiency.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this route record, such as stop additions, driver reassignments, or status updates. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the vehicle's rated payload capacity utilized by the planned load on this route. Key metric for fleet efficiency and freight cost optimization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle or trailer assigned to execute this route. Links to the vehicle master in the fleet management domain.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

products.name: route_stop
products.description: Individual stop on a planned delivery route. Captures stop sequence number, consignee account reference, delivery address, planned arrival and departure times, actual arrival and departure times, stop type (delivery/pickup/cross-dock), number of cases/pallets to deliver, stop status, and dwell time. Enables stop-level performance tracking and route adherence measurement.

attributes.name: route_stop_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual stop on a planned delivery route. Primary key for the route_stop entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party logistics (3PL) carrier or internal fleet entity responsible for executing this stop. Used for carrier performance measurement, freight audit, and contract compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver assigned to execute this route stop. Links to the workforce or driver master record for performance tracking, compliance, and payroll purposes.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_storage_location. Business justification: Required for Stop Execution Report to map each route stop to the exact warehouse storage location for picking/delivery, enabling OTIF compliance tracking.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound shipment or delivery order associated with this stop. Links stop-level execution to the shipment document in SAP S/4HANA SD or Blue Yonder WMS.

attributes.name: route_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time

attributes.name: actual_cases
attributes.description: Actual number of cases delivered or picked up at this stop as confirmed by the driver or proof of delivery (POD) scan. Used for OTIF fill rate calculation and short-shipment identification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the driver departed this stop after completing the delivery or pickup activity. Used for dwell time calculation, route performance analysis, and carrier SLA reporting.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: actual_pallets
attributes.description: Actual number of pallets delivered or picked up at this stop as confirmed at execution. Used for OTIF measurement, pallet reconciliation, and carrier billing verification.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: actual_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight in kilograms of goods delivered or picked up at this stop as confirmed at execution. Used for freight audit, carrier billing reconciliation, and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: arrival_variance_minutes
attributes.description: Difference in minutes between actual arrival time and planned arrival time. Positive values indicate late arrival; negative values indicate early arrival. Core metric for OTIF and route adherence KPI reporting.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop requires temperature-controlled cold chain handling during delivery. Triggers cold chain compliance monitoring and temperature logging requirements for perishable or temperature-sensitive consumer goods.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this route stop record was first created in the system, typically when the route was planned and stops were generated. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: delivery_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the delivery location for this stop. Used for driver navigation, proof of delivery, and logistics compliance documentation.

attributes.name: delivery_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the delivery location (suite, unit, dock number, building identifier). Supplements the primary address for precise delivery execution.

attributes.name: delivery_city
attributes.description: City of the delivery location for this stop. Used for geographic segmentation of delivery performance and freight cost analysis.

attributes.name: delivery_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the delivery location (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for cross-border logistics compliance and international freight management.

attributes.name: delivery_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the delivery location. Used for route optimization, freight zone determination, and last-mile delivery analytics.

attributes.name: delivery_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the delivery location. Used for regulatory compliance, freight lane analysis, and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_window_end
attributes.description: Latest acceptable arrival time at this stop as agreed with the consignee or retailer. Defines the end of the customer-committed delivery time window for SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: delivery_window_start
attributes.description: Earliest acceptable arrival time at this stop as agreed with the consignee or retailer. Defines the start of the customer-committed delivery time window for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes the driver spent at this stop, calculated as the difference between actual departure and actual arrival times. Key KPI for stop-level efficiency, driver productivity, and route optimization.

attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why a delivery stop was not completed successfully (e.g., consignee closed, refused delivery, access denied, vehicle breakdown). attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the delivery stop location in decimal degrees. Used for route optimization, geofencing, and real-time track-and-trace in transportation management systems.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the delivery stop location in decimal degrees. Used alongside latitude for route optimization, geofencing, and real-time track-and-trace.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: otif_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop met the On Time In Full (OTIF) delivery standard — i.e., arrived within the committed delivery window and delivered the full planned quantity. Core KPI for retail customer compliance and supply chain performance.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Walmart OTIF Policy; SAP IBP S&OP

attributes.name: planned_arrival_time
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time the driver is expected to arrive at this stop, as determined by the route planning system. Used as the baseline for On Time In Full (OTIF) measurement and service level agreement (SLA) compliance.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: planned_cases
attributes.description: Number of cases (standard shipping units) planned to be delivered or picked up at this stop as per the delivery order. Used for load planning, vehicle capacity utilization, and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: planned_departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time the driver is expected to depart this stop after completing the delivery or pickup activity. Used for route schedule adherence and dwell time planning.

attributes.name: planned_pallets
attributes.description: Number of pallets planned to be delivered or picked up at this stop. Used for vehicle load planning, dock scheduling, and warehouse labor planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: planned_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total planned weight in kilograms of goods to be delivered or picked up at this stop. Used for vehicle load compliance, freight cost calculation, and carrier billing.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: pod_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether a proof of delivery (POD) was successfully captured at this stop (e.g., electronic signature, barcode scan, photo). Required for invoice settlement, dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: pod_method
attributes.description: Method used to capture proof of delivery at this stop. Electronic_signature indicates digital sign-off; barcode_scan indicates GS1 scan confirmation; photo indicates photographic evidence; paper indicates manual paper POD; none indicates no POD captured.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: pod_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who signed or confirmed receipt of the delivery at this stop. Used for delivery verification, dispute resolution, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when proof of delivery was captured at this stop. Used for delivery confirmation audit trail, invoice trigger, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: stop_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the stop location, typically the retail store name, distribution center name, or customer site name. Used for driver manifests and operational reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: stop_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this stop within the planned delivery route. Determines the order in which the driver visits consignees. Used for route adherence analysis and optimization.

attributes.name: stop_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of this route stop within its lifecycle. Planned indicates not yet visited; in_transit indicates driver en route; arrived indicates driver on-site; completed indicates delivery confirmed; skipped indicates stop bypassed; failed indicates delivery attempt unsuccessful.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: stop_type
attributes.description: Classification of the activity performed at this stop. Delivery indicates outbound drop-off; pickup indicates inbound collection; cross_dock indicates transfer without storage; return indicates reverse logistics collection; service indicates a non-product visit.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: temperature_exceedance
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature exceedance event was recorded during transit to or at this stop. Triggers quality hold, product disposition review, and regulatory notification processes.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001 Quality Management; GMP

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain compliance at this stop. Used to validate temperature logs against product storage requirements and regulatory standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain compliance at this stop. Used to validate temperature logs against product storage requirements and regulatory standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this route stop record was last modified, such as when actual times were recorded, status was updated, or POD was captured. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle or truck assigned to execute this route stop. Used for fleet utilization tracking, maintenance scheduling, and cold chain compliance verification.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module; SAP S/4HANA PM

products.name: freight_invoice
products.description: Carrier-issued freight invoice submitted to Consumer Goods for transportation services rendered. Captures invoice number, carrier reference, invoice date, payment due date, shipment/BOL references, invoiced charges (line-haul, fuel surcharge, accessorials), currency, invoice status (received/under-audit/approved/disputed/paid), and variance amount vs. contracted rate. Central to freight audit and pay (FAP) process.
products.reference: Freight Invoice / Carrier Invoice / FAP Invoice

attributes.name: freight_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the freight invoice record in the Consumer Goods lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_offset. Business justification: Linking invoices to purchased carbon offsets enables tracking of emissions mitigation per freight transaction.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier rate contract against which this invoice is audited. Used in freight audit and pay (FAP) to validate invoiced charges against contracted rates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Purchasing Contract

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (transportation service provider) who issued this freight invoice. Links to the carrier master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Carrier Master

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Needed to allocate freight invoice expense to the appropriate cost center for internal cost tracking and budgeting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for posting freight invoices to the general ledger; finance GL accounts are used for financial reporting of freight costs.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record associated with this freight invoice. Enables reconciliation between transportation execution and billing.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Allows assignment of freight invoice expense to profit center for profitability analysis of logistics services.

attributes.name: accessorial_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of accessorial charges on the invoice, including but not limited to liftgate, residential delivery, inside delivery, detention, redelivery, and hazmat fees. Audited against contracted accessorial schedules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; NMFTA Accessorial Standards

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Amount approved for payment to the carrier after freight audit review and any adjustments. May differ from invoiced total if disputes or corrections were applied. This is the amount that flows to accounts payable for payment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: audit_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the freight audit review was completed for this invoice. Marks the transition from 'under_audit' to 'approved' or 'disputed' status in the freight audit and pay (FAP) workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number issued by the carrier for the associated shipment. Key cross-reference document linking the freight invoice to the physical shipment and proof of delivery.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; U.S. Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) Title 49 — Transportation

attributes.name: contracted_amount
attributes.description: Expected freight charge calculated from the applicable carrier contract rate for this lane, mode, and service level. Used as the benchmark in freight audit to identify billing variances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Purchasing Contract; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the freight invoice record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA tracking for invoice processing.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this freight invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight operations and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the shipment destination. Required for cross-border freight, customs compliance, and international freight cost reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipment destination facility (customer DC, retail store, or consumer address) to which the freight was delivered. Used for lane-level freight cost analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN (Global Location Number) Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: dispute_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the reason for disputing the freight invoice, including specific discrepancies identified during freight audit. Supports carrier communication and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for disputing the freight invoice (e.g., rate discrepancy, duplicate invoice, service failure, unauthorized accessorial). Populated when invoice_status is 'disputed'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_discrepancy|duplicate_invoice|service_failure|unauthorized_accessorial|weight_discrepancy|missing_bol — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification; NMFTA Standards

attributes.name: edi_transaction_code
attributes.description: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transaction set identifier for invoices received electronically via EDI 210 (Motor Carrier Freight Invoice) or equivalent. Enables traceability of electronic invoice transmission.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Transaction Set 210 — Motor Carrier Freight Invoice; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: freight_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Motor Freight Classification (NMFC) Freight Class
attributes.description: National Motor Freight Classification (NMFC) freight class assigned to the shipment (e.g., 50, 70, 100, 150). Determines LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) base rates and is a key audit point for freight invoice validation.
attributes.references: NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association) — NMFC Classification

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Carrier-applied fuel surcharge amount added to the base line-haul charge. Typically calculated as a percentage of line-haul based on the DOE (Department of Energy) fuel index. Key component for freight cost variance analysis.
attributes.references: U.S. DOE Fuel Index; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the carrier issued the freight invoice. Used to calculate payment due date, aging, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) metrics in freight payables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned invoice number as printed on the freight invoice document. Externally known identifier used for carrier communication, dispute resolution, and payment remittance.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice

attributes.name: invoice_source
attributes.description: Channel through which the freight invoice was received by Consumer Goods. Used to track EDI adoption rates and identify manual processing inefficiencies.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the freight invoice within the freight audit and pay (FAP) process. Drives processing actions and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the freight invoice by document type. Distinguishes standard carrier invoices from credit memos, debit memos, rebills, and adjustments for accurate financial processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Document Type; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: invoiced_total_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount invoiced by the carrier, inclusive of line-haul, fuel surcharge, accessorials, and taxes. This is the amount the carrier is requesting for payment before audit adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight invoice covers a temperature-controlled (cold chain) shipment requiring refrigerated or frozen transport. Relevant for Consumer Goods products with cold-chain compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 — Good Manufacturing Practice; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment covered by this invoice contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and regulatory compliance. Triggers validation of hazmat accessorial charges.
attributes.references: U.S. DOT CFR Title 49 — Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA Standards

attributes.name: line_haul_amount
attributes.description: Base transportation charge for moving freight from origin to destination, excluding surcharges and accessorials. Core component of the freight invoice monetary triplet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; NMFTA Freight Classification

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the shipment origin. Required for cross-border freight, customs compliance, and international freight cost reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipment origin facility (plant, warehouse, or distribution center) from which the freight movement originated. Used for lane-level freight cost analysis and carrier performance reporting.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN (Global Location Number) Standard; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was issued to the carrier for this freight invoice. Used to calculate Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), confirm on-time payment, and support carrier relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be made to the carrier per the contracted payment terms. Critical for cash flow management and avoiding late payment penalties.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Terms; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Internal payment document or check/ACH reference number assigned when the invoice was paid. Used to reconcile freight invoices against bank statements and carrier remittance advice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Document; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the carrier (e.g., Net30, Net45, 2/10Net30). Determines the payment due date and any early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Terms; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used to track the shipment within the carrier's system. Standard identifier in LTL and TL freight for track-and-trace and invoice matching.
attributes.references: NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association) Standards

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Consumer Goods internal purchase order number associated with the freight services procured. Used for three-way match in accounts payable and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Purchase Order

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the freight invoice was received by Consumer Goods from the carrier, either via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), email, or carrier portal. Marks the start of the freight audit and pay (FAP) cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; EDI X12 Standard 210

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date the transportation service was rendered (pickup or delivery date). Used to match the invoice to the correct accounting period and validate service delivery.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery; CFR Title 49

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Carrier service level or product code for the transportation service rendered (e.g., standard ground, expedited, next-day, two-day). Used to validate that the invoiced service matches the contracted service level agreement (SLA).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Shipping Conditions; Carrier SLA

attributes.name: shipment_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual or billed shipment weight in kilograms as stated on the freight invoice. Used to validate weight-based freight charges against contracted rates and detect weight discrepancies.
attributes.references: NMFTA Freight Classification; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the freight invoice, including applicable federal, state, and local taxes on transportation services. Required for accurate financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Tax; SOX Financial Reporting; CFR Title 26

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for the shipment covered by this invoice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TL|LTL|parcel|intermodal|air|ocean|rail — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; CFR Title 49 — Transportation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the freight invoice record was last modified in the Consumer Goods data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between the invoiced total amount and the contracted rate amount (invoiced_total_amount minus contracted_amount). Positive value indicates overbilling by carrier; negative indicates underbilling. Central metric in the freight audit and pay (FAP) process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification; Oracle Cloud Financials

products.name: freight_audit_result
products.description: Consolidated freight cost and audit record representing the audited, allocated, and accrued transportation cost at shipment or leg level. Captures audit date, freight invoice reference, audited line items, contracted rate applied, invoiced vs. audited amounts, variance amount and reason code, audit outcome (approved/disputed/short-paid), recovery amount, cost category (line-haul/fuel/accessorial/duty/insurance), cost allocation basis (weight/volume/value), cost center allocation, accrual status, and actual vs. standard cost variance. SSOT for freight cost truth — feeds COGS freight component, logistics cost-to-serve analysis, and carrier dispute management.
products.reference: Freight Audit and Pay (FAP) / Freight Audit Result

attributes.name: freight_audit_result_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each freight audit result record. Primary key for the freight_audit_result data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier rate contract or transportation agreement under which the contracted freight rate was applied during audit. Ensures rate validation is traceable to the governing agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (trucking company, freight forwarder, or parcel carrier) that executed the shipment and issued the freight invoice being audited.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which the audited freight cost is allocated. Supports logistics cost-to-serve analysis and COGS freight component reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or third-party freight audit service provider who performed the audit. Supports audit trail, quality review, and auditor performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Workday HCM; Internal Freight Audit Policy

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Provides GL account reference for audit results, ensuring freight audit adjustments are posted to correct ledger accounts.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent logistics shipment record against which this freight audit result was generated. Links audit outcome to the shipment's BOL, carrier, and lane details.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: accrual_amount
attributes.description: Amount accrued in the general ledger for this freight cost prior to invoice receipt and audit. Used to reconcile accrual vs. actual freight cost and manage period-end close accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Status of the freight cost accrual in the general ledger. 'accrued' means the cost has been accrued in the period; 'reversed' means the accrual was reversed upon invoice receipt; 'posted' means the actual invoice has been posted; 'pending' means accrual is awaiting approval; 'not_required' means no accrual was needed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: actual_vs_standard_variance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual vs. Standard Freight Cost Variance
attributes.description: Difference between the audited freight amount and the standard freight cost (audited_amount minus standard_cost_amount). Positive value indicates actual cost exceeded standard; negative indicates favorable variance. Key input to COGS freight component and logistics P&L.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the freight invoice was audited against contracted rates and shipment data. Principal business event date for the audit lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Freight Audit Policy

attributes.name: audit_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the freight audit was performed by an internal team, a third-party freight audit provider, or an automated audit system. Supports audit quality governance and cost-to-audit tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Freight Audit Policy; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the freight audit result. 'approved' means invoiced amount matches contracted rate; 'disputed' means a formal dispute has been raised with the carrier; 'short_paid' means payment was issued for the audited (lower) amount; 'pending' means audit is in progress; 'voided' means the audit record was cancelled; 'escalated' means the dispute has been escalated for resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved|disputed|short_paid|pending|voided|escalated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: audited_amount
attributes.description: Final freight amount determined by the audit process as the correct payable amount. May equal the contracted rate amount or reflect adjustments for accessorials, corrections, or negotiated settlements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; Internal Freight Audit Policy

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the shipment being audited. Used to cross-reference shipment documentation and validate carrier charges against actual freight moved.
attributes.references: GS1 Transport Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: contracted_rate_amount
attributes.description: Freight amount calculated by applying the contracted carrier rate to the actual shipment characteristics (weight, volume, lane). Represents the expected charge per the governing carrier contract.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; Oracle Cloud Procurement; Carrier Contract Terms

attributes.name: cost_allocation_basis
attributes.description: Basis used to allocate the audited freight cost across cost centers, products, or business units. 'weight' allocates by shipment weight (kg); 'volume' by cubic meters; 'value' by declared goods value; 'units' by case/pallet count; 'equal_split' divides equally.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; Internal Cost Allocation Policy

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Classification of the freight cost component being audited. 'line_haul' is the base transportation charge; 'fuel_surcharge' is the fuel adjustment; 'accessorial' covers additional services (liftgate, residential delivery, etc.); 'duty' covers customs/import duties; 'insurance' covers cargo insurance; 'detention' covers carrier wait-time charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: line_haul|fuel_surcharge|accessorial|duty|insurance|detention — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Freight Conditions; NMFC; Carrier Tariff Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the freight audit result record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: Date on which a formal dispute was raised with the carrier for the identified freight charge variance. Used to track dispute aging and carrier SLA compliance for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Internal Freight Audit Policy; Carrier Contract Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned or internally-assigned reference number for a formal freight charge dispute. Populated when audit_status is 'disputed' or 'escalated'. Used to track dispute resolution progress and recovery.
attributes.references: Internal Freight Audit Policy; Carrier Contract Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: dispute_resolved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier dispute was formally resolved (credit issued, short-payment accepted, or dispute closed). Used to measure dispute resolution cycle time and carrier performance.
attributes.references: Internal Freight Audit Policy; Carrier Contract Terms

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal year and month (YYYY-MM) in which the freight cost is recognized for financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, COGS freight accrual reconciliation, and logistics cost-to-serve reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: freight_invoice_number
attributes.description: Carrier-issued invoice number for the freight charges being audited. Primary external business identifier for the audit record; used for carrier dispute management and accounts payable matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert invoice currency amounts to reporting currency at the time of audit. Sourced from SAP FI or Oracle Cloud Financials daily rate tables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; ISO 4217

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code governing freight cost responsibility between buyer and seller for this shipment. Determines which party bears the audited freight cost. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD; GS1 Transport Standards

attributes.name: invoice_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the carrier's freight invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight cost consolidation and FX translation to reporting currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the carrier issued the freight invoice. Used to calculate invoice aging, payment terms compliance, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) for carrier payables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: invoice_received_date
attributes.description: Date the freight invoice was received by the company's accounts payable or freight audit team. Used to measure invoice processing cycle time and payment terms compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Gross freight amount as billed by the carrier on the invoice, in the invoice currency. Represents the carrier's claimed charge before audit validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which payment was issued to the carrier for the audited freight invoice. Used for cash flow management, payment terms compliance, and carrier relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the audited freight invoice must be paid per carrier contract payment terms. Drives accounts payable scheduling and early payment discount capture.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; Carrier Contract Terms

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Accounts payable payment reference number (check number, ACH transaction ID, or EFT reference) issued for the audited freight invoice. Confirms payment execution and enables AP reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used to track the shipment within the carrier's system. Key identifier for carrier dispute resolution and track-and-trace reconciliation.
attributes.references: NMFC (National Motor Freight Classification); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount actually recovered from the carrier through short-payment, credit memo, or dispute resolution. May differ from variance_amount if only partial recovery was achieved.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; Carrier Dispute Management

attributes.name: reporting_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for internal financial reporting and COGS freight component allocation (e.g., USD as functional currency). Enables consistent cross-currency logistics cost-to-serve analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI CO; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: Pre-established standard freight cost for this lane and transport mode, used as the benchmark for actual vs. standard cost variance analysis. Feeds COGS standard costing and logistics cost-to-serve reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Standard Costing; Oracle Cloud Financials; Internal COGS Policy

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for the shipment (e.g., Truckload (TL), Less-than-Truckload (LTL), parcel, intermodal, air, ocean, rail). Determines applicable rate structures and audit rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TL|LTL|parcel|intermodal|air|ocean|rail — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; NMFC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the freight audit result record was last modified. Tracks audit status changes, dispute updates, and payment postings for data lineage and change management.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between the invoiced amount and the audited amount (invoiced_amount minus audited_amount). Positive value indicates overcharge by carrier; negative value indicates undercharge. Core metric for carrier dispute management and freight cost savings tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; Internal Freight Audit Policy

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the variance between invoiced and audited amounts (e.g., RATE_MISMATCH, WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY, DUPLICATE_INVOICE, ACCESSORIAL_NOT_CONTRACTED, FUEL_SURCHARGE_ERROR). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RATE_MISMATCH|WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY|DUPLICATE_INVOICE|ACCESSORIAL_NOT_CONTRACTED|FUEL_SURCHARGE_ERROR|LANE_MISMATCH|BILLING_ERROR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Freight Audit Policy; SAP S/4HANA FI; Carrier Dispute Management

attributes.name: variance_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation of the variance reason, providing additional context beyond the variance_reason_code. Used by freight audit analysts and carrier dispute managers.
attributes.references: Internal Freight Audit Policy; Carrier Dispute Management

attributes.name: weight_actual_kg
attributes.description: Actual verified shipment weight (in kilograms) as recorded at origin or confirmed by weigh-in-motion data. Used to validate carrier billed weight and identify weight discrepancy variances.
attributes.references: NMFC; GS1 Transport Standards; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: weight_billed_kg
attributes.description: Shipment weight (in kilograms) as billed by the carrier on the freight invoice. Compared against actual/verified weight to identify weight-based billing discrepancies.
attributes.references: NMFC; GS1 Transport Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

products.name: tracking_event
products.description: Real-time or near-real-time shipment tracking event captured from carrier EDI (214/990), GPS telematics, or IoT sensors. Captures event timestamp, shipment/leg reference, event type (picked-up, in-transit, out-for-delivery, delivered, exception, delay, damage, refused), location (city/state/GPS coordinates), carrier event code, temperature reading (cold-chain), exception root cause code, financial impact estimate, resolution action and timestamp, and data source. Powers track-and-trace visibility, cold-chain compliance monitoring, exception management, and carrier performance measurement.
products.reference: EDI 214 / Shipment Status Message / Track & Trace Event

attributes.name: tracking_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shipment tracking event record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the tracking_event data product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (trucking company, parcel carrier, ocean liner, air freight provider) that generated or reported this tracking event.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned identifier for the driver or operator responsible for the shipment at the time of this tracking event. Used for driver performance analysis, proof-of-delivery attribution, and exception accountability. Not a personal identifier in the consumer goods context — represents a carrier operational reference.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; FMCSA ELD Mandate

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation lane on which this tracking event occurred, enabling lane-level performance and exception analysis.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment record to which this tracking event belongs. Links the event to the full shipment context including origin, destination, carrier, and BOL details.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: carrier_event_code
attributes.description: The carrier's native status or event code as transmitted via EDI 214/990 or carrier API (e.g., 'X1', 'D1', 'AF', 'OFD'). Preserves the source system code for carrier-specific reporting and reconciliation against carrier invoices and SLA commitments.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; ANSI X12 EDI Standard

attributes.name: carrier_sla_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carrier Service Level Agreement (SLA) Met Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier met the contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) milestone at this event (e.g., on-time pickup, on-time delivery). Derived from comparison of event_timestamp against planned_event_timestamp and carrier contract terms. Feeds carrier performance scorecards and SLA penalty/incentive calculations.
attributes.references: Carrier Contract SLA Terms; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tracking event record was first ingested and created in the silver layer lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp (when the event occurred in the real world). Used for data latency monitoring and SLA measurement of carrier EDI/API feed timeliness.

attributes.name: customs_status
attributes.description: The customs clearance status of the shipment at the time of this tracking event, applicable to cross-border shipments. Indicates whether the shipment has cleared customs, is held for inspection, pending documentation, released after hold, or seized. Critical for international supply chain visibility and compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP); EU REACH Regulation; FDA Import Regulations

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The originating system or channel that generated this tracking event. Distinguishes between carrier EDI transmissions (214/990), GPS telematics feeds, IoT sensor readings, carrier API webhooks, WMS scan events, and manual entries. Critical for data lineage and source reliability scoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: edi_214|edi_990|gps_telematics|iot_sensor|carrier_api|manual_entry|wms_scan — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214; ANSI X12 EDI Standard; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes the shipment or vehicle dwelled at the event location (e.g., carrier terminal, cross-dock, customer dock) before the next movement event. Supports carrier performance analysis, dock scheduling optimization, and detention charge identification.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: edi_interchange_control_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Interchange Control Number
attributes.description: The unique interchange control number from the EDI envelope (ISA segment) of the source EDI transmission that generated this tracking event. Enables end-to-end EDI message traceability and duplicate detection.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standard; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: The ANSI X12 EDI transaction set number associated with the source message that generated this tracking event (e.g., 214 = Transportation Carrier Shipment Status, 990 = Response to a Load Tender). Supports EDI audit trail and carrier integration troubleshooting.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standard; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: equipment_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the transportation equipment (trailer number, container number, railcar number, vessel IMO number) associated with this tracking event. Enables equipment-level tracking, utilization analysis, and cross-referencing with carrier equipment records.

attributes.name: event_city
attributes.description: The city where the tracking event occurred, as reported by the carrier or GPS system. Used for geographic visualization of shipment progress and lane-level exception analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message

attributes.name: event_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country where the tracking event occurred (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'MEX'). Required for cross-border shipment tracking and customs compliance reporting.

attributes.name: event_state_province
attributes.description: The state or province where the tracking event occurred, using standard postal abbreviations (e.g., 'CA', 'TX', 'ON'). Supports regional performance reporting and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this tracking event record indicating whether it is the current authoritative event (active), has been superseded by a correction, cancelled, or identified as a duplicate. Supports data quality management in the silver layer.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset) at which the tracking event occurred in the real world, as reported by the carrier, GPS telematics system, or IoT sensor. This is the principal business event time, distinct from record ingestion timestamps.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; ISO 8601

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the shipment tracking event representing the current milestone or status change in the shipment lifecycle. Drives track-and-trace visibility and exception management workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: picked_up|in_transit|out_for_delivery|delivered|exception|delay|damage|refused — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the exception condition, providing additional context beyond the root cause code. May include carrier notes, driver comments, or system-generated messages explaining the nature of the delay, damage, or refusal.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this tracking event represents or triggered a shipment exception condition (e.g., delay, damage, refused delivery, missed pickup, temperature breach). Drives exception management workflows and carrier performance scorecards.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: exception_root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized root cause code categorizing the reason for a shipment exception (e.g., 'WEATHER', 'CARRIER_DELAY', 'CUSTOMS_HOLD', 'MECHANICAL_FAILURE', 'INCORRECT_ADDRESS', 'REFUSED_BY_CONSIGNEE', 'DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT'). Used for exception trend analysis and carrier performance management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WEATHER|CARRIER_DELAY|CUSTOMS_HOLD|MECHANICAL_FAILURE|INCORRECT_ADDRESS|REFUSED_BY_CONSIGNEE|DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214; Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the carrier terminal, cross-dock, distribution center, port, or customer facility where the tracking event occurred (e.g., carrier hub code, GLN). Supports facility-level dwell time and throughput analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN); Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the financial impact associated with this tracking event exception (e.g., cost of delay, damage claim value, re-delivery cost, expedite surcharge). Used for freight cost variance analysis and carrier chargeback management. Expressed in the currency defined by financial_impact_currency.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency operations across global consumer goods distribution networks.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: geofence_zone
attributes.description: The named geofence zone or virtual boundary that triggered this tracking event (e.g., 'CUSTOMER_DC_INBOUND', 'CARRIER_TERMINAL_CHICAGO', 'PORT_OF_LA_GATE'). Populated for GPS telematics events generated by geofence entry/exit triggers. Supports automated milestone detection without manual carrier check-ins.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: humidity_pct
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage reading captured at the time of the tracking event by an IoT sensor. Relevant for moisture-sensitive consumer goods (e.g., hygiene products, paper-based packaging). Null for shipments without humidity monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the location where the tracking event was recorded by GPS telematics or IoT sensor. Enables precise geospatial mapping of shipment progress and route deviation detection.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the location where the tracking event was recorded by GPS telematics or IoT sensor. Paired with latitude for precise geospatial analysis.

attributes.name: planned_event_timestamp
attributes.description: The originally scheduled or planned date and time for this event milestone (e.g., planned pickup time, planned delivery window). Compared against event_timestamp to calculate schedule adherence and On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance at the event level.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand and Supply Planning; GS1 EDI 214

attributes.name: pod_method
attributes.description: The method by which Proof of Delivery (POD) was captured for a delivered event (electronic signature, paper signature, photo confirmation, or no-signature-required). Supports POD compliance tracking and carrier contract enforcement.

attributes.name: pod_signature_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual who signed for the delivery at the consignee location, as captured on the Proof of Delivery (POD) document. Populated only for 'delivered' event types. Supports dispute resolution and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used to identify and track a freight shipment within the carrier's system. Serves as the primary external reference for LTL and TL carrier tracking and freight audit reconciliation.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standard; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: resolution_action_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the corrective action taken to resolve the exception associated with this tracking event (e.g., 'REROUTED', 'REDELIVERY_SCHEDULED', 'CLAIM_FILED', 'PRODUCT_QUARANTINED', 'CARRIER_NOTIFIED', 'EXPEDITED'). Supports exception resolution tracking and SLA compliance measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REROUTED|REDELIVERY_SCHEDULED|CLAIM_FILED|PRODUCT_QUARANTINED|CARRIER_NOTIFIED|EXPEDITED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the exception associated with this tracking event was resolved or closed. Used to calculate exception resolution cycle time and measure carrier SLA compliance for exception handling.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: shipment_leg_number
attributes.description: Sequential leg number within a multi-leg shipment (e.g., leg 1 = origin DC to cross-dock, leg 2 = cross-dock to destination). Enables granular tracking of multi-modal or relay shipments across the inbound and outbound network.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: speed_kmh
attributes.description: The speed of the transport vehicle in kilometers per hour at the time of the GPS telematics event. Used for route compliance monitoring, driver safety analytics, and detection of unauthorized stops or route deviations. Null for non-GPS-sourced events.
attributes.references: FMCSA Hours of Service Regulations; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: temperature_breach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the temperature reading at this event exceeded the shipment's defined cold-chain temperature range (temperature_min_c to temperature_max_c as defined on the parent shipment). True signals a cold-chain compliance violation requiring exception management and potential product quarantine.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR; FSMA; ISO 9001

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient or product temperature reading in degrees Celsius captured at the time of the tracking event by an IoT sensor or cold-chain monitoring device. Critical for cold-chain compliance monitoring of temperature-sensitive consumer goods (e.g., personal care, food, pharmaceutical products). Null for non-cold-chain shipments.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR; FSMA

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-issued parcel or shipment tracking number (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS tracking number) used for consumer-facing and operational track-and-trace. Distinct from PRO number which is used for freight/LTL.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; ANSI X12 EDI Standard

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation active at the time of this tracking event. Relevant for multi-modal shipments where the mode may change between legs (e.g., ocean to rail to truckload). Drives mode-specific SLA and performance benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|ltl|parcel|rail|ocean|air|intermodal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Incoterms 2020; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tracking event record was last modified in the silver layer lakehouse (e.g., due to a carrier correction, status update, or exception resolution). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and change detection for downstream consumers.

products.name: cold_chain_log
products.description: Continuous temperature and humidity monitoring log for cold-chain shipments of temperature-sensitive consumer goods (e.g., refrigerated/frozen personal care, health products). Captures shipment/leg reference, sensor device ID, reading timestamp, temperature value, humidity value, min/max thresholds, excursion flag, excursion duration, and corrective action taken. Supports FDA cold-chain compliance and product safety documentation.
products.reference: Cold Chain Monitoring / Temperature Log / GDP Cold Chain

attributes.name: cold_chain_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each cold chain monitoring log record. Primary key for the cold_chain_log data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (Cold Chain Documentation)

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier responsible for the transport unit during this monitoring session. Used to attribute excursions to specific carriers for performance management and contract compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module

attributes.name: destination_facility_distribution_center_distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility to which the cold chain shipment is destined. Used to assess whether excursions occurred in transit versus at origin or destination.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the person who acknowledged the excursion alert. Required for FDA audit trail and CAPA documentation to establish accountability.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); ISO 9001 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent logistics shipment record for which this cold chain reading was captured. Links the monitoring log to the shipment's Bill of Lading, carrier, and route context.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module

attributes.name: primary_cold_distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility from which the cold chain shipment originated. Used to correlate excursions with origin facility loading conditions and cold storage practices.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific shipment leg or segment within a multi-leg journey during which this sensor reading was recorded. Enables excursion attribution to a specific carrier or transit segment.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: transport_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transport unit (trailer, container, refrigerated truck, or intermodal container) in which the sensor is installed. Used to correlate readings with equipment maintenance records and carrier performance.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Module

attributes.name: alert_acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the triggered alert was acknowledged by a responsible party (logistics manager, QA officer, or 3PL coordinator). Used to measure alert response time and compliance with excursion management SLAs.

attributes.name: alert_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reading triggered an automated alert notification to logistics, quality, or operations teams. True = alert was sent. Used to audit alert responsiveness and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective action taken in response to a detected excursion (e.g., 'Refrigeration unit reset and temperature restored', 'Shipment quarantined pending QA review', 'Product returned to cold storage'). Required for FDA compliance documentation and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) records.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 9001 Clause 10.2 (Nonconformity and Corrective Action); GMP CAPA Guidelines

attributes.name: corrective_action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the corrective action was initiated or completed in response to an excursion. Used to calculate response time and assess compliance with SLA and regulatory requirements for excursion management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cold chain log record was first ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); SOX Section 404 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: data_logger_report_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the data logger report or download session from which this reading was extracted. Enables traceability back to the original device report file for audit and regulatory submission purposes.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: excursion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Cumulative duration in minutes that the shipment has been in an excursion state up to and including this reading. Used to assess product safety impact, Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) calculations, and regulatory disposition decisions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reading represents a temperature or humidity excursion — i.e., the observed value fell outside the defined min/max thresholds. True = excursion detected. Used to trigger alerts, corrective actions, and FDA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7 (Control of Nonconforming Outputs)

attributes.name: excursion_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the excursion based on the magnitude of deviation from threshold and duration. Critical = immediate product safety risk; Major = significant deviation requiring QA review; Minor = within acceptable tolerance band; None = no excursion. Drives escalation and corrective action workflows.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: excursion_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of excursion detected at this reading: temperature above maximum threshold (temperature_high), temperature below minimum threshold (temperature_low), humidity above maximum (humidity_high), humidity below minimum (humidity_low), or no excursion (none). Supports root cause analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the transport unit at the time of this sensor reading. Enables geospatial mapping of excursion events to identify problematic routes, regions, or transit points.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the transport unit at the time of this sensor reading. Used in conjunction with GPS latitude for geospatial excursion analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Traceability Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: humidity_max_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The upper bound relative humidity threshold percentage defined for this shipment or product category. A reading above this value may indicate a humidity excursion risk.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: humidity_min_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The lower bound relative humidity threshold percentage defined for this shipment or product category. A reading below this value may indicate a humidity excursion risk.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: humidity_pct
attributes.description: Observed relative humidity percentage recorded by the sensor at the reading timestamp. Critical for products sensitive to moisture (e.g., personal care, health products). Used alongside temperature to assess storage condition compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: log_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer representing the order of this reading within the shipment's cold chain monitoring session. Enables chronological reconstruction of the temperature/humidity profile for a shipment and detection of data gaps.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; GS1 Global Traceability Standard

attributes.name: mean_kinetic_temp_c
attributes.description: Calculated Mean Kinetic Temperature in degrees Celsius for the shipment up to this reading point. MKT is the single calculated temperature that, if maintained over the storage period, would produce the same thermal challenge as the actual temperature variations. Used for product stability and regulatory disposition decisions.
attributes.references: USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines

attributes.name: monitoring_session_code
attributes.description: Identifier grouping all sensor readings belonging to a single continuous monitoring session (from sensor activation to deactivation). Used to reconstruct the complete temperature profile for a shipment and detect session gaps.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: product_temperature_class
attributes.description: Temperature storage classification of the product(s) in this shipment as defined by product specifications or regulatory requirements. Frozen = below -18°C; Refrigerated = 2–8°C; Controlled Room Temp = 15–25°C; Cool = 8–15°C. Determines applicable thresholds.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; USP <1079>; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: qa_disposition
attributes.description: Quality disposition decision made by the QA team for the affected product lot following excursion review. Approved = product released; Rejected = product destroyed or returned; Quarantined = held pending further investigation; Pending Review = awaiting QA decision; Conditionally Approved = released with conditions. Populated only when excursion_flag is True.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; GMP Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: qa_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the QA team completed their review and issued a disposition decision for the excursion event. Used to measure QA response time and compliance with regulatory timelines.

attributes.name: reading_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Configured interval in seconds between consecutive sensor readings for this monitoring session. Typical values range from 60 (1 minute) to 900 (15 minutes). Used to validate data completeness and detect missing readings.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the sensor captured the temperature and humidity measurement. This is the principal event timestamp for the log record and is critical for FDA cold-chain compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; ISO 9001 Clause 9.1; GS1 Global Traceability Standard

attributes.name: regulatory_report_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this excursion event requires formal regulatory reporting to the FDA or other governing body based on product type, excursion severity, and applicable regulations. True = regulatory report must be filed.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192; CPSC Reporting Requirements; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: sensor_battery_pct
attributes.description: Remaining battery level of the sensor device at the time of this reading, expressed as a percentage. Used to predict sensor failure risk and ensure data continuity for compliance documentation.

attributes.name: sensor_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sensor device was last calibrated. Required for FDA and GMP compliance to ensure measurement accuracy. Readings from uncalibrated or expired-calibration sensors may be flagged for review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; ISO 9001 Clause 7.1.5; GMP Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: sensor_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the sensor device must next be calibrated to remain compliant. Readings captured after this date may be flagged as non-compliant in regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the IoT temperature/humidity sensor device that captured this reading. Used for device traceability, calibration audit, and excursion investigation. Sourced from the sensor manufacturer's serial number or asset tag.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68 (Automatic, Mechanical, Electronic Equipment); ISO 9001 Clause 7.1.5 (Monitoring and Measuring Resources)

attributes.name: sensor_model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation of the sensor device (e.g., 'Sensitech TempTale 4', 'Emerson DL8000'). Used for device management, calibration scheduling, and accuracy benchmarking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 7.1.5; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: sensor_placement
attributes.description: Physical placement location of the sensor within the transport unit (e.g., ambient air, product contact, door panel, floor, ceiling, center load, return air). Affects interpretation of readings and excursion impact assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|product_contact|door_panel|floor|ceiling|center_load|return_air|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines; ASHRAE Guidelines for Cold Chain

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Observed temperature value in degrees Celsius recorded by the sensor at the reading timestamp. The principal quantitative measurement for cold-chain compliance monitoring. Used to detect excursions against defined min/max thresholds.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) Cold Chain Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_max_threshold_c
attributes.description: The upper bound temperature threshold in degrees Celsius defined for this shipment or product category. A reading above this value triggers a heat excursion flag. Sourced from product specification or regulatory requirement.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: temperature_min_threshold_c
attributes.description: The lower bound temperature threshold in degrees Celsius defined for this shipment or product category. A reading below this value triggers a cold excursion flag. Sourced from product specification or regulatory requirement.
