attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GMP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: transport_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transport unit used for this cold chain shipment leg. Determines expected temperature maintenance capability and regulatory documentation requirements.
attributes.references: GMP Cold Chain Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; GS1 Global Traceability Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cold chain log record was last modified (e.g., QA disposition updated, corrective action recorded). Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); SOX Section 404 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: veeva_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the associated quality or regulatory document stored in Veeva Vault (e.g., excursion investigation report, CAPA record, regulatory submission). Enables traceability between cold chain log records and formal quality documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); Veeva Vault Quality Documents Module; GMP CAPA Guidelines

products.name: transport_exception
products.description: Record of a transportation exception or disruption event impacting a shipment or delivery. Captures exception type (delay, damage, lost, refused, weather, carrier failure), exception timestamp, shipment/delivery reference, root cause code, financial impact estimate, resolution action taken, resolution timestamp, and exception status. Feeds OTIF root-cause analysis and carrier performance scorecards.

attributes.name: transport_exception_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each transportation exception or disruption event record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier responsible for the shipment at the time the exception occurred. Used to attribute exceptions to specific carriers for performance scorecard analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Transport exceptions (e.g., hazmat breach) trigger specific compliance obligations; linking enables tracking and reporting of required corrective actions.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation lane on which the exception occurred. Enables lane-level exception frequency analysis and routing guide optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics shipment record impacted by this exception. Links the exception to the parent shipment for OTIF root-cause analysis and carrier performance scorecards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/WM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: source_exception_id
attributes.description: Original exception identifier from the source operational system (SAP S/4HANA, Blue Yonder WMS, or carrier EDI). Preserved for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the impacted shipment, denormalized for freight audit and carrier claims processing. The BOL is the primary legal document governing the carrier's responsibility for the goods.
attributes.references: UCC Article 7; SAP S/4HANA SD; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: carrier_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier was formally notified of the exception. Populated when carrier_notified_flag is True. Used to measure carrier response time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: carrier_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has been formally notified of the exception and required resolution actions. True=carrier notification sent. Tracks communication compliance in carrier management processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: claim_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount formally claimed against the carrier for the exception event (damage, loss, or delay penalty). May differ from financial_impact_amount if only a portion is recoverable under the carrier contract.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; UCC Article 7

attributes.name: claim_reference_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned or internal reference number for the freight claim associated with this exception. Used to track claim status in freight audit and payment systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current status of the freight claim filed against the carrier for this exception. not_filed=no claim initiated, filed=claim submitted to carrier, under_review=carrier reviewing, approved=carrier accepted liability, rejected=carrier denied claim, settled=financial settlement completed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; UCC Article 7

attributes.name: cold_chain_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involved a breach of cold-chain temperature requirements. True=temperature excursion or cold-chain protocol violation occurred. Triggers regulatory notification and product disposition review per FDA and GMP requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716; GMP; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp when this transport exception record was first created in the system. Distinct from exception_timestamp (when the event occurred) and reported_timestamp (when it was reported).

attributes.name: delay_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated or actual duration of the delay in hours caused by the exception. Applicable primarily to delay-type exceptions. Used to calculate OTIF impact and carrier SLA breach severity.
attributes.references: SAP IBP S&OP; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 OTIF Standards

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exception has been escalated to management or carrier leadership due to severity, financial impact, or SLA breach. True=exception is escalated. Drives priority queue routing in exception management workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the exception was escalated to management or carrier leadership. Populated only when escalation_flag is True. Used to measure escalation response time.

attributes.name: exception_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the transportation exception occurred. Used for cross-border exception analysis and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: exception_location
attributes.description: Geographic location (city, facility, port, or GPS coordinate description) where the transportation exception was identified or occurred. Critical for route-level exception analysis and cold-chain compliance investigations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: exception_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the transportation exception event. Used in carrier communications, freight audit correspondence, and claims processing. Format: EXC- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transportation exception record. Drives workflow routing and SLA tracking. open=newly identified, in_progress=resolution underway, resolved=corrective action taken, closed=fully closed with no further action, escalated=elevated to management or carrier leadership.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: exception_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing granular detail within the exception type (e.g., 'partial_damage', 'temperature_excursion', 'missed_pickup', 'customs_hold', 'driver_no_show', 'equipment_failure'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: partial_damage|temperature_excursion|missed_pickup|customs_hold|driver_no_show|equipment_failure|address_error|capacity_constraint — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: exception_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when the transportation exception was first identified or occurred. This is the business event time, distinct from the record creation audit timestamp. Used as the primary time dimension for OTIF root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the transportation exception. Drives routing to resolution workflows and feeds OTIF root-cause analysis. Values: delay (shipment not delivered on time), damage (goods damaged in transit), lost (shipment cannot be located), refused (delivery refused by consignee), weather (weather-related disruption), carrier_failure (carrier operational failure).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or confirmed financial impact of the transportation exception in the stated currency. Includes freight cost premiums, expediting costs, product loss value, and customer penalty exposure. Used for carrier claims and cost-to-serve analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SOX; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial_impact_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: hazmat_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception involved a shipment containing hazardous materials. True=hazmat goods were part of the impacted shipment. Triggers mandatory regulatory incident reporting to EPA, DOT, and OSHA.
attributes.references: EPA; OSHA; DOT 49 CFR; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: otif_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exception caused a breach of the On Time In Full (OTIF) delivery commitment for the associated shipment. True=OTIF KPI was negatively impacted; False=exception resolved without OTIF breach. Feeds OTIF root-cause analysis dashboards.
attributes.references: GS1 OTIF Standards; SAP IBP; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number for the shipment, used to track the exception with the carrier's own systems during claims and resolution communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exception requires formal notification to a regulatory authority (FDA, EPA, CPSC, DOT, etc.). True=regulatory notification must be filed. Driven by hazmat_involved_flag, cold_chain_breach_flag, or product safety classification.
attributes.references: FDA; EPA; CPSC; OSHA; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the required regulatory notification was submitted to the relevant authority. Populated only when regulatory_notification_required is True. Used for compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: FDA; EPA; CPSC; OSHA; DOT 49 CFR; SOX

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the exception was formally reported into the transportation management system by the carrier, driver, or logistics coordinator. May differ from exception_timestamp if there is a reporting lag.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: resolution_action_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the corrective action taken to resolve the exception (e.g., RA001=rerouted shipment, RA002=replacement shipment dispatched, RA003=carrier claim filed, RA004=delivery rescheduled, RA005=goods returned to origin). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RA001|RA002|RA003|RA004|RA005|RA006|RA007 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: resolution_action_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific corrective action taken to resolve the transportation exception. Supplements the resolution_action_code with operational detail for audit and continuous improvement purposes.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the transportation exception was resolved and corrective action was confirmed complete. Used to calculate exception resolution cycle time and carrier SLA compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the transportation exception as determined during investigation. Used for systemic trend analysis and carrier performance scorecards. Examples: RC001=carrier capacity, RC002=weather event, RC003=customs delay, RC004=equipment breakdown, RC005=incorrect address. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RC001|RC002|RC003|RC004|RC005|RC006|RC007|RC008 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the root cause of the transportation exception, providing context beyond the standardized root_cause_code. Captured by the logistics coordinator or carrier representative during investigation.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business-assessed severity of the exception based on financial impact, customer impact, and regulatory risk. critical=immediate executive escalation required, high=same-day resolution required, medium=resolution within SLA window, low=informational tracking only.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable shipment reference number from the transportation management system (TMS) or ERP, denormalized here for operational convenience in exception reporting and carrier communications without requiring a join to the shipment table.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating operational system of record from which this exception record was captured. Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer reconciliation. SAP_S4HANA=SAP S/4HANA SD/WM module, BLUE_YONDER_WMS=Blue Yonder WMS, ORACLE_ERP=Oracle Cloud Supply Chain, MANUAL=manually entered, EDI=received via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; Oracle Cloud ERP; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum recorded temperature in Celsius during the cold-chain breach event. Populated only when cold_chain_breach_flag is True. Used alongside temperature_excursion_min_c for product disposition and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum recorded temperature in Celsius during the cold-chain breach event. Populated only when cold_chain_breach_flag is True. Used for product disposition decisions and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation on which the exception occurred. Denormalized from the shipment for exception frequency analysis by mode. road=truck/LTL/FTL, rail=rail freight, ocean=sea freight, air=air freight, intermodal=multi-mode, parcel=small parcel/courier.
attributes.references: GS1 Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp when this transport exception record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to status, resolution details, or financial impact estimates.

products.name: carrier_performance
products.description: Periodic carrier performance scorecard record capturing measured KPIs for a carrier over a defined period. Captures carrier reference, measurement period (week/month/quarter), OTIF rate, on-time pickup rate, on-time delivery rate, tender acceptance rate, claims rate, damage rate, EDI compliance rate, and overall performance tier (preferred/approved/probation/suspended). Supports carrier relationship management and contract renewal decisions.

attributes.name: carrier_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each carrier performance scorecard record in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier master record for which this performance scorecard is being measured.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the logistics analyst or manager who reviewed and approved this scorecard before publication.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Internal Carrier Governance Policy

attributes.name: avg_transit_days
attributes.description: Average number of calendar days from actual pickup to actual delivery across all shipments in the measurement period. Compared against standard transit days to assess transit time performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: carrier_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the carrier's primary account representative or performance manager who receives and acknowledges this scorecard.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: claims_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total_claims_amount field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: claims_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments resulting in a freight claim (loss, damage, or shortage) during the measurement period. Key indicator of cargo handling quality.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Carmack Amendment (49 U.S.C. § 14706); Internal QA Policy

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Weighted composite score (0–100) summarizing the carrier's overall performance across all measured KPIs for the period. Drives performance tier assignment and contract renewal decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Carrier Scorecard Methodology; SAP IBP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier performance scorecard record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX

attributes.name: damage_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments with reported product damage upon delivery during the measurement period. Distinct from claims rate as it isolates physical damage from loss/shortage events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001; Internal Quality Assurance Policy

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the KPI data for this scorecard was sourced (e.g., SAP TM, Blue Yonder WMS, TradeEdge). Supports data lineage and audit traceability in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Blue Yonder WMS; TradeEdge; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has formally disputed the KPI results in this scorecard. True = dispute raised; False = no dispute. Triggers a review workflow when True.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Internal Carrier Governance Policy

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the carrier's stated reason for disputing the scorecard results. Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Internal Carrier Governance Policy

attributes.name: edi_compliance_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Compliance Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments for which the carrier transmitted all required EDI transaction sets (e.g., 214 shipment status, 210 freight invoice) accurately and on time during the measurement period.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standards; GS1; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: freight_spend_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total_freight_spend field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: improvement_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Carrier Improvement Plan (CIP) is active for this carrier as of this measurement period. True = improvement plan in effect; False = no active plan.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Internal Carrier Governance Policy

attributes.name: in_full_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments delivered with the complete ordered quantity, without short-shipment or partial delivery, during the measurement period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Walmart OTIF Compliance Standard

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of carrier freight invoices that matched the contracted rate without requiring correction or dispute during the measurement period. Supports freight audit and pay processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; Internal Freight Audit Policy

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the performance measurement window — weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual. Determines the cadence at which KPIs are aggregated and reviewed.
attributes.references: SAP IBP S&OP; Internal Logistics KPI Framework

attributes.name: network_region
attributes.description: Geographic network region covered by this scorecard (e.g., Northeast US, Western Europe, APAC). Enables regional performance benchmarking across the carrier network.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Internal Distribution Network Design

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments delivered to the destination within the committed delivery window during the measurement period. Distinct from OTIF as it excludes the in-full dimension.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Internal Logistics KPI Framework

attributes.name: on_time_pickup_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments where the carrier arrived at the origin facility within the scheduled pickup window during the measurement period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Internal Logistics KPI Framework

attributes.name: otif_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments delivered both on time and in full during the measurement period. Core OTIF KPI used in carrier scorecards and contract compliance reviews. Calculated as (OTIF shipments / total shipments) × 100.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; Walmart OTIF Compliance Standard; GS1

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted OTIF target percentage for this carrier and service level during the measurement period. Used to calculate variance against actual OTIF performance.
attributes.references: Carrier Contract SLA; Walmart OTIF Compliance Standard; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Overall performance classification assigned to the carrier for this measurement period based on composite KPI scoring. Preferred = top-tier; Approved = meets standards; Probation = below threshold with improvement plan; Suspended = removed from routing guide pending review.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Internal Carrier Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the measurement period covered by this scorecard record.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the measurement period covered by this scorecard record.

attributes.name: pod_compliance_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Proof of Delivery (POD) Compliance Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments for which a valid Proof of Delivery (POD) document was received within the contractually required timeframe during the measurement period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Internal Freight Audit Policy

attributes.name: prior_period_composite_score
attributes.description: Composite performance score from the immediately preceding measurement period. Enables trend analysis and period-over-period performance comparison without requiring a self-join.

attributes.name: scorecard_finalized_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the scorecard was locked as final after the dispute resolution window closed. Null if scorecard is not yet finalized.
attributes.references: Internal Carrier Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: scorecard_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for logistics team commentary on the scorecard, including context for performance anomalies, weather events, or force majeure conditions that impacted KPIs.

attributes.name: scorecard_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this scorecard record, used in carrier communications and contract review meetings. Format: CPSC-YYYY-MM-XXXXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: scorecard_published_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the scorecard was formally published and shared with the carrier for review. Marks the start of the carrier's dispute window.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Internal Carrier Governance Policy

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the scorecard record. Draft = under calculation; Published = shared with carrier; Disputed = carrier has raised a challenge; Finalized = agreed and locked; Archived = historical.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Internal Carrier Governance Policy

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Service tier under which the carrier operated during this measurement period, enabling performance comparison within the same contracted service commitment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Carrier Contract SLA

attributes.name: tender_acceptance_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of load tenders accepted by the carrier on first offer during the measurement period. Low acceptance rates indicate capacity reliability issues and routing guide compliance failures.

attributes.name: tender_acceptance_target_pct
attributes.description: Contracted minimum tender acceptance rate for this carrier during the measurement period. Compared against actual tender acceptance rate to assess routing guide compliance.
attributes.references: Carrier Contract SLA; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: total_claims_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of freight claims filed against the carrier during the measurement period, expressed in the reporting currency. Used for financial recovery tracking and carrier liability assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Carmack Amendment (49 U.S.C. § 14706); Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: total_freight_spend
attributes.description: Total freight cost paid to the carrier during the measurement period, including base freight, fuel surcharges, and accessorial charges. Used for spend analytics and contract benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Procurement; Internal COGS Reporting

attributes.name: total_shipments
attributes.description: Total number of shipments tendered to the carrier during the measurement period. Serves as the denominator for rate-based KPI calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: total_tenders
attributes.description: Total number of load tenders issued to the carrier during the measurement period, including both accepted and rejected tenders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; EDI 204 Load Tender Standard

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation for which this scorecard applies. Allows segmented performance analysis by mode (e.g., Truckload vs. Less-than-Truckload vs. Parcel). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TL|LTL|parcel|intermodal|ocean|air|rail — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; GS1 Transport Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this carrier performance scorecard record. Used for incremental load detection and change data capture in the lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX

products.name: third_party_provider
products.description: Master record for 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) providers engaged by Consumer Goods for outsourced transportation, warehousing, or value-added logistics services. Captures 3PL provider name, service scope (transport/warehousing/customs/last-mile), geographic coverage, contract reference, SLA commitments, system integration method (EDI/API), performance tier, and operational status. Distinct from individual carriers — 3PLs manage multi-modal networks on behalf of Consumer Goods.

attributes.name: third_party_provider_id
attributes.description: Primary key for third_party_provider

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: 3PL ESG commitments are required for supplier sustainability assessments and integrated ESG reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Vendor account number assigned to the 3PL provider in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master or Oracle Cloud Supplier). Used to link logistics provider records to financial transactions, purchase orders, and invoice processing workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1-LIFNR); Oracle Cloud Supplier Master

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Base URL of the 3PL provider's API endpoint used for real-time track-and-trace, shipment status updates, and capacity queries. Applicable when integration_method is API. Stored securely; used by Consumer Goods integration middleware for automated data exchange.
attributes.references: Consumer Goods IT Integration Architecture Standards

attributes.name: claims_resolution_sla_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Freight Claims Resolution Service Level Agreement (SLA) Days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days within which the 3PL provider is contractually obligated to resolve freight damage or loss claims. Used for claims management SLA tracking and financial recovery monitoring.
attributes.references: Carmack Amendment (49 U.S.C. § 14706); Consumer Goods Freight Claims Policy

attributes.name: cold_chain_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the 3PL provider is certified and operationally equipped to handle temperature-controlled (cold chain) shipments. True = cold chain capable; False = ambient/dry only. Critical for routing perishable consumer goods, health, and personal care products requiring temperature integrity.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (Cold Chain); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master service agreement with the 3PL provider expires. Null indicates an open-ended evergreen contract. Used to trigger renewal workflows, renegotiation alerts, and provider transition planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; SOX Contract Compliance

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the master service agreement (MSA) or logistics services contract governing the 3PL relationship. Links to the contract management system (SAP CLM or Oracle Procurement Contracts) for terms, pricing schedules, and SLA annexures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; Oracle Cloud Procurement Contracts

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master service agreement with the 3PL provider becomes effective and services may commence. Used for contract lifecycle management, renewal tracking, and SLA enforcement windows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; SOX Contract Compliance

attributes.name: country_of_registration
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the 3PL provider is legally incorporated or registered. Used for regulatory compliance, trade compliance screening, and financial reporting (e.g., withholding tax determination).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the 3PL provider master record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the currency in which freight charges and financial settlements with this 3PL provider are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency freight cost reporting and FX exposure management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number uniquely identifying the 3PL provider's legal entity globally. Used for financial due diligence, credit risk assessment, and supplier onboarding validation in Oracle Cloud Procurement.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; Oracle Cloud Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: edi_code
attributes.description: EDI partner identifier used in ISA segment of EDI transmissions to uniquely identify the 3PL as a trading partner. Combined with edi_qualifier to form the complete EDI address. Required for automated shipment tendering, status updates, and freight invoice processing.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards; GS1 EDI

attributes.name: edi_qualifier
attributes.description: EDI interchange qualifier code identifying the 3PL in EDI transmissions (e.g., '01' for DUNS, '02' for SCAC, 'ZZ' for mutually defined). Required for EDI 204 (Motor Carrier Load Tender), 214 (Shipment Status), and 210 (Freight Invoice) message routing.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards; GS1 EDI

attributes.name: escalation_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the senior escalation contact (e.g., account manager or operations director) at the 3PL provider. Used when primary contact is unresponsive or for critical SLA breach escalations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Consumer Goods SLA Escalation Framework

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the geographic regions, countries, or trade lanes covered by this 3PL provider (e.g., 'North America', 'EU + UK', 'APAC excluding China'). Used for lane assignment, network design, and provider selection in logistics planning. Free-text to accommodate complex multi-region scopes.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Standards; Consumer Goods Network Design Framework

attributes.name: hazmat_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the 3PL provider's hazardous materials handling certification. Null if hazmat_certified is False. Used to trigger recertification alerts and prevent routing of hazmat shipments to providers with lapsed certifications.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; IATA DGR; OSHA Compliance

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the 3PL provider holds valid certification to handle, transport, and store hazardous materials (e.g., flammable aerosols, chemical cleaning agents). True = hazmat certified; False = not certified. Required for routing consumer goods products classified as dangerous goods.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the 3PL provider's global or regional headquarters is located. Used for geographic segmentation, time-zone-aware SLA management, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the 3PL provider's headquarters is located. Used for sanctions screening, trade compliance, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1-LAND1)

attributes.name: insurance_cargo_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage amount of the 3PL provider's cargo/freight insurance policy in the contract currency. Determines the maximum recoverable value for lost or damaged shipments. Used in freight claims processing and risk exposure analysis.
attributes.references: Carmack Amendment (49 U.S.C. § 14706); Consumer Goods Freight Claims Policy

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the 3PL provider's insurance coverage (both liability and cargo). Used to trigger renewal alerts and enforce the contractual requirement that valid insurance is maintained throughout the service period.
attributes.references: Consumer Goods Vendor Insurance Requirements; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: insurance_liability_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage amount of the 3PL provider's general liability insurance policy in the contract currency. Used for risk assessment, contract compliance validation, and claims recovery ceiling determination.
attributes.references: Consumer Goods Vendor Insurance Requirements; SOX Risk Management

attributes.name: integration_method
attributes.description: Primary method used for electronic data interchange between Consumer Goods systems and the 3PL provider. EDI: ANSI X12 or EDIFACT message sets; API: REST/SOAP web services; portal: manual web portal entry; email: unstructured email exchange; ftp: file-based batch transfer. Drives integration architecture and operational SLA for data latency.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; ANSI X12; UN/EDIFACT

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the 3PL provider as recorded in official business registration documents. Used for contract execution, regulatory filings, and financial settlement. Must match the name on the master service agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1-NAME1); SOX Compliance

attributes.name: network_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic network region in which this 3PL provider operates for Consumer Goods. Used for regional logistics cost allocation, network design analytics, and regional SLA benchmarking in SAP IBP and supply chain planning tools.
attributes.references: Consumer Goods Global Logistics Network Design; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: otif_sla_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On-Time In-Full (OTIF) Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually committed OTIF delivery performance target for this 3PL provider, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 98.50 = 98.5%). OTIF measures the percentage of shipments delivered on time and in full quantity. Used as the baseline for SLA compliance monitoring and penalty/incentive calculations.
attributes.references: Consumer Goods OTIF KPI Standard; Walmart OTIF Compliance Framework

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractually agreed payment terms for freight invoices submitted by the 3PL provider (e.g., NET30 = payment due 30 days from invoice date). Used in accounts payable processing, cash flow planning, and DSO management in Oracle Cloud Financials.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Financials AP; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Operational performance classification assigned to the 3PL based on SLA attainment, OTIF scores, and audit results. preferred: top-tier, first-choice allocation; approved: standard eligible provider; conditional: eligible with restrictions; probationary: under performance improvement plan. Drives routing guide prioritization.
attributes.references: Consumer Goods Logistics Routing Guide Standards; OTIF KPI Framework

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary operational contact at the 3PL provider. Used for shipment notifications, exception alerts, and SLA reporting communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Contact

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the 3PL provider responsible for day-to-day operational coordination with Consumer Goods logistics teams. Used for escalation routing and relationship management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary operational contact at the 3PL provider. Used for urgent operational escalations, exception management, and after-hours incident response.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Contact

attributes.name: provider_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the 3PL provider across Consumer Goods systems (SAP S/4HANA vendor master, Oracle Cloud Procurement). Used as the business key for cross-system reconciliation and EDI partner identification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; GS1 GLN Standards

attributes.name: provider_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the 3PL provider relationship. active: fully operational and eligible for shipment assignment; onboarding: in setup/qualification phase; suspended: temporarily blocked (e.g., SLA breach, compliance issue); terminated: contract ended; inactive: not currently engaged.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the logistics provider by operational model. 3PL: outsourced logistics services; 4PL: manages other 3PLs on behalf of Consumer Goods; lead_logistics: single-point orchestrator; freight_broker: arranges carrier capacity; customs_broker: specializes in import/export clearance.
attributes.references: Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP) Definitions

attributes.name: service_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing countries where this 3PL is operationally active (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX'). Used for automated lane-to-provider matching, cross-border compliance checks, and network coverage analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: service_scope
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of logistics service categories provided by this 3PL (e.g., transportation|warehousing|customs|last_mile|value_added_services|cold_chain|reverse_logistics). Drives service assignment logic in Blue Yonder WMS and SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transportation|warehousing|customs|last_mile|value_added_services|cold_chain|reverse_logistics|cross_docking|freight_forwarding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Service Classification; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number (EIN/TIN/VAT number) for the 3PL provider's legal entity. Required for accounts payable processing, 1099/tax reporting, and regulatory compliance. Format varies by country of registration.
attributes.references: IRS EIN; EU VAT Directive; SOX Financial Compliance

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius that the 3PL provider can maintain across its cold chain network (e.g., 8.00 for refrigerated). Null if cold_chain_capable is False. Used for product-to-provider matching for temperature-sensitive SKUs.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius that the 3PL provider can maintain across its cold chain network (e.g., -25.00 for frozen). Null if cold_chain_capable is False. Used for product-to-provider matching for temperature-sensitive SKUs.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics

attributes.name: tracking_url_template
attributes.description: URL template for the 3PL's public or partner-facing shipment tracking portal. Contains a placeholder (e.g., {tracking_number}) that is substituted at runtime to generate a direct tracking link. Used in customer-facing notifications and internal track-and-trace dashboards.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or brand name of the 3PL provider as commonly known in the market (e.g., 'XYZ Logistics' vs. legal entity 'XYZ Global Supply Chain Solutions Inc.'). Used in operational communications, reporting dashboards, and carrier/partner directories.

attributes.name: transport_modes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of transport modes the 3PL is certified and operationally capable of managing (e.g., road|rail|ocean|air|intermodal|last_mile). Used for multi-modal shipment planning and carrier/3PL selection in SAP TM and Blue Yonder. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: road|rail|ocean|air|intermodal|last_mile|barge|pipeline — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management (TM); IATA; IMO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the 3PL provider master record. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

products.name: customs_declaration
products.description: International customs and trade compliance declaration record for cross-border shipments. Captures declaration number, shipment reference, origin and destination countries, HS (Harmonized System) codes, declared value, currency, incoterms, customs broker reference, import/export license numbers, duty and tax amounts, customs status (filed/cleared/held/released), and clearance timestamp. Supports regulatory compliance for international logistics.
products.reference: Customs Entry / Import/Export Declaration / HS Code Filing

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customs declaration record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics shipment record associated with this customs declaration. Links the declaration to the physical cross-border movement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: third_party_provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed customs broker or freight forwarder party responsible for preparing and filing this declaration on behalf of the importer/exporter.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 111; EU UCC Article 18; NCBFAA Standards

attributes.name: ams_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number from the U.S. CBP Automated Manifest System (AMS) or equivalent advance cargo notification system (e.g., EU ICS2). Required for pre-arrival security filing for ocean and air shipments.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP AMS 19 CFR Part 4; EU ICS2 (UCC Delegated Regulation 2015/2446); WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: anti_dumping_case_number
attributes.description: Reference number for an applicable anti-dumping or countervailing duty (ADD/CVD) order affecting the declared goods. Triggers additional duty assessment beyond standard tariff rates.
attributes.references: U.S. ITC Anti-Dumping Orders; EU Anti-Dumping Regulation 2016/1036; WTO Anti-Dumping Agreement

attributes.name: bond_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the customs bond (surety bond) guaranteeing payment of duties and taxes. Required for U.S. formal entries and other jurisdictions requiring financial security for customs obligations.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 113; Customs Bond Regulations

attributes.name: broker_reference_number
attributes.description: The customs broker's own internal reference number for this declaration filing. Used for reconciliation with broker invoices and correspondence.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 111; NCBFAA Standards

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Origin document supporting preferential duty treatment claims under a trade agreement. Required when trade_agreement_code is populated.
attributes.references: WCO Rules of Origin; USMCA Article 5.2; EU GSP Rules of Origin; ICC Certificate of Origin

attributes.name: clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customs authority officially cleared and released the shipment. Null if clearance has not yet occurred. Critical for OTIF tracking and logistics planning.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP ACE; EU AIS/AES; ISO 28000

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the goods were manufactured or substantially transformed. May differ from origin_country_code (country of export). Determines preferential duty treatment and trade agreement applicability.
attributes.references: WCO Rules of Origin; U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 102; EU UCC Articles 59-63; USMCA; CPTPP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this customs declaration record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: declaration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known official customs declaration number assigned by the customs authority or filing system (e.g., Entry Number in US CBP, MRN in EU). This is the primary business identifier used in regulatory correspondence and audit trails.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 142; EU Customs Code (UCC) Regulation 952/2013; GS1

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customs declaration as reported by the customs authority or broker. Drives operational actions such as release of goods, duty payment, or compliance escalation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|accepted|held|cleared|released|rejected — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. CBP ACE System; EU AES/AIS; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: declaration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customs declaration indicating the direction and nature of the cross-border movement. Drives applicable regulatory requirements and duty calculations.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP 19 CFR; EU UCC Regulation 952/2013; WCO Kyoto Convention

attributes.name: declared_value_amount
attributes.description: The gross declared value of the goods as submitted to customs authorities, used as the basis for ad valorem duty and tax calculations. Expressed in the declared currency. Must comply with WCO Transaction Value method.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Valuation Agreement (GATT Article VII); U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 152; EU UCC Articles 69-76

attributes.name: declared_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the declared customs value amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for duty calculation and currency conversion by customs authorities.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; WCO Customs Valuation Agreement; U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country into which the goods are being imported or delivered. Determines applicable customs regime, duty rates, and import restrictions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GS1; WCO; EU UCC

attributes.name: duty_amount
attributes.description: Total import or export duty assessed by the customs authority on the declared goods. Expressed in the duty currency. Includes ad valorem and specific duties as applicable.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; U.S. CBP 19 CFR; EU UCC; USMCA; CPTPP

attributes.name: duty_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which duty and tax amounts are assessed and payable to the customs authority.

attributes.name: duty_rate_pct
attributes.description: The applicable ad valorem duty rate percentage applied to the declared value to calculate the duty amount. Sourced from the applicable tariff schedule for the HS code and country pair.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; U.S. HTS; EU TARIC; USMCA; CPTPP

attributes.name: examination_type
attributes.description: Type of customs examination applied to the shipment (e.g., document review, physical inspection, laboratory testing). Drives expected clearance delay and compliance action requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP Examination Procedures; EU UCC Article 188; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: export_license_number
attributes.description: Government-issued export license or authorization number required for controlled goods subject to export regulations. Required for dual-use goods, hazardous materials, or goods subject to trade sanctions.
attributes.references: U.S. EAR (15 CFR Parts 730-774); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821; OFAC Sanctions

attributes.name: exporter_of_record
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity designated as the Exporter of Record (EOR) responsible for export compliance, filing export declarations, and maintaining export records.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP AES; U.S. EAR 15 CFR Part 758; EU UCC Article 5(16)

attributes.name: filed_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal business event timestamp recording when the customs declaration was officially submitted to the customs authority. Used for regulatory compliance tracking and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 142; EU UCC Article 171; WCO Kyoto Convention

attributes.name: free_trade_zone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods are entering or exiting a Free Trade Zone (FTZ) or Special Economic Zone (SEZ), which may affect duty suspension, deferral, or exemption treatment.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP FTZ Regulations 15 CFR Part 400; EU UCC Free Zones Articles 243-249; WCO

attributes.name: goods_description
attributes.description: Official textual description of the goods as declared to customs authorities. Must accurately describe the nature, composition, and intended use of the products. Used for HS code validation and customs examination.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; U.S. CBP 19 CFR; EU UCC Annex B; FDA Import Regulations

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the declared goods including packaging, expressed in kilograms. Required field on customs declarations for duty calculation and transport documentation.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; U.S. CBP 19 CFR; EU UCC; IATA; IMO

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the declared goods are classified as hazardous materials requiring special customs handling, documentation (e.g., SDS), and regulatory compliance under IATA DGR, IMDG, or ADR regulations.
attributes.references: IATA DGR; IMDG Code; ADR; EPA TSCA; OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The primary Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code assigned to the goods in this declaration. A 6-10 digit code per WCO Harmonized System nomenclature used to determine applicable duty rates, import restrictions, and trade statistics. For multi-line declarations, this represents the primary or header-level HS code.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System Convention; U.S. HTS Schedule B; EU Combined Nomenclature; GS1

attributes.name: import_license_number
attributes.description: Government-issued import license or permit number required for regulated goods (e.g., FDA-regulated consumer products, EPA-regulated chemicals, CPSC-regulated items). Required for customs clearance of controlled product categories.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EPA TSCA; CPSC Regulations; EU REACH Regulation 1907/2006

attributes.name: importer_of_record
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity designated as the Importer of Record (IOR) responsible for ensuring goods comply with all import laws and regulations and for paying applicable duties and taxes.
attributes.references: U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 141; EU UCC Article 5(15); WCO

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the allocation of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller for the shipment. Determines the customs value basis (e.g., CIF vs FOB) used for duty calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WCO Customs Valuation Agreement; U.S. CBP 19 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the declared goods excluding packaging, expressed in kilograms. Used for specific duty calculations, statistical reporting, and product compliance verification.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; U.S. CBP 19 CFR; EU UCC; GS1

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country from which the goods originate or are exported. Used for duty rate determination, trade agreement eligibility, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GS1; WCO; U.S. CBP Rules of Origin 19 CFR Part 102

attributes.name: port_of_entry_code
attributes.description: Official code of the customs port or border crossing point where the goods enter the destination country (e.g., UN/LOCODE, U.S. CBP Port Code). Used for routing, examination scheduling, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE; U.S. CBP Port Codes; EU Customs Office List; WCO

attributes.name: port_of_export_code
attributes.description: Official code of the customs port or border crossing point from which the goods are exported from the origin country (e.g., UN/LOCODE). Used for export declaration filing and trade statistics.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE; U.S. CBP AES; EU AES; WCO

attributes.name: quantity_declared
attributes.description: Quantity of goods declared to customs in the applicable unit of measure (e.g., units, liters, kilograms). Used for specific duty calculations and statistical reporting.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; U.S. CBP 19 CFR; EU UCC

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the declared quantity (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter). Must align with the WCO supplementary unit for the declared HS code. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|DZ|GR — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System Supplementary Units; UN/ECE Recommendation 20; GS1

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for a customs hold or examination, such as FDA import alert, CPSC safety review, missing documentation, or random inspection. Populated when declaration_status is 'held'.
attributes.references: FDA Import Alerts; CPSC Regulations; U.S. CBP Examination Procedures; EU UCC Article 188

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total taxes assessed at the border in addition to customs duties, such as VAT, GST, excise tax, or other import levies. Expressed in the duty currency.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; U.S. CBP 19 CFR; OECD Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: trade_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the preferential trade agreement under which reduced or zero duty rates are claimed (e.g., USMCA, EU-UK TCA, CPTPP, RCEP). Null if no preferential treatment is claimed.
attributes.references: USMCA; CPTPP; RCEP; EU Trade Agreements; WTO Preferential Tariff Rules

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport used for the cross-border shipment as declared to customs. Determines applicable customs procedures, documentation requirements, and transit time expectations.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; UN/EDIFACT; U.S. CBP ACE; EU UCC Annex B

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this customs declaration record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance.

products.name: freight_cost
products.description: Allocated and accrued freight cost record at the shipment or shipment-leg level. Captures shipment reference, cost category (line-haul, fuel surcharge, accessorial, customs duty, insurance), cost amount, currency, cost allocation basis (weight/volume/value), cost center allocation, accrual status, and actual vs. standard cost variance. Feeds COGS freight component and logistics cost-to-serve analysis.

attributes.name: freight_cost_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each freight cost record at the shipment or shipment-leg level. Primary key for the freight_cost data product.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier contract under which this freight cost was incurred. Enables rate compliance validation and contract utilization tracking.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier responsible for executing the freight movement associated with this cost record. Used for carrier cost benchmarking and contract compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Enables cost center allocation of freight costs for internal cost control and reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Links freight cost records to GL account for accurate financial consolidation of transportation expenses.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation lane associated with this freight cost. Supports lane-level cost benchmarking against standard rates.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent logistics shipment record to which this freight cost is attributed. Links cost to the shipment header for COGS freight component analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports profit center attribution of freight costs to assess logistics impact on product line profitability.

attributes.name: accrual_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight cost record represents an accrued (estimated) cost rather than an actual invoiced amount. True = accrual entry; False = actual invoiced cost. Critical for COGS freight component accuracy in period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Accrual Management; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or apportion this freight cost across shipment lines or cost centers. Weight = allocated by gross weight (kg); Volume = allocated by cubic volume (m3); Value = allocated by declared goods value; Units = allocated by case/unit count; Flat = fixed charge not allocated; Distance = allocated by route distance (km).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD-TM Cost Allocation; COGS Freight Component Methodology

attributes.name: allocation_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity value used as the basis for cost allocation (e.g., weight in kg, volume in m3, declared value in currency, number of cases). Paired with allocation_basis and allocation_uom to fully describe the allocation driver.

attributes.name: allocation_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure corresponding to the allocation_quantity field. KG = kilograms (weight basis); M3 = cubic meters (volume basis); USD = US Dollars (value basis); EA = each/cases (unit basis); KM = kilometers (distance basis); PCT = percentage (proportional basis).
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards; SAP S/4HANA UOM Configuration

attributes.name: audit_discrepancy_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference identified during freight audit between the carrier-invoiced amount and the expected contractual amount. Positive = carrier overcharged; Negative = carrier undercharged. Drives dispute and recovery actions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Freight Audit; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: billing_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (YYYY-MM) in which this freight cost is recognized for financial reporting. Used for period-end accrual matching and monthly freight cost trend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Period; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight used by the carrier for billing purposes, which is the greater of actual gross weight and dimensional (volumetric) weight. Critical for air and parcel freight rate validation and audit.
attributes.references: IATA Dimensional Weight Standards; Carrier Tariff Rules

attributes.name: cold_chain_premium_amount
attributes.description: Additional freight cost premium charged for temperature-controlled (cold chain) transportation. Applicable for perishable consumer goods, health, and personal care products requiring refrigerated or frozen transport.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD-TM Condition Types; ISO 22716 GMP Cold Chain

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Gross freight cost amount in the transaction currency for this cost category and shipment. Represents the base charge before any adjustments or credits. Core monetary field for logistics cost-to-serve analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Cost Element; ISO 4217

attributes.name: cost_amount_usd
attributes.description: Freight cost amount converted to US Dollars using the exchange rate at the time of cost recognition. Enables global freight cost consolidation and cross-currency benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation; ISO 4217

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Classification of the freight cost type. Line-haul covers base transportation; fuel surcharge is the carrier fuel adjustment; accessorial covers detention, liftgate, residential delivery; customs duty covers import/export tariffs; insurance covers cargo coverage premiums. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: line_haul|fuel_surcharge|accessorial|customs_duty|insurance|other — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]

attributes.description: Regulatory classification code for hazardous material, if applicable.

attributes.name: hazardous_material
attributes.description: True if the handling unit contains hazardous material.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Height of the handling unit in centimeters.

attributes.name: internal_reference_number
attributes.description: Internal reference used for cross‑system identification.

attributes.name: is_fragile
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contents are fragile.

attributes.name: is_oversized
attributes.description: True if the handling unit exceeds standard size limits.

attributes.name: last_scanned_location_code
attributes.description: Location code of the most recent scan event for the handling unit.

attributes.name: last_scanned_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent scan event.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Length of the handling unit in centimeters.

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: Primary material composition of the handling unit.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code of the location where the handling unit originated.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Internal department responsible for the handling unit.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the handling unit to arrive at destination.

attributes.name: planned_departure_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the handling unit to leave the origin.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal identifier applied to the handling unit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the handling unit.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the handling unit is equipped for temperature control.

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature for the handling unit when temperature controlled.

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature for the handling unit when temperature controlled.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: External tracking identifier assigned by the carrier.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Category of the handling unit, such as pallet, case, tote, etc.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the handling unit record.

attributes.name: volume_m3
attributes.description: Physical volume of the handling unit in cubic meters.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the handling unit in kilograms.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Width of the handling unit in centimeters.

attributes.name: parent_handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on handling_unit (parent_handling_unit_id)

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Owns physical inventory positions across the entire distribution network. Manages stock on hand, in-transit inventory, warehouse locations, FEFO/FIFO rotation rules, DIO metrics, OOS/OSA events, VMI replenishment triggers, lot/batch traceability for recall readiness, safety stock levels, and multi-echelon inventory visibility.

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Core master record of physical inventory on-hand quantities for each SKU at each storage location. Captures unrestricted, quality-hold, blocked, consignment, VMI-managed, and in-transit stock quantities by stock type and special stock indicator. Serves as the authoritative real-time inventory balance (single source of truth for quantity on hand). Supports OOS/OSA monitoring, days-inventory-outstanding calculation, available-to-promise derivation, and multi-echelon inventory visibility across the distribution network.
products.reference: SAP MM Stock Overview (MMBE) / Blue Yonder WMS Inventory Balance

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock position record. Primary key for the stock position entity.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical storage location (warehouse, distribution center, store, or specific bin) where the inventory is held.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Batch‑level inventory reconciliation report requires linking each stock position to its lot_batch for traceability of production dates and quality attributes.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or distribution facility that owns this inventory position.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand Inventory Balance Report requires linking each stock_position to its brand for marketing planning and stock‑availability forecasts.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: REQUIRED: Links each stock record to its purchase‑order line for cost allocation and replenishment analysis.

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: REQUIRED: Traceability of on‑hand stock to the goods receipt that created it for audit and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: product_lca_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.product_lca. Business justification: Required for LCA‑based inventory reporting; associates each stock position with its product LCA to calculate carbon footprint per inventory unit.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Material allocation: ties inventory stock positions to the production order that consumes them, enabling allocation reports and MRP planning.

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Inventory stock position reports need registration status of each SKU to ensure market compliance and audit readiness.

attributes.name: research_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_formulation. Business justification: Formulation Traceability Report requires linking each stock position to the formulation that defines its composition for quality investigations.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU for which inventory is held. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: sku_planning_param_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.sku_planning_param. Business justification: REPLENISHMENT PLANNING: stock positions need to reference SKU planning parameters for safety stock and lot sizing decisions.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor who owns consignment stock. Populated only when special_stock_indicator is consignment.

attributes.name: available_to_promise_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for new customer orders after accounting for existing commitments and reservations. Calculated as unrestricted quantity minus reserved quantity.
attributes.references: SAP IBP, Supply Chain Planning Standards

attributes.name: blocked_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of stock that is blocked from use due to quality issues, regulatory holds, or other restrictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module, FDA Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stock position record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the inventory valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|CAD|AUD|INR|BRL|MXN — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: days_inventory_outstanding
attributes.description: Number of days the current inventory level would last based on average daily demand. Key metric for working capital efficiency and cash flow management.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the product should not be sold or used. Essential for FEFO inventory rotation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory was physically received at this storage location. Used for FIFO rotation and aging analysis.

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of stock currently in transit between locations (plant-to-warehouse, warehouse-to-store, etc.) and not yet received at destination.

attributes.name: last_goods_movement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory transaction (receipt, issue, transfer) for this stock position. Used to identify slow-moving or obsolete inventory.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date when the last physical count or cycle count was performed for this stock position. Used for inventory accuracy monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stock position record was last modified. Used for data freshness monitoring and change tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the batch or lot was manufactured. Critical for shelf-life management and FEFO rotation.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum inventory level allowed at this location to prevent overstocking and optimize working capital.

attributes.name: obsolete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory is obsolete (discontinued product, expired, or no longer saleable) and should be written off or disposed.

attributes.name: oos_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current stock level is below safety stock and at risk of stockout. Used for proactive replenishment alerts.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of stock currently undergoing quality control inspection and not yet released for use.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical inventory quantity available at the storage location. This is the authoritative single source of truth for inventory balance.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock is under quarantine pending quality inspection, regulatory review, or investigation.

attributes.name: recall_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock is on hold due to a product recall or safety alert. Prevents further distribution or sale.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers automatic replenishment. When stock falls to this level, a purchase requisition or transfer order is generated.
