attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP, DRP Standards

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of stock reserved for specific sales orders, production orders, or other commitments and not available for general allocation.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum inventory level maintained as buffer stock to prevent stockouts due to demand variability or supply disruptions.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items requiring individual unit tracking.

attributes.name: shelf_life_remaining_days
attributes.description: Number of days remaining until expiration. Used for FEFO prioritization and markdown planning.

attributes.name: slow_moving_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory has had no or minimal movement over a defined period (typically 90+ days), signaling potential obsolescence risk.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock is held under special conditions or ownership arrangements. Standard stock is company-owned and unrestricted; consignment is supplier-owned; project stock is allocated to specific projects; sales order stock is reserved for specific customer orders; subcontracting stock is at vendor location; pipeline stock is in-transit; returnable packaging is reusable containers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|consignment|project|sales_order|subcontracting|pipeline|returnable_packaging — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: stock_rotation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory rotation policy applied at this location. FIFO=First In First Out; FEFO=First Expired First Out (for perishables); LIFO=Last In First Out; Manual=operator-controlled picking.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock position. Active=available for operations; Inactive=temporarily unavailable; Pending Disposal=marked for write-off; Transferred=moved to another location; Consumed=used in production or sold.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of inventory by availability status. Unrestricted stock is available for sale or use; quality inspection stock is pending QC approval; blocked stock cannot be used; returns stock is customer returns awaiting disposition; restricted use stock has limited applications; consignment stock is owned by supplier; VMI-managed stock is vendor-managed inventory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unrestricted|quality_inspection|blocked|returns|restricted_use|consignment|vmi_managed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the stock position, calculated as quantity on hand multiplied by unit cost. Used for balance sheet reporting and working capital analysis.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of inventory at this location, used for inventory valuation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the quantity is measured. EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon, M=Meter, FT=Foot. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL|M|FT — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unrestricted_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of stock that is freely available for sale, production, or distribution without any restrictions.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Method used to value the inventory for financial reporting. Standard uses predetermined costs; moving average recalculates after each receipt; FIFO assumes first-in-first-out; LIFO assumes last-in-first-out; weighted average uses average cost across all receipts.

attributes.name: vmi_replenishment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock position is managed under a VMI agreement where the vendor is responsible for replenishment decisions.

products.name: lot_batch
products.description: Master record for each manufactured or received lot/batch of a SKU, capturing batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, best-before date, country of origin, GMP status, and quarantine flags. Supports FEFO/FIFO rotation enforcement, lot-level traceability for recall readiness, and regulatory compliance (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU REACH, EU Food Information Regulation). Linked to production batch records in manufacturing execution systems and quality inspection lots.
products.reference: SAP MM Batch Master (MSC1N) / GS1 Batch Traceability

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot or batch record. Primary key for the lot_batch product.

attributes.name: dossier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.dossier. Business justification: Batch traceability links each lot/batch to its regulatory dossier for post‑market surveillance and recall investigations.

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory quality inspection requires recording the employee ID of the inspector for each batch; essential for traceability and compliance audits.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility where this lot or batch was produced.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand‑level lot traceability is required for quality compliance and consumer‑facing brand claims; linking lot_batch to brand supports this.

attributes.name: research_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_formulation. Business justification: Regulatory compliance mandates batch‑to‑formulation mapping to verify that each produced lot follows the approved formulation.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU that this lot or batch represents. Links to the product master.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique batch or lot number assigned during manufacturing. Used for traceability and recall management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Cosmetics

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the lot or batch. Indicates whether the batch is active and available, depleted, expired, recalled, destroyed, or transferred to another location.

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: The date until which the product retains optimal quality. Distinct from expiry_date; product may still be safe but quality may degrade after this date.
attributes.references: EU Food Information Regulation 1169/2011, FDA Food Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the Certificate of Analysis document that records the quality test results for this lot or batch.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting regulatory compliance status, exceptions, or special handling requirements for this lot or batch.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where this lot or batch was manufactured. Required for customs, trade compliance, and labeling.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, FDA Country of Origin Labeling, EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created this lot or batch record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lot or batch record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the product should not be used or sold. Used to enforce First Expired First Out (FEFO) inventory rotation and prevent sale of expired goods.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Requirements, EU Food Information Regulation 1169/2011

attributes.name: gmp_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot or batch was produced in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice standards. Critical for regulatory compliance and quality assurance.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Cosmetics, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lot or batch is on hold and cannot be used or shipped. True if on hold, False otherwise.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: The business reason why this lot or batch is on hold, if applicable. Examples: pending quality review, regulatory investigation, customer complaint.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which quality control inspection was performed on this lot or batch.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Alternative or supplementary lot identifier used in some manufacturing contexts. May be the same as batch_number or represent a sub-batch.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Cosmetics

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this lot or batch was manufactured or produced. Critical for shelf-life calculation and First Expired First Out (FEFO) rotation.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Cosmetics, FDA Food Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this lot or batch record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lot or batch record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this lot or batch. May include special handling instructions, quality observations, or other relevant information.

attributes.name: production_order_number
attributes.description: The production order or work order number under which this lot or batch was manufactured. Links to Manufacturing Execution System (MES) records.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Planning, Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: The quality grade or classification assigned to this lot or batch based on quality control inspection results. May affect pricing, distribution channel, or disposal decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: A|B|C|premium|standard|substandard|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quantity_produced
attributes.description: The total quantity of product manufactured in this lot or batch, measured in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Current quarantine or release status of the lot or batch. Quarantined lots cannot be used or shipped until quality inspection is complete and status is changed to released.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which this lot or batch was received into inventory, applicable for purchased or transferred goods.
attributes.references: SAP MM Materials Management, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lot or batch meets all applicable regulatory compliance requirements. True if compliant, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU REACH Regulation, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days remaining until expiry_date as of the current date. Used for inventory rotation and markdown decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Cosmetics

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: The date by which the lot or batch must be retested to confirm continued quality and compliance. Common in pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days from manufacturing_date to expiry_date, representing the total shelf life of this lot or batch. Used for First Expired First Out (FEFO) calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Cosmetics

attributes.name: storage_condition_requirement
attributes.description: The required storage conditions for this lot or batch to maintain product quality and safety. Examples: ambient, refrigerated, frozen, controlled room temperature.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Cosmetics, FDA Storage Requirements

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: The warehouse or storage location code where this lot or batch is currently stored. Used for inventory visibility and warehouse management.
attributes.references: SAP WM Warehouse Management, Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: supplier_lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number assigned by the supplier for received raw materials or finished goods. Used for traceability back to the supplier in case of quality issues or recalls.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: traceability_code
attributes.description: A unique code used for end-to-end supply chain traceability of this lot or batch. May be a GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) with batch extension or similar standard.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications, FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which quantity_produced is measured. Examples: EA (each), CS (case), KG (kilogram), L (liter). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|KG|LB|L|GAL|M|FT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: The name of the vendor or supplier from whom this lot or batch was received, if applicable for purchased goods.

products.name: inventory_storage_location
products.description: Master record for physical and logical storage locations within the distribution network including distribution centers, warehouses, retail back-rooms, 3PL facilities, and in-transit staging areas. Captures location code, location type (bulk, pick, reserve, quarantine, returns), temperature zone, capacity (weight, volume, pallet positions), WMS zone mapping, and geo-coordinates. Serves as the single source of truth for the location hierarchy used across warehouse management and inventory systems.
products.reference: SAP WM Storage Location / Blue Yonder WMS Location Master

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the storage location within the distribution network. Primary key.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires mapping each storage location to its jurisdiction for local compliance (labeling, safety, reporting).

attributes.name: location_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Each storage location has a manager responsible for inventory integrity; used in location performance and accountability reports.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility (distribution center, warehouse, retail store, or third-party logistics provider) where this storage location resides.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: WAREHOUSE MANAGEMENT: each storage location is physically part of a supply network node; required for location‑level inventory reporting.

attributes.name: third_party_provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party logistics provider managing this location, if applicable. Null for company-owned facilities.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification for the location based on inventory velocity and value. A for high-velocity/high-value, B for medium, C for low-velocity/low-value items. Used for slotting optimization.

attributes.name: aisle
attributes.description: Aisle designation within the warehouse layout for physical navigation and location addressing.

attributes.name: bay
attributes.description: Bay or section identifier within an aisle, representing a vertical or horizontal subdivision of storage space.

attributes.name: bin
attributes.description: Bin or slot identifier representing the smallest addressable storage unit within a level, used for item-level location precision.

attributes.name: blocked_date
attributes.description: Date when the location was blocked or made unavailable for inventory placement.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the location is blocked or unavailable, used for operational troubleshooting and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: capacity_pallet_positions
attributes.description: Number of standard pallet positions that can be stored in this location, used for pallet-based inventory planning.

attributes.name: capacity_volume_m3
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity of the storage location in cubic meters, used for space utilization optimization.

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms, used for load planning and safety compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was first created in the system for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated for cross-docking operations where goods move directly from receiving to shipping without long-term storage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location was decommissioned or removed from active use. Null for currently active locations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location became operational and available for inventory placement.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location is certified and equipped for storing hazardous materials per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HCS) and EPA Regulations

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within a bay, used for precise location addressing in multi-tier racking systems.

attributes.name: last_inventory_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed at this location, used for inventory accuracy tracking.
attributes.references: Inventory Management Best Practices and SOX Compliance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was most recently updated for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent inventory movement (putaway, pick, transfer) at this location, used for activity analysis and slotting optimization.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the storage location for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and facility mapping.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location used across warehouse management and inventory systems. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each physical or logical storage position.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the storage location for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Active for normal operations, blocked for temporary holds, maintenance for repairs, quarantine for quality issues, inactive for unused space, decommissioned for permanently retired locations.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location based on its operational purpose within the warehouse. Bulk storage for palletized goods, pick locations for order fulfillment, reserve for overflow, quarantine for quality hold, returns for reverse logistics, and staging for in-transit goods.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the storage location for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and facility mapping.

attributes.name: mixed_sku_allowed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mixed Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location permits storage of multiple SKUs simultaneously or requires single-SKU dedication for inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: picking_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for order picking optimization. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for fast-moving SKUs and efficient pick path planning.

attributes.name: replenishment_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Percentage threshold that triggers automatic replenishment from reserve to pick locations. Used in Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and automated replenishment processes.

attributes.name: rotation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory rotation policy applied to this location. FEFO (First Expired First Out) for perishables, FIFO (First In First Out) for standard goods, LIFO (Last In First Out) for specific scenarios, or MANUAL for operator-controlled picking.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Food Safety Standards

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification of the storage location based on access controls and monitoring requirements. High-value for premium products, controlled substance for regulated materials, restricted for limited access areas.
attributes.references: Internal Security Policy and FDA Controlled Substance Regulations

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the storage location. Ambient for room temperature, refrigerated for 2-8°C, frozen for below 0°C, and controlled for specific temperature ranges required by product specifications.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: WMS zone identifier used for warehouse layout management, picking optimization, and labor allocation. Zones group locations by operational characteristics or product categories.

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement event including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, returns, write-offs, and inter-plant transfers. Captures movement type code, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination locations, posting date, reference document (purchase order, production order, delivery note), carrier/shipment reference for inter-node transfers, and posting user. Provides the full audit trail for inventory reconciliation and in-transit tracking.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Movement (MIGO) / Material Document

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock movement transaction. Primary key for the stock movement record.

attributes.name: bom_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bom_line. Business justification: Manufacturing consumption tracking links inventory movements to specific BOM lines, enabling component usage analysis per product in the Component Consumption Report.

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_flight. Business justification: Logistics teams track stock movements tied to specific campaign flights to measure promotional material delivery and OTIF performance.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Transportation carrier responsible for moving inventory between locations for inter-node transfers.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost accounting for each inventory movement requires linking to the responsible cost center for internal reporting and allocation.

attributes.name: destination_location_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Warehouse, plant, or storage location to which inventory is being moved. Null for goods issues to external destinations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the person who posted or recorded this stock movement for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics shipment for inter-plant or inter-warehouse transfers to track in-transit inventory.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Needed to tie inventory movements to the originating sales order for order fulfillment audit and cost of goods sold reconciliation.

attributes.name: primary_stock_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Warehouse, plant, or storage location from which inventory is being moved. Null for goods receipts from external sources.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis of inventory flows assigns each movement to a profit center, needed for segment reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: PO receipt tracking for OTIF reporting and financial reconciliation links stock movements to the originating purchase order.

attributes.name: reversed_movement_stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original stock movement record that this transaction reverses or cancels.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU involved in this stock movement event.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Supplier or vendor from whom goods were received for goods receipt movements.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Customer to whom goods were issued for sales order fulfillment or Direct to Consumer (DTC) shipments.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number for traceability and recall readiness. Critical for FEFO/FIFO rotation and quality control.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock movement record was first created in the system for audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the movement value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date on the source document (purchase order, production order, delivery note) that triggered this movement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Shelf life expiration date for perishable or time-sensitive products. Critical for First Expired First Out (FEFO) rotation and Out of Stock (OOS) prevention.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock movement record was last updated or modified for change tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was manufactured or produced. Used for shelf life calculation and traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number generated for this goods movement. Unique identifier in the source ERP system.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year of the material document for SAP document key uniqueness.

attributes.name: movement_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the movement event for reporting and analytics purposes.

attributes.name: movement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the stock movement event.

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical inventory movement occurred or was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: SAP movement type code identifying the nature of the inventory transaction (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 261=Goods Issue to Production, 311=Stock Transfer, 551=Scrapping, 601=Goods Receipt from Delivery).

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code where the movement occurred.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the stock movement was posted to the inventory ledger for financial and inventory accounting purposes.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock movement requires quality inspection before the inventory can be released for use.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory moved in this transaction. Positive for receipts/increases, negative for issues/decreases.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code explaining the business reason for the movement (e.g., quality issue, damage, expiration, customer return, production scrap).

attributes.name: reference_document_line
attributes.description: Line item number within the reference document that corresponds to this stock movement.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the source transaction (PO number, production order number, delivery note number) that triggered this movement.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document that initiated this stock movement for audit trail and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase_order|production_order|sales_order|delivery_note|transfer_order|return_order|adjustment_document — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this movement is a reversal or cancellation of a previous stock movement transaction.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items requiring individual unit tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 SGTIN (Serialized Global Trade Item Number)

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special stock type indicator (e.g., E=Sales Order Stock, K=Consignment Stock, O=Project Stock, W=Vendor Managed Inventory).

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of inventory status determining availability for use (unrestricted=available for sale/use, quality_inspection=pending QC, blocked=not available).

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location or bin within the plant or warehouse where inventory is stored.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the inventory movement (quantity × unit cost) for financial reporting and inventory accounting.
attributes.references: GAAP Inventory Valuation, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of inventory at the time of movement for inventory valuation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP Inventory Valuation, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the movement quantity (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, KG=Kilogram, LT=Liter).

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification for split valuation of the same material (e.g., domestic vs imported, new vs refurbished).

products.name: inventory_replenishment_order
products.description: Transactional record of inventory replenishment requests and orders generated through VMI auto-replenishment, distribution requirements planning (DRP), or manual triggers. Captures replenishment type, requested quantity, approved quantity, source location, destination location, requested delivery date, priority, and fulfillment status. Closes the loop between demand sensing signals and physical stock movement execution.
products.reference: SAP IBP DRP / VMI Replenishment Order

attributes.name: inventory_replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory replenishment order record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Promotional campaigns trigger dedicated replenishment orders; linking enables the Campaign‑Driven Replenishment Report used in trade spend planning.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics carrier assigned to transport this replenishment shipment from source to destination.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Replenishment orders are charged to cost centers for budgeting and cost tracking of inventory replenishment.

attributes.name: destination_location_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, distribution center, or retail location that will receive the replenished inventory.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or automated process that created the replenishment order.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, distribution center, or manufacturing facility from which inventory will be shipped to fulfill this replenishment order.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center allocation of replenishment orders supports segment‑level expense reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_requisition. Business justification: REQUIRED: Internal replenishment orders are driven by purchase requisitions; linking supports demand‑driven planning.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU being replenished. Links to the product master for item details.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment was received at the destination location. Used to measure delivery performance and OTIF compliance.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment departed from the source location. Used to calculate On Time In Full (OTIF) performance.

attributes.name: approved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU approved for fulfillment after review and Available to Promise (ATP) validation. May differ from requested quantity due to supply constraints.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the replenishment order was cancelled, if applicable. Examples include demand change, supply constraint, or duplicate order.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the product should not be sold or used. Used to enforce First Expired First Out (FEFO) rotation rules in inventory management.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight cost incurred for transporting this replenishment order from source to destination location.

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of days between order placement and delivery at the destination location, based on historical lane performance.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number assigned to the inventory being replenished. Critical for traceability and recall readiness per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.

attributes.name: oos_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order was created to prevent an anticipated Out of Stock (OOS) event based on demand forecasting.

attributes.name: order_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order was approved for fulfillment by the supply chain planner or automated approval workflow.

attributes.name: order_cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order was cancelled, if applicable. Null for active orders.

attributes.name: order_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order was first created in the system, either automatically by planning algorithms or manually by a planner.

attributes.name: order_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planners to capture special instructions, handling requirements, or contextual information about the replenishment order.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment order indicating its position in the fulfillment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|in_transit|received|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the replenishment order to guide fulfillment sequencing and resource allocation. Critical orders address Out of Stock (OOS) situations.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received and confirmed at the destination location. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage or discrepancies.

attributes.name: replenishment_order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the replenishment order, used for tracking and communication across systems and stakeholders.

attributes.name: replenishment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order generation method: Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) auto-replenishment, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) planned order, manual trigger by planner, safety stock replenishment, emergency order, or seasonal build.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the replenishment inventory is needed at the destination location to prevent Out of Stock (OOS) conditions.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU requested for replenishment, as calculated by the demand planning system or entered by the planner.

attributes.name: rotation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory rotation policy applied to this replenishment: First Expired First Out (FEFO) for perishables, First In First Out (FIFO) for standard goods, Last In First Out (LIFO) for specific scenarios.

attributes.name: safety_stock_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order was triggered by inventory falling below the safety stock threshold at the destination location.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date for shipment departure from the source location, calculated based on lead time and requested delivery date.

attributes.name: shipment_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for the shipment associated with this replenishment order. Used for in-transit visibility.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped from the source location. Updated when the shipment is dispatched.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the replenishment quantity is expressed: Each (EA), Case (CS), Pallet (PL), Pound (LB), Kilogram (KG), Liter (L), Gallon (GAL). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|LB|KG|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: inventory_cycle_count
products.description: Transactional record of physical inventory cycle count events conducted at storage locations. Captures count date, count method (full physical, ABC cycle, perpetual), counted quantity, system quantity, variance quantity, variance percentage, count status (planned, in-progress, confirmed, posted), and approver. Supports inventory accuracy KPIs, shrinkage investigation triggers, and WMS reconciliation. Distinct from stock_movement as it represents a formal audit event, not a stock transaction.
products.reference: SAP MM Physical Inventory (MI01/MI07) / Blue Yonder Cycle Count

attributes.name: inventory_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory cycle count event. Primary key for the cycle count record.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the cycle count results and authorized the variance adjustment. Required for SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance and segregation of duties.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse storage location where the cycle count was performed. Links to the physical bin, aisle, or zone within the facility.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center where the cycle count was performed. Supports multi-site inventory management.

attributes.name: original_count_inventory_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: If this is a recount, references the inventory_cycle_count_id of the original count that triggered the recount requirement. Null for initial counts.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_counter_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse associate or employee who performed the physical count. Used for accountability and performance tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that was counted during this cycle count event.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: The ABC inventory classification of the SKU at the time of count. A = high-value items counted frequently, B = medium-value, C = low-value counted less frequently. Drives cycle count frequency.

attributes.name: adjustment_document_number
attributes.description: The ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) document number or transaction ID generated when the inventory adjustment was posted. Used for financial audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variance has been posted as an inventory adjustment in the ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system. True = adjustment posted, False = pending posting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count was approved by the authorized supervisor. Part of the audit trail for inventory adjustments.

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the physical cycle count was performed.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: The methodology used for the cycle count. Full physical = complete inventory audit, ABC cycle = frequency-based counting by value classification, perpetual = continuous counting, spot check = random verification, blind count = counter does not see system quantity.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, WMS Best Practices

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count event. Planned = scheduled but not started, in_progress = counting underway, confirmed = count verified, posted = variance adjusted in system, cancelled = count voided, recount_required = variance exceeds threshold.

attributes.name: count_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the cycle count was executed. Used for audit trail and WMS (Warehouse Management System) reconciliation.

attributes.name: count_zone
attributes.description: The warehouse zone or area designation where the count took place (e.g., receiving, picking, reserve, quarantine). Used for zone-based cycle count scheduling.

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: The actual physical quantity counted by the warehouse associate during the cycle count event. Measured in the SKU's unit of measure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the lot/batch counted. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation rules and consumer safety in CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods).

attributes.name: inventory_value_at_count
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the counted inventory based on the counted quantity and the unit cost at the time of count. Used for financial reconciliation and shrinkage cost calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was last updated. Tracks changes through the count lifecycle (planned → in_progress → confirmed → posted).

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the inventory counted. Critical for traceability and recall readiness in consumer goods.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counted inventory is in quarantine status pending quality inspection or regulatory clearance. True = quarantined, False = available.

attributes.name: recount_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count is a recount of a previous count that exceeded variance thresholds. True = recount, False = initial count.

attributes.name: system_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity recorded in the WMS (Warehouse Management System) or ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system at the time of the count. Used to calculate variance.
attributes.references: SAP WM/EWM, Blue Yonder WMS Standards

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counted inventory is stored in a temperature-controlled environment. True = cold chain storage, False = ambient. Relevant for perishable consumer goods.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the inventory was counted. EA = each, CS = case, PL = pallet, KG = kilogram, LB = pound, L = liter, GAL = gallon. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or additional context provided by the counter or approver regarding the variance. Used for investigation and documentation.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the system quantity. Calculated as (variance_quantity / system_quantity) * 100. Used to trigger investigation thresholds.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between counted quantity and system quantity (counted minus system). Positive values indicate overage, negative values indicate shortage.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorization of the root cause for the inventory variance. Used for shrinkage analysis, process improvement, and loss prevention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shrinkage|damage|misplacement|system_error|receiving_error|picking_error|expiration|theft|administrative_error|vendor_shortage — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the variance (variance_quantity * unit_cost). Represents the financial impact of the inventory discrepancy. Used for shrinkage reporting and P&L (Profit and Loss) impact analysis.

products.name: safety_stock_policy
products.description: Master record defining safety stock parameters and reorder point policies for each SKU-location combination. Captures safety stock quantity, reorder point, maximum stock level, minimum order quantity (MOQ), replenishment lead time, service level target (%), demand variability coefficient, and policy review date. Feeds SAP IBP inventory optimization and DRP planning runs. Distinct from stock_position (actual balance) — this is the policy/rule that governs when replenishment is triggered.
products.reference: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization / MRP Safety Stock

attributes.name: safety_stock_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety stock policy record. Primary key.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse, distribution center, or storage location where this safety stock policy applies.

attributes.name: primary_safety_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain planner or inventory analyst responsible for maintaining and reviewing this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU governed by this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and velocity. A items are high-value/high-velocity requiring tight control; B items are moderate; C items are low-value/low-velocity; D items are obsolete or slow-moving.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this safety stock policy was formally approved and authorized for use in planning systems.

attributes.name: average_daily_demand
attributes.description: The mean daily demand quantity for this SKU at this location, calculated from historical sales and forecast data. Used in reorder point and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine safety stock levels. Statistical methods use demand variability and service level; time-based methods use fixed days of supply; manual methods rely on planner judgment; hybrid methods combine multiple approaches.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization Calculation Logic

attributes.name: carrying_cost_rate_percent
attributes.description: The annual percentage cost of holding inventory, including warehousing, insurance, obsolescence, and cost of capital. Used to calculate the financial impact of safety stock levels.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The standard cost per unit of the SKU, used to calculate the financial value of safety stock inventory and carrying costs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock policy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: criticality_level
attributes.description: Business importance classification indicating the impact of stockouts. Critical items cause production stops or lost sales; high items significantly impact operations; medium and low items have manageable stockout consequences.

attributes.name: demand_standard_deviation
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand variability around the average daily demand. Used to calculate safety stock levels for a given service level target.

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand volatility, typically the coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean demand). Higher values indicate greater uncertainty and require higher safety stock.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning Statistical Forecasting

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this safety stock policy becomes active and is applied in replenishment planning and inventory optimization runs.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this safety stock policy expires or is superseded by a new policy. Null indicates an open-ended policy.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock policy record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this safety stock policy was last reviewed and validated by inventory planning or supply chain teams.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: The upper inventory threshold for this SKU-location combination. Prevents overstocking and excess inventory carrying costs.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The smallest order quantity that can be placed for replenishment, typically driven by supplier constraints or economic order quantity calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required for a product to be shipped to customers or transferred to retail. Products below this threshold may be blocked from sale.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next policy review. Calculated as last_review_date plus review_frequency_days.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The quantity increment in which orders must be placed (e.g., pallet quantities, case pack sizes). Orders are rounded to the nearest multiple.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Organizational grouping code identifying the supply chain planning team or business unit responsible for managing this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the safety stock policy, typically a concatenation of SKU and location codes for external reference.

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planners to document special considerations, exceptions, seasonal adjustments, or business context relevant to this safety stock policy.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety stock policy methodology. Fixed policies use static parameters; dynamic policies adjust based on demand variability; seasonal policies account for cyclical patterns; promotional policies support campaign-driven demand; VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) policies are supplier-controlled; consignment policies apply to stock owned by suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization Best Practices

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered. Calculated as safety stock plus demand during lead time.

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days required from order placement to inventory availability at the location. Includes procurement, production, and transportation time.

attributes.name: replenishment_strategy
attributes.description: The inventory replenishment approach applied to this SKU-location. Reorder point triggers orders when stock falls below ROP; periodic review orders at fixed intervals; min-max maintains stock between bounds; kanban uses visual signals; DRP (Distribution Requirements Planning) uses time-phased planning; VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) is supplier-controlled.

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: The number of days between scheduled reviews of this safety stock policy. High-value or high-variability items may be reviewed weekly or monthly; stable items may be reviewed quarterly or annually.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization Review Cycle

attributes.name: rotation_rule
attributes.description: The inventory rotation strategy applied to this SKU-location. FIFO (First In First Out) for standard goods; FEFO (First Expired First Out) for perishables and date-sensitive products; LIFO (Last In First Out) for specific accounting scenarios; manual for items requiring human judgment.

attributes.name: safety_stock_policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety stock policy. Active policies are in effect; inactive policies are not applied; suspended policies are temporarily paused; under_review policies are being evaluated; expired policies have passed their validity period; draft policies are not yet approved.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The target safety stock quantity to be maintained at the location for this SKU, expressed in the base unit of measure. This buffer inventory protects against demand variability and supply uncertainty.

attributes.name: safety_time_days
attributes.description: Additional lead time buffer added to the replenishment lead time to account for supply uncertainty. Used in time-based safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: The target percentage of demand that should be met from available stock without stockouts. Typically ranges from 90% to 99.9% depending on product criticality and business strategy.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days from production or receipt date until the product expires or becomes unsellable. Critical for FEFO rotation and safety stock sizing for perishable goods.

attributes.name: stockout_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The estimated cost per unit of a stockout event, including lost sales, expedited freight, production downtime, and customer dissatisfaction. Used in service level optimization.

attributes.name: system_generated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy was automatically generated by SAP IBP optimization algorithms (true) or manually created by a planner (false).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit in which safety stock quantities are expressed (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, PL for pallet).

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: Demand variability classification. X items have stable, predictable demand; Y items have moderate variability; Z items have highly erratic or unpredictable demand patterns.

products.name: intransit_shipment
products.description: Transactional record tracking inventory that is physically in-transit between nodes in the distribution network (supplier-to-DC, DC-to-DC, DC-to-store). Captures shipment reference, origin node, destination node, carrier, in-transit quantity by SKU/lot, expected arrival date, actual arrival date, in-transit status (departed, in-transit, arrived, exception), and OTIF flag. Provides multi-echelon inventory visibility for in-transit stock that is not yet receipted at destination.
products.reference: SAP MM In-Transit Stock / Blue Yonder WMS ASN

attributes.name: intransit_shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the in-transit shipment record. Primary key for tracking inventory moving between distribution network nodes.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the logistics carrier or third-party logistics provider (3PL) responsible for transporting the shipment.

attributes.name: destination_node_network_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the target location in the distribution network where the shipment is being delivered (distribution center, warehouse, retail store, or customer location).

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Required for shipment‑to‑order tracking in OTIF logistics reports; sales order is the business driver for each in‑transit shipment.

attributes.name: primary_intransit_network_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the source location in the distribution network from which the shipment departed (supplier facility, distribution center, warehouse, or manufacturing plant).

attributes.name: research_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_formulation. Business justification: Launch logistics report tracks shipments of newly launched formulations, tying in‑transit data to the formulation for rollout monitoring.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product SKU being shipped. For multi-SKU shipments, this represents the primary or single SKU; detailed line-level tracking may exist in related shipment_item records.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment physically arrived at the destination node. Null until arrival occurs. Used for OTIF performance measurement.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Production batch identifier for granular traceability within a lot. Used for quality assurance and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: carrier_service_level
attributes.description: The transportation service level or speed tier selected for this shipment, impacting transit time and cost.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this in-transit shipment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment physically departed from the origin node. Used for transit time calculation and OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement.

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination location type in the supply chain network.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the exception event, including root cause and resolution actions taken.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the shipment encountered any exceptions during transit (delays, damage, routing issues, temperature excursions).

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary exception encountered during shipment transit. Null if no exception occurred.

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned or estimated date when the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination node. Used for inventory planning and ATP (Available to Promise) calculations.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight transportation cost for this shipment in the base currency. Used for logistics cost allocation and freight audit.

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight cost amount.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class code for hazardous materials (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 8 for corrosives). Null if not hazmat.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the shipment arrived with the complete expected quantity, regardless of timing.

attributes.name: intransit_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of inventory units currently in-transit for this shipment. Represents stock that has left origin but not yet arrived at destination.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this in-transit shipment record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number for traceability and recall readiness. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation and quality control.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the shipment arrived on or before the expected arrival date, regardless of quantity accuracy.

attributes.name: origin_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the origin location type in the supply chain network.

attributes.name: otif_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the shipment met OTIF performance criteria (arrived on time with full quantity). True if both time and quantity targets were met.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in this shipment. Used for warehouse receiving planning and dock scheduling.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with this shipment, linking the in-transit inventory to the originating procurement transaction.

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the in-transit quantity (each, case, pallet, weight, volume). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lbs|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipment was formally receipted into destination inventory through WMS (Warehouse Management System). May differ from arrival timestamp due to inspection and put-away processes.

attributes.name: required_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Cold Chain Management Standards, FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: required_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Cold Chain Management Standards, FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: shipment_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the shipment, used for tracking and communication with carriers and logistics partners. May be ASN (Advanced Shipping Notice) number or BOL (Bill of Lading) number.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the in-transit shipment. Tracks progression from departure through arrival and final receipt at destination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|departed|in_transit|arrived|receipted|exception|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: shipment_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of the shipment in cubic meters. Used for transportation capacity planning and dimensional weight calculations.

attributes.name: shipment_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including packaging. Used for freight cost calculation and carrier capacity planning.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this shipment requires temperature-controlled transportation (cold chain logistics) to maintain product quality and safety.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for real-time shipment visibility and proof of delivery. Used for integration with carrier tracking systems.

attributes.name: transit_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the shipment was in transit from departure to arrival. Calculated as the difference between actual arrival and departure timestamps.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for moving the shipment between origin and destination.

products.name: oos_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing Out-of-Stock (OOS) and On-Shelf Availability (OSA) events at the SKU-location level. Captures OOS start timestamp, OOS end timestamp, OOS duration (hours), root cause category (demand spike, replenishment failure, forecast miss, upstream stockout, logistics delay), estimated lost sales value, and resolution action. Sourced from POS data feeds and demand sensing signals. Critical for OSA improvement programs, retail execution accountability, and service level reporting.
products.reference: OOS/OSA Event / TradeEdge Secondary Sales Signal

attributes.name: oos_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the out-of-stock event record.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, distribution center, or retail location where the OOS event occurred.

attributes.name: previous_oos_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous OOS event ID for the same SKU-location if this is a recurrence, enabling trend analysis.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Out‑of‑stock events are owned by a specific employee who drives corrective actions; required for OOS root‑cause analysis and SLA reporting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU that experienced the out-of-stock condition.

attributes.name: actual_demand_units
attributes.description: Actual observed demand in units during the OOS event period, used to identify demand spikes or forecast misses.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Brand name of the SKU that experienced the OOS event, used for brand-level OOS performance tracking.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel type where the OOS event occurred: retail, wholesale, e-commerce, DSD (Direct Store Delivery), or DTC (Direct to Consumer).

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action plan implemented to prevent recurrence of similar OOS events in the future.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the OOS event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the OOS event resulted in direct customer impact such as lost sales, customer complaints, or service level breaches.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_units
attributes.description: Forecasted demand in units for the period during which the OOS event occurred, used to compare actual vs. planned demand.

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: System or channel that detected and reported the out-of-stock event, such as POS system, WMS, demand sensing platform, manual report, retail execution app, or EDI feed.

attributes.name: estimated_lost_sales_value
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of sales lost due to the out-of-stock condition, calculated based on historical demand patterns and average selling price.

attributes.name: estimated_lost_units
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of units that could not be sold due to the out-of-stock condition.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OOS event record: open (active OOS), resolved (inventory restored), under investigation (root cause analysis in progress), or closed (fully resolved and documented).

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Forecast accuracy percentage for the SKU-location during the period of the OOS event, calculated as (1 - |actual - forecast| / actual) * 100.

attributes.name: impact_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the OOS event impact based on lost sales value, SKU importance, and customer impact. Categories: critical, high, medium, low.

attributes.name: inventory_on_hand_at_oos
attributes.description: System-recorded inventory quantity on hand at the time the OOS event was detected, used to identify phantom inventory situations.

attributes.name: last_replenishment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent replenishment delivery prior to the OOS event, used to analyze replenishment frequency adequacy.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the OOS event record was most recently updated, reflecting changes to status, resolution actions, or root cause analysis.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_replenishment_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled replenishment delivery at the time of the OOS event, used to assess replenishment planning gaps.

attributes.name: oos_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the out-of-stock event measured in hours, calculated as the difference between end and start timestamps.

attributes.name: oos_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the out-of-stock condition was resolved and inventory became available again.

attributes.name: oos_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the out-of-stock condition was first detected. Sourced from POS data feeds or demand sensing signals.

attributes.name: oos_type
attributes.description: Classification of the OOS event type: warehouse stockout (no inventory in facility), shelf stockout (inventory in back room but not on shelf), phantom inventory (system shows stock but physical count is zero), or system mismatch.

attributes.name: osa_actual_percent
attributes.description: Actual on-shelf availability percentage achieved during the period including the OOS event, calculated from POS and inventory data.

attributes.name: osa_target_percent
attributes.description: Target on-shelf availability percentage for the SKU-location at the time of the OOS event, used to measure performance against goals.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Product category classification of the SKU that experienced the OOS event, used for category-level OOS analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this OOS event is a recurrence of a previous OOS event for the same SKU-location combination within a defined time window.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Configured reorder point threshold for the SKU at this location, used to evaluate whether replenishment triggers were properly set.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Action taken to resolve the out-of-stock event, such as emergency replenishment, transfer from alternate location, expedited shipment, customer backorder, substitution offered, or no action taken.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the resolution action was initiated or completed to address the out-of-stock condition.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Primary root cause classification for the OOS event. Categories include demand spike, replenishment failure, forecast miss, upstream stockout, logistics delay, or system error.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the root cause behind the out-of-stock event, providing context beyond the category classification.

attributes.name: safety_stock_level
attributes.description: Configured safety stock level for the SKU at this location at the time of the OOS event, used to assess whether safety stock was breached.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the OOS event caused a breach of service level agreement commitments to customers or retail partners.

products.name: stock_hold
products.description: Transactional record of quality holds, regulatory blocks, and commercial holds placed on inventory lots or stock positions. Captures hold type (QC inspection hold, regulatory recall hold, commercial dispute hold, damage hold), hold reason, hold quantity, hold start date, hold release date, hold status, approving authority, and disposition decision (release, rework, destroy, return to supplier). Integrates with quality management usage decisions and regulatory hold workflows.
products.reference: SAP QM Usage Decision / Quality Hold

attributes.name: stock_hold_id
attributes.description: Primary key for stock_hold

attributes.name: approving_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Hold decisions must be approved by a designated employee; the link enables hold audit logs and compliance verification.

attributes.name: customer_complaint_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this hold to a customer complaint or quality issue reported from the field. Used for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this hold to a specific quality control inspection record. Used to trace hold back to QC (Quality Control) test results.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Quality or safety holds are often brand‑specific; the link supports brand‑level hold tracking and impact analysis for marketing decisions.

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.recall_event. Business justification: Stock holds related to a recall should reference the recall event directly, consolidating recall information and eliminating the free‑text recall number.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier who provided the held inventory. Used for supplier quality management and return processing.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center where the held inventory is located.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the hold release or disposition was approved by the authorized authority.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Production batch identifier for the held inventory. Used in conjunction with lot number for granular traceability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hold record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposition decision was made and executed. Null if disposition is still pending.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
