attributes.description: Final decision on how to handle the held inventory. Release (approve for use), rework (reprocess), destroy (scrap), return to supplier, downgrade (sell as secondary), or pending (awaiting decision).

attributes.name: disposition_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the disposition decision, including justification and any special handling instructions.

attributes.name: expected_resolution_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the hold is expected to be resolved. Used for planning and escalation management.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-before date for the held inventory. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation and determining if held product is still usable.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for the held product. Standardized identifier used across the supply chain.

attributes.name: hold_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the inventory has been on hold. Calculated as the difference between current date (or release date) and hold start date. Used for aging analysis and KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the hold, used in quality management and warehouse operations. Format: HLD-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: hold_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for resolving the hold. Critical holds require immediate action (e.g., safety issues); low priority holds can be resolved in normal workflow.

attributes.name: hold_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory units placed on hold. Measured in the base unit of measure for the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit).

attributes.name: hold_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the hold quantity. EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific reason for the hold. Format: AAA-NNN. Examples: QCF-001 (failed inspection), REG-002 (FDA recall), DMG-005 (physical damage).

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the hold was placed, including specific quality defects, regulatory citations, or commercial issues.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: Date when the hold was released and inventory became available for disposition. Null if hold is still active.

attributes.name: hold_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the hold was released, including time zone. Used for calculating hold duration and compliance metrics.

attributes.name: hold_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the hold was placed on the inventory. This is the business event date when the stock became restricted.

attributes.name: hold_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the hold was initiated, including time zone. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hold. Active holds block inventory movement; released holds allow disposition; pending review awaits approval; escalated holds require management intervention.

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hold reason. Quality Control (QC) inspection hold, regulatory recall hold, commercial dispute hold, damage hold, quarantine hold, or investigation hold.

attributes.name: hold_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the inventory on hold, calculated at standard cost. Used for financial impact analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: hold_value_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the hold value amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP.

attributes.name: is_recall_related
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this hold is related to a product recall. True if the hold is part of a recall action; false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hold record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the inventory on hold. Critical for traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the held inventory was manufactured or produced. Used for shelf-life calculations and traceability.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether stakeholders (supply chain, sales, customers) have been notified of this hold. True if notifications sent; false otherwise.

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when stakeholder notifications were sent regarding this hold. Used for compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from regulatory authority (FDA, EPA, CPSC) if the hold is related to a regulatory action, recall, or investigation.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items on hold. Used for unit-level traceability in high-value or regulated products.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the product on hold. Links to product master data for item details.

attributes.name: warehouse_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, aisle, or zone location within the warehouse where the held inventory is stored. Format varies by WMS (Warehouse Management System).

products.name: recall_event
products.description: Master record for product recall and withdrawal events triggered by safety, quality, or regulatory findings. Captures recall classification (Class I/II/III FDA, voluntary withdrawal), affected SKUs, affected lot/batch ranges, recall scope (geographic, channel, customer), recall initiation date, regulatory notification date (FDA/CPSC), quantity recalled, quantity recovered, recall status, and financial impact estimate. Supports lot_batch traceability queries and regulatory reporting obligations.
products.reference: FDA Product Recall / CPSC Recall Classification

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product recall or withdrawal event. Primary key.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Regulatory recall notifications are issued per brand; linking recall_event to brand enables brand‑level recall management and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_recall. Business justification: Internal recall events must be tied to the external regulatory product recall record to align actions and reporting.

attributes.name: recall_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory recall processes assign a coordinator employee; tracking the employee ID is mandatory for audit trails and communication logs.

attributes.name: research_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_formulation. Business justification: Recall root‑cause analysis links the recalled SKU to the specific formulation that caused the issue, enabling targeted corrective actions.

attributes.name: affected_gtin_list
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) List
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GTIN/UPC/EAN codes for recalled products. Enables point-of-sale blocking and supply chain traceability across trading partners using GS1 standards.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications, EDI Transaction Standards

attributes.name: affected_lot_batch_range
attributes.description: Specification of the lot numbers, batch codes, or serial number ranges included in the recall. Critical for traceability and targeted recovery. May be expressed as ranges, lists, or patterns.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 (FSMA Traceability), GMP Batch Record Requirements

attributes.name: affected_product_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the product(s) subject to recall, including brand names, product names, sizes, formulations, and any distinguishing characteristics. Used for consumer identification.
attributes.references: GS1 Product Identification Standards, FDA Recall Communications

attributes.name: affected_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of SKU codes for all products included in the recall scope. Links to product master for detailed SKU attributes and enables inventory queries.
attributes.references: Internal SKU Master Data, GS1 GTIN Standards

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority officially closed the recall after reviewing effectiveness checks and final reports. Nullable until regulatory closure is granted.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7, CPSC Recall Closure Process

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all recall activities were completed, including product recovery, customer notification, and corrective actions. Nullable until recall is finished.

attributes.name: consumer_contact_method
attributes.description: Primary method(s) used to notify consumers about the recall. Press Release: public media announcement. Direct Mail: letters to registered consumers. Email: electronic notification. Phone: direct phone contact. Social Media: notification via social platforms. Retail Signage: point-of-sale notices. Multiple Methods: combination approach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Press Release|Direct Mail|Email|Phone|Social Media|Retail Signage|Multiple Methods — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Recall Communications Guidelines, FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) implemented to address the root cause and prevent recurrence. Includes process changes, equipment modifications, supplier changes, and quality system improvements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 CAPA Requirements, FDA QSR 21 CFR 820.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recall event record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements, Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: depth_of_recall
attributes.description: Level in the distribution chain to which the recall extends. Consumer Level: recall reaches end consumers. Retail Level: recall stops at retail stores. Wholesale Level: recall stops at wholesalers/distributors. Distribution Center: recall stops at company distribution centers before reaching trade.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact
attributes.description: Estimated total financial impact of the recall including product cost, logistics, customer credits, disposal, regulatory fines, and brand impact. Expressed in reporting currency. Used for financial reserves and management reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting, Internal Cost Accounting

attributes.name: expiration_date_range_end
attributes.description: Latest expiration or best-by date printed on recalled products. Defines the full date range for consumer identification.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Requirements, Consumer Product Identification

attributes.name: expiration_date_range_start
attributes.description: Earliest expiration or best-by date printed on recalled products. Helps consumers and retailers identify affected units on shelf.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Requirements, Consumer Product Identification

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated financial impact amount. Enables multi-currency recall cost tracking and consolidation.

attributes.name: health_hazard_evaluation
attributes.description: FDA or internal assessment of the health risk posed by the recalled product. Describes potential adverse health consequences and likelihood of occurrence. Used to determine recall classification.

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.description: Date when the recall was officially initiated by the company. This is the business event date when the decision to recall was made and communicated internally.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7, Internal Recall SOP

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recall event record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements, Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: manufacturing_date_range_end
attributes.description: Latest manufacturing date of products included in the recall scope. Defines the cutoff for affected production runs.
attributes.references: GMP Manufacturing Records, Batch Genealogy Standards

attributes.name: manufacturing_date_range_start
attributes.description: Earliest manufacturing date of products included in the recall scope. Used to identify affected inventory based on production timeline.
attributes.references: GMP Manufacturing Records, Batch Genealogy Standards

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority (FDA, CPSC, EPA, or other governing body) was formally notified of the recall event. Required for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.46, CPSC Section 15(b) Reporting

attributes.name: public_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when the recall was publicly announced through press release, FDA website posting, or other public communication channels.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Communications, FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_distributed
attributes.description: Total quantity of affected product that was distributed into the market prior to recall initiation. Expressed in base unit of measure (units, cases, kilograms). Represents the maximum potential recall scope.

attributes.name: quantity_recalled
attributes.description: Total quantity of product subject to the recall action. May differ from quantity distributed if recall scope is narrowed to specific lots, channels, or geographies.

attributes.name: quantity_recovered
attributes.description: Actual quantity of recalled product recovered from the market through returns, destructions, and corrections. Updated throughout recall lifecycle. Used to calculate recall effectiveness percentage.
attributes.references: Recall Effectiveness Checks, FDA Audit Trail

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields in this recall record. Ensures consistent interpretation of distributed, recalled, and recovered quantities.
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Standards, Internal UOM Master

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the specific defect, contamination, safety issue, or regulatory violation that triggered the recall. Includes root cause findings and quality investigation summary.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Strategy, Internal Quality Management System

attributes.name: recall_classification
attributes.description: FDA or regulatory classification of the recall severity. Class I: dangerous or defective products that could cause serious health problems or death. Class II: products that might cause temporary health problem or pose slight threat of serious nature. Class III: products unlikely to cause adverse health reaction but violate FDA labeling or manufacturing regulations. Voluntary Withdrawal: firm removes product from market not required by FDA. Market Withdrawal: minor violation not subject to legal action. Stock Recovery: correction of product still in distribution chain.
attributes.value_regex: Class I|Class II|Class III|Voluntary Withdrawal|Market Withdrawal|Stock Recovery
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7, CPSC Recall Handbook

attributes.name: recall_effectiveness_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated percentage of recalled product successfully recovered from the market. Formula: (quantity_recovered / quantity_recalled) * 100. FDA expects effectiveness checks at 2, 4, and 8 weeks. High effectiveness (>95%) supports recall closure.

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: External recall identification number assigned by the company or regulatory authority for tracking and communication purposes.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Enterprise System (RES), CPSC Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: recall_scope_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel(s) affected by the recall. Retail: products sold through retail stores. Wholesale: products in wholesale/distributor inventory. DTC: direct-to-consumer shipments. Food Service: products sold to restaurants/institutions. Healthcare: products distributed to healthcare facilities. All Channels: recall spans all distribution paths.
attributes.references: Internal Channel Management, Supply Chain Segmentation

attributes.name: recall_scope_customer_segment
attributes.description: Specific customer segments, account types, or customer groups affected by the recall. Used for targeted notification and recovery when recall does not affect all customers.
attributes.references: CRM Customer Segmentation, Account Management Standards

attributes.name: recall_scope_geographic
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the recall expressed as countries, states, regions, or distribution territories. Examples: USA nationwide, California only, EU markets, specific distribution centers. Supports targeted recovery and regulatory reporting by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Strategy, International Recall Coordination

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recall event. Initiated: recall has been declared and communication started. In Progress: active recovery and customer notification underway. Ongoing: recall activities continuing. Completed: all recall activities finished, awaiting final regulatory closure. Terminated: recall ended by firm decision. Closed: regulatory authority has reviewed and closed the recall.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Procedures, Internal Recall Management Process

attributes.name: recall_strategy
attributes.description: Documented strategy for executing the recall including communication plan, recovery method, depth of recall (consumer level, retail level, wholesale level), and timeline. Required by FDA 21 CFR 7.42.

attributes.name: recall_type
attributes.description: Primary reason category for the recall event. Safety: product poses health or safety risk. Quality: product fails quality specifications. Regulatory: non-compliance with regulations. Labeling: incorrect or missing label information. Contamination: presence of foreign material or microbial contamination. Allergen: undeclared allergen present.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Guidelines, ISO 22000, GMP Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority overseeing this recall. FDA: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. CPSC: Consumer Product Safety Commission. EPA: Environmental Protection Agency. EU REACH: European chemicals regulation. Health Canada: Canadian health authority. ANVISA: Brazilian health authority. TGA: Australian Therapeutic Goods Administration. MHRA: UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|CPSC|EPA|EU REACH|Health Canada|ANVISA|TGA|MHRA|Other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA, CPSC, EPA, International Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: regulatory_case_number
attributes.description: Official case or reference number assigned by the regulatory authority for tracking this recall in their system. Used for all regulatory correspondence and reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Enterprise System, CPSC Case Management

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the root cause investigation findings including failure mode, contributing factors, and systemic issues identified. Supports CAPA and regulatory reporting.

products.name: inventory_vmi_agreement
products.description: Master record defining Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) agreements between Consumer Goods and its retail/distributor customers. Captures VMI partner (retailer/distributor), covered SKUs, min/max stock levels at partner location, replenishment frequency, data sharing method (EDI, TradeEdge), service level commitment, VMI start date, VMI end date, and agreement status. Distinct from replenishment_order (the execution) — this is the governing policy for VMI-managed inventory relationships.

attributes.name: inventory_vmi_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Inventory Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) Agreement ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the VMI agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Consumer Goods employee responsible for managing this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific partner warehouse, distribution center, or retail location covered by this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: tertiary_inventory_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this VMI agreement record.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail or distributor partner participating in the VMI arrangement.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the VMI agreement for business reference.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or contract number for the VMI agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VMI agreement based on scope and strategic importance.

attributes.name: auto_replenishment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated replenishment orders are triggered based on inventory levels without manual approval.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which invoices are generated for inventory replenished under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMI agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for financial transactions under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: data_sharing_method
attributes.description: Technical method or platform used to exchange inventory visibility and replenishment data between Consumer Goods and the VMI partner.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: Specific EDI transaction set codes used for VMI data exchange (e.g., 846 Inventory Inquiry/Advice, 852 Product Activity Data).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the VMI agreement expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the VMI agreement becomes active and binding.

attributes.name: forecast_sharing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether demand forecast data is shared between Consumer Goods and the VMI partner for collaborative planning.

attributes.name: inventory_ownership
attributes.description: Defines who owns the inventory at the partner location until point of sale or consumption.

attributes.name: inventory_vmi_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VMI agreement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMI agreement record was last updated.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether lot or batch traceability is mandatory for inventory managed under this VMI agreement for recall readiness.

attributes.name: max_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum inventory quantity threshold at partner location to avoid overstocking.

attributes.name: min_stock_level
attributes.description: Minimum inventory quantity threshold at partner location that triggers replenishment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or operational notes related to the VMI agreement.

attributes.name: oos_penalty_clause
attributes.description: Description of financial or operational penalties applied if out-of-stock events occur at partner location.

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage for deliveries that meet both on-time and in-full criteria as defined in the VMI agreement.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Agreed payment terms for invoices related to VMI replenishment (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: pos_data_sharing_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Data Sharing Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether point-of-sale transaction data is shared by the partner to enable demand sensing and replenishment optimization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the VMI partner for operational communication.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary business contact at the VMI partner responsible for this agreement.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary business contact at the VMI partner for urgent escalations.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiration that renewal notice must be provided to continue the VMI agreement.

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which inventory replenishment occurs under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: replenishment_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required from replenishment trigger to delivery at partner location.

attributes.name: rotation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory rotation policy applied at partner location (FEFO = First Expired First Out, FIFO = First In First Out).

attributes.name: safety_stock_level
attributes.description: Buffer inventory quantity maintained to mitigate stockout risk due to demand variability or supply disruption.

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: Committed service level percentage for on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery under this VMI agreement.

attributes.name: stock_level_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all stock level thresholds (e.g., cases, pallets, eaches, kilograms).

attributes.name: target_stock_level
attributes.description: Optimal inventory quantity to maintain at partner location under normal conditions.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required to terminate the VMI agreement by either party.

products.name: stock_valuation
products.description: Transactional record of inventory valuation snapshots for each SKU-location combination, capturing standard cost, moving average price, total stock value, COGS allocation, inventory write-down amounts, and valuation method (standard cost, FIFO, weighted average). Aligned with material ledger postings in the financial system. Supports COGS reporting, days-inventory-outstanding calculation, and financial close processes. Distinct from stock_position (quantity) — this captures the monetary value dimension of inventory.
products.reference: SAP CO Material Ledger / Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: stock_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock valuation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Valuation reports allocate inventory value to cost centers for internal cost control.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Valuation entries are posted to GL accounts; linking enables automated posting and audit.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse, distribution center, or storage location where the inventory is held.

attributes.name: material_ledger_posting_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the corresponding material ledger posting in the financial system (SAP MM-FI integration reference).

attributes.name: product_lca_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.product_lca. Business justification: Enables sustainability‑aware valuation; incorporates LCA carbon footprint data into stock valuation calculations for ESG reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center based inventory valuation supports profitability analysis per business unit.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU being valued in this record.

attributes.name: actual_unit_cost
attributes.description: The actual cost per unit used for this valuation snapshot, determined by the selected valuation method.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch number for this inventory, used for quality control and traceability in manufacturing.

attributes.name: cogs_allocation_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Allocation Amount
attributes.description: The portion of inventory value allocated to COGS during the valuation period, representing goods sold or consumed.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity company code that owns this inventory for financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock valuation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the valuation amounts are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: days_inventory_outstanding
attributes.description: The average number of days inventory is held before being sold, calculated as (inventory value / COGS) × days in period.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the product should not be sold or used, critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation rules.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year to which this valuation record belongs (1-12).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this valuation record belongs, used for financial reporting and period-based analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_turnover_ratio
attributes.description: The number of times inventory is sold and replaced over the period, calculated as COGS divided by average inventory value.

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent goods issue or consumption transaction for this SKU-location combination.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent goods receipt transaction for this SKU-location combination, used for aging analysis.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing lot or batch number associated with this inventory position, critical for traceability and recall readiness.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock valuation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: moving_average_price
attributes.description: The continuously recalculated average cost per unit based on all goods receipts and invoice receipts, used for moving average valuation method.

attributes.name: net_realizable_value
attributes.description: The estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business less the estimated costs of completion and sale. Used to determine if write-down is required.

attributes.name: obsolete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory has been classified as obsolete and should be written down or disposed of.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or distribution center code where the inventory is physically located.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: The physical quantity of inventory units available at the location on the valuation date. Measured in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: revaluation_amount
attributes.description: The adjustment amount applied to inventory value due to cost changes, currency revaluation, or accounting policy changes.

attributes.name: safety_stock_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of safety stock (buffer inventory) maintained to prevent stockouts, calculated using safety stock quantity and unit cost.

attributes.name: slow_moving_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory is classified as slow-moving based on turnover thresholds, triggering potential write-down review.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The predetermined cost per unit set by the cost accounting team, used for standard costing valuation method.

attributes.name: total_stock_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of inventory at this location, calculated as quantity on hand multiplied by actual unit cost.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter).

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: The accounting classification code used to group materials for financial reporting and general ledger account determination.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this inventory valuation snapshot was taken. Typically aligned with financial period close dates.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to calculate inventory value: standard cost, moving average price, FIFO (First In First Out), weighted average, or LIFO (Last In First Out).

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: The current status of this valuation record in the financial close process: preliminary, final, adjusted, or closed.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The split valuation type used when a material is valuated separately (e.g., own production vs. external procurement, domestic vs. import).

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between standard cost and actual cost, representing price or quantity variances that impact inventory value.

attributes.name: write_down_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount by which inventory value has been reduced due to obsolescence, damage, or net realizable value adjustments.

attributes.name: write_down_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the inventory write-down: obsolescence, physical damage, expiration, market value decline, quality issue, or other.

products.name: stock_adjustment
products.description: Transactional record of manual and system-generated inventory adjustments that correct stock balances outside of normal goods movement flows. Captures adjustment reason (shrinkage, damage, system reconciliation, theft, sampling, promotional giveaway), adjusted quantity, adjusted value, adjustment date, approver, and supporting reference document. Distinct from stock_movement (which covers standard GR/GI flows) — adjustments represent exception corrections to the inventory ledger.
products.reference: SAP MM Inventory Adjustment / Physical Inventory Difference Posting

attributes.name: stock_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for stock_adjustment

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.company_code

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Adjustment postings must be charged to the correct cost center for variance analysis and budgeting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each inventory adjustment posts to a GL account; linking ensures accurate journal entry generation.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.inventory_storage_location

attributes.name: primary_stock_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who initiated or created the adjustment transaction in the system.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Financial adjustments are allocated to profit centers to reflect impact on segment P&L.

attributes.name: reversed_adjustment_stock_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original adjustment transaction that this record reverses, establishing the correction chain for audit purposes.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being adjusted.

attributes.name: tertiary_stock_posted_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who posted the adjustment to the inventory and financial ledgers.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center where the inventory adjustment occurred.

attributes.name: adjusted_quantity
attributes.description: Net quantity change applied to inventory (positive for additions, negative for reductions), measured in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: adjusted_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the inventory adjustment calculated as adjusted quantity multiplied by unit cost, impacting Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: Business date when the inventory adjustment was physically identified or when the correction event occurred, distinct from system posting date.

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique adjustment document number used for tracking and reference in operational systems and audit trails.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the specific reason for the inventory adjustment (e.g., SHRINK, DAMAGE, SAMPLE, PROMO, RECALL, OBSOLETE, RECOUNT).

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why the inventory adjustment was necessary, providing business context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the adjustment transaction indicating its approval and posting state in the inventory ledger.

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the adjustment transaction was created or recorded in the system.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the adjustment transaction indicating the nature of the inventory correction (physical count variance, shrinkage, damage, expiry, system reconciliation, theft).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the adjustment was formally approved by authorized personnel, required for audit trail and compliance.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number of the inventory being adjusted, critical for traceability and recall readiness per GMP requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the adjustment record was first created in the database, used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the adjusted value and unit cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-before date for the adjusted inventory batch, critical for First Expired First Out (FEFO) rotation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the adjustment record was last updated, tracking the most recent change for audit and version control.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code classifying the inventory transaction for goods movement and financial posting (e.g., 701 for goods issue, 702 for goods receipt).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual information about the adjustment that may be relevant for audit or operational review.

attributes.name: physical_count_quantity
attributes.description: Actual physical quantity counted during inventory verification, used to calculate the adjustment variance for cycle counts and physical inventories.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code representing the manufacturing or distribution facility where the inventory adjustment occurred.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Financial accounting date when the adjustment was posted to the inventory ledger and general ledger, used for period closing and financial reporting.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number supporting the adjustment (e.g., physical inventory document, cycle count sheet, damage report, quality inspection report).

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of supporting document referenced for the adjustment, providing audit trail and justification context. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physical_inventory|cycle_count|damage_report|quality_inspection|sampling_request|promotional_giveaway|recall_notice — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment is a reversal of a previous adjustment transaction, used for error correction and audit trails.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items requiring individual unit tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating special stock categories such as consignment, vendor-managed inventory (VMI), or customer-owned stock requiring separate tracking.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of inventory stock status indicating availability for use (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked, restricted, returns).

attributes.name: system_quantity_after
attributes.description: Resulting inventory quantity in the system after the adjustment has been posted, representing the corrected stock balance.

attributes.name: system_quantity_before
attributes.description: Inventory quantity recorded in the system before the adjustment was applied, used for variance analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard or moving average cost per unit of the inventory item at the time of adjustment, used for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the adjusted quantity (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, KG for kilogram, LT for liter).

products.name: reservation
products.description: Transactional record of inventory reservations that earmark specific stock quantities for confirmed sales orders, production orders, promotional commitments, or intercompany transfers. Captures reservation type (sales order, production, promotional, intercompany), reserved quantity, reserved lot/batch (if FEFO-specific), reservation date, expiry date of reservation, fulfillment status, and consuming document reference. Prevents double-allocation of available stock across competing demand streams.

attributes.name: reservation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for reservation

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Reservation creation is performed by an employee; capturing the employee ID supports auditability and performance metrics.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse storage location where the reserved inventory is physically held.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center, warehouse, or manufacturing facility holding the reserved inventory.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order consuming this reserved material. Populated when reservation_type is production_order.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion or promotional campaign for which inventory is reserved. Populated when reservation_type is promotional.

attributes.name: reservation_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order document that triggered this reservation. Populated when reservation_type is sales_order.

attributes.name: reservation_transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the intercompany or inter-facility transfer order. Populated when reservation_type is intercompany_transfer.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for which inventory is reserved.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom inventory is reserved, typically linked through the sales order.

attributes.name: allocation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory allocation rule applied to this reservation: First Expired First Out (FEFO), First In First Out (FIFO), Last In First Out (LIFO), specific lot assignment, or customer priority-based.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch number associated with the reserved inventory for production traceability and quality control.

attributes.name: blocked_date
attributes.description: Date when the reservation was placed on hold or blocked from fulfillment.

attributes.name: blocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation is temporarily blocked from fulfillment due to quality hold, credit hold, or other business constraints.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the reservation is blocked, such as quality inspection pending, credit limit exceeded, or regulatory hold.

attributes.name: committed_to_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reservation represents a firm commitment to a customer with contractual On Time In Full (OTIF) obligations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the reservation automatically expires if not fulfilled, releasing the reserved stock back to available inventory.

attributes.name: fulfilled_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the reservation that has been fulfilled through goods issue or consumption. Measured in the product's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Planned method for fulfilling this reservation: warehouse pick and pack, Direct Store Delivery (DSD), cross-dock transfer, or drop-ship from supplier.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that last updated the reservation record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Specific lot or batch number reserved for First Expired First Out (FEFO) compliance and traceability. Critical for recall readiness and expiry management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GS1 Lot/Batch Traceability

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions related to the reservation, such as handling requirements, customer requests, or allocation exceptions.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this reservation for allocation decisions when inventory is constrained. Critical reservations are protected first.

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the reserved inventory must be available for fulfillment or consumption to meet downstream commitments.

attributes.name: reservation_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory reservation was created and stock was earmarked for this demand.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reservation number used for tracking and reference across systems and documents.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reservation indicating whether it is active, partially fulfilled, fully fulfilled, cancelled, or expired.

attributes.name: reservation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reservation purpose: sales order fulfillment, production consumption, promotional commitment, intercompany transfer, quality hold, or safety stock allocation.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory units reserved and earmarked for this specific demand. Measured in the product's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items reserved at the individual unit level.

attributes.name: source_document
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the originating business document that triggered the reservation (order number, forecast ID, promotion code).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application that created the reservation (e.g., SAP ERP, Salesforce, EDI, IBP).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the reserved quantity (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, KG for kilogram).

attributes.name: vmi_replenishment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reservation is part of a Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) replenishment program where the supplier manages customer inventory levels.

domains.name: research
domains.description: Owns research and development, innovation pipeline, and NPD data. Manages R&D project portfolios, formulation development records, lab testing, clinical/consumer test results, prototype development, patent filings, INCI ingredient libraries, sensory evaluation, regulatory dossiers, and stage-gate milestone tracking for new product launches from concept to commercialization.

products.name: rd_project
products.description: Master record for all R&D and NPD projects in the innovation pipeline, from initial business opportunity through commercialization. Captures project identity, innovation brief details (target consumer, desired benefits, cost/RSP targets, competitive benchmarks, strategic fit rationale, key performance indicators), stage-gate phase, project type (new product, reformulation, line extension, cost optimization), target launch date, project sponsor, brand alignment, strategic priority tier, budget allocation, resource assignment, current milestone status, and the originating business opportunity context. Serves as the backbone of the R&D portfolio management function and links all downstream formulation, testing, regulatory, and scale-up activities. Subsumes the innovation brief as the project inception record.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the R&D or NPD project in the innovation pipeline.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: ESG commitments drive R&D project prioritisation and reporting; linking enables project‑level ESG tracking in project portfolio dashboards.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand under which this product will be launched, linking to the brand master.

attributes.name: primary_rd_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the executive or business leader sponsoring this R&D project, linking to the employee or workforce master.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category or segment this project targets, linking to the product taxonomy.

attributes.name: product_lca_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.product_lca. Business justification: R&D projects generate product LCA studies; linking the LCA record to its originating project enables regulatory filing and market‑entry sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: rd_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the project manager or R&D lead responsible for day-to-day execution of this project.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.consumer_segment. Business justification: Project planning uses a defined consumer segment; FK enables segment‑level reporting and budget alignment.

attributes.name: actual_launch_date
attributes.description: Actual date the product was launched commercially, if the project has reached commercialization.

attributes.name: budget_allocated
attributes.description: Total budget allocated to this R&D project for all phases, including formulation, testing, regulatory, and scale-up activities.

attributes.name: budget_spent

products.name: stage_gate_milestone
products.description: Tracks each formal stage-gate review milestone within an R&D project lifecycle. Records gate number (G0 concept through G5 launch), gate decision (go/kill/hold/recycle), review date, gate owner, decision rationale, deliverables checklist completion status, and next gate target date. Enables portfolio governance and NPD pipeline velocity tracking across all active projects.

attributes.name: stage_gate_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stage gate milestone record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_stage_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the executive or senior leader responsible for chairing the gate review and making the final gate decision.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the R&D project to which this stage gate milestone belongs.

attributes.name: tertiary_stage_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who last modified this stage gate milestone record, used for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: action_items
attributes.description: Summary of key action items, conditions, and follow-up tasks assigned during the gate review that must be completed before proceeding or for the next gate.

attributes.name: consumer_acceptance_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score from consumer testing and sensory evaluation reflecting target consumer acceptance, purchase intent, and preference versus competitive products.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stage gate milestone record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the business reasoning, risk assessment, and strategic considerations that led to the gate decision outcome.

attributes.name: delay_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the root cause for any delay in the gate review milestone, such as incomplete deliverables, resource constraints, technical challenges, or regulatory issues.

attributes.name: deliverables_checklist_status
attributes.description: Overall completion status of the mandatory deliverables checklist required for this gate. Complete indicates all deliverables met, incomplete indicates gaps, partial indicates some deliverables met.

attributes.name: deliverables_completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of mandatory gate deliverables that have been completed and approved at the time of review, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: gate_attendees
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of names or identifiers of executives and stakeholders who attended the gate review meeting.

attributes.name: gate_criteria_met_count
attributes.description: Number of mandatory gate criteria that were successfully met and approved during the review process.

attributes.name: gate_criteria_total_count
attributes.description: Total number of mandatory gate criteria defined for this stage gate review, used to calculate criteria fulfillment rate.

attributes.name: gate_decision
attributes.description: The formal decision outcome of the stage gate review. Go indicates approval to proceed to next stage, kill terminates the project, hold pauses for additional information, recycle returns to previous stage for rework.

attributes.name: gate_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the previous gate review date and this gate review date, used to track stage cycle time and NPD velocity.

attributes.name: gate_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the stage gate milestone (e.g., Concept Review, Business Case Approval, Launch Readiness).

attributes.name: gate_number
attributes.description: The formal stage gate identifier in the NPD (New Product Development) process. G0 represents concept ideation, G1 scoping, G2 business case, G3 development, G4 testing and validation, G5 launch.

attributes.name: gate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stage gate milestone. Scheduled indicates future gate, in_review indicates active review in progress, completed indicates decision made, cancelled indicates gate no longer required.

attributes.name: investment_approved_amount
attributes.description: The financial investment amount approved by the gate review committee to fund activities in the next stage of the project, expressed in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: investment_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the approved investment amount.

attributes.name: is_milestone_delayed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this gate milestone was delayed beyond its originally scheduled review date. True indicates delay occurred, False indicates on-time or early completion.

attributes.name: market_attractiveness_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score reflecting the commercial attractiveness of the target market, considering market size, growth rate, competitive intensity, and strategic fit.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stage gate milestone record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_gate_target_date
attributes.description: The planned target date for the next stage gate review milestone in the project lifecycle, used for forward planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: npv_estimate
attributes.description: The estimated net present value of the project calculated at this gate, used for portfolio prioritization and go/kill decision making.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the project's compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (FDA, EPA, REACH, etc.) at this gate. Compliant indicates all requirements met, non_compliant indicates gaps, pending_review indicates assessment in progress.
attributes.references: FDA Regulations, EU REACH Regulation, ISO 22716

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal stage gate review meeting was conducted and the gate decision was made.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assigned during the gate review, reflecting technical, commercial, regulatory, and operational risks associated with proceeding to the next stage.

attributes.name: roi_estimate_percentage
attributes.description: The estimated return on investment percentage for the project at this gate, calculated as expected return divided by investment cost.

attributes.name: scheduled_review_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for the stage gate review, used to track schedule adherence and milestone slippage.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score reflecting the environmental and social sustainability profile of the project, considering carbon footprint, sustainable sourcing, packaging recyclability, and social impact.

attributes.name: technical_feasibility_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score assessing the technical feasibility of the project, considering R&D capability, technology maturity, formulation complexity, and manufacturing readiness.

products.name: research_formulation
products.description: Master record for product formulations developed in R&D labs. Captures formulation code, version number, formulation name, product category, formulation type (leave-on, rinse-off, solid, liquid, aerosol), development status (experimental, prototype, pilot, approved), target viscosity, pH range, shelf-life target, and the R&D project it belongs to. Serves as the SSOT for all formulation development records across the CPG/FMCG portfolio.

attributes.name: research_formulation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product formulation record. Primary key for the research formulation entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the principal scientist or formulation chemist responsible for developing this formulation.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this formulation to the parent R&D project portfolio. Enables tracking of formulations within broader innovation initiatives.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.consumer_segment. Business justification: Formulation development targets a specific consumer segment; linking ensures alignment with market research insights.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: List of known allergens present in the formulation requiring declaration per regulatory requirements (e.g., EU Allergen List).

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the formulation received final approval for commercialization from the stage-gate review committee.

attributes.name: batch_size_kg
attributes.description: Standard production batch size in kilograms for manufacturing scale-up planning. Based on pilot plant or commercial production capacity.

attributes.name: claim_support_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation requires clinical or consumer testing to substantiate marketing claims (e.g., anti-aging, moisturizing efficacy).

attributes.name: consumer_test_score
attributes.description: Average consumer acceptance score from home-use testing or clinical trials. Scale typically 0-10 or 0-100 depending on protocol.

attributes.name: cooling_rate_celsius_per_min
attributes.description: Controlled cooling rate in degrees Celsius per minute after mixing. Important for emulsion stability and crystal formation control.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost target (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cost_target_per_unit
attributes.description: Target manufacturing cost per unit for the formulation. Used for feasibility assessment and margin analysis during NPD.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the formulation record was first created in the R&D system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: cruelty_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation and its ingredients have not been tested on animals, meeting cruelty-free certification standards.

attributes.name: development_status
attributes.description: Current stage of the formulation in the R&D lifecycle. Tracks progression through stage-gate process from ideation to commercialization approval. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|experimental|prototype|pilot|validation|approved|discontinued|on_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: discontinued_date
attributes.description: Date when the formulation was discontinued or archived. Null if still active in the development pipeline.

attributes.name: formulation_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier assigned to the formulation in the R&D system. Used for cross-referencing across lab notebooks, pilot batches, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: formulation_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the formulation including intended use, key benefits, and distinguishing characteristics. Used for internal documentation and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: formulation_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the formulation assigned by the R&D team. May include project codename or working title.

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Physical form and application method of the formulation. Critical for manufacturing process design and packaging selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: leave_on|rinse_off|solid|liquid|aerosol|gel|cream|powder|emulsion|suspension — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fragrance_type
attributes.description: Classification of fragrance used in the formulation. Important for allergen labeling and consumer preference targeting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the formulation record. Tracks version history and change management.

attributes.name: microbiological_challenge_test_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation passed preservative efficacy testing (challenge test) demonstrating adequate antimicrobial protection.

attributes.name: mixing_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Optimal mixing temperature in degrees Celsius for formulation processing. Affects ingredient solubility and stability.

attributes.name: mixing_time_minutes
attributes.description: Required mixing duration in minutes to achieve homogeneous formulation. Critical process parameter for manufacturing instructions.

attributes.name: natural_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ingredients derived from natural sources per ISO 16128 standard. Used for natural/organic product claims.

attributes.name: patent_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a patent application has been filed for this formulation or its novel components.

attributes.name: patent_number
attributes.description: Patent application or grant number if applicable. Confidential intellectual property reference.

attributes.name: preservative_system
attributes.description: Description of the antimicrobial preservative system used in the formulation. Critical for microbial stability and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level product category classification for the formulation. Aligns with the company's product portfolio segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: skin_care|hair_care|oral_care|personal_hygiene|household_cleaning|baby_care|cosmetics|fragrance|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory category classification for the formulation. Determines applicable compliance requirements and approval pathways.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21, EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009

attributes.name: safety_assessment_status
attributes.description: Status of toxicological safety assessment and risk evaluation for the formulation. Required for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: sensory_evaluation_score
attributes.description: Composite score from trained panel sensory evaluation assessing appearance, texture, fragrance, and application properties. Scale typically 0-10.

attributes.name: shelf_life_target_months
attributes.description: Target shelf life duration in months from manufacturing date. Based on stability testing and regulatory requirements for the product category.

attributes.name: stability_test_status
attributes.description: Current status of accelerated and real-time stability testing program for the formulation. Required for shelf-life validation.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Composite sustainability rating for the formulation based on ingredient sourcing, biodegradability, and environmental impact. Scale typically 0-100.

attributes.name: target_consumer_segment
attributes.description: Intended consumer demographic or market segment for the formulation (e.g., sensitive skin, anti-aging, professional use, mass market).

attributes.name: target_ph_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable pH value for the formulation. Defines upper bound of acceptable pH range for quality control.

attributes.name: target_ph_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable pH value for the formulation. Critical for product stability, efficacy, and skin compatibility.

attributes.name: target_viscosity_cps
attributes.description: Target viscosity measurement in centipoise (cps) for the formulation. Critical quality parameter for product consistency and manufacturing processability.

attributes.name: vegan_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation contains no animal-derived ingredients and meets vegan certification criteria.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the formulation following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented with each iteration or modification during development.

products.name: research_formulation_ingredient
products.description: Line-level record of each ingredient within a formulation, representing the formulation bill of materials (BOM). Captures INCI name, trade name, supplier code, concentration percentage (min/max/target), function class (emulsifier, preservative, fragrance, active, colorant), raw material reference, inclusion basis (w/w, w/v), and regulatory restriction flags per jurisdiction (EU, US FDA, ASEAN). attributes.name: research_formulation_ingredient_id

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.description: Reference to the parent formulation record. Links this ingredient line to the overall formulation BOM.

attributes.name: raw_material_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.raw_material_spec. Business justification: Each formulation ingredient references a raw material; linking to raw_material_spec centralises material data and removes duplicated raw_material_code and supplier_code.

attributes.name: addition_order

attributes.name: allergen_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is subject to restrictions or prohibitions under ASEAN cosmetic regulations. True if restricted or prohibited.

attributes.name: cas_number

attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: cost_per_kg
attributes.description: Standard cost per kilogram for the ingredient. Used for formulation cost analysis and NPD financial modeling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: einecs_number

attributes.name: eu_maximum_concentration_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration percentage for this ingredient under EU regulations. Null if no EU-specific restriction applies.

attributes.name: eu_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is subject to restrictions or prohibitions under EU cosmetics regulations. True if restricted or prohibited.

attributes.name: function_class
attributes.description: Functional classification of the ingredient within the formulation (e.g., emulsifier, preservative, fragrance, active, colorant). attributes.name: inci_name

attributes.name: inclusion_basis
attributes.description: Unit basis for ingredient concentration measurement (w/w = weight/weight, w/v = weight/volume, v/v = volume/volume, ppm = parts per million, ppb = parts per billion). Critical for accurate formulation and manufacturing.

attributes.name: ingredient_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of ingredients within the formulation BOM. Used for manufacturing process order and documentation.

attributes.name: ingredient_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ingredient within the formulation. Tracks approval state and usability for manufacturing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ingredient line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: maximum_concentration_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration percentage for the ingredient. Defines upper bound for manufacturing tolerance and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: minimum_concentration_percent
attributes.description: Minimum allowable concentration percentage for the ingredient. Defines lower bound for manufacturing tolerance and quality control.

attributes.name: natural_origin_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is derived from natural sources. Used for natural and organic product claims and certifications.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special handling instructions, formulation rationale, or regulatory considerations for this ingredient.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag

attributes.name: palm_oil_derivative_flag

attributes.name: us_fda_maximum_concentration_percent

attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration percentage for this ingredient under US FDA regulations. Null if no FDA-specific restriction applies.

attributes.name: us_fda_restricted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) Restricted Ingredient Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is subject to restrictions or prohibitions under US FDA regulations. True if restricted or prohibited.

attributes.name: vegan_flag

products.name: inci_library

attributes.name: inci_library_id

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: allergen_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient is a known or potential allergen requiring special labeling or formulation considerations. True indicates allergen status.

attributes.name: approved_concentration_max_percentage
