products.name: sensory_evaluation
products.description: Records formal sensory panel evaluations of product prototypes and formulations. Captures panel type (trained expert panel, consumer panel, QC panel), evaluation date, product sample code, sensory attributes assessed (color, odor, texture, spreadability, rinse-off feel, after-feel), scoring methodology (QDA, hedonic scale, JAR scale), panelist count, and overall sensory profile outcome. Sensory evaluation is a distinct R&D sub-function with its own workflow and data structure.

attributes.name: sensory_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sensory evaluation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: panel_session_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific panel session, used to group multiple evaluations conducted in the same session.

attributes.name: primary_sensory_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sensory scientist or lead evaluator responsible for conducting and overseeing the evaluation session.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project under which this sensory evaluation was conducted.

attributes.name: after_feel_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the after-feel attribute, measuring the sensation after product use (e.g., moisturization, residue, stickiness).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the sensory evaluation results: pending review (awaiting review by R&D leadership), approved (results accepted for decision-making), rejected (results deemed invalid), or requires retest (evaluation must be repeated).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation results were formally approved.

attributes.name: attributes_assessed
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sensory attributes evaluated during the session (e.g., color, odor, texture, spreadability, rinse-off feel, after-feel, viscosity, foam quality, fragrance intensity).

attributes.name: benchmark_product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the benchmark or competitive product used for comparison in the evaluation, if applicable.

attributes.name: blinding_method
attributes.description: Method used to prevent bias: single-blind (panelists do not know product identity), double-blind (neither panelists nor administrators know), or open-label (product identity known).
attributes.references: ISO 8588 Sensory Analysis - Methodology - A and Not-A Test

attributes.name: color_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the color attribute, typically on a scale defined by the evaluation methodology (e.g., 1-9 scale).

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation session was completed and results finalized.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level of the evaluation results, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95% confidence).
attributes.references: ISO 11136 Sensory Analysis - Methodology - General Guidance for Conducting Hedonic Tests with Consumers

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score assessing the reliability and validity of the evaluation data, based on factors such as panelist consistency, response completeness, and adherence to protocol.

attributes.name: evaluation_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the sensory evaluation session, typically formatted as SE-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sensory evaluation panel session was conducted.

attributes.name: evaluation_methodology
attributes.description: Sensory testing methodology used: QDA (Quantitative Descriptive Analysis), hedonic scale (liking/preference), JAR scale (Just About Right), duo-trio test, triangle test, ranking, or descriptive analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: qda|hedonic_scale|jar_scale|duo_trio|triangle_test|ranking|descriptive_analysis|paired_comparison|acceptance_test|discrimination_test — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 13299 Sensory Analysis - Methodology - General Guidance for Establishing a Sensory Profile

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing qualitative observations, panelist comments, unexpected findings, or contextual information from the evaluation session.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the sensory evaluation: scheduled (planned but not started), in progress (currently being conducted), completed (finished and results recorded), cancelled (not conducted), or on hold (temporarily paused).

attributes.name: formulation_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the product formulation being tested, used to track iterations and changes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: odor_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the odor/fragrance attribute.

attributes.name: overall_liking_score
attributes.description: Overall hedonic score representing panelists' overall liking or preference for the product sample.

attributes.name: panel_type
attributes.description: Type of sensory panel used for the evaluation: trained expert panel (highly trained sensory experts), consumer panel (target consumers), QC panel (quality control team), internal panel (company employees), or external panel (third-party evaluators).
attributes.references: ISO 8586 Sensory Analysis - General Guidelines for the Selection, Training and Monitoring of Selected Assessors and Expert Sensory Assessors

attributes.name: panelist_count
attributes.description: Number of panelists who participated in this sensory evaluation session.
attributes.references: ISO 8586 Sensory Analysis - General Guidelines for the Selection, Training and Monitoring of Assessors

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Category of the product being evaluated (e.g., skincare, haircare, oral care, household cleaning).

attributes.name: product_sample_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the product prototype or formulation sample being evaluated. May be blinded to prevent bias.

attributes.name: purchase_intent_score
attributes.description: Score indicating panelists' likelihood to purchase the product, typically measured on a scale (e.g., 1-5 or 1-9).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sensory evaluation was conducted in compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines (e.g., FDA, EU cosmetics regulations, GMP).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 58 Good Laboratory Practice, ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: rinse_off_feel_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the rinse-off feel attribute, relevant for products that are washed off (e.g., shampoos, body washes).

attributes.name: sensory_profile_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome classification of the sensory evaluation: acceptable (meets standards), unacceptable (fails standards), needs improvement (requires reformulation), exceeds expectations (superior performance), or benchmark equivalent (matches competitive standard).

attributes.name: spreadability_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the spreadability attribute, measuring ease of application.

attributes.name: statistical_significance
attributes.description: Indication of whether the evaluation results are statistically significant based on predefined confidence levels (e.g., p<0.05).
attributes.references: ISO 11132 Sensory Analysis - Methodology - Guidelines for Monitoring the Performance of a Quantitative Sensory Panel

attributes.name: test_conditions
attributes.description: Description of environmental and procedural conditions under which the evaluation was conducted (e.g., temperature, lighting, sample presentation order).
attributes.references: ISO 8589 Sensory Analysis - General Guidance for the Design of Test Rooms

attributes.name: test_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where the sensory evaluation was conducted (e.g., central lab, regional facility, third-party lab).

attributes.name: texture_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the texture attribute (e.g., smoothness, creaminess, grittiness).

products.name: prototype
products.description: Master record for physical product prototypes developed during the NPD process, including associated packaging component specifications. Captures prototype code, prototype generation (P1, P2, P3), associated formulation version, packaging configuration with component-level detail (component type, material type — HDPE, PET, glass, aluminum, paperboard — dimensions, weight, closure type, decoration method, compatibility test status with formulation, recyclability classification), fill weight/volume, manufacturing scale (bench, pilot, scale-up), prototype creation date, prototype status (active, superseded, approved for consumer test), R&D packaging approval status, and the R&D project it belongs to. Prototypes are distinct from formulations — they represent the physical product iteration including packaging.

attributes.name: prototype_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical product prototype. Primary key.

attributes.name: packaging_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_profile. Business justification: Prototype packaging decisions require reference to a packaging profile for LCA, recyclability and carbon‑footprint data; link supports sustainability assessment during prototype validation.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulation version used in this prototype. Links the physical prototype to its chemical/ingredient composition.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project under which this prototype was developed.

attributes.name: superseded_by_prototype_id

attributes.name: closure_type

attributes.name: container_height_mm

attributes.name: container_weight_grams

attributes.name: decoration_method

attributes.name: estimated_packaging_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of the packaging configuration per unit, including all components and decoration. Used for target COGS analysis.

attributes.name: fill_volume_ml

attributes.name: manufacturing_scale

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: packaging_approval_date

attributes.name: prototype_status

products.name: patent_filing
products.description: Master record for patent applications and granted patents arising from R&D innovation activities. Captures patent application number, patent title, filing date, jurisdiction (US, EU, JP, CN, global PCT), patent type (utility, design, composition of matter, process), inventors list, assignee, prosecution status (filed, published, granted, abandoned, expired), grant date, expiry date, and linked R&D project or formulation. Supports IP portfolio management and freedom-to-operate analysis.

attributes.name: patent_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patent filing record. Primary key for the patent filing entity.

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking related patent applications filed in multiple jurisdictions claiming the same priority. Used to track global patent family coverage.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Family Standards, EPO INPADOC Patent Family

attributes.name: primary_patent_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this patent filing record in the system. Used for audit trail and data stewardship accountability.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific formulation or composition of matter that is the subject of this patent filing. Links patent to the proprietary formula being protected.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project that generated this patent filing. Links the patent to the originating innovation initiative.

attributes.name: abstract
attributes.description: Brief technical summary of the invention as filed with the patent office. Typically 150-250 words describing the problem solved, the solution, and key technical features.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) Rule 8, USPTO Patent Abstract Requirements

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Official application number assigned by the patent office upon filing. Unique identifier used for tracking prosecution status with the patent authority.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Application Standards, USPTO Patent Application Numbering

attributes.name: assignee_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the assignee's country of incorporation or residence. Used for IP portfolio geographic analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|GBR|DEU|FRA|JPN|CHN|KOR|CAN|AUS|BRA|IND|MEX — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignee_name
attributes.description: Legal entity that owns the patent rights, typically the employer of the inventors. For Consumer Goods patents, this is usually the company name or a subsidiary.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Assignment Standards, WIPO Patent Ownership Guidelines

attributes.name: backward_citations_count
attributes.description: Number of prior art patents and publications cited by this patent application. Indicates the breadth of prior art landscape and novelty assessment complexity.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Citation Analysis, WIPO Patent Analytics

attributes.name: claims_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims in the patent application. Claims define the legal scope of protection. Higher claim counts typically indicate broader or more complex inventions.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Claims Standards, WIPO Patent Drafting Guidelines

attributes.name: commercial_value_tier
attributes.description: Internal assessment of the patent's commercial importance to the business. Strategic patents protect core technologies or blockbuster products. High-value patents have clear revenue impact. Low-value or exploratory patents may be defensive or speculative.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated annual maintenance cost. Typically USD for global IP portfolio reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|KRW|CAD|AUD|BRL|INR|MXN — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cpc_class
attributes.description: Primary CPC classification code. CPC is a joint classification system developed by EPO and USPTO, providing more granular technology classification than IPC.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent filing record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_maintenance_cost
attributes.description: Projected annual cost to maintain the patent in force, including official fees, agent fees, and translation costs across all jurisdictions. Used for IP portfolio cost-benefit analysis.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date the patent protection expires, typically 20 years from filing date for utility patents. After this date, the invention enters the public domain.
attributes.references: WIPO TRIPS Agreement Article 33, USPTO 35 U.S.C. 154

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date the patent application was officially filed with the patent office. Establishes priority date for novelty and non-obviousness assessment.

attributes.name: forward_citations_count
attributes.description: Number of times this patent has been cited by subsequent patent applications. High forward citation count indicates influential or foundational technology.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Citation Analysis, WIPO Patent Analytics

attributes.name: freedom_to_operate_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the patented technology can be commercialized without infringing third-party patents. Cleared indicates no blocking patents found. Risk identified or blocked indicates potential infringement issues requiring licensing or design-around.

attributes.name: grant_date
attributes.description: Date the patent was officially granted by the patent office. Marks the beginning of enforceable patent rights. Null if patent has not yet been granted.
attributes.references: USPTO 35 U.S.C. 151, WIPO Patent Grant Standards

attributes.name: independent_claims_count
attributes.description: Number of independent claims in the patent. Independent claims stand alone and define the broadest scope of protection. Typically 1-5 independent claims per patent.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Claims Standards, WIPO Patent Drafting Guidelines

attributes.name: internal_reference_code
attributes.description: Company-specific internal tracking code or docket number for the patent filing. Used for cross-referencing with R&D project records and financial systems.

attributes.name: inventors_list
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of inventors named on the patent application. Inventors are the individuals who conceived the invention. Format: LastName, FirstName; LastName, FirstName.
attributes.references: USPTO 35 U.S.C. 115, WIPO Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) Rule 4.1

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two or three-letter code identifying the patent office jurisdiction where the patent was filed. US=United States, EP=European Patent Office, JP=Japan, CN=China, KR=South Korea, CA=Canada, AU=Australia, BR=Brazil, IN=India, MX=Mexico, RU=Russia, ZA=South Africa, PCT=Patent Cooperation Treaty (international application). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US|EP|JP|CN|KR|CA|AU|BR|IN|MX|RU|ZA|PCT — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WIPO ST.3 Standard (Two-Letter Codes), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

attributes.name: legal_status
attributes.description: Current legal standing of the granted patent. Active indicates patent is in force and enforceable. Lapsed indicates failure to pay maintenance fees. Revoked or invalidated indicates patent rights have been terminated by legal action.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Legal Status Standards, USPTO Patent Maintenance

attributes.name: licensing_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patent is subject to licensing agreements. Licensed out means the company has granted rights to third parties. Licensed in means the company has acquired rights from others. Cross-licensed indicates mutual licensing with another party.
attributes.value_regex: not licensed|licensed out|licensed in|cross-licensed|available for licensing

attributes.name: maintenance_fee_due_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled date for payment of patent maintenance or renewal fees to keep the patent in force. Failure to pay results in patent lapse. Applicable only to granted patents in jurisdictions requiring periodic fees.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Maintenance Fee Schedule, EPO Renewal Fee Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent filing record was last updated in the system. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: patent_attorney_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external law firm or patent agent representing the company for this patent filing. Used for managing outside counsel relationships and costs.

attributes.name: patent_number
attributes.description: Official patent number assigned upon grant by the patent office. Null until patent is granted. Used for citation and enforcement purposes.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Numbering Standards, USPTO Patent Numbering

attributes.name: patent_title
attributes.description: Official title of the patent as filed with the patent office. Describes the invention in concise legal language.

attributes.name: patent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the patent by legal type. Utility patents cover functional inventions, design patents cover ornamental designs, composition of matter covers chemical formulations, process covers manufacturing methods, plant covers new plant varieties, and reissue covers corrections to previously granted patents.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Classification System, WIPO International Patent Classification (IPC)

attributes.name: pct_application_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing was made under the Patent Cooperation Treaty, which allows a single international application to seek protection in multiple countries simultaneously.

attributes.name: pct_application_number
attributes.description: PCT international application number if this filing was made under PCT. Format: PCT/CC/YYYY/NNNNNN where CC is country code, YYYY is year, NNNNNN is serial number.

attributes.name: primary_ipc_class
attributes.description: Primary IPC classification code assigned to the patent. IPC is a hierarchical system for classifying patents by technology area. Format: Section-Class-Subclass-Group (e.g., A61K-008/00 for cosmetic preparations).

attributes.name: priority_date
attributes.description: Earliest filing date claimed for priority purposes, typically from a provisional application or foreign filing. Used to establish prior art cutoff date.
attributes.references: WIPO Paris Convention Article 4, USPTO 35 U.S.C. 119

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Consumer goods product category that the patented invention applies to. Aligns with business product portfolio structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: skincare|haircare|oral care|personal hygiene|household cleaning|laundry|baby care|cosmetics|fragrances|wellness — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Product Category Taxonomy, GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC)

attributes.name: prosecution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the patent application in the prosecution process. Tracks the lifecycle from drafting through grant or abandonment. Office action pending indicates examiner has issued objections requiring response. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|published|under examination|office action pending|allowed|granted|abandoned|expired|withdrawn — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Prosecution Standards, WIPO Patent Prosecution Guidelines

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date the patent application was published by the patent office, typically 18 months after filing. Makes the invention publicly disclosed.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) Article 21, USPTO 35 U.S.C. 122

attributes.name: secondary_ipc_classes
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of additional IPC classification codes applicable to the patent. Used when invention spans multiple technology domains.

attributes.name: technology_domain
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the patent's technology area within consumer goods. Used for portfolio management and strategic IP planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: formulation|packaging|manufacturing process|delivery system|ingredient|fragrance|preservation|sustainability|biotechnology — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: claim_substantiation

Captures claim text (e.g., '48-hour moisturization', 'clinically proven', 'dermatologist tested'), claim type (efficacy, safety, environmental, comparative), substantiation method (clinical study, consumer test, instrumental measurement, expert endorsement), supporting study references, claim approval status, legal review sign-off, market applicability, and expiry/renewal date. Bridges R&D evidence to marketing claim usage and ensures claims are defensible under advertising standards (NAD, ASA) and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: raw_material_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the raw material specification record. Primary key for R&D-owned technical specifications governing formulation use.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the R&D scientist or manager who approved this raw material specification.

attributes.name: inci_library_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.inci_library. Business justification: Raw material specifications share many attributes with the INCI library; linking consolidates ingredient master data and eliminates duplicated INCI fields.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the raw material specification was approved by R&D for use in formulations.

attributes.name: approved_concentration_max_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration of this raw material in formulations as approved by R&D and regulatory for safety and compliance.

attributes.name: approved_concentration_min_percent
attributes.description: Minimum allowable concentration of this raw material in formulations as approved by R&D for efficacy and safety.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per kilogram (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cost_per_kg
attributes.description: Standard cost of the raw material per kilogram for R&D costing and formulation budget estimation. Used for target COGS calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the raw material specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: einecs_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Inventory of Existing Commercial Chemical Substances (EINECS) Number
attributes.description: European regulatory identifier for chemical substances marketed in the EU before September 1981. Required for EU REACH compliance.

attributes.name: eu_maximum_concentration_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration of this raw material in finished products as mandated by EU regulations. Null if no EU restriction applies.

attributes.name: eu_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material is subject to restrictions or prohibitions under EU cosmetics regulations.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes for the raw material indicating physical, health, and environmental hazards (e.g., H302, H315, H317). Used for SDS and safety compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the raw material specification record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: material_name
attributes.description: Common or trade name of the raw material as used in R&D documentation and formulation records.

attributes.name: moisture_content_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content expressed as a percentage. Important for stability and shelf life of formulations.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special handling instructions for the raw material specification. May include formulation tips, compatibility warnings, or sourcing notes.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material has organic certification from a recognized certifying body (e.g., USDA Organic, ECOCERT, COSMOS).

attributes.name: palm_oil_derivative_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material is derived from palm oil. Important for sustainability tracking and RSPO compliance.

attributes.name: particle_size_microns
attributes.description: Average or target particle size measured in microns. Relevant for powders and solid materials affecting texture and performance.

attributes.name: purity_percent
attributes.description: Minimum purity level of the active ingredient or material expressed as a percentage. Critical specification parameter for formulation consistency.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: raw_material_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the raw material by R&D for internal identification and formulation reference. Distinct from procurement supplier material codes.

attributes.name: rd_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the raw material specification for use in R&D formulations. Approved materials are cleared for inclusion in new product development.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory category or classification of the raw material (e.g., cosmetic ingredient, OTC active, food additive, fragrance component, colorant) determining applicable regulatory pathways.

attributes.name: sds_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current Safety Data Sheet is available for this raw material in the document management system.

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Expected shelf life of the raw material in months under specified storage conditions before quality degradation.

attributes.name: specification_version
attributes.description: Version number of the raw material specification document. Incremented when specification parameters are updated.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius to prevent degradation or safety hazards.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain raw material stability and quality.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: supplier_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the approved supplier in the procurement and R&D systems.

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the approved supplier or manufacturer providing this raw material. Used for R&D sourcing and formulation traceability.

attributes.name: us_fda_maximum_concentration_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) Maximum Concentration Percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration of this raw material in finished products as mandated by US FDA regulations. Null if no FDA restriction applies.
attributes.references: FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration) - CFR Title 21

attributes.name: us_fda_restricted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) Restricted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material is subject to restrictions or prohibitions under US FDA regulations for cosmetics or OTC drugs.
attributes.references: FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration) - CFR Title 21

attributes.name: vegan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material is free from animal-derived ingredients and suitable for vegan product formulations.

products.name: research_packaging_spec
products.description: R&D-owned technical specification records for packaging components developed or evaluated during NPD. Captures component type (primary, secondary, tertiary), material type (HDPE, PET, glass, aluminum, paperboard), component dimensions, weight, closure type, decoration method, compatibility test status with formulation, recyclability classification, and R&D approval status. Distinct from procurement packaging master — this is the R&D technical specification driving prototype and launch packaging decisions.

attributes.name: research_packaging_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the R&D packaging specification record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the R&D team member or manager who approved this packaging specification for use in prototypes or production.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project under which this packaging specification was developed or evaluated.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the packaging specification received R&D approval for use in the NPD project.

attributes.name: barrier_properties
attributes.description: Description of the packaging materials barrier characteristics, including oxygen barrier, moisture barrier, light barrier, or UV protection properties critical for product stability.
attributes.references: ASTM D3985 Oxygen Transmission; ASTM E96 Water Vapor Transmission

attributes.name: capacity_ml
attributes.description: Nominal fill capacity of the packaging component in milliliters, representing the target product volume for primary containers.
attributes.references: ISO 4788 Laboratory Glassware; FDA CFR Title 21

attributes.name: child_resistant_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging component has been certified as child-resistant per regulatory requirements for hazardous products.
attributes.references: ISO 8317 Child-Resistant Packaging; CPSC 16 CFR 1700; ASTM D3475

attributes.name: closure_type
attributes.description: Type of closure mechanism for the packaging component, such as screw cap, pump dispenser, flip-top, spray nozzle, or child-resistant closure.

attributes.name: color_specification
attributes.description: Color designation for the packaging component, typically using Pantone codes or descriptive color names for brand consistency.
attributes.references: Pantone Matching System (PMS); Internal Brand Guidelines

attributes.name: compatibility_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the formulation-packaging compatibility testing was completed or last reviewed.

attributes.name: compatibility_test_result
attributes.description: Summary of the compatibility test findings, including any observed interactions, leaching, discoloration, or structural changes.

attributes.name: component_height_mm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the packaging component in millimeters, measured per the specification drawing.

attributes.name: component_length_mm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the packaging component in millimeters, measured per the specification drawing.

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the packaging component within the packaging hierarchy: primary (direct product contact), secondary (outer carton/box), tertiary (pallet/shipper), closure (cap/pump/dispenser), label, or insert.

attributes.name: component_weight_grams
attributes.description: Weight of the empty packaging component in grams, used for sustainability calculations and shipping cost estimation.

attributes.name: component_width_mm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the packaging component in millimeters, measured per the specification drawing.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the cost per unit value.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Estimated or quoted cost per unit of the packaging component, used for NPD cost modeling and target COGS calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging specification record was first created in the R&D system.

attributes.name: decoration_method
attributes.description: Method used to apply graphics, branding, or regulatory information to the packaging component. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: screen_print|pad_print|label|heat_transfer|in_mold_label|direct_print|embossing|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: eu_reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging material complies with EU REACH regulation for chemical substance registration and restriction.

attributes.name: fda_food_contact_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging material is approved for direct food contact per FDA regulations.

attributes.name: formulation_compatibility_status
attributes.description: Status of compatibility testing between the packaging material and the product formulation, indicating whether the packaging is suitable for the intended product.
attributes.references: ISO 10993 Biological Evaluation; Internal Compatibility Testing Protocol

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging specification record was last updated, tracking iterative design changes and review cycles.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to delivery for this packaging component, critical for project timeline planning.

attributes.name: material_grade
attributes.description: Specific grade or quality designation of the material, including food-grade, pharmaceutical-grade, or recycled content specifications.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21 Part 177; EU Regulation 10/2011

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Primary material composition of the packaging component, using standard polymer abbreviations and material classifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HDPE|PET|PETG|PP|glass|aluminum|paperboard|corrugated|LDPE|PVC|bioplastic|composite — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 1043 Plastics Symbols; GS1 Material Type Codes

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier for this packaging component, impacting prototype and pilot production planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional technical details, design rationale, testing observations, or special handling requirements for the packaging specification.

attributes.name: prototype_batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the prototype packaging samples produced for evaluation, linking to physical samples in R&D inventory.

attributes.name: rd_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the packaging specification within the R&D stage-gate process, indicating readiness for prototype or production use.

attributes.name: recyclability_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the packaging components recyclability based on material type and local recycling infrastructure availability.
attributes.references: ISO 14021 Environmental Labels; How2Recycle Label System; FSC Standards

attributes.name: recycled_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of post-consumer or post-industrial recycled material content in the packaging component, supporting sustainability goals.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall regulatory compliance status of the packaging specification against applicable FDA, EU, and regional packaging regulations.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU Regulation 1935/2004; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: specification_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the packaging specification, used for cross-referencing in R&D documentation and prototype builds.

attributes.name: specification_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the packaging specification, typically including component type and material summary.

attributes.name: supplier_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the supplier or manufacturer of the packaging component, used for sourcing and procurement coordination.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.description: Composite sustainability score for the packaging specification, considering recyclability, recycled content, material weight reduction, and renewable material usage.

attributes.name: tamper_evident_feature
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging includes tamper-evident features such as breakable seals, shrink bands, or induction seals.

attributes.name: technical_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the detailed technical drawing or CAD file for the packaging component.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the packaging specification, following major.minor versioning convention to track iterative design changes.

products.name: safety_assessment
products.description: Formal product safety assessment records required for regulatory compliance and consumer safety. Captures assessment type (cosmetic product safety report per EU Regulation 1223/2009, toxicological risk assessment, dermal sensitization assessment, HRIPT), assessor name and qualification, assessment date, product/formulation assessed, safety conclusion (safe/unsafe/conditionally safe), conditions of use, and any required label warnings. Mandatory for EU CPSR and other market registrations.
products.reference: CPSR / Toxicological Safety Assessment / EU Reg 1223/2009

attributes.name: safety_assessment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for safety_assessment

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved the safety assessment for regulatory submission.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulation being assessed for safety.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project under which this safety assessment was conducted.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished product being assessed, if applicable. May be null for formulation-only assessments.

attributes.name: supersedes_assessment_safety_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous safety assessment record that this version supersedes, maintaining audit trail of assessment history.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: List of allergenic substances present in the formulation that must be declared on the label per regulatory requirements (e.g., EU Allergen List per Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III).
attributes.references: EU Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III, IFRA Standards

attributes.name: application_frequency
attributes.description: Recommended frequency of product application (e.g., once daily, twice daily, as needed, weekly).

attributes.name: application_site
attributes.description: Body site(s) where the product is intended to be applied (e.g., face, hands, scalp, body, mucous membranes).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the safety assessment was formally approved for use in regulatory submissions and product commercialization.

attributes.name: assessment_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the safety assessment, used for external reference and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the safety assessment was completed and signed off by the assessor.

attributes.name: assessment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the safety assessment work commenced.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety assessment record.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of safety assessment conducted. CPSR (Cosmetic Product Safety Report) per EU Regulation 1223/2009, toxicological risk assessment, dermal sensitization, HRIPT (Human Repeat Insult Patch Test), ocular irritation, or mutagenicity assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cosmetic_product_safety_report|toxicological_risk_assessment|dermal_sensitization_assessment|hript|ocular_irritation_assessment|mutagenicity_assessment|phototoxicity_assessment|reproductive_toxicity_assessment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU Regulation 1223/2009, OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified safety assessor who conducted the evaluation.

attributes.name: assessor_qualification
attributes.description: Professional qualifications and credentials of the safety assessor (e.g., PhD Toxicology, Registered Pharmacist, Diploma in Pharmaceutical Medicine).

attributes.name: assessor_registration_number
attributes.description: Professional registration or license number of the safety assessor, as required by regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: conditions_of_use
attributes.description: Specific conditions under which the product is deemed safe, including application site, frequency, duration, and target population (e.g., adults only, rinse-off only, not for use on damaged skin).

attributes.name: contraindications
attributes.description: Specific conditions or populations for which the product should not be used (e.g., not for use on broken skin, avoid if allergic to fragrance, not suitable for children under 3).

attributes.name: cpnp_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP) Notification Required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this assessment supports a product requiring notification in the EU CPNP system.

attributes.name: cpnp_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP) Reference Number
attributes.description: CPNP notification reference number if the product has been notified in the EU portal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_location
attributes.description: File path or document management system reference where the full safety assessment report is stored (e.g., Veeva Vault document ID).

attributes.name: exposure_duration
attributes.description: Duration of product contact with skin or mucous membranes (e.g., rinse-off, leave-on, brief contact).

attributes.name: fda_registration_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this assessment supports a product requiring FDA registration or notification in the United States.

attributes.name: label_warnings_required
attributes.description: Mandatory label warnings and precautionary statements required based on the safety assessment (e.g., avoid contact with eyes, for external use only, keep out of reach of children).
attributes.references: EU Regulation 1223/2009 Article 19, FDA CFR Title 21

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety assessment record was last modified.

attributes.name: margin_of_safety
attributes.description: Calculated margin of safety ratio (NOAEL/SED), indicating the safety buffer between the no observed adverse effect level and systemic exposure dose.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the safety assessment, typically required every 3-5 years or when formulation changes occur.

attributes.name: noael_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: No Observed Adverse Effect Level (NOAEL) Value
attributes.description: No Observed Adverse Effect Level in mg/kg body weight/day, derived from toxicological studies.
attributes.references: OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: regulatory_market_scope
attributes.description: Geographic markets and regulatory jurisdictions for which this safety assessment is intended (e.g., EU, USA, ASEAN, China, Brazil).

attributes.name: restricted_substances_compliance
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the formulation complies with all restricted substance regulations (EU Annexes II-VI, FDA prohibited ingredients).
attributes.references: EU Regulation 1223/2009 Annexes II-VI, FDA CFR Title 21

attributes.name: restricted_substances_findings
attributes.description: Details of any restricted substances identified in the formulation and their compliance status with maximum concentration limits.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the safety assessment was last reviewed or updated to reflect new data or regulatory changes.

attributes.name: safety_conclusion
attributes.description: Overall safety conclusion reached by the assessor: safe for intended use, unsafe, conditionally safe (with restrictions), or insufficient data to conclude.

attributes.name: supporting_studies_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key toxicological and clinical studies used to support the safety assessment, including study types and outcomes.

attributes.name: systemic_exposure_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated systemic exposure dose in mg/kg body weight/day, calculated from dermal absorption and usage patterns.

attributes.name: target_population
attributes.description: Intended consumer population for the product (e.g., adults, children over 3 years, infants, pregnant women, general population).

attributes.name: toxicological_endpoints_evaluated
attributes.description: List of toxicological endpoints assessed (e.g., acute toxicity, skin irritation, eye irritation, skin sensitization, repeated dose toxicity, mutagenicity, carcinogenicity, reproductive toxicity).
attributes.references: OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals, SCCS Notes of Guidance

attributes.name: undesirable_effects_reported
attributes.description: Description of any undesirable effects observed in toxicological studies or post-market surveillance that are relevant to the safety assessment.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the safety assessment document, incremented with each revision or update.

products.name: scale_up_trial
products.description: Records manufacturing scale-up trials conducted to transfer formulations from R&D bench scale to pilot or commercial production scale, serving as the formal technology transfer record. Captures trial date, manufacturing site, batch size, equipment used, process parameters (mixing speed, temperature, time, order of addition), yield, in-process test results, deviation observations, scale-up status (pass/fail/conditional), technology transfer checklist completion, and manufacturing readiness sign-off. Bridges R&D formulation development with manufacturing operations and commercial launch readiness.
products.reference: Scale-Up Trial / Technology Transfer Batch / Pilot Batch Record

attributes.name: scale_up_trial_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing scale-up trial record. Primary key for the scale-up trial entity.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Technology‑transfer records require the specific manufacturing facility where the scale‑up trial is performed for capacity planning.

attributes.name: primary_scale_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing manager or technical authority who signed off on the scale-up trial and manufacturing readiness.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D formulation being scaled up from bench scale to pilot or commercial production scale.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_line. Business justification: Scale‑up trials are scheduled on a particular production line; linking enables line utilization reporting and OEE tracking.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent R&D project under which this scale-up trial is conducted.

attributes.name: actual_output_kg
attributes.description: Actual quantity of finished product produced during the scale-up trial measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: appearance_assessment
attributes.description: Visual evaluation of product appearance including texture, homogeneity, and any defects observed during the trial.

attributes.name: batch_size_kg
attributes.description: Total batch size produced during the scale-up trial measured in kilograms, representing the scale of production tested.

attributes.name: color_measurement
attributes.description: Objective color measurement of the scaled-up batch using colorimetry or visual assessment against standard.

attributes.name: cooling_rate_celsius_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cooling Rate in Celsius Per Minute
attributes.description: Rate at which the batch was cooled after processing, critical for product texture and stability.

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions implemented during or after the trial to address deviations or quality issues.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the trial cost amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the scale-up trial record was first created in the data system.

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any process deviations, non-conformances, or unexpected observations during the scale-up trial.

attributes.name: deviation_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact of observed deviations on product quality, safety, and manufacturing readiness.

attributes.name: deviation_observed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any process deviations from the standard manufacturing procedure were observed during the trial.

attributes.name: equipment_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the manufacturing equipment setup used during the trial, including mixer type, vessel capacity, and auxiliary equipment.

attributes.name: heating_rate_celsius_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Rate in Celsius Per Minute
attributes.description: Rate at which the batch was heated during processing, important for thermal-sensitive formulations.

attributes.name: in_process_test_results
attributes.description: Summary of all in-process quality control tests performed during the scale-up trial, including pass/fail status for each checkpoint.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the scale-up trial record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Key insights, learnings, and recommendations captured from the scale-up trial for future technology transfers and process improvements.

attributes.name: manufacturing_readiness_level
attributes.description: Assessment of manufacturing readiness for commercial production based on trial outcomes and technology transfer completion.

attributes.name: manufacturing_sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date when manufacturing operations formally approved the scale-up trial results and confirmed readiness for commercial production.

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing facility or plant where the scale-up trial was executed.

attributes.name: mixing_speed_rpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mixing Speed in Revolutions Per Minute (RPM)
attributes.description: Rotational speed of the mixing equipment during the trial, critical process parameter for scale-up consistency.

attributes.name: mixing_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the mixing phase during the scale-up trial, key parameter for process reproducibility.

attributes.name: next_steps
attributes.description: Documented next actions required following the scale-up trial, such as additional trials, process optimization, or commercial launch preparation.

attributes.name: odor_assessment
attributes.description: Sensory evaluation of the product fragrance and odor profile compared to bench-scale formulation.

attributes.name: order_of_addition
attributes.description: Documented sequence in which raw materials and ingredients were added during the manufacturing process, critical for formulation reproducibility.

attributes.name: pass_fail_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed justification for the trial status decision, including quality assessment, process performance, and readiness for commercial production.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Measured pH of the scaled-up batch, critical quality parameter for product stability and skin compatibility.

attributes.name: process_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target processing temperature maintained during the scale-up trial, critical for formulation stability and quality.

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: Specific production line or equipment train used for the scale-up trial within the manufacturing site.

attributes.name: quality_sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date when quality assurance formally approved the scale-up trial results and confirmed product quality meets specifications.

attributes.name: scale_factor
attributes.description: Multiplication factor representing the scale-up ratio from bench scale to pilot or commercial scale (e.g., 10x, 100x, 1000x).

attributes.name: technology_transfer_checklist_status
attributes.description: Completion status of the formal technology transfer checklist documenting all required activities and sign-offs.

attributes.name: trial_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code assigned to the scale-up trial for external reference and tracking across R&D and manufacturing systems.

attributes.name: trial_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for conducting the scale-up trial including raw materials, labor, equipment time, and testing.

attributes.name: trial_date
attributes.description: The date on which the scale-up trial was conducted at the manufacturing facility.

attributes.name: trial_status
attributes.description: Overall outcome status of the scale-up trial: pass (successful), fail (unsuccessful), conditional_pass (passed with minor issues), in_progress (ongoing), or cancelled.

attributes.name: trial_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scale-up trial based on production scale: pilot (small-scale test), semi-commercial (intermediate scale), commercial (full production scale), or validation (qualification run).

attributes.name: viscosity_cps
attributes.description: Measured viscosity of the scaled-up batch, key quality attribute for product consistency and consumer experience.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Actual production yield as a percentage of theoretical yield, indicating manufacturing efficiency and material loss.

products.name: study_protocol

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: amendment_date

attributes.name: amendment_number

attributes.name: blinding

attributes.name: creation_timestamp

attributes.name: data_retention_period

attributes.name: data_sharing_policy

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: design_type

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: ethics_approval_date

attributes.name: ethics_approval_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the ethics committee approval.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria

attributes.name: inclusion_criteria

attributes.name: indication

attributes.name: is_confidential

attributes.name: primary_endpoint

attributes.name: protocol_code
attributes.description: Business code or alphanumeric identifier assigned to the protocol by the sponsor or R&D organization.

attributes.name: protocol_name

attributes.name: protocol_type

attributes.name: randomization_method

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of regulatory authority approval.

attributes.name: sample_size

domains.name: regulatory
domains.description: Owns product registration, regulatory submissions, labeling compliance, and safety documentation management. Manages regulatory dossiers, SDS/MSDS sheets, ingredient declarations, country-specific registrations (FDA, EPA, EU), CPSC filings, IFRA compliance records, post-market surveillance, and CFR compliance. Ensures multi-jurisdictional regulatory adherence.
domains.references: FDA 21 CFR, EU REACH, CPSC, IFRA, EPA

products.name: regulatory_registration
products.description: Master record for product registrations with regulatory authorities across all jurisdictions. Tracks registration number, status, effective/expiry dates, registering authority, product scope, registration type (new, renewal, amendment, cancellation), active ingredients, use classification, submission reference, and renewal due date. Covers FDA, EPA (FIFRA pesticide/antimicrobial), CPSC, EU REACH, and country-specific registrations. SSOT for all regulatory registration identities regardless of authority or jurisdiction.

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product registration record. Primary key for the registration entity.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Financial posting of registration fees requires a GL account; finance uses GL accounts for all fee postings.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing facility or establishment where the registered product is manufactured. Links to facility master data.
attributes.references: FDA Establishment Identifier, GMP Facility Registration

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Registration approval requires a designated regulatory affairs employee; linking enables audit trail of responsible employee.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product being registered with regulatory authorities. Links to the product master record.

attributes.name: active_ingredients
attributes.description: List of active ingredients or substances covered by this registration, using INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) or CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service) numbers where applicable. Critical for EPA pesticide and antimicrobial registrations.
attributes.references: INCI, CAS Registry, EPA Active Ingredient List

attributes.name: annual_report_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which annual registration reports or updates must be submitted to the regulatory authority. Used for compliance tracking and reporting calendar management.
attributes.references: FDA Annual Reporting, EPA Annual Reporting

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority officially approved the registration application.
attributes.references: FDA Approval Process, EPA Approval Process

attributes.name: cfr_citation
attributes.description: Specific CFR (Code of Federal Regulations) citation or section under which the product is registered (e.g., 21 CFR 314 for NDAs, 40 CFR 152 for pesticides). Applicable primarily to US registrations.

attributes.name: cpsc_tracking_label_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Tracking Label Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether CPSC tracking label requirements apply to this registered product. True if tracking labels are required, False otherwise. Applicable to children's products and certain consumer goods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the registration becomes legally effective and the product may be marketed or distributed under this registration.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the registration expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null for registrations with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee amount paid or payable for this registration in the registration holder's reporting currency. Includes initial registration fees and any applicable renewal fees.
attributes.references: FDA Fee Schedule, EPA Fee Schedule

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the registration fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product and manufacturing facility meet Good Manufacturing Practice requirements as verified during registration. True if GMP-compliant, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ISO 22716, FDA GMP, EU GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: holder_address
attributes.description: Full business address of the registration holder as registered with the regulatory authority. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: FDA Establishment Registration, EPA Company Registration

attributes.name: holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the company or entity that holds the registration. This is the registrant of record with the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: FDA Establishment Registration, EPA Company Registration

attributes.name: ifra_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product formulation complies with IFRA standards for fragrance ingredients. True if IFRA-compliant, False otherwise. Relevant for cosmetic and personal care products.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the jurisdiction where the registration is valid (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR, CAN, BRA, JPN, AUS, CHN).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_region
attributes.description: Specific region, state, or province within the country where the registration applies (e.g., California, Ontario, Bavaria). Used for sub-national regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: label_approval_number
attributes.description: Approval number for the product label as reviewed and accepted by the regulatory authority. Critical for EPA pesticide registrations where label claims are strictly regulated.
attributes.references: EPA Label Review, FDA Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this registration record. Audit trail field for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration record was last modified or updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the registration. May include restrictions, special handling requirements, or regulatory caveats.

attributes.name: post_market_surveillance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether post-market surveillance or pharmacovigilance reporting is required for this registration. True if surveillance is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Description of the product scope covered by this registration, including specific formulations, SKUs (Stock Keeping Units), or product variants included under this registration.
attributes.references: FDA Registration Scope, EPA Registration Scope

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: EU REACH registration number for chemical substances. Applicable for products containing substances subject to REACH regulation in the European Union.

attributes.name: registering_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or governing body with which the product is registered (e.g., FDA, EPA, EU Commission, Health Canada, ANVISA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EPA|CPSC|EU_REACH|Health_Canada|ANVISA|PMDA|TGA|SFDA|MHRA|BfR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA, EPA, CPSC, EU REACH, ISO 3166

attributes.name: registration_category
attributes.description: Regulatory category or class of the registration as defined by the authority (e.g., OTC drug, prescription drug, general use pesticide, restricted use pesticide, cosmetic product, biocidal product).
attributes.references: FDA Product Categories, EPA Pesticide Categories, EU Biocidal Product Regulation

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number or identifier issued by the regulatory authority. This is the externally-known unique identifier for the registration (e.g., FDA registration number, EPA registration number, EU REACH registration number).
attributes.references: FDA Registration, EPA FIFRA, EU REACH

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the registration. Tracks the registration through submission, review, approval, active use, and potential suspension or expiration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|active|suspended|expired|cancelled|rejected — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Registration Status, EPA Registration Status

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Type of registration action being recorded. Indicates whether this is a new registration, renewal of existing registration, amendment to existing registration, cancellation, variation, or transfer to another entity.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary regulatory affairs contact person for this registration. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory affairs contact person responsible for this registration. Used for correspondence and regulatory inquiries.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary regulatory affairs contact person for this registration. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the registration renewal application must be submitted to maintain continuous registration status. Used for proactive renewal management.
attributes.references: FDA Registration Renewal, EPA Registration Renewal

attributes.name: sds_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) associated with this registered product. Links to safety documentation repository.
attributes.references: OSHA HCS, GHS, EU CLP Regulation

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this registration record originated (e.g., Veeva Vault, SAP ERP, Oracle ERP). Used for data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the registration application or dossier was submitted to the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: FDA Submission Process, EPA Submission Process

attributes.name: submission_reference_number
attributes.description: Internal or external reference number for the regulatory submission dossier associated with this registration. Links to detailed submission documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Submission Tracking, EPA Submission Tracking

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the intended use or application of the product as defined by the regulatory authority (e.g., cosmetic, drug, pesticide, antimicrobial, food contact substance, medical device). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cosmetic|drug|pesticide|antimicrobial|food_contact|medical_device|biocide|industrial_chemical — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Product Classification, EPA Use Classification, EU CLP Regulation

products.name: submission
products.description: Regulatory submission records filed with any governing body worldwide. Captures submission type (510k, PMA, GRAS, TSCA, cosmetic notification, CPSC Section 15(b) report, SaferProducts.gov, REACH registration), submission date, dossier reference, submission channel, assigned reviewer, status, target decision date, hazard/incident details (for safety filings), population at risk, and linked registration. SSOT for all regulatory filings regardless of authority. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module.

attributes.name: severity_level

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.name: submission_number

attributes.name: primary_contact_employee_id
