attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Dossier primary contact is an employee responsible for dossier management; needed for responsibility reporting.

attributes.name: product_lca_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.product_lca. Business justification: Regulatory dossiers often require Life‑Cycle Assessment data; FK attaches the LCA record to the dossier.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product for which this regulatory dossier was compiled. Links to the product master record.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory submission that this dossier supports. One dossier may support multiple submissions across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the dossier was formally approved by the regulatory affairs leadership or quality assurance team for submission or archival.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the regulatory affairs manager or quality assurance officer who approved the dossier for submission.

attributes.name: cfr_reference
attributes.description: Specific CFR title and part number(s) that govern the regulatory requirements addressed by this dossier, applicable for U.S. FDA and EPA submissions.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information related to the dossier compilation, review, or submission.

attributes.name: compilation_date
attributes.description: Date when the dossier compilation was completed and finalized for submission or review.

attributes.name: completeness_percentage
attributes.description: Numeric representation of dossier completeness, calculated as the percentage of required sections and documents that have been compiled and approved.

attributes.name: completeness_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether all required documentation sections and supporting materials have been compiled and verified for regulatory submission readiness.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level indicating the sensitivity and access restrictions for the dossier content.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dossier record was first created in the regulatory data management system.

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual documents included in this regulatory dossier package.

attributes.name: dossier_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the regulatory dossier, used for external reference and tracking across regulatory affairs teams and submissions.

attributes.name: dossier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory dossier indicating its stage in the compilation and submission process.

attributes.name: dossier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory dossier format and submission standard. CTD (Common Technical Document), eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document), IECIC (International Cooperation on Cosmetics Regulation), CPNP (Cosmetic Products Notification Portal), FDA 510K (Medical Device Premarket Notification), EPA FIFRA (Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the dossier becomes the active regulatory documentation package for the associated product or submission.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the dossier is no longer valid or requires renewal, typically driven by regulatory authority requirements or internal policy.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the dossier includes documentation demonstrating compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice standards as required by regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: ifra_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the dossier includes documentation demonstrating compliance with IFRA standards for fragrance ingredients.

attributes.name: ingredient_declaration_included
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a complete ingredient declaration (INCI list or equivalent) is included in the dossier.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country or region code representing the regulatory jurisdiction for which this dossier applies.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (with optional ISO 3166-1 country code) indicating the primary language in which the dossier documentation is compiled.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update or modification to the dossier record, supporting audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review or audit of the dossier content for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or update of the dossier, ensuring ongoing compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: owning_team
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the regulatory affairs team responsible for compiling, maintaining, and submitting this dossier.

attributes.name: post_market_surveillance_included
attributes.description: Indicator of whether post-market surveillance data, adverse event reports, or vigilance documentation is included in the dossier.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 1223/2009 Article 23, FDA 21 CFR Part 803

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: REACH registration number for chemical substances included in the dossier, required for EU market compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory body or agency for which this dossier is intended. FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration), EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), CPSC (Consumer Product Safety Commission), EMA (European Medicines Agency), MHRA (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency), ANVISA (Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency), PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency Japan). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EPA|CPSC|EMA|MHRA|ANVISA|PMDA — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_category
attributes.description: Broad regulatory classification of the dossier content, such as cosmetics, personal care, household products, food contact materials, or pesticides, aligning with applicable regulatory frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cosmetics|personal_care|household_cleaning|food_contact|pesticides|biocides|medical_devices — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA CFR, EU REACH, CPSC Guidelines

attributes.name: safety_assessment_included
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a formal safety assessment report is included in the dossier, as required for cosmetic and personal care product registrations.

attributes.name: sds_included
attributes.description: Indicator of whether Safety Data Sheets (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) are included in the dossier for hazardous substances or mixtures.

attributes.name: vault_folder_path
attributes.description: Hierarchical folder path within Veeva Vault where the dossier documents are stored, enabling navigation and retrieval.

attributes.name: vault_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this dossier record to the corresponding document repository location in Veeva Vault for full document access and version control.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the dossier, tracking revisions and updates to the compiled documentation package.

products.name: sds
products.description: Safety Data Sheet (SDS/MSDS) master records for raw materials, finished goods, and intermediates as required by OSHA HazCom, EU CLP, and GHS standards. Captures SDS version, revision date, GHS hazard classifications, signal word, precautionary statements, first aid measures, handling/storage requirements, disposal guidance, transport classification (UN number, packing group), and authoring chemist. Managed in Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Safety Data Sheet record. Primary key.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material, finished good, or intermediate product that this SDS describes.

attributes.name: accidental_release_measures
attributes.description: Personal precautions, protective equipment, emergency procedures, and methods for containment and cleanup of spills or releases.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Visual description of the substance including color and form.

attributes.name: authoring_chemist
attributes.description: Name of the qualified chemist or toxicologist who authored or reviewed this SDS for technical accuracy.

attributes.name: autoignition_temperature
attributes.description: Temperature at which the substance will spontaneously ignite without an external ignition source.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance or mixture, if applicable.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the jurisdiction for which this SDS is prepared (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disposal_considerations
attributes.description: Guidance on proper disposal methods, waste treatment, and applicable regulations for the substance and contaminated packaging.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety document type: SDS (Safety Data Sheet per GHS), MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheet legacy format), or Extended SDS (with additional exposure scenarios).

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) or file path to the published SDS document in the document management system.

attributes.name: ecological_information
attributes.description: Environmental impact data including aquatic toxicity, persistence and degradability, bioaccumulative potential, and mobility in soil.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this SDS version becomes the official document for regulatory and operational use.

attributes.name: emergency_phone_number
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency contact telephone number for chemical emergency response (e.g., CHEMTREC, poison control).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this SDS version is superseded or no longer valid, requiring update or renewal.

attributes.name: exposure_limits
attributes.description: Occupational exposure limits (OELs), permissible exposure limits (PELs), threshold limit values (TLVs), and biological exposure indices.
attributes.references: OSHA PEL, ACGIH TLV, GHS Section 8

attributes.name: firefighting_measures
attributes.description: Suitable extinguishing media, unsuitable extinguishing media, and special hazards arising from the substance or mixture during fire.

attributes.name: first_aid_measures
attributes.description: Detailed first aid instructions for different exposure routes (inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, ingestion) as required by GHS Section 4.

attributes.name: flash_point
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the substance will ignite when given an ignition source, typically in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes assigned to this substance or mixture (e.g., Flam. Liq. 2, Acute Tox. 3, Skin Corr. 1B).

attributes.name: handling_precautions
attributes.description: Safe handling practices and precautions for use to prevent exposure and ensure worker safety.

attributes.name: hazard_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS hazard statements (H-codes) describing the nature and degree of hazards (e.g., H225: Highly flammable liquid and vapor).

attributes.name: hazardous_decomposition_products
attributes.description: Hazardous substances that may be formed under fire conditions or other decomposition scenarios.

attributes.name: incompatible_materials
attributes.description: Materials or substances that should not be stored or used with this product due to potential hazardous reactions.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when this SDS was originally issued or first published.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which this SDS is written (e.g., EN for English, ES for Spanish).

attributes.name: manufacturer_address
attributes.description: Complete physical address of the manufacturer or supplier for regulatory contact purposes.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the company that manufactures or supplies the product covered by this SDS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: odor
attributes.description: Characteristic odor of the substance or mixture, if detectable.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group indicating degree of danger for transport: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: personal_protective_equipment
attributes.description: Required personal protective equipment for safe handling: respiratory protection, hand protection, eye protection, skin protection.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement of the substance or mixture, indicating acidity or alkalinity.

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical form of the substance or mixture at ambient conditions.

attributes.name: pictograms
attributes.description: List of GHS pictogram codes required on the label (e.g., GHS02 Flame, GHS07 Exclamation Mark, GHS08 Health Hazard).

attributes.name: precautionary_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS precautionary statements (P-codes) describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects (e.g., P210: Keep away from heat/sparks/open flames).

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product code or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for the material covered by this SDS.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The commercial or chemical name of the product or substance covered by this SDS.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: Official shipping name for transport documentation as specified by UN/DOT regulations.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_information
attributes.description: Applicable regulatory requirements including TSCA status, REACH registration, California Prop 65, SARA Title III, and other jurisdiction-specific regulations.

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the SDS was last revised or updated.

attributes.name: sds_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this SDS, used for regulatory submissions and cross-referencing.

attributes.name: sds_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SDS document within the regulatory document management system.

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: GHS signal word indicating the severity level of the hazard: Danger (more severe) or Warning (less severe).

attributes.name: stability
attributes.description: Chemical stability information and conditions to avoid that may cause instability or hazardous reactions.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Conditions for safe storage including temperature, humidity, ventilation requirements, and incompatible materials.

attributes.name: toxicological_information
attributes.description: Comprehensive toxicology data including acute toxicity, skin corrosion/irritation, eye damage/irritation, sensitization, mutagenicity, carcinogenicity, reproductive toxicity, and target organ effects.

attributes.name: transport_hazard_class
attributes.description: UN/DOT hazard class for transportation (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport classification.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this SDS revision, tracking document evolution over time.

products.name: ingredient_list
products.description: Ingredient declaration records capturing the full ingredient list for a finished product SKU as required for labeling compliance. Tracks INCI names, CAS numbers, concentration ranges, function (preservative, surfactant, fragrance, colorant), declaration order, jurisdiction-specific requirements (FDA 21 CFR, EU Cosmetics Regulation, REACH), allergen flags, and restricted substance flags. Links to product master and formulation records.
products.reference: INCI / FDA 21 CFR / EU Cosmetics Regulation

attributes.name: ingredient_list_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ingredient_list

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulation record that defines the recipe and composition for this product. Links to formulation master data.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished product SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this ingredient declaration applies. Links to product master data.

attributes.name: allergen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is a known allergen requiring special labeling or disclosure per regulatory requirements (e.g., EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III).
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III, FDA Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allergen type if allergen_flag is true. Used for consumer safety labeling and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the regulatory affairs professional who approved this ingredient declaration for use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ingredient declaration was approved by regulatory affairs.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service) registry number identifying the chemical substance. Used for regulatory submissions and safety documentation.

attributes.name: common_name
attributes.description: Common or trade name of the ingredient used for internal reference and non-regulated communications.

attributes.name: concentration_max_percent
attributes.description: Maximum concentration of the ingredient in the finished product, expressed as a percentage by weight. Used for regulatory submissions and formulation specifications.

attributes.name: concentration_min_percent
attributes.description: Minimum concentration of the ingredient in the finished product, expressed as a percentage by weight. Used for regulatory submissions and formulation specifications.

attributes.name: concentration_typical_percent
attributes.description: Typical or target concentration of the ingredient in the finished product, expressed as a percentage by weight. Used for quality control and manufacturing guidance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ingredient declaration record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: declaration_name_override
attributes.description: Alternative name to be used on the product label if different from INCI name, as permitted by jurisdiction-specific regulations (e.g., trade name, common name).

attributes.name: declaration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient must be declared on the product label per regulatory requirements. Some processing aids or trace contaminants may be exempt.

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ingredient declaration record in the regulatory documentation workflow.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ingredient declaration becomes effective for regulatory compliance and labeling purposes.

attributes.name: einecs_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Inventory of Existing Commercial Chemical Substances (EINECS) Number
attributes.description: EINECS (European Inventory of Existing Commercial Chemical Substances) number for substances marketed in the EU before September 1981. Required for EU REACH compliance.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this ingredient declaration is no longer valid, typically due to formulation changes or regulatory updates. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: fda_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Regulatory Status
attributes.description: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) regulatory status of the ingredient for use in consumer goods (e.g., GRAS - Generally Recognized As Safe, approved food additive, approved color additive).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR, FDA GRAS Notice Inventory

attributes.name: ifra_amendment_number
attributes.description: IFRA (International Fragrance Association) amendment number that governs the use restrictions for this ingredient if IFRA restricted.
attributes.references: IFRA Standards and Code of Practice

attributes.name: ifra_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is subject to IFRA (International Fragrance Association) restrictions or standards for use in fragrance compounds.
attributes.references: IFRA Standards and Code of Practice

attributes.name: inci_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name
attributes.description: Standardized INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) name for the ingredient as required for cosmetic product labeling. Mandatory for cosmetics and personal care products.
attributes.references: INCI International Cosmetic Ingredient Dictionary and Handbook

attributes.name: ingredient_function
attributes.description: Primary functional role of the ingredient in the formulation (e.g., preservative, surfactant, fragrance, colorant, active ingredient). Used for regulatory classification and formulation analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preservative|surfactant|emollient|humectant|emulsifier|thickener|fragrance|colorant|active_ingredient|solvent|ph_adjuster|antioxidant|chelating_agent|opacifier|film_former — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ingredient_sequence
attributes.description: Order in which this ingredient appears on the product label declaration. Typically sorted by descending concentration per regulatory requirements (FDA 21 CFR, EU Cosmetics Regulation).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 701.3, EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex I

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction for which this ingredient declaration record applies. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|DEU|FRA|ITA|ESP|CHN|JPN|AUS|BRA|IND|KOR — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ingredient declaration record was last modified in the data platform.

attributes.name: nanomaterial_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is in nanomaterial form, requiring special labeling per EU Cosmetics Regulation (nano) designation.

attributes.name: natural_origin_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is derived from natural sources (plant, mineral, animal) as opposed to synthetic or petrochemical sources. Used for natural product claims and marketing.
attributes.references: ISO 16128 Natural and Organic Cosmetics Standard

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is certified organic by a recognized certification body (e.g., USDA Organic, COSMOS, ECOCERT). Used for organic product claims.
attributes.references: USDA Organic Standards, COSMOS Standard, ECOCERT

attributes.name: palm_oil_derivative_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is derived from palm oil. Used for sustainable sourcing tracking and RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) compliance.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals) registration number for substances manufactured or imported in the EU in quantities of 1 tonne or more per year.

attributes.name: restricted_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is subject to regulatory restrictions, concentration limits, or prohibited use conditions in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex II/III, FDA 21 CFR, REACH SVHC List

attributes.name: restriction_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of jurisdictions or regulatory bodies where restrictions apply (e.g., EU, USA, CAN, JPN). Used for multi-jurisdictional compliance management.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory restriction applied to this ingredient if restricted_substance_flag is true. Defines the nature of the regulatory control.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation, FDA 21 CFR, CPSC Guidelines

attributes.name: rspo_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether palm-derived ingredients are RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) certified for sustainable sourcing.

attributes.name: sds_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number linking this ingredient to its Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) document for hazard communication and workplace safety.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this ingredient declaration record originated (e.g., Veeva Vault, SAP PLM, internal formulation system).

attributes.name: vegan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is free from animal-derived substances and suitable for vegan product claims.
attributes.references: Vegan Society Standards, Internal Vegan Certification

products.name: label_version
products.description: Product label version master tracking all approved and historical label artwork versions for each SKU across markets. Captures label version number, market/country, language, label type (primary, secondary, shipper), regulatory approval status, approval date, approving authority, label claims, warning statements, net content declaration, country-of-origin, and Veeva Vault document reference. Supports multi-jurisdictional labeling compliance.
products.reference: FTC Labeling / FDA CFR / EU Labeling Directive

attributes.name: label_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the label version record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approval_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Label Version Approval Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Label approvals are signed off by a regulatory employee; FK records who approved each label version.

attributes.name: previous_version_label_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding label version that this version supersedes, enabling version lineage tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU this label version applies to.

attributes.name: allergen_declarations
attributes.description: Allergen declarations required on the label (e.g., 'Contains: milk, soy, tree nuts'). Applicable for food and cosmetic products.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the label version received regulatory approval from the governing authority.

attributes.name: approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory approval expires and the label version can no longer be used, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference or registration number assigned by the regulatory authority for this label approval.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or authority that approved this label version (e.g., FDA, EPA, EU Commission, Health Canada).

attributes.name: artwork_checksum
attributes.description: SHA-256 checksum hash of the artwork file to ensure file integrity and detect unauthorized modifications.

attributes.name: artwork_file_name
attributes.description: File name of the approved label artwork file (e.g., PDF, AI, or other format) stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: barcode_type
attributes.description: Type of barcode symbology printed on the label (e.g., UPC, EAN-13, GTIN-14, QR Code, DataMatrix).

attributes.name: barcode_value
attributes.description: The encoded value of the barcode printed on this label version (e.g., UPC number, GTIN, serialized data).

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Brand name displayed on the label.

attributes.name: certification_marks
attributes.description: Third-party certification marks and compliance logos displayed on the label (e.g., 'USDA Organic', 'Leaping Bunny', 'Non-GMO Project', 'Kosher', 'Halal').

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for creating this new label version (e.g., 'Regulatory requirement change', 'Ingredient reformulation', 'Packaging redesign', 'Correction of error').

attributes.name: contact_information
attributes.description: Consumer contact information displayed on the label (phone number, website, email) for inquiries and customer service.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced, as declared on the label.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, FTC Country of Origin Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this label version record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: distributor_name
attributes.description: Name of the distributor or importer as declared on the label, if different from manufacturer.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this label version is no longer valid for new production. Nullable for currently active versions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this label version becomes effective and can be used in production and distribution.

attributes.name: expiry_date_format
attributes.description: Format specification for how the expiry or best-before date will be printed on the label (e.g., 'MM/YYYY', 'DD-MMM-YYYY', 'EXP: YYYY-MM-DD').

attributes.name: ingredient_list
attributes.description: Full ingredient list as declared on the label in descending order of predominance, following regulatory naming conventions (INCI for cosmetics, common names for food).

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the currently active label version for the SKU in the specified market. True if current, False if historical.

attributes.name: label_type

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code, optionally with ISO 3166-1 country code (e.g., en, en-US, fr-CA) indicating the label language.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this label version record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this label version record was last modified.

attributes.name: lot_code_format
attributes.description: Format specification for the lot or batch code that will be printed on labels during production (e.g., 'YYMMDD-LLLL' where LLLL is line code).

attributes.name: manufacturer_address
attributes.description: Full address of the manufacturer as declared on the label for regulatory compliance and consumer contact.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer as declared on the label for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: market_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the market jurisdiction for this label version (e.g., USA, DEU, JPN).

attributes.name: net_content_declaration
attributes.description: Full net content declaration statement as it appears on the label, including quantity and unit (e.g., '500 ml', '16 fl oz (473 ml)').

attributes.name: net_content_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric value of the net content quantity declared on the label.

attributes.name: net_content_unit

attributes.name: product_name_on_label

attributes.name: recycling_symbols
attributes.description: Recycling symbols and sustainability marks displayed on the label (e.g., 'Recyclable', 'FSC Certified', 'Green Dot', resin identification codes).

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the label version in the target market jurisdiction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|withdrawn|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_code

Tracks IFRA standard version, fragrance ingredient, product category (leave-on, rinse-off, fine fragrance), maximum permitted usage level per IFRA standard, actual formulated usage level, compliance status (compliant/non-compliant), assessment date, and assessor. Required for fragrance safety substantiation in personal care and household products.
products.reference: IFRA Standards / IFRA Code of Practice

attributes.name: ifra_compliance_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: IFRA (International Fragrance Association) Compliance Record ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IFRA compliance record. Primary key for tracking fragrance ingredient compliance assessments against IFRA standards.

attributes.name: assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the assessor who performed the IFRA compliance evaluation. Links to HR system for audit trail.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product containing the fragrance ingredient. Links to the product master data for which this IFRA compliance assessment applies.

attributes.name: actual_formulated_usage_level
attributes.description: Actual concentration of the fragrance ingredient in the finished product formulation. Expressed in the same unit as maximum_permitted_usage_level. Used to determine compliance status.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fragrance ingredient is a recognized allergen requiring declaration on product labeling per EU Cosmetics Regulation or other jurisdictional requirements.

attributes.name: allergen_threshold_exceeded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fragrance ingredient concentration exceeds the allergen labeling threshold (0.001% for leave-on, 0.01% for rinse-off products per EU regulation).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the IFRA compliance record was formally approved by regulatory affairs. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the IFRA compliance record. Approved records are used for regulatory submissions and product release decisions.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory affairs manager or quality director who approved this IFRA compliance record for use in regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the IFRA compliance assessment was performed for this fragrance ingredient and product combination. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next IFRA compliance reassessment is required. Triggered by IFRA standard updates or product reformulation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory affairs or quality assurance professional who performed the IFRA compliance assessment.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Chemical Abstracts Service registry number uniquely identifying the fragrance ingredient chemical substance. Standard format: XXXXXX-XX-X.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes from the assessor regarding special considerations, assumptions, or clarifications related to this IFRA compliance assessment.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the fragrance ingredient usage against IFRA standards. Compliant indicates actual usage is within permitted limits; non-compliant requires reformulation; pending review indicates assessment in progress.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IFRA compliance record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: exemption_justification
attributes.description: Detailed justification text if an exemption or deviation from IFRA standard is claimed. Must include scientific rationale and risk assessment summary.

attributes.name: formulation_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the product formulation for which this IFRA compliance assessment applies. Links to PLM system for formulation change tracking.

attributes.name: fragrance_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific fragrance ingredient being assessed for IFRA compliance. May be a chemical name, INCI name, or proprietary fragrance component identifier.

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: ifra_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by fragrance supplier confirming IFRA compliance of the fragrance compound. Required for audit and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IFRA compliance record is currently active and valid. Inactive records represent historical assessments superseded by newer evaluations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this IFRA compliance record. Typically triggered annually or upon IFRA standard amendment. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level product type classification determining IFRA category assignment and usage restrictions. Leave-on products have stricter limits than rinse-off products.

attributes.name: qra_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number to the Quantitative Risk Assessment document supporting the safety substantiation of this fragrance ingredient usage. Required for regulatory defense.

attributes.name: record_source_system

products.name: surveillance_event
products.description: Post-market surveillance records tracking product safety signals, adverse event reports, consumer complaints with safety implications, and regulatory authority inquiries after product launch. Captures signal type, source (consumer complaint, retailer report, regulatory authority, social media), severity classification, affected SKU/batch, investigation status, root cause, corrective action, and regulatory reporting obligation triggered. Supports CPSC and FDA post-market requirements.

attributes.name: surveillance_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for surveillance_event

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Investigation costs from post‑market surveillance are charged to a cost center for cost tracking.

attributes.name: investigation_assigned_to_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surveillance Event Investigation Assigned To Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Post‑market surveillance investigations are assigned to an employee; FK enables investigation tracking.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production lot or batch implicated in the surveillance event for traceability and potential recall scope determination.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Current Good Manufacturing Practice; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product (SKU) implicated in the surveillance event.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number of the affected product for traceability and scope analysis.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 Cosmetics GMP

attributes.name: consumer_complaint_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the consumer complaint or adverse event as reported, capturing symptoms, circumstances, and product usage context.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803.3; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act

attributes.name: corrective_action_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was fully implemented and verified for effectiveness.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Corrective Action; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action plan implemented or planned to address the root cause and prevent recurrence.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Corrective Action Process; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required based on the investigation findings and risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Corrective Action; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the surveillance event record was first created in the system for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: event_occurrence_date
attributes.description: Date when the adverse event or product issue actually occurred or was first observed by the consumer or reporter.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803; ISO 10377 Consumer Product Recall

attributes.name: event_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the surveillance signal was first received by the organization, marking the start of the regulatory clock for reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803.10 Reporting Requirements; CPSC Section 15(b) Immediate Reporting

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the post-market surveillance event investigation and resolution workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reported|under_investigation|root_cause_identified|corrective_action_pending|corrective_action_completed|closed|escalated_to_recall — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Corrective Action Process; FDA 21 CFR Part 806 Medical Device Corrections and Removals

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the post-market surveillance signal indicating the nature of the safety or quality concern.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date of the affected product, relevant for stability-related events.

attributes.name: financial_impact_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the surveillance event including investigation costs, corrective actions, potential recall costs, and liability exposure in USD.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; IFRS 37 Provisions

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country codes indicating the geographic markets where the affected product was distributed, pipe-separated for multiple countries.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number identifying the product involved in the surveillance event for international traceability.

attributes.name: injury_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the injury or adverse health effect reported by the consumer or healthcare provider.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act

attributes.name: injury_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveillance event involved a reported consumer injury or adverse health effect.

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the investigation was completed and root cause determination was finalized.

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal investigation of the surveillance event was initiated.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; FDA 21 CFR Part 820 Quality System Regulation

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the surveillance event record was last updated, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the affected product batch was manufactured, used for shelf-life and stability analysis.

attributes.name: medical_treatment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reported injury required medical treatment or healthcare intervention.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803.3 Serious Injury Definition

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the surveillance event record for accountability and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: recall_classification
attributes.description: FDA recall classification (Class I, II, III) or equivalent regulatory classification indicating the level of health hazard.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.3 Recall Classification; CPSC Recall Handbook

attributes.name: recall_initiated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveillance event resulted in a product recall or market withdrawal action.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 Enforcement Policy; ISO 10377 Consumer Product Recall

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Regulatory authority to which the surveillance event must be reported based on jurisdiction and product category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|CPSC|EPA|EU_RAPEX|Health_Canada|TGA_Australia|ANVISA_Brazil|CFDA_China|MHRA_UK|none — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; EU RAPEX Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_report_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference or tracking number assigned by the regulatory authority upon submission of the surveillance report.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803; CPSC Reporting Portal

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the mandatory regulatory report was submitted to the applicable authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveillance event triggers a mandatory regulatory reporting obligation to FDA, CPSC, EPA, or other authorities.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803; CPSC Section 15(b); EU RAPEX System

attributes.name: reporter_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the reporter for written communication and documentation exchange.

attributes.name: reporter_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the reporter for follow-up investigation and clarification.

attributes.name: reporter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who reported the surveillance event, required for follow-up and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803; GDPR Article 6 Lawful Processing

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the root cause for trending and analytics purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_defect|formulation_issue|packaging_failure|labeling_error|contamination|stability_failure|consumer_misuse|no_defect_found|under_investigation — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: root_cause_identified
attributes.description: Documented root cause of the surveillance event as determined through investigation, including manufacturing defect, formulation issue, packaging failure, or misuse.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Root Cause Analysis; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100 Corrective and Preventive Action

attributes.name: severity_classification
attributes.description: Risk-based severity rating of the surveillance event based on potential harm to consumers and regulatory impact.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803.3 Definitions; CPSC Risk Assessment Methodology

attributes.name: signal_source
attributes.description: Origin channel through which the post-market surveillance signal was received. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: consumer_direct|call_center|retailer|distributor|regulatory_authority|social_media|healthcare_provider|internal_audit — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry - Postmarket Surveillance; ISO 10377 Consumer Product Recall

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code of the affected product for traceability and inventory correlation.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards; Internal Product Master Data

attributes.name: surveillance_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the surveillance event, externally referenced in regulatory submissions and internal tracking systems.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803 - Medical Device Reporting; CPSC Section 15(b) Reporting

attributes.name: units_affected_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of product units potentially affected by the surveillance event, used for recall scope and risk assessment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 Recall Procedures; ISO 10377

products.name: product_recall
products.description: Product recall and market withdrawal master records initiated voluntarily or mandated by regulatory authorities. Captures recall class (Class I/II/III per FDA/CPSC), recall reason, affected SKUs, affected lot/batch numbers, recall scope (geographic, channel), initiation date, authority notification date, press release reference, quantity recalled, completion date, effectiveness check results, and consumer remedy type. SSOT for recall event management across all jurisdictions and authorities.

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product recall event. Primary key for the product recall record.

attributes.name: coordinator_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Recall Coordinator Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Recall coordination is managed by a specific employee; FK supports recall project management.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Recall expenses (logistics, disposal) are allocated to a cost center for budgeting and reporting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Product recalls are managed per jurisdiction; linking provides a normalized jurisdiction reference.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.logistics_shipment. Business justification: Recall execution must pinpoint shipments containing recalled items; linking product_recall to logistics_shipment supports targeted recall logistics and reporting.

attributes.name: affected_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of distribution channels impacted by recall (e.g., Retail, E-commerce, Wholesale, DSD, DTC). Defines which go-to-market channels received affected product.

attributes.name: affected_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where recalled products were distributed (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: affected_gtin_list
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) List
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GTIN/UPC/EAN codes for recalled products. Enables point-of-sale and supply chain identification of affected items.

attributes.name: affected_lot_batch_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of manufacturing lot or batch numbers included in the recall. Enables traceability to specific production runs.
attributes.references: GMP Batch Record Requirements, 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: affected_production_date_range_end
attributes.description: End date of the production date range for affected products. Used when recall spans multiple production dates.

attributes.name: affected_production_date_range_start
attributes.description: Start date of the production date range for affected products. Used when recall spans multiple production dates.

attributes.name: affected_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU codes for all product variants included in the recall. Links recall to specific product master records.

attributes.name: affected_states_provinces
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state or province codes where recalled products were distributed within countries. Used for regional recalls.

attributes.name: authority_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the company notified the relevant regulatory authority of the recall. FDA requires notification within 24 hours of recall initiation.

attributes.name: consumer_hotline_number
attributes.description: Toll-free or dedicated phone number for consumers to call with questions about the recall or to request remedies.

attributes.name: consumer_remedy_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for consumers on how to return, dispose of, or obtain remedy for recalled products. Includes contact information and process steps.

attributes.name: consumer_remedy_type
attributes.description: Type of corrective action or compensation offered to consumers who purchased recalled products. Defines how consumers are made whole.
attributes.references: CPSC Recall Remedy Guidelines, FDA Recall Guidelines

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan implemented to prevent recurrence of the issue that caused the recall.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 211.180 CAPA Requirements, ISO 9001 CAPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_date
attributes.description: Date when the recall effectiveness check was conducted to verify that all consignees were notified and appropriate action taken. FDA requires effectiveness checks at specified intervals.

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the recall effectiveness check. Effective: recall objectives met. Partially Effective: some objectives met. Ineffective: recall objectives not met. Pending: check in progress.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total financial cost of the recall including product value, logistics, disposal, consumer remedies, and administrative costs. Reported in company reporting currency.

attributes.name: health_hazard_evaluation
attributes.description: Assessment of the health risk posed by the recalled product. Describes potential adverse health consequences and likelihood of occurrence. Used to determine recall classification.

attributes.name: press_release_reference
attributes.description: Reference number, URL, or document identifier for the official press release or public announcement of the recall.

attributes.name: public_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the recall was publicly announced through press release, media, or regulatory agency posting.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Communications, CPSC Public Notification Requirements

attributes.name: quantity_recalled_units
attributes.description: Total number of product units subject to recall. Represents the volume of affected inventory across all distribution levels.

attributes.name: quantity_recovered_units
attributes.description: Number of recalled product units successfully recovered and removed from distribution. Used to calculate recall effectiveness.

attributes.name: recall_classification
attributes.description: FDA/CPSC classification of recall severity. Class I: dangerous or defective products that could cause serious health problems or death. Class II: products that might cause temporary health problem or slight threat of serious nature. Class III: products unlikely to cause adverse health reaction but violate FDA labeling or manufacturing regulations. Voluntary: company-initiated without regulatory mandate. Market Withdrawal: minor violation not subject to FDA legal action.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7, CPSC Recall Handbook

attributes.name: recall_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the recall was officially closed after all corrective actions were completed and effectiveness verified. Nullable for ongoing recalls.

attributes.name: recall_coordinator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the recall coordinator for internal and external communications regarding the recall event.

attributes.name: recall_coordinator_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the recall coordinator for urgent communications regarding the recall event.

attributes.name: recall_effectiveness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of recalled units successfully recovered (quantity_recovered_units / quantity_recalled_units * 100). FDA requires effectiveness checks to verify recall completion.

attributes.name: recall_initiation_date
attributes.description: Date when the company officially initiated the recall action. Marks the beginning of the recall event lifecycle.

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Official recall identification number assigned by the company or regulatory authority. External business identifier for the recall event.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Enterprise System, CPSC Recall Database

attributes.name: recall_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the root cause of the recall (e.g., contamination, mislabeling, undeclared allergen, packaging defect, microbial contamination, foreign material).
attributes.references: FDA Recall Reason Codes, Internal Quality Classification

attributes.name: recall_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the defect, hazard, or violation that triggered the recall. Includes specific product issue, potential health risk, and circumstances of discovery.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Guidelines, CPSC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: recall_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the recall action. Defines the market territories affected by the recall.

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recall event. Tracks progression from initiation through completion or termination.

attributes.name: recall_type
attributes.description: Distribution level at which the recall is executed. Consumer Level: product reached end consumers. Retail Level: product at retail stores. Wholesale Level: product at distribution centers. Manufacturing Level: product not yet distributed.

attributes.name: recall_website_url
attributes.description: URL of the dedicated webpage providing detailed recall information, consumer instructions, and remedy request forms.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recall record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recall record was last modified. Audit trail for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or regulatory body overseeing the recall (e.g., FDA, CPSC, EPA, Health Canada, EU Commission). May be multiple authorities for international recalls.
attributes.references: FDA, CPSC, EPA, International Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recall was mandated by a regulatory authority (True) or initiated voluntarily by the company (False).
attributes.references: FDA Recall Guidelines, CPSC Recall Authority

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the formal root cause analysis document or investigation report that identified the underlying cause of the product defect or contamination.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Management System, CAPA Process

products.name: jurisdiction
products.description: Reference master for regulatory jurisdictions defining the geographic and legal scope of regulatory requirements. Captures jurisdiction code, jurisdiction name, country/region, applicable regulatory framework (FDA, EU, ASEAN, GCC), market entry requirement type, language requirements for labeling, and notification vs. registration requirement flag. Used to drive multi-jurisdictional compliance workflows across registrations, labels, and submissions.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory jurisdiction. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to a parent jurisdiction if this jurisdiction is a sub-jurisdiction (e.g., a state within a country, or a country within a regional bloc). Null for top-level jurisdictions.

attributes.name: animal_testing_ban_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the jurisdiction prohibits the sale of products tested on animals (True) or allows it (False).
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation, Cruelty Free International

attributes.name: cfr_reference
attributes.description: The specific CFR title and part number applicable to this jurisdiction (e.g., 21 CFR Part 700 for cosmetics). Primarily used for US FDA jurisdictions.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to this jurisdiction.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Official email address for contacting the regulatory authority for this jurisdiction.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Official phone number for contacting the regulatory authority for this jurisdiction.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the primary country of the jurisdiction (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). For regional jurisdictions, this may represent the lead country or be null.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this jurisdiction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this jurisdiction definition and its requirements became effective.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this jurisdiction definition expires or is superseded. Null if currently active with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification or compliance is mandatory for products sold in this jurisdiction (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: ifra_compliance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Fragrance Association (IFRA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether compliance with IFRA standards for fragrance ingredients is required (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: ingredient_declaration_format
attributes.description: The required format for ingredient listing on labels: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients), CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service number), common name, or proprietary (brand-specific naming).
attributes.references: INCI, CAS Registry, FDA, EU Cosmetics Regulation

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the jurisdiction (e.g., US-FDA, EU-REACH, ASEAN-CCD).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., United States Food and Drug Administration, European Union REACH).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the jurisdiction record: active (in use), inactive (no longer applicable), pending (awaiting activation), superseded (replaced by newer version).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the jurisdiction scope: national (country-level), regional (multi-country bloc), supranational (international treaty), state/provincial (sub-national), or municipal (city-level).

attributes.name: labeling_language_primary
attributes.description: ISO 639 two- or three-letter code for the primary language required on product labels in this jurisdiction (e.g., en, fr, de, zh).

attributes.name: labeling_language_secondary
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639 language codes for additional languages required or recommended on labels (e.g., fr,nl for Belgium).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this jurisdiction record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: market_entry_requirement_type
attributes.description: The type of regulatory requirement for market entry: notification (simple filing), registration (formal registration), pre-market approval (full dossier review before sale), post-market surveillance (monitoring after launch), or voluntary (no mandatory requirement).

attributes.name: notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal notification to the regulatory authority is required before product launch (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: post_market_surveillance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ongoing post-market surveillance (adverse event reporting, product monitoring) is mandatory (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: pre_market_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether pre-market approval (full dossier review and authorization before sale) is required (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: product_information_file_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Product Information File (PIF) or dossier must be maintained and made available to authorities (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: reach_registration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether REACH registration for chemical substances is required for this jurisdiction (True) or not (False). Primarily applicable to EU and EEA jurisdictions.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Code representing the geographic region or economic bloc (e.g., EU, ASEAN, GCC, MERCOSUR). Used for multi-country jurisdictions.

attributes.name: registration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal product registration with the regulatory authority is mandatory (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the governing regulatory body or agency responsible for enforcement within this jurisdiction (e.g., FDA, EPA, CPSC, European Commission).

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The primary legal or regulatory framework governing this jurisdiction (e.g., FDA 21 CFR, EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009, ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, GCC Standardization Organization).

attributes.name: responsible_person_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a designated Responsible Person (RP) within the jurisdiction is required for regulatory compliance (True) or not (False). Common in EU jurisdictions.

attributes.name: sds_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) must be provided for products in this jurisdiction (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: submission_portal_url
attributes.description: URL of the online portal or system used for submitting regulatory notifications, registrations, or dossiers to this jurisdiction.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regulatory Authority Website Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: Official website URL of the regulatory authority for this jurisdiction, providing access to regulations, guidance documents, and submission portals.

products.name: restricted_substance
products.description: Master record for all chemicals, ingredients, and materials subject to prohibition, restriction, authorization, or disclosure under any applicable regulation worldwide. Captures substance name, CAS number, EC number, restriction type (banned, concentration limit, disclosure required, authorization required), applicable regulation(s), REACH registration number, tonnage band, SVHC status, authorization status, maximum permitted concentration, effective date, downstream user notification obligations, and affected product categories. SSOT for all regulated substance data including EU REACH, California Prop 65, FDA prohibited ingredients, EPA restricted chemicals, and FIFRA substances.
products.reference: EU REACH SVHC / California Prop 65 / FDA Prohibited Ingredients

attributes.name: restricted_substance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the restricted substance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Restricted substances are subject to jurisdiction‑specific regulations; linking provides a proper reference and removes the duplicated code.

attributes.name: affected_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories or SKU families in which this substance is restricted or prohibited (e.g., cosmetics, household cleaners, food contact materials, children's products).
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC), CPSC Product Categories

attributes.name: alternative_substance_recommendations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CAS numbers or substance names recommended as safer alternatives for formulation substitution.
attributes.references: EPA Safer Choice Program, EU REACH Substitution Plans

attributes.name: applicable_regulations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all regulations, directives, or legal frameworks under which this substance is restricted (e.g., EU REACH, California Prop 65, FDA 21 CFR 700, EPA FIFRA, CPSC regulations).
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation, California Prop 65, FDA CFR, EPA regulations, CPSC guidelines

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current status of regulatory authorization for use of the substance in specific applications or markets.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation Title VII, FDA Pre-Market Approval

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance described in the open scientific literature.
attributes.references: CAS Registry, OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: cfr_reference
attributes.description: Specific CFR title, part, and section citation(s) that govern the use, labeling, or prohibition of this substance in the United States.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special handling instructions, or notes regarding the restricted substance and its regulatory status.

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the maximum permitted concentration: percent by weight, percent by volume, parts per million (ppm), parts per billion (ppb), or milligrams per kilogram.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this restricted substance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: downstream_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether manufacturers and importers must notify downstream users (formulators, distributors, retailers) of the presence of this substance in articles or mixtures.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation Article 33, SCIP Database

attributes.name: ec_number
attributes.description: Seven-digit identifier assigned to chemical substances for regulatory purposes within the European Union.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation, EINECS (European Inventory of Existing Commercial Chemical Substances)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the restriction or regulatory requirement becomes legally enforceable.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation, FDA Federal Register Notices

attributes.name: epa_restricted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Restricted Chemical Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substance is subject to EPA restrictions under TSCA, FIFRA, or other environmental regulations.
attributes.references: EPA TSCA, FIFRA (Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act)

attributes.name: fda_prohibited_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Prohibited Ingredient Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substance is explicitly prohibited by the FDA for use in cosmetics, drugs, or food contact materials under CFR Title 21.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard class and category codes assigned to the substance (e.g., Acute Tox. 3, Skin Corr. 1B, Carc. 1A) for safety data sheet and labeling purposes.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals), OSHA HCS

attributes.name: ifra_prohibition_category
attributes.description: IFRA product category (1-11) in which the substance is prohibited or restricted, ranging from Category 1 (lip products) to Category 11 (non-skin contact products).

attributes.name: ifra_standard_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable IFRA Standard number and amendment that governs the use of this substance in fragrance compounds.
attributes.references: IFRA Standards, IFRA Code of Practice

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this restricted substance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the restricted substance record was last reviewed for regulatory updates, new restrictions, or changes in applicable law.

attributes.name: maximum_permitted_concentration
attributes.description: Maximum allowable concentration of the substance in finished products, expressed as a percentage by weight or volume, as defined by applicable regulations.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex II/III, FDA CFR Title 21

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next periodic review of this restricted substance record is scheduled to ensure ongoing compliance with evolving regulations.

attributes.name: owning_team
