attributes.name: lot_batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the affected product units. Essential for determining scope of hazard and recall.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date_range_end
attributes.description: End date of the manufacturing period for affected product units.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date_range_start
attributes.description: Start date of the manufacturing period for affected product units.

attributes.name: population_at_risk
attributes.description: Description of consumer population particularly vulnerable to the hazard (e.g., children under 3, elderly, pregnant women). Used for targeted warnings and recalls.

attributes.name: product_model_number
attributes.description: Specific model or SKU number of the product involved in the incident. Critical for identifying affected units.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial name of the product involved in the CPSC filing as known to consumers.

attributes.name: recall_announced_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a public recall has been announced in conjunction with this filing. True if recall press release issued.

attributes.name: recall_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date the product recall was publicly announced via CPSC press release and website posting.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the regulatory contact for official CPSC correspondence.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory affairs contact responsible for managing this filing and CPSC communications.

attributes.name: saferproducts_report_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the report in the SaferProducts.gov public database if the filing resulted in a public posting.

attributes.name: submitted_by_email
attributes.description: Email address of the submitter for CPSC correspondence and follow-up communications.

attributes.name: submitted_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who submitted the filing to CPSC on behalf of the company.

attributes.name: supporting_document_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents attached to the filing (test reports, photos, consumer complaints, medical records, etc.).

attributes.name: units_affected
attributes.description: Estimated number of product units in commerce that are subject to the reported hazard. Used to assess population at risk.

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of units of the affected product sold to consumers. Helps determine recall scope and consumer notification requirements.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit UPC barcode of the product involved in the filing. Used for retail identification and tracking.

attributes.name: vault_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the document management system (Veeva Vault) where all filing documentation is stored.

products.name: epa_registration
products.description: EPA pesticide and antimicrobial product registration records under FIFRA (Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act). Captures EPA registration number, product name, active ingredient(s), registration type (new, amendment, renewal, cancellation), registration date, expiry date, use classification (general/restricted), label approval status, and data call-in requirements. Applicable to household disinfectants, insecticides, and antimicrobial cleaning products.

attributes.name: epa_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EPA registration record. Primary key for this product.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal facility master record for the manufacturing site producing this registered product. Links EPA registration to internal facility management.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal product master record for the registered product. Links this EPA registration to the company's product catalog.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory submission record that resulted in this EPA registration. Links to the submission dossier and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: active_ingredient_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of active ingredient(s) in the registered product. Each active ingredient is the chemical substance responsible for the pesticidal or antimicrobial effect. Format: Chemical Name (CAS Number); Chemical Name (CAS Number).

attributes.name: active_ingredient_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage concentration of each active ingredient in the formulation. Corresponds to the active_ingredient_list. Format: percentage values separated by semicolons matching the ingredient list order.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA registration was cancelled, either voluntarily by the registrant or involuntarily by EPA. Nullable for active registrations.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the EPA registration was cancelled. Includes voluntary cancellation reasons (e.g., product discontinuation, business decision) or involuntary reasons (e.g., safety concerns, data deficiencies, regulatory non-compliance).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this EPA registration. May include internal notes on registration strategy, EPA correspondence summaries, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: company_number
attributes.description: Five-digit EPA company number assigned to the registrant. This is the first component of the EPA registration number and identifies the company holding the registration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EPA registration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_call_in_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the registrant must submit data or studies in response to an EPA data call-in. Failure to meet this deadline may result in registration cancellation.

attributes.name: data_call_in_requirement
attributes.description: Description of any outstanding data call-in requirements issued by EPA. Data call-ins require registrants to submit additional studies or data to support continued registration. Includes requirement reference number and due date.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA registration becomes legally effective and the product may be manufactured, distributed, and sold under this registration.

attributes.name: epa_establishment_number
attributes.description: EPA establishment number identifying the facility where the product is manufactured. Format: Company Number-State Code-Facility Number (e.g., 12345-CA-001). Required on product labels.

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: Official EPA registration number assigned under FIFRA. Format: Company Number-Product Number-Supplemental Number (e.g., 12345-67 or 12345-67-890). This is the externally-known unique identifier for the registered pesticide or antimicrobial product.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA registration expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Nullable for registrations without a fixed expiration (subject to periodic review).

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Physical form and delivery method of the registered product. Determines packaging, application method, and handling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: liquid|aerosol|wipe|powder|granular|tablet|gel|paste|ready_to_use|concentrate — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: label_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the current label version was approved by EPA. Critical for compliance tracking and ensuring only approved labels are used.

attributes.name: label_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the EPA-approved product label. The label must be approved before the product can be marketed. Approved = label accepted by EPA, Pending Review = submitted awaiting EPA review, Conditionally Approved = approved with minor changes required, Rejected = label not acceptable, Revision Required = EPA requested changes.

attributes.name: label_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the currently approved EPA label. Used to track label revisions and ensure correct label is in use for manufacturing and distribution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EPA registration record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renewal action for this EPA registration. Used to track renewal history and calculate next renewal due date.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next renewal application must be submitted to EPA to maintain continuous registration status. Critical for compliance planning.

attributes.name: product_brand_name
attributes.description: Commercial brand name under which the product is marketed to consumers. May differ from the registered product name.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: EPA product classification category based on intended use and target pest. Antimicrobial = broad-spectrum microbial control, Disinfectant = kills bacteria/viruses on surfaces, Sanitizer = reduces microbial load, Insecticide = controls insects, Rodenticide = controls rodents, Fungicide = controls fungi, Herbicide = controls weeds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: antimicrobial|disinfectant|sanitizer|insecticide|rodenticide|fungicide|herbicide — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Official product name as registered with EPA. This is the name that appears on the approved label and in EPA databases.

attributes.name: registrant_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the company or entity holding the EPA registration. This is the party legally responsible for the registered product.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA registration was officially granted or approved by the Environmental Protection Agency. This is the principal business event timestamp for this registration record.

attributes.name: registration_review_case_number
attributes.description: EPA case number for the periodic registration review process. EPA reviews all pesticide registrations on a 15-year cycle to ensure they continue to meet safety standards.

attributes.name: registration_review_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when EPA issued the most recent registration review decision for this product. Used to track compliance with periodic review requirements.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the EPA registration. Active = currently valid and marketable, Pending = application submitted awaiting EPA decision, Approved = EPA approved but not yet effective, Suspended = temporarily not valid, Cancelled = permanently terminated, Expired = validity period ended, Withdrawn = applicant withdrew before approval. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|pending|approved|suspended|cancelled|expired|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Type of EPA registration action. New = initial registration, Amendment = modification to existing registration, Renewal = periodic renewal, Reregistration = compliance with updated data requirements, Cancellation = voluntary or involuntary termination, Conditional = approved pending additional data, Emergency Exemption = Section 18 emergency use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|amendment|renewal|reregistration|cancellation|conditional|emergency_exemption — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary regulatory affairs contact for this EPA registration. Used for internal coordination and EPA correspondence tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory affairs contact responsible for managing this EPA registration. Internal point of contact for registration maintenance and EPA correspondence.

attributes.name: reregistration_eligibility_decision
attributes.description: EPA determination of whether the product is eligible for reregistration under updated safety and environmental standards. Eligible = meets current standards, Ineligible = does not meet standards and requires reformulation or cancellation, Pending = under EPA review, Not Applicable = not subject to reregistration.

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: Required signal word on the product label indicating relative acute toxicity. Danger = highest toxicity (Category I), Warning = moderate toxicity (Category II), Caution = lower toxicity (Category III), None = minimal toxicity (Category IV).

attributes.name: target_pest_list
attributes.description: List of target pests, pathogens, or organisms that the product is registered to control (e.g., bacteria, viruses, mold, ants, cockroaches). Defines the approved efficacy claims.

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: EPA classification determining who may purchase and apply the product. General Use = available to general public, Restricted Use = requires certified applicator due to potential hazards to environment or applicator.

attributes.name: use_site_description
attributes.description: Description of approved use sites and application locations for the registered product (e.g., household surfaces, food contact surfaces, hospitals, schools, outdoor residential). Defines where the product may legally be applied.

attributes.name: vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the EPA registration documents stored in the regulatory document vault system (e.g., Veeva Vault). Links to approved labels, safety data sheets, and registration correspondence.

products.name: change
products.description: Tracks new, amended, or repealed regulations and standards that may impact the company's products or operations. Captures change source (regulatory authority, industry body), change type (new regulation, amendment, repeal, guidance update), affected product categories, affected jurisdictions, impact assessment status, required action deadline, responsible regulatory affairs owner, and implementation status. Drives proactive regulatory intelligence and ensures timely compliance adaptation.

attributes.name: change_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the regulatory change record.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Regulatory changes are tied to a specific jurisdiction; linking enables consistent jurisdiction lookup and removes the duplicated code column.

attributes.name: regulatory_change_responsible_owner_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regulatory Change Responsible Owner Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory change implementation is owned by a specific employee; linking records ownership for change management.

attributes.name: affected_product_category
attributes.description: Product category or categories impacted by the regulatory change.

attributes.name: affected_product_scope
attributes.description: Scope description of the products impacted (e.g., all SKUs in a brand, specific formulations).

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: High‑level category of the regulatory change.

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the regulatory change, including scope and rationale.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the regulatory authority or internal tracking system.

attributes.name: change_source
attributes.description: Origin of the change (regulatory authority, industry body, court decision).

attributes.name: change_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory change record.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the change (new regulation, amendment, repeal, guidance update).

attributes.name: compliance_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk rating associated with non‑compliance to the change.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the regulatory change record was first created.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory change becomes effective for the business.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory change ceases to be applicable, if applicable.

attributes.name: impact_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date the impact assessment was completed or recorded.

attributes.name: impact_assessment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the impact assessment process.

attributes.name: impact_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the regulatory impact on the business.

attributes.name: implementation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when implementation activities were completed.

attributes.name: implementation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when implementation activities began.

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the implementation of required actions.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether compliance with the change is mandatory (true) or optional (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the regulatory change record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form notes or comments regarding the change.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the change for planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference number of the regulation (e.g., CFR section, EU directive).

attributes.name: required_action_deadline
attributes.description: Latest date by which required compliance actions must be taken.

attributes.name: source_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority issuing the change (e.g., FDA, EPA).

attributes.name: source_body
attributes.description: Governing body or standard organization responsible for the change.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief title summarizing the regulatory change.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Link to the official document or announcement describing the change.

attributes.name: superseded_change_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on change (superseded_change_id)

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Owns human capital and workforce management data. Manages employee master records, organizational structure, payroll, benefits, talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, workforce planning, OSHA safety incident records, training records, and labor compliance across manufacturing and commercial operations. Integrates with Workday HCM.

products.name: employee
products.description: Core master record for every worker across manufacturing plants, commercial offices, distribution centers, and field sales teams. Stores legal name, employee ID, national ID, employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, seasonal), hire date, termination date, employment status, job title, job code, cost center, business unit, plant/site assignment, manager reference, pay grade, FLSA classification, union membership flag, Workday HCM worker ID, contract terms (type, notice period, probation, working hours, shift pattern, CBA reference), emergency contact, and employment action history (hire, promotion, transfer, termination, LOA with effective dates and reason codes). SSOT for all workforce identity, employment lifecycle, and worker demographic data integrated from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee record. Primary key for the employee entity.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the direct manager or supervisor to whom this employee reports. Used for organizational hierarchy and reporting structure.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: High-level organizational division or business unit to which the employee belongs (e.g., Manufacturing, Sales, R&D, Supply Chain).

attributes.name: cba_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name of the collective bargaining agreement that governs the employee's terms and conditions, if applicable. Null for non-union employees.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled end date of the current employment contract. Null for permanent or at-will contracts without a defined end date.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current employment contract or agreement.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of employment contract governing the employee's terms: permanent (indefinite), fixed-term (specific end date), at-will (terminable by either party), or project-based (tied to specific project completion).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center to which the employee's compensation and expenses are allocated. Used for budgeting and financial reporting.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Specific department within the business unit where the employee works (e.g., Quality Control, Brand Marketing, Procurement).

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary corporate email address assigned to the employee for business communication.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person to be contacted in case of an emergency involving the employee.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the emergency contact person.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact to the employee (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling, friend).

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the employee: active (working), inactive (not currently working), leave (on approved leave), terminated (employment ended), suspended (temporarily not working), or probation (trial period).

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's working arrangement: full-time, part-time, contract, seasonal, temporary, or intern.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the employee is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the employee was originally hired by the organization. Used for tenure calculations, benefits eligibility, and anniversary tracking.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized internal code representing the job classification or position type. Used for compensation benchmarking, workforce planning, and reporting.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position name assigned to the employee (e.g., Manufacturing Supervisor, Sales Representative, Quality Analyst).

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: Employee's legal first name as it appears on government-issued identification and payroll records.

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: Employee's legal last name (surname/family name) as it appears on government-issued identification and payroll records.

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: Employee's legal middle name or initial as it appears on government-issued identification.

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in USA, National Insurance Number in UK). Used for payroll, tax reporting, and legal compliance.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of advance notice required for voluntary resignation or termination as specified in the employment contract.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade or band assigned to the employee's position. Used for salary administration and compensation planning.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the employee (mobile or desk phone).

attributes.name: plant_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical manufacturing plant, distribution center, office location, or field territory where the employee is primarily assigned.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the employee prefers to be called in day-to-day business interactions, which may differ from legal name.

attributes.name: probation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's probationary period ends. Null if probation has been completed or does not apply.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard shift schedule or rotation pattern assigned to the employee (e.g., day shift, night shift, rotating 3-shift, 4-on-4-off). Particularly relevant for manufacturing and distribution center workers.

attributes.name: standard_working_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Contractual number of hours the employee is expected to work per week (e.g., 40.00 for full-time, 20.00 for part-time).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's employment ended. Null for active employees. Used for offboarding, final payroll, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for employment termination (e.g., voluntary resignation, involuntary termination, retirement, end of contract). Null for active employees.

attributes.name: union_membership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a member of a labor union or covered by a collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Name of the labor union to which the employee belongs, if applicable. Null for non-union employees.

attributes.name: work_location_city
attributes.description: City where the employee's primary work location is situated.

attributes.name: work_location_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the employee primarily works (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: work_location_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the employee's primary work location is situated.

attributes.name: workday_worker_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) Worker ID
attributes.description: External system identifier from Workday HCM. Used for integration and reconciliation with the source system of record.

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Organizational hierarchy unit representing departments, divisions, business units, cost centers, and plant-level teams within the consumer goods enterprise. Stores org unit code, name, org unit type (department, division, plant, region, team), parent org unit reference, effective date range, cost center code, GL account mapping, and responsible manager. Supports multi-level org hierarchy traversal for headcount reporting, labor cost allocation, and S&OP workforce planning.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational unit. Primary key for the org_unit data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center associated with this organizational unit for financial tracking and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is the responsible manager or leader of this organizational unit.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the hierarchy. Enables multi-level org hierarchy traversal for reporting and analytics. Null for top-level units.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Annual budget allocation for this organizational unit in the reporting currency. Used for financial planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amount. Supports multi-currency financial consolidation.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Business unit or division code for management reporting and performance analysis. Supports segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code to which this organizational unit belongs. Used for statutory reporting and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this organizational unit is domiciled. Used for regulatory compliance and labor law adherence.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this organizational unit record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_headcount
attributes.description: Current number of employees assigned to this organizational unit. Updated periodically for workforce analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit ceased or will cease to be active. Null for currently active units. Enables point-in-time org structure reconstruction.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit became or will become active and operational. Supports temporal hierarchy analysis and historical reporting.

attributes.name: external_code
attributes.description: External system identifier or legacy code for this organizational unit. Used for integration with third-party systems and data migration tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for posting labor costs and expenses associated with this organizational unit. Supports financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: headcount_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum planned headcount capacity for this organizational unit. Used in workforce planning and S&OP labor capacity analysis.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this organizational unit in the enterprise hierarchy. Level 1 is top-level, increasing numbers indicate deeper nesting. Supports hierarchy traversal and reporting.

attributes.name: is_commercial_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is a commercial or sales unit. Used to segment commercial workforce for sales force automation and trade promotion planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: is_manufacturing_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is a manufacturing or production unit. Used to segment manufacturing workforce from commercial operations.

attributes.name: is_support_function
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is a corporate support function (HR, Finance, IT, Legal). Used for overhead allocation and indirect labor analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this organizational unit record. Supports change management and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or site code where this organizational unit operates. Used for facility management and workforce planning.

attributes.name: org_unit_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the organizational unit. Used in reporting, financial systems, and operational processes. Must be unique within the enterprise.

attributes.name: org_unit_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the organizational units purpose, responsibilities, and scope within the enterprise.

attributes.name: org_unit_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the organizational unit as it appears in corporate communications and reporting.

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit. Active units are operational and can have employees assigned. Inactive or closed units are historical.

attributes.name: org_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit indicating its role in the enterprise hierarchy. Supports segmentation for headcount reporting and S&OP workforce planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: department|division|business_unit|plant|region|team|cost_center|function|subsidiary|branch — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or production facility code for plant-level organizational units. Supports MES integration and production workforce planning.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for regional organizational units. Supports geographic segmentation in sales and operations planning.

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: OSHA safety risk classification for this organizational unit based on work environment and hazard exposure. Used for safety incident tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or short name of the organizational unit for display in constrained UI contexts and reports.

attributes.name: union_representation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees in this organizational unit are represented by a labor union. Used for labor compliance and collective bargaining agreement tracking.

products.name: position
products.description: Approved headcount position within the organizational structure representing a budgeted role slot. Stores position code, position title, job profile, org unit, plant/site, position type (permanent, temporary, seasonal), FTE allocation, budgeted headcount, filled/vacant status, effective date, and requisition linkage. Enables workforce planning, vacancy tracking, and labor budget management aligned with Workday HCM Position Management.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approved headcount position within the organizational structure. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center that bears the financial responsibility for this position's compensation and benefits.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized job profile that defines the role responsibilities, competencies, and requirements for this position.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary work location (plant, site, office, distribution center) where this position is based.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit (department, division, or business unit) to which this position belongs.

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active recruitment requisition for this position if it is currently vacant and being recruited for.

attributes.name: supervisor_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position that supervises this position, establishing the reporting hierarchy within the organizational structure.

attributes.name: budgeted_headcount
attributes.description: The approved headcount allocation for this position in the annual workforce budget. May differ from FTE for shared or split positions.

attributes.name: compensation_grade
attributes.description: The compensation grade or pay band assigned to this position, defining the salary range and compensation structure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this position record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_position_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is designated as business-critical, requiring succession planning and priority filling due to its impact on operations.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the salary range (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this position was or will be eliminated or made inactive. Null for positions with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this position became active and available for assignment within the organizational structure.

attributes.name: employment_type

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `consumer_goods_ecm`.`_metrics`.`consumer_cltv_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic CLTV and revenue forecasting metrics"
  source: "`consumer_goods_ecm`.`consumer`.`cltv_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "calculation_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', calculation_date)
      comment: "Month of CLTV calculation"
    - name: "cltv_tier"
      expr: cltv_tier
      comment: "CLTV tier classification"
    - name: "primary_brand_code"
      expr: primary_brand_code
      comment: "Primary brand associated with the customer"
    - name: "primary_category_code"
      expr: primary_category_code
      comment: "Primary product category for the customer"
    - name: "primary_channel"
      expr: primary_channel
      comment: "Primary sales channel for the customer"
  measures:
    - name: "customer_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of customers with a CLTV record"
    - name: "average_cltv_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cltv_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average Customer Lifetime Value score"
    - name: "average_predicted_revenue_12m"
      expr: AVG(CAST(predicted_revenue_12m AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average predicted revenue for next 12 months"
    - name: "average_purchase_frequency"
      expr: AVG(CAST(purchase_frequency AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average purchase frequency per customer"
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic CLTV and revenue forecasting metrics

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `consumer_goods_ecm`.`_metrics`.`consumer_dtc_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Key financial and volume metrics for direct-to-consumer orders"
  source: "`consumer_goods_ecm`.`consumer`.`dtc_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "order_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
      comment: "Month of the order (UTC)"
    - name: "order_status"
      expr: order_status
      comment: "Current status of the order"
    - name: "channel_code"
      expr: channel_code
      comment: "Channel through which the order was placed"
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Payment method used for the order"
  measures:
